title_original: ママって呼んでもいいのかな？ ～私が赤ちゃんになるまで～
description: Ichika, a young girl in the pharmacy department of a university, was busy balancing her daily studies with a part-time job to earn money for university fees. She was in danger of one day having to stay in university. Then she hears a story about a friend of hers who made a lot of money with a secret part-time job. Ichika's family is a single parent and she has younger siblings, so if she were to stay in university, it would cause problems for her family...with this in mind, she accesses a website where secret part-time jobs are listed. On the website, she sees an offer from a woman for "500,000 yen for two weeks of play," and decides that if the play partner is a woman...she will take her up on the offer. [From DLsite English]

characters.name: Houjou Ichika
characters.description: She is a strong older sister who grew up taking care of her younger brothers in a single father's home. She's trying to become a pharmacist to get a job that will help her family's finances, but she's having a very hard time due to the difficulty of her studies. [Edited from Itch.io]

characters.name: Komano Hinata
characters.description: A tall woman with a calm demeanor. She has a secret that she can't tell anyone, and wants a baby of her own. [Edited from Itch.io]

description: "Problem Child" me, Class Heartthrob her—two lines that should never cross collided through a series of coincidences, shattering my monochrome world. Crave her eyes on me alone, crave her world with me alone. The pure longing in my heart gradually begins to twist. [From Steam]

characters.name: Yun Xinyao
characters.description: She usually speaks with coldness and disdain, so she is often avoided and called a "problem girl". Likes: Nothing in particular. [Translated from Steam]

title: Possessioner
description: The year is 2035. A series of mysterious incidents began to occur in Tokyo. Young women disappeared under strange circumstances, and returned brainwashed, commanding armies of bionic monsters and assaulting human settlements. Such women were called "Possessioners". A special all-female squad was formed to face them in combat and bring them back to humanity. Possessioner is primarily a Japanese-style adventure game. The player selects verb commands from a menu and combines them with objects appearing afterwards to interact with the environment and trigger events. Navigation is menu-based as well. The game also contains sporadic turn-based battles against the Possessioners and their minions. Four female combatants have a variety of attacks at their disposal, but the battles are fairly simple and there is no role-playing system. The game contains scenes with nudity and explicit, exclusively

title: Queen Of Thieves
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: For a long time, the three sisters Joanne, Kira and Thalia were on their own, living their separate lives. They believed their mother Arianna, the Queen of Thieves, to be dead, executed twenty years ago in the town of Ahkra by the villainous Lord Raul Capello. One day, their father Lysander calls them to Ahkra. He has big news: their mother, and his wife, could still be alive! At least, that's what a mysterious figure is telling him. They seem to be the only one who knows what's really going on, and they’re willing to help the sisters, for a price. They'll need to follow in their mother's footsteps, robbing from the rich to meet the increasingly outrageous demands of their mysterious benefactor.

characters.name: Kira
characters.description: Kira is the middle child and often feels the pressure of such a position. During her younger days, she always found herself trapped between Joanne and Thalia when they were fighting. She sympathised with her older sibling’s desire to help them all grow up but she also found herself agreeing with her younger sister that Joanne was not their mother and had no right to act that way. In the end, she usually ended up siding with Thalia but occasionally she would agree with Joanne when their youngest sibling just went too far with her teasing. When she was old enough to leave home, she moved to a town a few miles away from Triberg to work as a guard. She enjoyed the life very much. There was a comradery amongst the guards that she had not experienced before and it made her happy to live amongst such a large group in their barracks. characters.name: Thalia
characters.description: Thalia is the youngest and more rebellious of the Queen of Thieves’ children. She is short, scrawny and not particularly strong but she has been blessed with great agility. Throughout her life, she has used that skill to great effect to play pranks on her older siblings and overall make a nuisance of herself. She was the first to leave the family home at the age of fifteen and seek out a ‘better life’. Soon after, Thalia found herself working as an acrobat in a troupe of traveling performers. She was very good at it and soon found herself performing in front of many rich and powerful people throughout the world. Her travels brought her into contact with many people and she found all of them interesting. As part of her exploration, she found making love to those new attractive people she met was the best way to get to know them. She slept with men and women of all shapes and sizes. Specie

characters.name: Joanne
characters.description: Joanne is the oldest of the Queen of Thieves daughters and the only one born with the gift of magic. From a very young age, she was able to instinctively use her abilities to all kinds of magic. Her ambition when she was a child was to go to a famous school of magic and learn how better to use her gifts. Her dream fell apart, however, on the day her mother was captured. With her gone, she was the only one left, apart from her father, who could care for her younger siblings. She became almost a surrogate mother to Kira and Thalia. Her younger sisters have not always appreciated this but they understand what she had to give up to do it. Unlike her sisters, Joanne has no real experience with romance. characters.name: Fredrick Holtzer
characters.description: Fredrick has been a lifelong resident of Ahkra. He was born in the town and expects to die there. His family has been living in the area for generations and he has some pride in that. Even when things might be better elsewhere, he has rather stubbornly refused to move on. He currently runs a rather successful shop selling all kinds of goods. The middle classes and even some nobles frequently patronize his establishment leaving him relatively well-off compared to many others under the rule of Lord Raul. His success has made him rather unpopular with his fellow merchants but he cares little for that. So long as those that count him as friends like him then he cares little for those he is not friends with. He does not make real friends easily, however, so there are few that have a high opinion of him in Ahkra. Most consider Fredrick a troublemaker who has no respect for the rules of busines

characters.name: Tiberius Celsus
characters.description: The captain of the guard has served Lord Raul for all of his adult life. He joined the city guard as soon as he was old enough and quickly rose through the ranks. Due to his tall height and build, most assume him to be a mindless thug but that could not be further from the truth. Tiberius is an extremely thoughtful person although he can come across as being rather slow because of this. He thinks things through from all sides before coming to a conclusion. This can frustrate some, but he can be stubborn when others try to force him to move at their pace. Tiberius is extremely popular with the women of Ahkra, although as yet he is not known to have had any real relationship with any. It has led to rumours of him having interests outside of women although he has always denied such accusations when questioned. Asking him about such things is one of the sure ways to embarrass him. His female

characters.name: Melvin Thorburn
characters.description: Very few people in Ahkra really know Melvin. He is the scion of a long-standing noble family although rumours persist that he is the last of his line, and his estate is essentially empty except for him. His family fell out of favour with Lord Raul due to issues dating back to Melvin’s childhood, and it appears Raul has little interest in burying the hatchet. Mostly, he is seen visiting various business in the city, and buying all sorts of strange items that may no logical sense when put together. No one quite knows what he is up to although there are many who are curious. Those few who have interacted with Melvin find him rather charming albeit somewhat vain. He tends to agree with any compliments given to him and has gained quite a reputation as a womaniser. Many do fall for his good looks and charming words, thinking they have won the heart of a noble, but all have ended up disappointe

characters.name: Moirgane Mercier
characters.description: More commonly known as ‘Girl!’ or ‘Hey you!’, Moirgane is the long suffering waitress at the biggest tavern in Ahkra. She has been working there for several years now and knows practically everyone in town because of it. No one has a bad word to say about her and she is very popular with her often surly employer. Moirgane can be a little awkward when around people she is not familiar with, but she tends to warm to people quickly. She has a reputation for being kind and accommodating, something she is quite proud of although it embarrasses her to be praised in front of others. Many do not realise it, but the waitress is actually extremely intelligent and particularly gifted when it comes to working with numbers. She does not keep this fact a secret, but it so rarely comes up in conversation at a tavern that many assume she works as a waitress because she was too stupid to do anything else

characters.name: Therjalla Arme’Fallanerien
characters.description: No one really knows who Therjalla is apart from being Ahkra’s new healer. The old and much maligned healer died very suddenly a couple of weeks before the sisters arrived in town, and the priests of the temple begged the traveling elf to stay on as temporary healer, until a replacement could be sent from the order’s headquarters hundreds of miles away. She agreed to do so, as despite being a scholar first, she still held to her vow as a healer, and could not let the people be without one for however many weeks it will take for a replacement to be sent. Outside of healing, Therjalla keeps to herself at all times and talks to no one, except to collect various supplies she has brought in, to aid her research into the various herbs and plant life of the world. Several people have spotted her roaming the woods at night, collecting samples and carrying them back to the temple where she stays,

characters.name: Arianna Spiros
characters.description: Daughter of a very successful merchant, Arianna was popular with both nobles and commoners alike. She was often seen in the company of all kinds and no one thought badly of her for it. Most famously, she was fought over by a young Raul Capello and Lysander Spiros. In the end, Lysander prevailed and Raul never forgave him for it. Arianna herself felt great affection for both of them, and likely loved both of them too, but there was something dangerous about Raul that made her decide it was better to spend her life with the poorer Lysander than live a life of luxury with the Capello family. Arianna is a very strong willed woman with a big heart who finds it difficult to say no to people. It was perhaps why she took so long over her decision on who to marry which led to the grudge that developed between Raul and Lysander. Despite that, she still believes in doing what is right even if that

characters.name: Mary-Ann Folami
characters.description: When Mary-Ann was an infant, her grandparents and parents left the Broken Lands to settle in Ahkra. Her grandfather started a forge in service to Lord Raul’s father and soon her family began to prosper. That ended shortly after Raul came to power. Her grandfather had died by then and Raul had little interest in the services of Mary-Ann’s father. They were cast out of his castle and were left to man a forge in the city. Gone was the creation of unique weapons and armour, replaced by horseshoes and other simple things that any competent blacksmith could make. Shortly before turning eighteen, Mary-Ann’s parents died and she found herself alone. She decided to take over the family forge and has served as the town blacksmith ever since. title: Planet Stronghold: Colonial Defense
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Planet Stronghold: Colonial Defense brings you back in time in the early settlement days of the Planet Stronghold colony. By a bizarre coincidence, two captains, two siblings, get stuck in the same colony: Alex and Diana Nelson. Take control of one of them, and discover the mysteries and the dangers of Planet Stronghold, and the personalities of the various characters of your team. The game features a big card-collectible gameplay part, easy to learn but hard to master. Upgradable cards brings even more replayability, especially at higher difficulty levels. For those looking forward more to the story and visual novel/dating sim aspect, you can play the game in "Visual Novel Mode" and enjoy the game dialogues and the beautiful painted artwork style: there are eight characters to befriend, and if you play your cards right, romance!

title: Love & Dehumanization
description: This is an adult visual novel that takes place in a fantasy RPG world. A girl willingly becomes a monster and is subject to brutal violence. Though she doesn't realize it, hope is somehow waiting on the other side of this cruelty. At its core, this story is about the desire to be violated and dehumanized, to be viewed as lesser, to be stripped of your autonomy. It is a story about how this desire manifests and inflicts itself, how it hurts and traumatizes us, and how to reclaim it in the name of catharsis and love. [From itch.io]

title: Mahou Shoujo Ai 2
description: Several years after the incident, main character attends a preparatory school in Tokyo with inconvenient memories pushed out of his memory. One day he witnesses a girl fighting monsters while no ordinary human can see the girl as she is protected by the barrier. Girl tries to erase his memory, but it does not work. As a result she suggest living together as a form to keep the boy protected from monsters. [From vndbreview]

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: Rin and Ai’s senior, she is known as the strongest warrior, to the extent of being called a “demon god,” despite her gentle and soft appearance. She has a kind, “big sister” type personality. Her willingness to actively interact with humans makes her an outlier in her world. She comes to Akitoshi’s apartment as its manager. In truth, she is secretly tasked with a mission to kill Shin.

title: Shokushu Shoujo
description: You'll play as Asada Mayu as you interact with a mysterious inhuman girl who seduces you with her otherworldly powers (and appendages). [from J-List]
full_description: You'll play as Asada Mayu as you interact with a mysterious inhuman girl who seduces you with her otherworldly powers (and appendages). [from J-List]

title: Mahou Shoujo Žižek-chan!
description: A visual novel about magical girls and ideology. Join our cute, 14 year old heroine, Slavoj Žižek, as she makes a pact with a strange, light-pink alien from another planet, Theorina, to become a magical theorist girl and save the world from ideology! Fighting alongside her is the cool and mysterious beauty, Lacan, who seems to have a gloomy outlook on life - but why? Will Žižek’s optimism and faith in humanity fade as she attempts to make the world a better place - or will she succeed in her mission to bring down the consumerist society around her using the powers of love and hope? You will have to read to find out…. The 'Žižek' is this VN is a cute and female version of the very real (and very alive) philosopher, Slavoj Žižek, and the 'Lacan' is a cute and female and not-dead version of the very real (and now dead) psychoanalyst Jacques Lacan. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Slavoj Žižek
characters.description: A 14-year-old schoolgirl.

characters.name: Jacques Lacan
characters.description: A mysterious, quiet girl in Žižek's class.

characters.name: Theorina
characters.description: An adorable alien from another planet.

title: As We Know It
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: When the world gets too hot humanity finds sanctuary underground. After a long waiting list you finally score a spot in the local underground city of Camden, run by Mayor Rick Davidson. You and your mother move in and begin to acclimate to this wonderful new life. As time passes, however, things start to go wrong. Unravel what’s going on, and face some hard choices that will impact your relationships and fate. Get a job, find romance, and meet the other residents of Camden- your new home. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Ashlynn Phillips
characters.description: Ashlynn is suspicious, but desperate to make this new life work. Her life on the surface was hard. She spent most of it fighting for everything and going without. Now she's safe. Her mother is safe. They have food, water, and shelter. Nothing will get in the way of that ever again, if she has anything to say about it. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Evaline Turner
characters.description: An overly friendly security officer full of charm, and a sad smile. She'll tackle criminals all day, and then sweep you into her arms and sing karaoke with you all night. Or she’ll challenge you to a race, then feel bad that she didn’t let you win. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Gloria Miller
characters.description: The sweet Community Affairs Supervisor who wants to keep everyone's spirits up in these dark times. Born in Camden she isn't fully aware of the harsh realities of the surface. Bored of living underground she wants to either shake things up or escape. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Jude Myers
characters.description: You can usually find him at the bar with Sam, the closest thing to family he has left. Or in the greenhouse tending to the plants with loud grunge music from the 1990s shaking the walls. If you see him with any tech, you should probably assume it’s contraband and say nothing. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Micah Everett
characters.description: A perfectionist with an eloquent way of speaking, and a quiet voice. Insecure from a previous relationship which causes him to appear distant at first. Tries to throw himself into work as much as possible, and as the community’s lead doctor no one tries to stop him. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Camila Phillips
characters.description: Your mother, despite her airy optimistic nature you know she’s seen some very dark times. You can hear her whimper in her sleep, though she’ll vehemently deny it. She's content to read romantic stories and daydream until reality catches her attention. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Rick Davidson
characters.description: The man in charge. Will do whatever it takes to ensure Camden’s future success and prosperity. Many of the residents are enamored with the charming mayor, but he seems to have finally taken a personal interest in the doe-eyed Camila Phillips. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Sam
characters.description: Bad-ass bartender who’s been to hell and back. Runs Icarus. Took a young Jude in when she was 17 and they have been family ever since. Don’t steal from her or she will stab you. No really. A lot of attitude and sass. Protective of her loved ones. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Trevor
characters.description: Grumpy librarian, not a people-person, may like Bryan more than he seems to, likes books and hates people, would prefer if you just never went to the library ever, dislikes Gloria Miller. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Tabby
characters.description: Sweet little Tabby, likes to study in the gym. Lonely. Smarter than other kids her age. She may think you’re a bit dumb, but is happy to tutor you. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Vince
characters.description: Head of security, strict at work, but a caring and sensitive father and friend. Adores his daughter, single but not looking (Sorry Iris), acts as a father figure to Eva, good sense of humor. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Bryan
characters.description: Handsome, charming, friendly, and utterly useless at his job. Has a huge crush on the grumpy librarian, and spends his time at the library when he isn’t napping at work. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

characters.name: Iris Marie Jackson
characters.description: A man crazy flirt with a big smile and a lot of sass. Fun, outgoing, likes just about everyone but her ex. Acts like the southern-belle of Camden. [From Jaime Scribbles Games]

title: Lily's Handmaid
description: Sometimes turning down a job offer may cost you your soul. Sarah, for one, is keen on keeping her soul to herself, so she promptly accepts lady Melissa Duskheart's proposition to become a handmaid for Melissa's daughter, Lily. Though she had no prior experience of being a domestic servant, Sarah finds herself quite comfortable in her new workplace. The noble ladies and their maidservants are an amiable lot, really, when you get to know them. Granted, they are not big on exclusive relationships like most of the common folk, but that's hardly something that would bother an easy-going girl like Sarah. Especially when she's constantly being approached by, frankly, very attractive women...

title: LINGERING
description: The Heart Breachers is an organization committed to keep humankind safe from the harmful manifestations of their own emotions. Contained within every burst of feelings is an Ignite, the purest form of energy. Negative feelings bear Lingerings, and positive feelings produce Astrays. Astrays are typically tame, but Lingerings could wreak havoc in the real life while driving its host to madness. These projected forms pale in comparison to the Ignites, which might have to be dealt with directly in extreme cases. Often unruly and violent, killing an Ignite means killing its host’s ability to feel emotions permanently…

characters.name: Jonathan White
characters.description: Elegant, charming, handsome, and a snob. Being the heir to a global phone company,money has never been a problem for Jonathan, neither has been grades or winning favors. Despite so he is powerless, his family conceals it by making skin tight, see through gloves that emit fire, making it seem like Jonathan can control fire, when actually the only thing mutant about him is his maybe too stunning blue eyes. Despite his wealth and popularity, he has a very prominent inferiority complex towards his younger-genius-brother, Felix.

characters.name: Eric
characters.description: Jon's best friend, is the sole heir of his family's company specializing on caretaker/nurse robots. Is the first person to take care of Jon after his suicide attempt. Is generally a cheerful, inappropriate ladies man. Like Jon he is the black sheep of the family for lacking the ability to heal other people (a mutation power, common in his family). He does have the ability to heal himself instantly though, even growing a new body if his head is cut off. Thus gaining the name 'cockroach'. His P.E.T is a cockroach.

title: tender feelings like water
description: A water spirit sees a girl in red out on rainy days. The spirit and girl meet and meet again, slowly beginning to fall in love. Yet the rain fails to end. It is flood season, and the people beseech the local god to stop. [From Itch.io]
full_description: A water spirit sees a girl in red out on rainy days. The spirit and girl meet and meet again, slowly beginning to fall in love. Yet the rain fails to end. It is flood season, and the people beseech the local god to stop. [From Itch.io]

title: A Wave of Lights
description: In a seaside town, Hannah spends her days asleep and her nights wandering the empty beach. Too anxious to hold down a job or go to school, her roommate thinks she's hopeless. Hannah is inclined to agree. On one of these monotonous nights, a spaceship crashes on the beach! The cute alien inside disrupts Hannah's life... and her entire sense of self. [From itch.io]

title: Takorita Meets Potato
title_original: タコリタ・ミーツ・ポテト
description: In Tako Kingdom, deep under the sea, soup is an everyday, common meal. Princess Takorita is deeply dissatisfied with this food culture and demands a new dish which can spice up her life. She decides to go up to the land together with the merman "Mer" as her guard. On the land, Princess Takorita meets the humans Dino and Ina. The culture differences greatly surprise the princess. Then, finally, she has her fated encounter with the "french fries".🍟🍟🍟 ...Is that all? No, that's not all! French fries might look simple, but there's more to it. Princess Takorita continues her adventure to make the fries more and more tasty! Her journey is far from over. Even finding her long-lost grandfather is only a small part of her adventure.

characters.name: Princess Takorita
characters.description: The princess of Tako Kingdom, which is located deep under the sea. A strong-willed girl who likes to tease others. Her hunch about food suddenly becomes sharp as she arrives on the land. She falls in love with the french fries, and she won't spare any effort to make the fries tastier.

characters.name: Mer
characters.description: A merman who arrives on the land together with Princess Takorita to be her guard. He often gets forgotten and doesn't look reliable, but he surprisingly shows great abilities when he needs to. He can't speak while he's on the land, as he sacrifices his voice to get human legs. Hence, he uses body language to express his feelings.

characters.name: Dino
characters.description: The village chief's son who meets Princess Takorita and Mer soon after they arrive on the land. He hates troublesome things and dislikes spicy food. He thinks Princess Takorita is strange and decides to join her on her adventure.

characters.name: Ina
characters.description: Dino's cousin who likes to cook. Princess Takorita relies on her cooking skills a lot. She's attracted by Princess Takorita's ideas and joins her on her adventure.

title: The Charm of Love
description: My life began to sparkle with new colors when I entered one of the best universities in the country! But I just relaxed too quickly and did not notice how the time came for the exams. And some professors have never seen me! Well, that's okay. Fortunately, I'm smart enough to create the Amulet of Fortune. But... does it work correctly? [From Steam]

title: Demonheart: The Ice Demon
tags: Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: In this otome visual novel, you play as the young witch Shar, who was invited to live with a famous older witch. Shar's host needs protection from the demonic prisoners she keeps beneath her house. As Shar learns more of the house's secrets, she can build a relationship with her host's brother... or one of her prisoners. [From Steam]

characters.name: Shar
characters.description: A young witch from a tropical village in El'shei. She specializes in benevolent magic, like her mother, the Oracle of Chtaz. Shar attracts the attention of a more powerful and famous witch, and receives an invitation to become her assistant. [From official website]

characters.name: Eniri
characters.description: A witch respected in the big city and beyond, she is Shar's host and the mistress of her mansion. She can't help herself from conducting dangerous experiments. Strict and merciless toward those she sees as inferior, she will try to teach Shar her views about life, social roles and magic. [From official website]

characters.name: Esmius
characters.description: A demonspawn trapped by Eniri and turned into her unwilling servant. He appears to take his imprisonment well, even to the point of joking and teasing others. It feels like he's hiding a deep pain inside, but Shar can't figure out which part of him is a lie. [From official website]

characters.name: Sirath
characters.description: The younger brother of the great witch Eniri. As a male, he can't continue the family tradition of witchcraft, but Eniri still has a use for him in the family business - mixing potions. Sirath envies his sister and her witch associates, and will keep a close eye on Shar when she joins the household. [From official website]

characters.name: Nissa
characters.description: A girl that Shar meets in the marketplace of the big city, Nissa acts like a bit of a rogue. She is quick to decide she wants to be Shar's friend. She will show Shar around the city, share the local gossip, and want to learn everyone's juicy secrets. [From official website] [spoiler]Her real name is Salome Rynn.

characters.name: Zhan
characters.description: Eniri's family friend, he is a smith who has joined in on the business of selling magic trinkets. He will be there to support Shar as she adapts to her new home. He is unaware of the shady practices going on in his old friend's basement. [From official website]

title: It's A Promise
tags: Protagonist's Cousin as a Support Character
description: Erin has gotten used to the monotony of her life. But she still feels like something is missing. One day she is approached by a young woman named Ori who seems to know who she is. Erin doesn't remember her at all... Ori asks her out on a date and Erin finds herself saying yes. How will the date go? Will Erin remember who Ori is? Will Ori find out that Erin doesn't remember her? [From [URL=https://foxpancakes.itch.io/its-a-promise]Itch.io]

characters.name: Erin
characters.description: Erin is a pretty chill person, though she's often misunderstood because of her stand-offish appearance. She loves romance but feels like it will never happen for her. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Ori
characters.description: Ori is a bubbly and shy young woman. Though she can be assertive and headstrong when she wants to be. She appears to know Erin, but Erin doesn't remember her. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Tao
characters.description: Tao is Erin's cousin and best friend. He likes to tease Erin sometimes, but he always has her best interest at heart. He loves horror movies and heavy metal music. [From Itch.io]

title: Betflix
tags: Protagonist's Full Sister as a Heroine
description: Sitting next to her sister, Holly gets an invite to a mysterious new app called Betflix. She can earn money by completing bets for an anonymous perverter user. But as the bets get bigger, so do the risks! It starts with just a selfie, but soon escalates to sexy selfies with less and less clothes! Holly can't help getting caught up in the excitement, even though she tries to win the bets without her sister, Louise, spotting her dangerous games. But Louise has a secret all of her own... [From itch.io]

characters.name: Louise
characters.description: Louise is a rebel and a risktaker. A tech master and a devious hacker. She uses her powers for perverted gain, often testing out new hacks on her poor unsuspecting younger sister, Holly. A lover of sex toys, her collection is huge and eye-opening. Boys can sometimes be fun, but they often bore her. But show her a beautiful female body and she will do everything she can to see it naked. Even her sister's. [From DumbKoala]

characters.name: Holly
characters.description: Holly dreams of making it big as a model. She has tried out on a few shoots, but always seems to end up naked. As a wannabe model, Holly adores dress-up and cosplay. She has a passion for photography and is never too far from a selfie, but her love of nudity can often get her into big trouble. She is super close to her sister, Louise, the pair share everything. Holly is often too trusting, and easily manipulated. But don't be fooled - she has a dark, daring side. [From DumbKoala]

title: Affection -San Shimai to Juusha no Shoujo-
description: It’s the spring break of her first year of high school. Miyashiro Saya, a girl who struggled to connect with others and eventually dropped out of school, finds herself alone and without a place to belong. Her salvation comes in the form of an offer from her former teacher’s acquaintance: a job as a maid at a wealthy household. The mansion she arrives at is home to three sisters from the West. Saya, who had kept her heart closed off to the world, begins to rediscover her smile through her daily life with her new "masters." Though their personalities couldn’t be more different, their circumstances are strangely similar. This is a story of four girls, each carrying their own scars, shaping a tale of master-servant bonds and the quiet beauty of everyday life. [Translated from booth]

characters.name: Miyashiro Saya
characters.description: Likes: being headpat. Dislikes: caffeine.

characters.name: Clairelith Viscotte
characters.original: クレアリス・ヴィスコット
characters.description: Likes: spending time with her sisters or Saya. Dislikes: photos.

characters.name: Silvia Viscotte
characters.original: シルヴィア・ヴィスコット
characters.description: Likes: iced coffee. Dislikes: the outside world, other people.

characters.name: Marie Viscotte
characters.original: マリー・ヴィスコット
characters.description: Likes: making people happy. Dislikes: piano.

title: Pitstop in Purgatory
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Dang, you're dead! Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and has to make peace with her death. Only problem is... she doesn't remember anything! Point and click your way through adventure-based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling, and solve the mystery of our heroine's untimely demise. [From Steam and Itch.io]

characters.name: Rahel Eleanor Amethyst
characters.description: Kind and gentle, Rahel does whatever she can to make Astrid's journey through Purgatory easier. She has made the best of her situation despite her loneliness, saying that she has discovered things while deceased that her contemporaries had never thought existed. While possessing a noticeably outdated vocabulary, Rahel's helpful and honest nature is evident when she speaks.

It’s a nostalgic, sentimental story about the joys of creating: particularly when it’s done with a dear friend. title: Velvet Bite: Softly, With Teeth
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You've been invited to a Halloween party! Yay! Music! Food! Drinks! Vampires! Wait. VAMPIRES!? A Romantic Visual Novel featuring 6 romanceable vampires. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Madison
characters.description: "That's my question to ask. Why are you here?" Your roommate! She's not happy to be around you, obviously.

characters.name: Forrest
characters.description: "City life isn't good for your mental health. Vampires also need greens to heal." Kind and caring. His dessert wasn't very good. Too bad.

characters.name: Yvonne
characters.description: "Hm, what's good for a fairy? Cutie pie? Or sweetheart?" A beauty, known to never age. Runs a business.

characters.name: Sebastian
characters.description: "I mistook you for a different person. I guess I was drunk." Book lover and movie enthusiast. Not a social person.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: "So, was the party worth it?" Your psychiatrist. She's also a vampire, by the way.

characters.name: Everard
characters.description: "Only do the fun stuff. That's my life philosophy." Is he a magician or a con artist? We don't know.

title: Boy Meets Girl
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: The player takes the role of Inoue Yuuta, a boy who returns to the town of Tokimori after ten years of living elsewhere. Seeing that his parents had gone out of the country on job assignments, Yuuta found himself sent to live with his aunt and uncle. Of course, things do not go as planned, since his own aunt and uncle had also gone on a business trip to Brazil, leaving his cousin Chizuru in charge of the house until they returned. Yuuta's return to Tokimori is filled with numerous reunions. Aside from his former-tomboy cousin, he meets again with Kasugano Haruna, a girl that he used to know ten years ago. The sudden arrival of a girl named Tsubasa Miu sets the story in motion as Yuuta gets reacquainted with his past, the memories of his childhood, feelings of forgotten love, and the mystery associated with the town's local attraction, the stone spire known as the "Spire of Memories". [Fr

characters.name: Tsubasa Miu
characters.description: Miu is a girl that met Yuuta ten years before the story begins, as the daughter of a family that had just moved into the town of Tokimori. Miu and Chizuru get along extremely well and compliment each other through their naturally playful personalities. In general, Miu can be thought of as a simple person, finding joy and fun in things that the other members of the cast shrug off. At the same time, she is very insightful and likes to stay under the radar when it comes to what she knows. Her lack of understanding when it comes to certain things lead to comic situations that put our protagonist on the spot, as well. [From Moroboshi Yuumei's review]

characters.name: Kasugano Haruna
characters.description: Haruna is one of the two girls Yuuta used to know from ten years before BMG begins. Unlike Miu, Haruna has always been shy and reserved. Haruna used to play with Yuuta and Miu back when they were kids, and got along quite well with both. Still, she always felt as the odd man in their trio, since the chemistry between our protagonist and Miu was very strong. Her feelings for Yuuta are so strong that she has managed to remember many things about him from ten years ago, hoping to one day meet with him again and tell him how she feels. As a second year high school student, Haruna is president of the school's Magical Club. Contrary to its name, the club actually focuses on doing volunteer work and helping out when called upon. Much to her chagrin, the Science Club's president constantly tries to instigate competition between the two clubs, convinced that the idea of magic is silly compared to

characters.name: Shingyouji Mao
characters.description: Mao is introduced as an underclassman that is also the vice-president of the Magical Club. At the beginning of the story, Mao acts like the jealous first year girl that is set on protecting Haruna from Yuuta. She can tell that her senpai has feelings for our protagonist, so she at first tries to keep him from joining the Magical Club. Despite initial antagonism and her attempts to make Yuuta look bad in front of Haruna, Mao realizes that Haruna's happiness is more important, and later decides to turn our protagonist into the "ideal guy" for her beloved senpai. Unsurprisingly, some her ideas on how a guy should be like tend to be outlandish, but at times does give worthwhile advice. The focus shifts to getting to know our protagonist when she realizes he won't be transforming into a cool guy any time soon. Personality-wise, Mao is generally cheerful, if extremely protective of Haruna. She

characters.name: Kumotani Chizuru
characters.description: Chizuru is Yuuta's older cousin, and is in charge of the house she shares with our protagonist while her parents are away on business. At a first glance, Chizuru is a very non-serious character, preferring to joke around and do the occasional odd thing. At heart, however, she is a very responsible girl who feels a little overwhelmed by having to run her family's coffeehouse, "The Mysterious Spire". Her playfulness aside, Chizuru is actually very strict when it comes to the rules of the house, and often penalizes those that break curfew or fail to do as they're told with "fines" that must be paid by dropping money into her piggy bank. A constant running gag with Chizuru is that despite making a living brewing coffee and baking snacks, she's actually a terrible cook. [spoiler]This trait goes from gag to plot point when we discover that the reason her cooking is so questionable is because s

characters.name: Souma Nanami
characters.description: Nanami is a girl that lives next door to the Kumotani family, and is good friends with Chizuru. Being at least two years younger than Yuuta, Nanami still has many things to learn and understand ahead of her. As she is something of a slow learner, Chizuru at one point was tutoring her in math and English. Sadly, after Chizuru's parents went away, there was no one to help her keep up in school until Yuuta came along. [From Moroboshi Yuumei's review.]

description: Charlotte is a young girl who lives in a small village out in the countryside. She happily spends her days with her childhood friend and next-door neighbor, the Little Match Boy. One day, she suddenly shrinks to about the size of a thumb. With her cute and fairy-like new body, Charlotte immediately gains popularity. People begin to call her "Thumbelina." One day, while Thumbelina and the Little Match Boy are off on a trip to a distant spring, the village is attacked by mysterious soldiers. Knowing that they are searching for Thumbelina, the Little Match Boy takes her into the depths of the forest to protect her. And so the two of them embark on a journey to find a way to restore Thumbelina to her normal size, all the while avoiding the pursuing soldiers. Along the way, they will make friends with a cast of colorful characters, and this adventure will reveal their deepest secrets... (Tran

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: "I met a lot of people on this journey. Wonderful and fun things are coming to me!" An energetic and slightly tomboyish girl that was raised in a country village. One day her body suddenly became small, just about as big as a thumb, and she began to be called 'Thumbelina'. Then her village was attacked and in order to evade her pursuers she started out on a journey with the Little Match Boy.

characters.name: Lars Christensen
characters.original: ラース・クリステンセン
characters.description: "I'll definitely protect you, because when you're beside me I feel relieved." Thumbelina's childhood friend who lives next door to her. His family is poor so he makes a living selling matches. He's a bit of a apathetic and sulky person, but at his root he is kind. He's going on an adventure with Thumbelina.

characters.name: Lune
characters.description: "I go wherever I feel like going, I do whatever I feel like doing, I proceed naturally however I feel like. That's what freedom is." A hunter who travels freely without making connections with people. He doesn't like mixing with people, but because of the guidance of the wind he starts traveling together with Thumbelina. A guy who is hard to understand that goes at his own pace.

characters.name: Svia
characters.description: "...I'm a little scared. But I'm with you so it's ok... I think." A girl who doesn't mingle with people because whatever she touches freezes. She lives alone in the castle she loves, but she decides by chance to go along with Thumbelina's invitation and join the journey. She acts cool and has a strong will, but she has a side that doesn't like to be alone.

characters.name: Sirius
characters.description: "I'll protect the little princess. This is also part of a knights teachings." A dragon knight that protects the sacred dragon valley. A bit of a formal guy who lives for his mission, he is overflowing with justice. A gentlemanly and polite guy who is very helpful. He's always together with the silver dragon Truce.

characters.name: Truce
characters.description: Sirius's pet silver dragon. He has a bad mouth and isn't honest, but he can be compassionate sometimes. [spoiler]He can transform into a human.

characters.name: Esheru
characters.description: "I want to go along with her, I want to be Thumbelina's power!!" On a stormy night she saved a prince and fell in love with him. A mermaid princess who traded her voice for legs. She wants to know about the outside world more and be helpful to Thumbelina so she goes along on the journey. She's sensitive to other people's pain and has a kind heart.

characters.name: Gobi
characters.description: A loyal servant of Esheru that pulls her goldfish bowl satisfactorily. He's very strong and will always run to help his master when she's in a pinch.

characters.name: Ugly Duckling
characters.description: "Hmm, If you want a fight I'll give it to you, you impotent bastard!!" A grey duckling that escaped from a certain castle. He's coming along on the journey with Thumbelina as emergency rations. He's exceedingly frank and loves women. He often talks non-stop about indecent topics.

characters.name: Albireo
characters.description: "Women aren't something you can pluck lightly. They're something you offer yourself up with all your might to be engulfed by." A young man with beautiful white wings that appears gallantly in front of Thumbelina. He's actually the transformed form of the Ugly Duckling. A smug gentleman who is a little overbearing. He calls himself the 'Sexy Attendant'. He gives off a trivial impression, but he is actually good with the sword and has a helpful side.

characters.name: Siegward
characters.description: "Touching you with these hands that are stained with sin... Please forgive me. I have the resolve to bear this responsibility." A swallow that loves spring. He's bound by a charm and has lived for a hundred years while transformed into a human. He swore loyalty to his once kind king, and decided to live for that kings sake. He is a kind and gentle man, but his sword arm is the best in the kingdom.

characters.name: Black Knight
characters.description: "...If you intend to get in my way than that's enough of a reason to kill you. Fall into Hell." A loyal subordinate of the king of Odense who serves him with absolute power. On the King's order he spearheaded the attack on Thumbelina's village. He has a callous personality and could even easily kill his own subordinates.

characters.name: Nude King
characters.description: "I'm the naked king who holds nothing and wears nothing. Besides this power of darkness of course." He was once a kind king who loved his country. But he made a contract with a person of darkness and gained a great power and was corrupted. He started scheming to sink the world into darkness. There is no trace of his former self left, he's now selfish and arrogant. [spoiler]For the majority of the game he is possessed by Loki.

characters.name: Lupian
characters.description: "I was born with the same destiny as you. No matter the time I'm your ally." A mysterious prince that appeared when Thumbelina was in a pinch. He fights using the sword on his hip and flower magic. It seems since his birth he's held an important secret concerning Thumbelina...?

characters.name: Bright Moon / Dark Night Moon
characters.description: The moon that floats in the sky. He should watch over the meetings of people in the world. But now he is the cursed 'Dark Night Moon' that serves the Nude King and searches for Thumbelina.

characters.name: Valfar
characters.description: A great magician who served the once kind king. On nights with a strong wind he offers mysterious seeds to girls of a certain village.

characters.name: Ragna
characters.description: The strong willed knight captain who served the once kind king. Because of his great skill he's called the 'Swift Sword' and is admired my many knights.

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Falling in love with a gangster is a dangerous choice... -Story- "Welcome to our world." You're leading an ordinary life in sunny California when suddenly you get kidnapped by LA's most wanted gang! Thrown into the extravagant life of these stylish but dangerous gangsters, you must choose one of them to watch over you...but who can you trust? Living in the gang's world isn’t easy, yet in the face of all the shootouts and explosions, an undeniable attraction begins to form... Not only are you the key to important information the gang needs, but you are also in possession of something else they are missing in their lives: your heart!

description: ——On a humid day in June, the air thick with the promise of the rainy season. It all started when she asked that girl to help her study for an upcoming exam. Her gentle smile reminded her, just a little, of her late mother—— As summer break approaches, Nozomi Aikawa, a high school freshman, asks her neighbor and classmate, Satsuki Shinozuka, to help her study for her final exams. Satsuki always wears a calm, gentle smile, but as they grow closer, Nozomi begins to notice cracks in that facade. It’s as if she’s carefully hiding something behind her kindness, enduring it all in silence. Nozomi finds herself drawn to the fragile, fleeting quality of the girl who reminds her so much of her late mother. ——It’s raining. Just like that day, it’s been raining since morning—— [Translated from dlsite]

title: Clear Skye Thinking
description: Alice Shah doesn’t want to go on holiday to Scotland, and she most definitely doesn’t want to go to grey, dreary Skye. Alice has a love for elegant, classy clothes, and she spends hours on her appearance every morning. Alice considers herself a sophisticated, elegant lady, and she has no desire to go tramping through muddy fields to visit crumbling old castles. Unfortunately for Alice, however, her dad is determined to spend their summer in Skye so he can meet up with a former friend, Ian Carter, and his family: his wife, the haughty Hilda, and their ginger spawn, the loud and boisterous Piper. Alice hasn’t seen Piper since they were small children, and she has few memories of her. She doubts that she’ll be able to get on with anybody who lives on a teeny-tiny island full of sheep, but Alice is pleasantly surprised. Piper isn’t as abrasive as her father, or as stuck-up as her mother. Pip

title: Out of the Ocean
description: Sakuragi Asuka is an ordinary girl of no particular note. She's so plain and ordinary her parents think nothing of palming her off on her aunt for a year so they can work overseas, leaving Asuka marooned on the small island of Omorishima. Asuka is an awkward girl by nature, and she finds it hard to fit in. How in the world is she going to cope living in Omorishima, which is so dissimilar to Tokyo?! Asuka is dreading going to school, and she's terrified she won't be able to make any friends... But a chance encounter with a mysterious maiden late at night soon flips Asuka's life upside-down. This maiden has long, fair hair, bright blue eyes... And she also has a tail! What is Asuka going to do now?! [From Steam]

description: "I dream of myself, taking Nica by the hand and leading her through the rainy streets of a desolate London. I see these roads broken and littered with cars, Kensington Park overgrown with weeds, Big Ben's clock tower fallen by the wayside— Maybe others would think of this as eerie, but to me, this is the only way London could ever be beautiful: as a stage for just the two of us, on equal footing and with the sun as our only witness." After months of flirting and sexting, Nica and Chun are finally meeting up for the first time in London. Nica is a up-and-coming trans retro game streamer, and Chun is a med student who is having cold feet over her workload. They have confided their deepest secrets to each other online, but can they understand each other offline? [From itch.io]

Between the drug cartels, the AIDS epidemic, and a flood of undocumented immigrants, hundreds more will vanish, never to be seen again. Chelo Martínez finds the people who slip through the cracks. Help Chelo explore the beaches and back alleys of Miami at its most dangerous, investigating her very first cases as a private investigator. characters.description: The Princess of the royal family is sought after by celebrities all over the world. She likes Yoji Yuki and has always shown her love to him. Pure character is easily injured. Always put on a royal dignity.

characters.name: Han'ya Suehiro
characters.description: A gentle-looking, kind-hearted teenager. He is very caring and very dependent. He has an admiration for Aika Yuixx, but he is distressed by the difference in identity.

characters.name: Yoji Yuki
characters.description: Elegant and handsome, born weak and sick. But he is the most magical person in the college. Struggling with a strong sense of self-disgust. He is a very abnormal person.

full_description: To love a person, is it really such a happy thing? I don't think so. Maybe we just like that kind of feeling. I live in a quiet and peaceful town. There is no war here, everything is so beautiful, just like a paradise. We met each other and became friends in such a world. Our feelings are crisscrossing. Why are we living? Why were we born here? To get everything by any means, is it really the way to win? I am confused in the successive emotional whirlpool... The story like a cross is unfolded like this-- "I expected I would not love anybody anymore. But after I met her, my life totally changed. I entirely fell under the enchantment of her." "I knew that I was lying. That was not real me." [From Steam]

title: The Angel Inn
description: Your first adventure begins in four days. And today, you’ve reached “The Angel Inn”, where you can relax before the departure. Is this your lucky day? The only male guest, with 3 beautiful girls. Get to know them, and be wise in managing time in your four days, because good things may happen at The Angel Inn! Meet Shea, the sweet innkeeper, Faylinn, the tsundere fencer with a secret, and Rosabella, the provocative, seductive bard from the Noble Society. [From Steam]

[Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

title: The Hero's Journey
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You are a hero; the Hero, in fact, who has just put an end to the Villain terrorising the island, ending your long quest. But you remember nothing of it; not the quest, not the woman claiming to be your fiancée, not your amazing deeds and immense riches. Five years have been wiped clean from your mind. When the Villain’s minions continue to cause trouble, you must travel once more, this time in search of your forgotten memories. But the more you remember, the less the stories ring true. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Seren
characters.description: You remember your wretched past: the death of your soldier parents, your childhood on the streets, your harsh training for a war that ended before you could ever fight in it. The first eighteen years of your life were a constant struggle to survive. Five years later, you're rich, famous and confused. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Aerona
characters.description: You have no memory of the warrior woman, and it breaks her heart. You'd planned a life together, she tells you. Now your plans are on hold, and your relationship is uncertain. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Ikemma
characters.description: You don't remember him. Your companions say he is pure evil; a foreigner using dark magic to terrorize the islanders. No one has ever seen him, yet they know endless tales of his cruelty. Like the tales you hear about yourself, they don't seem real. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Rhain
characters.description: You remember your best friend. He looks older now; less cheerful than he used to be. He stuck with you throughout your quest, and he'll stick with you in your amnesia. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Emrys
characters.description: You encounter this charming young man in your journey. You wonder if you've met before; his face is familiar, yet his voice isn't. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Wooly
characters.description: The strange goat man is mute, but more expressive than most. His eyes regard you with too many feelings to count; pity, wariness, doubt... If only you could ask him why. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Thisbe
characters.description: The mutant girl left her village to walk in your footsteps, but never expected your paths would cross. She's bright, star-struck and excited, but a shadow lurks in her eyes. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Beca
characters.description: You save the girl from cruel circumstances; crueler even than your own. Like you did at her age, she still has many hardships ahead of her. [From itch.io]

description: The story is about the protagonist Lü Xuan who wakes up in the middle of the night and finds her chest overflowing with blood. A mysterious black hole appears in her palm, and at the same time, up to one hundred million shocking “wealth” crawl out of the hole. In the midst of her horror, various strange monsters that came for this wealth continue to rush towards Lü Xuan. This is a strange story that takes place in a gloomy city. [From Steam]

characters.description: Currently suffering from damaged memory, but clearly understands that her goal is to find her girlfriend, Ann Sakura. Suffers from schizophrenia, and hallucinates vividly when under sever pressure. Long-term use of Olanzapine and therapy conducted by Ann Sakura have helped with her recovery. Received systematic training in logical analysis and deductive reasoning, but memory loss may lead to impaired abilities.

title: Qianse
description: The unchanging me and the seemingly unchanging her. Sometimes I even wonder if our unchanging lives are heading for a mundane end. However, the cold reality always pierces the fragile dream. Just like both of our daily routines, we were slowly swept into the storm. She was the first friend I ever met in my life, the first person who was willing to commit her heart to me. By the time I truly realized the weight of her in my heart, all remedies were long gone. "If only I had been braver then." "If only I had confessed everything back then." However, regret and self-reproach can not change the reality of the slightest. Through the boundless fog, into the misty dream. When I first touched the truth of everything. Where will it all lead? [Translated from Steam]

title: Genjitsukai
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: What if you're so obsessed with vampires that you wholeheartedly believe them to exist in real life and you've made it your life goal to prove their existence to the world? This is the case for 19-year-old Cherise. Having been obsessed with vampires for years, she spends most of her time reading vampire-themed books, thinking of theories to prove their existence and most importantly: being on the lookout to find one! The latter has been rather unsuccessful — that is, until Cherise finds Dalton and Aleisha, two people who make her 'vampire sensor' overheat. Full of excitement and hope, she makes it her next mission to get close to them and prove once and for all that she isn't crazy like most people believe her to be. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Dalton
characters.description: The (inhumanly) handsome guy Cherise has been stalking a bit. Has both a playful and a serious character. He’s strangely obsessed with garlic bread and he loves the taste of toothpaste. Is very keen on his privacy.

characters.name: Aleisha
characters.description: The strange girl from the bookstore. She has a quiet and serious nature and seems to be very responsible, but can be playful at times. Likes fancy dinners and clothes and she talks about her family a lot.

characters.name: Cherise
characters.description: A true vampire fanatic. She is obsessive, cheerful and determined. She's honest and kind, but can be a little blunt at times. She smiles a lot and usually draws people in with her cheery personality. Her life goal is to one day prove the existence of vampires. [From Kagi Projects]

description: A one-shot mystery story following a woman who attempts to uncover the secrets of a seemingly abandoned estate in order to solve her brother's suicide. [Edited from Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Kaitlyn Liao
characters.description: Kaitlyn, a main character in The Freshman, The Sophomore, The Junior, and The Senior series, is a student at Hartfeld and a vocalist of the punk band "The Gutter Kittens". She is also one of Your Character's love interests. She makes her first appearance in The Freshman, Book 1, Chapter 1. Kaitlyn is a funny, lively girl. She loves parties, shopping, and gossip, but is also very loyal to her friends. When they first meet, Kaitlyn is instantly friendly towards Your Character and is very excited to be her suitemate. Initially, she takes it upon herself to act as a matchmaker for Chris Powell and Your Character. However, she soon develops romantic feelings for Your Character herself. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Clarissa Waverley
characters.description: Clarissa Waverley is the second child of the Waverley children. She is first seen in Chapter 2. Clarissa is a cheerful and optimistic teenager. Just like Simon, she greets Your Character to the manor warmly. In Chapter 3, it's revealed that she enjoys poetry and has a crush on a boy in town named Edmund who she wants to send a poem to, but always chickens out. If Your Character says that she prefers girls, Clarissa is not scandalized by it and still asks for help with her poem. [spoiler]Clarissa is the only younger sibling that is cautious about how long they've been in the manor. She comments in Chapter 3 that she hasn't seen the mailman in forever. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Eleanor Waverley
characters.description: Eleanor Waverley is the eldest child of the Waverley children. She is also one of Your Character's love interests. She is first seen in Chapter 2. Eleanor is mature and responsible, as she is in charge of taking care of her younger siblings. She is very formal and polite with her siblings viewing her as a mother figure. She is also shown to be kind, given that she allows Your Character to stay at the manor. Eleanor has difficulty telling others hurtful things, begging Your Character not to reveal to her siblings that they are ghosts. Eleanor is shown to be easily flustered if the player chooses to pursue a romance with her. Making the right dialog choices causes Eleanor to stutter and blush easily while improving the relationship between Eleanor and Your Character. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.description: Teagan is one of the contestants of America's Most Eligible. She makes her first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 1. Teagan is shown to be very bubbly and spiritual when first introduced to Your Character. While she is a very happy person, she knows how to defend herself, as she doesn't tolerate Bianca Sandoval's behavior towards her in the closing moments of Chapter 2. Depending on who the player chooses to eliminate in Chapter 2, Teagan may either be a consistent presence throughout the first book, or absent for most of it. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Jennifer Espinoza
characters.description: Jen is one of the producers of America's Most Eligible and one of Your Character's love interests. While she is shown to be sweet and kind, she cannot be impartial when it comes to her job as a producer, as is noted by Piper, due to her clear favoritism towards Your Character when compared to her other contestants; this is likely because of her crush on Your Character. Her mother describes her as hard-working and caring.

characters.name: Vincent
characters.description: Vince is one of the contestants of America's Most Eligible. He is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 19. Although much of his personality is second-hand information from Adam McIntyre, it appears that he is a charming yet selfish and disloyal person given that he betrayed Adam at the end of Season 9. Jen Espinoza mentions that his personality is much more hostile when the cameras are off, once threatening to get her fired because he felt she was asking him too many questions during his confessional. He enjoys riling up the other contestants, including Adam and Mackenzie Harris, through berating and insults. In a premium scene in All-Stars Chapter 14, he says he would rather be feared than loved. He also believes he is God's gift to humanity. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Eden Labelle
characters.description: Eden is first seen in Book 2, Chapter 1 and appears practical and sincere. Despite being known as "the Heiress" in her previous season of America's Most Eligible, she has worked hard to build her own company and make a name for herself. [Edited from the Wiki]

title: A Field of Flowers and Stars
description: Raine, a genius mechanic with a lust for adventure, thrives in the frontier of space accompanied only by her shipborne AI navigator. Well into her travels, she makes a critical error while piloting, jumping through an unstable wormhole and crash-landing on an unknown planet. There, she makes first contact with a young species of sentient beings that look a lot like humans with a hint of… goat? To return to her home, Raine must repair her ship before the wormhole closes. However, in this unfamiliar place, she makes a friend that forces her to question what she really wants. [From Itch.io]

title: Lock and Key: A Magical Girl Mystery
description: What does it mean to be a magical girl? This is the question at the heart of ​ Lock and Key, a magical mystery set in a world shaped by your interpretation of the magical girl genre. Sherri and Kealey Cohen, now a married couple in their late 20s, left the title of magical girls behind them over a decade ago. Now on the verge of losing their powers and entering a life of true normalcy, a string of unexplainable murders forces them to come out of retirement for one last adventure. Together with Nina, their old friend, and Ruby, a new protege, Sherri and Kealey will have to face a mystery connected both to their past and future. In the world of Lock and Key, the player shapes their path...and more importantly, determines where that path will end. [From official website]

characters.name: Sherri Cohen
characters.description: DOB: 7 January 1990 Hobby: Collecting stuffed animals Favorite Food: Coffee Cake A former Magical Girl turned private eye, Sherri "Sherlock" Cohen uses her powers of clairvoyance to solve crimes nobody else can. Logical, tough, and self-reflective, Sherri has a soft and sensitive side that only her wife Kealey is allowed to see. However, the uncertain future of a life without powers will test her resolve more than anything has before.

characters.name: Kealey Cohen
characters.description: DOB: 7 March 1990 Hobby: Knitting Favorite Food: Takoyaki Kealey always enjoyed the life of a Magical Girl more than her wife Sherri. Still making use of her shapeshifting abilities to the fullest, you'd never guess that such a soft and compassionate woman was one of the most successful cat burglars in Chicago. Full of love, laughter, and zest for life, Kealey is a wonderful presence everywhere she goes.

characters.name: Nina Alencar
characters.description: DOB: 6 April 1989 Hobby: Racquetball Favorite Food: Strawberry Cheesecake What is there to say about Miss Nina that her avid fans haven't said already? A longtime friend and former Magical Girl partner of Sherri and Kealey, the bright and bubbly Nina went from a life of fighting Consumed to a life in the spotlight as one of the world's biggest pop stars. These days, "Chicago's favorite daughter" mostly uses her powers of teleportation to avoid paparazzi, but her magical girl style still influences her looks to this day! #stannina!

characters.name: Ruby Thompson
characters.description: DOB: 1 February 2004 Hobby: Writing Poetry Favorite Food: Popcorn Ruby "Nightshade" Thompson, a brand new Magical Girl, considers herself a true creature of the night as she uses her powers of invisibility to blend into the shadows. Fully immersed in her dark and mysterious role, the truth is that Ruby's edgy, persona masks a deep insecurity and anxiety about her new life. Will the guidance of three veteran Magical Girls give her enough strength to stand on her own? Or is she doomed to hide behind a mask forever?

characters.name: Elle Byrne
characters.description: Sherri, Kealey, and Nina's former Magical Girl ally. Always the baby of the group, she was the whole team's little sister and loved dearly by her three closest friends. Sadly, she passed away in 2007, long before her time. Elle Byrne was fifteen years old when she died, and the shock of that death changed her three friends forever. But how did she die? What happened that fateful night? And why couldn't Sherri, Kealey, and Nina stop it? [From in-game bio]

characters.name: Natasha Rubinsky
characters.description: A forensic scientist specializing in on-site crime scene investigation, Natasha "Nat” Rubinsky is Sherri's longtime acquaintance and key source of information about police activity in the city. While the two are far from friends, Sherri's consistent ability to get results and Nat's authority to keep the cops away from her make for some very effective teamwork. Nat is aggressive, argumentative, caustic, and an overall pain in the ass...but at least she's got enough common sense to know what it takes to get results. Doesn't mean she's gonna be friendly about it, though. [From in-game bio]

plot_tags: Modern Day United States of America
full_description: What does it mean to be a magical girl? This is the question at the heart of ​ Lock and Key, a magical mystery set in a world shaped by your interpretation of the magical girl genre. Sherri and Kealey Cohen, now a married couple in their late 20s, left the title of magical girls behind them over a decade ago. Now on the verge of losing their powers and entering a life of true normalcy, a string of unexplainable murders forces them to come out of retirement for one last adventure. Together with Nina, their old friend, and Ruby, a new protege, Sherri and Kealey will have to face a mystery connected both to their past and future. In the world of Lock and Key, the player shapes their path...and more importantly, determines where that path will end. [From official website]

title: Andromeda Six: Star Crossed Lovers
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Set in the universe of the Visual Novel Andromeda Six, the Festival of Valen takes place once a year, a celebration of love much like an ancient human tradition. During your stay in Teranium*, a couple of troublemakers create a situation on the A6, and it's up to you to clean it up. Pick one of the 6 crew members of the starship and join them on an unexpected mission in Nos Vega. You're on the clock to get it done, but the allure from the Festival of Valen may be just what it takes to make you and your chosen companion far too distracted to do so. Can you keep your head in the game or will you end up falling prey to the stars around you? Will you keep your partner at arm's length or take that next step? Discover this Valentine's, on Star Crossed Lovers. *DLC set during events around Episode 2 and 3 [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Damon Reznor
characters.description: The cold hearted but charming second-in-command with a sharp tongue. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Ayame Ikeda
characters.description: The bright and no-drama ace pilot and self-proclaimed geek queen. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Sebastian Illahaj
characters.description: The humorous and easygoing engineer with a love of bionics. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Calderon James Lynch
characters.description: The stoic and standoffish ex-military commander with a fiery vendetta. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Juniper Nyux
characters.description: The calm and collected gunman with a gentlemen's demeanor. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Ryona Guinevere Mi'haden
characters.description: The pure hearted and nurturing medic with a deep-rooted yearning for revenge. [From itch.io]

title: Bistro Days
description: You are an aspiring food blogger in the city of Wisteria. One day, a giant raccoon guides you to Bellflower Bistro, where you meet three charming characters that will prove to be your life's turning point. What fate awaits you at the bistro? Will you answer to your true calling and become a food blogger that will make your mom proud? Are you able to help your romantic partner achieve their dreams? What choices will you make? Who will you date? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Rose
characters.description: Rose is the manager of the bistro, having worked in similar establishments since she was in high school. Now with years of experience under her belt, she is an expert in all things food industry and has the confidence and leadership skills to boot. Although friendly, she tends to hold everyone to a high standard. She sometimes comes into conflict with those who disagree with her, but she always forgives and moves on. [Taken from itch.io]

characters.name: Lily
characters.description: Lily only started working at the bistro a few months ago. She joined at a weird time, when the management and work conditions were beginning to reach an all-time low. Having been in the hospitality business for a long time, she tried her best to resolve the issues in the bistro on her own -- but ultimately, she leaned on Rose for help when things got out of hand. [Taken from itch.io]

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Iris is a new hire, joining shortly after Lily. Rose hired her because of her outgoing personality and how skilled Iris is at everything, especially latte art and drawing daily menu boards. As a general team member at the bistro, she balances the front-of-the-house tasks, as well as the social media page and signboards. [Taken from itch.io]

title: My Mom's Secret
tags: Protagonist's Blood-related Mother as a Heroine
description: Naomi makes a shocking discovery in her mom's bedroom. She isn't innocent and knows what a magic wand is, but she has never seen one before or used it. Until now. However, Naomi takes a little too long to experiment with her new toy. Mom catches her daughter in the act, but Naomi knows how to twist any situation to her sexual advantage... [From itch.io]

characters.name: Naomi
characters.description: The fiery leader of the evil twins, Naomi always gets what she wants. And what she wants is the hottest girl in school. Always scheeming with her twin sister Mia, Naomi is never too far from trouble - and that always means trouble for someone else. No one is safe from her corrupting beauty - not even her long-suffering mother, Abigail. [From DumbKoala]

characters.name: Abigail
characters.description: Mother to the twins Mia and Naomi and teacher at their school, Abigail must wrestle with conflicting desires and obligations at every step. With her husband away, Abigail has to resort to other means to get satisfaction. Means that sometimes cross a line. And then she has to try and control her troublesome daughters. She is under no illusion that they both revel in sexual cruelty, Abigail herself often fails to resist their evil charms. As any good mother should, she will try to steer her daughters on the right path. But its going to be a bumpy road ahead... [From DumbKoala]

As she was walking on the street, she came across the mascot Shamii fighting a monster and made her contract. Thus, she became Magical Girl Lovely Lily. However, Airi did not realize that being a magical girl is quite different from what she always dreams of.

characters.name: Nanamiya Luna
characters.description: Child Genius Luna Nanamiya, once a child actress by the stage name 'Satsuki Nana' by which she is still often known, lives in a luxury tower apartment and refuses to engage with people. She is young but has already educated herself to about Junior High. Her income is due to her hobby of Stock Trading and Currency Exchange.

Has the power to restore her virginity whenever she's raped so she can continue to fight monsters without worry. [spoiler]Truthfully Shamii is trying to send embarrassment energy back to his home planet and works with the Libido to put Airi in ever increasing embarrassing situations.

Because Kokoha broke her hymen while harassing her as a child she can use dildos without worry since it's already too late to protect her virginity. She daydreams about being raped by a nameless, faceless, imaginary older brother. Because of her masochistic nature she's forced to collect S Energy for Kokoha by doing embarrassing things. This means police leave her alone allowing her to wander aimlessly through town completely nude or wearing whatever fetish clothes she desires. Getting stares and lewd comments from strangers will still happen of course.

She wanted to live life to the fullest and not waste a single day on things she saw as "boring". One day, though, one glass too much gets her into the hospital where she enjoys the company of her overly caring best friend Mel and handsome but kind of mysterious young man, Alex. She finds herself in an unexciting environment where she feels trapped. But her boring nights become a bit more exciting when she hears a story of a ghost that roams the hospital… [Edited from Itch.io]

title: Ellaria: Cotton & Cream
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Dive in to the mystical land of Ellaria, where Elves, Fairies, and Demons rule supreme, and other races are no more than an afterthought on the authors fingertips. Enjoy a tale of action, adventure, romance, and a whole lot of snark. Bring your armor folks, lest you get injured by all the fourth wall breaking. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Toffee
characters.description: The nameable protagonist, an elf who loves adventure, and has trained hard to get where she is today as one of Ellaria's most beloved rangers. She puts on a humble facade for the public, but loves the attention. Despite their disagreements, there's nothing she'd rather be doing than traveling the land with her two dear friends. Even when they really, really get on her nerves.

characters.name: Cotton
characters.description: A fairy who, while he has a lot of respect for his culture and teachings, dislikes the fact that the only type of magic he can do is healing. His team members insist that's all he needs to do, but he wants to feel more useful. He doesn't like running straight into danger and is exasperated every time Cream and Toffee do so. Is nice to pretty much everyone but his friends.

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: Your guide through this journey, who isn't afraid to tell you when you've made a terrible decision.

characters.name: Cream
characters.description: A mischievous girl who will always prefer getting things done to sparing people’s feelings. Ruthlessly violent in battle (‘sour’ cream), but adorable everywhere else (‘whipped’ cream). She likes to put on a cool face for her fans. She can seem a little inconsiderate, and abrasive, especially to those who aren’t used to demons and don’t know anything about their culture.

characters.description: A quiet girl in her senior year of high school. At the start of the game, she inherits the estate of her recently passed grandfather and as a result meets the incubi, who drastically change her life. [From Kickstarter]
