She regulates the school's non-athletic groups, such as the gardening and biology clubs. Nonon also runs the school's Rakugo Club, 100 Poems by 100 Poets Club and most likely the marching band. Nonon's Three-Star Goku Uniform resembles that of a drum majorette. Her baton is not just for show, as Nonon is a conductor as well. ~!After the events of episode 17, she and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach!~

characters.name: Matarou Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako's little brother. He acts as the leader of the local troublemakers who mostly loiters around the Honnouji Town cul-de-sac.

characters.name: Barazou Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako's father. He is the town’s unlicensed doctor. He's killed more patients than actually saved them.

characters.name: Sukuyo Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako's carefree mother.

characters.name: Aikurou Mikisugi
characters.description: A mysterious male teacher who develops an interest in Ryuko soon after she arrives at Honnouji Academy. ~!He is secretly an operative of the terrorist organization Nudist Beach, working to prevent Satsuki Kiryuin's influence from spreading any further. He also knew Ryuko's father before he was murdered. Has a tendency to strip, as fitting with his organization's name.!~

characters.name: Maiko Oogure
characters.description: Oogure Maiko is the Head of Trap development.

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン
description: What happens when a drunken promise leads to living with a dragon? That’s Miss Kobayashi’s new reality when Tohru appears in her life. With a maid-slash-dragon in her home, she’s experiencing a whole new level of domestic bliss! But the dragons don’t stop there. On a mission to find Tohru appears Kanna, a little dragon with a big attitude. Before she knows it, Kobayashi’s got a house full of dragons—one serving tail and the other serving serious moe! Together, they live side by side with only the occasional disaster…well, maybe. But nothing beats coming home to the warm welcome of a dragon maid! (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Damocles
characters.description: Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown. Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru. However, unlike other Chaos Dragons, he respects the non-interference laws preventing dragons from killing humans of Earth, although when angered, he attacks Kobayashi and threatens to leave her at the brink of death. Despite this, he cares for his daughter and is concerned for her safety and happiness.

characters.name: Sone
characters.description: Sone is one of Kobayashi's neighbors.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica
title_original: 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ
description: One night, 14-year-old Madoka Kaname has a terrible nightmare - against the backdrop of a devastated city, she witnesses a girl fight a losing battle against a dreadful being lingering above, while a cat-like magical creature tells Madoka the only way to change such tragic outcome is for her to make a contract with him and become a magical girl. The next day, the teen's dream seemingly becomes reality as the girl she saw in her dream - Homura - arrives at Mitakihara Middle School as a transfer student, mysteriously warning Madoka to stay just the way she is; but when later on she and her best friend Sayaka encounter the same cat-like magical creature from her dream - who introduces himself as Kyubey - the pair discovers that magical girls are real, and what's more, they can choose to become one. All they must do is sign a contract with Kyubey and agree to take on the duty to fight abstract beings called 'witches' that spread despair to the human world, and in return, each one of them will be granted any single wish they desire. However, as Homura's omen suggests, there might be far more to becoming a magical girl than Madoka and Sayaka realize... Notes: - Due to the 2011 Tōhoku ear

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Hitomi Shizuki
characters.description: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies.

characters.name: Junko Kaname
characters.description: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher. She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

characters.name: Tomohisa Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 175-180 cm Madoka's father. A stay-at-home dad. He does housekeeping, cooking, laundry and cleaning.

characters.name: Kazuko Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 155-157 cm Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.

characters.name: Kyousuke Kamijou
characters.description: __Height:__ 170-175 cm A terminally ill boy whom Sayaka constantly visits. He used to play violin when he was younger and enjoys listening to classical musical CDs that Sayaka brings him.

characters.name: Tatsuya Kaname
characters.description: Madoka's little brother. He's 3 years old and goes to kindergarten.

title: Bocchi the Rock!
description: Hitori Gotou, “Bocchi-chan,” is a girl who’s so introverted and shy around people that she’d always start her conversations with “Ah...” During her middle school years, she started playing the guitar, wanting to join a band because she thought it could be an opportunity for even someone shy like her to also shine. But because she had no friends, she ended up practicing guitar for six hours every day all by herself. After becoming a skilled guitar player, she uploaded videos of herself playing the guitar to the internet under the name “Guitar Hero” and fantasized about performing at her school’s cultural festival concert. But not only could she not find any bandmates, before she knew it, she was in high school and still wasn’t able to make a single friend! She was really close to becoming a shut-in, but one day, Nijika Ijichi, the drummer in Kessoku Band, reached out to her. And because of that, her everyday life started to change little by little... (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Hitori Gotou
characters.description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

characters.name: Nijika Ijichi
characters.description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

characters.name: Ryou Yamada
characters.description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

characters.name: Ikuyo Kita
characters.description: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

characters.name: Seika Ijichi
characters.description: Nijika's older sister and manager of the live house "STARRY".

characters.name: Kikuri Hiroi
characters.description: Bassist and vocalist of the band "SICK HACK". Always drunk to forget about life's downsides.

characters.name: PA-san
characters.description: __Height:__ 162cm Mysterious looking female PA engineer with a mouth piercing. In her private life, she is active as a virtual Youtuber under the name "Otogi Alto" producing gameplay videos.

characters.name: Futari Gotou
characters.description: Hitori's younger sister.

characters.name: Naoki Gotou
characters.description: Hitori and Futari's father.

characters.name: Michiyo Gotou
characters.description: Hitori and Futari's mother.

characters.name: Jimihen
characters.description: The Gotou family dog.

characters.name: Shima Iwashita
characters.description: Drummer of the band "SICK HACK".

title: serial experiments lain
description: We're all connected... There is the world around us, a world of people, tactile sensation, and culture. There is the wired world, inside the computer, of images, personalities, virtual experiences, and a culture all of its own. The day after a classmate commits suicide, Lain, a 14-year-old girl, discovers how closely the two worlds are linked when she receives an e-mail from the dead girl: I just abandoned my body. I still live here... Has the line between the real world and the wired world begun to blur? (Source: Geneon Entertainment)

characters.name: Lain Iwakura
characters.description: Lain is a 14 year old girl who uncovers her true nature through the series. She is first depicted as a shy junior high school student with few friends or interests. ~!She later grows multiple, bolder personalities, both in the physical and Wired worlds.!~

characters.name: Masami Eiri
characters.description: ~!The key designer of Protocol 7. While working for Tachibana Labs, he illicitly included code enabling him to control the whole protocol at will and "embedded" his own consciousness in the protocol. Consequently, he was fired by Tachibana Labs and was soon found dead on a railway. He believes the only way for humans to evolve further is to absolve themselves from their physical limitations and live as digital entities. He also refers at himself as "god".!~

characters.name: Arisu Mizuki
characters.description: Lain's classmate and her only true friend throughout the series, Alice is a devoted confident and has a simple, sincere personality. She is the first to attempt to help Lain socialize by taking her to a nightclub, and from this point always tries to protect and take care of her. Alice is introduced as the shyest part of a junior high school trio, but her character development shows a fearless dedication to her friends. Alice's name, along with her friends Juri and Reika, were taken by [Chiaki Konaka](https://anilist.co/staff/101160/) from his previous work, [*Alice in Cyberland*](https://anilist.co/anime/5330/). Both characters also share the same voice actress by request.

characters.name: Mika Iwakura
characters.description: Lain's older sister, an apathetic 16-year-old student who casually picks on her little sister's habits and behavior. Mika is considered to be the only normal member of Lain's family; she sees her boyfriend in love hotels, is on a diet, and shops in Shibuya. ~!At a certain point in the series, her consciousness is seriously damaged by violent hallucinations. While Lain begins freely delving into the Wired, Mika is taken there by her proximity to Lain and gets stuck between the physical world and the Wired.!~

characters.name: Yasuo Iwakura
characters.description: Passionate about computers and electronic communication, he is shown as working with Eiri Masami at Tachibana Labs. He subtly pushes Lain, his daughter, toward the Wired and monitors her development until she becomes aware of her condition. ~!He leaves her telling her that he did not enjoy playing a family, but did love her. He seems eager to lure her into the Wired, but warns her not to get overly involved in it.!~

characters.name: Tarou
characters.description: An 11-year-old boy of about Lain's age, who occasionally works for the Knights to bring forth "the one truth." He has not yet been made a member, and is unaware of their full intentions. Taro loves virtual reality video games and hangs out all day at the Cyberia night-club with his friends, Myu-Myu and Masayuki. He has been described as a "techno punk teenager" by Michael Tribett, and uses special technology, such as custom HandiNavis and video goggles. Taro takes pride in his internet anonymity, and asks Lain for a date with her Wired self in exchange for information. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Karl Haushofer
characters.original: カール・ハウスホーファー

characters.name: J.J
characters.description: The DJ, who was a member of the Knights.

characters.name: Chisa Yomoda
characters.description: Chisa Yomoda is Lain's classmate. She's the one that initially gets Lain involved with the Wired. ~!She commits suicide at the beginning of the story and later contacts Lain from within the Wired saying "There was no reason for me to stay in the real world any longer. In the real world, it didn't matter if I was there or not. When I realized that, I was no longer afraid of losing my body."!~

characters.name: Reika Yamamoto
characters.description: Part of Lain's group of friends.

title: Lycoris Recoil
description: “LycoReco” is a café with a traditional Japanese twist located in downtown Tokyo. But the delicious coffee and sugary sweets are not the only orders this café takes! From delivering packages short distances, to pick-ups and drop-offs on the lonely streets at night, to zombies and giant monster extermination…?! Whatever your problem, we're here to help! We will solve any kind of "trouble" you may have! Waiting for you are the ever-smiling poster-girl and the cool, serious newcomer. A petite girl who never wants to work and a young woman approaching thirty who wants to get married. And the manager is a nice guy who’s obsessed with Japan! Whatever your order is, leave it all up to us♪ (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl. ~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco. A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris. She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees. Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”. ~!In episode 7 of the anime, it is revealed that Mika is gay.!~

characters.name: Mizuki Nakahara
characters.description: Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone. Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time. ~!In some later episodes, it is revealed that Kurumi is actually the hacker Walnut.!~

characters.name: Shinji Yoshimatsu
characters.description: A member of the Alan Institute. A regular at Café LycoReco. [Mika](https://anilist.co/character/268459/Mika)’s old friend. ~!He is later shot and killed by Mika!~

characters.name: Fuki Harukawa
characters.description: A 1st Lycoris of DA Tokyo branch. Previously [Takina](https://anilist.co/character/260328/Inoue-Takina)’s partner. She and [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato) fight like cats and dogs.

characters.name: Sakura Otome
characters.description: A 2nd Lycoris of DA Tokyo branch. She is Fuki's partner instead of Takina.

characters.name: Majima
characters.description: A terrorist who attacked a subway station.~!He was the one who blew up the radio tower prior to the events of the series, and had met young chisato during that time!~~!He, alongside Chisato is also a child of Alan!~~!In the last episode he is shown falling to his death, however shortly after it is revealed he survived!~

characters.name: Kusunoki
characters.description: DA Commander.

characters.name: Abe
characters.description: A detective for the Oshiage Police Department.

title: NANA
description: Two twenty-somethings seemingly share nothing in common apart from their first name, but a chance meeting on a train bound for Tokyo sets Nana Komatsu and Nana Oosaki on a collision course with destiny. Nana Komatsu, a love-at-first-sight dreamer, aims to find enduring happiness in the big city. Nana Oosaki, neo punk rock vocalist, pursues her burning ambitions of musical stardom and worldwide fame. As their fates increasingly intertwine, they each chase their dreams — until the harsh realities of life in big city Tokyo threaten to tear everything apart. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Nana Komatsu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5’2) Komatsu came to Tokyo, looking to find her dream. Unlike Osaki, Komatsu came from a large and happy household, though her childish outlook prevented her from living on her own initially. She's the middle child of three sisters. Her chance encounter with Osaki began a friendship which changes Komatsu's life forever. She is introduced to Osaki's band, Black Stones, and their members. She later even helps "Blast" to find their bassist, by drawing a poster to advertise the vacancy. Much to her surprise, she also discovers that the members of Blast were friends with the members of Trapnest, a popular rock band of which she's a very big fan.

characters.name: Nana Oosaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") One of the two titular characters of the series, Oosaki Nana may look like a tough punk rocker, but she has a kind heart and is a devoted friend. Abandoned by her parents and raised by her grandmother, Nana was expelled from high school after she was falsely accused of prostitution. Despite these hardships, Nana "polishes the shards of her dreams" and is determined to be successful as the lead vocalist of Blast. She is now engaged to her first love, [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/1425), although she also has lingering, ambiguous feelings for [Yasu](https://anilist.co/character/2450). Nana's favourite things never change. Her favorite designer is Vivienne Westwood, and her favorite band is the Sex Pistols. She smokes Seven Stars and likes coffee with milk and strawberry cake. She also has the ability to cook, but prepares all her food with too much salt which

characters.name: Shinichi Okazaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Shinichi Okazaki is the bass player of Blast, and youngest member of the band, being only 15 years old. Shin was born in Sweden, he speaks British English with a Swedish accent. Due to his dysfunctional family, Shin left his home and abandoned his original family name. ~!He moonlights as a male prostitute, with Reira being one of his clients. Among other things, he is an expert mahjong player and a confidant and early roommate to Nobu. He stops seeing Reira to protect her status and his own feelings—also possibly sparked from fear by Takumi's warning. Ryouko Kawashigi, one of his older clients, bears a striking resemblance to Reira and he sees her again after the two musicians ended their relationship. She lives near his parents' apartment, works as a stewardess, and is the one that taught Shin "bad things". He and Ryouko were put under arrest for possession of marijua

characters.name: Ren Honjou
characters.description: BLAST's former bassist, and Trapnest's current guitarist. He is very popular and his music is well-received by fans. He and Nana Oosaki were once in a relationship. Ren is a big fan of the Sex Pistols; he participated in a tribute album to them, and wears a "Sid Vicious" padlock around his neck that he received from Nana. Nana had an image of a lotus tattooed on her upper arm in honor of him ("Ren" is a Japanese name for lotus). The brand of the cigarettes he originally smoked was the 'Seven Stars'. Nana first met him through Nobu, who really just admired him from afar. Ren was popular around their hometown for supposedly being found as a baby in an abandoned warehouse, which he lives in to this day. He isn't ashamed of this; he actually brags about it. Ren and Nana are proven to be very similar throughout the series, but they are not totally similar. R

characters.name: Layla Serizawa
characters.description: Although her name is often transliterated as "Reira", her actual name is "Layla", after Eric Clapton's famous song of the same name. She is half-American, half-Japanese, and is the lead singer of Trapnest. She also penned some of their songs. Layla's friendship with her band comes all the way back to her elementary school days, starting with Takumi Ichinose. The two met when Layla and her mother moved to Japan. Often criticized by the neighborhood because of her then-vague understanding of the Japanese language, Takumi was asked to befriend her. The two stuck together throughout their childhood, mostly teaching each other about their first language - Reira learned more about Japanese, while Takumi learned more about English.

characters.name: Nobuo Terashima
characters.description: He is the guitarist of Blast; attended the same high school as Nana Osaki. He is friendly and optimistic, but at times, he tends to miss the focus of conversations around him. Before Nana's "smoking ban", he's the only non-smoking member of Blast. But, his poor threshold for alcohol meant that he leaked many secrets while he's drunk (most notably, about Nana and Ren's relationship to Shin). Like Yasushi, Nobu comes from a rich family (his parents own an inn). Despite this, he is still very passionate about music, even sharing Osaki's dream of making it big with a band one day. ~!He falls in love with Hachi and they start a short but happy relationship. When Takumi tells Nobu about her pregnancy, Hachi painfully leaves him for Takumi. While he eventually accepts the reasons why she left him, he still fears the possibility of the child being his and he co

characters.name: Yasushi Takagi
characters.description: He plays percussion and is the leader of Blast, usually handling the business partnerships and financial decisions needed for the band's success. His favorite cigarette brand is "Black Stones", from which the band got their name. He is also a lawyer in training, despite his "scary" appearance (clean shaven head, many earrings and dark glasses). He's the big brother figure for Nana O—and sometimes Nobu—and acted as Nana's "guardian" when she arrived in Tokyo. In the past, he shared several ties with Trapnest's members. Yasu and Ren grew up in the same orphanage and remained close friends when Yasu was adopted. He dated Reira while in high school and was jealous of Takumi's success and influence on her, which he later relates as the reasons for their break up. Also, he's the oldest member of Blast which Nobu sometimes teases him about (by calling him "old man"). ~!He is in a budding romanc

characters.name: Takumi Ichinose
characters.description: **Height**: 183 cm The leader and bassist of Trapnest. He is handsome and has a reputation of being a playboy. Despite his raw sexual charisma, Takumi can also be a cold and controlling workaholic. His favorite brand of cigarettes is Gitanes. ~!Coming from a family with an alcoholic and bitter father, he and his older sister learned to be independent at a young age due to their mother being bed-ridden with illness in the hospital. He looked after Layla since they were children and always harbored a brother-like care for her. He ends up dating and sleeping with Hachi, which dubiously resulted in Hachi's pregnancy. For some reason, perhaps because of his family background or because he is starting to become possessive, he refuses to leave Hachi and the unborn child despite Hachi's uncertainty whether it is his or Nobu's. In a previous chapter, Naoki said something to Yasu about Takumi not

characters.name: Kyousuke Takakura
characters.description: Junko's boyfriend who currently shares an apartment with her. He's also good friends with Hachi and Shouji. His laid-back attitude to life may deem him a slacker in the eyes of many, but he's actually quite perceptive and he coddles Hachi more than Junko would like. Both him and Junko are studying to become artists (his art being Romantic and hers being Post-Modernistic).

characters.name: Naoki Fujieda
characters.description: He is the drummer of Trapnest. Like Nobu in Black Stones, he's the "clueless", loud-mouthed member of his band. As with the rest of his bandmates, he's a friend of Yasu. He's a big fan of glam rock bands or musical artists, like David Bowie, and his look is inspired by the glam rock look. He started playing drums when Takumi asked him to be in the music club in high school, thinking that he'd be perfect in him and Reira's band with his blond hair and "Prince"-ly appearance. Naoki was very excited by this idea, thinking he'd get tons of girls and popularity by being in a band. He realized right away that being in a band isn't as easy as he thought. He didn't immediately join Trapnest, and played in a few small bands that never really even had any gigs before joining them. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sachiko Kawamura
characters.description: **Height**: 146 cm She works at the same restaurant as Shoji. Early on in the manga, Hachi once dreamt of Shoji two-timing her with a buxom, Prada-loving city girl named Sachiko (she thought of the name randomly). Ominously, it later turned out to be true, though the real Sachiko is nothing like "virtual" Sachiko. Interestingly, Hachi also plays with the idea of naming her unborn daughter Sachiko. ~!Later on, she starts dating Shoji and they become a couple.!~

characters.name: Miu Shinoda
characters.description: A placid and soft-spoken actress who shares a boarding house with Blast and [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/22258/Matsumoto-Asami). She is 27, but her acting profile states that she is 23. Her name is often mispronounced "Myuu" by many people. Miu wears long sleeves to hide the scars on her wrists from self-mutilation. Also, in volume 11 (the volume where she first appears), it's shown that she's a very good mahjong player (she claimed that she learned her skills by having special training for her role in a mahjong movie as a nameless rival). ~!She is currently dating [Yasu](https://anilist.co/character/2450/Takagi-Yasushi).!~

title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season
title_original: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 3rd season
title_en: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3
description: A year has passed since Subaru’s victory at the Sanctuary. He savors a life of fulfillment while Emilia’s camp stands united for the royal selection—until a fateful letter arrives. Anastasia, a royal selection candidate, has invited Emilia to the Watergate City of Priestella. But as the party begins its journey, crisis stirs beneath the surface and Subaru meets a cruel fate once again. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: The first episode has an extended runtime of ~90 minutes, and received an early premiere at Anime Expo on July 5, 2024.

characters.name: Emilia
characters.description: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5") Emilia is a half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella),

characters.name: Subaru Natsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak. While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and prote

characters.name: Reinhard van Astrea
characters.original: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア
characters.description: __Height__: 184 cm (6'0") Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt's](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) knight. As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital. As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

characters.name: Beatrice
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") __Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~ The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences. ~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~ ~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

characters.name: Felt
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11") A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family. ~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

characters.name: Ram
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”) Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

characters.name: Anastasia Hoshin
characters.original: アナスタシア・ホーシン
characters.description: Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius). Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

characters.name: Aldebaran
characters.description: **Height:** 173 cm (5'8") Aldebaran, commonly known as Al, is [Priscilla Barielle](https://anilist.co/character/90186/Priscilla-Barielle)'s knight, though he claims to just be a subordinate. He has a frivolous personality and acts aloof, but shows insecurity regarding his disfigured face and wears a helmet to conceal it. Due to that, he is a man of both eccentric appearance and behavior. ~!Like Subaru, he is revealed to be from Japan and was summoned roughly 18 years before Subaru. Shortly after he was summoned, he lost his left arm in an unfortunate incident in the Empire of Vollachia. !~

characters.name: Wilhelm van Astrea
characters.original: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was [Theresia van Astrea](https://anilist.co/character/124116/van-Astrea-Theresia)'s husband. Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. However this wasn't always the case as in youth, Wilhelm was very opposite of who he was in his later years. Brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, becoming increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that

characters.name: Elsa Granhiert
characters.original: エルザ・グランヒルテ
characters.description: An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes. ~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

characters.name: Roswaal Mathers
characters.original: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース
characters.description: ~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~ The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal. He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well. ~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

characters.name: Julius Euclius
characters.original: ユリウス・ユークリウス
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father. As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are. Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/

title: Kuzu no Honkai
description: Hanabi has loved her older friend Narumi for years, but she’s still in high school and not only is Narumi now her new homeroom teacher, he’s also clearly in love with the music teacher, Akane. And as awkward as being the unwanted third in a romantic triangle can be, things become even more twisted for Hanabi when she learns that another student, Mugi, is in love with Akane. That leads to a strange idea: since the ones that Mugi and Hanabi are in love with aren’t available, the two unrequited thirds start to explore the idea of becoming each other’s substitute surrogate relationship. It’s not about romance, of course. Just sex and convenience. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Hanabi Yasuraoka
characters.description: At the beginning of the story she's in love with [Narumi Kanai](https://anilist.co/character/120993/Kanai-Narumi), her childhood friend who is now her teacher. She immediately realizes that Narumi is in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) and not her. She meets [Mugi Awaya](https://anilist.co/character/120990/Awaya-Mugi), who is in love with Akane, and starts a relationship with him to satisfy each other's loneliness. She has different attitudes with each character: she's cheerful with [Sanae Ebato](https://anilist.co/character/120992/Ebato-Sanae), her best friend, timid with Narumi Kanai and sincere with Mugi because she trusts him a lot.

characters.name: Mugi Awaya
characters.description: He falls in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) accepting the fact he has no chance of making her his. He is shown to be emotionless and revealed minimum expression, but as the story goes on, things start to change. He also shows a caring side for the ones close to him. Moka, a childhood friend, has deep feelings for Mugi, but he denies her feelings for him because he knows well he would ruin her.

characters.name: Akane Minagawa
characters.description: Akane Minagawa is a music teacher at Hanabi's school. She hides her true personality with a "mask" at the beginning of the story, but it's clear to see that she is very manipulative and takes pride in hurting others. ~!She is a compulsive cheater who would sleep with anyone to make her feel better about herself. She likes the feeling of being wanted and needed by someone. With that being said, both Mugi and Narumi fall in love with her, she doesn't mind playing with men and toying with their feelings.!~

characters.name: Sanae Ebato
characters.description: Sanae is introduced to the series as the best friend of the main character, Hanabi. She is shown to be a supportive character in the beginning, but when they're alone, she tends to be very possessive. ~!Her ill feelings towards men began when she was almost molested by a man on the train, although saved by Hanabi, leaving her scared. Sanae begins to have romantic feelings towards Hanabi as the story progresses.!~

characters.name: Narumi Kanai
characters.description: Narumi Kanai is amicable and benign. He is also a teacher at Hanabi's school, who he cares deeply about but never views her relationship wise, more like a precious little sister. ~!Narumi appeared to fall in love with Akane, although he knew that she had a hobby of sleeping with other men. He is prepared to cherish her for the rest of his life even if she cheats on him, he just cares about her happiness.!~

characters.name: Noriko Kamomebata
characters.description: Noriko Kamomebata or as she likes to be called, Moka, is shown to be childish and whiney. Her appearance is intended to make her look like a princess who is in need of a "prince". Mugi is her childhood friend who she fell in love with. Although she may be annoying, she seems to care for others and like to see them happy. Her size makes her look younger than she actually is.

characters.name: Atsuya Kirishima
characters.description: Sanae's cousin.

characters.name: Takuya Terauchi
characters.description: One of Akane's former students who is in a physical relationship with her. Hanabi approaches him in an attempt to make Akane jealous, but she realizes that she is unable to repeat Akane's behavior. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mei Hayakawa
characters.description: Mugi's senior at high school. Mugi turned to her after being unable to initially confess to Akane and they had sex. Afterwards, Mei apologizes to Mugi for rushing him into it. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Shinsekai yori
description: Following a sudden outbreak of psychokinesis in 0.1% of the population, a rapid transformation swept the world. The godlike ability to manipulate matter remotely turned many power wielders to violence, inciting a long period of upheaval. Finally, after a chaotic era shaped by the rise and fall of oppressive regimes, the psychic humans were able to achieve a fragile peace by isolating their society, creating a new world bound by complex rules. In the town of Kamisu 66, 12-year-old Saki Watanabe has just awakened to her powers and is relieved to rejoin her friends—the mischievous Satoru Asahina, the shy Mamoru Itou, the cheerful Maria Akizuki, and Shun Aonuma, a mysterious boy whom Saki admires—at Sage Academy, a special school for psychics. However, unease looms as Saki begins to question the fate of those unable to awaken to their powers, and the children begin to get involved with secretive matters such as the rumored Tainted Cats said to abduct children. Shinsekai yori tells the unique coming-of-age story of Saki and her friends as they journey to grow into their roles in the supposed utopia. Accepting these roles, however, might not come easy when faced with the dark and shockin

characters.name: Saki Watanabe
characters.description: Saki is the main character and narrator of the story. Saki is a new student at the magic school, “Saint Academy”. Once she joins Saint Academy, she hangs out with [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/57571/Asahina-Satoru), [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/57573/Akizuki-Maria), and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/57575/Aonuma-Shun), her friends from Wakien Elementary School, as well as [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/57589/Itou-Mamoru), her new classmate. While she's not shy, she is sensitive and delicate.

characters.name: Satoru Asahina
characters.description: A loud, brash 12-year-old who is part of a childhood friend group consisting of himself, Saki, Shun, Maria and Mamoru that attends Sage Academy in Kamisu 66. Satoru is a quick-witted and observant person who cares a lot about his friends despite poking fun at them. He is shown to be particularly close with Saki, as he teases and argues with her more often than the others. Like the rest of the students at the academy, he has a psychic ability called Cantus. During summer camp, the group of five go off on a wild adventure that leads to Satoru and Saki being separated from the others and them meeting a Queerat named Squealer, who appears trustworthy at first but seems to have dangerous intentions.

characters.name: Maria Akizuki
characters.description: Maria is Saki's best friend and a beautiful girl with pale, white skin and blazing red hair. She's very strong willed, and commands the weak, quiet Mamoru, but in times of need she devotes herself to protecting him. On the other hand, she does show a girlish fear of scary stories too. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Shun Aonuma
characters.description: Another one of Saki's childhood friends. Shun is very clever, with a strong intellectual curiosity and mature manners. His marks in magic are excellent at Saint Academy, and many have high hopes for his future. According to Satoru, Shun is the most talented at using the Force in their group.

characters.name: Mamoru Itou
characters.description: After joining Saint Academy and being put in the same class as Saki, he follows them around. He's a very shy boy, and rarely voices his own thoughts and opinions. ~!As he grows older, he starts to have feelings towards Maria. He and Maria were killed after their child's birth.!~ (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Squealer
characters.original: 野狐丸; スクィーラ
characters.description: Squealer is a queerat, an intelligent species that work as servants to humans. Like others of his species, he's small and has the appearance of a giant rat, but is very intelligent and astute. He is the representative of the Robber Fly, a colony of queerats. ~!His ideals are freedom, equality between humans and queerats, and the end of the monarchy system inside of the queerats colonies where the queen is the absolute ruler. He helps [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/57569) and her friends to escape from the wild queerats that were pursuing them. Later, he rescues [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/57573) and [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/57589) from the tainted cats and keeps them in his colony. But his main objective was to get a human child from them to start a revolution. Once he got the child and bred it until it got the cantus, around 10 years old, he uses it to attack

characters.name: Rijin
characters.description: A high priest of the Temple of Purification who seals away the children's telekinesis for breaking the rules and escorts them to be judged. ~!He is killed by a Balloon Dog (風船犬 Fuusen Inu) while escorts the children.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mushin
characters.description: Head Priest of the Temple of Purity.

characters.name: Kiroumaru
characters.description: The supreme commander of the Giant Hornets colony. Despite having orders to kill the children, he risked his life to help them escape. ~!Much later on, his colony was destroyed by a Fiend sent by Yakomaru and he barely survived. He was briefly held captive at the Temple of Purification before Saki released him. After that, he assisted Saki and her group to Tokyo and eventually sacrificed his life to defeat the Fiend.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Takashi Sugiura
characters.description: Saki's father.

title: Yuru Camp△
description: Rin likes to go camping by herself along the lakes that provide a scenic view of Mt. Fuji. Nadeshiko loves to take cycling trips by herself to places where she can see Mt. Fuji. After they meet, Rin and Nadeshiko take camping trips, eat cup ramen together, and enjoy the scenery. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nadeshiko Kagamihara
characters.description: A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

characters.name: Aoi Inuyama
characters.description: A gentle girl who speaks with a Kansai accent. Of the reckless outdoor crew members, Aoi is like the secret leader who looks out for everyone during important times. She’s called 'Inuko' by [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/124578). (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Chiaki Oogaki
characters.description: A bright and active person, in charge of choosing the camping spots and gear. She’s lively and cheerful, but is also full of emotion and easily brought to tears. Wanting to camp, she forms the outdoor crew with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/124577). (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Ena Saitou
characters.description: Rin’s friend, a free spirited person who goes at her own pace. She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she occasionally shows interest in their activities. She also gives casual advice to Rin, who is bad at dealing with people. She has a dog called 'Chikuwa.'

characters.name: Rin Shima
characters.description: A solo camper who started camping due to her grandfather’s influence. She experiences camping with another person for the first time when she meets [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Kagamihara-Nadeshiko). She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she worries about Nadeshiko a bit.

characters.name: Saki Shima
characters.description: [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Rin-Shima)'s mother.

characters.name: Sakura Kagamihara
characters.description: Sakura Kagamihara is the older sister of [Nadeshiko Kagamihara](https://anilist.co/character/124576). She often drives Nadeshiko to and from campsite destinations.

characters.name: Minami Toba
characters.description: A substitute teacher, soon become the advisor for Outdoor Activities Club. It is later revealed that she has already met Nadeshiko and Rin. ~!She was seen drinking incredible amounts of booze while camping with her little sister.!~

characters.name: Ryouko Toba
characters.description: [Minami](https://anilist.co/character/131523)'s sister.

characters.name: Chikuwa
characters.description: Chikuwa is Ena's pet dog.

characters.name: Kikukawa Subaru
characters.description: Talkative mountain climber

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon S
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴンＳ
description: A strange turn of events leads the Dragon, Tohru, to work as Miss Kobayashi's maid. She occasionally (that's a lie, she often) causes trouble for her beloved Miss Kobayashi while blending into human society and splendidly (that's a lie, only mediocrely) carrying out her maid duties. Her fellow dragons, Kanna, Lucoa, Fafnir, and Elma all find their own places to fit in as well and enjoy interspecies interactions with the humans. Yet while they're all enjoying that laid-back and occasionally turbulent left, the threat of a new Dragon swoops down upon Miss Kobayashi. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Damocles
characters.description: Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown. Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru. However, unlike other Chaos Dragons, he respects the non-interference laws preventing dragons from killing humans of Earth, although when angered, he attacks Kobayashi and threatens to leave her at the brink of death. Despite this, he cares for his daughter and is concerned for her safety and happiness.

title: Majo no Tabitabi
title_en: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
description: Inspired by her favorite book, Elaina ventures out to see the world she's read so much about. Like a leaf on the wind, she travels from one country to another, looking to sate her inquisitiveness and searching for new experiences. She's confronted by humanity in all its forms, whether strange, bizarre, or emotional. Exploration and curiosity drive her journey. Where to next, Elaina? (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Elaina
characters.description: On her broom, she flies from country to country with her long, black robes adorning the lengths of her arms and trailing behind her with every weave and turn. Her purple-blue eyes peer out from beneath a black tricorn hat to reveal beautiful and silky ashen hair that flows down her back like clouds flowing through summer skies. On her chest is pinned a star-shaped brooch — signifying her status as a witch. Prior to the main story, she was a sheltered child who was greatly proficient in magic, innocent, and "not knowing what failure is."

characters.name: Saya
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Saya is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is an apprentice witch who [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina) meets in the Land of Mages as a novice. Saya has black hair tied back in a small tassel on the left side and blue eyes. She initially wears a charcoal grey outfit, black stockings, and white boots. Saya is a person with a kind personality on the outside, but is slightly manipulative in her thinking as shown when she manipulated Elaina to stay with her for a while. She also has a desire to have company and friends, which mostly stemmed from her younger sister returning back to her homeland without her.

characters.name: Fran
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Fran is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina)'s master and a witch. Fran has long black hair, blue eyes, and has a beauty mark underneath her right eye. She wears a midnight-blue hat with a red ribbon coiled around it and a matching color outfit both of which have a stary night pattern in the interior. She also wears beige-colored pants, red earrings, brown boots, and her witch's brooch on her right chest. She's portrayed as an elated and jocular woman. Compared to the other witches in Robetta, she's shown to be a non-judgemental person.

characters.name: Sheila
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Sheila is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Sheila has long blonde hair tied back in a ponytail and green eyes. She wears a white jacket with a navy blue interior over a brown dress shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes.

characters.name: Elaina no Haha
characters.description: Light Novel Volume 14 Chapter 4 & Anime Episode 10 Spoilers: ~!It is revealed that Elaina's Mother is Victorica (ヴィクトリカ) aka Fran no Shishou (フランの師匠), [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/149042) and [Sheila](https://anilist.co/character/177010)'s teacher. Her appearance is heavily similar to [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina). She wears a witch hat with a pink ribbon tied around it, a black jacket with pink collars and interior over a red vest. Furthermore, she wears long black socks and boots. Sometime before the main story begins, she trained [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/149042/Fran) to become a witch. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)!~ ~!She also uses the pen name Niké when writing her stories.!~

characters.name: Amnesia
characters.description: Amnesia is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is described as a mysterious girl who always lost her memories every time she sleeps. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

title: Hibike! Euphonium
description: Spring in the first year of high school. Kumiko, a member of the brass band in junior high school, visits the high school brass band club with classmates Hazuki and Sapphire. There, she comes across Reina, her former classmate from junior high. Hazuki and Sapphire decide to join the club, but Kumiko can’t make up her mind. She recollects her experience with Reina at a competition in junior high school. (Source: Pony Canyon USA)

characters.name: Kumiko Oumae
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

characters.name: Reina Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

characters.name: Hazuki Katou
