characters.description: **Instrument:** Tuba Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

characters.name: Sapphire Kawashima
characters.description: **Instrument:** Contrabass Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Asuka Tanaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words. However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band. By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she

characters.name: Shuuichi Tsukamoto
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Trombone Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.

characters.name: Noboru Taki
characters.description: __Height:__ 184cm Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

characters.name: Aoi Saitou
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Tenor Saxophone She is a third-year student who quit the Kitauji brass band, having played the tenor saxophone since junior high school. Aoi was Kumiko Oumae and Shuuichi Tsukamoto's childhood friend, two years older than them. They lived in the same neighborhood, and often played together, but grew apart as they got older.

characters.name: Mamiko Oumae
characters.description: Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.

characters.name: Haruka Ogasawara
characters.description: __Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

characters.name: Kaori Nakaseko
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm **Instrument:** Trumpet A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.

title: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta…
title_original: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグしかない悪役令嬢に転生してしまった…
title_en: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
description: Wealthy heiress Katarina Claes is hit in the head with a rock and recovers the memories of her past life. It turns out the world she lives in is the world of the game Fortune Lover, an otome game she was obsessed with in her past life... but she's been cast as the villain character who tries to foil the protagonist's romances! The best ending the game has for Katarina is exile, and the worst, death! She'll have to find a way to avoid triggering the flags of doom, and make her own happy future! (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Katarina Claes
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Earth The main villain of the Fortune Lover game, however, after she recalls her previous life as a Japanese student, her personality underwent a massive change and she became much nicer and more humble. Game Description: The quintessential villainess. A selfish, spoiled princess type. Because [Prince Gerald](https://anilist.co/character/129134) injured her during childhood, they had gotten engaged. Because of this scar, she considered the prince to be hers, and bound him to her. In addition, she didn’t think highly of suddenly getting a stepbrother, and often bullied him.

characters.name: Gerald Stuart
characters.original: ジオルド・スティアート
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Fire Gerald is the third prince of the country, and the capture target that is Katarina's fiance. Even though he looks like an orthodox blonde-haired, blue-eyed prince, Katarina thought otherwise that on the inside he’s actually an evil sadistic prince. However, even though Gerald in the game was supposed to be “not interested in Katarina at all, and almost never visited her, before she noticed, he would come over to her house once every three days. And, he even helps Katarina harvest the fruits and vegetables from the field, and would always bring her sweets as presents, and were completely friends now. They have a lot of contact. __Game Description:__ Gerald, though have a prince out of a fairy tale look but his personality was twisted and schemer. He is a genius who can do anything. He has no particular interests and is bored with his everyday life.

characters.name: Keith Claes
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Earth Keith is the capture target that was adopted into the Claes family seven years ago for his powerful magic. He’s a handsome boy with flaxen hair and blue eyes, and since he was neglected by his stepmother and stepsister, had a lonely upbringing and became a playboy type character because of it. And when he entered school, his loneliness was supposed to be healed by the heroine and he would fall in love, but to prevent that from happening, Katarina has been pulling him out of his room every day. During this time, without Katarina having to pull him out anymore it turned out that they were always together. Game Description: The 3rd capturable character in the game Fortune Lover and the stepbrother of Katarina Claes. He was adopted from a branch family because of his huge magical powers. he is treated coldly by his stepsister and stepmother. As a reaction to this lack o

characters.name: Alan Stuart
characters.original: アラン・ステイア一 ト
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Water Alan is the fourth prince of this country, and is Gerald’s younger twin brother as well as a capture target. He’s a beautiful prince with a wild streak, with silver hair and blue eyes, and he’s always being compared to Gerald, so he’s constantly in pain from feelings of inferiority, and it should have been set that he hates his brother, but Alan didn’t seem to be troubled by an inferiority complex or anything at all now, and it doesn’t seem like he hates Gerald either. Katarina didn't know she was the reason why the twins relationship has been reasonably good. Although Alan route Katarina didn’t appear as she wasn’t a rival, in the game she should have had hardly any contact with Alan but he would come to visit her almost every day, and his talent for music has completely bloomed so Katarina always receive invitations to his piano and violin concerts and would alway

characters.name: Nicol Ascart
characters.description: __Magic Type: Wind__ The fourth capturable character of the otome game Fortune Lover. He’s the taciturn, expressionless son of the prime minister, and also a capture target. With black hair and eyes, and a perfect doll-like face, he’s a handsome boy with a devilish charm that can even capture men as well as women with his unique atmosphere. Game Description: Nicole Ascarot, the prime minister’s son, Alan and Gerald’s childhood friend. He’s one year older than the heroine, and is a taciturn senpai type of character. (Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

characters.name: Mary Hunt
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Water The 4th daughter of Marquis Hunt, a feeble and weak character in the otome game Fortune Lover who was supposed to have no contact with Katarina. Mary is Alan’s fiancee, and is also the rival character on his route. She’s a beauty with auburn hair and doll-like eyes. In the game settings, she didn’t think highly of Katarina Claes, and just like Alan, should have had almost no contact with Katarina, but she’s already one of her best friends now. (Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

characters.name: Sophia Ascart
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Wind Sophia, Nicol's sister and rival for the path of Nicol. She is as beautiful as her brother and should not have been in contact with Katarina, but now she is her companion, and one of her best friends, like Mary.

characters.name: Maria Campbell
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Light Maria Campbell was the main character of the game Fortune Lover. Maria worked hard and actively participated in household chores, never complained or said anything selfish, and desperately studied. When she entered magic school, her long years of hopes for magic school were immediately shattered when she learned she was the only commoner. What’s more, she was also bullied for the audacity of having magic powers despite only being a commoner.

characters.name: Sirius Deek
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Wind~!Dark magic!~ Student Council President at Magic Academy. ~!His real name is Rafael Walt, which he goes by after the events of the second LN. Previously known as Sirius Deek, an illegitimate son of Marquis Deek of a maid. In the town he lives, he was constantly being picked on though he has never told his mother. However, he and his mother were kidnapped by Marquess Deek. She who felt inferior to Rafael's mother who was both beautiful and bore a healthy and handsome son while Marquess Deek has a sickly son named Sirius Deek. Marquess Deek revealed her intention of both robbing the life and magic of Rafael and his mother. A forbidden ritual happened and Rafael's mother died after her magic was moved to Sirius and Sirius died afterward his soul was extracted and merged to Rafael's body. Rafael became Sirius however, despite the merging of Sirius and Rafael's memories,

characters.name: Anne Shelly
characters.description: Anne Sherry is Katarina Claes's personal maid, who has been in her service ever since she was 8 years old.

characters.name: Millidiana Claes
characters.original: ミリディアナ・クラエス

characters.name: Atsuko Sasaki
characters.description: Sasaki Atsuko, commonly known as A-chan, was Katarina's best friend in her previous life. In elementary school, Atsuko was often teased, ignored, and had her stuff hidden. She was kept out of the loop by everyone and this caused her to become recluse and afraid of other people.

title: citrus
description: Fashionable and friendly Yuzu Aihara is ready to face her brand-new school and find her first love. The only problem? It's an all-girls' school. Determined to make a good impression and lots of friends, Yuzu puts on her best looks—only to wind up in trouble on day-one! After a close encounter by the beautiful yet harsh student council president Mei and having her phone confiscated, Yuzu is losing hope that this will be a perfect high school story. But nothing compares to the shock when she gets home to find out Mei is her brand-new stepsister—who suddenly kisses her! With her heart beating wildly and her emotions a complete mess, Yuzu wonders something: Is she falling for Mei? Torn between being a good stepsister and dealing with her feelings, Yuzu does everything she can to become close to Mei. But can she melt the ice around Mei's heart and heal the pain she hides? (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Mei Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

characters.name: Yuzu Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei). Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

characters.name: Harumi Taniguchi
characters.description: Harumi, most known as "Harumin", befriends Yuzuko being that she is a "Gyaru in Disguise". As she isn't one of the students who have been attending the academy since Elementary School, she takes no interest in following around the Student Council President and often packs items within her cleavage. As an individual, Harumi is perky, caring and an overall good friend towards Yuzuko.

characters.name: Matsuri Mizusawa
characters.description: Matsuri is a second-year in middle school and Yuzu's childhood friend who lived close to her before she moved to the Aihara residence. Matsuri makes her first appearance in chapter 8. She is a pretty girl who is always seen with a pair of headphones around her neck. being very sly and fake toward an unidentified friend. She comes across Yuzu and Harumin at an arcade and invites them out to karaoke. Harumin is appears to be quite wary and suspicious of her. Upon deducing the nature of Yuzu's feelings toward Mei, Matsuri professes a romantic interest in Yuzu and kisses her in front of Mei. She sells masturbation videos she finds on the Internet to old men through a phone app, and tells them they are hers, as a means of income. She considers men to be dense and believes that all can be manipulated easily.

characters.name: Himeko Momokino
characters.description: Himeko is a Student Council Member and Mei's childhood friend. Himeko has a rather stuck-up and stubborn personality, and despises people who don't follow the school regulations.

characters.name: Kayo Maruta
characters.description: Kayo Maruta is a supporting character and ex-vice-president of the student council. She is best friends with Mitsuko, who she affectionately calls Micchan. Kayo is one of the few people who dares to talk to Mitsuko casually and lives to see another day; she also is seen at Micchan's side for much of the latter half of the manga. Glasses-senpai talks formally with everybody else. While on the student council at Aihara Academy, Maruta was dedicated and very diligent at making sure people are rule-followers, even chastising Yuzu while it's her first day there. Eventually, the brunette lightens up later on and shows her softer side for Micchan and the readers, as well as the group that went on the summer trip in volume 8. During the extra in volume four of the manga, she reveals her surname and her past position in the council.

characters.name: Sara Tachibana
characters.description: A young-looking silver-haired girl who Yuzu befriends in the Tokyo Train Station after they both miss a train (coincidentally, to the same place, Kyoto). Sara believes in things such as fate and soul mates, and as such believes she and Yuzu were "destined to meet."

characters.name: Nina Tachibana
characters.description: Sara's younger twin sister, who is skeptical and does not believe in fate.

characters.name: Shou Aihara
characters.description: Mei's father, later Yuzu's new stepfather

characters.name: Ume Aihara
characters.description: Biological mother of [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Yuzu-Aihara), stepmother of [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Mei-Aihara)

title: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken 4th Season Part 1 & 2
title_original: 転生したらスライムだった件 第4期 第1&2クール
title_en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4
description: Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near! (Source: Crunchyroll News)

characters.name: Rimuru Tempest
characters.description: __Species:__ Human (past life) → Slime __Kind:__ Reincarnated, Otherworlder Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

characters.name: Veldora Tempest
characters.original: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト
characters.description: __Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) __Species:__ True Dragon __Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally __Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

characters.name: Ranga
characters.description: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

characters.name: Milim Nava
characters.description: __Kind:__ Inhabitant "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

characters.name: Benimaru
characters.description: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

characters.name: Souei
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre) Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

characters.name: Shuna
characters.description: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

characters.name: Daikenja
characters.description: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. ~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~ ~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

characters.name: Rigurd
characters.description: Formerly the chief of the goblin village [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru) comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

characters.name: Rigur
characters.description: Rigur was named after his late elder brother. Rigur, after making [Gobta](https://anilist.co/character/129350/Gobta) the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348/Rigurd).

characters.name: Gobta
characters.description: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

title: Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level MAX ni Nattemashita
title_original: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました
title_en: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
description: An at-home comedy about a powerful girl who doesn’t work too hard!(⋈◍ ˃ᴗ˂ ◍)。✧♡ After dying of overwork in the real world, I’m reincarnated as an immortal witch, and I spend 300 years enjoying a relaxing life. At some point, though, I end up at level 99! All those years spent killing slimes to make the money to pay the bills gave me a ton of experience points… Rumors of the level 99 witch spread, and soon I’m up to my ears in curious adventurers, duelist dragons, and even a monster girl calling me her mom! “This isn’t a dojo, so don’t come here to fight me…!” I’ve never been on an adventure, but I’m the strongest in the world… What’s going to happen to my relaxing life?! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Azusa Aizawa
characters.description: Commonly known as "The Witch of the Highlands." A girl who was reincarnated as an immortal witch with the appearance of a seventeen-year-old. Before she knew what was happening, she'd become the strongest being in the world. Although she's had some rough times, it has ultimately given her a family, and she's delighted about it.

characters.name: Laika
characters.description: A dragon girl and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She's fastidious and cares a lot about what others think, but she's a good, earnest, and hardworking girl. Gothic Lolita clothes, maid outfits, and other frilly things suit her very well (which embarrasses her).

characters.name: Halkara
characters.description: A young elf woman and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She is an upstanding CEO who runs a company using her knowledge of mushrooms, but in the house in the highlands, she's known for her knack for screwing up.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.description: A high-ranking demon known as the Lord of the Flies and the demons' minister of agriculture. She frequently shuttles between the demon realm and the house in the highlands. She's [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s reliable "big sister" surrogate.

characters.name: Falfa
characters.description: Oldest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and math.

characters.name: Shalsha
characters.description: Youngest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and history.

characters.name: Rosalie
characters.description: A ghost girl and resident of the house in the highlands. She's devoted to Azusa, who didn't shy away from her as a ghost and instead reached out to her. She can go through walls but can't touch people. She can also possess others.

characters.name: Flatorte
characters.description: Flatorte is a cheerful, energetic blue dragon girl who obeys what [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa) says. Since she's a dragon like [Laika](https://anilist.co/character/135593/Laika), there is somewhat of a rivalry between them, but she's an optimistic and energetic girl. Unlike Laika, she has a tail in human form.

characters.name: Provat Allières
characters.original: プロヴァト・ペコラ・アリエース
characters.description: The Demon King. A girl with a devilish temperament who loves to use her power and influence to bewilder her subordinates and Azusa. She actually has a masochistic desire to be subordinate to someone stronger than she is, and she adores Azusa.

characters.name: Natalie
characters.description: Natalie Jr. is a new guild receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild in Flatta village. She shares a name with her predecessor [Natalie](https://anilist.co/character/217736). Natalie Jr. is the one who reveals that Azusa has achieved max level by killing nothing but slimes for over 300 years with her Increased EXP Acquisition ability. However, due to Azusa wanting to keep a low profile and continue with her quiet slow life, she requests that Natalie keep her stats and level a secret, to which, Natalie agrees.

characters.name: Natalie
characters.description: Natalie Sr. was a guild receptionist for sometime at the Adventurer's Guild in Flatta. Upon Azusa's arrival in the Adventurer's Guild, Natalie greets her and after estimating the amount of money she earned for the slime crystals she turned in, has her register in the guild. To her surprise, Natalie states that her Immortality Ability is impressive. (Source: Slime Taoshite 300 Nen Fandom Wiki)

title: Yagate Kimi ni Naru
description: Yuu Koito thought love would be something amazing and magical, but when a male friend asks her to date, she feels nothing. She doesn't even know how to respond until she overhears the student council president of her new high school, Touko Nanami, turning down a similar request. With Touko's help, Yuu manages to let her friend down gracefully, but then Touko confesses that she, herself, is starting to have feelings for Yuu, leaving Yuu in a quandary. Yuu doesn't think that she's in love with Touko, but she does feel something. As Yuu joins the Student Council, and she and Touko become closer, her confusion about her feelings only continues to grow. Because you can't control who you love, or who falls in love with you. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuu Koito
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works. ~! She later falls in love with Touko. !~

characters.name: Touko Nanami
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5’4”) A second year high school student, and the busiest member of the student council. She consistently ranks number one with her test scores and grades, and excels in sports as well. Due to this, and her beauty, admirers frequently confess to her - only to be turned down, as the confessions never make her feel anything.

characters.name: Sayaka Saeki
characters.description: Sayaka is [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529/Nanami-Touko)'s best friend from her first year of high school. She is a second-year high school girl and the student council vice president.

characters.name: Koyomi Kanou
characters.description: Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She wants to become a writer.

characters.name: Seiji Maki
characters.description: Maki is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council. He grew up surrounded by two older sisters and a younger sister, so he finds it easy to talk with girls.

characters.name: Akari Hyuuga
characters.description: Akari is Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She is a member of the basketball club.

characters.name: Miyako Kodama
characters.description: Owner of a small café. Riko's girlfriend.

characters.name: Riko Hakozaki
characters.description: A literature teacher and the student council's staff advisor. Miyako's girlfriend.

characters.name: Suguru Doujima
characters.description: Doujima is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council.

characters.name: Rei Koito
characters.description: Yuu's older sister. Hiro's girlfriend.

title: Kimi no Koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo
title_original: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女
title_en: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You
description: Rentarou Aijou was rejected 100 times in middle school. He visits a shrine and prays for better luck in high school. The God of Love appears and promises that he’ll soon meet 100 people he’s destined to date. But there’s a catch—once destiny introduces someone to him, the two must happily love each other. If they don’t, they’ll die. What will befall Rentarou and his 100 girlfriends in high school? (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Rentarou Aijou
characters.description: __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 1 Rentarou is an extremely kind and thoughtful person who loves all of his many girlfriends very dearly, often to a scarily self-sacrificing degree. Before he began his days as a high school student, Rentarou had been rejected a total of 100 times. Following a rejection from his friend on the day of his junior high graduation, he goes to a matchmaking shrine and prays to the shrine's god, wishing for a happy high school life by getting a girlfriend. In response, the Love God appears before Rentarou, telling him that he will meet his "soulmate" in high school, and that they will fall in love at first sight. He then reveals that Rentarou has 100 of such soulmates, and that should he ever meet one, he must make them his girlfriend and make them happy, or else they will die.

characters.name: Hakari Hanazono
characters.description: __Type:__ Deredere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 1 **Girlfriend No. 001** Hakari is described as a "clumsily calculative" lady. She is often planning and plotting to achieve her goals which may or may not go as planned due to her clumsiness. She is prim and proper on the outside while inside she is just as much of a degenerate, if not more so, than the other members of the Hanazono family. She also teases [Inda Karane](https://anilist.co/character/173760) a lot, often leaving her embarrassed or pissed.

characters.name: Karane Inda
characters.description: __Type:__ Tsundere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 1 **Girlfriend No. 002** Karane is known for being straightforward and honest about how she feels about a given situation except for two subjects: her feminine figure (or supposed lack of) and her deep love for [Aijou Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou). Her desperate attempts to hide how she feels about a given situation despite her honest nature often make people think she is going to strike them.

characters.name: Shizuka Yoshimoto
characters.description: __Type:__ Dandere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 3 **Girlfriend No. 003** Shizuka is rather timid especially given her rather quiet or mute voice which makes her rather distant from other people. However, ever since she met [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) she has become braver, even willing to sacrifice her own safety to help [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hanazono-Hakari) out. She is also the most modest of Rentarou's girlfriends as she refused to peep on him when he was taking a bath and even tried to stop them from doing so.

characters.name: Nano Eiai
characters.description: __Type:__ Kuudere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 6 **Girlfriend No. 004** Nano is practical to a fault, obsessed with solving a problem in the most efficient way possible no matter what. Nano is the smartest among the girls. In her school exam, she gets the perfect score (700/700), which is better than the scores of genius-level characters in other manga. Nano has memorized hundreds of digits of Pi, which she sometimes uses to calm herself down. Due to her extreme intelligence and efficiency, in most difficult situations Nano is the first to come up with solutions. However, her solutions are sometimes brutal due to her lack of social experience.

characters.name: Kusuri Yakuzen
characters.description: __Type:__ Druggie __Occupations:__ Third-Year High School Student, Chemistry Club President __Debut:__ Chapter 10 **Girlfriend No. 005** Kusuri is energetic and ingenuitive; she is capable of creating a drug for almost anything. She doesn't tend to be concerned about the dangers of the drugs she makes, and will often happily force them upon others or take them herself without hesitation.

characters.name: Hahari Hanazono
characters.description: __Type:__ MILF __Occupation:__ High School Chairwoman __Debut:__ Chapter 17 **Girlfriend No. 006** [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hakari-Hanazono)'s mother. Hahari appears as a very mature and sophisticated woman, until she sees something cute. She has an uncontrollable love for cute things, including children, as well as Rentarou and his family. When she sees something she finds cute, she may start drooling. Like her daughter, she is also a pervert towards Rentarou as she is shown to have perverted fantasies about him. She is incredibly wealthy, and willing to throw her money around to get what she (or Rentarou) wants. Although she fell in love with Rentarou, Hahari still deeply loves her deceased lover. She feels guilty about falling in love again until Rentarou comforts her and assures her that there is nothing wrong with loving more than one person. ~!When she was very

characters.name: Mei Meido
characters.description: __Type:__ Maid __Occupation:__ Personal Maid __Debut:__ Chapter 30 **Girlfriend No. 008** The personal maid of [Hahari Hanazono](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hahari-Hanazono). Mei is polite and proper, rarely showing strong emotions. She is loyal to Hahari above all else, and is unlikely to do anything unless given permission or ordered to by Hahari specifically. Mei's fanatical loyalty to the Rentarou Family and the Hanazono Family results in her gladly offering to "eliminate" people that threaten, insult, or even mildly inconvenience [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou), Hahari, or the other girlfriends. Mei is an all-around maid. It seems that she can do nearly everything, including driving, cooking, shooting, and even nursing. Mei is also shown to exceed her already exceptional abilities if ordered to do so by Hahari.

characters.name: Kami-sama
characters.description: The god of a local shrine who informs Rentarou that due to his constant prayers to his shrine, and partially due to him being distracted when watching [Castle in the Sky](https://anilist.co/anime/513/Tenkuu-no-Shiro-Laputa/), he overly blessed Rentarou to meet 100 soulmates during his high school life.

characters.name: Kaoru
characters.description: The boy with a terminal illness whom Hahari had fallen in love with when she was a schoolgirl. Before he died, Hahari was artificially inseminated using his sperm at the age of 13, which led to the birth of Hakari. Rentarou meets his spirit after rescuing Hakari and causing Hahari to fall in love with him.

characters.name: Yuujin A
characters.description: Rentarou's friend up until his middle school graduation.

title: Gakkou Gurashi!
description: Why would anyone form a School Living Club? Could four girls, their advisor, and a puppy really love their school so much that they’d want to live in it? Or is there another reason, something that lurks behind the façade of their comfortable existence? Something that waits outside their school’s doors. Something that has already robbed one girl of her sanity? While the others try to come to grips with a dark new reality, the rest of the world falls to ruin at the hands of a ravenous force, and insanity may be the last hope for survival. Shocks, heartbreak and stunning revelations await as the twisted tale unfolds. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuki Takeya
characters.description: Yuki Takeya is the main protagonist of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former senior student at Megurigaoka Private High School and a member of the School Life Club, where she, as the most cheerful and optimistic person, comes up with club activities and brings comfort among the club despite their surroundings. ~!Yuki is oblivious to the fact that she is in the midst of a zombie apocalypse and the "activities" of the club are survival missions. Not wanting to disturb her already fragile mental state, the other girls go along with her ideas.!~

characters.name: Kurumi Ebisuzawa
characters.description: Kurumi Ebisuzawa is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School and the primary "zombie killer"/strategist of the School Life Club, where her abilities prove invaluable.

characters.name: Yuuri Wakasa
characters.description: Yuuri Wakasa is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School. As the big-sister figure, Yuuri is the president of the School Life Club, where she is more commonly referred to as "Rii (-san)". She keeps a detailed record of food, electricity, lessons, and other resources and activities. Yuuri is usually very calm and mature, and acts in a collected and proper manner. She also is quite serious, always looks after her comrades, and is not afraid to scold someone when they put themselves in danger pointlessly.

characters.name: Miki Naoki
characters.description: Miki Naoki is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a second year student of Megurigaoka High School. She eventually joins the School Life Club as the youngest member after being rescued during the members' outing to the mall. Miki is very polite and kind, as she uses the honorifics and calls her seniors "senpai". Though she is usually quiet, Miki is very caring and supportive, as she comforts her friends when they feel down, and gives them words of encouragement when they need it. Miki has had many appearances with "The Stand," a book by Stephen King, which is a post-apocalyptic horror/fantasy novel. ~!At first, Miki hates the way Kurumi and Yuuri accept Yuki's illusions, but later comes to understand their reasons and warms up to Yuki. Later considering her as one of her closest, if not, best friend.!~

characters.name: Megumi Sakura
characters.description: Megumi Sakura is a Japanese teacher at Megurigaoka Private High School and the faculty adviser for the School Life Club. She is affectionately called "Megu-nee" by her students (rather than her preferred "Sakura-sensei"). Megumi is a kind, patient young woman, who cares more for her students than herself. She has a soft tone in her voice and generally a calm demeanor when around others. Despite being an adult, she is also very innocent and meek at times, as Yuki states that she doesn't have much of a presence.

characters.name: Kei Shidou
characters.description: Mii-kun's friend.

characters.name: Taroumaru
characters.description: In the anime, Taromaru is notably an intelligent and tolerant dog, putting up with anything Yuki puts him up to and being able to open doors and escape. He is able to avoid infected citizens and escape to the safety of Kei and Miki, and is later found by Kurumi in the mall. He is taken in by the School Life Club members as their "mascot." After upsetting Taromaru at the mall by yelling at him, Taromaru dislikes being around [Miki](https://anilist.co/character/89054/Miki-Naoki), preferring to be with the other girls instead. ~!Before dying, he is seen cuddling with Miki as an act of forgiveness.!~ ~!After he becomes infected, he becomes volatile, barking and attacking Kurumi before being sealed inside a locked room. However, he is shown to have slight consciousness, as he protects Yuki from other zombies!~ In the manga, Taromaru is a Shiba Inu puppy that Yuki found while exploring. ~!he o

characters.name: Takae Yuzumura
characters.description: Close friend and classmate of Yuki Takeya.

characters.name: Akiko Kamiyama
characters.description: Teacher at Megurigaoka Private High School

characters.name: Arnault Hatonishiki
characters.original: アーノールト ハトニシキ
characters.description: A pigeon caught by Kurumi Ebisuzawa, tasked with sending a letter.

characters.name: Tsumugi Katsuragi
characters.description: An upperclassman that Kurumi had romantic feelings for.

characters.name: Touko Deguchi
characters.description: Touko is one of the girls, including Hikako Kirai and Aki Hikarizato, that School: Live Club and Ruu Wakasa encountered after fleeing from their unnamed pursuers. As the Fallen Crew club president, her job is to make everything, and anything they do, fun. She is the Leader of the "Degeneracy Club", later Renamed "The Circle", and is the most notable Gamer in the series, even getting yelled at in Vol.10 for "spewing her Gamer Brain" onto others. (Source: fandom.com)

title: Hanamonogatari
description: Second season of the Monogatari Series, part 2/2. Contains the arc Suruga Devil from the Hanamonogatari light novel. Now that Koyomi Araragi and Hitagi Senjougahara have graduated, few familiar faces remain at Naoetsu Private High School. One of them is Suruga Kanbaru, holder of the Monkey's Paw. When she begins to hear talk of a mysterious being known as the "Devil," who will magically solve any problem, she immediately thinks these rumors are about her and decides to investigate. Kanbaru discovers the Devil is actually Rouka Numachi, a former rival who provides free advice to those who seek her out now that she can no longer play basketball due to a leg injury. As a collector of misfortune, Numachi enjoys relieving her clients' stress by giving them false hope. Though Kanbaru sees no real harm being done, she reprimands Rouka for lying and heads home, relieved she is not the cause of the rumors. But the next morning, when she finds that her left hand has reverted back to its original form, she may have a reason to worry after all.

characters.name: Suruga Kanbaru
characters.description: Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. ~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

characters.name: Rouka Numachi
characters.description: Rouka Numachi is the former basketball rival and supposed arch-nemesis of Suruga Kanbaru. Though she once shared an affinity for basketball akin to Suruga, albeit as a defensive player, she would go on to sustain a leg injury that would end her endeavor in sports. The two had a falling out in middle school due to Rouka's injuries causing a rift between the two. Rouka is characterized by the concept of "schadenfreude"; in which she derives pleasure from the misfortune of others. A self-proclaimed collector misfortunes, she enjoys listening to people's problems whilst offering empty promises of helping them out. Turning this form of counseling into a non-profit service, Rouka began to operate under the alias called "Lord Devil"; in which she promises her customers that she can solve anyone's problems with absolute certainty. Contrasting Suruga's virtuous nature, her desire for collecting m

characters.name: Koyomi Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself. ~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

characters.name: Karen Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay. ~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Ts

characters.name: Deishuu Kaiki
characters.description: The white swindler who once deceived [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the cause of [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku)'s curse. Kaiki is a capable conman, able to deceive multiple people to get the results he wants, usually being money. On one occassion, he has used the alias 'Suzuki'. Though he appears to be a deceitful man, Kaiki has tried to help others occasionally. In Nisemonogatari , ~!it is revealed that he was a university student alongside [Yozuru](https://anilist.co/character/57501) and [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552). Back in his college days, he had a crush on [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Tooe-Gaen), so he now watches over her daughter [Kanbaru](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) out of respect.!~ He is the narrator of Koimonogatari .

characters.name: Ougi Oshino
characters.description: Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows." Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows. ~!As of Hanamonogatari and afterwards, chronologically, Ougi refers to himself as a boy. Others will question Ougi's identity when they first meet him as they knew him as a girl before, but they all shrug it off and seem to doubt themselves as to whether

characters.name: Tooe Gaen
characters.description: Tooe is [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115)'s older sister. Like Izuko, Tooe used to be a specialist; unlike her sister, she created oddities, including the Rainy Devil. Tooe is [Suruga Kanbaru](https://anilist.co/character/22054)'s mother. When Suruga was young, Tooe and her husband died in a traffic accident; due to this, Suruga was given the Rainy Devil's left arm: the monkey's paw.

characters.name: Seiu Higasa
characters.description: Seiu is a member of the basketball team with Suruga Kanbaru. During her second year, she was the vice-captain. After Suruga retired due to the Rainy Devil's effects, Seiu became the captain. Seiu is a student at Naoetsu High and is in the same year as Kanbaru. She is often blunt, calling Kanbaru an idiot for having bad grades. As a friend of Kanbaru and fellow teammate of the basketball team, Kanbaru and Seiu are presumed to be somewhat close friends. As Kanbaru's friend, she has given her the nickname "Ruga." Initially, Seiu seems to be a background character, though she has a more prominent role in Monster Season. ~!In Shinobumonogatari, her name is read as "Seiu," though in Yoimonogatari, it is later read as "Hoshiame," where both having similar meanings. This was later brought up in Amarimonogatari, and it is said that, "both readings are correct, you can read them both ways." There

characters.name: Shinobu Oshino
characters.description: A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona. ~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia

title: Munou na Nana
description: It is the year 20XX. Earth has been assaulted by monsters known as 'the Enemy of Humanity'. In order to deal with this threat, special schools comprised of teenagers with extraordinary abilities were formed. These people, who came to be known as 'the Talented', have abilities that defy the rules of reality. Among these superpowered individuals was an outlier, someone who was sent to one of these schools despite having no innate special abilities whatsoever. This is the story of our protagonist, who attempts to defeat the Enemies of Humanity through the use of intelligence and manipulation.

characters.name: Nana Hiiragi
characters.description: A main character of Talentless Nana. Her talent is mind-reading. ~!Her mind-reading ability is a lie and she's talentless. She uses logical deductions and improvisation to fake her ability.!~ A cute and observant, though somewhat pushy girl. Despite her mind-reading talent, she admits she's not good at reading the room. ~!Nana Hiiragi is actually the protagonist of Talentless Nana. Cruel and calculating, she is an antiheroine who has been sent to the island by the government to stop the Talented from fostering their abilities by assassinating them one by one.!~ ~!Has had a personal vendetta against the Talented ever since they killed her parents in a break-in. She blames her ditzy young self for it.!~ ~!Becomes disillusioned with her goal and vows to never kill again after she learns that each of the Talented's theoretical "body counts" are entirely fabricated.!~

characters.name: Kyouya Onodera
characters.description: ~!Kyouya's immortality allow's him to take attacks that would usually kill someone, and it is shown when he is attacked that he can somewhat regenerate. Although he has immortality he can still feel pain to an extent.!~ ~!The price of his immortality is that he can only remember the last 2 years. He writes about his experiences in notebooks, so he can read them and remember past events.!~

characters.name: Michiru Inukai
characters.description: ~!She has a Healing ability. Although unlike normal healing, she is giving up her lifespan to heal another. Often times after she heals a major injury, she feels lightheaded and sick. Her healing was shown to be of Type Heavy Injuries as she was able to completely heal Nana having received a fatal injury. She can do Resurrection, though it is at the cost of her life.!~ ~!Her body is revealed to still be cared for. While her heart has stopped, her body is still warm even after events of the island. !~

characters.name: Nanao Nakajima
characters.description: ~!Can neutralize other people’s powers.!~ ~!After his ability mutates, he is able to neutralize the human body functions too. This can mean neutralizing their bodily functions (breathing, heartbeat, etc.). In addition, the extent of neutralizing human body functions allows him to neutralize people's moral capacity, turning them into temporary killing machines. He is essentially able to mind-control them into the killing.!~

characters.name: Moguo Iijima
characters.description: __Talent:__ Fire powers. He can engulf his fists in flame and shoot beams of fire from them.

characters.name: Youhei Shibusawa
characters.description: Youhei has the ability to go back in time up to 24 hours, however the further back he goes, the more tired he is when he returns. If someone from the past sees him, he's sent back to the present immediately.

characters.name: Jin Tachibana
characters.description: __Talent:__ ~!Transformation. He can shapeshift into any living animal or Talented human, unless someone is watching him.!~ ~!His real ability is Telekinesis.!~ A former Talented student from five years ago. Presumed dead. ~!The only survivor from the previous class of Talenteds. Has been living on the island ever since the previous class destroyed themselves in a brutal war.!~ ~!While it's unclear if his real name is Jin Tachibana, the body he uses the most often is not his own.!~

characters.name: Seiya Koori
characters.description: __Talent:__ Ice powers. He's been shown to freeze objects and water. He can not freeze living things. A regular flirt, despite having a girlfriend.

characters.name: Tsunekichi Hatadaira
characters.description: ~!his talent is to see the future and to take photos of it.!~

characters.name: Shinji Kazama
characters.description: __Talent:__ Necromancy, he can manipulate dead bodies at will, see through their eyes, access their memory, and use their talents. Close friend of Yuka Sasaki. ~!His real talent is Super Strength. Yuka, the true necromancer, has been controlling Shinji's corpse and lied about her and Shinji's talents.!~

characters.name: Yuuka Sasaki
characters.description: __Talent:__ Super Strength. Disabled when her animal allergies act up. Close friends with Shinji Kazama. ~!Her true talent is Necromancy. She can manipulate the dead, as well as call on their memories and use their talents.!~

characters.name: Kirara Habu
characters.description: __Talent:__ Venom. Her saliva is poisonous, but she has to eat poisonous animals to refuel it. Friends with Kaori Takanashi, and bully of Michiru.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Hangyaku no Monogatari
title_original: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 叛逆の物語
title_en: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-
description: Were all the magical girls truly saved from despair? Now, the great "Law of Cycles" leads the magical girls to their new fate. Madoka Kaname, a girl who once led an ordinary life, sacrificed her very existence to set every magical girl free from their cruel destiny. Homura Akemi, another magical girl who was unable to keep her promise with Madoka, continues to fight in the world in which Madoka left her behind. "I dream of the day when I can finally see your dear smile again." Madoka Kaname has changed the world. In this new world, is what the magical girls see a world of hope... or despair? (Source: Madman)

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Nagisa Momoe
characters.description: A magical girl who wished for a cheesecake that her mother would think was the best. Nagisa is usually rather childish, serving as the plucky and cheerful comic relief of the group, though she's shown to be more perceptive than she seems. She tends to speak rather eloquently. She fights with a trumpet horn that can shoot bubbles powerful enough to put cracks in a witch's barrier. ~!She is the magical girl form of [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/40842/Charlotte).!~ ~!Nagisa is considered a secretary to the Law of Cycles following Madoka's wish. She assisted Madoka, along with Sayaka, in their attempt to stop the Kyubey from controlling the Law of Cycles and freeing Homura. Following Homura rewriting the universe, her previous knowledge as a magical girl as well as her magical girl powers have been taken away.!~

characters.name: Hitomi Shizuki
characters.description: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies.

characters.name: Junko Kaname
characters.description: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher. She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

characters.name: Tomohisa Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 175-180 cm Madoka's father. A stay-at-home dad. He does housekeeping, cooking, laundry and cleaning.

characters.name: Kazuko Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 155-157 cm Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.

characters.name: Kyousuke Kamijou
characters.description: __Height:__ 170-175 cm A terminally ill boy whom Sayaka constantly visits. He used to play violin when he was younger and enjoys listening to classical musical CDs that Sayaka brings him.

title: Lazarus
description: The year is 2052 — an era of unprecedented peace and prosperity prevails across the globe. The reason for this: mankind has been freed from sickness and pain. Nobel Prize winning neuroscientist Dr. Skinner has developed a miracle cure-all drug with no apparent drawbacks called Hapuna. Hapuna soon becomes ubiquitous… and essential. However, soon after Hapuna is officially introduced, Dr. Skinner vanishes. Three years later, the world has moved on. But Dr. Skinner has returned — this time, as a harbinger of doom. Skinner announces that Hapuna has a short half-life. Everyone who has taken it will die approximately three years later. Death is coming for this sinful world — and coming soon. As a response to this threat, a special task force of 5 agents is gathered from across the world to save humanity from Skinner’s plan. This group is called “Lazarus.” Can they find Skinner and develop a vaccine before time runs out? (Source: Adult Swim)

characters.name: Axel Gilberto
characters.description: Parkour specialist originally from Brazil. He has outstanding physical abilities and is a quick thinker, who can fly through the city like a bird. He is famous for his numerous jailbreaks.

characters.name: Doug Hadine
characters.description: Originally from Nigeria. He's an intelligent man who creates strategies as the brains of the team, and hides his warm heart behind a calm and collected demeanor. As a student, he studied physics and had a great respect for [Dr. Skinner.](https://anilist.co/character/347658/Skinner) He has a high-strung and prideful personality.

characters.name: Christine Blake
characters.description: Originally from Russia. She has a lively and frank personality, allowing her to get along with anyone. She acts as a gun specialist, who can use any type of gun. She is also a heavy drinker and optimist. ~!Christine is not her real name, she changed her face and identity after defecting from Russian intelligence.!~

characters.name: Leland Astor
characters.description: Originally from Canada. His special skill is piloting drones. He seems like a normal dumb middle school student, but has a complicated family situation which is kept secret. He is skilled at reading the room but never says his real intentions. His hobby is ego surfing.

characters.name: Eleina
characters.description: Originally from Hong Kong. Although she seems unsociable and is bad at listening to what others say, she is actually a famous hacker under the name "Mad Screamer."

characters.name: Hersch Lindemann
characters.description: Leader of Lazarus. She has a lot of influence on both nations and large corporations, and does her job without being carried away by emotions. She is an angry and terrifying woman. ~!She used to work with Skinner as a fellow researcher at the Hague.!~

characters.name: Abel Anderson
characters.description: Director of the National Security Agency (NSA). He is always unfazed, calm, and rational, to the point his colleagues questioned if he is secretly an AI.

characters.name: Deniz Skinner
characters.description: Skinner is a three-time Nobel Prize winning scientist. He suddenly disappeared three years ago. He is the inventor of the cure-all drug Hapna, and was seen as a saint for donating his patent and prize money to solving world issues.

title: Azumanga Daiou THE ANIMATION
title_original: あずまんが大王 THE ANIMATION
description: Ten year old child prodigy, Chiyo Mihama, is finding it tough fitting in at high school with the girls five years her elder: Osaka (dimwitted with a weird take on the world), Tomo (a powder keg that goes off at a moment’s notice), Kagura (the competitive athlete of the bunch), Yomi (the hothead), and Sakaki (timid and obsessed with a love of animals that isn’t reciprocated). Together with their teacher, they navigate the rough waters and fun times of high school. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Sakaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm Sakaki is a quiet, stylish girl. Looking cool and distant, she's often seem staring out of the window. Being tall and well-endowed in both athletics and body, she's often admired by many girls in the school where Azumanga Daioh takes place. Despite being tall, cool and aloof or distant, deep in her heart she wishes to be small, soft, and cute, like [Chiyo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/247/Mihama-Chiyo), but she perceives that she can't - because of her height. She loves cats and always attempts to be friendly with them, but often gets scratched and bitten in response. Her soft and girly side shows when she's drawing, talking and reading about cats, or when she's holding one.

characters.name: Tomo Takino
characters.description: Tomo Takino is extremely energetic and competitive, despite being nonathletic and a slacker at the same time. She tends to irritate everyone around her, especially [Yomi](https://anilist.co/character/182/Mizuhara-Koyomi), who has been her classmate since elementary school. Tomo's character is extremely impulsive and never considers nor cares about the consequences of anything she says or does. However, on the occasions when Tomo has actually been inspired to concentrate on something, she has demonstrated that she is quite capable. She succeeded in gaining the grades needed to qualify for the same high school as Yomi, though Yomi ridiculed her and openly said that there was no way that she could do so. Once Tomo began attending high school, however, she returned to her lackadaisical ways. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Koyomi Mizuhara
characters.description: Koyomi Mizuhara, commonly known as Yomi, is a grade-school friend and general antithesis of Tomo. She is the voice of reason of the series, carrying herself as the most mature and serious of the group. Though smart and athletic, she is constantly dissatisfied with herself due to her weight and is always trying various diets in an effort to become thinner. She can never seem to stick to these diets however, as she finds herself constantly tempted by her favorite foods. Another weakness of Yomi's character is that while she is above average in everything else, Yomi is an awful singer, but karaoke is one of her favorite pastimes. While usually functioning as Tomo's "straight man", she sometimes manifests a rather cruel sense of humor. Yomi also has an uppercut that Tomo is usually on the receiving end of whenever she pushes Yomi too far. However, even though she likes to think tha

characters.name: Ayumu Kasuga
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Ayumu Kasuga is a transfer student from Osaka. [Tomo](https://anilist.co/character/181), expecting her to act like the stereotypical Osakan—loud, exuberant and fond of jokes—chose for her the nickname "Osaka", although Ayumu's behavior could not be more different. Ayumu considers the name "slow" and "spacey", but she lacks the energy or motivation to dispute it. The nickname sticks so well that she is called Osaka by teachers and even in the class roster, to the point that no one remembers her real name. In the manga, Osaka mentions that she lived in Kobe when she was in elementary school and was born in Wakayama. Tomo, who says she doesn't know where Wakayama is, tells Ayumu to "just be Osaka". ~!Despite the fact that her non sequiturs and tendency to nod off during lectures upset [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/3094), she remains in Yukari's homeroom class all

characters.name: Chiyo Mihama
characters.description: Chiyo Mihama , usually called Chiyo-chan, is a child prodigy, having skipped five grades to 10th grade (first year in Japanese high school) at the start of the series yet is still top of the class. Such grade-skipping would be unthinkable in Japan, and the series humorously explores its potential consequences. The other characters find Chiyo amazingly cute, but sometimes take advantage of both her youthfulness and her scholastic abilities. Her diminutive stature leads to her having a lack of confidence, particularly in sports where she fears she is a burden to others. Chiyo is frequently viewed with jealousy by fellow students, initially because of her intelligence, but later also because of the discovery that her family is exceedingly wealthy (they own an enormous mansion and a summer house which Chiyo invites her classmates to visit on several occasions). The stylistic rendering of Chi

characters.name: Yukari Tanizaki
characters.description: Tanizaki Yukari is the girls' English and homeroom teacher (class 3), but a teacher with very unconventional methods and a close relationship with the class. Her students are casual enough to call her by her first name: Yukari-sensei, and even use the very informal and intimate name and title of Yukari-chan. She can be moody and, like Tomo, is incredibly impulsive and has a tendency not to think things through. Yukari has a rivalry/friendship with Minamo and attempts to prove that she is the superior teacher.

characters.name: Kagura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Her name comes from Shinto ritual: the kanji for Kagura (神楽) meaning "entertainment of the gods". It was used to describe the traditional music played at shrines and the Imperial Court. Kagura also makes a cameo appearance as an anthropologist in Classroom of Thesis; From the Report to the Graduation Thesis by Kazuhisa Todayama which refers to several other Azumanga Daioh characters. While she makes appearances earlier on as one of Nyamo's students, Kagura doesn't become a true acquaintance of the group until sometime later, joining Yukari's class in the 2nd year (Yukari selects her as a ringer to win the school athletic competitions). She devotes most of her time to the swim team but is an all-around good athlete. Thanks to her dedication to swimming Kagura receives some rather pronounced tan lines during the summer months, which friends like Osaka waste no time in po

characters.name: Minamo Kurosawa
characters.description: A gym teacher at the girls' school. In the girls' first year of high school, she is the homeroom teacher of Class 5. During their last two years, she is the homeroom teacher of Class 2. An old high school friend and rival of Yukari, they have a juvenile, exasperating, but funny relationship with each other; Yukari relentlessly insults and freeloads from Nyamo, but Nyamo gets her digs in, too. "Nyamo" is a nickname from her student days, but Yukari calls her that, and so does Tomo. Other students call her Kurosawa-sensei. Whereas Yukari appears to be an older version of Tomo, Nyamo resembles Yomi (more in personality than looks) and the two teachers' odd relationship is similar to the one that Tomo and Yomi share. Popular with the students, Nyamo is nicer, less obnoxious, and far more in control than Yukari. Yukari often teases her about her past romantic relationships and that she is a "

characters.name: Kimura
characters.description: The only male teacher seen regularly in the series, Kimura's open-mouthed expression (as well as his ability to simply appear out of nowhere) tends to creep out most of the female students. While he has shown tendencies to be responsible and kind-hearted (he recycles littered cans, donates frequently to charities and even offered 10,000 yen as an offering at a Shinto shrine to pray for world peace), he openly enjoys looking at girls wearing bloomers sports gear and swimsuits (he even so much as admitted that he became a teacher because he liked looking at schoolgirls). Obviously, the girls find this perverted, but it also creates empathy with the male students, most of whom would like to do the same thing. ~!He is married to a pretty and kind young woman and has a (normal) young daughter, much to everyone's surprise.!~

characters.name: Kaori
characters.description: Called Kaorin by all of her peers (and one admirer who is most definitely not a peer), Kaori is a bright girl interested in Astronomy, Arts & Crafts, ...and Miss Sakaki, a beautiful, but very reserved, classmate. It is Kaori's great tragedy she is often too abashed merely by the sight of Sakaki to cultivate more of a relationship with the enigmatic object of her affections, but chance does throw the two of them into shared situations now and again. At these times Kaori can be quite forward in her own way, especially when it comes to fending off any "threats" to her time spent with her heart's desire. Kaori's high school career becomes much more trying in its latter days when her new homeroom teacher declares his undying affection for young "Kaorin." Horrors!

characters.name: Chiyochichi
characters.description: Chiyo's father first appears within a dream of Sakaki's, where he is given to her as a pet, claiming to be both a cat and Chiyo's father. In an episode not long after, a stuffed doll in his likeness is given to Chiyo for her birthday. He continues making appearances at regular intervals throughout the series, most often in Sakaki's daydreams.

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: Maya is an Iriomote cat (kitten actually) who the girls meet on their class trip to Okinawa on the Iriomote island. Surprisingly he seems to like Sakaki a lot. When Maya's mother dies he searches for Sakaki and eventually finds them and saves Sakaki and Chiyo from Kamineko and his gang. Chiyo then offers to keep Maya at her place until Sakaki moves out and is able to keep Maya at her own place - and Sakaki names the kitten Maya as an abbreviation of 'Yamamaya', a term used by Iriomote natives. (Image credit: Wikipedia)

title: Araburu Kisetsu no Otome-domo yo.
title_original: 荒ぶる季節の乙女どもよ。
title_en: O Maidens in Your Savage Season
description: The girls in a high school literature club do a little icebreaker to get to know each other: answering the question, "What's one thing you want to do before you die?" One of the girls blurts out, "Sex." Little do they know, the whirlwind unleashed by that word pushes each of these girls, with different backgrounds and personalities, onto their own clumsy, funny, painful, and emotional paths toward adulthood.

characters.name: Niina Sugawara
characters.description: Kazusa's friend, a melancholic girl who the guys call a "crane" because of her fragile beauty. Initially, Niina ignores the boys because of a harassment experience in her childhood but gradually begins to develop feelings for Izumi because of his caring and kindness. Thus, her loyalty to her friend and their common love of one boy quickly becomes one of the main conflicts of the story.

characters.name: Momoko Sudou
characters.description: A shy girl and Kazusa’s best friend. At first, like the other girls, she becomes interested in relationships with boys. However, as the story progresses, she gradually realizes her true feelings and growing attraction toward other girls. At first, she dismisses it as a misunderstanding about why girls like boys, but eventually she develops a one-sided crush on Sugawara.

characters.name: Rika Sonezaki
characters.description: The president of a literary club, a tall, prudish girl who is ashamed of her interest in the opposite sex because of her strict upbringing and serious nature.
