Nevertheless, in spite of her purism, she gets the most healthy relationship with guys compared to other girls. Over time she comes to realize that romantic affection and sexual attraction are not the same thing, thus she begins to lower her guard and starts a relationship with [Shun Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/141291/).

characters.name: Hitoha Hongou
characters.description: A blunt girl aspiring to publish erotica novels. Being a virgin, she relies on online adult chatrooms to get inspiration and feedback on her sexual writing. When her editor describes her first draft as if it was written by a virgin 40 year old man, she decides that she needs to go further on her journey for sexual knowledge.

characters.name: Kazusa Onodera
characters.description: Kazusa is the series main lead. Since childhood, she has been in love with Izumi, but all this time she was afraid to take a step forward, while the mockery of more popular classmates did not motivate her to be more active in an attempt to attract his attention. However, as the story progresses, she notices that Izumi is clearly sexually attracted to Sugawara’s outstanding beauty and tenderness. She is Sugawara's friend and is childhood friends with Izumi and Momoko.

characters.name: Izumi Norimoto
characters.description: Kazusa's childhood friend and the subject of interest from her and Sugawara. A kind and caring young guy, he doesn't have any sexual experience or knowledge about love in general, therefore his problems with the differentiation of love and sexual attraction quickly become the cause of a love triangle and a conflict between him and two girls.

characters.name: Hisashi Saegusa
characters.description: A famous director, who also works in acting classes for little children, including one Sugawara attended.

characters.name: Shun Amagi
characters.description: A boy infatuated with Sonezaki even when her class looked down on her.

characters.name: Tomoaki Yamagishi
characters.description: A young male teacher who is blackmailed into being the advisor for the Literature Club by [Hitoha](https://anilist.co/character/141294/), in the absence of their former advisor and imminent disbanding. He is given the nickname Milo-sensei by Hitoha and is called by that nickname by the rest of the club. Hitoha later seems to develop a relationship with him that he is highly reluctant.

characters.name: Satoshi Sugimoto
characters.description: A boy who attends the same cram school as Momoko and tries to start a relationship with her.

characters.name: Sonoe Juujou
characters.description: Juujou is one of the most popular girls in the school, and is initially what causes Rika Sonezaki to start having her own struggles with sex and relationships. Later in the series she befriends Sonezaki.

title: Gintama'
description: After a one-year hiatus, Shinpachi Shimura returns to Edo, only to stumble upon a shocking surprise: Gintoki and Kagura, his fellow Yorozuya members, have become completely different characters! Fleeing from the Yorozuya headquarters in confusion, Shinpachi finds that all the denizens of Edo have undergone impossibly extreme changes, in both appearance and personality. Most unbelievably, his sister Otae has married the Shinsengumi chief and shameless stalker Isao Kondou and is pregnant with their first child. Bewildered, Shinpachi agrees to join the Shinsengumi at Otae and Kondou's request and finds even more startling transformations afoot both in and out of the ranks of the the organization. However, discovering that Vice Chief Toushirou Hijikata has remained unchanged, Shinpachi and his unlikely Shinsengumi ally set out to return the city of Edo to how they remember it. With even more dirty jokes, tongue-in-cheek parodies, and shameless references, Gintama' follows the Yorozuya team through more of their misadventures in the vibrant, alien-filled world of Edo. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Gintoki Sakata
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673), taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent. In the Joi war, he was known as the "White Devil" (Shiroyasha) due to his silver hair and white coat he wore in battle, which, combined with his impressive capabilities as a swordsman, made him famous among his comrades and struck fear into Amanto. Gintoki has naturally permed silver hair, which he blames for his lacking love-life. He has a big crush on the TV's news weather girl, [Ketsuno](https://anilist.co/character/6225). In fact, to date, the only time he is seen to have blushed is when he tries to make use of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Shinpachi Shimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm Shinpachi Shimura works under [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) to learn the ways of the samurai. He used to stay at his family's dōjo. However, it seems more like he's just trying to help Gintoki pay the rent than to learn. Shinpachi is the captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," a pop singer's fan club. Shinpachi meets Gintoki after Shinpachi was tripped by the ambassador of Planet Chatoran. Gintoki beats up the ambassador and his guards, not to stand up for Shinpachi, but to get revenge for his spilled parfait. Gintoki frames Shinpachi for the crime, which somehow led to him saving [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) (Otae), Shinpachi's sister, from becoming part of a brothel. Despite his meek appearance, Shinpachi is a more than competent swordsman of his family's Kakidō-Ryu, the type of swordsmanship his dojo teach

characters.name: Kagura
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races. The Yato is said to have "transparent" skin that is highly sensitive to sunlight, so Kagura carries a purple parasol at all times. The parasol is also the Yato clan's weapon of choice; Kagura's is bulletproof and fires bullets from its tip. Because of her Yato blood, she is super-strong and can stop a speeding motor-scooter with one hand. Although stronger than most humans, she cannot control her strength perfectly. Her super-human strength makes her extremely bad with pets. Most of her pets, with the exception of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651/Sadaharu), have met with an untimely demise at her hands. She is also extremely flexible and fast; capable of catching multiple spee

characters.name: Kotarou Katsura
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'8") Katsura is [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672)'s former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers. He is a wanted man due to his involvement in terrorist activities against the Bakufu, and is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Although his initial methods were originally more violent in nature (for instance, sending a bomb to an Amanto embassy), Katsura has gradually grown to believe that there are people important to him in Edo, and decides that he no longer wants to destroy the country, but believes there should be a way to change it without causing sacrifices. Katsura seems to be highly respected by his followers, and has even been called the "Daybreak of the Joui Faction" by some. When people believed that Katsura had died during the Beniz

characters.name: Ayame Sarutobi
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm Sarutobi Ayame is a ninja from the Oniwabanshuu by training, but is currently working as an assassin. She also has a part-time job at the Kunoichi Café. Since her initial appearance, she has developed a serious obsessive infatuation with [Sakata Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), to the point of even stalking him. She is severely myopic, to the point of being almost blind (cannot tell living things from inanimate objects) without her eyeglasses. It was also hinted that she doesn't see well even with her eyeglasses on, as she once mistook [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) (dressed up as Gintoki) for Gintoki himself. However, this could solely be due to her infatuation with him. She has frequently clashed with [Otae](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) for various reasons. Ayame has a playful attitude but gets serious wh

characters.name: Sougo Okita
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Okita is the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi. Personality-wise, he tends to be light-hearted and somewhat childish though his speech is heavily deadpan. He outwardly displays annoyance and dislike for [Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650/Hijikata-Toushirou), and continuously tries to kill (or at least badly wound) Hijikata whenever he has the chance so that he can become the Vice-Commander. Okita has great affection and fondness for [Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943/Kondou-Isao), who took him under his wings when he was little. He still regards Hijikata as one of his three friends (the other two being Kondo and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki)). He enjoys seeing women fight, finding the ugly looks on their faces as they grab each other being hilarious. He wears a distinctive eye mask when taking a nap during duty, which is a

characters.name: Toushirou Hijikata
characters.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 177 cm __Affiliations:__ Shinsengumi Toshiro Hijikata is the famed chain smoking, vice commander of the Shinsengumi so named by his subordinates, because of his fearsome demeanor. Purportedly the brains behind the force, he takes his work seriously, and is fiercely loyal to his leader, [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943). Hijikata has a reputation as a fearsome leader, earning the nickname of "demonic vice-commander". He is also hot-tempered and often speaks of seppuku. However, despite his cold exterior, he does have a more compassionate side. He also has a tendency to cry after watching movies that are not particularly emotional. Hijikata is obsessed with mayonnaise and thus has the nickname "Mayora". He has been known to smother anything he eats under a mountain of mayonnaise, and he carries a number of objects shaped like jars of mayonnaise,

characters.name: Sadaharu
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Sadaharu has the outward appearance of a giant dog, but is actually an inugami. When sitting on his haunches, he is taller than most humans. He was left in front of Gintoki's apartment in a box that had "To Mr. Freelancer" written on it. Sadaharu chomps on anything smaller than itself, such as Gintoki's and other people's heads. Kagura seems to be the only one who can control him, for she has immense strength, though he chomps on her occasionally. Though he was dangerous when Gintoki first received him, he has become quite tame in the later episodes, and has helped the main characters in many occasions. He was named by Kagura, after her first pet, a rabbit which she accidentally killed while having a nightmare. He was originally owned by a pair of miko sisters, who initially called him Kamiko. Recently, Sadaharu has impressed a yakuza's boss and receives permission to

characters.name: Isao Kondou
characters.description: __Height:__ 184 cm Isao Kondo is the Commander of the Shinsengumi. When not working, he is the stalker of [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944), earning him the nickname Gorilla-stalker. His superior is [Katakuriko Matsudaira](https://anilist.co/character/5972), a high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu. Even though the Shinsengumi are loyal to Kondo, he often has to use Vice Commander [Toshiro Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650) to settle them down (with harsh words or use of violence) before conducting a speech. Kondo is good friends with Toshiro and [Sougo Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282), and if one of them ever strayed, then the other two would punch him back to where he belongs, as Kondo once told Sougo. Sougo also often remarks that Kondo's nice-guy attitude is also his weakness as he never notices negative points about other

characters.name: Tae Shimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm Tae Shimura is [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s older sister. She runs the Kakidokan Dojo—which was her father's failing dojo—with her brother. She is usually addressed as "Otae"; the "O" is an honorific used to refer to women. [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) always addresses her as "big sister" (anego). Despite her sweet face, she is one of the most violent characters in _Gintama_ (and arguably strong too). She mercilessly beats up [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943) and [Gintoki Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/672) whenever they anger her; in episode 19, she mercilessly kicks the men out onto the road (namely her brother, Gintoki and [Taizou Hasegawa](https://anilist.co/character/3760)) so as to stop a car for a hitch ride. She often displays her trademark sweet-looking smile with her eyes closed before engaging in her viole

characters.name: Tatsuma Sakamoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 181 cm Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be _____". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki". Gintoki often corrects him, citing that if he were named Kintoki, they would be in some kind of hentai anime (because 'Kin' from 'Kintoki' instead of 'Gin' would make the title 'Kintama', which means 'testicles' instead of 'Gintama', which means 'silver soul'). Despite his goofy nature, Sakamoto is actually a successful businessman in the galaxy. He believes that business is a way of protecting his country. He has a private, well-equipped defensive business fleet. He believes that sacrifices should be made for the good of the community, which is why he chose to abandon his comrades on Earth to travel

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is [Katsura's](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) companion. Elizabeth was a present from [Tatsuma Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/2945/Sakamoto-Tatsuma), who presumably picked it up on his travels around space. Although many people consider Elizabeth to be insane and extraneous, Katsura has named the ambiguous avian "Elizabeth" and dotes on it. Elizabeth is something of a painter, and is surprisingly dexterous. Also, Elizabeth resorts to using signboards to "communicate", as well as an occasional means of attack. Elizabeth is also a skilled fighter, able to use signboards to fight off swordsmen. Although the true identity of Elizabeth is uncertain, it appears to be a man wearing a duck costume. In its first appearance, hairy legs are seen underneath her sheet and the body of a humanoi

title: Ishuzoku Reviewers
description: Beauty truly is in the eye of the beholder! From elves to succubi to cyclopes and more, the Yoruno Gloss reviewers are here to rate the red-light delights of all manner of monster girls...The only thing is, they can never agree on which species are the hottest! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Crimvael
characters.description: An angel whose halo was damaged, meaning they can't return to heaven until it's healed. Stunk and Zel promised to take care of them until then, but in the meantime, they're forced to be a member of the Interspecies Reviewers. After taking the gender-swap potion, they're called "Clitorim"

characters.name: Stunk
characters.description: A seasoned human adventurer, one of the founding members of the Interspecies Reviewers. ~!He's referred to as "Stunkette" when he takes a female shape.!~

characters.name: Zel
characters.description: As an elf, he's over 200 years old. He's one of the founding members of the Interspecies Reviewers. ~!In his female form, he's called "Zellie"!~

characters.name: Aloe
characters.description: A fairy, owner of the Fairy Nectar brothel.

characters.name: Kanchal
characters.description: A halfling who often assists the group with the various reviews. ~!His female form is called Challison!~

characters.name: Meidri
characters.description: A birdmaid who works as a waitress at Ale 'n Eats.

characters.name: Piltia
characters.description: A halfling hostess. In bed, she prefers the dominant role.

characters.name: Lorna
characters.description: An elf who's been a hostess for over 300 years. She's 659 years old.

title: Keijo!!!!!!!!
description: "Keijo" is a popular gambling sport where contestants stand on platforms floating on the water and must use their butts and chests to fight against each other to push each other off the platform. Nozomi Kaminashi, a high school student, aims to join the sport after she graduates. Nozomi was raised in a poor family and hopes to make lots of money by playing Keijo. She grew up training in gymnastics, and she has good balance and flexibility. After high school, Nozomi joins a training boarding school and enters the world of Keijo. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nozomi Kaminashi
characters.description: Nozomi Kaminashi is the main protagonist of Keijo!!!!!!!!. She was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Nozomi officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. After her winless start in the professional world of Keijo, Nozomi tries to seek a mentor to guide her. After meeting [Sumire Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/271330/Sakuragi-Sumire), Nozomi asks Sumire to become her mentor. Although Sumire initially refused, Sumire is later willing to become soeur with her.!~ ~!After her match with [Sayaka Miyata](https://anilist.co/character/90194/Miyata-Sayaka), Nozomi is able to advance to the A-Rank. Sometime later, Nozomi and Sayaka start to stay in the Garden Worth, a lodging for Keijo players, where they reunite with [Hanabi Kawai]

characters.name: Sayaka Miyata
characters.description: Kaminashi's first friend and rival. Before Keijo used to be a judo's athlete, she was the Japan's hope for a golden medal in the Olympics but threw it all away in the qualifications. She has a complex about her bust size and Kaminashi usually makes fun about it. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Sayaka officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch.!~

characters.name: Kazane Aoba
characters.description: She is a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, a former resident of Room 309 and currently a member of the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Kazane officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Chugoku's Hiroshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Non Toyoguchi
characters.description: Non Toyoguchi was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Non officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kyushu's Kagoshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Hanabi Kawai
characters.description: Hanabi Kawai was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked third in the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Hanabi officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch, and is mentored by Kyoko Shirayuki. After collecting enough points, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Mio Kusakai
characters.description: She's a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, and a member of the Elite Class in said school, where she ranked first place in the entrance exam. She's an infighter, and has a pretty wide range of special techniques at her disposal. She's also most likely lesbian, as she's often seen flirting with the other girls, as well as the fact that several of her specials have the intent of pleasuring her opponent, she also states at one point that she rather has cute girls than hot guys. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Mio officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Saya Kogatana
characters.description: Saya Kogatana was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked sixth in the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Saya officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch. After collecting enough points, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Nagisa Ujibe
characters.description: Nagisa Ujibe is a former champion Keijo player. She is currently working at Setouchi Keijo Training School as an instructor. During her youth, she was able to attain the rank Prize Queen, and was nicknamed as the Siren.

characters.name: Kyouko Shirayuki
characters.description: Kyoko Shirayuk is an A-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch. Her mentor was Sanae Kirieda. ~!She becomes Hanabi Kawai's mentor after Hanabi officially becomes a Keijo player.!~

characters.name: Maya Sakashiro
characters.description: Maya Sakashiro was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked second in Suruga. She is the adoptive daughter of Ayako Sakashiro, Suruga's coach and headmaster. ~!Kaya Sakashiro is the alternative personality of Maya Sakashiro, who only emerges in a threatening situation that can't be handled by Maya. Kaya was ranked first in Suruga. In other words, the strongest Suruga's student.!~ Upon graduating from Suruga, Maya officially becomes a Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

characters.name: Sanae Hououin
characters.description: Sanae Hououin was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked third in Suruga. She is also nicknamed as the Suruga's Black Beast (駿河の黒き獣, Suruga no Kuroki Kemono), and Cheater (チート女, Chīto Onna). Upon graduating from Suruga, Sanae officially becomes a Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

characters.name: Rin Rokudou
characters.description: Rin Rokudo was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked second in the Elite Class. Upon graduating from Setouchi, Rin officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

title: Shikanoko Nokonoko Koshitantan
title_original: しかのこのこのここしたんたん
description: Koshi Torako has everyone fooled. Her classmates see her as the perfect honor student, unaware of her secret delinquent past. But her new picturesque school life is thrown into chaos when she bumps into Shikanoko Noko, a girl with antlers! Mayhem seems to follow this strange doe-eyed girl. Who, or what, is she? (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Each episode streamed 4 days early on some streaming services. The original TV broadcast started on June 7th, 2024.

characters.name: Noko Shikanoko
characters.description: __Grade:__ 3rd Year __Positions:__ Founder, Mascot, and Official Deer of the Deer Club, Part-Time Deer at Hino Zoo. Noko Shikanoko is a unique human-deer hybrid and the founder and mascot of the Deer Club at Hino Minami High School. She is a transfer student who becomes the best friend, classmate, and clubmate of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi).

characters.name: Torako Koshi
characters.description: __Grade:__ 3rd Year (Formerly 2nd Year). __Positions:__ President of the Deer Club, Head of the Student Council, Delinquent Gang Member (Formerly). __Relatives:__ [Anko Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330138/Anko-Koshi) (Younger Sister). Torako Koshi is a student at Hino Minami High School, and a highly respected one at that; being considered by many to be a "perfect girl". She is the classmate, best friend, and clubmate of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko). Wanting to change for the better after her past of being a delinquent, Koshi vowed to renew her ways. Within a year, she had become the complete opposite, becoming an honor student who's athletic, kind, helpful, and adored by all. However, after meeting Shikanoko Noko, she found out the deer girls chaotic actions makes some of her delinquent-like traits slip out more often than she would like to

characters.name: Anko Koshi
characters.description: __Grade:__ 1st Year __Position:__ "Self-Proclaimed Sister Caretaker" of the Deer Club Anko is a new student at Hino Minami High School, the 3rd official member of the Deer Club, and the younger sister of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi). She is best known for her sister complex towards their older sibling; being highly obsessed with everything regarding her sister and making it her personal life goal to be always by her sister's side 24/7, much to the latter's dismay and embarrassment. She will not hesitate to try and outright assassinate anyone who goes as far as to even just stand within near proximity of Koshitan, typically having a dark and sinister aura whenever somebody starts to act all chummy with them. Anko is also known to be adept at arming herself with her collection of kunai when faced with possible "threats" and in setting traps in her victim

characters.name: Meme Bashame
characters.description: __Grade:__ 1st Year __Position:__ "Deer-In-Training" of the Deer Club Meme Bashame is a new student at Hino Minami High School and the 4th official member of the Deer Club. Bashame joined the Deer Club because of her newfound idolization of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), who had offered Bashame kindness and deer crackers: saving Bashame from starving on their first day of high school. Bashame hopes of learning to become a full-fledged deer during her stay in the deer club under Nokotan, viewing her as a sensei of sorts and having somewhat of a passive obsession over them. Bashame can be described as laidback and sluggish, having no problem falling asleep anywhere and everywhere at anytime, usually ending up dozing on the cold concrete floor. Bashame miraculously never gets sick from this. Bashame also is notable for having illeism, a tendency to ref

characters.name: Neko Nekoyamada
characters.description: __Height:__ 132 cm __Grade:__ 3rd Year __Positions:__ Vice President of the Student Council, Honorary Member of the Deer Club Neko Nekoyamada is a student at Hino Minami High School, and the self-proclaimed rival of the Deer Club. She is very catlike, both in appearance with her hair stylized into neat cat ear-like cones, and in personality with wanting to be praised and seen as superior by her fellow classmates. Due to her always being outshined by both [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi) and the Deer Club's extreme popularity, Neko has the goal to discover Koshitan's weakness and overthrow her, and to get the deer club disbanded, so she can finally be in the spotlight and become the President of the Student Council. She is known to be hot-headed and competitive and likes to be organized and get work done in the student council, tending to do a lot of work.

characters.name: Kinu Tanukikoji
characters.description: __Grade:__ 2nd Year __Position:__ Secretary of the Student Council Kinu Tanukikoji is a student at Hino Minami High School and a complete girlfailure, being extremely timid and overthinking almost everything. Whenever she makes a simple mistake like accidentally getting papers in the wrong order, she mentally spirals and goes into a state of panic, even going as far as coming up with imaginary disastrous events that would (but actually won't) unfold from her minor mistake and attempting to commit seppuku. Kinu is also childhood friends with [Chiharu Tsubameya](https://anilist.co/character/337287/Chiharu-Tsubameya).

characters.name: Chiharu Tsubameya
characters.description: __Grade:__ 2nd Year __Position:__ Treasurer of the Student Council Chiharu Tsubameya is a student at Hino Minami High School. She initially appears to be a much calmer and more collected girl, having a cool and laid-back personality. So laid-back, in fact, that it is extremely difficult to figure out what she is thinking. She is known to unconsciously give glares and almost completely ignore what others are offering or saying to her. The exception of this rule is [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), of which she treasures and loves any small gift or attention from, due to her being a massive fan of them. Despite appearing somewhat distant on the outside, she has been shown to care for others outside of Nokotan, such as when she felt bad for mistreating [Koshitan](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi) due to her having felt envious that she cou

title: Watashi ga Motete Dousunda
title_original: 私がモテてどうすんだ
description: Kae Serinuma is what you'd call a "fujoshi." When she sees boys getting along with each other, she loves to indulge in wild fantasies! One day her favorite anime character dies and the shock causes her to lose a ton of weight. Then four hot guys at school ask her out, but that isn't exciting to her at all — she'd rather see them date each other! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Kae Serinuma
characters.description: A nerdy and chubby girl in second year of high school. She's a fujoshi obsessed with BL and otome games. After spending a week without eating due to sadness after the death of her favourite character, she loses weight and becomes stunning, earning four suitors.

characters.name: Asuma Mutsumi
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ History Club He is a high school student in his third year and head of the history club. He is also one of the four boys and one girl who are trying to win Kae Serinuma's affection. Mutsumi is depicted having straight shaggy brown hair that is styled on either side, slanted light brown eyes, a calm expression and he is often seen with a soft, genuine smile. ~!In the manga, Kae Serinuma made her choice and asked Asuma to become her boyfriend. Seven years after Mutsumi graduated, they get married and have a son named Shion Mutsumi.!~ (Source: Watashi Ga Motete Dousunda Wikia)

characters.name: Shima Nishina
characters.description: Shima Nishina is a first-year high school student, fujoshi, mangaka and cosplayer. She's in class 1-4, and is known to be quite popular and crafty. She's a smooth talker and can easily appear likeable to her peers.

characters.name: Amane Nakano
characters.description: Kae's friend.

characters.name: Kazuma Mutsumi
characters.description: [Asuma Mutsumi's](https://anilist.co/character/89546/Mutsumi-Asuma) older brother. He is a student teacher who teaches at the same school Asuma is attending.

characters.name: Takurou Serinuma
characters.description: Kae's older brother who often picks on her.

characters.name: Kirari Nanashima
characters.description: Nanashima's younger sister. She is a fan of the anime Puri Puri Moon.

title: Happy Sugar Life
title_original: ハッピーシュガーライフ
description: Satou Matsuzaka is a beautiful high schooler who has a reputation for being permissive with men. However, a chance encounter with a young girl named Shio Koube makes Satou realize that this is her first and only true feeling of love. Telling others that she lives with her aunt, Satou secretly shares an apartment with Shio. Despite her innocent appearance, Satou is willing to do anything to protect her beloved, resorting to desperate measures to ensure that their "happy sugar life" remains intact. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Satou Matsuzaka
characters.description: Satou Matsuzaka learns to love for the first time after meeting [Shio Koube](https://anilist.co/character/126755) and lives with her in a shared apartment. Publically, she tells people that she resides with her aunt in her apartment, and keeps the fact that she lives with Shio a secret. Satou is a freshman at Makikou High School and primarily works at Cure á Cute, maintaining a kind nature and getting along well with other people in order to sustain her lifestyle with Shio. While she wishes she could spend her time with Shio forever in their apartment, she is aware of the fact that they cannot live on peacefully if she does not work and earn money for food, utilities, etc. Because of this, Satou often has to confront the outside world where people interfere with her relationship due to her past history of accepting anyone who has confessed to her and changing partners every three days. S

characters.name: Shio Koube
characters.description: Shio Kobe is a young, innocent girl who lives with Satou Matsuzaka in their apartment. She loves and cares for Satou deeply, but often remains blissfully unaware of Satou's endeavors aside from Satou's necessary attendance in school and work, as she is not allowed outside of the apartment. Shio is a kind and innocent girl who tries her best to work hard and watch over the house while Satou is away at school and work. She routinely greets Satou whenever she returns home and is always genuinely happy to spend time together with Satou. Shio believes that both she and Satou need to stay together, otherwise they would both be broken and incomplete forever.

characters.name: Asahi Koube
characters.description: A young boy in a hood who is constantly searching for his younger sister, [Shio](https://anilist.co/character/126755/Koube-Shio), in order to reunite their family. He regularly prints out posters to put up around the city and sleeps underneath the park bench at night. Asahi is devoted and kind. As a child, he was quiet and well-behaved, listening to his mother at all times and did his best to support her physically and emotionally. When Shio was born, Asahi encouraged his mother to work hard for Shio because she became a symbol of hope for the both of them. He cared so much about his mother and Shio to the point where he urged his mother to leave the house with her and that he would stay behind with their abusive father so that he wouldn't pursue Asahi's mother. Due to his father's extreme abuse, Asahi grew resentful of adults and chose to never trust them. He wants nothing more than to

characters.name: Taiyou Mitsuboshi
characters.description: Taiyou Mitsuboshi is Satou Matsuzaka's coworker who first met her at Princess Imperial, ~!but soon quit due to getting sexually abused by his manager.!~

characters.name: Shouko Hida
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5’2”) Shouko Hida is Satou Matsuzaka's coworker. She considers Satou to be a good friend since they used to spend time together hanging out with guys as they both searched for their one true love. ~!She is killed by Satou after having taken a picture of Satou and Shio together and sending the photo to Asahi !~

characters.name: Daichi Kitaumekawa
characters.description: Daichi Kitaumekawa is Satou Matsuzaka's teacher who is renowned for his good looks and nice personality among his students. However, underneath this facade lies a deeply perverted man who takes an interest in Satou, obsessing over her after a school event. At school, Daichi is considered to be a kind and helpful teacher who demonstrates his concern for his students by speaking to them privately about personal matters and offering assistance in any way he can. ~!But in reality, he is a perverted man who wants to have a harem of women, regardless if they are his students. He tries to hit on his students a lot despite the fact that he has a wife and a young daughter.!~ ~!Satou uses this fact against him as she knows that despite his cheating, he doesn't want to lose his family or take the blow to the reputation that would come if he were found out.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Satou no Oba
characters.description: A relative of Satou who had taken full custody of her after her parents died many years ago. She is basically the one responsible for making Satou the deranged psychopath that she is today. (Source: Wikipedia, edited)

characters.name: Sumire Miyazaki
characters.description: Sumire Miyazaki is a minor character in Happy Sugar Life. She is Satō Matsuzaka's next-door neighbor and co-worker who refers to her as "senpai." Among her friends, her nickname is Su-chan. Sumire is a self-conscious girl, referring to herself as plain and awkward and idolizing Satou for being the exact opposite of herself. ~!She has a rather obsessive personality, becoming infatuated with Satou, blushing over sniffing her work uniform, and going as far as to break into her locker to know more about her.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Shizuka Kitaumekawa
characters.description: Shizuka Kitaumekawa is the wife of Daichi Kitaumekawa and the mother of Minori Kitaumekawa. Shizuka is the dutiful housewife of Daichi. She only sees her husband in a positive light ~!and is oblivious to his dark and obsessive side. This is shown evident when Daichi is arrested after being reported for taking advantage of his students and Shizuka looks on in shock with Minori.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Minori Kitaumekawa
characters.description: Minori Kitaumekawa is the preschool daughter of Daichi Kitaumekawa and Shizuka Kitaumekawa. Minori appears to be a cheerful preschooler who loves her family. ~!She is happily unaware of her father's dark nature.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Yuuna Koube
characters.description: Shio and Asahi's mother. After having been forced into marriage under unfortunate circumstances, she gave birth to and raised the two children until being separated from Asahi while escaping their father; afterwards abandoning Shio.

title: MARRIAGETOXIN
description: For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters. Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters’ Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage. But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru’s sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline—by force if necessary—Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs. It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job. Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride. (Source: EMOTION Label Channel)

characters.name: Hikaru Gero
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Poison User Hikaru Gero is part of the Gero Family, one of the top five families of specialists. He is the current heir to the Poison clan. A poison-using hitman from the clan of assassins. In order to keep his sister from being forced into having a child to continue the lineage of the clan, Gero decides to try and get married and have a child of his own.

characters.name: Mei Kinosaki
characters.description: ~!__Gender:__ Male!~__Occupation:__ Swindler Mei Kinosaki is a marriage swindler who charms both men and women in order to get money from them to help keep their sick brother alive. Mei was saved by [Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) after being captured by a crime syndicate that they had wronged. Mei agreed to help Gero find a wife in exchange for Gero's protection, and help with keeping their sick brother alive.

characters.name: Shiori Ureshino
characters.description: She is the next heir of the Ureshino Family. After the death of her father, he would leave her in charge of the company. This would cause her to be under the care of her uncle who would try to help her in everything she needed. After her uncle informed her that a murderer was after her, she agrees to be escorted by someone.

characters.name: Kimie Arashiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm (5'7'') __Specialist Type:__ Hamster User She is from Beast Clan. After her brother disappeared, Kimie would try to take a job in his place, this would cause Kimie to be kidnapped by a group of terrorists who wanted her organs. At that moment a small [Hikaru Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) would come to save her. From that moment on, Kimie would become a big fan of Gero.

characters.name: Kyouko Himekawa
characters.description: She is a famous art thief known in the underworld. Himekawa is an animal lover as she is friend with a shark named Jawshua. She is also able to see the feelings of painting.

characters.name: Piichi Nakagawa
characters.description: An ordinary human, but a genetic anomaly with abilities far beyond a regular assassin. He possesses exceptional information-processing skills along with superhuman physical abilities. Needs to sleep more than 10 hours a day to function properly, but after sleeping his body can heal almost any injury or ailment. In terms of pure talent, he is among the very best in the modern era. His dream is to open up a cafe with his girlfriend, [Marin](https://anilist.co/character/336020).

characters.name: Shizuku Ushio
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Water User A businessman of the underworld. Highly professional and thorough in her work, she completes all of her tasks with precision. She has a laid back personality and respects Hikaru Gero for what he has done for the poison clan. Due to having hypersensitive skin, she's usually dressed in a diving suit.

characters.name: Akari Gero
characters.description: She is a specialist part of the Gero Family alongside her brother and Teruaki.

characters.name: Toshiki Hanamaki
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Bug User He is a specialist from Hanamaki Clan a sub-branch of the Gero Family. He's Gero's best friend.

characters.name: Toshiro Dogo
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1'') __Specialist Type:__ Beast User He is member of the Dogo Family, one of the top five families of specialists.

characters.name: Genya Naruko
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Sound User A direct descendant of the "Sound" lineage. Possesses a unique aura and distinctive way with words. Not only is he extremely handsome, but he is also highly popular among the ladies. Since he needs to stay relaxed to use his abilities, he's come up with his own unique ways to unwind.

characters.name: Tonako Dogo
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Wolf User She is the current head and member of the Dogo Family.

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen OVA
title_original: かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～OVA
description: OVA adapting both chapters of Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai Darkness and Chapter 96 of the main series.

characters.name: Miyuki Shirogane
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council. Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president. Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and

characters.name: Yuu Ishigami
characters.description: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school. Later in the series: ~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of

characters.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her. Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~ ~!In a [Oshi no Ko special chapter](https://anilist.co/manga/153520), it was reveale

characters.name: Chika Fujiwara
characters.description: The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__. ~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya) told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

characters.name: Miko Iino
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'7") She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

characters.name: Ai Hayasaka
characters.description: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust. Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act. Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work. Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101). ~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguy

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

characters.name: Kei Shirogane
characters.description: Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council. She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games th

characters.name: Erika Kose
characters.description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

characters.name: Karen Kino
characters.description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

characters.name: Tsubasa Tanuma
characters.description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

characters.name: Maki Shijo
characters.description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

title: Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei
title_original: 転生王女と天才令嬢の魔法革命
title_en: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
description: Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy’s expectations by developing “magicology,” a unique magical theory based on memories from her past life. One day, she witnesses the brilliant noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom’s next monarch. That’s when Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name-which somehow involves them living together and researching magic! Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures, but those of the kingdom...and the entire world! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Anisphia Wynn Palettia
characters.original: アニスフィア・ウィン・パレッティア
characters.description: Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic. However, as she's unable to use magic herself, she spends her days conducting questionable research in hopes of fulfilling her dream. Her eccentric behavior earned her the nickname "Princess Peculiar".

characters.name: Euphyllia Magenta
characters.original: ユフィリア・マゼンタ
characters.description: The daughter of [Duke Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen). A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat. As the fiancé of [Prince Algard](https://anilist.co/character/287676/Von-Palettia-Algard), she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...

characters.name: Ilia Coral
characters.description: [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia)'s personal maid. Although a servant, she watches over Anisphia like an older sister. She was saved by Anisphia in the past and is deeply loyal to her. ~!Ilia was born into a low-ranking noble family. To improve their status, her parents intended to marry her off to an influential husband, basically treating their daughter as a political tool. All of this caused Ilia to grow up to become a fairly weak-willed person who did whatever she was told. However, before marrying her off, her family had her work at the royal palace as a maid. This led to her meeting Princess Anisphia, the Anisphia made Ilia her personal maid and permitted her to talk openly in her presence. All of this caused Ilia's personality to undergo a great change as she became much more blunt and willing to stand up for herself. Eventually, she cut all ti

characters.name: Lainie Cyan
characters.description: The daughter of a commoner elevated to the rank of Baron. Despite her humble origins, she has succeeded in attracting the attention of the sons of several influential nobles at the aristocratic academy. ~!It is eventually revealed that Lainie is actually a vampire who constantly gives off a charm that makes people infatuated with her, which she herself was unaware of. Following this, she is taken in by Anisphia so she may learn to control her abilities, which she repays by working for her as a maid.!~

characters.name: Sylphine Maise Palettia
characters.original: シルフィーヌ・メイズ・パレッティア
characters.description: Queen of the Kingdom of Palettia.

characters.name: Grantz Magenta
characters.description: Euphilia's father, the head of the ducal Magenta family, chancellor of the realm of the Kingdom of Palettia, and close friend to King Orphans.

characters.name: Algard Von Palettia
characters.original: アルガルド・ボナ・パレッティア
characters.description: Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Palettia. Engaged to [Euphilia Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/203120/Magenta-Euphyllia).

characters.name: Orphans Il Palettia
characters.original: オルファンス・イル・パレッティア
characters.description: King of the Kingdom of Palettia.

characters.name: Tilty Claret
characters.original: ティルティ・クラーレット
characters.description: The eldest daughter of the powerful Marquis Claret. She has withdrawn to a private residence, where she studies curses. Occasionally she conducts joint research with [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia), but they have a complicated relationship because of their different beliefs. ~!Tilty suffers from an incurable affliction that left her unable to properly release her magical energy, causing her physical and mental pain whenever she tries to use magic. Nonetheless, her family, being traditionalists blindly faithful to the spirits, forced her to learn to use her magic anyway. This continued until the pain finally caused Tilty to snap and lash out against her family.!~

characters.name: Chartreuse Hakushaku
characters.description: Count Chartreuse is the minister of magic and the father of Moritz Chartreuse who opposes any changes that might endanger the nobles' authority. ~!He had been secretly manipulating Algard Von Palettia for years to turn him into a puppet ruler under his control and played an active role in the prince's attempted revolution!~

characters.name: Moritz Chartreuse
characters.original: モーリッツ・シャルトルーズ

title: K-ON! Movie
description: With graduation right around the corner, every member of the Light Music Club except for Azusa will be leaving for good. But the girls aren’t going to let something as silly as graduation tear them apart! For their final hurrah, the girls are going on the ultimate vacation tour— all the way to London! Their overseas journey will lead them on a trip of discovery and friendship as they take the stage one last time for their final encore together. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yui Hirasawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

characters.name: Mio Akiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble. She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

characters.name: Ritsu Tainaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by [Tsumugi Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/19568/Tsumugi-Kotobuki) and [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She was the one who rebooted the Light Music Club when it was on the verge of being disbanded, and has become the natural leader of the club since then. Ritsu plays a yellow Rick Marotta Signature Yamaha Hipgig drum kit with an add-on floor tom (in the opening credits only) combined with a cymbal set from Avedis Zildjian, though is shown playing a white Yamaha Absolute Series drumkit in the anime's closing credits.

characters.name: Tsumugi Kotobuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Mugi plays a Korg Triton Extreme 76-key keyboard, though she is also seen playing a Korg RK-100 keytar in the closing credits of the first season.

characters.name: Azusa Nakano
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Azusa Nakano, nicknamed "Azu-nyan" by [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is a main character in the K-ON! series. She is a second year student at Sakuragaoka High School. She decided to join the Light Music Club after seeing the band's performance in the school festival, and thus became Ho-kago Tea Time's second guitarist. Azusa plays a Fender Japan '69 Reissue Mustang in Candy Apple Red.

characters.name: Sawako Yamanaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school. An alumna of the school and a former member of the light music club, she does not want people to know she was formerly a member of a heavy metal band, thus she covers up by being mild and gentle to her co-workers and especially to students. She is forced to be the adviser of the light music club, as Ritsu blackmails her after the girls learn of her past, though it is unknown whether she stopped being the adviser for the wind instrument club as the story progresses. Though she has a mature and gentle demeanor in the school, Sawako, affectionately addressed as "Sawa-chan" by both Ritsu and Yui, displays a totally different, completely authentic character when she is alone with the light music club. In reality, she is a rather wild, lazy and quite an irresponsible teacher who enjoys dressing up the light

characters.name: Nodoka Manabe
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Nodoka is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s childhood friend and confidant who is a member of the school's student council. As a normal, well-mannered and intelligent girl, she is generally taken aback by the light music club's odd behavior, and easily gets annoyed with [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) whenever she forgets to fill in the club's application forms. She shares the same class as [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) in their second year, who appreciates her companionship tremendously, as being the only person [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) knows in her class. In her third year, she becomes the student council president.

characters.name: Ui Hirasawa
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of p

characters.name: Satoshi Tainaka
characters.description: Satoshi is [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka)'s younger brother. He appears when [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) is walking home with him from the movies. He then ventures of with a friend from school he saw on the way home. He seems to respect his sister [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) but still acts like a normal boy. Satoshi seems to be a bit more mature than [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka), usually saying things like "Geez, be more careful next time" when he has to take care of the problems she caused. Satoshi knows Mio because she and [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) have been friends for so long, but becomes shy when [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) brings the rest of the Light Music Club home without telling him ([Ritsu](https://ani

characters.name: Jun Suzuki
characters.description: **Role:** Bassist **Instrument:** Bass Guitar Jun is [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano)'s and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) to reprimand her. [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) tries to get her to join the light music club but ultimately fails due to a strange visit to the club room. However, she starts to regret it when she hears about all the activities the club does. She has a pet cat and plays the bass. Jun has an older brother, Atsushi Suzuki, nicknamed Acchan by her. He plays the bass at a university and helps Jun on "secret training sessions" because she apparently "still sucks at bass".

characters.name: Kawakami-san
characters.description: She is a former member of the Light Music Club of Sakuragaoka High School and the manager of the live house where the Light Music Club were invited to perform.

characters.name: Aya
characters.description: "Love Crisis" bassist.

title: Yuru Yuri
description: After a year in grade school without her childhood friends, first year student Akari Akaza is finally reunited with second years Yui Funami and Kyouko Toshinou at their all-girls' middle school. During the duo's first year, Yui and Kyouko formed the "Amusement Club" which occupies the now nonexistent Tea Club's room. Shortly after Akari joins, one of her fellow classmates, Chinatsu Yoshikawa, pays the trio a visit under the impression that they are the Tea Club; it is only once the three girls explain that the Tea Club has been disbanded that they can convince Chinatsu to join the Amusement Club—a group with no purpose other than to provide entertainment for its members. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Mirakurun
characters.description: The character in a manga that Kyoko likes. She is known to always battle Rivarun.

characters.name: Rivarun
characters.description: The antagonist of the fictional anime Miracalun, she is an alien invader who plans to conquer earth, and Miracalun's mentor and friend.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

characters.name: Chizuru Ikeda
characters.description: [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/35877/Chitose-Ikeda)'s twin sister. Her personality is pretty much the opposite of Chitose's nice and ditsy nature. When she takes her glass off her yuri goggles activate and she starts drooling. She seems to be fond of the Ayano/Chitose pairing. She has a love for Chitose while she dislikes Kyōko as she constantly tries to play pranks on her and is seemingly a barrier against her fantasies.

title: Girls und Panzer
description: You may have heard of kung fu, but the girls at Oarai High School practice gun-fu—really, really BIG 75mm gun-fu, in fact. It's called Sensha-do, and it's the martial art of operating armored tanks! They take it seriously too, and since winning the national Sensha-do championship is such a huge deal at Oarai, they sometimes go to extreme ends in order to get the best students from Panzer class to sign up. Which is how Miho Nishizumi, who HATES operating tanks, gets drafted to join doomsday-driven driver Mako, even-triggered gunner Hana, highly receptive radio operator Saori and combustible tank-fangirl and loader Yukari as the incomparable Anko Team. They may not be on the half-track to fame and fortune, and maybe a few of them would rather shop for tank tops than become tops in tanks, but once their focus is locked and loaded, they're absolutely driven. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Miho Nishizumi
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Kumamoto City, Kunamoto Prefecture She was born into the distinguished family of the Nishizumi Style of Sensha-do, but she changed schools to Ooarai Girls Academy intending to run away from Sensha-do. However, perplexingly enough, she was extorted into joining Sensha-do by the student council. She's a second-year and considers her friend's feelings more than anyone else. She has traumatic memory of tanks because of an incident that happened during her past with a tank. She's Ankou Team's Commander and is Ooarai's De Facto captain. Miho has a polite personality and can lack self-confidence when in social situations. However when in a Sensha-do battle, Miho is known for her quick and decisive thinking. Miho also has a deep sense of loyalty to her friends, being ready to sacrifice her own reputation for the sake of others. Finally, Miho is a fan of t

characters.name: Saori Takebe
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture Hana's friend and the other girl who befriended Miho during the first day of school. She is a social butterfly and is incredibly talkative. She yearns for a love that will love everything in the world, despite never being in a relationship before. She thought she would be popular among boys if she took Sensha-do. She is a member of the Ankou Team and serves as the Radio Operator and machine gunner. She also acts as a big sister for the Rabbit team comprised of the freshman. She sometimes calls [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi) "Miporin". Saori is also a talented cook. ~! As of Das Finale, she is now the PR Manager for the Oorari Student Council !~ (Source: Official Character Sheet)

characters.name: Hana Isuzu
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5'4") **Home Town:** Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture A member of Anko Team and the Team's gunner. A beautiful girl who has a gentle and composed demeanor, and is the other girl alongside Saori who befriended Miho during the first day. She was born into a home that had mastered the art of flower arrangement, but having felt dissatisfaction with this way of life, as a genuine Ojou-sama she chose Shensha-do instead. ~! She is disowned by her mother because of her decision to pursue Sensha-do instead of flower arrangement, but eventually, her mother reconciles with her after seeing the positive effects Sensha-do has had on Hana's life.!~ ~! As of Das Finale, Hana is the President of the Ooarai Student Council !~

characters.name: Yukari Akiyama
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture A member of Anko Team, and the loader of the Team. She gets overly excited when she sees or hears anything about tanks - to put it, she is a tank otaku. Yukari has had a deep love for all things tanking and WW2 since a young age. She collects tank models and frequently utilizes WW2-era equipment whenever possible. She uses her knowledge of tanks to help the team. She has a deep respect and admiration of overall tank commander [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi), going as far to refer to her as "Nishizumi-dono". Yukari is also known for her infiltration missions, where before a match she will sneak her way into the competing team's school in order to get intel for Miho and the rest of Oorari. ~!As of Das Finale, Yukari is now the Vice President of the Oorari Student Council.!~

characters.name: Mako Reizei
characters.description: **Height:** 145 cm (4'9") **Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture A member of Anko Team and is the team's driver. She is a quiet and gloomy girl who falls easily asleep, and hates mornings. She is also weak to certain conditions. She is late to school everyday but is top of the class and can learn things almost instantly just by reading. She is a genius with a high level grade performance. But, due to her habitual tardiness in the morning she has insufficient credits, and so in exchange for credits, she is pursuing Sensha-do. She is childhood friends with [Saori Takebe](https://anilist.co/character/62941/Saori-Takebe). Mako lives with her aging and strict grandmother [Hisako Reizei](https://anilist.co/character/74701/Reizei-Hisako). ~!Mako lost her parents in an accident when she was in elementary school. According to Saori, Mako fought with her mother shortly before the accident and w

characters.name: Anzu Kadotani
characters.description: Student Council President and commander of Team E, which is also called "Turtle Team." She is manipulative, childish and care-free girl who lets Momo and Yuzuko do all the tank operations while she just sits by as if she the passenger. She forces Miho to participate in Sensha-do. Although as time passes her actions and some comments indicate that the reason she's pushing Sensha-do so hard is to protect the school, not out of vain pride. However, only members of the Student Council know what that reason is but are keeping it to themselves to avoid panicking or pressuring the other students. Her team uses a Czech made "Panzer 38(t)," it was later on modified to a Jagdpanzer 38(t) "Hetzer" in episode 10. ~!It was later on revealed that her reason for reviving "Sensha-do" was to prevent the school's impending closure due to budget cuts in maintaining the ship where the school resides, that i

characters.name: Yuzu Koyama
characters.description: Student Council Vice-President. She is a brown-haired, well endowed girl who works mostly in the Student Council, does all the work as Anzu shoves it at her. She is also their team's driver. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Momo Kawashima
characters.description: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5") **Home Town:** Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture Momo is a third year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's also the PR manager of her school's student council. She started as the gunner and loader of Turtle Team, and when its Panzer 38(t) was converted into a Hetzer she took her definitive position of loader. Although she looks composed and calm girl, she loses her temper easily and when she's angry and shooting at the same time. Her devotion to the school, and her desire to save it by winning no matter what, had likely brought her to be so vehement. She hates being called "Momo-chan." Momo has 5 younger siblings: four sisters and one brother. ~!In Das Finale, everyone in Ooarai then learns that Momo's failed her University Admissions Test because she was busy looking for new tanks for Ooarai for the Winter Continuous Track Cup. Momo intends to make Ooarai as one

characters.name: Noriko Isobe
characters.description: She is the tank commander/loader of Team B (also called "Duck Team"), her team is composed of members of the school's Volleyball team. Her team operates a Japanese Type 89 "Otsu."

characters.name: Taeko Kondou
characters.description: Taeko seems to be the most sociable of her teammates, even if she appears rather quiet and possibly introverted. She has a gentle, friendly demeanor, and never seems to lose her temper, even in desperate situations.

characters.name: Shinobu Kawanishi
characters.description: Shinobu is a first year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's also a member of the volleyball varsity team and her specialty is attacking. She's also the driver of the Duck Team's Type 89B "I-Go" tank, and is often the unintentional tsukkomi within the volleyball team. She comes from Hitachinaka, Ibaraki.

characters.name: Akebi Sasaki
characters.description: Akebi is a first year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's also a member of the volleyball varsity team and her specialty is blocking. She's also the gunner of Duck Team's Japanese Type 89B.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou
title_original: ひぐらしのなく頃に業
description: New kid Keiichi Maebara is settling into his new home of peaceful Hinamizawa village. Making quick friends with the girls from his school, he's arrived in time for the big festival of the year. But something about this isolated town seems "off," and his feelings of dread continue to grow. With a gnawing fear that he's right, what dark secrets could this small community be hiding? (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar
