characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Shion Sonozaki
characters.description: Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. ~!Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger sister.!~ She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, s

characters.name: Hanyuu Furude
characters.description: Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster"). In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the characters, she can be frightening when angered, and with her spirit-like nature, her appearance can change with her mood until she takes a physical form. She is very meek and often makes the noise "Au au, au au…" when she is nervous or uncomfortable, or sometimes while trying to make a point. She also t

characters.name: Kuraudo Ooishi
characters.description: Kuraudo Oishi is a veteran police investigator at Okinomiya who has vowed to solve the mystery of the Hinamizawa murders before his retirement, due to personal reasons. Due to his uncouth tactics and the lengths that he goes to in order to solve the mystery, he is looked upon as a nuisance by the villagers. ~!He approaches one of the main characters to become his informant in several arcs, and is sometimes unwittingly responsible for triggering their paranoia.!~

characters.name: Miyo Takano
characters.description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

characters.name: Rumiko Chie
characters.description: Rumiko is the female teacher of Keiichi's class, who is a parody character of Tsukihime's Ciel-Senpai (permission for her usage was given by Type-Moon). The seiyū for her character in the anime series is the same as the seiyū of Ciel from the Tsukihime anime. Going along with the parody, her favorite food is curry rice, just like Ciel, and will go to great and somewhat scary, lengths to uphold the honor of curry, which is shown in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei OVA, where she becomes enraged by Keichi's "offense" to curry. On a stronger note, she is seen wielding wooden T's, shapped, and held, in exactly the same fashion as the Black Keys from Tsukihime.

characters.name: Mamoru Akasaka
characters.description: He is a young police investigator at the Metropolitan Police Department in Tokyo. He befriended [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) while investigating a case in Hinamizawa four years ago, all due to a prophecy about his wife which came true, though he just brushed it off as coincidence.

characters.name: Kyousuke Irie
characters.description: Kyosuke is the head doctor of the village clinic. Despite his young age and the fact that he has a severe maid fetish, he is highly respected in the community. He cheerfully makes house calls and seems to truly care about everyone's health. He has (half-jokingly) admitted that he wishes to marry [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko) when she is older, but is not above chasing after [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) when she is wearing one of the uniforms from the restaurant Angel Mort. In addition, he is the manager of the village's baseball little league team, the Hinamizawa Fighters. ~!In the past, he has performed lobotomies without consent, which led to him being banished from the medical academic society in Tokyo. He is recruited by Takano to direct research the Hinamizawa Syndrome, which he feels will redeem himself. It is later revealed that

title: Yani Neko
description: Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Yaniko Satou
characters.description: The eponymous Chainsmoking Cat. Yaniko is so addicted to cigarettes that she will do anything for another smoke, no matter how degrading or gross it may seem, and attempts by others to help her quit smoking never last long.

characters.name: Yakuko Etsushimaru
characters.description: A girl who looks up to [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/) as her senior. She secretly uses harder drugs in her apartment.

characters.name: Hameko Yurufuwa Anal Tenshi
characters.original: ゆるふわアナル天使ハメ子
characters.description: [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s high school classmate and neighbor who loves playing fighting games, livestreaming, and uploading videos on her "Hame Channel". Easily angered and flustered when things do not go her way. Born without a legal last name, she decided to register Easygoing\*Angel (ゆるふわ＊天使, Yurufuwa\*Tenshi) as her last name. However a city hall worker mistook the asterisk symbol for anus, hence giving her a rather awkward last name.

characters.name: Kaoruko Nishi
characters.description: A college student and amateur comedian from the Kansai region.

characters.name: Aruko Sakai
characters.description: A college student despite looking like a small girl with a massive hairdo. An alcoholic with a habit of wandering off to distant places when drinking outside her home.

characters.name: Saori Tatsuno
characters.description: The only human neighbor of [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s apartment and a fellow smoker who works as a manga artist under a pseudonym, though her manga does not sell well. She sometimes asks Yaniko or other Beastfolk to assist with her manga, with mixed results.

characters.name: Ouya Ootani
characters.description: The landlord of the apartment building where most of the main cast live. Often the victim of [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s laziness, but very levelheaded despite his intimidating appearance.

characters.name: Imoko Satou
characters.description: [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s younger sister who is a respected and responsible high school student. She often takes care of Yaniko's wellbeing.

characters.name: Nazuna Kujou
characters.description: A homeless friend of [Yaneko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/). She outwardly behaves like a recluse who dislikes worldly matters. Originally, she lived in a tent on the riverbank, but her tent was washed away when the river flooded during a typhoon, and she now lives on the grounds of the apartment complex. ~!Her family is very wealthy, and she receives several million yen in monthly allowance, but the use of the money is unknown.!~

characters.name: Yomuko Kaku
characters.description: She's a classmate of [Imoko](https://anilist.co/character/389132/) and frequents her apartment. She aspires to be a novelist and publishes her own novels on a novel submission site, but she spends more time on social media than writing, so her novel-writing efforts are not going very well.

characters.name: Lani
characters.description: Leader of the Alpha village.

characters.name: Hana
characters.description: A school friend of [Imoko.](https://anilist.co/character/389132/)

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena
description: Just after Utena's parents died, she was consoled by a prince who gave her a ring with a rose crest on it. Utena was so impressed by the Prince that she vowed to become one herself one day. A few years later, Utena is attending Ohtori Academy where she gives all the teachers headaches because she dresses in a boy's uniform so she can be like the prince she met long ago. After Utena's friend is insulted by a member of the Student Council, Utena fights in a duel for her friend's honor. Utena's rose crest allows her to enter the dueling arena, where Utena wins the duel and becomes engaged to the Rose Bride. Unknowingly, Utena is pulled into a series of duels with other members of the Student Council for the possession of the Rose Bride. As she becomes fond of Anthy, the Rose Bride, she must fight to keep her friend safe and to discover the horrifying secret behind Ohtori Academy. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Utena Tenjou
characters.description: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

characters.name: Anthy Himemiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality. Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.

characters.name: Akio Ootori
characters.description: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons. His given name derives from the Japanese name for Venus, the Morning Star, which is identified with Lucifer.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: Anthy's pet (whom she will only refer to as friend, but may be more properly described as a familiar). He is a small marmoset who acts as comedic relief. However, he also acts as an omen of bad fortune in certain episodes. ChuChu is drawn much furrier by Chiho Saito in the manga than he is drawn in the anime, the anime itself making him look more like a mouse than a monkey.

characters.name: Miki Kaoru
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Blue Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru Sword: Épée Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines" Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealo

characters.name: Juri Arisugawa
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Orange __Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya __Sword:__ Rapier __(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.

characters.name: Touga Kiryuu
characters.description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys. ~!Toward the end of the series, however, Touga's facade of chivalry is replaced with an apparently truer concern for Utena, to the extent that he very subtly attempts to substitute his head for hers on Akio's chopping block. Arguably, this is also an example of Touga's inability to see Utena as who she really is, rather than in a stereotypical feminine role.

characters.name: Nanami Kiryuu
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Yellow __Rose Bride:__ [Touga Kiryuu](https://anilist.co/character/753/Kiryuu-Touga) __Sword:__ Scimitar (main) and Dagger (as main-gauche) __Drive to Duel:__ Her big brother's honor, her own self-worth, and validation of her relationship with Touga (Anime) Touga's little sister, the prototypical "queen bee" of the school. She is very fond of him to the point of their relationship having semi-incestuous edge, at least on her part. Nanami often makes various malicious attacks on students she deems inferior (or worse, those she suspects Touga is paying attention to).

characters.name: Kyouichi Saionji
characters.description: __Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana __Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime) Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhoo

characters.name: Kozue Kaoru
characters.description: She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals. Like Nanami, Kozue also seems to have an extreme brother complex. She is very protective of Miki and is the reason that he does not have a girlfriend (despite the affection of many of his schoolmates). Kozue considers herself a "wild animal," wanting to be freed from adult rules and restrictions (in reality, she is resentful of her father remarrying). ~!In Adolescence of Utena she is shown as being very possessive of Miki, even holding a razor to his throat and calling him a traitor when he refuses to divulge details of his personal affairs to her. A car with Kozue's name is also seen briefly, though the director merely states

characters.name: Ruka Tsuchiya
characters.description: A master swordsman, Ruka is former captain of the fencing team and occasional member of the Student Council. He considers Juri to be the most talented member of the club and considers himself her mentor. ~! * Rose: Blue * Rose Bride: Shiori Takatsuki * Sword: Rapier * (Anime) Drive to Duel: To give Juri, the one he loves, the power of miracles. In the manga, Anthy served as Ruka's Rose Bride on several occasions before he left the school due to an unknown illness. He reappears at the school after a prolonged absence, claiming that he has recovered, though still not well enough to duel. He pushes Juri to duel Utena once again, but she throws the match after overhearing what she thinks is Ruka discussing with Touga how he's manipulating her. When she refuses to duel, Ruka himself is forced to duel Utena, and the strain causes a relapse of his illness. As he lies on the dueling fi

characters.name: Souji Mikage
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Black __Sword:__ Sabre __Drive to Duel:__ ~!To make Mamiya Chida the Rose Bride. (Anime) To finally defeat Mamiya's sister, Tokiko.!~ Mikage is the head of the popular Mikage Seminar at Ohtori Academy.

title: Umibe no Étranger
description: After coming out to his parents, aspiring novelist Shun Hashimoto has no one to turn to, until the day he meets high schooler Mio Chibana on the beach. The two instantly click—just before Mio has to leave for the mainland. Now three years later, Mio returns with a confession. But after all this time, will Shun feel the same? (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Shun Hashimoto
characters.description: Hashimoto Shun, a gay novelist in the making, lived on the island Okinawa with his family. On Okinawa, he met a boy named Chibana Mio, who later left to pursue his studies for three years. When he returned, he confessed his attraction to Shun and developed a relationship with him. Originally from Hokkaido, he moved to Okinawa to live with his grandmother after his parents discovered his sexual orientation.

characters.name: Mio Chibana
characters.description: Mio is a 20-year-old freeter. After his mother's death, he briefly moves to Okinawa, where he meets Shun. Initially offended at Shun's attitude, he soon falls in love and pursues him romantically when he returns to Okinawa. Mio attempts to get better understanding of Shun's concerns, despite Shun constantly dismissing his advances.

characters.name: Sakurako
characters.description: Sakurako is Shun's childhood friend who has known he was gay since high school. Through an arranged marriage, she was also Shun's fiancée until he came out to his parents during the wedding ceremony. Despite this, Sakurako is still in love with him. ~!In Harukaze no Étranger, A few years after Shun and Mio move into the main house, She ends up cutting her hair, claiming that she feels like a bunch of weight has come off her shoulders.!~ ~!It's also said that The adopted son of the Hashimoto household, [Fumi](https://anilist.co/character/185464/Fumi-Hashimoto), has a crush on her because of the kindness she gave him!~

characters.name: Eri
characters.description: Eri is a woman who previously lived with Shun and his grandmother in Okinawa before moving out to live with her girlfriend, Suzu.

characters.name: Oba-chan
characters.description: Shun's grandmother. He stays at her place.

characters.name: Suzu
characters.description: Eri's girlfriend.

title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai!: Kirameki no… Slapstick Noel
title_original: 中二病でも恋がしたい! 煌めきの... 聖爆誕祭（スラップステック・ノエル）
title_en: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions: Glimmering...Explosive Festival (Slapstick Noel)
description: Episode 13, included in the final volume of the BD/DVD. Taking place directly after the events of Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! , Christmas is coming up and Rikka is told by Nibutani that this is an opportunity for her to get closer to Yuuta. Under Makoto's suggestion, they plan a Christmas party at Sanae's Mansion.

characters.name: Yuuta Togashi
characters.description: A high school boy who used to be a delusional teen, believing himself to be the Dark Flame Master and becoming alienated from everyone as a result. Finding this to be embarrassing, he attempts to erase this past from existence, even choosing to go to a separate high school from all of his junior high school classmates. However, after encountering [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865), his past delusions come back to haunt him.

characters.name: Rikka Takanashi
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Rikka Takanashi is an active Chuunibyou, who still has the syndrome. Her delusional syndrome involves her right eye which she calls her "Wicked Eye," which, according to her, wields darkness tamed by the power of a pure heart. In reality, her so-called "Wicked Eye" is nothing more than a colored contact lens which she conceals underneath an eyepatch. Despite being quite attached to [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta), she is cautious of strangers and adopts a battle pose whenever she meets someone for the first time. She is also rather clumsy, often tripping over and forgetting things. She also doesn't have many friends, as shown that in her mobile phone only has her sister's email. ~!Rikka's father died in the past, which she stubbornly denies. In the process, she one-sidedly met Yuuta, who was an active chuunibyou at that time, and was a

characters.name: Shinka Nibutani
characters.description: A beautiful girl in [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s class. Shinka is Yuuta's classmate and class representative, who is also a cheerleader. One of the most popular girls in the class due to her looks, she is generally thought of a kind and gentle girl. ~!She too suffered a case of eighth-grader syndrome, going by the name of Forest Summer. Like Yuuta, she chose a school that none of her former classmates were going to so she could escape from her embarrassing past. When she is with Yuuta, [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), and the others in the clubroom, her usual happy, sweet demeanor fades and she is blunt, edgy, and tends to fight with [Dekomori](https://anilist.co/character/67215/Dekomori-Sanae) quite a lot. This is because Dekomori admires Forest Summer (and does not believe Shinka is actually Forest Summer, constantly referring

characters.name: Sanae Dekomori
characters.description: Sanae is an underclassman to the rest of the club members. She, like [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), is a Chuunibyou. She claims that she is Rikka's servant and wants to take her master's place. Her "power" is Mjolnir, a pair of hair nunchucks. Despite being a Chuunibyou, she is top in her class. Little was known about her relatives but it's implied that she is from a rich family. ~!She eventually becomes the student council president with [Nibutani](https://anilist.co/character/65871/Nibutani-Shinka) as her vice president. Her "nunchucks" are filled with candy, since her previous attempt with cookies didn't go well.!~ (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kumin Tsuyuri
characters.description: Kumin is [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863)'s chill and carefree senpai who loves adventures, cats, and pillows. Spends most of the time in the club room napping. She adores any chuunibyous and once said that it would've been fun to have some delusions herself.

characters.name: Makoto Isshiki
characters.description: Yuuta's classmate and friend. He created a "cutie poll" which ranked all the girls in class in terms of cuteness. However, because of this, his head was shaved into a crew cut. Later on he joins Rikka's club and develops a crush on Kumin.

characters.name: Nanase Tsukumo
characters.description: Yuuta and Rikka's homeroom teacher, who is often kind, if sometimes a little sadistic in teasing her students, particularly Rikka. She is called Nana-chan by Yuuta and Rikka.

title: Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete
title_original: 魔法少女にあこがれて
description: Hiiragi Utena is a major fangirl of the magical girls protecting her city, so when she has the chance to become one herself, she leaps at the chance to join their technicolor ranks… but when she transforms, she learns she isn’t fated to be a daring do-gooder, but rather a villain on the side of evil! At first she tries to quit her new gig as the leader of the local baddies, but she quickly realizes she enjoys it and is a total natural at tormenting the magical girls she loves so much. With both a bang and a whimper, Hiragi’s journey as a magical-girl-tormenting sadist has begun! (Source: HIDIVE)

characters.name: Utena Hiiragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Utena is a shy and introverted girl who longingly admires magical girls, collects their memorabilia, and talks passionately about them. Her obsession with Tres Magia even reached to the point where she wished to fight alongside them, but that ultimately led to her being tricked by [Venalita](https://anilist.co/character/301180). At times, she can be simple-minded.

characters.name: Kiwi Araga
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm She became a member of Enormeeta to beat up magical girls, because she hated that they got more attention than her on social media. Although Kiwi was initially hostile towards [Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), after undergoing shock training, she became docile and developed a crush on Utena. Now she is content with Utena's acknowledgement alone. Kiwi frequently fantasizes about going to a love hotel with Utena. Despite appearances she is decent enough academically to help Utena avoid her grades deteriorating. She and [Magia Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859) instinctively have it out for each other. They immediately devolve to insults and fighting at every opportunity — even in their civilian forms, despite not recognizing each other due to recognition inhibition.

characters.name: Korisu Morino
characters.description: __Height:__ 128 cm Korisu is a quiet and reserved girl, and the youngest member of Enormeeta. She has a large collection of old toys that are precious to her. Her theme is Alice in Wonderland.

characters.name: Nemo Anemo
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm __Favorite Food:__ Takoyaki __Least Favorite Food:__ Shiitake Mushrooms __Something That Made Her Happy Recently:__ Pulled Three SSRs In A Social Game Nemo is a snarky and crude girl. She is also quite arrogant, since she has a habit of taunting her opponents. She is also childhood friends with [Akoya Matama](https://anilist.co/character/255890). They have good teamwork when fighting together. However, they also argue often. In spite of this, they may have romantic feelings for each other.

characters.name: Matama Akoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm __Favorite Food:__ Sweet Rolled Omelettes __Least Favorite Food:__ Coriander __Recent Ambition:__ To Have A Video Of Her Singing Go Viral On Social Media Matama is a cheerful girl. However, she is also quite narcissistic and very sensitive to criticism. She fears both [Lord Enorme](https://anilist.co/character/288448) and [Magia Baiser Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), finding them both similar in that they use sexual harassment as punishment. She is terrible at singing except when engaging in exhibitionism, a fact discovered when Utena made her perform in the nude on threat of [Nemo](https://anilist.co/character/255889) being harmed.

characters.name: Sayo Minakami
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm Sayo is a calm and composed person, part of which is attributed to her being a shrine maiden. As shown in the flashback leading to her making the decision to become Magia Azul, she is also a brave person who does not hesitate to help others. Due to being restrained and tormented by Schiavo multiple times, Sayo began to develop masochistic tendencies. Her masochism and obsession with "fighting" with Enormeeta has gone to the point where she shows envy when [Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/191857/Hanabishi-Haruka) or [Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859/Tenkawa-Kaoruko) get the chance to fight them but she does not, as seen when she glares enviously and drools after seeing Magenta without her panties after the latter fought [Nero Alice](https://anilist.co/character/191858/Morino-Korisu).

characters.name: Haruka Hanabishi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Haruka is an extremely energetic and compulsive girl, always smiling and acting on her feelings. She cares a lot about Sayo and Kaoruko, admiring their strength and skill as magical girls. However, she is extremely naïve and gullible and seems to lack intelligence and common sense as well. Despite all this, Haruka is an extremely caring girl who cares about her friends and will go through any trial to protect them. When reflecting on being controlled by Baiser, she felt shame and regret over attacking Sulfur and Azul.

characters.name: Kaoruko Tenkawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 146 cm Kaoroku puts on a calm and cool mask for the public, but in reality she is a crude, foulmouthed, and short-tempered girl. She is also the most intelligent and cunning member of Tres Magia. She is not hesitant to start conflict, and will goad and taunt others, whether as herself or as Magia Sulfur.

characters.name: Lord Enorme
characters.description: Lord Enorme is cruel and remorseless, being the mastermind who caused the defeat and possible deaths of many magical girls. She is extremely arrogant and very self-entitled, believing that the world exists solely for the sake of being ruled by her. She takes pride in her actions, and does not hesitate to torture others for any reason, even her own subordinates.

characters.name: Venalita
characters.description: Venalita is a mascot who recruits magical girls for Enormeeta. He is shrewd and pragmatic, using whatever means necessary to recruit members into Enormeeta. He is also quick of mind, as he was able to successfully get Utena to forgive him for tricking her by making up a story about how his people are being killed by magical girls, and that he doesn't mind being labelled as evil as long as he can save them.

characters.name: Sister Gigant
characters.description: Sister Gigant is very submissive and obedient, following orders without question and not protesting punishment. She is also melancholy, as she is often seen crying and lamenting certain events. However, despite following Lord Enorme without question, her true loyalty is to Venalita.

characters.name: Vatz
characters.description: Vatz is the mascot for Tres Magia.

title: Hibike! Euphonium 2
description: With another tournament fast approaching, Kumiko's band is doubling down on practice and discipline, leaving little time for sleep or other recreational activities. The redoubled practice schedule brings Kumiko and Reina closer together, but elsewhere in the band, it seems like drama threatens to tear the group's unity apart. The ghost of the prior year's mass band exodus still haunts many of Kumiko's classmates, and with former band member Nozomi Kasaki now asking to return, it seems like the grudges of the past will soon be impossible to ignore. (Source: Anime News Network, edited) Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

characters.name: Kumiko Oumae
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

characters.name: Reina Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

characters.name: Asuka Tanaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

characters.name: Hazuki Katou
characters.description: **Instrument:** Tuba Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

characters.name: Sapphire Kawashima
characters.description: **Instrument:** Contrabass Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words. However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band. By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she

characters.name: Shuuichi Tsukamoto
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Trombone Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.

characters.name: Noboru Taki
characters.description: __Height:__ 184cm Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

characters.name: Aoi Saitou
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Tenor Saxophone She is a third-year student who quit the Kitauji brass band, having played the tenor saxophone since junior high school. Aoi was Kumiko Oumae and Shuuichi Tsukamoto's childhood friend, two years older than them. They lived in the same neighborhood, and often played together, but grew apart as they got older.

characters.name: Mamiko Oumae
characters.description: Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.

characters.name: Haruka Ogasawara
characters.description: __Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

characters.name: Kaori Nakaseko
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm **Instrument:** Trumpet A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.

title: Adachi to Shimamura
description: Adachi spends her school days skipping class until she meets fellow delinquent Shimamura and the two become fast friends. Cutting class together deepens their friendship but soon unexpected emotions blossom. As awkwardness and confusion settle in, the two girls travel this sea of emotions without a paddle as they learn about each other’s feelings. (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Sakura Adachi
characters.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Akira Hino
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji). Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

characters.name: Yashiro Chikama
characters.description: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

characters.name: Taeko Nagafuji
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura). Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure. Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon: Valentine, Soshite Onsen! (Amari Kitai Shinaide Kudasai)
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン バレンタイン, そして温泉! (あまり期待しないでください)
title_en: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)
description: On Valentine's Day, Tohru attempts to give Kobayashi some chocolates containing a love potion, but she quickly sees through her plan. However, Kobayashi ends up eating some of it after mistaking it for chocolate Kanna received, although the love potion gets cancelled out by some alcohol that was included in the chocolate. Later, Makoto invites everyone on a trip to a hot spring inn, where Tohru gives Kobayashi some regular chocolates. Note: Unaired episode 14 included with the volume 7 BD/DVD release of Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon.

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

title: Mahou Shoujo Site
description: Asagiri Aya is a young girl who has fallen victim to bullies at her school. Looking for a way to escape her troubles, she looks to the internet for distraction, when a mysterious website called "Magical Girl Site" appears. Simply viewing the page is all it takes to hurtle Aya headlong into the deadly world of the Magical Girl Apocalypse. There, it’s fight or die, against a seemingly endless array of savagely adorable, frilly-skirted killing machines, each armed with magical powers and an unquenchable thirst for blood and chaos. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Aya Asagiri
characters.description: At school she gets tacks put in her shoes, glue put on her desk, her head shoved in a toilet, and even worse than that. At home, her older brother who is stressed from trying to live up to their father's expectations ties her up, strips her, and beats her to relieve his stress. All Aya thinks about every day amidst the hell that is her life is dying. But one day a strange website called "Mahou Shoujo Site" pops up on her computer. The next day, the bullies at her school push her past the limit once again, but this time things go a little differently.

characters.name: Tsuyuno Yatsumura
characters.description: __Height:__ 5'0" She is a magical girl with the power to stop time. She tells Aya information about the magical girls and allies with her so they can be safer together. Unlike Aya, she does not have a problem using her power to injure or kill people who she dislikes. She was born in a city called Kanagawa, her hobbies are sleeping, gaming, and swimming, her advantages are that she's friendly, fit and takes the initiative. Tsuyuno doesn't like meat or waking up in the morning, but does like vegetables, games on her phone, honey, yogurts, cute things and advertising mascots.

characters.name: Nijimi Anazawa
characters.description: Nicknamed Nijimin, she is the most popular idol of the idol group 'Inu Asobi' (Puppy Play). Aya and Tsuyuno try to meet her based on a Slaughter Note of wands Rina was carrying. Though her normal demeanor is very perky and friendly, when shown a picture of Rina she becomes very upset and homicidal.

characters.name: Rina Shioi
characters.description: She is a very intelligent girl, analyst, strategist and somewhat clumsy, but when discovering the truth about the Tempest her way of acting changed radically to a more sinister, aggressive, psychopathic attitude and with murderous instincts to obtain all the possible magical objects. She is also quite sarcastic and sometimes does not take the situations seriously. She also has a warmer personality that is not usually shown when she wanted to shake hands with Tsuyuno.

characters.name: Sarina Shizukume
characters.description: Aya's classmate, and the leader of the group that bullies her at school.

characters.name: Kosame Amagai
characters.description: A mahou shoujo with healing powers. She can heal others by cutting her wrist and letting them drink her blood. ~!She received her stick from Hatchi, the admin of another mahou shoujo site, after being diagnosed with cancer.!~

characters.name: Kaname Asagiri
characters.description: Aya's older brother. He introduces himself to parents and teachers as a studious and serious boy but uses his adoptive sister to let off steam, beating and humiliating her.

characters.name: Hachi
characters.description: An administrator for the Mahou Shoujo Site website.

characters.name: Mikari Izumigamine
characters.description: Having been born into a wealthy family, she believes herself superior to other people. Her stick allows her to fly at high speed.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: She is one of the Administrators of the Magical Girl Sites in Mahou Shoujo Site.

title: Boku no Kanojo ga Majime Sugiru Shoujo Bitch na Ken
title_original: 僕の彼女がマジメ過ぎる処女ビッチな件
description: With nothing left to lose, ordinary high school student Haruka Shinozaki confesses to beautiful, diligent class representative Akiho Kousaka and to his surprise she accepts. Kousaka takes dating as seriously as she does everything else, but does not quite get it. She pragmatically suggests activities that are too sexual. (Source: KADOKAWA)

characters.name: Shizuku Ariyama
characters.description: Shizuku is a lively third-year high school student and childhood friend of Haruka, who merely sees her as an older sister and thus addresses her as such. However, she has recently become romantically interested in Haruka as well and makes several playful and obvious allusions towards him, even though she is too shy to take the initiative when things have a chance to get serious.

characters.name: Akiho Kousaka
characters.description: Akiho is a beautiful, aloof-looking high school second-year model student and popular girl in her class, and Haruka's love interest. However, she has absolutely no experience with intimate relationships and thus tends to overanalyze this topic in her nervousness. She has the habit of approaching sexual topics in a straightforward manner, a trait which was ingrained into her by her mother at an early age, hence the name.

characters.name: Haruka Shinozaki
characters.description: Haruka is a shy and gentle boy who is a second-year in high school. He is quite popular with the girls in his neighborhood, but remains unaware of, or is simply not interested in, their romantic inclinations towards him. He has sexual fantasies, but is too shy to express them. He has been in love with Akiho since he was a high school first-year, but once she agrees to become his girlfriend, he finds out some things about her which he has some trouble to getting used to.

characters.name: Misaki Aikawa
characters.description: Misaki Aikawa is a classmate and friend of Kanata Shinozaki who works part-time in an ice cream shop.

characters.name: Saori Igarashi
characters.description: Saori is Haruka and Akiho's classmate, as well as the class president. She is a moralist and a prudish girl who tends to overreact, thereby driving herself hysterical for no plausible reason.

characters.name: Rina Saijou
characters.description: Rina is a charismatic girl from a wealthy family who transferred to Haruka's school in search of a boyfriend. Like Akiho, she is very liberal in talking about sex-related matters, but since she previously attended an all-girl school and could only find romance with other girls, her experience in romancing males is practically non-existent. She owns two dogs, Butter and Margarine, whom she regards like human beings.

characters.name: Kanata Shinozaki
characters.description: Kanata is Haruka's younger sister by one year, who adopts a cat-like behavior pattern and is seldom seen without her cat-ear hoodie jacket. She is very infatuated with her older brother and considers herself the only girl cute enough to be his girlfriend. One of her favorite interactions with him is to have him pet her on the head.

characters.name: Sayo Shizumori
characters.description: Sayo is a girl who keeps her hair hanging in front of her eyes. She is very shy in personal relations, but likes to peep on romantic couples and excite herself on what she sees.

characters.name: Fuyumi Kousaka
characters.description: Fuyumi is Akiho's mother, who greatly resembles her daughter in both appearance and demeanor.

characters.name: Seiya Hoshikawa
characters.description: Hoshikawa is Haruka's classmate and a handsome, if narcisstic boy who enjoys the romantic attention of nearly every girl in school. However, Hoshikawa is only interested in male-to-male relationships, especially with Haruka, who naturally fails to notice the deeper significance of Hoshikawa's allusions.

characters.name: Natsuo Kousaka
characters.description: Natsuo is Akiho's father, who in personality and looks shares many similarities with Haruka and, despite the years they have spent together, is still taken by surprise by his wife's peculiarities.

title: Onii-chan wa Oshimai!
title_original: お兄ちゃんはおしまい！
description: Mahiro Oyama was just a normal erotic-game loving dude…until he woke up one morning as a woman! Turns out his mad-scientist little sister, Mihari, tried out one of her new experiments on him…with a disastrous outcome, as far as Mahiro’s concerned! But Mihari is as determined to study him as he is determined to go back to his shut-in, game-playing life, and one thing’s for sure…life is going to get a whole lot weirder from here on out! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Mahiro Oyama
characters.description: He was a hikikomori neet and loner, until he woke up one morning as a little girl thanks to his [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari) drugging him.

characters.name: Mihari Oyama
characters.description: [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro)'s little sister. A genius scientist that skipped grades and is now attending college. She is responsible for drugging Mahiro, turning him into a young girl.

characters.name: Kaede Hozuki
characters.description: Kaede is a close personal friend of [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari). They became friends in middle school. Mihari has progressed further in the academic system than Kaede, but they still are close, and see each other regularly.

characters.name: Miyo Murosaki
characters.description: Miyo-chan is a classmate of Mahiro in middle school. She is friends with [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) and [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/130824/Ouka-Asahi). Miyo-chan is somewhat quiet and shy, and many times does not express herself verbally. However, she likes to hug and embrace her girl school friends, and takes a great interest in them and their activities. She has become particularly interested in Mahiro, although she is younger then her by a couple of years. Miyo-chan seems to be socially interested only in girls, and limits her time and attention to only select girls. She gives the appearance of showing her love and affection as a Shoujo Ai or Yuri shipping (girl with girl relationships). As such, Miyo-chan is always quick to ascribe a Yuri motive to any two girls talking or playing around with one another, as she likes to watch, on the side, su

characters.name: Momiji Hozuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Momiji is the younger sister of [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/130819). She is in middle school, and is in the same class that [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822) enters when they reenter school. Momiji likes to dress, look, and act as a tomboy, and many times she is taken for a young teen/tween boy. However, Momiji gives no indication that she is in any way a transgender tween. She appears to only be gender non-conforming. However, she can be quite feminine in appearance on select occasions, like when she wears the middle school female uniform, a cute jumper dress, to school. She forms a strong friendship with Mahiro, and helps Mahiro navigate the middle school academic and social challenges of school. Many times she comes to Mahiro's defense when Mahiro is bewildered or frightened by somebody or something happening at school, or if it is perceived tha

characters.name: Asahi Ouka
characters.description: Asahi is a classmate of [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) in middle school. She befriends Mahiro, and the two become quite close to one another. Asahi talks with a pronounced Osaka accent. In the English language, such characters are usually given a heavy southern accent, similar to a southern, country girl drawl so reminiscent of a southern belle/dixie chick. She pronounces Mahiro's name as "Maa-high-row". She loves to hug people, especially her friends. Mahiro tells herself that Asahi always smells like the fresh, clean, morning sun! She likes to talk about sports, and is very good at girl's track and field. Asahi also has the curious conversational habit of always referring to herself in the third person, as if she is always on the outside looking in at herself. She is also not the least bit afraid or bothered by offering her thoughts and/or opinions in a rath

characters.name: Nemu Fujimi
characters.description: Nemu is frequently seen sleeping. She sleeps throughout the entire day, even sleeping in gym class and while standing up.

title: Shokei Shoujo no Virgin Road
title_original: 処刑少女の生きる道（バージンロード）
title_en: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
description: When interdimensional travelers from an otherworldly land known as “Japan” appear, they often bring death and destruction. It’s up to Executioners like Menou to track and exterminate the Lost Ones before they wreak havoc. When Menou encounters a beguiling Lost One named Akari, it’s bloody business as usual… until Menou discovers Akari can cheat death, that is. Even so, Menou has a job to do, and she is committed to her executioner’s mission come hell or high water — provided her newly stirring feelings don’t get in the way. (Source: Sentai Filmworks) Note: The first two episodes received an advance release on Abema on March 20, 2022. The regular TV broadcast started on April 2, 2022.

characters.name: Menou
characters.description: The Executioner. A young executioner girl who has exceptional magical talent. She is strongly dedicated to her mission and tries to finish off [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696) before her power gets out of hand. She gets close to her targets with friendly manner to grasp their ability before killing them. Her main weapons are short blade and sacred scripture.

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: Apprentice priestess working under [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou). She is deeply attached to Menou but has near zero religious faith. She is good at fighting with a fretsaw, but has poor skill with scripture magic.

characters.name: Akari Tokitou
characters.description: The Lost One. She is affectionate and easy-going. Menou is unable to kill her because of her ability even though she is not aware of it herself. She begins her journey with Menou, without knowing her true intentions.

characters.name: Ashuna Grizarica
characters.original: アーシュナ・グリザリカ
characters.description: Traveling Princess Knight. Princess of the Grizarica Kingdom, who is strong and beautiful. People call her the "Princess Knight" and she carries a sword with the royal crest as she always is ready for a fight.

characters.name: Mitsuki
characters.description: He was summoned from another world with the ability "nothingness" and was immediately thrown out of the castle. He wandered around aimlessly until he met [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)

characters.name: Flare
characters.description: Skilled priest and executioner, who has killed the most Lost Ones from other worlds. She is [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)'s mentor and Menou is considered her successor.

characters.name: Orwell
characters.description: The Archbishop. She is trusted by many people and has the greatest skill in magic of her era. She offers [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou) help in killing [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696/Akari-Tokitou) because in the central cathedral she controls a chamber that can contain and even kill otherworldly pure concepts.

characters.name: Manon Libelle
characters.description: Representative of the Libelle Family Head. Sole daughter of Count Libelle, who acts as the representative of the family after the Count fell ill. She is always dressed in a kimono and carries herself gracefully.

characters.name: Sicilia
characters.description: Priest of the port city Libelle. She works under Flare and they seem to be acquainted but further details are unclear.

characters.name: Shoujo
characters.description: ~!One of the four Human Errors, demon of the fog Pandemonium which was sealed away. She takes the form of a young girl, but her true body is still inside the fog. She has lost the memories and personality from before she became a Human Error.!~

title: Akebi-chan no Sailor Fuku
title_original: 明日ちゃんのセーラー服
description: It’s Komichi Akebi’s first year of junior high and she has her heart set on one thing: Robai Private Academy’s sailor uniform. As the next chapter of her life gets closer, she dreams of all the exciting new experiences she’ll get to have—school lunches, classes, club activities, and of course, making lots of friends! With her favorite outfit on, Komichi feels ready for anything. (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Komichi Akebi
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 1. A girl who has a strong yearning for sailor uniforms due to a certain reason. She has a bright and straightforward personality, and is really looking forward to school life. She is very good at sports. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Erika Kizaki
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 5. The first classmate that [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) met. She has the air of a young lady, but also has an active side that likes fishing and mountain climbing.

characters.name: Touko Usagihara
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 2. She has good communication skills and a cheerful personality. She knows a lot of rumors about her classmates. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Tomono Kojou
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 6. She has a quiet and gentle personality, and loves to read. She started talking to [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) when she borrowed her handkerchief. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Hitomi Washio
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 16. She is the tallest girl in her class and has already become a promising member of the volleyball team. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Kei Tanigawa
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 9. She is a brilliant student who passed the entrance exam to the prestigious Shoume Gakuen. After meeting Komichi, she becomes interested in taking selfies. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Hotaru Hiraiwa
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 14. She is the smallest girl in the class, mysterious and unpredictable. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Riri Minakami
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 13. She is a good swimmer and speaks in a Kansai dialect. She doesn't talk much in class, but seems to be comfortable talking to Komichi. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Neko Kamimoku
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 4. She always looks sleepy and often dozes off in class, which the teacher often cautions her about. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Ai Tatsumori
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 8. A girl who aims to be the best at everything. She is the head of the school. She hates to lose and has a strong desire to improve. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Ayumi Togeguchi
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 10. She is careful not to speak in a dialect. Because of this, she doesn't talk much in class. However, when she gets emotional, she sometimes can't stop herself. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Riona Shijou
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 7. She had been learning hard tennis all her life until she started studying for her exams. She has a certain complex. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo
title_original: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
title_en: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
description: A.S. (Ad Stella) 122 An era when a multitude of corporations have entered space and built a huge economic system. A lone girl from the remote planet Mercury transfers to the Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group which dominates the mobile suit industry. Her name is Suletta Mercury. With a scarlet light burning in her pure heart, this girl walks step by step through a new world. (Source: Mobile Suit Gundam The Witch from Mercury Official Site)

characters.name: Suletta Mercury
characters.original: スレッタ・マーキュリー
characters.description: A second-year student in the piloting department, who transferred to the school from Mercury. Suletta is timid and somewhat lacks communication skills. She is the pilot of the Gundam Aerial developed on Mercury. ~!Suletta was one of the repli-children created from Ericht Samaya. However, according to official records, she had a deceased father. As Aliya Mahvash mentioned when she told her fortune, she learned that her father had passed away when she was a young child.!~

characters.name: Miorine Rembran
characters.original: ミオリネ・レンブラン
characters.description: An attractive and academically distinguished second-year student in the management strategy department. Miorine is the only daughter of Delling Rembran, the president of the Beneritt Group and chairman of the school's board. She has a strong rebellious feeling towards her father. Miorine has shown an interest in gardening in her spare time, with an apparent focus on tomatoes. (Source: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Official Site)

characters.name: Elan Ceres
characters.description: A pilot fielded by Peil Technologies—one of the "Big Three" corporations within the Benerit Group. A third-year student in the Piloting Department at the Asticassia School of Technology (Student ID: KP002), he is also a member of the Duel Committee. He pilots the Zowort and the Gundam Pharact. Although he is the top-ranked student in the Peil dormitory, he remains a solitary figure who does not open up to anyone at the academy. Perhaps due to this, his only real point of contact was [Shaddiq Zenelli](https://anilist.co/character/279509/Shaddiq-Zenelli)—a fellow member of the Duel Committee with strong communication skills. Later, however, he developed an interest in [Suletta Mercury](https://anilist.co/character/279507/Suletta-Mercury), and upon seeing the mobile suit Suletta pilots—the Aerial—he correctly identified it as a GUND-ARM. As noted above, he embodies a sense of "solitary deta

characters.name: Guel Jeturk
characters.description: An heir to Jeturk Heavy Machinery, one of the group's three branches, and a third-year student in the piloting department. Guel has a rough temperament and is quick to anger. As the ace pilot of Jeturk House, he has absolute confidence in his own skills. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Shaddiq Zenelli
characters.description: An adopted child of the CEO of Grassley Defense Systems, one of the group's three branches. A third-year student in the piloting department who leads Grassley House. Although still a student Shaddiq has shown his skill in business too, he is a candidate for next generation executive. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Cardo Nabo
characters.description: She was a researcher who represented the Vanadis Institute. As a leading proponent of the "GUND FORMAT" theory, she had earned the respect of her fellow researchers

characters.name: Nadim Samaya
characters.description: The father of the Samaya family.

characters.name: Nika Nanaura
characters.description: A second-year student in the mechanical department, who belongs to Earth House. She loves mecha and is very curious about Suletta's Gundam Aerial. Nika has outstanding maintenance skills and is proud of herself for customizing Chuchu's Demi Trainer. ~!At some point, Nika was acquainted with Dawn of Fold and become part of the group, with [Naji](https://anilist.co/character/307149/Hija-Geor-Naji) acting as a Father figure for her.!~~!Nika joined the Asticassia School of Technology under a promise of [Shaddiq](https://anilist.co/character/279509/Zenelli-Shaddiq) with the condition of be a go-between agent between Dawn of Fold and his Faction.!~

characters.name: Chuatury Panlunch
characters.original: チュアチュリー・パンランチ
characters.description: Chuchu is a troubled young girl, who is an Earthian facing discrimination from a significant portion of the Spacians who look down on Earthians as underlings. Being in the same school as many Spacians, she along with her Earthian friends has been the subject of regular abuse and harassment. This along with her home people being the subject of Spacian oppression and exploitation has given Chuchu a profoundly negative impression of all Spacians often deriding them as "Shitty Spacians" and lashing at them at the first opportunity. Because of the harsh circumstances of her growth and her present situation, Chuchu is rather hot-headed and prone to pick fights, especially with Spacians who harass or torment others for fun or classism. Chuchu sees herself as someone who carries the burdens and hopes of her home people and is sympathetic to those who carry similar struggles.

characters.name: Nugen
characters.description: One of the four co-CEOs who manage Peil Technologies, one of the Benerit Group's three branches, via a parliamentary system.

characters.name: Vim Jeturk
characters.description: Guel's father, and CEO of the Jeturk company, one of the Benerit Group's three branches.

characters.name: Rouji Chante
characters.description: A first-year mechanic in the Burion House. He belongs to the Dueling Committee. He is familiar with mobile crafts and other mecha, and always carries his own modified Haro. In stark contrast to Cecelia—who resides in the same Brion Dorm—he is exceptionally quiet and shows very little emotional range. He is utterly indifferent toward anything that fails to capture his interest; combined with hiss reserved nature, he is so unobtrusive that, even when present, he might as well be part of the background. That said, he diligently carries out his duties for the "Duel Committee" and provide highly accurate analyses. He is a serious person who truly embodies the principle of "actions speak louder than words."

title: Liz to Aoi Tori
description: Students and best friends Mizore Yoroizuka and Nozomi Kasaki prepare to play a complex musical duet, Liz and the Blue Bird , for oboe and flute. Though they play beautifully together and have been friends since childhood, Mizore and Nozomi find that with graduation looming and the duet proving difficult, their friendship begins to buckle under the pressure. Interspersed with their story is the fantasy tale of Liz, drawn like a storybook, contrasting with the crisp realism of the school. (Source: Shout! Factory)

characters.name: Nozomi Kasaki
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Flute Nozomi is a second-year student who used to play flute for the Kitauji High School's Bass Band Club in her first year.
