She and most of the first year members quit the club due to a conflict between the first-year members and the third-year members at that time. Sound! Euphonium Season 2 Spoilers: ~!Nozomi tried to rejoin the band as well as get Asuka's approval. However, Asuka initially rejected due to the fear of Mizore possibly being affected by Nozomi's sudden return, causing a negative impact on Mizore's performance for the competition. However, due to an unexpected move by Nozomi to talk to Mizore causing her to run off, the latter managed to talk things out with Nozomi and restore their friendship. It is also revealed that Mizore played the oboe for the sole reason that it was the only thing that connected her with Nozomi.!~ Liz and the Blue Bird Spoilers: ~!I

characters.name: Mizore Yoroizuka
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Oboe Mizore is a second-year student who plays oboe. She is a very quiet and introverted girl, and despite seeming hard to interact with, she has friends like [Natsuki Nakagawa](https://anilist.co/character/88923/Nakagawa-Natsuki), [Yuuko Yoshikawa](https://anilist.co/character/88916/Yoshikawa-Yuuko), and - despite past relationship troubles - [Nozomi Kasaki](https://anilist.co/character/120724/Nozomi-Kasaki). She likes practicing the oboe alone outside the classroom, and frequently arrives at school early, hours before the start of her classes, in order to practice. She's the only student to arrive at school even earlier than [Reina Kousaka](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina).

characters.name: Ririka Kenzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'3") __Instrument:__ Oboe Ririka is a first-year student of Kitauji High School and an oboe player in Kitauji Concert Band Club. She has a light and cheerful childlike personality who tries to build a good relationship with [Mizore](https://anilist.co/character/125960/). However, according to [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/133462/), Ririka is aware of her ability to pass off any rude or suspicious behaviour as innocence with her smile. When Ririka's interested in something, she starts from the beginning and goes step by step. Her special skill is making friends.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words. However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band. By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she

characters.name: Natsuki Nakagawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Natsuki is a reserved girl who is seen rarely talking, and she has an aloof and calm attitude. It is later revealed that the second-years are like this because of an event which occurred the year before [Kumiko Oumae](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s first year at Kitauji. However, Natsuki is normally friendly to everyone, and tends to be mature and calm in most situations. She is also understanding of situations and takes everything quite nicely.

characters.name: Reina Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

characters.name: Noboru Taki
characters.description: __Height:__ 184cm Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

characters.name: Satomi Niiyama
characters.description: She is a woodwind Instructor brought in by Noboru Taki to help with the Kitauji Concert Band on its path to the national competition. Her main instrument is flute, which she majored in, but she is also highly proficient in all other woodwind instruments. She is the youngest of the four instructors directing the band who is described as gentle with a sweet personality and her woodwind students describe her as a firm but good teacher. As nice as she is outside of class, Niiyama is revealed to be as strict as Taki and Hashimoto during rehearsal and sectionals, setting extremely high standards for her students and forcing them to practice for hours every day.

characters.name: Hazuki Katou
characters.description: **Instrument:** Tuba Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

characters.name: Kumiko Oumae
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

title: Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!?
title_original: オタクに優しいギャルはいない!?
title_en: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
description: Meet Takuya Seo, an otaku who sits behind the popular gals in class, Ijichi and Amane. Since they're people from different "castes," you wouldn't expect them to have much in common. But when their worlds collide over a borrowed eraser, Takuya slips up about his favorite anime, and Amane...is rather quick to correct him. She says she's not a fan, but her familiarity with the series suggests otherwise. Could she be...a fellow geek?! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takuya Seo
characters.description: A socially awkward, unassuming otaku high school boy who loves the girls' anime “Kiramon.” Nicknamed “Otaku-kun.” He tends to speak rapidly when talking about Kiramon. He's good at drawing but struggles with academics and communication. He has an aversion to gals. Through a series of unexpected events, he becomes involved with his classmates, the gals [Kei Amane](https://anilist.co/character/322471/Kei-Amane) and [Kotoko Ijichi](https://anilist.co/character/322472/Kotoko-Ijichi).

characters.name: Kei Amane
characters.description: The cool gal in [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) class. One of the top beauties in her grade. Has strong likes and dislikes, especially dislikes vegetables. Tall and skilled at basketball, but not part of any club activities. Despite her intelligent looks, she's not particularly good at studying. As for Kiramon, she insists she only likes it for her little sister-like friend [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/392458/Amamiya-Sayu) and isn't an otaku... but...?

characters.name: Kotoko Ijichi
characters.description: A cheerful gal who is [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) classmate. She has excellent communication skills and is good at studying, but not so good at sports. She tends to get close when talking. She is the third of five siblings, with two older brothers and two younger brothers. Because she has so many siblings, she often acts as a mother figure and takes care of her younger brothers.

characters.name: Genichirou Ijichi
characters.description: Kotoko Ijichi's older brother.

title: Sakura Trick
description: Haruka and Yuu have been best friends forever and they've always sat next to each other in class since… well, since they were just girls in junior high anyway. But on their first day of high school, they're stunned to learn that the new seating plan has them on opposite sides of the classroom! So, since everyone knows that long distance relationships won't work unless the parties involved put extra effort into it, they decide they need to do something extra special to permanently seal their friendship. However, deciding to kiss each other awakens a whole new level of feelings, and it doesn't help that some of their classmates seem to be 'involved" in similar circumstances. So what's a girl to do when her best girl friend suddenly seems more like a girlfriend? It's a life lesson that the school curriculum isn't normally prepared to teach, except maybe in French class, and our two young heroines are about to get a private education you'll never forget! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Haruka Takayama
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Haruka is a student at Misato West High School and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda) best friend. Haruka also has a tendency to become jealous, especially when it comes to Yuu.

characters.name: Yuu Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Yuu is a student at Misato West High School and [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama)'s best friend. She tends to slack off at school. Her older sister is [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/87710/Mitsuki-Sonoda).

characters.name: Kotone Noda
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Kotone is a student at Misato West High School and comes from a rich family. She gave [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama) the nickname "Harupoppo".

characters.name: Shizuku Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Shizuku is a shy student at Misato West High School, who currently lives together with [Kotone](https://anilist.co/character/87706/Kotone-Noda).

characters.name: Kaede Ikeno
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Kaede is a student at Misato West High School, and also the class president. Her best friend is [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87709/Yuzu-Iizuka). ~!Later in the manga it’s confirmed that Kaede has feelings for Yuzu.!~

characters.name: Yuzu Iizuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Yuzu is a student at Misato West High School. She goes to school on her moped. Her best friend is [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87708/Kaede-Ikeno).

characters.name: Mitsuki Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mitsuki is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council president. Her younger sister is [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda).

characters.name: Sumi Otokawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Sumi is a student at Misato West High School and a member of the student council.

characters.name: Rina Sakai
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Rina is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council vice president.

title: Masou Gakuen H×H
title_en: Hybrid x Heart Magias Academy Ataraxia
description: Hida Kizuna possesses the HHG (Heart Hybrid Gear) ability, but it is not strong enough to make him particularly important. His older sister calls him to transfer to a strategic defense school, where many of the students (many of which are large-breasted girls) use their HHG abilities to fight invaders from another world while wearing extremely skimpy pilot outfits. Kizuna's fighting ability doesn't measure up, but his sister has another plan; getting the girls to have erotic experiences with Kizuna, so that it will allow them to replenish their energy or power-up. It looks like his new school life is going to be full of embarrassment! (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Kizuna Hida
characters.description: He's the second child of Nayuta Hida, younger brother and lover of [Reiri Hida](https://anilist.co/character/89668/Hida-Reiri), adopted older brother to Hida Setsuna as well as the first-person who obtains HHG on Earth/Lemuria and the only male HHG pilot on Lemuria. After being expelled from Ataraxia by his mother, he lived as a regular student until he was called back by his sister after she learns his secret abilities and made him the captain of Amaterasu.

characters.name: Aine Chidorigafuchi
characters.description: She is one of prominent members of Ataraxia's Amaterasu who is famed for mastering Heart Hybrid Gear much quicker than her comrades, specifically [Kizuna](https://anilist.co/character/89664/Hida-Kizuna). ~!It is later revealed that she is also known as Aines Synclavia the lost princess of Vatlantis Empire before her amnesia.!~

characters.name: Hayuru Himekawa
characters.description: Hayuru is the ace of Japan and an esteemed member of the Amaterasu. She is a member of Ataraxia's Morals Committee and an extremely strict woman. Hayuru is a beautiful young woman with long eyelashes and blue eyes. She has long black hair with hime-style which is decorated with red ribbons, that keep her hairstyle into twin-tails. She has a slender figure yet Hayuru does have well-developed bust and voluptuous buttocks. Furthermore, she wears the usual academic uniform. In privacy, she sometimes wears a headdress with cat ears. Her Neros looks like a device that gives the image of a sharp bladed tool. An armament that looks similar to a Japanese katana is fixed at the waist, while eight long and slender mechanical parts float on her back. In other words, she looks somewhat like a samurai from the Edo period, which is reflected by her personality.

characters.name: Yurishia Farandole
characters.original: ユリシア・ファランドール
characters.description: Yurishia is a beautiful young woman with typical features of Caucasian descent, having blonde hair, blue eyes, and white skin. She looks more mature compared to her age. [Kizuna](https://anilist.co/character/89664/Hida-Kizuna) described her as glamorous and perfect. Her Heart Hybrid Gear looks like a protector with beautiful material. The sleek surface reflects the surrounding light and gold lines of light is running inside it. It has a small surface area which makes one feel uneasy whether it could really accomplish its role as a protector. There are also weapons integrated on the back and around the waist. The two large units stretching out from the back, the Differential Frames (Offensive Mobile Particle Engine) divides the energy they produce for propulsive power and the particle cannon. The units have a mobile style where Yurisia can move them freely using her will, leaving no blind

characters.name: Reiri Hida
characters.description: Hida Reiri is the principal and commander of Ataraxia. She becomes the leader of Ataraxia after it became an independent country. She is the daughter of Hida Nayuta, as well as the older sister and semi-secret lover of Hida Kizuna and adopted older sister Hida Setsuna. Carrying the heavy responsibility of protecting her world from the threats brought by the AU Conflict , Reiri was the one who started the Heart Hybrid program.

characters.name: Sylvia Silkcut
characters.original: シルヴィア・ シルクカット
characters.description: Sylvia Silkcut is a beautiful young girl with purple eyes and short bob-cut blonde hair with a hairpin in it. She usually wears her school uniform. She has a petite body and is considered very cute by everyone. Other female members of Amaterasu often tempt her.

characters.name: Sharon Cunningham
characters.original: シャロン・カニンガム

characters.name: Scarlett Fairchild
characters.original: スカーレット・フェアチャイルド
characters.description: Scarlett is a charming young girl with golden-yellow cat-like eyes. She has long red hair which are usually in a long ponytail with black ribbon keeping it in place. She has a tight and slender body which is according to Kizuna is like steel spring with well-shaped bust. After coming to Ataraxia she starts wearing school uniform and stylish casual clothes like top and miniskirts in her free time.

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya
title_original: Fate/kaleid liner プリズマ☆イリヤ
description: Illyasviel von Einzbern’s normal life is suddenly halted by the Kaleidostick Ruby, a magical wand on the run from her former master, who instantly decides that little Illya has all the right stuff to become the next great magical girl. However, Ruby’s previous owner Rin Tohsaka isn’t exactly thrilled to be de-wanded, especially since she’s just accepted an assignment to collect the seven legendary Class Cards. It seems the only solution is for Illya to take up the task and learn the ropes under Rin’s supervision. Meanwhile, a girl named Miyu has been chosen by the Kaleidostick Sapphire as HER new master, much to the irritation of Sapphire’s previous master, Rin’s arch rival Luviagelita Edelfelt! Exactly what kind of plan are the wands conjuring up? (Source: Sentai Filmworks) Note: The show streamed in advance on Niconico Live on July 6, 2013 in Japan. The regular TV broadcast started on July 13, 2013.

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
characters.original: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Daughter of the distinguished lineage of magi of the Edelfelt, Luvia is their young and talented family head. A student in Clock Tower, the Mage's Association academy, she is one of the candidates for the position of student's president for the current academic term. As long as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) is not nearby, Luvia's attitude is always graceful, never blaspheming and with a beauty similar to a swan. Of course, that is just a facade and she is actually very competitive and suffers with perfectionist tendencies. Luvia has long golden blonde hair styled entirely in large coils. She physically resembles Rin somewhat, furthering speculation that the younger Edelfelt sister from the Third Holy Grail War may have married into the Tohsaka family. She is from Finland.

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Artoria Pendragon
characters.original: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1) Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon. __In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his C

characters.name: Medusa
characters.description: ~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone. With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Ho

characters.name: Heracles
characters.description: __In Fate/Stay Night:__ ~!The Servant of [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel), he is a swarthy giant with adamantine skin and gross brawn. He wields a colossal stone Axe-Sword, and is capable of causing massive destruction with the mere backlash of his swings. As a Berserker, he was stripped of his sanity and reason, acting feral and animalistic in combat. Berserkers are praised as members of the "Strongest" class, though they are difficult to control. Illya, however, appears to have little trouble managing Berserker.!~

characters.name: Taiga Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother. She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps fr

characters.name: Medea
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Servant type:__ Caster ~!An honored guest of the Ryudou family​ permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.!~

characters.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
characters.original: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

characters.name: Hassan-i-Sabbah
characters.description: One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect and the 19th who took the name of Hassan-i-Sabah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain. This particular individual suffered from Multiple Personality Disorder which he utilized to compartmentalize his abilities. This gave his Noble Phantasm the ability to manifest his different personalities as separate and autonomous entities. Though they differ in terms of build and sex, the different personas share similar characteristics: they have dark brown skin, purple hair (for those who have it) and wear white skeletal masks. Like all other Hassan-i-Sabah, he can be summoned only in the Assassin Class with the class itself acting as a catalyst. __Personas:__ • Asako (アサ 子) • Big Assassin (でかアサシン) • Child Assassin (ちびアサシン) • Macour the Quick (迅速のマクール) • Strange Arm Gozour (怪腕のゴズール) • Zayd the Base (基底のザイード) • more... __In Fate/Zero__ ~! Assa

title: Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou.
title_en: I'm in Love with the Villainess
description: The world turns upside down when a corporate drone wakes up as Rae Taylor, the heroine in her favorite otome game, Revolution. Rae is elated at the opportunity to court Claire François, the game’s villainess and the object of her affection. Armed with her knowledge of the game and events to come, Rae sets out to make Claire fall for her. But how will the villainess take Rae’s romantic advances? (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Misha Jur
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm (5'0") Misha is Rae's best friend and roommate at the Academy. She is a noble from a house that fell from grace and became impoverished. Despite the Jur family's struggles with money, she still holds some reputation. She is accepting of her position and, rather than hold onto the noble status, portrays herself as equal among people with common background. This allowed for Rae and Misha to form their longstanding friendship.

characters.name: Lene Aurousseau
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm (5'1") Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid. Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

characters.name: Thane Bauer
characters.description: The second heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. Thane is often stoic and feels his abilities are inferior to his brothers, giving him a complex about it. Thane is considered as the least popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Yuu Bauer
characters.description: ~!Gender: Female!~ The third heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. A charismatic and attractive prince type who uses charm to mask a cunning mind. Yu is the second most popular capture target within the game. ~!Later in the story it is revealed that Yuu was born as female, but she was raised as a boy. She wishes to live as a girl again.!~

characters.name: Rod Bauer
characters.description: The eldest heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family and first in line to the throne. He is a energetic young man who becomes interested in Rae, much to her dismay. Rod is the most popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Manaria Sousse
characters.description: Manaria Sousse is the first crown princess of the kingdom of Sousse. She is a distant relative of Claire. She is the world's first confirmed quad-caster who possesses the highest aptitude in every element. ~!Manaria was Claire's first love, although she was first mistaken for a boy, and helped Claire overcome the trauma of losing her mother. They grew close after this incident and would continue writing to each other for years to come.!~

characters.name: Loretta Kugret
characters.original: ロレッタ・クグレット
characters.description: Loretta is from the House Kuguret, a family well known for their history of military service.

characters.name: Pipi Barlier
characters.description: Pipi is the daughter of the House Barlier, a family with deep-seated connections in Bauer’s business world. She is childhood friends with Claire François and Loretta Kugret.

characters.name: Ralaire
characters.description: Baby slime adopted by [Rae](https://anilist.co/character/171836/Taylor-Rae).

characters.name: Dole François
characters.description: Dole François is the Minister of Finance in the Bauer Kingdom and the father of Claire François.

title: Flip Flappers
title_original: フリップフラッパーズ
description: As a middle school student, Cocona has been trying to decide what to do with her life. Magical Girl, however, wasn’t a career path that she’d ever considered. When suddenly a strange girl named Papika thrusts her into a secret organization called Flip Flap, Cocona’s outlook does a radical flip-flop. Her views start to change when she is dragged into an alternate dimension called Pure Illusion where she’s charged with gathering crystal shards and fighting strange creatures. Now, between running missions and facing off against a rival organization, Cocona doesn’t have much time to consider alternate career choices. What are these shards, and why is gathering them so important? There’s a mystery to be solved and multiple worlds to be saved in FLIP FLAPPERS! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Papika
characters.description: A mysterious girl who appears in front of Cocona. She's always bright and active, thirsting for adventure, along with having nearly no fear. She is also proficient at riding a hoverboard, often surfing the skies. After becoming friends with Cocona, Papika insists on returning to Pure Illusion for more adventures. ~!In the past, she was referred to as, "Papikana," when she was partners with Mimi.!~

characters.name: Cocona Cocomine
characters.description: A second-year middle school student who lives with her grandmother. She's an honor student who serves as the class representative. Because of her cautious personality, she's unable to step foot into new opportunities.

characters.name: Yuyu
characters.description: An elementary school student and Toto's younger twin sister. Yuyu is calm and collected, while also speaking with little to no emotion in her voice. Outside of Pure Illusion, Yuyu wears a cast on her left arm; however, while in Pure Illusion, she wields a power fist.

characters.name: Yayaka
characters.description: Cocona's childhood friend and classmate. Cocona relies on her for her cool and strong-minded personality. She cares for Cocona deeply, getting jealous when she gets a new friend. ~!Yayaka secretly works with FlipFlap's rival organization, Asclepius, to collect amorphous fragments. She is partners with Toto and Yuyu.!~

characters.name: Hidaka
characters.description: A scientist who researches the, "Shards of Mimi," at FlipFlap, and created the TT-392 and other inventions. Hidaka is technical and excitable, especially when it comes to his work. He gives Cocona info about Pure Illusion from time to time; but, due to his excitability and technicality, often leads to it going over her head.

characters.name: Salt
characters.description: An unreadable man who is collecting the "Shards of Mimi," along with being the leader of FlipFlap. Salt is cold and almost always serious. Despite that, he does care about what happens to FlipFlap's employees. ~!Prior to leading FlipFlap, he was good friends with Papikana and Mimi; along with having a caring personality.!~ ~!Salt is Cocona's biological father.!~

characters.name: Toto
characters.description: An elementary school student and Yuyu's older twin brother. Toto, along with Yuyu, work under Asclepius to get amorphous fragments. Like his sister, he is calm and collected, even in dire situations. Furthermore, he speaks with little to no emotion. While in Pure Illusion, he uses a device that fires a barrage of missiles. ~!Toto, along with Yuyu, was created by Asclepius; thus making them the first two amorphous children.!~

characters.name: Sayuri
characters.description: An operator that works for FlipFlap who, unlike Hidaka, is always worried about inventions.

characters.name: TT-392
characters.description: A robot seemingly created by Hidaka. It has various functions and is often used by Papika. TT-392 is often beaten up, be it by friend or foe, but is always fixed. Contained in its body is a brain, which gives TT-392 its traits. ~!TT-392 is able to transform into a more muscular form.!~

characters.name: Uexküll
characters.description: Cocona's pet. It can grow and shrink and show various facial expressions. It likes small spaces. Its name is a reference to the German biologist Jakob von Uexküll. While in Pure Illusion, it has a human-like appearance.

characters.name: Iroha Irodori
characters.description: A third-year at Cocona's school, and a member of the art club. Iroha paints many great art pieces, which Cocona sometimes is in awe of. She also believes that she doesn't deserve to wear nail polish, due to her past. ~!When Iroha was a kid, her parents were always fighting, so she'd visit her grandma's place often. During that time, she made a promise with her grandma, which she failed to keep, leading her to regret it. After Papika and Cocona keep up on the promise in Pure Illusion, Iroha's personality changes and she begins to wear nail polish.!~

characters.name: Nyunyu
characters.description: The third amorphous child who replaces Yayaka. Unlike Toto and Yuyu, Nyunyu is lively and expresses many emotions. She gets along with TT-392, though she has wrecked it once. ~!Nyunyu quickly changes sides from Asclepius to Flip Flap, and continues to hang out with the crew.!~

title: GIRLS BAND CRY
title_original: ガールズバンドクライ
description: Feeling out of place in the countryside, high school dropout Nina Iseri moves to Tokyo. After a rough first day and getting locked out of her apartment, she meets her favorite guitarist, Momoka Kawaragi. The two put on a street performance together and decide to start a band with three other girls. While each girl faces her own struggles, their passion for music keeps their dreams alive. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Nina Iseri
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm An ordinary girl who is a little shy. She attended school, but kept a low profile and had average grades. She didn't have any big dreams and lived her life going with the flow.

characters.name: Momoka Kawaragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm A young street musician. She is easy-going and firm. She does not like to dress typically feminine and chooses to keep her hair down, and keep her clothes plain. She is bright and caring and has the feeling of an reliable senior at an athletic club.

characters.name: Subaru Awa
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A girl who attends an entertainment school. She's appeared in commercials and has a promising future ahead of her. She is a beautiful girl who could become a model, and is good at socialising and is very graceful. But, inside she is actually strong-willed and competitive.

characters.name: Tomo Ebizuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm Originally, she was a young lady from a wealthy family that was famous in their local area. However, she currently lives in a shared apartment. Her view on the world is cold and oblique. Like a hedgehog, she is very cautious and does not open up much.

characters.name: Rupa
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm A slightly tanned girl who has a South Asian father and a Japanese mother. She has an artistic sense, and a clear-headed mind. She is a so-called genius that everyone respects for her gentle and modest demeanor. Her only flaws is that she is a heavy drinker, and gets tunnel vision when she has a goal in mind.

characters.name: Ai
characters.description: The drummer of Diamond Dust who uses a Natural Cherry Pearl Masters Maple drum kit.

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: She is the lead guitarist of Diamond Dust who uses a Deep Candy Apple Red ESP Horizon-I electric guitar.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: The bassist of Diamond Dust who uses a Caribbean Shoreline Flat Ibanez Premium SR1605B bass.

characters.name: Hina
characters.description: The vocalist and rhythm guitarist of Diamond Dust after Momoka's departure, and a former friend of Nina. She uses a See-Through Purple Fernandes NTG-LTD electric guitar.

characters.name: Mueno Iseri
characters.description: [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/306614/Nina-Iseri)'s father and a well-known education advisor. They conflicted over Nina's school issues but he allowed her to quit school and move away from home.

characters.name: Kyouko
characters.description: A Street Performer

characters.name: Suzune Iseri
characters.description: [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/306614/Nina-Iseri)'s older sister who occasionally checks in on her.

title: Gakuen Mokushiroku: HIGHSCHOOL OF THE DEAD - Drifters of the Dead
title_original: 学園黙示録HIGHSCHOOL OF THE DEAD ドリフターズ・オブ・ザ・デッド
title_en: High School of the Dead: Drifters of the Dead
description: When an unplanned stop on a deserted island gives Takashi, Saeko and the rest of the ragged band of survivors a chance to expose themselves to something other than zombie bites for a change, they're more than ready to take a break and let their hair down. Discovering the remnants of an old beach store, the entire group strips to swimsuits and sets out to make the uninhabited island inhabitable, but they're unaware that this seeming paradise is actually just the dead calm before the storm. Because sometimes the recently deceased aren't the only problems that can lie buried in the sand, and as the swimwear comes off and the inhibitions come down, a kink in the island's food chain sets a truly shocking series of events into motion! You won't believe what comes out next, but suffice it to say that the deserted island may not be so deserted after all! (Source: Sentai Filmworks) Note: An unaired episode bundled with the seventh volume of the manga.

characters.name: Takashi Komuro
characters.description: A sophomore high school student, Takashi is in the same class as Rei whom he has been friends with since childhood,He's loved her ever since she made a childhood promise to marry him when they were older. However it was his hesitance and ignorance about her feelings that caused tension in their friendship which led to her starting to date his friend Hisashi. He was one of the first people to notice that something was wrong in the school and quickly took action to escape with his friends. His relationship with Rei was shaken further when he was forced to kill her boyfriend after he was bitten and had turned into a zombie. Soon afterwards their relationship was amended. His resolve to protect Rei at all costs and everyone else in the group earned him their respect and admiration as a leader despite his own feelings of inadequacy. He often acts brash and will go out to risk his life to save

characters.name: Rei Miyamoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm __Weight:__ 50 kg Classmate and childhood friend of Takashi, they've known each other since kindergarten. When they were little she promised that one day she would marry him. Despite liking Takashi, their relationship was at odds at the beginning of the manga due to his indecisiveness. It was then that she started dating one of his friends, Hisashi, since he wouldn't make a move. As the story progressed they ended up reconciling their relationship. She doesn't find it above herself to reprimand Takashi for acting carelessly. She worries about his well-being yet admits that his selflessness nature is one reason why she fell in love with him. Headstrong and reliable, Rei has proven to be a skilled combatant and strong asset to the group. Initially in the same year as Saeko, Rei was held back despite being an excellent student. Her father- a police detective- had been inv

characters.name: Saeko Busujima
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm A high school senior and president of the school's kendo club, she is extremely skilled with a bokken and close combat. Calm and collected with a sense of pride in her skills and those that she's with, Saeko is among the most reliable of the group. Everyone can count on her combat skills to pull them through a tough spot if need be. Not much is known about her family except for her father who had traveled abroad on a self-defense conference before the advent of the Outbreak. She has shown fondness towards Takashi and believes in his abilities to get them through the crisis. ~!Four years prior to the start of the story, a man had attempted to assault her. Armed with her bokken, she easily disposed of the would-be assailant, breaking several of his bones before the police came. This experience revealed her sadistic tendencies; she enjoyed holding the power to inflict pai

characters.name: Saya Takagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm __Weight:__ 52 kg First making her escape with fellow classmate Kohta Hirano, she is the daughter of an influential Uyoku dantai politician and her family is deeply involved in Japan's politics. A self-proclaimed genius, Saya's knowledge, and deductive capabilities have allowed the group to escape from harm. She was among the first to conclude that "they" were attracted to only sound. Despite coming from a prestigious family she despises her parents whom she thought had given up on her in this crisis. It was before their escape from the mansion that she managed to make up with her parents. Other than Rei, she is the only one who has a history with Takashi Komuro since they were children and is assumed to having deeper feelings for him. Slightly self-conscious, she detests the fact that people neither address her by her first name nor look her in the eyes while speaking

characters.name: Kouta Hirano
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Weight:__ 88.8 kg A 16-year-old sophomore student who was often bullied in school, Kouta is a gun otaku and knows the ins and outs of the firearms and any military-related equipment that the group may come​ across. At the beginning of the story he helped Saya Takagi escape danger, though only did so by following her orders. His skills as a marksman have proven to be a valuable asset to keeping everyone alive. On a one-month trip to America he was trained by the US military contractor Blackwater USA which furthered his obsession over weapons. His crush on Saya is one-sided as he on occasion tries to ask her out only to be rejected. Before leaving the family mansion of Saya, her father entrusted her safety to him and Takashi. Saya Takagi has once mentioned that he and Takashi are the most likely to snap if things keep going the way they are. He's grown very attached to

characters.name: Shizuka Marikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm The school nurse at Fujimi High School, she is rather ditsy as compared to the rest of the girls in the group. Her large bust size is often used as a comical element in the story. A 26-year-old bachelorette, she lives with Rika Minami, a sniper of Japan's Special Assault Team. Her home was used as a safe haven for the group once they escaped high school. As a nurse, she is responsible for the health and care of everyone in the group and is efficient at doing so. Despite being the only adult in the group, she is emotionally fragile and doesn't know what will become of her life since the Outbreak started. Like the rest of the main characters, Shizuka worries that she will never see her family or friends again.

characters.name: Alice Maresato
characters.description: Only 7 years old she was saved from being attacked by several undead by Takashi after her father was killed by members of a household who wouldn't allow them safety. Innocent and passive, Alice is the only member of the group that maintains a cheerful attitude despite all their troubles and the loss of her parents. Looking up to everyone in the group as a bigger brother and sister, she is unwilling to leave them even if it's for her own safety. Alice is often seen playing around with a small dog named Zeke whom they had picked up while saving Alice, and Kohta who she has grown fairly attached too. Presiding over her as a mother figure is Saya whom she has also grown attached too. Later in the series, Alice often aids Kouta by handing him magazines for his firearm while the group is under attack. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Zeke
characters.description: Zeke is a puppy with white coat and black ear flaps that Komuro's group took in as a member. He also wears a red dog collar with a bone ornament that hangs at its front.

title: Machikado Mazoku
description: When Yuuko Yoshida wakes up one morning to discover that she’s sprouted horns and a tail, she learns something that her mother has been meaning to tell her. You know that battle between the Light and Dark that’s been going on since the dawn of time? Well, Yuuko’s family are the bad guys. So now, Yuuko has to defeat a local magical girl to win back some of her family’s vanquished power so they can afford to go to the all-you-can-eat pancake restaurant. And, of course, it turns out that the Magical Girl goes to Yuuko’s school, but Momo’s really nice and keeps rescuing Yuuko, which is pretty embarrassing and leaves Yuuko rather conflicted… but… all you can eat pancakes? (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Momo Chiyoda
characters.description: **Momo Chiyoda** is the magical girl who is protecting the town of Seiiki Sakuraga-oka. As a magical girl, she is a maniac of muscle training, and her physical power overwhelmingly surpasses that of her rival [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461), the succubus in town. Her magical girl career is mysterious, including rumors that she had once saved the world.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshida
characters.description: Yuuko Yoshida is a demon whose power is suddenly awakened in her first year of high school; aims to overthrow the magical girl in town to break her family's spell. However, although she has the ability to sneak into others' dreams, her physical strength and stamina are much weaker than the ones of her rival, the magical girl [Momo Chiyoda](https://anilist.co/character/141457).

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

characters.name: Mikan Hinatsuki
characters.description: **Mikan Hinatsuki** is a Magical Girl who arrives in town to support [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/141457). She suffers from a curse that brings misfortune to those close to her whenever she gets overly excited or anxious.

characters.name: Seiko Yoshida
characters.description: **Seiko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461) and [Ryouko](https://anilist.co/character/141462/Ryouko-Yoshida)'s mother.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: **Lilith** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s demon ancestor. She appears in her dreams one night and gives her demon powers, and tasks her on defeating a magical girl.

characters.name: Ryouko Yoshida
characters.description: **Ryouko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s younger sister. Ryouko's dream is to support her sister in becoming a fearsome demon.

characters.name: Anri Sata
characters.description: **Anri Sata** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Shion Ogura
characters.description: Shion Ogura is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Metako
characters.description: Momo Chiyoda's "navigator", one of many familiars that provides guidance to magical girls of the Light Clan. This guidance is usually in the form of spoken oracle, however, due to his old age and Momo's lack of motivation for her magical girl activities he acts like a normal cat 97% of the time while occasionally saying the phrase "The time hath come". Has an affinity for Yuuko's demon tail.

characters.name: Barking Dog
characters.description: [Inu wo Motsu Onna](https://anilist.co/character/287308/Inu-wo-Motsu-Onna)'s dog

title: Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita!
title_original: 私に天使が舞い降りた！
title_en: WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me
description: Miyako is a shy college student who is also an otaku. One day she happens to meet some angelic grade school kids! When Miyako sees her little sister's new friend Hana-chan, Miyako's heart won't stop racing! Miyako tries to get along with them but struggles... A sketch comedy all about trying to get along with the super cute girl is about to begin! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Miyako Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A college student who is shy around strangers and spends most of her time indoors. She becomes smitten by [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and starts making her snacks in exchange for getting her to dress up in cosplay outfits she makes.

characters.name: Hana Shirosaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 142.3 cm (4'8") An elementary school student who is classmates with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477). She is often disturbed by [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s behavior but puts up with it in order to eat her snacks.

characters.name: Hinata Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 140.7 cm [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s younger sister and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s classmate. She is particularly fond of her sister, who she nicknames "Mya-nee".

characters.name: Noa Himesaka
characters.description: __Height__: 142.7 cm (4'8") [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477)'s classmate who moves next door to [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and Hinata. She constantly sees herself as cute, often becoming downhearted when someone else (usually Hana) is said to be cuter.

characters.name: Koyori Tanemura
characters.description: __Height__: 138.6 cm (4'6") A class representative in Hana's class. She aspires to be someone that everyone can rely on, but is often unreliable herself.

characters.name: Kanon Konomori
characters.description: __Height:__ 141 cm (4'7") Another class representative in [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s class and [Koyori](https://anilist.co/character/131478)'s best friend. She is kind and often seen as very reliable, much to Koyori's chagrin.

characters.name: Kouko Matsumoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 164.8 cm (5'4") A girl who was in a club with [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) during high school. While Miyako hardly remembers her, she has been obsessively fixated on her, acting like a stalker.

characters.name: Chizuru Hoshino
characters.description: Miyako and Hinata's mother.

characters.name: Emily Himesaka
characters.description: Noa Himesaka's mother.

characters.name: Yuuna Matsumoto
characters.description: Yuuna is [Kouko Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/136814)'s little sister who appears for the first time when [Miyako Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and [Hinata Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131477) go outside to go shop.

characters.name: Yamanaka-sensei
characters.description: The homeroom teacher of Class 5-3, which Hinata, Hana, Noa, Kanon, and Koyori are all in.

characters.name: Haruka Shirosaki
characters.description: Hana Shirosaki's mother.

title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
description: A tale of otherworldly beauty and celestial secrets unfolds in this new take on Japan’s oldest folktale. Inspired by The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, the film reimagines Japan’s oldest folktale with a modern touch by integrating music, fantasy, and contemporary animation. Set in the virtual realm of Tsukuyomi, the story unfolds as a live performance marrying original music with Yamashita’s signature style of polished visuals, emotive pacing, and dynamic 3D camerawork to boldly transform this classic tale for a new generation. (Source: Netflix, edited)

characters.name: Kaguya
characters.description: A mysterious girl from the Moon. Looking for fun, she decided to become a livestreamer in Tsukuyomi. She's energetic, outrageous and loves [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/378972/Sakayori-Iroha).

characters.name: Iroha Sakayori
characters.description: A 17-year-old high school girl. A model student who excelles in both academics and sports. She works hard to pay her living expenses and tutition fees. She's a fan of [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/378973/Runami-Yachiyo), Tsukuyomi's top livestreamer. She's also a talented musician, but doesn't compose anymore.

characters.name: Yachiyo Runami
characters.description: The top livestreamer of the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." A mysterious 8,000-year-old (allegedly) AI who can sing, dance, and even create clones.

characters.name: FUSHI
characters.description: A fluffy sea slug who serves as Yachiyo's companion and guides the girls through Tsukuyomi. For some reason, it views Kaguya and the Inudoge as enemies.

characters.name: Inudoge
characters.description: Kaguya's companion. It follows her all around Tsukuyomi.

characters.name: Akira Mikado
characters.description: Leader of Black Onyx. He is a talented and charismatic player, as well as a self-described "egotistical character". He enjoys flashy performances and gives it his all when it comes to entertaining the audience.

characters.name: Rai Komazawa
characters.description: A member of Black Onyx and Noi's older brother. He is calm and doesn't speak much, but has good rhythm and is good at singing.

characters.name: Noi Komazawa
characters.description: A member of Black Onyx and Rai's younger brother. He enjoyes wearing cute clothes on his avatar. He's usually quite lazy, but when motivated, he provides good fanservice.

characters.name: Mami Isayama
characters.description: Iroha's friend and a food influencer. She's a fan of Akira Mikado. She's a reliable person who likes to eat at her own pace.

characters.name: Roka Ayatsumugi
characters.description: Iroha's friend and beauty influencer. She cares for Iroha, since she pretends everything's fine even when she's tired. She is a striking beauty and has a delicate personality.

characters.name: Koto Okkoteru
characters.description: A Tsukuyomi livestreamer. Utulizing his exceptional speaking skills and background as a former professional gamer, he provides live commentary for all events within Tsukuyomi.

characters.name: Otakou Chuuken
characters.description: A Tsukuyomi liverstreamer. She hosts the show "News Tsukuyomi!!" where she discusses the latest topics of the virtual world.

title: Shiroi Suna no Aquatope
title_original: 白い砂のアクアトープ
description: Kukuru Misakino is a 18-year-old girl who works at an aquarium and she encounters a former idol who lost her place in Tokyo and escaped to Okinawa named Fuuka Miyazawa. Kukuru and Fuuka spend their days at the aquarium, their hearts filled with their own passions. But their precious place is about to be shut down forever. The girls face their dreams and reality, loneliness and friendships, bonds and conflicts... This summer is about to turn a glimmering, new page. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Kukuru Misakino
characters.description: Kukuru is a high school student acting as the director of a small "Gamagama Aquarium" in Okinawa. She has a direct and cheerful personality. Having a stronger attachment to the aquarium than anyone else, Kukuru has a professional side where she is willing to speak harshly when living creatures are involved. She is ignorant of fashion. Kukuru is struggling to revitalize the "Gamagama Aquarium," which is on the verge of closing.

characters.name: Fuuka Miyazawa
characters.description: Fuuka is a former idol. She gave up her dream and left for Okinawa on her way back to her hometown. There, she met Kukuru. Fuuka is a serious and hard worker. She is also sensitive to the feelings of others.

characters.name: Tsukimi Teruya
characters.description: Tsukimi is Kukuru's classmate and has been her friend since elementary school. She is a sweet girl who helps out at her mother's restaurant Kame. Her friends frequently gather at her shop and her nickname is "Udon-chan." She has a nice and easygoing personality, but she also takes good care of others and is loved by everyone.

characters.name: Karin Kudaka
characters.description: Karin is a civil servant working for a tourist association in her town. She is a reliable older sister figure who helps with the aquarium. She is an "older friend" to Kukuru and the others.

characters.name: Ojii
characters.description: [Kukuru's](https://anilist.co/character/204495/Kukuru-Misakino) grandfather, the head of the Gama Gama Aquarium. He entrusts the day-to-day business of the aquarium to Kukuru during summer vacation, as he goes around on important business for the aquarium. He has a bright and kind personality. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kuuya Yakamashi
characters.description: A staff member at Gama Gama Aquarium. He speaks frankly, and looks lazy, but is very serious at his job. He is not good at talking to girls in his age group, and often avoids making eye contact with them. With the aquarium as short handed as it is, he runs long shifts that tire him out. He is quite fond of the umeshu that [Kukuru's](https://anilist.co/character/204495/Kukuru-Misakino) grandmother makes. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kai Nakamura
characters.description: [Kukuru's](https://anilist.co/character/204495/Kukuru-Misakino) classmate and childhood friend. He helps his fisherman father, boarding a boat with him before sunrise, and giving his catch of the day to the Misakino family. He is a longtime confidante of Kukuru, and has volunteered to work at the Gama Gama Aquarium during the summer. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Takeshita
characters.description: A veterinarian.

characters.name: Obaa
characters.description: Kukuru's grandmother.

characters.name: Eri Miyazawa
characters.description: Fuuka's mother.

characters.name: Satsuki Teruya
characters.description: Tsukimi's mother. A fortune teller.

title: Seikon no Qwaser
description: When Mafuyu Oribe and her adopted sister Tomo rescue a strange wounded man, they have no idea what they're getting involved with or what the consequences will be. Alexander Nikolaevith Hell is an Iron Qwaser, one of many opposing factions of super-warriors who can each draw upon the power of an element and wield it as an almost unstoppable array of weapons. And unfortunately for Mafuyu, Alexander's faction is there to gather the mystical relics known collectively as the High Circuit, which puts her friends, family and school at ground zero in a battle for the fate of all mankind! But there's an even more disturbing twist, as Qwasers require a special liquid diet to manifest their powers, one provided by the women who serve as a Qwaser's partner. And THAT means that the nursing Mafuyu's already given Alexander isn't the only kind of nursing he needs! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Mafuyu Oribe
characters.description: Mafuyu is the adopted daughter of St. Mihailov's last dean, and the self-appointed protector of Tomo Yamanobe. Upbeat and cheerful, she is so proficient in kendo that she carries a wooden sword with her all the time. She has to endure hardship on a daily basis in form of her classmates picking harshly on her and especially Tomo. This changes when she encounters Sasha for the first time, where she starts living with him and, little by little, is pitted herself in the fights between Qwasers. Though at odds with Sasha's coldness, Mafuyu has started to open up to him and the two have formed a stronger bond.

characters.name: Tomo Yamanobe
characters.description: Daughter of St. Mihailov's last dean and currently best friend and roommate of Mafuyu, Tomo is her opposite, both physically and mentally: she's very childish, sweet, and naïve, and while having the largest bust of the whole female cast, she's physically weak, and always gets bullied by her classmates. Tomo is the spitting image of Sasha's original protector, Olja, which explains why he took so willingly the role of Tomo's guardian, much to Mafuyu's chagrin. ~!Also, sometimes an upside down Eastern Cross (with its third slab being a scar), the symbol of the Adepts, appears between her breasts. This is later revealed to be the presence of the Qwaser of Gold, which apparently inhabits Tomo's body and, as itself stated, is slowly draining her of her life, which is why she has to replenish herself through Teresa's Soma.!~

characters.name: Teresa Beria
characters.description: A Serbian Orthodox nun that serves at St. Mihailov in a variety of ordinary chores, such as taking care of children in the school's kindergarten or tending to flowers, she is notable in that, for most of the beginning of the series, she never shows any form of emotion, reacting with fright only when Mafuyu was about to close a door on her. This is explained when her past is revealed: as a child she was part of a Serbian Orthodox convent in Krajina, during the Yugoslav Wars, a jovial and hyperactive girl until the day a group of Croatian militiamen, led by "Gas Chamber" Croa, assaulted the convent and pillaged it, slaughtering and raping its occupants in a bloody carnage. The sole survivor, Teresa assisted at the whole massacre from inside a closet, and when found, she was so shocked that her emotions were locked away by the trauma. Only when Sasha gave her his support and

characters.name: Alexander Nikolaevich Hell
characters.original: アレクサンドル ニコラエビッチ ヘル
characters.description: Alexander is a young Qwaser of Russian origin who controls the element of Iron, with which he can manipulate the said element on a molecular level, thus being capable not only to morph it in any form he wishes, but also create extreme heat or cold. He was held captive and trained with the other Qwasers into harnessing his powers, and survived the brutal ordeal thanks to the affection received from an older girl named Olja, and whose murder by the Qwaser of Gold he witnessed. He received a large scar on the left side of his face from the same Qwaser. The scar is shaped like an Eastern Cross, and tends to bleed heavily when he draws upon his powers. Sasha appeared out of nowhere on the grounds of St. Mihailov, and was quickly accepted into the school as a student of class 1-A, the same that [Mafuyu Oribe](https://anilist.co/character/21339/Oribe-Mafuyu) and [Tomo Yamanobe](https://anilist.

characters.name: Hana Katsuragi
characters.description: A student of class 1-A, she acts as an enforcer on school grounds, but also she is the main architect of the physical abuses that Mafuyu and Tomo have to endure every day, such as regularly throwing the class' garbage can on them or forcing them to fill it after "casually" tripping on it, to covering Tomo's desk with writings and trash. Being the right hand of Miyuri, she welcomes Ekaterina Kurae when she arrives in Japan, and it's here that her apparent fondness for lolicon is discovered, as she becomes extremely embarrassed in Ekaterina's presence and, while the latter fakes to fade out, she kisses her out of lust. These events let her become the unwilling slave of her new mistress, subject to humiliaton and erotic torment on a daily basis (which, on a side note, made her very proficient in S&M, such as making extremely complex nodes with little effort). She appears to have some ma

characters.name: Ekaterina Kurae
characters.description: A little Russian girl, no more than ten years old and with the beauty of a doll, she arrives in Japan shortly after the beginning of the war of the Qwasers. While she is presented as extremely shy and child-like, befitting her age (she has a habit of addressing herself in third person in these instances), her true colors depicts her as a domineering, arrogant, prideful and almost malicious queen, all maintaining a facade of childish innocence. She is a powerful Qwaser who wields the element of copper, which usually makes her gain control and manipulate electrical wires and redirect their flow to electrocute and incinerate her foes. She does not fight herself due to her frailty as a little girl, and this is why she is always guarded by a grim, archaic gynoid dressed in regal attire named Anastasia, which Ekaterina calls mother for reason currently unknown. She currently attends at St. Mih

characters.name: Miyuri Tsujidou
characters.description: The daughter of the current dean at St. Mihailov Academy, who succeeded Tomo's father. While beautiful and well-endowed, Miyuri is extremely bossy, arrogant and prideful, making nothing to conceal her disrespect for Tomo and Mafuyu and to bully them on a daily basis, supported by Hana. Greatly humiliated by Sasha, who correctly defines her as a leecher of others' powers, she "takes revenge" by welcoming and taking care of Ekaterina Kurae, the Qwaser of Copper. It can be noted that Miyuri is very rich and appears to have a sheltered upbringing, based on her drowning Ekaterina with expensive gifts. However, being treated as a fool after Sasha's arrival made her somewhat of a comic relief character. On a positive note, it can be assumed that she truly cares even for those she bullies, as she stripped naked for a group of terrorists so as to spare the same ordeal to Ekaterina, Mafuyu and the

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.description: Known as Lizzie for short, she is the disciple of Shin'ichiro Ootori and a Qwaser on her own, who wields the element of titanium, which she uses in battle in form of an enormous greatsword named Excalibur, whose high-frequency blade can produce massive shockwaves and slice through almost anything. She is quite attached to Mafuyu. Although very strong as a Qwaser, she is quite brash and childish when not fighting, though she is also very responsible and reliable and, most of all, completely loyal to her master. This loyalty prompts her to aid Shin'ichiro in kidnapping Tomo, by fighting Sasha so as to repel his attempted rescue, where she is defeated but spared. (From Wikipedia)

characters.name: Ayana Minase
characters.description: A bespectacled classmate of Tomo and Mafuyu, Ayana appears to be one of the only students of class 1-A willing to take their side despite them being bullied or ignored while mistreated. Though she appears to be gentle and weak, she is in fact the very first Adept to appear in the series: her true identity is that of a Qwaser, and she wields control over the element of magnesium, which she usually shapes in razor-sharp chakrams that she throws and controls in both trajectory and shape, being also capable of igniting them with fire. Revealing her friendship with Tomo and Mafuyu to be mere acting, she confronts Sasha three times, being killed during their third battle after failing to kidnap and held Tomo as a hostage. As a clone without will, she is later summoned to fight against Shin'ichiro Ootori. (From Wikipedia)

characters.name: Croa
characters.description: Known as Gas Chamber, he is a tall, wicked-looking member of the Adepts, and as a Qwaser he wields the element of chlorine, with which he can create noxious and lethal gases or, in conjunction with water, generate hydrochloric acid. He was the one responsible of the massacre that left Teresa as the sole survivor, and years later appeared again at St. Mihaiolv, ordered to complete an "ethnic cleansing" of its inhabitants, namely Sasha, Teresa, Mafuyu, and Tomo. He himself is a psychotic assassin, bent on spreading atrocities such as rape and slaughter in the name of extermination, as he did during the massacres of the Yugoslav Wars.

characters.name: Eva Silver
characters.description: The Qwaser in control of the element mercury, known as the Witch of Living Silver, appeared as a fake teacher at a lesson of class 1-A, ~!where she trapped the students thanks to her powers and then had Fumika Mitarai humiliated in front of her classmates, so as to "punish" her and them all for their bullying or indifference to Mafuyu and Tomo being bullied. Initially killed and burned alive by Sasha, she managed to survive, altought greatly disfigured, and recover herself by patching her torn body with those of her clones, Q and R. She later kidnapped Mafuyu so as to have another confrontation with Sasha, in which Ekaterina intervened as well, pointing out that "Eva Silver" is a mere nickname, and that this Qwaser's real identity was that of Eva Braun, wife-lover of Adolf Hitler. She herself states that being alive and young after so much time is thanks to cloning herself and using her

characters.name: Joshua Phrygianos
characters.original: ジョシュア＝フリギアノス
characters.description: A member of the Adepts, and a true rarity among them in that he is neither brutal nor prone to mass murder. As a Qwaser he is unlucky at best, as his element, roentgenium, is completely useless in combat due to its unbelievable short time activation of 3.5 microseconds, this caused his peers to pick and mistreat him due to his weakness. ~!He is the eldest of five siblings and apparently lives in poverty. Initially described as a maniac who threatened girls, he tried to abduct Tomo and ended up helping her and cooking for her, but also tried to steal her Soma. However, he was overcome by guilt and shame, choosing to leave the Adepts behind him and living with his dear siblings. As for now, he is the only Qwaser of the Adept who didn't die at the hands of Sasha, even though the two of them met.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai
title_original: 夜のクラゲは泳げない
title_en: Jellyfish Can’t Swim in the Night
description: "I want to find what I enjoy." Shibuya is a city full of identity. It is here on Shibuya’s late night streets that illustrator Mahiru Kozuki, former idol Kano Yamanouchi, Vtuber Kiui Watase and composer Mei Kim Anouk Takanashi — four young women who are slightly outside the world — join together and form an anonymous artist group called JELEE. “I” also want to shine like someone else. If it's not me but “we” then we might be able to shine. (Source: Crunchyroll News, HIDIVE, edited)

characters.name: Mahiru Kouzuki
characters.description: Mahiru is a typical high school girl who follows the philosophy of "nothing matters." Despite being sensitive, she often gets upset over small things, although she truly cares about others. When she was young, Mahiru used to draw illustrations under the pseudonym "Kurage Yoru." However, something happened that made her stop for a while. Now, she struggles with feeling different and tries to blend in with everyone else. But then, she meets Kano, and everything changes. Kano helps her see that it's okay to be unique, and Mahiru's life starts to feel special again.

characters.name: Kano Yamanouchi
characters.description: Meet Kano, a former idol who is determined to achieve her dreams! She's a strong-willed individual who knows what she wants and isn't easily swayed by others. Kano used to be part of the "Sunflower Dolls" idol group, where she performed as "Nonoka Tachibana." However, she decided to leave the group after a controversy and embarked on a journey to discover her true calling. During her journey, Kano meets Yoru Umitsuki, an artist who creates a beautiful jellyfish mural that inspires her to look at life in a new way. This encounter becomes a turning point for Kano as she redefines her values and explores new possibilities in her own unique way.

characters.name: Kiui Watase
characters.description: Kiui and Mahiru have been friends since childhood. Operating under the persona of the Vtuber "Nox Ryugasaki," Kiui consistently promotes their belief in being the strongest individual. Kiui is adept at swiftly mastering any task, and all the skills they display as a Vtuber are their own. However, these differences have led to them feeling somewhat out of place among peers. Mahiru is the only person with whom Kiui feels comfortable discussing the past without reservation, and is always willing to help dear friends.

characters.name: Mei Takanashi
characters.original: 高梨・キム・アヌーク・めい
characters.description: Mei attends a high school affiliated with the conservatory. She started her musical education at a young age and has earned numerous awards in competitions, demonstrating her exceptional talent. Despite her mixed German heritage, Mei's reserved demeanor and appearance often lead her to spend time alone, keeping her distance from others. However, by chance, she became a dedicated fan of Nonoka Tachibana and followed her activities passionately until the end. Feeling adrift after her favorite idol retired, Mei starts to feel a mix of emotions when she encounters Kano, who is being true to herself.

characters.name: Miiko
characters.description: An idol who claims to be forever 17 and the strongest in the galaxy. She has been active for a long time and is always full of motivation and perseverance. ~!In actuality, she is 31-years-old and mother to [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/332268/).!~

title: Akuma no Riddle
description: The story is set at Myoujou Academy, a private girls' boarding school. The 10th year's Kurogumi class has 12 assassins with their sights on one target, Haru Ichinose. Tokaku Azuma is a recent transfer student who is also targeting Ichinose, but she gradually develops feelings for Ichinose. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Haru Ichinose
characters.description: __Height:__ 159cm (5'2") Haru is shown to be a bright and cheerful girl of Black Class. As claimed by Tokaku, Haru poses a naive character and trusts anyone without a single thought. She is shown to have a highly optimistic attitude, which is sometimes bothersome for Tokaku since she is not used to friendliness. All in all, Haru's rival classmates appreciate her gullible nature; deeming her as an easy target. She is very forgiving and doesn't mind anyone for bearing any kind of grudge towards her as seen when she still talks in a caring and friendly manner towards every other girl who loses their purpose after chasing her with killing intents. ~!Like the other women of her clan, Haru possesses the "Queen Bee" power of manipulating others to protect her and let her live the position of highest hierarchy; making others be simply a "worker bee". Haru inhibits and implies this power without

characters.name: Tokaku Azuma
characters.description: __Birthday:__ March 3 __Height:__ 170cm (5'6") Tokaku is a distant and cold girl. Even at first glance, she has the appearance of an assassin.She eventually grows to care for Haru in time, even coming to the point of calling herself Haru's protector. Azuma dislikes it when other people try to get close to her, and she especially hates being called by her first name, but Haru compromises and calls her "Tokaku-san". She is skilled with using knives, and has exceptionally quick reflexes. It is soon revealed that Azuma has never killed anyone before, despite possessing very useful skills as an assassin. Her family is a well known family of assassins. They say that the east's Azuma and the west's Kuzunoha are two assassination clans that existed in the country since ancient times. The Kuzunoha was the main branch and the Azuma is a branch family. However, interactions between these two clans

characters.name: Mahiru Banba
characters.description: A rather shy and mysterious-looking young woman who's a former assassin who's developed a second personality at some point in her past named Shin'ya Banba who's a quite more rude and violent personality than the actual Mahiru. Both are like two souls who share the same body, thus both never appear at the same moment throughout the plot, yet both are able to communicate with each other to a certain degree. Mahiru is a shy and timid girl who often has trouble speaking for herself. She is easily subject to bullying, and is often defenseless. However, when the sun sets, Mahiru's alternate personality, Shin'ya Banba, appears. Shin'ya is the complete opposite of Mahiru, and refers to herself (or even himself) as "ore (俺)", a masculine term. In contrast to her host personality, Shin'ya has an aggressive and borderline insane appearance cultivated to protect Mahiru. Shin'ya is able to enter a te

characters.name: Sumireko Hanabusa
