characters.description: Sumireko is a high class, polite girl. She's considerably warmer to people than [Tokaku](https://anilist.co/character/86241/Azuma-Tokaku) is, but she's hinted to be one of the more dangerous members of Class Black.

characters.name: Nio Hashiri
characters.description: Hashiri Nio is an energetic and upbeat girl with a knack for peeping into other people's businesses. Despite being a part of the Black Class group, she is also affiliated with the academy in some way.

characters.name: Isuke Inukai
characters.description: Isuke is a truly sadistic girl who is always shown to be with clothing that show her stomach. She is also very blunt and quick to express her opinion, and likes to command other people, such as making [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/88212/Sagae-Haruki) call her "Isuke-sama". Isuke's family includes her gay parents, who aren't related to her by blood at all.

characters.name: Kouko Kaminaga
characters.description: A girl with glasses who insists of being the 'rep' of everything, such as Black Class' class representative. She is shown to use grenades as a weapon.

characters.name: Shiena Kenmochi
characters.description: Shiena seems to have a normal personality compared to the rest of the members of Class Black. Although she is somewhat scatterbrained and forgetful, she is also strict at times, as shown when directing the play in Episode 5. She says she will do anything to protect the place she belongs to. Shiena is skilled at analysis, as seen when she is able to gather information about Hitsugi and Chitaru by simply watching them during rehearsals for the class play. She is also a skilled hacker as seen in the final episode where she successfully hacks into Myojo Academy's system. When she was younger she got bullied a lot. She had one friend whom she talked to on the phone called Yukarin, but one day she asked Shiena if she wanted revenge on the people who bullied her. Yukarin told Shiena about the group called Collective Dismissal and that they will give her her 'vengeance'. Shiena asks what they wa

characters.name: Hitsugi Kirigaya
characters.description: Kirigaya Hitsugi is a girl who has the body of an elementary school student. She has a bad sense of direction, as demonstrated when she gets lost on her way to Myoujou Academy. Although Hitsugi looks like the horribly unreliable type, she also has her reasons for being in the Black Group. She is also quite attached to Chitaru, as she is a nice and caring person.

characters.name: Ataru Mizorogi
characters.description: He is the homeroom teacher of Haru and Azuma for the Black Class. Ataru is a young and friendly teacher wanting his students to think of him as a big brother.

characters.name: Chitaru  Namatame
characters.description: Chitaru is a kind and caring girl who really looks out for others, especially those that appear to be heavily dependent (such as Hitsugi and Haru). She states early on that she has no plans to target Haru whatsoever. She appears to be quite attached to Hitsugi, but mainly in a motherly way.

title: Kill la Kill Tokubetsu-hen
title_original: キルラキル 特別編
description: Unaired episode included with the 9th Blu-ray and DVD volumes.

characters.name: Ryuuko Matoi
characters.description: She transfers into Honnouji Academy as a second-year student, an Academy ruled by power and authority. She wields a huge single-bladed scissor, and demands to know the owner of the other half. As she remembers, the wielder of the lost half of the scissor blade is the same person who killed her father. ~!Her body has been fused with life fibers, making her a "life fiber monster"!~ ~!She is the daughter of Kiryuuin Ragyou, making Kiryuuin Satsuki her older sister!~

characters.name: Satsuki Kiryuuin
characters.description: Satsuki Kiryuin is another main heroine of the anime, "Kill La Kill." She is an 18-year-old woman, and is the Student Council President of Honnouji Academy. She rules the school with an iron first, and assesses the students' abilities, holding the position/authority to draw out power surpassing that of humans. ~!She seems to have information regarding the death of Ryuko's father, putting the two at odds immediately after her arrival.!~ ~!She later states that she was the one to send Harime Nui to kill her father, however that was a lie, as the entire murder was orchestrated by Kiryuuin Ragyou and Harime Nui.!~ ~!After betraying her mother, she shares the same goal as Ryuuko Matoi.!~ ~!She is the sister of Ryuuko Matoi.!~

characters.name: Rei Hououmaru
characters.description: Rei is originally from Africa but her hometown was caught in a civil war. Ragyou saved her and gave her the name she has now, “Rei Hououmaru”. She now works as secretary for Kiryuuin Ragyou at Revocs Corporation.

characters.name: Senketsu
characters.description: A living sailor uniform [Ryuuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797/Matoi-Ryuuko) finds beneath her house. Senketsu is a Kamui (神衣 lit. "God Clothes"), an outfit that provides its wearer with godlike abilities in exchange for their blood. He has the power to transform into an indestructible suit of armor, albeit with a skimpy appearance, much to Ryūko's embarrassment. His name, given to him by Ryūko, literally means 'fresh blood'. ~!After defeating Kiryuuin Ragyou, while falling through the earth's stratosphere, Senketsu burns up protecting Ryuuko.!~

characters.name: Mako Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako is a second year student at Honnouji Academy. She is an uber air-head, so her unbelievable actions never cease to shock and awe the people around her. She strongly believes that she and [Ryuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797) are best of friends even though they have just met.

characters.name: Ira Gamagoori
characters.description: Gamagoori Ira is one of Four Kings. He is the Head of the Public Morals Committee. He sworn absolute loyalty to the [Student Council President](https://anilist.co/character/83799/Kiryuuin-Satsuki).

characters.name: Houka Inumuta
characters.description: Houka Inumuta is one of Four Kings, as he is the Student Council Secretary and Intelligence and Strategic Analyst. He always tries to use the least effort to achieve the greatest results. ~!After the events of episode 17, He and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach!~

characters.name: Nonon Jakuzure
characters.description: Nonon Jakuzure is one of the main characters in Kill la Kill and one of the Student Council's Elite Four. She regulates the school's non-athletic groups, such as the gardening and biology clubs. Nonon also runs the school's Rakugo Club, 100 Poems by 100 Poets Club and most likely the marching band. Nonon's Three-Star Goku Uniform resembles that of a drum majorette. Her baton is not just for show, as Nonon is a conductor as well. ~!After the events of episode 17, she and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach!~

characters.name: Matarou Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako's little brother. He acts as the leader of the local troublemakers who mostly loiters around the Honnouji Town cul-de-sac.

characters.name: Barazou Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako's father. He is the town’s unlicensed doctor. He's killed more patients than actually saved them.

characters.name: Sukuyo Mankanshoku
characters.description: Mako's carefree mother.

characters.name: Aikurou Mikisugi
characters.description: A mysterious male teacher who develops an interest in Ryuko soon after she arrives at Honnouji Academy. ~!He is secretly an operative of the terrorist organization Nudist Beach, working to prevent Satsuki Kiryuin's influence from spreading any further. He also knew Ryuko's father before he was murdered. Has a tendency to strip, as fitting with his organization's name.!~

title: Nekopara
description: In this world, cats aren't furry four-footed creatures, but human-like girls with ears, tails, and cat-like behaviors. Still kept as pets, they're allowed out on their own if they pass a special training and wear their bells. A young man running his own patisserie lives with two of these cats, Chocola and Vanilla, who help him out around the store. Maple and Cinnamon, two of the cats from home, also come in everyday, and together they enjoy a sweet life. Even if the cats don't always get along – and Azuki and Coconut certainly don't – things are peaceful and calm until a stray kitten follows Chocola home. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Chocola
characters.description: **Breed:** Black Cat Mix **Height:** 152 cm Chocola is a cheerful and energetic catgirl as [Kashou](https://anilist.co/character/130309/Minazuki-Kashou) himself describes her, 'happy-go-lucky.' She doesn't usually get upset, and even when she does, she often swings back to being as cheery as usual, though occasionally she can be genuinely sad about something. She is curious, and has a childlike outlook on things, which is fitting as she and [Vanilla](https://anilist.co/character/88788/Vanilla) are mentioned to be only 9 months old in human terms. She likes Kashou.

characters.name: Vanilla
characters.description: **Breed:** White Cat Mix **Height:** 149 cm Vanilla is quiet, calm and very stoic. She rarely expresses her emotions, making her a somewhat of a kuudere character, as opposed to her sister's energetic, playful personality. She loves her twin sister [Chocola](https://anilist.co/character/88787/Chocola), and will accompany her always due to her siscon-like relationship towards her.

characters.name: Azuki
characters.description: **Breed:** Munchkin **Height:** 142 cm The eldest catgirl of the Minazuki Family. She is quite full of energy, but can be rude and has a knack for bad mouthing her younger sisters, despite supposedly being the most grown up. Even so, she cares for her family and sometimes worries for their well-beings.

characters.name: Coconut
characters.description: **Breed:** Maine Coon **Height:** 168 cm Coconut is the second youngest of the Minazuki catgirls. The others typically consider her to be cool, but Coconut yearns to instead be considered cute and doesn't seem to have much confidence in her body. She has low self-esteem due to her clumsiness and self-proclaimed lack of skills.

characters.name: Maple
characters.description: **Breed:** American Curl **Height:** 157 cm Maple knows her table manners and is quite knowledgeable in technology. She can easily be said to be the most independent and "mature" of the Minazuki catgirls. However, her elegance could be considered by some to be grating, such as Azuki. The way she acts can be compared to a typical American teenage girl, only way more elegant and refined. Also, she's rude to customers because whenever she walked past them, she hears things and says her opinion out loud.

characters.name: Cinnamon
characters.description: **Breed:** Scottish Fold **Height:** 150 cm The third oldest catgirl in the Minazuki Familly. Cinnamon is typically shy and very cheerful. However, her somewhat active and perverted imagination causes her to interpret various everyday occurrences in a sexual manner and become aroused as a result. She seems rather shameless about this trait as she will do it in public or in front of customers of La Soleil.

characters.name: Shigure Minazuki
characters.description: **Height:** 135 cm The younger sister of Kashou Minazuki. She takes an almost mother-like pride in the catgirls she has trained. Despite her elegant demeanor, she has a gigantic brother complex which occasionally surfaces as love declarations for Kashou.

characters.name: Kashou Minazuki
characters.description: Kashou is very independent and knows how to take care of himself. Being focused on his self-sufficiency, he often isolates himself from others as much as he can. Kashou is quite serious at times and always looks at reality. He isn't very sociable with others due to his independent demeanor. He'll occasionally avoid any opportunities to start a conversation. Apart from that, he's very nice and takes care of Chocola and Vanilla like little sisters. As a descendant in a line of pastry chefs, Kashou likes to take pride in his cooking skills. He takes in a hobby of trying out new cooking methods to create the most delicious dishes. He treats every of his baking products with care and with great precision.

characters.name: Cacao
characters.description: Cacao (formerly Sugarcane, the name given by Azuki) is a stray cat found by Chocola when she went out to buy ponzu for tuna. Cacao followed Chocola until she arrived home. The Minaduki thought that this is a lost cat and they tried to find an owner for it but they couldn't find one. Now Cacao lives with Chocola and Vanilla in Kashou Minaduki's house because of Chocola's wish for her to stay there. "Cacao" is a name chosen by Shigure Minaduki and the Minaduki cat-girls later on.

characters.name: Chiyo no Haha
characters.description: Chiyo's mother, who often visits La Soleil with her daughter.

characters.name: Umi no Ie no Ane
characters.description: The older of the siblings working at Beach Clubhouse Orange in episode 12.

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai
title_original: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい
title_en: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
description: At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye. Everyone, that is, except Sheena, who wishes for nothing more than the growing conflict around her to end. On the night of her roommate's death, Sheena meets a strange girl covered in blood, who smiles despite the turmoil surrounding them. The next day, the girl appears as a new student in Sheena's class and introduces herself as Mimi. Initially thought to be a school myth, there are now whispers in the orphanage's halls that Mimi is their secret weapon—an immortal who cannot die. When Mimi is later assigned as Sheena's new roommate, Sheena's world grows even more complicated when she begins living with someone who loves and welcomes death, when all Sheena wants to do is stop it… (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Sheena Totsuki
characters.description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

characters.name: Mimi Kagari
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena). She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

characters.name: Seiran Lizzy
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm She is a serious person with a strong sense of justice. Whenever one of her classmates behaves in a frivolous manner, she scolds them. But every time she does so, [Ali](https://anilist.co/character/229291/Maud-Ali) calms her down. She shows glimpses of a strong connection with Ali that goes beyond friendship.

characters.name: Ali Maud
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm She has a calm personality, always smiling, and is more mature than the other students. She has a bold personality and expresses her thoughts directly, which makes [Seiran](https://anilist.co/character/229290/Lizzy-Seiran) worry about her.

characters.name: Halfred Anhalt
characters.original: アンハルト・ハルフレズ
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena)'s classmate. When younger, they disliked wearing the hand-me-down skirts from their older sisters, and asked for their brother's shorts instead, leading them to be criticized for not acting "like a girl" and causing problems for their family. At present, they are still figuring out their identity, and about relationships. They are intrigued by Mimi and Sheena's bond. Their favorite food is anything easy they can carry to their room.

characters.name: Esta Nino
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm An upperclassman from class 16. Esta puts on a cheery demeanor and is kind to both her juniors and classmates. She would often ignore her own health and lets others have priority when it comes to getting treatment, regardless of how bad her own condition might be. She is roommates with a classmate named [Heather](https://anilist.co/character/402132/Heather).

characters.name: Omi
characters.description: The homeroom teacher for Class 14, to which [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and the others belong. Despite her detached demeanor, she truly cares about her students.

characters.name: Fran
characters.description: The school nurse at the school [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and her friends attend. She is skilled in healing magic and is indispensable to the school. She’s always looking out for [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi).

characters.name: Heather
characters.description: An upperclassman from class 16. She is roommates with a classmate named [Esta](https://anilist.co/character/380872/Nino-Esta).

title: Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu 2
title_original: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です2
title_en: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Season 2
description: Office worker Leon has just been thrust into an otome game where women hold all the power. His only tool for survival is the knowledge gained from playing this game in his past life. But after befriending the heroine and villainess, and making a name for himself, his choices begin to warp the story beyond what he knows. Now, Leon is dragged into a conspiracy that could shake the entire kingdom. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Leon Fou Bartfort
characters.original: リオン・フォウ・バルトファルト
characters.description: Our main character, who finds him reincarnated in an otome game after tripping down some stairs.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.description: The main character of the otome game.

characters.name: Angelica Rafua Redgrave
characters.original: アンジェリカ・ラファ・レッドグレイブ
characters.description: The villainess of the otome game, who is befriended by [Leon](https://anilist.co/character/152674/Fou-Bartfort-Leon) and [Livia](https://anilist.co/character/152673/Olivia).

characters.name: Marie Fou Lafuan
characters.original: マリエ・フォウ・ラーファン
characters.description: ~!The sister of [Leon](https://anilist.co/character/152674/Fou-Bartfort-Leon) from Japan, who was also reincarnated in the otome game.!~

characters.name: Luxion
characters.description: Luxion was originally a cash in-game shop item in the original Otome Game, but now, he's the deuteragonist of the story, an important supporting player of the major events of the series.

characters.name: Julius  Rafa Holfort
characters.original: ユリウス・ラファ・ホルファート
characters.description: Julius Rafa Holfort is one of the main capture target in first series of the otome game and prince of the Holfort Kingdom.

characters.name: Mylene Rafa Holfort
characters.original: ミレーヌ・ラファ・ホルファート
characters.description: Mylene Rafa Holfort is the mother of [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/168842/Rafa-Holfort-Julius), wife of [Roland](https://anilist.co/character/409980/Holfort-Roland) and the Queen of Holfort Kingdom.

characters.name: Brad Fou Field
characters.original: ブラッド・フォウ・フィールド

characters.name: Jilk Fia Marmoria
characters.original: ジルク・フィア・マーモリア

characters.name: Greg Fou Seberg
characters.original: グレッグ・フォウ・セバーグ

characters.name: Chris Fia Arclight
characters.original: クリス・フィア・アークライト

characters.name: Balcus Fou Bartfort
characters.original: バルカス・フォウ・バルトファルト
characters.description: The father of [Leon](https://anilist.co/character/152674/Fou-Bartfort-Leon) and head of the Bartfort Household

title: Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san
title_original: 履いてください、鷹峰さん
description: Takane Takamine is the goddess of her high school. With perfect grades, athletic prowess, and unrivaled beauty, this student council president is the apple of everyone's eye-including Koushi Shirota, a below-average student with no friends or social prospects whatsoever. But he'll soon find out the secret behind Takamine's unbelievable success-her underwear! When she strips, she can undo any of her past actions, and now that Koushi knows, Takamine won't let him off so easy... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takane Takamine
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Student Council President She is a perfectionist and wants to be the best at everything. She has an ability called "The still untouched, unknowing maiden. (The eternal aisle)". Every time she takes off a piece of underwear she can make what was done into something it wasn't.

characters.name: Koushi Shirota
characters.description: Once he is introduced to Takane Takamine, he is soon told that he will become her "closet", in which he has to replace her underwear once she has used her ability.

characters.name: Ellie Evergreen
characters.original: 絵梨依・エバーグリーン
characters.description: Takashi's old childhood friend

title: Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden
title_original: マギアレコード 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ外伝
title_en: Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story
description: In exchange for the fulfillment of a wish, Magical Girls keep fighting, unbeknownst to the rest of the world. But Iroha Tamaki can’t seem to remember her wish. A rumor begins to spread among Magical Girls. “Magical Girls can be saved if they go to Kamihama.” Kamihama City, the city where Magical Girls and Uwasa are gathering. The story of Iroha Tamaki, in search for her lost wish, begins… (Source: Aniplex of America)

characters.name: Iroha Tamaki
characters.description: Iroha came to Kamihama to investigate strange dreams she was having. Kind-hearted, she tends to worry too much about others. She's not up on the latest trends and isn't good with her phone. Usually reserved, she can be a fighter when it matters most.

characters.name: Yachiyo Nanami
characters.description: A seasoned Magical Girl who has fought witches for 7 years in Kamihama. Yachiyo is well informed about the city and Magical Girls in general. She keeps her distance from other Magical Girls while she compiles files on the Rumors of Kamihama City.

characters.name: Sana Futaba
characters.description: A pessimistic Magical Girl, Sana was rejected by her family and those around her, so she has hardly any self-confidence. However, she'll quietly stand by the people who need her, ready to help them when the time comes.

characters.name: Felicia Mitsuki
characters.description: Felicia is a spirited Magical Girl, full of energy and determination, who hates Witches for taking the lives of her parents. She now works as a mercenary, hunting Witches all across Kamihama. Her tough talk hides a kind heart and a love of animals.

characters.name: Tsuruno Yui
characters.description: A reckless Magical Girl who's full of energy. Tsuruno loves her family, especially her grandfather and great-grandfather, who lead the Yuis to their former prosperity. She fights to become the strongest Magical Girl in order to restore the Yui name.

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Kuroe
characters.description: Kuroe is a Magical Girl who lives in Takarazaki City. Kuroe fights alongside Iroha from time to time, but mostly they're acquaintances who get together on a regular basis to exchange information. ~!Later, they develop a close friendship similar to the friendship between Iroha and Yachiyo.!~ Kuroe is afraid of fighting in life or death battles and wishes she could be saved from being a Magical Girl. ~!She eventually begins to obsess over Kamihama City after hearing a certain rumor. Later, she reveals the desire to be as strong as Iroha and Yachiyo.!~

characters.name: Kaede Akino
characters.description: A worrywart, Kaede is easily scared. She is also kind, caring, and ready to take risks for her friends. She loves animals, plants, and insects, and nature in general. She enjoys gardening, and though she's not good at them, she likes UFO Catchers.

characters.name: Rena Minami
characters.description: A Magical Girl who has trouble opening up to others. Rena acts cocky to make up for her lack of self-confidence, which leads people who don't know her well to misunderstanding her. She's a picky eater and loves sweets. She is also a big fan of idols.

title: Fumetsu no Anata e Season 3
description: The story of Fushi the immortal enters the modern era. Following the battles in Renril, Fushi, like a tree, spreads his roots throughout the world, fighting to eliminate the Nokkers. Hundreds of years later, having completed his mission, he awakens in the modern era. He enjoys a life of peace, free of enemy threats and surrounded by precious friends, new and old. But ominous shadows grow near yet again. Enemies that enter into the fissures of the mind. And Fushi learns of the true goals of his creator, the Beholder. Faced with new trials, the time approaches for Fushi to make the ultimate decision. (Source: NHK PR, edited)

characters.name: Fushi
characters.description: **Age:** ~!~800 years!~ **Relatives:** [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) ("father"; creator), [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) (adoptive "mother"), [Gugu](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) (adoptive brother) Fushi is an immortal being created by The Beholder and placed on Earth to preserve the world. Fushi is an immortal being that can take the form of anything that has given him stimuli. His original form was a featureless white sphere. Without consciousness, he copied the first thing he bumped into, which happened to be a rock. Soon afterward, he became moss and stayed like that for some time. When a wounded wolf wandered close in the middle of winter and died, the immortal copied the wolf. He retains the ability to turn into these things. Later, after the death of the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Unnamed-Boy

characters.name: Mizuha
characters.description: A girl from the present area. ~!She's one of [Hayase](https://anilist.co/character/136545/Hayase)'s descendants and will be the eighteenth leader of the Defense Corps.!~

characters.name: Yuuki Aoki
characters.description: He is a boy from the present era. He offers [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to stay at his place. He's the vice-president of the occult research club.

characters.name: Kansatsu-sha
characters.description: The mysterious being and observer who cast the orb onto the Earth. His goal is to preserve the world. He sent [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to acquire various kinds of information from the world and aid his observations.

characters.name: Hanna
characters.description: She's a girl from the present era. [Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki)'s and [Mizuha](https://anilist.co/character/204189/Mizuha)'s friend.

characters.name: Tamaki Kazumu
characters.description: A boy from the present era. [Aoki's](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki) friend. He's a first-year, occult-club member and self-professed brawn of the club.

characters.name: Senba Suzuhiko
characters.description: A boy living in the present era. [Aoki's](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki) friend. He's a first-year occult club member and self-professed brains of the club.

characters.name: Aiko Aoki
characters.description: A person living in the present era. [Yuki Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki)'s younger sibling.

characters.name: Kazumitsu
characters.description: A person living in the present era. [Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki) and [Aiko's](https://anilist.co/character/204182/Aoki-Aiko) grandparent.

characters.name: Satoru
characters.description: ~!The human reincarnation of [Kansatsu-sha](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha).!~

characters.name: Mimori
characters.description: A girl from the present era.

characters.name: Hirotoshi
characters.description: [Mimori's](https://anilist.co/character/204418/Mimori) brother-in-law

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?)
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ! (※ムリじゃなかった!?)
title_en: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless…
description: Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako’s total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai’s romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they’re destined to be lovers. Let the love games begin! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Renako Amaori
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative. In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

characters.name: Mai Ouzuka
characters.description: **Height:** 167 cm (5'6") Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, they are in "friends mode." Mai's mother is an internationally renowned fashion designer, and Mai is one of her models. As a result, her family is very wealthy.

characters.name: Satsuki Koto
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5'5") Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her. ~!Satsuki lives in a run-down apartment and works part-time to support her single mother.!~

characters.name: Ajisai Sena
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality. Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

characters.name: Kaho Koyanagi
characters.description: **Height:** 153 cm (5'0") As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality. ~!Renako is later revealed to be Kaho's childhood friend. Renako was unable to remember who she was because her surname had been changed from Minaguchi to Koyanagi.!~

characters.name: Haruna Amaori
characters.description: She is Renako's younger sister. She is a second-year junior high school student and a member of the badminton club. She is naturally extroverted and athletic, unlike her older sister.

characters.name: Hitoe Hanatori
characters.description: [Mai's](https://anilist.co/character/196167/Mai-Ouzuka) personal driver and housekeeper.

title: Asagao to Kase-san.
description: A relationship is like a garden. It's hard, really hard, to plant the initial seeds. Once you've gone through the agonizing process of wondering if the other person even likes you, fought the fear that telling her could destroy everything, and made your confession, the most difficult part begins. Because you have to keep nurturing this wonderful new feeling to keep it growing. Not just in your own heart, but in hers. And since even the most beautiful rose can cut you to the bone with its thorns, who can you talk to for advice? Especially when you're both girls in high school? For shy Yamada and boyish Kase, time is running out. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yui Yamada
characters.description: A quiet girl who is in charge of greenification. She's poor at sports and singing.

characters.name: Tomoka Kase
characters.description: A popular and handsome girl in the class next door to [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/125397)'s. She's the ace of the track and field club.

characters.name: Mikawa
characters.description: Yamada's classmate and best friend. She's in the tennis club. She can't handle the sight of blood well.

characters.name: Akane Inoue
characters.description: Akane Inoue, also known as Inoue-senpai, is a graduate and former member of the track and field club at Yui Yamada and Tomoka Kase's high school. ~!As a result of rumors, she is long believed by Yamada to be Kase's ex-girlfriend, although this is eventually proven to be false.!~

title: Azur Lane
description: Azur Lane, a combination of all the different Camps in the world, was once successful in repelling the underwater menace, the Siren. Now splintered, they must face a new threat in Red Axis, former allies who crave to wield this otherworldly Siren technology for their own nefarious desires! Who will be victorious in the never-ending war between these battleship girls!? (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Belfast
characters.description: Edinburgh-Class Light Cruiser. As the head of the Royal Navy, she is very dutiful and affectionately calls the Commander “master”.

characters.name: Enterprise
characters.description: __Faction:__ Eagle Union __Class:__ Yorktown Legendary Yorktown-class aircraft carrier Enterprise. She has a natural sense of responsibility and values teamwork most of all things. Her "Lucky E" passive in game is a reference to Enterprise's luck and resilience when it came to surviving battles.

characters.name: Akagi
characters.description: Akagi-Class Aircraft Carrier. A threatening and easily jealous sadist with yandere tendencies. In the anime, she acts possessive towards her sister, Kaga, while in the game and other adaptions it’s towards the Commander.

characters.name: Kaga
characters.description: Kaga-Class Aircraft Carrier. She loves to battle and is very attached to her older sister, Akagi.

characters.name: Laffey
characters.description: Benson-Class Destroyer. A sleepy girl who speaks in monotone and isn’t motivated by anything but fighting. Like her other sisters, she wears a pair of bunny ears. Also an avid drinker of Oxycola.

characters.name: Ayanami
characters.description: Fubuki-Class Destroyer. She has difficulty understanding things outside of fighting and is confused by certain human interactions. Her nickname is “The Demon”. Her verbal tic is “desu".

characters.name: Javelin
characters.description: J-Class Destroyer. A very cheerful and affectionate genki girl who wields a javelin.

characters.name: Shoukaku
characters.description: Carrier of the Sakura Empire's Fifth Carrier Division. Older sister of Zuikaku.

characters.name: Zuikaku
characters.description: Carrier of the Sakura Empire's Fifth Carrier Division.

characters.name: Warspite
characters.description: Queen Elizabeth-class battleship. Calls herself a "grand old lady" despite looking young. In Azur Lane: Queen's Orders, she swears fealty as a knight of the Royal Navy.

characters.name: Queen Elizabeth
characters.original: クイーン・エリザベス
characters.description: Queen Elizabeth-class battleship. True to her name, she acts like a spoiled queen and is a tsundere. Very close with her knight and fellow battleship, Warspite.

title: Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon
title_original: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々
title_en: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
description: Three years into her life as a shut-in, vampire Terakomari Gandesblood (Komari for short), awakens to find she’s been appointed as a Commander in the Mulnite Imperial Army! The thing is, her new unit consists solely of belligerent ruffians who revolt against their superiors at the slightest hint of weakness. Although Komari hails from a line of vampires as powerful as they are prestigious, her refusal to drink blood has made her the picture of mediocrity—scrawny, un-coordinated, and inept at magic. With the odds stacked against her, will the help of her trusty (and slightly infatuated) maid Vill be enough for this recluse to blunder her way to success? Or will Komari rue the day she ever left the safety of her room? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Terakomari Gandesblood
characters.original: テラコマリ・ガンデスブラッド
characters.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 7th unit.

characters.name: Villhaze
characters.description: [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari)'s personal maid, assigned as part of her position as a Crimson Lord.

characters.name: Karen Helvetius
characters.original: カレン・エルヴェシアス
characters.description: Empress of the Mulnite Empire. Hard to read and wanton in nature, she appoints the reclusive [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari) as a Crimson Lord.

characters.name: Sakuna Memoir
characters.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 6th unit.

characters.name: Millicent Bluenight
characters.original: ミリセント・ ブルーナイト
characters.description: A member of the terrorist organization "Inverted Moon".

characters.name: Meruka Tiano
characters.description: Reporter for the Six Countries, a newspaper considered by some to be untrustworthy.

characters.name: Gertrude Rainsworth
characters.original: ガートルード・ レインズワース

title: Kämpfer
description: Waking up transformed into a beautiful girl might be the stuff of some guys' fantasies, but when the suddenly effeminatized Natsuru is informed by a stuffed tiger that he's now a Kampfer, a mystical fighter who has to fight other Kampfers in female form, his life becomes a living nightmare! Putting aside the obvious "plumbing" issues, Natusru's best childhood friend turns out to swing the other way and SHE has a crush on his new female body. Not complex enough? Natsuru's school has separate sections for boys and girls, so he and she are now double enrolled. The rumor-mill has it that he's dating herself. And there are other Kampfers attending the school who want to take her out, and he's not sure which ones mean "on a date" and which ones mean "permanently." Oh, and did we mention that some Kampfers use swords and gun?! Hormones, fists, and other body parts will fly as the daring, new gender-blender defender must become a contender or die! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Kaede Sakura
characters.description: Shizuku's childhood friend and one of the Three Beauties of Seitetsu, she has many admirers, Natsuru being one of them. She has a large collection of stuffed Zoumotsu Animal dolls and likes to present them to her friends; those who receive the dolls, however, tend to end up becoming Kämpfers. She began to develop a crush on Kämpfer Natsuru after being saved from Kämpfer Akane at the beginning of the series, later coming under the mistaken impression that the normal Natsuru is her rival for Kämpfer Natsuru's affection and consequently becoming somewhat hostile to him, a situation not helped after a misunderstanding in a very compromising situation leads her to think Natsuru is cheating on the female Natsuru. ~!Later she is revealed to possibly have something to do with the appearances of the White Kämpfers and may be manipulating Natsuru. It is eventually confirmed on separate occasions w

characters.name: Natsuru Senou
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm The series' main protagonist. Second year student of Seitetsu Gakuin High-school. He is chosen as a Blue Kämpfer by Moderator and setup as a Zauber type with power based on fire. In keeping with the rule that all Kämpfers are females, he turns into girl upon transformation. After a fight with Shizuku exposed his Kämpfer form to other students of the school, Shizuku arranged to have him enrolled in girl's class to fulfil public curiosity in a way that diverts attentions away from Kämpfer battle. His Kämpfer form has subsequently been ranked among the Three Beauties of Seitetsu (there used to be only two) and, much to Natsuru's own dismay, become subject of intense affections from Kaede Sakura (whom he has a crush on). Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Akane Mishima
characters.description: School librarian and Natsuru's friend, she is also a Blue Kämpfer like Natsuru. Normally very shy (which might very well be attributed to her tendency of misunderstanding what others are trying to do in a borderline-erotic way) and soft-spoken, she has bipolar disorder upon transforming into a Kämpfer, becoming foul-mouthed, bitter, vindictive, and trigger-happy. She explained most of the rules of being a Kämpfer when Natsuru's own Messenger gave no such details. She is a Gewehr type Kämpfer who uses an 1911 .45 pistol and appears to be ambidextrous. In addition to having Natsuru as the first male to establish in-depth friendship with her, Akane eventually begins to harbor feelings for him, becoming jealous and easily irritable when he talks about another girl (most if not all of the time being Kaede) in front of her or when another girl takes an interest in

characters.name: Shizuku Sangou
characters.description: President of the Student Council and one of the Three Beauties of Seitetsu, she is a model student with perfect attendance record. In addition, however, she is also a Red Kämpfer fighting with the Schwert ability of wielding two chained daggers at will. She wants to expose Moderator's intentions but has no problem fighting Blue Kämpfers until that goal was accomplished. After being spared following a defeat by [Natsuru](https://anilist.co/character/24977), she enters a truce with Natsuru and [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/24978) and has since taken an interest in Natsuru in a slightly sly and teasing manner, throwing him off balance with embarrassing remarks/actions while maintaining a poker face in the process, despite being constantly treated with suspicion as a result. After being invited by [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/24581) to visit her home and then spend the night t

characters.name: Mikoto Kondou
characters.description: Natsuru's childhood friend who only recently reunited with him due to her father being an archaeologist who lives abroad, a way of live that already made her think little of doing things others would consider far too dangerous. Although having too much pride to explicitly admit, she has feelings for Natsuru and is more than a bit bothered by the presence of a girl with the same name as his (who in reality is Natsuru in his Kämpfer form). Even after the misunderstanding is later cleared up, the advances made by Akane and Shizuku on Natsuru (Mikoto apparently does not believe Kaede would reciprocate his feelings) subsequently makes her even more nervous about her chance with him as well. When she was seeing Miss Seitetsu contest of the school festival, she caught a bouquet that Kaede tossed with a Messenger hidden in it, consequently being turned into a Schwert-type Red Kämp

characters.name: Kanden Yamaneko
characters.description: The Messenger for Shizuku in the shape of a wildcat bristling hairs. [wikipedia]

characters.name: Seppuku Kuro Usagi
characters.description: Akane's messenger. According to Mishima Akane, this black rabbit has a voice similar to that of Tamura Yukari. Oh wait, that's the voice of the seiyuu!

characters.name: Rika Ueda
characters.description: A Schwert user armed with a kusarigama. Her weapon is quite similar like Shizuku's and It turned out to be that Rika is a White Kämpfer. ~!Rika appears in episode 7 and barges into Sakura's room and interrupts Akane while she was about to confess.!~

characters.name: Sayaka Nakao
characters.description: A Schwert user armed with a sabre.

characters.name: Ryouka Yamakawa
characters.description: A Gewehr user armed with a submachine gun resembling an Uzi.

characters.name: Harakiri Tora
characters.description: Natsuru's Messenger.

characters.name: Chissoku Norainu
characters.description: Mikoto's Messenger.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Hajimari no Monogatari
title_original: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 始まりの物語
title_en: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings
description: The first movie in the Madoka tetralogy; a recap of the first eight episodes of the series.

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Hitomi Shizuki
characters.description: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies.

characters.name: Junko Kaname
characters.description: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher. She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

characters.name: Tomohisa Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 175-180 cm Madoka's father. A stay-at-home dad. He does housekeeping, cooking, laundry and cleaning.

characters.name: Kazuko Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 155-157 cm Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.

characters.name: Kyousuke Kamijou
characters.description: __Height:__ 170-175 cm A terminally ill boy whom Sayaka constantly visits. He used to play violin when he was younger and enjoys listening to classical musical CDs that Sayaka brings him.

characters.name: Tatsuya Kaname
characters.description: Madoka's little brother. He's 3 years old and goes to kindergarten.

title: Cross Ange: Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo
title_original: クロスアンジュ 天使と竜の輪舞
title_en: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angel and Dragon
description: Betrayed, stripped of her birthright, and declared less than human. Everything that Princess Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi of the Misurugi Empire thought she knew about her world was a lie. Now, for the crime of not being able to use magic, she’s been sentenced to certain death as a slave-soldier. The girl now known as Ange is no longer an innocent Princess: she’s learning how to kill draconic invaders, defending the same traitors who stole her life. However, they made a fatal mistake: they gave her access to an incredible weapon. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi
characters.original: アンジュリーゼ・斑鳩・ミスルギ
characters.description: She used to be a member of the nobility who had the title of "First Princess of the Misurugi Empire" until the day of her coronation when she was exposed as a "Norma" by her ambitious brother Julio. Stripped of her title and honor, and thrown into a remote island where her own kind are treated like tools for battling dragons, her once comfortable life of honor, privilege, and prestige now becomes a life of where everyday is a battle to stay alive as she struggles to accept her new life as one of the warriors of the First Troop.

characters.name: Salamandinay
characters.description: Salamandinay pilots the Ryuu-Shin-Ki, Enryugo, and comes from the same dimension as the DRAGON's. Sala's piloting skill is great enough to allow her to fight on par with Ange. She is also skilled enough in hand-to-hand combat to easily subdue Ange. She is able to control DRAGON's through singing. She is also able to sing the "True Star Song", which is used to power the Enryugo it's High-Yield Cannons.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Eien no Monogatari
title_original: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 永遠の物語
title_en: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal
description: The second movie in the Madoka tetralogy. It is a recap of the last four episodes of the series.

title: Ikoku Nikki
description: Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has always preferred the company of books—but when her sister and brother-in-law pass away, Makio unexpectedly becomes the guardian of her 15-year-old niece, Asa Takumi. As they navigate grief, clashing personalities, and the challenges of living together, the two slowly open their hearts to each other, discovering warmth, understanding, and the meaning of family. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Makio Koudai
characters.description: A 35-year-old novelist who lives alone. She is deeply introverted, and has not communicated with her relatives for a long time due to arguments with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/387235) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/363293). Took in her sister's orphaned daughter, [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957).

characters.name: Asa Takumi
characters.description: After the passing away of her parents, she was adopted by her [Aunt Makio](https://anilist.co/character/171138). She now faces the hardship of adapting to a new environment, while sorting the emotions within herself.

characters.name: Shingo Kasamachi
characters.description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138) friend and ex-boyfriend.

characters.name: Emiri Nara
characters.description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) classmate and best friend. ~!Asa eventually learns that Emiri is a lesbian and that Emiri is dating [a girl](https://anilist.co/character/393115) who attends the same preparatory classes.!~

characters.name: Nana Daigo
characters.description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/Koudai-Makio) friend from her days at school.

characters.name: Kazunari Touno
characters.description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) guardianship supervisor.

characters.name: Michiko Nara
characters.description: [Emiri's](https://anilist.co/character/363290/) mother.

characters.name: Minori Koudai
characters.description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/) deceased mother. [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/) older sister.

characters.name: Hajime Takumi
characters.description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/) deceased father.

characters.name: Kyouko Koudai
characters.description: Minori and Makio's mother. Asa's grandmother.

characters.name: Kotoko
characters.description: Makio's friend from her days at school.

characters.name: Motsu
characters.description: Makio's friend from her days at school.

title: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
title_en: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
description: At just seventeen, Yuki is a professional death game player. She’s survived enough rounds to know that survival is calculation, not luck—and that failure is final. For most players, the games are a nightmare with no escape. For Yuki, they’re simply business. Yet in a world where rooms turn into graves and every choice could be her last, even experience offers no protection. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~47 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

characters.name: Yuki Sorimachi
characters.description: Yuki's goal is to win ninety-nine death games while also attempting to keep as many of her fellow participants alive as possible.

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight
title_original: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュー・スタァライト
description: The franchise centers on "Starlight" — the song and dance revue troupe loved throughout the world. Karen and Hikari make a promise with each other when they're young that one day they'll stand on that stage together. Time passes, and now the girls are 16 years old. Karen is very enthusiastic about the lessons she takes every day, holding her promise close to her heart. Hikari has transferred schools and is now away from Karen. But the cogs of fate turn, and the two are destined to meet again. The girls and other "Stage Girls" will compete in a mysterious audition process to gain acceptance into the revue. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Karen Aijou
characters.description: The protagonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. She set out on the road to becoming a Stage Girl after being captivated by a performance of "Starlight" she saw as a child. She is always boisterous and cheerful but hates early morning lessons. She joins the mysterious Revue with Hikari Kagura, who crossed fates with her when they were young girls.

characters.name: Hikari Kagura
characters.description: Hikari Kagura (神楽 ひかり, Kagura Hikari) is the deuteragonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Karen's childhood friend. A born performer who studied at an acting school in England. Her fate has been linked with Karen's since viewing a performance of "Starlight". Reuniting with her old friend, she is driven by a strong desire to join the mysterious Revue. (Source: Revue Starlight Wiki)

characters.name: Nana Daiba
characters.description: Nana Daiba is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. This Stage Girl is the de facto mother of the 99th class, kind and caring to her classmates. Nicknamed "Banana". Talented not only in singing and dancing but also as a director. Still delighted by the group performance of "Starlight" back in her first year.

characters.name: Claudine Saijou
characters.description: She is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as the second seat in the class. Born to a Japanese father and a French mother, this talented Stage Girl already has a long career as a child actress. Upon entering the school, she meets the brilliant [Maya Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126666/Tendou-Maya) and immediately begins a staunch rivalry.

characters.name: Junna Hoshimi
characters.description: Junna Hoshimi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A top student who serves as the class representative. Has great decision-making and analytical skills, but is prone to overthinking. After choosing to pursue acting against her parents' wishes, she now frets over the gap in skill between herself and those with natural talent like Maya.

characters.name: Maya Tendou
characters.description: She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as head of the class. Practically born for the theater world, with a renowned stage actor and a prima donna for parents. Blessed with a good physique and a carrying voice, she refuses to rest on her laurels and always strives to reach greater heights.

characters.name: Futaba Isurugi
characters.description: Futaba Isurugi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A highly unorthodox Stage Girl who came to Seisho Music Academy along with her childhood friend Kaoruko. Kind-hearted despite her rough words, she takes care of Kaoruko while always griping. Tiny but athletic, she shows deadly aptitude for staged swordfights.

characters.name: Kaoruko Hanayagi
characters.description: Kaoruko Hanayagi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Granddaughter of the head of a traditional Japanese dance school, this Stage Girl has refined skills in traditional song and dance. Raised in privilege, she is all too reliant on Futaba Isurugi. While she is always smiling, she is more calculating than anyone else. Speaks in the elegant Kyoto dialect.

characters.name: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki
characters.description: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki is the tritagonist in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Though she sings and dances her heart out on stage, this Stage Girl is normally withdrawn and contemplative. She admires her roommate Karen's cheery and outgoing nature, but her feelings are put in a difficult place when Karen's old friend Hikari shows up.

characters.name: Kirin
characters.description: The Giraffe is a talking, unnamed giraffe that oversees the Revues and controls the Stage of Fate.

characters.name: Shion Amemiya
characters.description: Shion Amemiya is a student at Seisho Music Academy who participates in the Play Creator Program. She is the playwright for Class B's performance of Starlight, always seen with director Kiriko Masai and she is presumably responsible for Nana Daiba when she takes on the role of trainee playwright.

characters.name: Kiriko Masai
characters.description: Kiriko Masai is a student at Seisho Music Academy who participates in the Play Creator Program. She is the director for Class B's performance of Starlight, working alongside playwright Amemiya Shion and Nana Daiba.

title: SANDA
description: In a future where children are few and regarded as Japan's most valuable assets, Christmas has become a mere legend of the past. For the students of Daikoku Welfare Academy—a boarding school where they are educated, protected, and monitored—the mythical Santa Claus is a forgotten character of fiction. For the adults, Santa Claus is a very real menace that needs to be neutralized by the Saint Nick Pursuit Unit in case he makes an appearance. Shiori Fuyumura, a student of Daikoku Welfare Academy, is determined to find her best friend, Ichie Ono, who has been declared dead after being missing for six months. One morning, Fuyumura summons her fellow class representative, Kazushige Sanda, only to attack the unknowing boy. She is convinced that Sanda is the descendant of the infamous Santa Claus—the only person who can make her wish of finding Ono come true—and is determined to force out his dormant true self by any means necessary. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Kazushige Sanda
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm A second year middle school student at Daikoku Aigo Academy who is a descendant of Santa Claus. He was determined to hide the curse of Santa Claus, but his powers were recently unleashed. When he transforms into Santa, he becomes a muscular old man who works hard to grant the wishes of children.

characters.name: Shiori Fuyumura
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm One of [Sanda's](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda) classmates who is unusually tall for her age. She broke the seal on Santa Claus's powers in order to request his help in solving the mysterious disappearance of her friend [Ono](https://anilist.co/character/363834/Ichie-Ono).

characters.name: Saburou Yagiuda
characters.description: Captain of the Special Search Unit of The Red Coats.

characters.name: Niko Kazao
characters.description: Sanda's state-mandated marriage partner.

characters.name: Hitoshi Amaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm He is [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommate.

characters.name: Hifumi Ooshibu
characters.description: Principal of Daikoku Aigo Academy. ~!Underwent a total of 72 reconstruction surgeries to maintain his youthful appearance.!~

characters.name: Hajime Mogi
characters.description: One of [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommates.

characters.name: Ichie Ono
characters.description: [Fuyumura](https://anilist.co/character/246681/Shiori-Fuyumura)'s best friend who mysteriously went missing.

characters.name: Toyo Tetsudome
characters.description: The rector of Daikoku Aigo Academy. In contrast to Principal Ooshibu, who constantly pursues youth, she has gracefully accepted her old age. She's still spry for her age, however...

characters.name: Ikkei Douzono
characters.description: One of [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommates.

characters.name: Iori Utagawa
characters.description: One of [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommates.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten
title_original: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ〈ワルプルギスの廻天〉
title_en: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
description: The 10th anniversary online event for the Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica anime revealed that the franchise is getting a new anime film titled Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten . The film will be an official sequel to the Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Hangyaku no Monogatari film that opened in October 2013. The tagline on the new film's visual reads, "Now, let's continue the story." (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Nagisa Momoe
characters.description: A magical girl who wished for a cheesecake that her mother would think was the best. Nagisa is usually rather childish, serving as the plucky and cheerful comic relief of the group, though she's shown to be more perceptive than she seems. She tends to speak rather eloquently. She fights with a trumpet horn that can shoot bubbles powerful enough to put cracks in a witch's barrier. ~!She is the magical girl form of [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/40842/Charlotte).!~ ~!Nagisa is considered a secretary to the Law of Cycles following Madoka's wish. She assisted Madoka, along with Sayaka, in their attempt to stop the Kyubey from controlling the Law of Cycles and freeing Homura. Following Homura rewriting the universe, her previous knowledge as a magical girl as well as her magical girl powers have been taken away.!~

characters.name: Hitomi Shizuki
characters.description: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies.

characters.name: Walpurgis Night
characters.description: The witch of stage settings; her nature is helplessness. She symbolizes the fool who continuously spins in circles. The witch's mysteries have been handed down through the course of history; her appellation is "Walpurgis Night." She will continue to rotate aimlessly throughout the world until she completely changes the whole of this age into a drama. When the doll's usual upside-down position reaches the top part of the witch, she completely roils the civilization on the ground in a flash through her gale-like flight. Her true name is unknown.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: The witch of desserts. Her nature is tenacity. What she desires is everything. She will never give up. Though she is capable of creating infinite amounts of any dessert she desires, she is unable to make the cheese that she loves most. If you have a piece of cheese, you can easily catch her off-guard. (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

title: Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level MAX ni Nattemashita: Sono ni
title_original: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました ～そのに～
title_en: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level Season 2
description: Get ready for more relaxing tales! Azusa Aizawa is a powerful witch who finally reached level 99 and now busies herself with laid-back quests instead. Her family continues to grow as some familiar faces are joined by bright-eyed newcomers. From trips to the beach to a martial arts tournament, you’re invited on Azusa’s carefree and heartwarming adventures of leisure. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Azusa Aizawa
characters.description: Commonly known as "The Witch of the Highlands." A girl who was reincarnated as an immortal witch with the appearance of a seventeen-year-old. Before she knew what was happening, she'd become the strongest being in the world. Although she's had some rough times, it has ultimately given her a family, and she's delighted about it.

characters.name: Laika
characters.description: A dragon girl and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She's fastidious and cares a lot about what others think, but she's a good, earnest, and hardworking girl. Gothic Lolita clothes, maid outfits, and other frilly things suit her very well (which embarrasses her).

characters.name: Halkara
characters.description: A young elf woman and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She is an upstanding CEO who runs a company using her knowledge of mushrooms, but in the house in the highlands, she's known for her knack for screwing up.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.description: A high-ranking demon known as the Lord of the Flies and the demons' minister of agriculture. She frequently shuttles between the demon realm and the house in the highlands. She's [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s reliable "big sister" surrogate.

characters.name: Rosalie
characters.description: A ghost girl and resident of the house in the highlands. She's devoted to Azusa, who didn't shy away from her as a ghost and instead reached out to her. She can go through walls but can't touch people. She can also possess others.

characters.name: Flatorte
characters.description: Flatorte is a cheerful, energetic blue dragon girl who obeys what [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa) says. Since she's a dragon like [Laika](https://anilist.co/character/135593/Laika), there is somewhat of a rivalry between them, but she's an optimistic and energetic girl. Unlike Laika, she has a tail in human form.

characters.name: Falfa
characters.description: Oldest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and math.

characters.name: Shalsha
characters.description: Youngest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and history.

characters.name: Provat Allières
characters.original: プロヴァト・ペコラ・アリエース
characters.description: The Demon King. A girl with a devilish temperament who loves to use her power and influence to bewilder her subordinates and Azusa. She actually has a masochistic desire to be subordinate to someone stronger than she is, and she adores Azusa.

characters.name: Natalie
characters.description: Natalie Jr. is a new guild receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild in Flatta village. She shares a name with her predecessor [Natalie](https://anilist.co/character/217736). Natalie Jr. is the one who reveals that Azusa has achieved max level by killing nothing but slimes for over 300 years with her Increased EXP Acquisition ability. However, due to Azusa wanting to keep a low profile and continue with her quiet slow life, she requests that Natalie keep her stats and level a secret, to which, Natalie agrees.

title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru
title_original: 結城友奈は勇者である
description: Yuuna Yuuki is an ordinary second-year middle school student. She gets up in the morning, gets ready for school, goes to classes, participates in club activities, and has fun with her friends. But there is one extraordinary thing about Yuuki — she belongs to the “Brave Hero Club.” What does the Brave Hero Club do? Who is the mysterious being called “Vertex?” Yuuki Yuuna and her friends’ story takes place in Year 300, Era of the Gods. (Source: Ponycan USA)

characters.name: Yuuna Yuuki
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic. She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

characters.name: Mimori Tougou
characters.description: [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name.
