Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident. ~! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !~

characters.name: Fuu Inubouzaki
characters.description: A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating. As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

characters.name: Itsuki Inubouzaki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times. As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

characters.name: Karin Miyoshi
characters.description: A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere". As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense

characters.name: Sonoko Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

title: Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi
title_original: カナン様はあくまでチョロい
description: Kanan, a female demon, infiltrates a high school with the goal of devouring some delicious human souls. She sets her sights on the perfect target, a teen boy named Kyougi Youji, and goes for the kill—only to somehow end up in a relationship with him instead?! Kanan’s never been in love before, and this oddly innocent demon creates absolute chaos as the two venture into romance with a first date and beyond! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Kanan Zebul
characters.description: Kanan Takakiyo, at first glance, is an ordinary teenage girl who is president of her high school's public morals committee. However, this is all a facade - her true identity is Kanan Zebel, a thousand-year-old demon who is the daughter of [Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/), the Great Demon of Gluttony. Eager to consume human souls, she descended to the human world and used hypnotism to convince an ordinary family that she was their firstborn - all so that she could find a student to consume. Her search brought her to [Youji Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/), her kohai in school who mistakenly believes she wants to go out with him. Unfortunately, there is one caveat to her plan... she has never been in a relationship before.

characters.name: Youji Kyougi
characters.description: A high school boy one year Kanan's junior. Kanan has chosen him as a target to devour his soul, but he mistakenly believes that she's confessing to him and becomes her boyfriend. Aggressively in love with Kanan.

characters.name: Jeanne
characters.description: Jeanne is one of the Lord's servants who descended from Heaven and is on a mission to protect Kyougi from demons.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Masurao
characters.description: She's a classmate of [Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/Kyougi-Youji) as well as his childhood friend. She doesn't like it when people call her Masurao because it comes off as manly.

characters.name: Ami
characters.description: Kanan’s childhood friend and loyal maid. As a succubus, she often takes… snack breaks daily.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.description: He's the father of Kanan, Miel and Miltie as well as the husband of Lillum.

characters.name: Lilim Zebul
characters.description: Lilim is the mother of [Kanan](https://anilist.co/character/282076/Zebul-Kanan), [Miel](https://anilist.co/character/318831/Zebul-Miel), and [Milch](https://anilist.co/character/318832/Zebul-Milch), as well as the wife of the [Great Demon Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/Beelzebub). She is afraid of men who are not her husband.

characters.name: Milch Zebul
characters.description: Milch is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the middle child of the Zebel family. She’s always interested in Kanan’s things, including her new boyfriend. The brattiest of the bratty little girls.

characters.name: Miel Zebul
characters.description: Miel is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the youngest child of the Zebel family. She is deeply fond of her oldest sister but gets a rush whenever she witnesses moments of proximity between Kanan and Youji. ~!In her free time, she streams online under the alias Honey Bunny.!~

characters.name: Kodagon
characters.description: She's the daughter of [Dagon](https://anilist.co/character/399870/), the man that [Lillum](https://anilist.co/character/318830/) rejected.

title: Comic Girls
description: The manga's story centers on the 15-year-old high school student and manga creator Kaoruko Moeta, who uses the pen name Chaos. After ranking at the bottom of a reader survey, Kaoruko's editor recommends that she enter an all-female dormitory for manga creators. Kaoruko's roommates are shoujo manga creator Koyume Koizuka, teen romance manga creator Ruki Irokawa, and shounen manga creator Tsubasa Katsuki. The girls support each other as they work to become better manga creators. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Ruki Irokawa
characters.description: A serialized "Teen's Love" manga artist. She originally wanted to draw cute animal manga for children, but her ability to draw big-breasted women led to her drawing erotic manga.

characters.name: Tsubasa Katsuki
characters.description: A serialized shounen manga artist with a boyish appearance. She will often put herself in the role of one of her characters in order to work on her manga. Because of her handsome appearance, other girls often fall in love with her, the most notable example of which is Koyume.

characters.name: Koyume Koizuka
characters.description: A shoujo manga artist who struggles with drawing boys. She develops a crush on Tsubasa. She has no experience in romance, so she is always nervous about the quality of her romantic manga and the nature of her "strange" feelings for Tsubasa as another girl.

characters.name: Kaoruko Moeta
characters.description: A shy 4-koma manga artist who moves into the Bunhousha Dormitory to improve her manga. As she looks much younger than she is, her appearance often becomes a reason for jokes and affection of others.

characters.name: Suzu Fuura
characters.description: A horror manga artist who enjoys the screams of others. Despite her odd behavior, she is rather pretty.

characters.name: Ririka Hanazono
characters.description: The housemother at Bunhousha Dormitory, ~! who is a former yuri manga artist. !~

characters.name: Miharu Nijino
characters.description: The strict homeroom teacher of Kaoruko's class.

characters.name: Mayu Amisawa
characters.description: Kaoruko's editor.

characters.name: Nyaos
characters.description: Nyaos was first seen to be afraid of Kaos-chan. Though when she picked her up, she became calm and collected and eventually, Kaos adopted her to be the dorm pet. She shares a lot of personality with Kaos, from her characteristics to her personality.

characters.name: Haruko Moeta
characters.description: Kaoruko's Mother.

title: Miru Tights
description: A rainy morning in April. Cherry blossoms are struck by the rain and floats in the puddle. High school students enter the school gate, carrying various colors of umbrellas. "Good morning, Ren," Yua greeted Ren, wearing wet tights in front of the shoe cupboard. When Ren faced her glumly, Homi, who was drenched, joined them as if she is jumping. The girls discuss the new semester. The girls live their irreplaceable school life as the seasons change. (Source: MAL News)

characters.name: Ren Aikawa
characters.description: She is close to Yua Nakabeni and Homi Moegi where she attends a class together with them at Yaegasumi High School. Ren works at the bar. The Bar Master states that there weren't many clients before Ren started to work there. Now, when she works there, the place is extremely busy. Likes 60 denier tights (opaque).

characters.name: Yua Nakabeni
characters.description: Yua is an honor student who is great at sports. Although she doesn't speak that much, she has excellent communication skills. She has long back hair and black eyes. Yua loves cosplay and posts her images in costumes on social media. Ren follows her profile. Likes 30 denier tights (sheer).

characters.name: Homi Moegi
characters.description: She is a close friend with Ren Aikawa and Yua Nakabeni, she attends a class together with them at Yaegasumi High School. Homi is very carefree and clumsy. She has a brother, Rui Moegi. Homi is a bright and active teenage girl. Throughout the series, it's pointed out that Moegi is wealthy as she goes to school in a car with a driver. She also has a younger brother, Rui Moegi who is in junior high school. Moreover, she's a member of the school's swimming club. Her favorite tights are 110 denier.

characters.name: Yuiko Okuzumi
characters.description: Homeroom teacher who is popular among the students. She is passionate about teaching and guiding her students, but can sometimes be overzealous. Outside of work, she likes to enjoy sake. She likes 20 denier tights (sheer).

characters.name: Master
characters.description: The master of a coffee shop where Ren works.

characters.name: Rui Moegi
characters.description: He is the brother of Homi Moegi.

title: Metallic Rouge
description: In a world where humans coexist with androids called Neans, a group known as the Immortal Nine rises up against society. Tasked with disposing of the revolters, a Nean named Rouge Redstar (aka Metal Rouge) and investigator Naomi Orthmann head to Mars to track them down…but first, Rouge wants some chocolate. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Rouge Redstar
characters.original: ルジュ・レッドスター
characters.description: A ten-year-old android who appears to be 17. Due to her actual age, she can be naive and have difficulty socializing, but she has a kind heart.

characters.name: Naomi Orthmann
characters.description: Naomi is an agent with the Department of Truth, whose job is to oversee android activity. While she seems lighthearted, she has a calm and rational approach. ~!It is later revealed that she is a nean created by the visitors.!~

characters.name: Gene Junghardt
characters.original: ジーン・ユングハルト
characters.description: Gene is the Deputy Chief of the Ministry of Truth. He is Rouge's older brother.

characters.name: Sarah Fitzgerald
characters.original: サラ・フィッツジェラルド
characters.description: Sarah is a well-known singer on Mars. ~!She is one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Purgatory Viola.!~

characters.name: Giallon Fate
characters.description: Giallon is a member of the nean-lead organization "Alter", which aims to overthrow human society. He is one of the Immortal Nine. Prioritizing hedonism and personal enjoyment over the organization's beliefs, Giallon is a pleasure-seeker possesses the ability to mimic and transform into a yellow gladiator.

characters.name: Jill Sturgeon
characters.description: Jill is a freelance journalist with strong communication skills and a cheerful personality. ~!She is actually one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Flash Silvia.!~

characters.name: Afdal Bashal
characters.original: アフダル・バシャール
characters.description: Afdal is a doctor who specializes in neans, known as a "tuner." He has a sharp tongue and an unsociable demeanor. However, he has solid skills and a strong sense of responsibility, earning trust from the neans. ~!He is one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Phantom Verde.!~

characters.name: Eden Varock
characters.description: Eden is a young man conducting investigations on war ruins on Mars. Although he claims it's research, it's unclear what he actually does with the items he acquires from the ruins. He has a carefree and light-hearted personality. ~!He is one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Jet Black Noir.!~

characters.name: Noid 262
characters.description: Noid 262 is an investigator nean working alongside Ash Stahl for the Guardianship Bureau. He is highly clever and extremely efficient in handling tasks, though there are still aspects of humanity that he hasn't fully grasped.

characters.name: Opera
characters.description: Opera serves under the Puppeteer.

title: Do It Yourself!!
title_original: Do It Yourself!! -どぅー・いっと・ゆあせるふ-
description: Building furniture and friendships have a lot in common. Intention, effort, and hard work are needed for both crafts. This is a story of girls in a DIY club building both as they carve out their futures. None of it comes easy, but that doesn’t stop any of ’em. Furniture, friendships, and the future—they’re building it all with their own hands! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Serufu Yua
characters.description: A laid-back first year of high school who grew up in a relaxed family. She has a delusional habit and soon becomes empty, hitting a wall or falling on the road and she is constantly injured. Even if the shirt sticks out, or if she has a terrible sleep, she doesn't care about "Oh, well!". Her hobby is graffiti.

characters.name: Miku Suride
characters.description: Serufu's childhood friend and neighbor who attends Yuyu Girls' Vocational High School for technology as a first-year student. She is nicknamed "Purin" by Serufu (and subsequently "Pudding" by Jobko) due to her habit of getting easily worked up and is often not honest about her feelings, particularly when it comes to Serufu.

characters.name: Rei Yasaku
characters.description: A third year student at Gatagata and head of the DIY Club. She has a strong passion for DIY, although this has led to some weird rumors about her around the school. Her family runs the Waku Waku Wan Wan hardware store.

characters.name: Takumi Hikage
characters.description: A shy first year student at Gatagata and Serufu's classmate, who also joins the DIY Club.

characters.name: Juliet Queen Elizabeth VIII
characters.original: ジュリエット・クイーン・エリザベス8世
characters.description: A 12-year-old child genius from America who ended up enrolling at Gatagata instead of Yuyu due to a kanji mixup and is staying at Miku's house. As she doesn't like her full name, she received the nickname "Jobko" from Serufu after she hears her say "Good job!". She uses her genius skills and state-of-the-art technology to assist with her DIY projects.

characters.name: Kokoro Kouki
characters.description: Miku's classmate at Yuyu who is very friendly and energetic. She grew up in Southeast Asia. Because she does not go to Gatagata, she cannot be an official member of the DIY Club and is instead an external member.

characters.name: Haruko Hoketsu
characters.description: The school nurse and DIY club advisor.

characters.name: Serufu no Haha
characters.description: Serufu's mother, who is just as laid back as her daughter.

title: Ura Sekai Picnic
description: Moments from death, Sorawo is saved by the mysterious Toriko in the Otherside. Attracted to its beauty, she soon discovers that this dimension is inhabited by monsters once thought imaginary. Joining with Toriko in her search for a missing friend, they set out to explore this nightmare-realm and maybe make a little money. What they encounter could bring enlightenment—or drive them mad! (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Sorawo Kamikoshi
characters.description: Sorawo is a shy, introverted person who usually prefers to be alone, not wanting to be bothered, and often keeps her distance from other people. There had been a time where she tried to make friends during her early years in university, attending a few parties, but in the end, she couldn't keep up, and it was too exhausting for her, so she decided to be on her own instead. When forced into a conversation or meeting people for the first time, she tends to end up flustered or talk excessively.

characters.name: Toriko Nishina
characters.description: Although she appeared mysterious at first, Toriko is known as upbeat and energetic most of the time, especially when around Sorawo Kamikoshi and Kozakura (to the point Kozakura finds her annoying). She was friendly upon meeting Sorawo, and dropped honorifics immediately after introducing herself to her. She'd been comfortable with Sorawo ever since, certain that they would get along well. She is carefree, not holding herself back when she and Sorawo explores the Otherside or when they celebrate post-expedition. She prefers addressing with no honorific to people she thinks she's friends or close with. She is also reliable and would often be the one to act or think fast during situations to aid Sorawo when needed.

characters.name: Akari Seto
characters.description: Akari Seto is a first year at the same university that Sorawo Kamikoshi attends, she is also a karate practitioner.

characters.name: Kozakura
characters.description: Kozakura is a reclusive researcher who lives near Shakujii Park and a college friend of Satsuki Uruma. Kozakura She also buys off the items that Sorawo and Toriko acquire from the Otherside and trades them to DS Lab later on. She is also their consultant regarding anything 'Otherside' related.

characters.name: Natsumi Ichikawa
characters.description: Natsumi Ichikawa is Akari Seto's childhood and best friend. After graduating from high school, Natsumi chose not to continue her studies and work at her family's car mechanic factory. After Sorawo and Toriko helped her, she undertook the modification of the AP-1.

title: Shuumatsu no Izetta
description: If I am promised to the princess, then I will fight for her sake. In 1939 C.E., the imperialist nation of Germania invaded a neighboring country. All at once, that war spread throughout Europe, and the era was dragged into a spiral of a great war. Then, in 1940, Germania's attack turned towards the Principality of Eylstadt, a small Alps country abundant with beautiful water and greenery. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Izetta
characters.description: Descendant of a witch family that has been inheriting mysterious powers from generation to generation. She can endow magical powers to the things she touches with her hands and manipulate them at will. In order to hide that power, she has been traveling around Europe with her grandmother since she was a baby.

characters.name: Ortfiné Fredericka von Eylstadt
characters.original: オルトフィーネ・フリーレリカ・フォン・エイルシュタット
characters.description: She is the only daughter and successor of the head of the principality of Eylstadt, Rudolph the 3rd. Thanks to her wisdom and kindness from when she was young, she has gained the love of not only the retainers but also the public. Because her father has fallen ill, she has been busy preparing against Germania's invasion in his stead.

characters.name: Sieghart Müller
characters.original: ジークハート・ミューラ

characters.name: Arnold Berckmann
characters.original: アーノルド・ベルクマン

characters.name: Elvira Friedmann
characters.original: エルヴィラ・フリードマン

characters.name: Hans Obermayer
characters.original: ハンス・オーベルマイヤー
characters.description: A major in the Eylstadt army.

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Season 2
title_original: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー Season 2
description: All eyes are on Toukai Teiou as she takes on the Japanese Derby, ready to gallop in Symboli Rudolf's footsteps and become an undefeated Triple Crown Horse Girl. The stands are full. The track is set. It's time to see which horse girl fortune favors! (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Toukai Teiou
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer. A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

characters.name: Mejiro McQueen
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady. Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

characters.name: Special Week
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream. Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

characters.name: Gold Ship
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else! An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

characters.name: Daiwa Scarlet
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose. Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

characters.name: Vodka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold. Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate, Daiwa Scarlet.

characters.name: Trainer
characters.description: Trainer of Team Spica.

characters.name: Silence Suzuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier. An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

characters.name: Rice Shower
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook. A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

characters.name: Symboli Rudolf
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute! Well-versed in both ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body, she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy. She seeks to be a model Umamusume, and as such, is keenly aware of the example that she sets. Her dream is to foster a new era in which all Umamusume can live in true happiness. She is especially admired by Tokai Teio.

characters.name: Maruzensky
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Keeping it old-school! A real hot rod! A dashing Umamusume with a sisterly demeanor and a retro way of speaking. She is a speed demon who adores the pure joy of the wind in her face. On the road, her hot rod is the one burning rubber, but in a race, it's her own two feet tearing up the track. Despite her tremendous power, she isn't pompous, and is well-liked by everyone. In Uma Musume: Pretty Derby she is member of Team Rigil.

characters.name: Narita Brian
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf. A member of team Rigil. A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf. She has little interest in anything besides running, which she does only to quench her own endless thirst. Off the racecourse, she is [Biwa Hayahide's](https://anilist.co/character/174851/Biwa-Hayahide) little sister and, for some reason, a student council vice president.

title: Shunkashuutou Daikousha: Haru no Mai
title_original: 春夏秋冬代行者 春の舞
title_en: Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Spring
description: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Hinagiku Kayou
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Agent of Spring __Power:__ Life Stimulation Hinagiku went missing for around ten years, taking the season of spring with her. ~!She's been in love with [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki) since childhood.!~ ~!She later reunites with Rosei and enters a relationship with him. Because she sees herself as a different person from before her kidnapping, Rosei begins calling her 'Hina'—a nickname only he is allowed to use.!~

characters.name: Sakura Himedaka
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Guard of Spring A young woman who cherishes [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo) greatly as her best friend and retainer. She falls into despair after Hinagiku's kidnapping and cuts ties with the Agent of Winter, [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki), and his Guard, [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu), soon afterwards, despite her lingering feelings for Itecho. ~!After Hinagiku's return, Sakura gradually lets the Winter duo back into her and Hinagiku's lives once the four reunite, internally accepting her feelings for Itecho and becoming closer to him in the process.!~

characters.name: Rosei Kantsubaki
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Agent of Winter __Power:__ Life Coagulation A young man who's heart was hardened after [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo)'s kidnapping. His Guard is [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu), a trusted older brother figure of his since childhood. He is known to be rash with his powers, using them to protect others rather than to solely bring Winter. ~!Rosei begins a relationship with Hinagiku after reuniting with her. Out of consideration for Hinagiku's assertion that she is different from her old self, he begins to call her 'Hina', a nickname she only allows Rosei to use.!~

characters.name: Itechou Kangetsu
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Guard of Winter A calm and gentle young man who been at [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki)'s side since he was a teenager. He treats Rosei like his own younger brother and cares deeply for [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka), a girl he once tutored in the duties of a Guard before [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo)'s kidnapping. ~!Itecho later realizes his feelings for Sakura after mistakenly believing that she intended to marry a Spring Administration Official.!~

characters.name: Ruri Hazakura
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Agent of Summer __Power:__ Life Operation She is cheery and sweet but always argues with her elder twin sister, Ayame.

characters.name: Ayame Hazakura
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Guard of Summer Ruri's elder sister and retainer. She plans on quitting as a Guard once she marries. Ruri has pushed her around since they were kids, but she wishes her only the best.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Iwaizuki
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Agent of Autumn __Power:__ Life Putrefaction The newest and youngest of the Agents. She is greatly fond and trusting of [Rindo](https://anilist.co/character/320098/Azami-Rindo).

characters.name: Rindo Azami
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Guard of Autumn He thinks he sees his Guard role as only a job, but it doesn't look so from the outside. Obliviously overprotective of [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/320099/Iwaizuki-Nadeshiko).

characters.name: Koubai Yukiyanagi
characters.description: [Hinagiku's](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayou) mother

characters.name: Nazuna
characters.description: She's a little girl who [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka) met while heading to Mount Ryugu. She's the first person to witness the return of Spring.

title: Sounan desu ka?
description: Because of a plane crash … starting today, we're spending the springtime of our lives on a desert island!! There's nothing here, so we have to make everything!! And eat everything!! (Ugh!) Check out our high-school-girl survival story of courage and knowledge. We're actually doing pretty well! We learn how to eat cicadas, how to build traps, a simple allergy test, how to eat hermit crabs, etc. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Homare Onishima
characters.description: She is solemn high school girl in Class 2-F at first glance, she is the survival specialist of the group being taught by her father since her childhood.

characters.name: Asuka Suzumori
characters.description: Asuka Suzumori is the cheery and athletic girl of the group who is a member of the basketball club while also helping out the track-and-field club, making her the second athletic next to Homare Onishima.

characters.name: Mutsu Amatani
characters.description: Mutsu Amatani is the shy academic girl of the group. Highly intelligent, she ranked first in her school year. Her hobbies are reading novels and cooking, Mutsu dreams to become a yaoi writer in the future

characters.name: Shion Kujou
characters.description: Shion Kujo is the rich and spoiled girl of the group. Being raised in a rich environment, she frequently whines which results in her sometimes embarrassing herself. Initially distrustful at [Homare Onishima](https://anilist.co/character/136411/) at first, she gradually warms up to the group while adjusting to her current stranded life.

characters.name: Jouichi Onishima
characters.description: He is the father of Homare Onishima.

title: CITY THE ANIMATION
description: This town, is not just a normal town. There's laughter, love and emotional moments. An unpredictable ordinary life presented by the residents. Exciting stuffs come one after another. Welcome to CITY. (Source: Kyoto Animation)

characters.name: Midori Nagumo
characters.description: Midori Nagumo is an energetic and headstrong college student who recently moved to the City. She hates responsibility and avoids it at all costs. Her best friend is [Niikura](https://anilist.co/character/127011/Niikura), whom she constantly pesters for money. She's usually identifiable by her ponytail and blue hoodie. Her irrational behavior annoys everyone around her.

characters.name: Niikura
characters.description: Niikura is Nagumo's best friend and roommate. Nagumo constantly asks her for money. She is more responsible than Nagumo, but her constant dealing with Nagumo's antics has left her with a short temper. She owns a yellow scooter that she rides around the City. She is an aspiring photographer.

characters.name: Wako Izumi
characters.description: Wako Izumi is an air-headed young lady who is never seen without a smile. She is often engrossed in minor things, completely ignoring her surroundings and oblivious to both obstacles and her mistakes.

characters.name: Tsurubishi Makabe
characters.description: The owner and head chef of Makabe's Western Bistro. He has a nonchalant, apathetic attitude, and doesn't care enough to deal with details. Despite his apparent lack of motivation, everyone knows that he won't put up with disobedience. He ends up hiring an unwilling Nagumo when Tatewaku tells him she offered to work for the restaurant. Also known as "Chef Makabe" for simplicity's sake. (Source: CITY Wiki)

characters.name: Tatewaku Makabe
characters.description: Tsurubishi's son. Before Nagumo worked at the Restaurant, he had to spend much of his free time helping his father. Now he dedicates his time to Soccer Club. He's a bit of a pushover. Often the target of Dr. Adatara's elaborate pranks.

characters.name: Matsuri Makabe
characters.description: A student in class 2A at CITY South Middle School. She is close friends with [Eri](https://anilist.co/character/180155/Eri-Amakazari) and the younger sister of [Tatewaku.](https://anilist.co/character/180033/Tatewaku-Makabe)

characters.name: Eri Amakazari
characters.description: A student in class 2A at CITY South Middle School and close friend of [Matsuri](https://anilist.co/character/180159)

characters.name: Riko Izumi
characters.description: Riko Izumi is a student in class 2-3 at CITY South High School and [Wako Izumi's](https://anilist.co/character/127010/Wako-Izumi) younger sister. She is often seen to be sleep-deprived and would often fall asleep whenever given the chance. Unbeknownst to her, she is able to capture the hearts of everyone who interacts with her in the city, even garnering a fan club composed of various city residents in an attempt to smooth out any potential conflict from anyone striving after their mutual crush. Despite her obliviousness of her surroundings thanks to her usual lack of sleep, she seems to have an affinity with robotics, as she have constructed several robots in her youth and have even shown to be a capable hacker, a skill that her sister relied upon to disable the machine utilized by the [Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/180034/Tsurubishi-Makabe)-[Adatara](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Adatara Hakase
characters.description: Grandfather of the Adatara family and inventor.

characters.name: Adatara no Chichi
characters.description: Father of the Adatara family liquor store. He is considered the brains of the CITY Triumvirate.

characters.name: Adatara no Haha
characters.description: The powerful mother of the Adatara family liquor store.

characters.name: Tatsuta Adatara
characters.description: Oldest son of the Adatara family. He used to play soccer until he inherited the family liquor store.

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギア
description: With the coming of spring, Hibiki Tachibana and Miku Kohinata start their first year in high school school at the prestigious Lydian Music Academy. That their idol, the singer Tsubasa Kazanari, also attends Lydian is just an added bonus. Neither of them know that their lives are about to change forever. Neither of them know that the first, awakening beat is almost upon them. (Source: Rightstuf)

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kanade Amou
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/51733/Kazanari-Tsubasa).

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Ryoko Sakurai
characters.description: Head Scientist of the Mobile Disaster Response Corps and creator of the Symphogear. She has the ability to form powerful force-fields. She tends to display some sexual tendencies towards Hibiki. Her loyalties are somehow questionable, as she concerns herself more over the Symphogears and armors. ~!She is soon revealed to be the main antagonist, Finé, who had possessed Ryoko's body long ago to use the power of Kadingir to destroy the moon and bring about chaos on the earth.!~

characters.name: Shinji Ogawa
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari; he works as Tsubasa's manager on the scenes.

characters.name: Sakuya Fujitaka
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.name: Aoi Tomosato
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.name: Yumi Itaba
characters.description: During most of her appearances throughout the series, she is mostly seen referring to anime, using phrases like, "What is this—an anime?"

title: Yuru Yuri♪♪
description: The girls of the Amusement Club return in Yuru Yuri♪♪, finding new ways to make passing time even more enjoyable. Their members consist of the always energetic Kyouko Toshinou; calm and sensible Yui Funami; polite but often overlooked Akari Akaza; and Chinatsu Yoshikawa, who stumbled upon the others while looking for the Tea Ceremony Club. Together they are the Amusement Club, which has the deceptively simple task of keeping its members entertained. Along with the Student Council and the odd family member, they strive to enjoy their youth to the fullest. Whether it's a trip to a hot spring or finishing overdue homework, their lives are never dull, and they will always find an excuse to spend time together. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Mirakurun
characters.description: The character in a manga that Kyoko likes. She is known to always battle Rivarun.

characters.name: Rivarun
characters.description: The antagonist of the fictional anime Miracalun, she is an alien invader who plans to conquer earth, and Miracalun's mentor and friend.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

characters.name: Chizuru Ikeda
characters.description: [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/35877/Chitose-Ikeda)'s twin sister. Her personality is pretty much the opposite of Chitose's nice and ditsy nature. When she takes her glass off her yuri goggles activate and she starts drooling. She seems to be fond of the Ayano/Chitose pairing. She has a love for Chitose while she dislikes Kyōko as she constantly tries to play pranks on her and is seemingly a barrier against her fantasies.

title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau
title_original: ささやくように恋を唄う
description: After performing a song at her school’s opening ceremony, musician Yori Asanagi receives an apparent love confession from freshman Himari Kino. But just as Yori decides she wants to return Himari’s feelings, Himari reveals that she did not “love” her, but “admires” her! But you can’t unring a bell once struck, and Yori is determined to make Himari fall for her, not just her music. Will their hearts ever beat as one, or will their love fall out of tune? (Source: HIDIVE)

characters.name: Himari Kino
characters.description: Himari is a very joyous, cheerful girl and often likened to a puppy by other characters. She is able to instantly befriend anyone, even hard to approach characters like [Shiho](https://anilist.co/character/215602/Izumi-Shiho). Himari is always wanting the best for her friends and cheering them on in whatever they pursue.

characters.name: Yori Asanagi
characters.description: A third year high school student who sings while playing guitar at the school rooftops and loves collecting cat merchandise. She is also a part of the "SS Girls" band in which she is positioned as the guitarist and vocalist.

characters.name: Miki Mizuguchi
characters.description: She is part of the brass band club who indirectly helps [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari)'s and [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori)'s relationship by collecting information.

characters.name: Shiho Izumi
characters.description: She is a third-year high school student and the main vocalist for the band Laureley.

characters.name: Momoka Satomiya
characters.description: She is a second year and President of the Culinary Research Club, she is also Laureley's bassist.

characters.name: Mari Tsutsui
characters.description: She is a third-year student and drummer in SS GIRLS.

characters.name: Kaori Tachibana
characters.description: She is a third-year student and keyboardist in SS GIRLS.

characters.name: Aki Mizuguchi
characters.description: Aki is a third year high school student and the bassist for the SS Girls. She is best friends with [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori) and was one of the first people to encourage her to pursue [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari). ~!Yori and Aki are best friends. Aki sometime after they became friends fell in love with her, having wanted several times to take an "extra step" but decided to not confess her feelings and only stay by her side as a friend in fear of losing their current relationship.!~

characters.name: Hajime Amasawa
characters.description: She is a third year high school student and Laureley's drummer.

characters.name: Kyou Amasawa
characters.description: A violinist. She is [Hajime's](https://anilist.co/character/217319) older sister. ~!She passed away in an accident when she was young.!~

title: Kanojo mo Kanojo Season 2
description: After their hot springs trip, Naoya continues his relationships with both Saki and Nagisa. Bringing along Milika (who kissed Naoya) and Shino (who secretly has romantic feelings for Naoya), they embark on a summer vacation full of romance with a fireworks festival, camping, and Okinawa. Milika's younger sister Risa also appears, making the romance in this neo-standard rom-com heat up even more. A season two filled with summer and swimsuits is about to begin! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Naoya Mukai
characters.description: **Height:** 170 cm (5'7") Naoya is considered to be a very straightforward and outgoing person. His straightforward personality is very explicit and knows no bounds; Naoya is straightforward regardless of his situation, be it in front of the mass crowd or in private with his girlfriends. Additionally, Naoya can be considered slightly selfish for he openly asks his first girlfriend, [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki), whether he can two-time her and go out with [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa). Despite his two-timing behavior, Naoya would do his best to keep himself to only two girlfriends, as seen by constantly rejecting and fending off [Hoshizaki Mirika](https://anilist.co/character/182020/Rika-Hoshizaki) despite her persistent behavior to gain his affection. He would also protect his relationship from all compromise, as seen wit

characters.name: Saki Saki
characters.description: **Height:** 161 cm (5'3") Saki Saki is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa). Saki is stated to be a cheerful and energetic girl. She is also an emotional, naive and forgetful girl. She excels in sports and can be openly aggressive against anyone, mostly Mukai Naoya, whose actions are a bit too much.

characters.name: Nagisa Minase
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm (5'1") Minase Nagisa is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886) Nagisa is shown to be a collected, considerate and humble girl. She seems to have no talent, often working hard to stay on her classmates average. Despite her considerate personality, she would resort to underhanded tactics, even to the point of cheating, to preserve her relationship with Mukai Naoya. Nagisa has been shown to have a lack of talent in singing and sports.

characters.name: Rika Hoshizaki
characters.description: Hoshizaki Rika, also known as her alternate name Mirika, is a popular virtual content creator on MeTube, and is persistently pursuing over [Naoya's](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) affection for her. She is a first year high school student who attends the same school as [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki) and Naoya.

characters.name: Shino Kiryuu
characters.description: Shino is a close friend of [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki). They are in the same class and the same after school club. Shino is serious and considerate, and also academically talented, being the top scoring student at school. ~!After learning [Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) and Saki Saki were both on a two-time relationship with [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa), she decided to expose their relationship, and attempt to end it, in order to help Saki, believing it was hurting her feelings. However she also has feelings for Naoya, and started to have doubts about hiding her feelings or not.!~

characters.name: Risa Hoshizaki
characters.description: She is Rika Hoshizaki's sister.

title: Netsuzou Trap: NTR
description: Yuma and Hotaru have been friends since childhood. It is only natural that when Yuma is nervous about her new boyfriend, she asks Hotaru along with her boyfriend for a double date. But when Hotaru offers herself to Yuma as "practice," both girls realize that they're more interested in each other than they are in their own boyfriends. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Yuma Okazaki
characters.description: Yuma is in her second year of high school with her childhood and best friend Hotaru. She is in a relationship with Takeda, but she's very inexperienced as he's her first boyfriend and often times asks Hotaru for advice but gets unexpected responses instead.

characters.name: Hotaru Mizushina
characters.description: Hotaru is Yuma's childhood and best friend. Yuma was always around to protect her from various things such as bullying at school, but over time she has changed and even ended up having many boyfriends (though Yuma noticed she seemed uninterested).

characters.name: Fujiwara
characters.description: Fujiwara is Hotaru's ex boyfriend, and is friends with Takeda.

characters.name: Takeda
characters.description: Takeda is a classmate and friend of Hotaru, and is Yuma's first boyfriend. He comes across as a friendly, understanding guy who is aware of his girlfriend's shyness, and does his best to remedy the situation.

title: Konohana Kitan
description: The manga's story is set in Kokohana-tei, a hot spring hotel located in an inn town between our world and the other world, where many people go to visit. The story portrays the lives of fox spirits, who take the form of girls and work at the hotel. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Yuzu
characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm The protagonist of the story. An innocent and hardworking country fox. She was brought up by Bikuni, and has a rather extensive knowledge of things.

characters.name: Satsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Yuzu's fellow attendant at Konohanatei; chosen to act as her mentor by head attendant Kiri. She's also Yuzu's roommate.

characters.name: Kiri
characters.description: __Species:__ Kitsune __Height:__ 147 cm The head attendant at Konohanatei. She has a relatively down-to-earth disposition.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 125 cm One of Yuzu's fellow attendants at Konohatei. She's the quiet type, and has an unconventional way of doing her job.

characters.name: Ren
characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm One of [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/123777/Yuzu)'s fellow attendants at Konohatei. She's more cynical than she seems.

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm One of Yuzu's fellow attendants at Konohatei. She has the most lax attitude towards the job out of them all. The most energetic of the attendants, her appearance, body, personality and behavior are all boyish to the point where she is at times outright mistaken for a boy at first glance.

characters.name: Hiiragi
characters.description: The white-haired priestess sister of Satsuki.

characters.name: Tsubaki
characters.description: The owner of Konohanatei.

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 2wei!
title_original: Fate/kaleid linerプリズマ☆イリヤ ツヴァイ！
description: With great powers come great responsibilities, and that includes cleaning up the aftermath of your previous adventures. Which means that, instead of getting a break after saving the world, newly changed magical girls Illya and Miyu have to help deal with the side-effects caused by the sealing of the Ley Cards. Still, that shouldn't be too hard, right? Wrong! Not only are the ley lines failing, but to make matters worse, Illya somehow ends up with a magical clone… and that sinister clone has plans of her own! Worse yet, since the "dark" version of herself is drawing its power from the same source as our heroine, Illya's own powers are being reduced proportionately. These are definitely not the kind of problems that the average girl should have to deal with. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
characters.original: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Daughter of the distinguished lineage of magi of the Edelfelt, Luvia is their young and talented family head. A student in Clock Tower, the Mage's Association academy, she is one of the candidates for the position of student's president for the current academic term. As long as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) is not nearby, Luvia's attitude is always graceful, never blaspheming and with a beauty similar to a swan. Of course, that is just a facade and she is actually very competitive and suffers with perfectionist tendencies. Luvia has long golden blonde hair styled entirely in large coils. She physically resembles Rin somewhat, furthering speculation that the younger Edelfelt sister from the Third Holy Grail War may have married into the Tohsaka family. She is from Finland.

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.original: クロエ・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card. ~!She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Taiga Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother. She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps fr

characters.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm __Sidearm:__ Thompson contender in conjunction with his Mystic Code Origin Bullets [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire. During his lifetime, Kiritsugu was disillusioned with becoming a Hero of Justice, a defender of humanity who could save everyone. Although he feels he failed to do so, his efforts were a source of inspiration for Shirou. Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. Although he was a magus with Magic Circuits and abilities he was considered unorthodox in that he would utilize modern technology and weaponry along with his magecraft to track down and kill magi. Although mentioned and seen in flashbacks in Fate/stay night, Kiritsugu is one of the main protagonists in its prequel Fa

characters.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
characters.original: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

characters.name: Bazett Fraga McRemitz
characters.original: バゼット・フラガ・マクレミッツ
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm Bazett is a serious, kind, and hardworking individual who possesses a strong sense of justice. She can be short-tempered, but calculating. While she presents herself as a strong-willed and mature woman with an independent streak, she is actually rather lonely. Bazett had always intended to summon [Cú Chulainn](https://anilist.co/character/499/Chulainn-C) for the Fifth Holy Grail War. The reason behind her motive was her desire to save him since childhood. Having had a dispassionate and socially desolate childhood, Bazett found herself immersed with the story of Cú Chulainn. She grieved for the tragedy of his legend, but at the same time felt that it gave her a sense of purpose. She strove to become a strong magus, gambling on the wild hope of summoning him and using the Holy Grail as a means of "saving" him from his inevitable fate. Bazett was born in a coastal village

characters.name: Leysritt
characters.description: Leysritt is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid much like Sella. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Regardless of her thin ego, she developed a sense of reason due to her alignment with Illya. As a result, Leysritt often says what she thinks without any consideration and this gets her often into a verbal conflict with Sella. She and Illya are actually very close friends and should Illya die, Leysritt would die as well. In contrast to Sella, she possesses a casual personality but has difficulty expressing her emotions and comes across as robotic at times. However, she appears to enjoy teasing Sella and also takes a liking to Shirou because his presence makes Illya happy.

characters.name: Sella
characters.description: Sella is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid and to teach Illya sorcery. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Sella is highly protective of Illya, whom she loves and cares for deeply, and thus is very suspicious of Shirou Emiya. Despite her apparent coldness to everyone but Illya, Sella is actually rather fickle and insecure, particularly about her body, and Leysritt and Illya often tease Sella for her harsh personality.

title: sin: Nanatsu no Taizai
description: In the story, the prideful archangel Lucifer disobeys God and is cast into the lowest level of hell as a fallen angel. On her way to hell, Lucifer happens to meet a high school girl on Earth named Maria, who helps her. In hell, Lucifer meets Leviathan, and Leviathan explains to Lucifer about The Seven Deadly Sins, the seven demon king rulers of hell. After The Seven Deadly Sins seal Lucifer's powers, Lucifer goes on a journey with Maria and Leviathan to defeat them. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Leviathan
characters.description: Leviathan is the Demon Lord of Envy, known for inciting jealousy amongst others.

characters.name: Lucifer
characters.description: Lucifer is the Demon King of Pride, known for being defiant against others. Formerly the first of the Archangels of Heaven and one of the Seven Lively Virtues, she was denounced and cast out of Heaven for her growing pride and rebellion against the will of God. After battling the Seven Mortal Sins for the first time, she is cursed by Belial with the Garb of Punishment, a barbed tattoo-like body-chain empowered by the Seven Sins which torments her with constant pain and blood-letting.

characters.name: Maria Totsuka
characters.description: A teenage human girl who initially encounters Lucifer during a brief stopover in the middle of her descent to Hell. Possesses an unusual gift of sight, which enable her to see celestial and demonic beings. Maria becomes Lucifer's unwilling servant when Lucifer rips out her heart, granting her immortality and eternal youth. At their first encounter, Lucifer also infused Maria with a part of her angel's blood, enabling her to find her offenders in order to exact revenge on them.

characters.name: Belphegor
characters.description: As the representation of Sloth, the laziest and easy-going of the Mortal Sins with white hair, mouse-like ears and two tiger-striped antelope-type horns. Her favorite hobby is playing on a smartphone.

characters.name: Mina
characters.description: Maria's playful, flirtatious schoolmate and best friend. She does not share Maria's talent and therefore does not believe in the existence of angels and demons.

characters.name: Satan
characters.description: Representing Wrath, Satan is a fiery, red-headed Demon Lord thirsting for the thrill of personal combat.

characters.name: Mammon
characters.description: The Demon Lord of Greed who attempts to employ every opportunity to make a winning, specializing in real estates and the sale of home-brewed magical potions. Her greed is partially founded by the actions of her unnamed husband, who saddled her with 500,000 children and a load of debts on her shoulders.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.description: Beelzebub represents the sin of gluttony. Despite her slight figure, she is the most voracious of the Seven Sins. She is physically distinguished by one single horn, similar to an alicorn, growing from the center of her forehead.

characters.name: Astaroth
characters.description: Astaroth represents the sin of melancholy. The weakest of the seven sins, she gains her followers by becoming a popular singer through uploading songs online. She dislikes fighting, and often tries to speak through rapping.

characters.name: Belial
characters.description: The Demon Lord of Vanity, and the ruler of the Seven Mortal Sins until Lucifer's arrival. Her most distinguishing feature are her heterochromatic eyes, of which the left one is ruby red while the right one sports a golden iris.

characters.name: Asmodeus
characters.description: As the representative of Lust, she is the most lecherous of the Seven Sins.

characters.name: Michael
characters.description: The Angel of Faith, whose power level rivals that of Lucifer. Michael is fiercely loyal and has a hot-blooded personality, but despite her potential, her abilities aren't very developed yet and so she dislikes feeling inferior to her companions. Michael loves egg-based dishes, and she's especially fond of omelettes.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo Season 2
title_original: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 Season2
title_en: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Season 2
description: A.S.122... An era when a multitude of corporations have entered space and built a huge economic system. After transferring to the Asticassia School of Technology from the planet Mercury, Suletta Mercury has experienced a school life filled with encounters and excitement, as both Miorine Rembran's bridegroom and a member of GUND-ARM, Inc. It has been two weeks since the incident at Plant Quetta. Suletta passes her days at the school, anticipating her reunion with Miorine. Miorine, meanwhile, has stationed herself at the head office of the Benerit Group, monitoring her father's condition. The two are about to face new hardships and pressing decisions. Each with her own feelings in her heart, the girls will confront the mighty curse the Gundam brings. (Source: GUNDAM.INFO, edited)

characters.name: Suletta Mercury
characters.original: スレッタ・マーキュリー
characters.description: A second-year student in the piloting department, who transferred to the school from Mercury. Suletta is timid and somewhat lacks communication skills. She is the pilot of the Gundam Aerial developed on Mercury. ~!Suletta was one of the repli-children created from Ericht Samaya. However, according to official records, she had a deceased father. As Aliya Mahvash mentioned when she told her fortune, she learned that her father had passed away when she was a young child.!~

characters.name: Miorine Rembran
characters.original: ミオリネ・レンブラン
characters.description: An attractive and academically distinguished second-year student in the management strategy department. Miorine is the only daughter of Delling Rembran, the president of the Beneritt Group and chairman of the school's board. She has a strong rebellious feeling towards her father. Miorine has shown an interest in gardening in her spare time, with an apparent focus on tomatoes. (Source: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Official Site)

characters.name: Elan Ceres
characters.description: A pilot fielded by Peil Technologies—one of the "Big Three" corporations within the Benerit Group. A third-year student in the Piloting Department at the Asticassia School of Technology (Student ID: KP002), he is also a member of the Duel Committee. He pilots the Zowort and the Gundam Pharact. Although he is the top-ranked student in the Peil dormitory, he remains a solitary figure who does not open up to anyone at the academy. Perhaps due to this, his only real point of contact was [Shaddiq Zenelli](https://anilist.co/character/279509/Shaddiq-Zenelli)—a fellow member of the Duel Committee with strong communication skills. Later, however, he developed an interest in [Suletta Mercury](https://anilist.co/character/279507/Suletta-Mercury), and upon seeing the mobile suit Suletta pilots—the Aerial—he correctly identified it as a GUND-ARM. As noted above, he embodies a sense of "solitary deta

characters.name: Guel Jeturk
characters.description: An heir to Jeturk Heavy Machinery, one of the group's three branches, and a third-year student in the piloting department. Guel has a rough temperament and is quick to anger. As the ace pilot of Jeturk House, he has absolute confidence in his own skills. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Shaddiq Zenelli
characters.description: An adopted child of the CEO of Grassley Defense Systems, one of the group's three branches. A third-year student in the piloting department who leads Grassley House. Although still a student Shaddiq has shown his skill in business too, he is a candidate for next generation executive. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Nika Nanaura
characters.description: A second-year student in the mechanical department, who belongs to Earth House. She loves mecha and is very curious about Suletta's Gundam Aerial. Nika has outstanding maintenance skills and is proud of herself for customizing Chuchu's Demi Trainer. ~!At some point, Nika was acquainted with Dawn of Fold and become part of the group, with [Naji](https://anilist.co/character/307149/Hija-Geor-Naji) acting as a Father figure for her.!~~!Nika joined the Asticassia School of Technology under a promise of [Shaddiq](https://anilist.co/character/279509/Zenelli-Shaddiq) with the condition of be a go-between agent between Dawn of Fold and his Faction.!~

characters.name: Chuatury Panlunch
characters.original: チュアチュリー・パンランチ
characters.description: Chuchu is a troubled young girl, who is an Earthian facing discrimination from a significant portion of the Spacians who look down on Earthians as underlings. Being in the same school as many Spacians, she along with her Earthian friends has been the subject of regular abuse and harassment. This along with her home people being the subject of Spacian oppression and exploitation has given Chuchu a profoundly negative impression of all Spacians often deriding them as "Shitty Spacians" and lashing at them at the first opportunity. Because of the harsh circumstances of her growth and her present situation, Chuchu is rather hot-headed and prone to pick fights, especially with Spacians who harass or torment others for fun or classism. Chuchu sees herself as someone who carries the burdens and hopes of her home people and is sympathetic to those who carry similar struggles.

characters.name: Nugen
characters.description: One of the four co-CEOs who manage Peil Technologies, one of the Benerit Group's three branches, via a parliamentary system.

characters.name: Rouji Chante
characters.description: A first-year mechanic in the Burion House. He belongs to the Dueling Committee. He is familiar with mobile crafts and other mecha, and always carries his own modified Haro. In stark contrast to Cecelia—who resides in the same Brion Dorm—he is exceptionally quiet and shows very little emotional range. He is utterly indifferent toward anything that fails to capture his interest; combined with hiss reserved nature, he is so unobtrusive that, even when present, he might as well be part of the background. That said, he diligently carries out his duties for the "Duel Committee" and provide highly accurate analyses. He is a serious person who truly embodies the principle of "actions speak louder than words."

characters.name: Delling Rembran
characters.original: デリング・レンブラン
characters.description: The president of the Benerit Group, and supervising representative of the auditing organization Cathedra.

characters.name: Lauda Neill
characters.description: Lauda Neill is in his third year of the pilot program. He is the deputy head of the Jeturk House. He is a half-brother to Guel, and although they are in the same grade, he is the younger brother. Unlike his older brother, he is calm and rational.

characters.name: Sarius Zenelli
