characters.description: The CEO of Grassley Defense Systems, one of the Benerit Group's three branches.

title: Watashi wo Tabetai, Hitodenashi
title_original: 私を喰べたい、ひとでなし
title_en: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
description: Hinako lives alone by the sea, quietly drifting through life after losing her family years ago. One day, a mermaid named Shiori saves her from a monster and says she’s come to eat her—just not yet. Until then, Shiori will stay by her side and keep her safe. In that moment, a deep hope swells in Hinako: Maybe this girl can finally grant her the ending she’s been waiting for. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Hinako Yaotose
characters.description: A High school girl living a quiet life in a seaside town, but she feels somewhat detached from her friends during the summer months. She lost her family on a trip when she was six years old. She has a deep, logical, calm and introverted personality. Rarely, she attracts aggressive monsters to her, including sea monsters from the shore. She seems to have signs of PTSD.

characters.name: Shiori Oumi
characters.description: The new transfer student and [Hinako Yaotose](https://anilist.co/character/250490/Yaotose-Hinako)'s classmate who's secretly a Mermaid. She enrolled to the same academy as Hinako even before summer break with the intent to eat Hinako. She has translucent eyes which resembles the ocean. She has an insightful, mysterious and refined personality.

characters.name: Miko Yashiro
characters.description: An energetic girl who happens to be [Hinako](https://anilist.co/character/250490/Yaotose-Hinako)'s classmate and childhood friend. However, she is often sick and therefore, absent from school. After "the incident", Miko was the only one to treat Hinako normally. She dislikes [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/259352/Oumi-Shiori), but is not necessarily enemies with her. ~!She appears to be human, but she is in fact a fox spirit with an appetite for human flesh. She calls in sick to fight her instinct to eat other humans. After failing to protect the rest of Hinako's family, she tasked herself with protecting Hinako from other monsters.!~

characters.name: Iso-Onna
characters.description: A youkai that tries to attack Hinako.

characters.name: Oba
characters.description: She took in Hinako after the accident.

characters.name: Mutsuki Yaotose
characters.description: Hinako's older brother. He died in an accident along with their parents.

characters.name: Yuri Yaotose
characters.description: Hinako's late mother.

characters.name: Daichi Yaotose
characters.description: Hinako's late father.

title: Kimi no Koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season
title_original: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女 第3期
title_en: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 3
description: The third season of Kimi no Koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo.

characters.name: Rentarou Aijou
characters.description: __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 1 Rentarou is an extremely kind and thoughtful person who loves all of his many girlfriends very dearly, often to a scarily self-sacrificing degree. Before he began his days as a high school student, Rentarou had been rejected a total of 100 times. Following a rejection from his friend on the day of his junior high graduation, he goes to a matchmaking shrine and prays to the shrine's god, wishing for a happy high school life by getting a girlfriend. In response, the Love God appears before Rentarou, telling him that he will meet his "soulmate" in high school, and that they will fall in love at first sight. He then reveals that Rentarou has 100 of such soulmates, and that should he ever meet one, he must make them his girlfriend and make them happy, or else they will die.

characters.name: Hakari Hanazono
characters.description: __Type:__ Deredere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 1 **Girlfriend No. 001** Hakari is described as a "clumsily calculative" lady. She is often planning and plotting to achieve her goals which may or may not go as planned due to her clumsiness. She is prim and proper on the outside while inside she is just as much of a degenerate, if not more so, than the other members of the Hanazono family. She also teases [Inda Karane](https://anilist.co/character/173760) a lot, often leaving her embarrassed or pissed.

characters.name: Karane Inda
characters.description: __Type:__ Tsundere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 1 **Girlfriend No. 002** Karane is known for being straightforward and honest about how she feels about a given situation except for two subjects: her feminine figure (or supposed lack of) and her deep love for [Aijou Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou). Her desperate attempts to hide how she feels about a given situation despite her honest nature often make people think she is going to strike them.

characters.name: Shizuka Yoshimoto
characters.description: __Type:__ Dandere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 3 **Girlfriend No. 003** Shizuka is rather timid especially given her rather quiet or mute voice which makes her rather distant from other people. However, ever since she met [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) she has become braver, even willing to sacrifice her own safety to help [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hanazono-Hakari) out. She is also the most modest of Rentarou's girlfriends as she refused to peep on him when he was taking a bath and even tried to stop them from doing so.

characters.name: Nano Eiai
characters.description: __Type:__ Kuudere __Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 6 **Girlfriend No. 004** Nano is practical to a fault, obsessed with solving a problem in the most efficient way possible no matter what. Nano is the smartest among the girls. In her school exam, she gets the perfect score (700/700), which is better than the scores of genius-level characters in other manga. Nano has memorized hundreds of digits of Pi, which she sometimes uses to calm herself down. Due to her extreme intelligence and efficiency, in most difficult situations Nano is the first to come up with solutions. However, her solutions are sometimes brutal due to her lack of social experience.

characters.name: Kusuri Yakuzen
characters.description: __Type:__ Druggie __Occupations:__ Third-Year High School Student, Chemistry Club President __Debut:__ Chapter 10 **Girlfriend No. 005** Kusuri is energetic and ingenuitive; she is capable of creating a drug for almost anything. She doesn't tend to be concerned about the dangers of the drugs she makes, and will often happily force them upon others or take them herself without hesitation.

characters.name: Hahari Hanazono
characters.description: __Type:__ MILF __Occupation:__ High School Chairwoman __Debut:__ Chapter 17 **Girlfriend No. 006** [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hakari-Hanazono)'s mother. Hahari appears as a very mature and sophisticated woman, until she sees something cute. She has an uncontrollable love for cute things, including children, as well as Rentarou and his family. When she sees something she finds cute, she may start drooling. Like her daughter, she is also a pervert towards Rentarou as she is shown to have perverted fantasies about him. She is incredibly wealthy, and willing to throw her money around to get what she (or Rentarou) wants. Although she fell in love with Rentarou, Hahari still deeply loves her deceased lover. She feels guilty about falling in love again until Rentarou comforts her and assures her that there is nothing wrong with loving more than one person. ~!When she was very

characters.name: Kurumi Haraga
characters.description: __Type:__ Hangry __Occupation:__ Third-Year Middle School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 24 **Girlfriend No. 007** Kurumi absolutely loves food and possesses an extremely high metabolism. As such, she's almost constantly hungry, and she grows extremely cranky if she isn't eating the certain food that she happens to be craving for at the moment. Kurumi has a strong word-association when it comes to food. Almost anything can remind her of food, at which point she has to eat that food or else she will become irritable.

characters.name: Mei Meido
characters.description: __Type:__ Maid __Occupation:__ Personal Maid __Debut:__ Chapter 30 **Girlfriend No. 008** The personal maid of [Hahari Hanazono](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hahari-Hanazono). Mei is polite and proper, rarely showing strong emotions. She is loyal to Hahari above all else, and is unlikely to do anything unless given permission or ordered to by Hahari specifically. Mei's fanatical loyalty to the Rentarou Family and the Hanazono Family results in her gladly offering to "eliminate" people that threaten, insult, or even mildly inconvenience [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou), Hahari, or the other girlfriends. Mei is an all-around maid. It seems that she can do nearly everything, including driving, cooking, shooting, and even nursing. Mei is also shown to exceed her already exceptional abilities if ordered to do so by Hahari.

characters.name: Iku Sutou
characters.description: __Type:__ Masochist __Occupations:__ First-Year High School Student, Baseball Club Member __Debut:__ Chapter 33 **Girlfriend No. 009** Iku loves baseball, to the point of spending hours recruiting for her team when it's on the verge of being disbanded. She is determined to do her best no matter what; because of this she's described as the embodiment of "stoicism" by Rentarou. Iku is also wildly masochistic, going so far as to train for hours until her body is in agony so she can enjoy the pain.

characters.name: Mimimi Utsukushisugi
characters.description: __Type:__ Narcissist __Occupation:__ Second-Year High School Student __Debut:__ Chapter 39 **Girlfriend No. 010** Mimimi is very haughty and narcissistic, constantly complimenting herself and talking about her beauty. Despite her appearance of a naturally-beautiful rich girl, Mimimi actually works incredibly hard to provide for herself and keep herself beautiful. She works for herself to earn money, is frugal where appropriate so she can afford expensive, gorgeous clothing, and puts significant effort into her appearance. Though she puts a lot of value on outward appearances, Mimimi also recognizes inner beauty when she sees it.

characters.name: Meme Kakure
characters.description: **Type:** Self-Conscious **Occupation:** First-Year High School Student **Debut:** Chapter 45 **Girlfriend No. 011** Meme is extremely shy, to the point of wearing masks to hide her face in order to avoid drawing attention to herself. She strives to keep her face hidden no matter what. Meme also enjoys knitting, and spends time knitting a lot of little stuffed animals. She uses these stuffed animals for "misdirection", in which she runs away quickly and leaves a stuffed animal as a distraction so no one sees where she went. Meme wears a modest turtleneck beneath her school blazer, and dark pantyhose. She also wears a minimizing bra to conceal the size of her chest.

title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
title_en: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
description: This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town. High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing. However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students! (Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

characters.name: Tan Otori
characters.description: A third-year student at Fujinari Academy Junior High. He serves as the public relations officer for the student council. Despite being a junior high student, he possesses enough academic ability to tutor high school students in math and science subjects. He is also highly competent in his role in public relations. He is incredibly cute and fully aware of it; his words and personality are blatantly "cutesy" and calculated to charm, yet he is a boy. As a "cross-dressing boy" (otokonoko), his nipples are usually visible, though there are times when they are not shown. ~!His father was absent from the time he was old enough to understand his surroundings, and his mother rarely returns home, so he effectively lives alone. Perhaps due to this family situation, he tends to act affectionately toward the student council members as if they were his own family—a tendency particularly evident with [

characters.name: Ume Mizunoe
characters.description: First-year student in Class 2 of the Fujinari Academy High School division. Student council secretary. Member of the Handicrafts Club. An academic standout with exceptional grades in liberal arts subjects and a track record of winning literary awards. Conversely, his performance in science and math subjects is abysmal—even recording single-digit test scores—putting him at risk of failing to advance to the next grade. As a result, his homeroom teacher, [Satomi Hiratsuka](https://anilist.co/character/341617/Satomi-Hiratsuka) (Biology), warned him that his grades would negatively impact his academic record and suggested he join the student council. He acts as the "straight man" (tsukkomi) of the group; he is the voice of reason who calmly resolves comedic situations that would otherwise spiral out of control—situations that the [President](https://anilist.co/character/341619/Hisako-Kotobuki

characters.name: Arisu Terui
characters.description: She is a second-year student in Class 4 at Fujinari Academy High School and serves as the treasurer for the student council. Her strongest subjects are biology and chemistry; she has even won awards in competitions. Although she also heads the Chemistry Club, she is effectively the only active member, as the only other person on the roster—Takaka—merely lends her name to the club. Raised in a wealthy, refined family, she appears at first glance to be a gentle, traditional beauty—the sort raised in the lap of luxury—but she is also skilled in martial arts. She excels in both academics and athletics, making her arguably the most formidable character in the story. She is feared throughout the school for her aggressive nature—she wouldn't hesitate to deliver a kick to the groin right off the bat—and her sharp, unsparing tongue; her presence on stage at a school assembly is enough to silence

characters.name: Hisako Kotobuki
characters.description: A brilliant student serving as the high school division's student council president. She ranks first overall academically, with English being her strongest subject. An outstanding individual who excels in both academics and athletics and is highly respected by others, she is frequently teased by those around her—especially [Arisu Terui](https://anilist.co/character/341618/Arisu-Terui)—due to a clumsy, scatterbrained streak stemming from her status as a closet pervert. The other cast members are so eccentric that she ends up appearing relatively ordinary and understated by comparison. While she technically holds the "heroine" position, in reality, she often plays the victim, constantly pushed around by the oddballs surrounding her—a role that makes her quite a pitiable character. Her sensible and reserved nature only adds to this sense of misfortune; she harbors a secret crush on the prot

characters.name: Komaro Michinoku
characters.description: __Height:__ 131 cm She is a girl packed with distinctive traits: sleepy-looking eyes with dark circles, voluminous long hair, and a rough, raspy natural voice. She serves as the student council's mascot-like figure. She gives her all in everything she does, but she is clumsy, prone to frequent mishaps, and cursed with an extraordinary streak of bad luck; consequently, the student council treats her as someone who needs constant looking after. Although she frequently gets into accidents, she boasts such toughness that she might simply slap a bandage on herself after being hit by a car and call it a day. She is like an endangered species—a creature with absolutely no wariness toward others. She is a classmate of [Ume Mizunoe](https://anilist.co/character/341616/Ume-Mizunoe), though they hadn't met previously because she had been absent due to an accident. She has taken a strong liking to U

characters.name: Satomi Hiratsuka
characters.description: Homeroom Teacher, High School Division Year 1, Class 2 / Head of Year. She likes Eel.

characters.name: Zaizen Batsunosuke
characters.description: A second-year student at the private Fujinari Academy and the president of the Handicrafts Club. He has a very timid personality, frequently apologizing and bursting into tears. He is also easily swayed; when the Robotics Club approached him about the clubroom issue, he promptly signed the petition without hesitation. His crafting skills are top-notch, and he often creates incredible plush toys—such as the "Kina-Usagi" he was holding upon his first appearance, or the various plushies of turtles and mysterious creatures surrounding him. Incidentally, a teddy bear he once crafted ended up being modified into a robot by the Robotics Club. He also reportedly feels very at ease when wearing his rabbit-themed outfit.

title: Bocchi the Rock! 2nd Season
title_original: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！ 2期
description: We will Be back！ The second season of Bocchi the Rock! (Source: Official BTR Twitter)

characters.name: Hitori Gotou
characters.description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

characters.name: Nijika Ijichi
characters.description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

characters.name: Ryou Yamada
characters.description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

characters.name: Ikuyo Kita
characters.description: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

title: Sabagebu!
description: Momoka's family moves a lot, so she's always "that new girl" and the schools she's attended have all blurred together. Until her first day at Aogiri High, that is, where she's rescued by an armed vigilante, assaulted by a platypus, and coerced into joining a secret organization of gun-toting female commandos. Okay, maybe that last one is really just the school's survival club, but the platypus is real and so are the extremes that club president Miou is willing to execute to recruit Momoka. Can uber-jaded Momoka's body armor-clad heart resist the charms of a girl who's all too ready to whip out her twin Desert Eagles in defense of another girl's virtue? Especially when it turns out that Momoka has her own talent for air pistols and senseless violence? (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Momoka Sonokawa
characters.description: A 15-year-old high school freshman, Momoka is a transfer student who is coerced into joining the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club by Miou. She initially kept an appearance of a polite and kind schoolgirl but is actually sharp-tongued, merciless, and easily angered. She is prone to taking revenge, often disproportionately.

characters.name: Miou Ootori
characters.description: An 18-year-old high school senior, Miou is the club president of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She came from a rich family and her beauty and charisma made her well respected in school. She seems to lack common sense and is quite forgetful. She was held back a year in high school because of misconduct, and thus the only club member old enough to apply for a license for the model guns the other members are too young to use.

characters.name: Urara Kasugano
characters.description: A high school freshman, Urara is a member of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She seemingly appeared sweet and cute but is actually really malicious and violent when jealous. She is a big fan of Miou and Urara, getting rid of possible rivals, is the main reason the Survival Game Club is stuck with four members prior to Momoka's arrival. She later developed a masochistic side after being hit by Momoka and started fawning over her.

characters.name: Maya Kyoudou
characters.description: A 16-year-old high school sophomore, Maya is a member of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She has large breasts and works part-time as a gravure model. She was initially shown to dislike natto due to their stickiness but due to Momoka's "training," she ended up fearing them.

characters.name: Kayo Goutokuji
characters.description: A high school freshman, Kayo is a member of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She goes to the same class as Momoka, Class C, but wasn't initially noticed. She doesn't talk much. She admits that she has no interest in survival games but joined the club because of her love for cosplaying. She sews her own costumes. She once displayed her cosplaying talent to Momoka in order to start a conversation with her because she didn't want to "seem like an otaku" by suddenly bringing it up.

characters.name: Kamo
characters.description: Miou's pet platypus. His appearance and behavior is described as mysterious. Kamo gets irritated quite easily. He likes the corn snack umaibou.

characters.name: Tenchou
characters.description: He is the manager of the shop where the Survival Game Club buys their airsoft gears, Military Shop "Sabage Yarou ze". His voice is similar to the narrator and Momoka even broke the fourth wall to acknowledge this though he denied it.

characters.name: Karaage☆ Lemon
characters.description: An arcade geek. Karaage Lemon is actually Japan's champion in the shooting game "Dead of Terror."

characters.name: Jushoku
characters.description: He is the head priest of the temple where the Survival Game Club participated in his Zen meditation training course. He is shown to be quite sadistic, going to great lengths just to distract the meditating Miou in order to punish her. When Miou proved to be unyielding, he asked her to be his successor which she agreed to.

characters.name: Rojin
characters.description: He is the local hunter at the village where the Survival Game Club wandered into, and a licensed member of the Japan Hunters Association. He inadvertently inspired the members of the Survival Game Club to train for the Hunting License Examination. He also works as a receptionist at the Central Civic Hall and told the girls that they are too young to apply.

characters.name: Roselia Haguro
characters.description: An elementary school student, Roselia is a member of the Chino Elementary School Survival Game Club. She claims to be the representative of the club and challenged Miou to a survival game match.

characters.name: Yayoi  Isurugi
characters.description: The president of the Aogiri High School Student Council, Yayoi is a capable and good-looking girl who swore to take vengeance on Miou for trampling on her efforts. She thought of plans on ruining the Survival Game Club ending with undesirable results. Because of her obsession on taking her revenge, the student body believed that she is in love with Miou and that they are dating. In one of her plans, she pretended to be a high school freshman who recently transferred, going by the name Ishida Kanna, in order to befriend Momoka. She later used this disguise to infiltrate the school cafeteria.

title: NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE
description: OMGkawaiiAngel, affectionately known as "KAngel", is the top streamer girl with 10 million subscribers, and not a day goes by without seeing her in action. Whether online, on TV, or at a live show, she is always surrounded by her cheering fans. Striving to catch up with KAngel's popularity is a three-girl streaming unit called Karamazov. And far removed from the world of these streamers is Kache, a girl who lives with her freeloader boyfriend while working at a theme cafe. The story of the "Internet Angel" who captivated the world, woven by a girl who shines like a star and girls who reach for that brilliance, and the story of "you" on the other side of the screen, begins here. (Source: Official Site) Note: Prior to broadcasting, "NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE -OVERTURE-" — a theatrical pre-screening of the first 3 episodes rearranged and edited together— debuted in Japan on March 6, 2026.

characters.name: Ame-chan
characters.description: __Chouten-chan's Birthday:__ Jul 7 Ame is a young girl with a needy personality, who has dropped out of school and confined herself at home. In order to pay for rent, and to meet her parasocial attention needs, Ame decides to commence live streaming on the internet, where she takes on the persona of "OMGkawaiiAngel", or "KAngel" for short, interacting with her stream viewers as she dons her wig and makeup.

characters.name: Moudoku Denpa Shoujo☆Purple Lollipop
characters.original: 猛毒電波少女☆パープル・ロリポップ
characters.description: __Height:__ 152cm The leader of Karamazov. Deadly Poison Denpa Girl. A new streamer with a defiant, devil-may-care smile, she’s a “denpa girl,” someone who entertains wild theories and accusatory delusions on the internet.

characters.name: Michica Gokubara
characters.description: __Height:__ 164cm Hell’s Blood Rose. A member of Karamazov. She’s committed to her Gothic Lolita aesthetic.

characters.name: Nechika-sama
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm A member of Karamazov. She captivates fans with her dignified and mesmerizing gaze.

characters.name: Kache
characters.description: __Height:__ 163cm A student at a professional training college. She works as a cast member at a theme cafe.

title: Strike Witches
title_original: ストライクウィッチーズ
description: The year is 1944 and the world lives in fear of unidentified flying objects called Neuroi. With the old-boy old guard unable to thwart this deadly menace, humanity turns its desperate eyes to an aerial attack force with much nicer legs. Meet the girls of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing, better known as the Strike Witches. These darlings of the great blue yonder may not have standard issue uniforms, but they do have all the right stuff. Where the average flyboy falters, these dolls blast aliens to bits in the bat of an eyelash. With a little magic and a whole lot of leg, the girls of the 501st are winning the war on pants, and aliens! (Source: Rightstuf)

characters.name: Yoshika Miyafuji
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11'') The main character of the series, age fifteen and hailing from the Fuso Empire. A typical young girl who comes from a family of clinicians who use their magic powers to heal people. Yoshika gains the features of a mame-shiba when using said power. Her father designed the Striker Units the Strike Witches use to fight. However, because her father died in the war she is vehemently against fighting when [Mio Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/7627/Sakamoto-Mio) appears to recruit her. Only after entering combat for the first time, helping to defend the Fuso fleet heading to Britannia from a Neuroi attack, does she decide to join the 501st. Now she holds the rank of Sergeant. Yoshika has a talent for cooking, but tends to care more about her food's health benefits than its taste, such as when she introduced the other Witches to natto. Carries a 13mm Type99 Mach

characters.name: Mio Sakamoto
characters.description: The first Strike Witch and sub-commander of the unit, with the commissioned rank of Squadron Leader and official rank of Major. Mio is also the oldest witch at nineteen (later, twenty) years old and, like Yoshika, comes from Fuso. She is seemingly the toughest and most mature of the Witches, being an experienced veteran of the early fighting against the Neuroi. She knew Yoshika's father while he was first designing the Striker Unit and was the first person to pilot one. Her usual task is to train new recruits, and in this role she becomes a very strict disciplinarian, appropriately gaining the ears and tail of a Doberman when equipped with her Striker. Otherwise she is quite friendly, if a little too forward at times, with a very distinct laugh. Under Mio's eyepatch is a magic eye that grants her increased visual prowess and the ability to spot Neuroi cores when used. Being 19/20 years o

characters.name: Perrine H. Clostermann
characters.original: ぺリーヌ・クロステルマン
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (4'9") A wealthy and proper fifteen year old Gallian girl who looks down on some of the less-refined habits of her peers. The emotional scars left by the Neuroi's destruction of her homeland cause her numerous problems. She often refuses to work as a team, and develops something of a dislike for the upstart newcomer Yoshika due to her attachment to Mio. When wearing her Striker Unit, she gains the dark ears and tail of a Chartreux. Perrine holds the rank of Flying Officer and her original unit was the Armée de l'Air 802nd Flying Corps. Carries a rapier into battle along with a Bren light machine-gun. Her Striker Unit is based on the Arsenal VG 39 and she is named after Pierre Clostermann.

characters.name: Lynette Bishop
characters.original: リネット・ビショップ
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Fifteen years old, Lynette is the only Witch in the 501st who is native to the Britannia Federation. The middle child of eight sisters, Lynette developed very domestic and practical habits from helping to take care of her siblings. Similarly domestic is the Scottish Fold, from which her Striker-equipped animal features are based. Plagued by occasional clumsiness and sometimes overlooked, she nevertheless strives to do her best. Holds the rank of Sergeant and her affiliation is the Royal Air Force 610th Fighter Squadron. Her armaments are a Mk. I Boys Anti-tank Rifle and a Bren light machine gun. She serves as the squadron's sharpshooter and possesses an almost magical degree of eyesight similar to Mio's. Her Striker Unit is based on the Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX, and her pilot archetype is Billy Bishop. Lynette also has an older sister, Wilma, who is also a Strike Wit

characters.name: Charlotte E Yeager
characters.original: シャーロット・E・イェーガー
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm A sixteen year old girl hailing from the United States of Liberion with the rank of Flight Leiutenant. Magnanimous in character and buxom in appearance, Charlotte is a thrill-seeker who is fascinated by speed. Like a speedy hare, she gains the ears and tail of a rabbit when equipped with her Striker. Concerned with cleanliness, Charlotte had her personal bath transported all the way to the Strike Witches' Britannia base when she was transferred from the Liberion Army 363rd Fighter Wing. In combat her armament can consist of a M1918 Browning Automatic Rifle, Thompson M1 A1, or Colt Government M1911 A1. The P-51D Mustang serves as the basis for her Striker Unit, while she herself is based on Chuck Yeager. ~!Near the end of episode 5, she broke the sound barrier at 1200 km/h (Mach 1), although she ended up ramming through a Neuroi (and destroying it) thereafter.!~

characters.name: Eila Ilmatar Juutilainen
characters.original: エイラ・イルマタル・ユーティライネン
characters.description: The fifteen year old top ace of the Suomus Air Force 24th Unit with the rank of Flying Officer. Eila's hobby is fortune-telling with tarot cards, although the accuracy of her predictions is questionable at best. Somewhat mischievous, like the black fox whose features she gains in flight. She has a talent for analyzing the thoughts and feelings of her companions, and this skill translates well to the battlefield where her judgment is used to consistently outwit her opponents. In combat her weapons of choice are the MG42 and Suomi M1931 submachine gun. Eila's Striker Unit is based on the Messerschmitt Bf-109G-2 and she herself is based on Eino Ilmari Juutilainen.

characters.name: Francesca Lucchini
characters.original: フランチェスカ・ルッキーニ
characters.description: **Height:** 148 cm Joining the 501st from the Duchy of Romagna, Francesca is the youngest soldier of the unit at a mere twelve years. Her rank is that of a Warrant officer and her unit affiliation was with Romagna's Regia Aeronautica 4th Air Unit. Francesca is often childish and self-indulgent, shirking training and other duties in order to have fun around the base or nap. However, in battle she displays a true talent and passion for flying. Also displayed are the ears and tail of a black leopard. Good friends with the similarly casual Charlotte. During battles she carries a M1919 A6, Breda-SAFAT 12.7 mm machine gun, or Beretta Model 1938A. Her Striker Unit is based on the G.55 Centauro, and her ace archetype is Franco Lucchini.

characters.name: Minna-Dietlinde Wilcke
characters.original: ミーナ・ディートリンデ・ヴィルケ
characters.description: The ranking officer of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing at eighteen years old, Minna has a sisterly air that shows her concern for those under her command. Whether in or out of battle, her first priority is the safety of her subordinates. Her more gentle demeanor means that she often acts as the "good cop" to Mio's "bad cop" when it comes to discipline. Alluding to her namesake, Minna gains wolf features when equipped for combat. Holds the commissioned rank of Wing commander, official rank of Lieutenant Colonel, and her affiliation is the Karlsland JG 3 Luftwaffe. During combat she arms herself with an MG42. Her Striker Unit model is the Messerschmitt Bf-109G-2 and her ace pilot archetype is Wolf-Dietrich Wilcke. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Erica Hartmann
characters.original: エーリカ・ハルトマン
characters.description: Karlsland's sixteen year old "ultra ace" of the Luftwaffe JG 52 with more than 200 confirmed victories and the rank of Flying Officer. While extremely efficient and strategic in battle, Erica is surprisingly sloppy with her belongings and often neglects cleaning tasks. With her Striker Unit equipped, Erica gains Dachshund features. A serious individual. Her armaments are the MG42 and a MP40. Her Striker Unit is based on the Messerschmitt Bf-109G-6 and her ace archetype is Erich Hartmann. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gertrud Barkhorn
characters.original: ゲルトルート・バルクホルン
characters.description: Eighteen year old Witch from Karlsland; a Flight Lieutenant formerly of the Luftwaffe JG 52. Quiet, efficient, and private, Gertrud tends to support her comrades from the shadows. Her naturally calm attitude grants her great battlefield stamina, allowing her to rack up an impressive shot-down tally. A long-time acquaintance of Minna and Erica, she is often seen supporting the former. In flight she gains the features of a German Wirehaired Pointer. For battle her armament consists of an MG42, MG131, or MG151 which she dual wields. Her Striker Unit is based on the Focke-Wulf Fw 190D-6 and her pilot archetype is Gerhard Barkhorn. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sanya V. Litvyak
characters.original: サーニャ・V・リトヴャク
characters.description: The single Witch out of the Orussia Empire at thirteen years old. Preferring to stay indoors during the day, Sanya has been described as "nocturnal." At times she is literally asleep on her feet, counting on [Eila](https://anilist.co/character/7631/Juutilainen-Eila-Ilmatar) to move her around. Despite this somewhat limiting her contact with the other members of the 501st, her low profile makes her ideal for night missions and sneak attacks. Gains the ears and tail of a black cat with her Striker Unit equipped. Sanya's rank is Flying Officer and her original unit affiliation is the Orussia Imperial Army 586th Fighter Regiment. Her weapon of choice is a modified Fliegerfaust called the "Fliegerhummer." Her Striker Unit design is based on the MiG60 (a fictional warbird combining features of the MiG-1, MiG-3, and Yakovlev Yak-1) and her pilot archetype is Lydia Litvyak.

characters.name: Amaki Suwa
characters.description: Amaki Suwa is a Strike Witch in the Army Air Force 47th Squadron. ~!Appeared in episode 12 of the anime. Like Yoshika, she is a Witch from Fuso. She gives Yoshika a letter from her father Dr. Miyafuji, but whether or not this means he is alive is unclear. This scene was repeated in episode 1 of the Strike Witches 2.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Saikin, Imouto no Yousu ga Chotto Okashiinda ga.
title_original: 最近、妹のようすがちょっとおかしいんだが。
description: In the romance comedy, a girl named Mitsuki Kanzaki lives with her step-brother Yuya after her mother remarries. One day, Mitsuki is possessed by the self-proclaimed spirit of a young girl, Hiyori Kotobuki. Hiyori (in Mitsuki's body) must fall in love with Yuya to move towards the "Gates of Heaven."

characters.name: Mitsuki Kanzaki
characters.description: Mitsuki appears to be a reserved and calm girl who recently moved in Yuuya's house after their divorced parents got married again. She encountered and was possessed by an angel one day on her way home from school shortly after transferring, whom the angel holds affection for Mitsuki's older brother. As a result, she often alters between her normal self and the angel's personality around people, especially to get Yuuya's attention.

characters.name: Yuuya Kanzaki
characters.description: Mitsuki's step brother.

characters.name: Hiyori Kotobuki
characters.description: An angel/ghost who takes over Mitsuki's body and tries to make sexual advancements towards Yuuya. Hiyori is the lost spirit of a girl who died but can’t reach the gates of heaven and reach eternal peace.

characters.name: Nanami Akesaka
characters.description: Nanami Akesaka is Mitsuki's aunt, who sometimes drop by to check on her from time to time.

characters.name: Kyouko Kanzaki
characters.description: Kyouko Kanzaki is Mitsuki's mother who recently married to Yuuya's father. ~! Prior to meeting Yuuya's father, she had undergone numerous failed relationships which, unbeknownst to her, made Mitsuki develop a disdain for men. !~

characters.name: Tetsuya Kanzaki
characters.description: Tetsuya Kanzaki is Yuuya's widowed father who married Mitsuki's mother, he is often working overseas

characters.name: Neko
characters.description: Neko is Yuuya's classmate, who has a fascination for supernatural and the occult that she is always seen reading a book about it, it is hinted that she is aware of the strange circumstances that Mitsuki is going through.

characters.name: Soccer-bu Captain
characters.original: サッカー部キャプテン
characters.description: Appears in episode 7.

characters.name: Shoutarou  Torii
characters.description: Shoutarou Torii is Yuuya's classmate and friend. He doesn't have a good relationship with his sister. Both of are even at odds with each other.

title: BanG Dream!
description: Kasumi Toyama was enthralled by the stars as a young girl, so when she discovers a trail of star-shaped signs one day after transferring to a new school, she can't help but follow them. They lead her to a shop run by the grandmother of one of her new classmates, and Kasumi finds something that will change her life forever: a star-shaped guitar! And just like that, Kasumi knows that forming a band is her destiny. Of course, convincing Arisa and her grandmother to sell her the guitar won't be easy, and finding a group of other girls who want to become musicians will be even harder. But when a girl has stars in her eyes and a starbeat in her heart, there's nothing that will stop Kasumi from making her fantasies come true! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Kasumi Toyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the vocalist and rhythm guitarist in the band Poppin'Party. When she viewed the stars one night as a child, she heard a sparkling "Star Beat" and had been searching for it. She believes that she found it after founding Poppin'Party. She also has a little sister named [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/152338/Toyama-Asuka), who she calls "Aa-chan". It's not always clear who is the more responsible out of the two. Cheerful and always in high spirits, Kasumi is a playful, active and generally positive girl that always finds something to be excited about. She is capable of sharing a mental wavelength with [Kokoro Tsurumaki](https://anilist.co/character/127272/Tsurumaki-Kokoro), something nobody else seems to be able to do. She is also the type to believe in (or fall for) the strangest explanations. However, Kasumi i

characters.name: Arisa Ichigaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Instruments:__ Roland JUNO-DS 61 W and Roland AX-Synth (White) Arisa is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the keyboardist of [Poppin'Party](https://anilist.co/staff/153185/PoppinParty). In the second season of the anime, she is a second-year student and the student council secretary. Arisa's grandparents run a pawnshop called "Ryuuseidou", and she lives in a big and traditional house, which includes a basement where the Poppin'Party members practice most of the time. When Arisa was younger, she started to learn the piano but then quit it halfway because she didn't have any motivation to continue - when she befriended [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Toyama-Kasumi) and heard about her plans to start a band, she picked it up again. Arisa is an introvert whose hobbies include tending for bonsai plants and internet surfing. Ev

characters.name: Rimi Ushigome
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") __Instrument:__ ESP Viper Bass A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the bassist of Poppin'Party. Outside of the band, Rimi is friends with Misaki, and similarly to Himari, one of Kaoru's fangirls. Rimi's pink bass guitar is a hand-me-down from her older sister Yuri, who is two years older than her and is the lead vocalist of the band Glitter Green. During Rimi's high-school entrance ceremony, she heard Kasumi's self-introduction that was filled with boundless optimism, and this sparked her interest in her. Though Rimi wanted to change her cowardly and shy personality, she had initially been unable to do anything about it. At first, Rimi declined Kasumi's invitation to become a member of the band Poppin'Party because of her stage fright, but everything changed when she became inspired by Kasumi who sang on stage at Live House Space until Glitter Gree

characters.name: Tae Hanazono
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") __Instrument:__ ESP Snapper Guitar A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the lead guitarist of Poppin'Party. The other members call her O-Tae. Tae lives with her parents and 20 rabbits. She has considerable skill with the guitar, since she started playing it when she was in elementary school. As a huge lover of music, she started working part-time at a live house after entering high school. Tae at first doubted Kasumi's idea to audition at Space, because the band needed a considerable skill level to pass. But when Kasumi, Arisa, Rimi, and Tae performed for the first time in front of their friends and family, Tae realized how much fun she had performing with them and joined the band as its fourth member. A relaxed individual who lives at a steady pace, Tae sometimes surprises the people around her with her keen observations and understanding of music.

characters.name: Saaya Yamabuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Instruments:__ Pearl Drums Antique Gold 4-Piece Reference Pure RFP924XSP-C102, Pearl Drums Electric Blue Sparkle EXX725/C 5-Piece Export Standard Drum Set with Hardware (1st season) Saaya is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer of Poppin'Party. She became good friends with her classmate [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Toyama-Kasumi) during their high school entrance ceremony, and since then they often eat lunch together. Saaya is the oldest of three children in her family; she has a younger brother named [Jun](https://anilist.co/character/152364/Yamabuki-Jun), and a younger sister named [Sana](https://anilist.co/character/152363/Yamabuki-Sana). Saaya's family owns the Yamabuki Bakery, at which she helps out, even during the school term. She also used to play in a girls' band called CHiSPA when she was in middle s

characters.name: Sayo Hikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") Sayo is a third year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the guitarist of [Roselia](https://anilist.co/staff/153170/Roselia). She is the older, more serious twin of [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/128164/Hikawa-Hina). Sayo sees being the eldest twin as more of a burden than anything. Ever since they were younger, Hina has always beated Sayo in everything; whereas Hina can master new skills with ease, Sayo requires a great deal of information before she can even begin to practice. As a result, Sayo developed a severe inferiority complex towards Hina. One of Sayo's main reasons for starting to play the guitar was because "it was something Hina wasn't doing". A serious and fussy girl, Sayo is somewhat cold in nature, even towards those she is close to. She never cuts corners or accepts shoddy workmanship, and she tends to stubbornly deny liking or be

characters.name: Rinko Shirokane
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Instruments:__ Roland FA-08 and Roland AX-Synth (Black) The student council president of Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the last member to join Roselia as their keyboardist. She is also part of the library committee at school. Rinko is very shy, and is at first scared of the idea of performing in a live concert. She is also the band's costume designer and sews their outfits all by herself. Her hobbies are reading and playing online games, the latter through which she met her best friend, [Ako](https://anilist.co/character/128144/Udagawa-Ako). Socially awkward, Rinko is a shy and asocial girl who was initially too frightened to speak in front of others, let alone perform before them. She has a tendency to stammer when speaking, and usually keeps quiet until she feels comfortable. When she is set on or passionate about something, however, she does so with c

characters.name: Ako Udagawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm (4'10") __Instruments:__ DW (Drum Workshop) Collector Series: Pure Maple five-piece drum set Ako is a student at Haneoka Girls' High School and Roselia's drummer. She admires [Yukina](https://anilist.co/character/128146/Minato-Yukina) and her older sister [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/128155/Udagawa-Tomoe), and is the best friend of [Rinko](https://anilist.co/character/128143/Shirokane-Rinko), whom she calls "Rin-rin". Ako has chuunibyou tendencies, and has illusions of grandeur and magical powers. Rinko suspects this is the result from her playing online games frequently. She enjoys playing the role while keeping a realistic mentality. She is very cheery and noisy, and, despite only being two years younger than the other band members, is treated like the kid sister by the other characters due to her childlike appearance and personality. Ako often wonders how sh

characters.name: Yukina Minato
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Yukina Minato is a second-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and is the cold and fierce leader of [Roselia](https://anilist.co/staff/153170/Roselia). She is a powerful vocalist, sparking the admiration of the other Roselia members. She is next-door neighbors with [Lisa Imai](https://anilist.co/character/128147/Imai-Lisa), who is also her childhood friend, and considers [Ran Mitake](https://anilist.co/character/128153/Mitake-Ran) somewhat of a rival. Yukina has a cold-blooded and cut-throat attitude towards reaching her goals, cutting down any obstacles in her path. She expects nothing less than perfect and takes practice very seriously. Because of this, she has no qualms with chiding or insulting someone if she feels they are underperforming. She is openly dismissive and unkind to people she deems below her standards. However, with the people she warms u

characters.name: Lisa Imai
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") __Instrument:__ ESP BTL Roselia Lisa Bass A student at Haneoka Girls' High School and Roselia's bassist. She follows gyaru fashion, but keeps her interest in amigurumi secret, since it does not match her image. She is good at baking cookies and is part of the dance club at school. Lisa is best friends and next-door neighbors with [Yukina](https://anilist.co/character/128146/Minato-Yukina), and they have been good friends since they were young. Outside of the band, Lisa is also friends with [Moca](https://anilist.co/character/125931/Aoba-Moca), who is her coworker at her part-time job at the convenience store Lisa is a friendly and lively girl who appears mature and calm. Despite her appearance, Lisa acts as the mediator in tense situations. She's often credited with keeping Roselia together despite the members' contrasting personalities and disagreements at time

characters.name: Yuri Ushigome
characters.description: Yuri is [Rimi](https://anilist.co/character/120231/Rimi-Ushigome)'s older sister, as well as the lead vocalist and guitarist of [Glitter*Green](https://anilist.co/staff/155955/GlitterGreen). She and the other members of Glitter*Green were members of the Hanasakigawa Girls' High School student council. ~!After graduating, Yuri went to study at a college overseas. She and Rimi keep in contact through text every day.!~

characters.name: Nanana Wanibe
characters.description: The keyboardist for Glitter*Green. She and the other band members were part of the Hanasakigawa Girls' High School student council, with Nanana as the student council president. She wears glasses, but removes them when performing. (Source: BanG Dream! Wikia, edited)

title: Valkyrie Drive: Mermaid
title_original: ヴァルキリードライヴ マーメイド
description: After adorable “mermaid” Mamori is transferred to one of five artificial islands, she’s cornered, attacked and eventually saved by another beautiful transfer named Mirei. Unfortunately, even after the girl intervenes, Mamori’s attackers refuse to let up. Just when they think all hope is lost, Mirei and Mamori share a passionate kiss that turns the little “mermaid” into a powerful sword. (Source: FUNimation)

characters.name: Mamori Tokonome
characters.description: A high schooler forcibly sent to Mermaid Island after contracting the A-Virus. Mamori is a gentle girl who abhors violence. This puts her at odds with her ability to transform into a deadly weapon as an Extar. She is frequently teased over her family name being written with the same Kanji as "Virgin".

characters.name: Mirei Shikishima
characters.description: A child soldier that arrives at Mermaid Island on the same day as [Mamori](https://anilist.co/character/89143/Tokonome-Mamori). Quickly establishing herself as a powerful Liberator, Mirei can be mistaken as cruel due to her stunted social skills and intimidating appearance. In reality, she is kindhearted and stoic unless Mamori is being bullied or threatened.

characters.name: Charlotte Scharsen
characters.original: シャルロット・シャルゼン

characters.name: Akira Hiragi
characters.description: __Height: __ 172.72cm He is the leader of "Welter" (The Guardians)—the self-governing body of "Feste" (The Castle) located on "Mermaid," an artificial island where those infected with the Armed Virus are quarantined—and refers to himself as "Boku." Known as "Gouverneur" (The Governor), he wears a white, high-collared military-style uniform. As the only male on the island, he possesses both charisma and striking good looks; addressed as "Akira-sama," he is the object of admiration for the island's girls—including Shojo Mamori, who admires him enough to have a poster of him in her room. ~!In reality, she hails from the wealthy "Hiiragi Zaibatsu" (conglomerate). She had entered the island disguised as a male under orders from her mother, Yui. Although she has a busty figure, she binds her chest tightly while in male disguise; however, she occasionally ventures out secretly wearing a long-ha

title: Rock wa Lady no Tashinami Deshite
title_original: ロックは淑女の嗜みでして
description: At an elite all-girls' academy where refined young ladies gather, Lilisa Suzunomiya, now the daughter of a real estate tycoon after her mother remarried, is forced to abandon her guitar and rock music to fit in. However, her passion is reignited by sounds from the old school building, where she meets a skilled drummer who shares her love for rock. Together, they embrace their inner rockstars, elegantly clashing and shouting their way through the academy in this captivating tale of grace and rebellion. (Source: HIDIVE)

characters.name: Lilisa Suzunomiya
characters.description: Lilisa was formerly from a commoner background. [Her mother](https://anilist.co/character/366741/Yuka-Suzunomiya) remarried Suzunomiya Tadashi, a real estate magnate in Kanto. She hides the fact that she was from a commoner background who liked rock and guitar only a month ago, and pretends to be a first-class lady, becoming the object of envy at school.

characters.name: Otoha Kurogane
characters.description: Beautiful and well mannered, she is the daughter of Kijuro Kurogane of the Kurogane family, which has produced many prime ministers since the Meiji era and whose influence extends to politics and business. She is a drummer.

characters.name: Tamaki Shiraya
characters.description: Tamaki is a 2nd year student at a sister school to Oushin Girls' Academy. She's well known as a skilled guitarist in her local area and repeatedly refuses offers to join bands. She is also [Otoha's](https://anilist.co/character/344565/Otoha-Kurogane) childhood friend.

characters.name: Tina Isemi
characters.description: Tina is a 2nd year student at Oushin Girls' Academy. She's referred to as Oushin's Prince due to her tall and androgynous appearance. In actuality, she has low self confidence and acts the way other people want her to be, and she wants to change that about herself.

characters.name: Alice Suzunomiya
characters.description: [Lilisa's](https://anilist.co/character/344566/) step-sister.

characters.name: Yuka Suzunomiya
characters.description: [Lilisa's](https://anilist.co/character/344566/Lilisa-Suzunomiya) mother.

title: Manaria Friends
description: Mysteria Academy is a prestigious magic school that teaches without discrimination to the three factions (humans, gods and demons) who otherwise are usually at battle with each other. This anime follows the daily lives of two young women at the academy, Anne, the princess of Mysteria, and the dragon princess Grea. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Grea
characters.description: A young girl who harbors the power of a dragon within herself wishes to be left alone. She's afraid of that power—a power that could wound others, as well as her own heart. But then a chance meeting with another girl shows her a new path. It's a path fraught with obstacles, but one Grea believes she can surpass with the help of her new friendship.

title: Kyoukaisenjou no Horizon
title_original: 境界線上のホライゾン
title_en: Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere
description: In the far future, humans abandon a devastated Earth and traveled to outer space. However, due to unknown phenomenon that prevents them from traveling into space, humanity returns to Earth only to find it inhospitable except for Japan. To accomodate the entire human population, pocket dimensions are created around Japan to house in the populace. In order to find a way to return to outer space, the humans began reenacting human history according to the Holy book Testament. But in the year 1413 of the Testament Era, the nations of the pocket dimensions invade and conquer Japan, dividing the territory into feudal fiefdoms and forcing the original inhabitants of Japan to leave. It is now the year 1648 of the Testament Era, the refugees of Japan now live in the city ship Musashi, where it constantly travels around Japan while being watched by the Testament Union, the authority that runs the re-enactment of history. However, rumors of an apocalypse and war begins to spread when the Testament stops revealing what happens next after 1648. Taking advantage of this situation, Toori Aoi, head of Musashi Ariadust Academy's Supreme Federation and President of the student council, leads his fell

characters.name: Tori Aoi
characters.description: Tori is the Head of Musashi Ariadust Academy's Supreme Federation and President of the student council. His athletics and grades are average, and he's both self and publicly recognized as an incompetent leader. However, because he doesn't know the meaning of depressed and has an incredibly cheerful attitude, he's very respected nonetheless. He knows a lot of strip jokes, and often plays the fool. ~! Toori made a contract with Asama Shrine shortly after Horizon's death. The contract allows him to "share everything he owns to anybody else" (with exception of sadness, which counts as a corruption of the contract and he will die as a result of this). This contract was immediately sealed afterwards, and was only reactivated more recently. When Toori gains the 1/4th governance status in Musashi as a Viceroy, he is given the authority to use 1/4th of the fuel of Divine State of Musashi. Since h

characters.name: Horizon Ariadust
characters.original: ホライゾン・アリアダスト
characters.description: A cybernetic doll that works at the Blue Thunder bakery. She strongly resembles a girl killed ten years ago. As an automaton, P-01s is unable to portray emotions by using facial expressions and she demonstrates perfect logical thinking. Regardless, she is a kind girl who loves doing what she likes. She also cares for Tori, although she tends to treat him rudely because her logical thinking dictates that she needs to feel annoyed at Toori's antics towards her. ~!Originally Lord Motonobu Matsudaira's daughter and Toori's childhood friend Horizon Ariadust, an accident abruptly took her life at a young age and she was reborn as an automaton whose true identity was kept a secret until the final moments of Mikawa before its destruction.!~ ~!She is the bearer of the Mortal Sin Armament Ólos Phthonos, the most valuable of the nine Mortal Sin Armaments as its "unification operating system".!~

characters.name: Masazumi Honda
characters.description: The vice president of the student council. She's very serious, skilled in debate, and aiming to become a politician. In the past she underwent gender reassignment surgery in order to succeed the family name, but certain circumstances forced her to stop the process part way. Her lack of breasts is a result of the surgery, but Tori treats her as a girl with a tiny chest.

characters.name: Nate Mitotsudaira
characters.original: ネイト・ミトツダイラ
characters.description: Nate Mitotsudaira is a knight of Hexagone Française and successor of the Mitotsudaira Clan. Half-human, half-wolf. Although she cannot transform into a wolf form, she possesses the form’s great strength. She uses her special weapon, her silver chains, to great effect. Because of her chivalrous nature and strong sense of duty, Nate feels very protective of the land on the Musashi, which technically falls within her family's domain. (Source: Genesis-Horizon Wikia)

characters.name: Kimi Aoi
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Toori's older sister. Both she and Toori were born on the same year, so they are of the same grade level. Bad with ghosts. Is a follower in the god of eroticism and dance. Dislikes her name, “Kimi” for some reason, so she changes it habitually. Though she calls Toori a foolish little brother, she also has another side that cares for him. Kimi possesses a sharp tongue and playful attitude, and often prefers to have fun instead of taking things seriously. However, she has a side that can be caring as well, as shown in her relationship with her brother Toori and even in her small gesture to her teacher Makiko Oriotorai. As a sister, she is constantly giving support to Toori whenever she can, and knows how she can properly help him out when he is in a bind, although she had shown a more ruthless side to her love when she was small. (Source: Genesis-Horizon Wikia)

characters.name: Tomo Asama
characters.description: A Shinto priestess of the Sengen Shrine, a childhood friend of Tori and Kimi and a master archer who uses her artificial left eye Konoha for precision shooting. Although a holy shrine maiden, she is often called “Sniper Maiden” by some.

characters.name: Tenzou Crossunite
characters.original: 点蔵 ・クロスユナイト
characters.description: A highly talented ninja, excelling in Ninjutsu and intelligence. Though very nice in character, he is also quite the pervert, openly declaring his love for blonde-haired, big-breasted women. (Source: Genesis-Horizon Wikia)

characters.name: Shirojiro Bertoni
characters.original: シロジロ・ベルトーニ
characters.description: Works as one of the youngest merchants in the Musashi Business Administration, and is contracted to the god of commerce. Makes decisions using profitability as his basis. In other words - a miser. Otherwise, he is quite experienced in economics and can be trustworthy in decision-making, as long as it involves money.

characters.name: Toussaint Neshinbara
characters.original: トゥーサン・ネシンバラ
characters.description: Toussaint Neshinbara has a very dry personality that penetrates even the thickest atmosphere of tomfoolery, yet is also fond of history, an aspiring novelist, and a romanticist. Is in charge of strategics planning and command during wartime. He is also considered by many to have chuunibyou, and is also generally agreed upon to be the author’s self-insert.

characters.name: Suzu Mukai
characters.description: Suzu Mukai is a blind girl who acts as a “stopper” for the intense cast surrounding her. Highly perceptive, and is able to detect phenomena that escape most people’s attention.

characters.name: Naomasa
characters.description: Naomasa is from Qing-Takeda. Works in the Musashi Engineering Club and lives alone in the dorms. Her right arm is mechanical. Uses her Divine Arms Jizurisuzaku to fight. She has an older sister-type personality. She is depicted to smoke a traditional Japanese pipe (kiseru) in the light novels. This is later replaced by an Allen wrench in the anime series.

characters.name: Heidi Augesvarer
characters.original: ハイディ・オーゲザヴァラー
characters.description: Heidi Augesvarer is Shirojiro Bertoni’s partner, both in business and in personal life. Although she constantly has a smile on, she is as much of a miser as Shirojiro is. She is always accompanied by her Maus named Erimaki. (source: genesis-horizon.wikia)

title: Maria†Holic
description: It’s not easy to find the perfect girl, even when you’re the same sex! Kanako thought attending an all girls school would be the perfect way to meet the girl of her dreams, but after her hot new roommate turns out to be a guy in drag, and catching the eye of the most popular girl in school only brings down the wrath of all the OTHER similarly obsessed girls, she’s not so sure! Complicate things with a cat-eared dorm leader, her roommate’s rude-mannered maid and identical twin sister (who attends an all boys school, of course,) and WAY too many attractive girls of questionable persuasions and the question becomes whether Kanako can die from frustrated nosebleeds! (Life would be SO much easier if guys didn’t literally give her the hives!) Will Kanako ever find a non-polar opposite of a compatible non-opposing polarity? (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Kanako Miyamae
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm She is a second year high school transfer student to the prestigious Catholic girls' school Ame no Kisaki, which both her parents attended. Kanako's father was a teacher there, and her mother a student; when they fell in love, they got married quite soon after they left school. Kanako was born not too long after that. She made a decision to come to Ame no Kisaki based on her parents finding happiness together, and she in turn wanted to find her fated one. However, not all is clear on the path of love. The day before she enrolls, Kanako happens to meet a kind, helpful, and indeed beautiful student, Mariya Shidou. Although, she is not what "she" seems. Kanako absolutely detests men, and will proceed to break out in hives if one happens to touch her. (She is a Lesbian, but prefers the term "yuri", even though she still hides this fact from her peers.) It's interesting to

characters.name: Mariya Shidou
characters.description: __Height:__ 160.3 cm At first glance, a seemingly kind, and selfless student, Mariya's true personality couldn't be further from that. A cunning, and incredibly sadistic boy who enjoys nothing more than torturing Kanako, or his twin sister Shizu, although he claims the treatment of the latter is because of his love for her. Mariya attends the prestigious Ame no Kisaki Catholic girl's school, due to a rather silly bet thought up by the previous head of the school, who in actual fact is Mariya's grandmother who he deeply cares for, and holds in high esteem. Mariya keeps a rosary she once owned as a memento. The bet in question is that Mariya, and his twin sister each attend schools for the opposite gender, and if they can stick that out for three years, the winner shall become head of both schools. There is a catch, and that must be that nobody can find out their true gender. When Shizu co

characters.name: Matsurika Shinouji
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm Matsurika is Mariya's maid. She is generally silent but is usually quite rude when she chooses to speak. She delivers the vast majority of her lines with almost no facial expressions. The majority of her insults are directed at Kanako and Mariya. She refers to Kanako by such names as "Ms. Pig," "Eiffel Tower" and "Tokyo Tower" due to Kanako's tall stature. When speaking to Mariya, Matsurika often delivers sharp remarks in regards to his cross-dressing tendencies or sexual perversions. Matsurika also attends classes with Mariya. She also stays hidden from the rest of the students, and follows Mariya's orders when told.

characters.name: Yuzuru Inamori
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm Yuzuru is a demure and friendly girl who has long been friends with Sachi. She is fairly shy and has some self-esteem issues. Kanako sees Inamori as a more elegant girl and is intrigued by her surprisingly large breasts. She is the best archer in the school's archery club, of which Mariya is also a member.

characters.name: Sachi Momoi
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm A bright and cheerful girl, Sachi quickly becomes friends with the newcomer, [Kanako](https://anilist.co/character/13869/Miyamae-Kanako). She has orange hair, commonly tied in pigtails. She is good friends with [Yuzuru](https://anilist.co/character/13872/Inamori-Yuzuru). She seems to have access to hammer space, as she pulls numerous things out from her pockets, even things that would not fit.

characters.name: Nanami Kiri
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm Kiri is an aloof and bespectacled student at Ame no Kisaki. Although she appears quite cold and dispassionate on the surface, she is actually a very caring and helpful personality. At the bequest of the teacher, she helps Kanako to overcome her initial troubles at the school, to the extent that she is willing to put her own reputation at stake by pretending to be Kanako's lover; so as to avoid trouble from Ryūken's fans. She eventually becomes very close friends with Sachi.

characters.name: Ryuuken Ishima
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm Ryūken is the star of Ame no Kisaki, due to her tall stature, good looks, kindness, and generally tomboyish nature. She is a member of the Drama Club, and has played several male roles. She has a great number of fans and her own fan club. Mariya himself is actually quite jealous of her popularity. She was supposed to be Kanako's roommate at the dormitories only to be run out the first night by Mariya so that Mariya could keep a close eye on Kanako. Ryūken's fans cause mischief for Kanako because they are jealous of her friendship with Ryūken.

characters.name: Shizu Shidou
characters.description: __Height:__ 160.6 cm Shizu is Mariya's twin sister. She attends an all boys school which was also run by the ex-chairman. She has a similar hatred/fear of males, and had similar experiences as Kanako, who she affectionately calls 'Kana-chan'. Unlike Mariya, she appears to actually be the kind, innocent girl that Mariya attempts to portray. She is also quick to get her feelings hurt, as well. The agreement for the competition was the loser would be chosen if someone found out from either school; Kanako, thinking Shizu was Mariya, mentioned Mariya's touching her, which revealed to Shizu that Kanako knew Mariya's gender, thus defining Mariya as the loser. Shizu had only went into the school to switch with Mariya for their schools' physical examinations. However, because Kanako found out Mariya's secret before she began attending the school, it was null, and because Kanako knew Shizu's true

characters.name: Ryouchou-sensei
characters.description: An unusual young girl with cat ears who looks after Dorm No. 2 which Kanako is assigned to. She is addressed as "Miss Dorm Leader" by all the students. When Kanako met her, and tried to make small talk and ask casual questions Dorm Leader looped back to the first question to say that she might also be addressed as 'Boss' or 'God'. Kanako took this as a hint to ask no more questions. The students do not dare disobey her for fear of vague, yet frightening threats. She has a pet dog, Yonakuni, who helps her take care of the place. Her rule of the dorm extends to manhandling Father Kanae after repeatedly demanding bribes so that he can see Kanako. She has an idiosyncratic speech pattern which makes her speak in a rather languid fashion and inserts the phrase 'desu yo' wherever grammatically possible. She is always accompanied by Yonakuni-san, the apron wearing dorm watchdog.

characters.name: Yonakuni-san
characters.description: Dog of Dorm Leader.

characters.name: Fumi Kumagai
characters.description: Homeroom teacher for Kanako, Nanami, Sachi and Yuzuru. She is a graduate of Ame no Kisaki, remembers Professor Miyamae, Kanako's mother and had met Kanako herself, when she was very young. She tells Kanako that everyone calls her "Miss Teddybear".

characters.name: Ayari Shiki
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shiki runs the school's student council. She is Mariya's and Shizu's cousin, and has a standing rivalry with Mariya. She calls him 'Flat Chest', as he calls her 'Fat Ass'. Apparently, the cause of the animosity between Mariya and Ayari happened because of a childhood incident where she had her dress ripped open supposedly by Mariya (and her underwear exposed). Because of that incident, she got called "Panda-Chang" after the mascot character printed on her underwear and all sorts of nicknames related to pandas. She blames Mariya for this incident and therefore holds a grudge on him for that. Ayari and Mariya look much alike and are about the same height.

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 2wei Herz!
title_original: Fate/kaleid liner プリズマ☆イリヤ ツヴァイ ヘルツ！
description: Illyasviel von Einzbern's life has become ridiculously complicated since the Kaleidostick Ruby convinced her to become a magical girl and join the quest for collecting the seven Class Cards. Since then, almost every day has brought a new surprise, from gaining new friends and partners like Miyu Edelfelt, to encountering her own magical twin! One would think Illya deserves a little time off, right? No such luck: a trip to the beach quickly turns into a magical quest, and Illya finds herself caught in a string of magical feuds, encounters with love potions, an excursion into the world of "boys love" comics (plus the women who read them), and half a dozen other delirious diversions. However, that's only the warm-up for what might be her final mission: recovering the long-lost Eighth Card! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
characters.original: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Daughter of the distinguished lineage of magi of the Edelfelt, Luvia is their young and talented family head. A student in Clock Tower, the Mage's Association academy, she is one of the candidates for the position of student's president for the current academic term. As long as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) is not nearby, Luvia's attitude is always graceful, never blaspheming and with a beauty similar to a swan. Of course, that is just a facade and she is actually very competitive and suffers with perfectionist tendencies. Luvia has long golden blonde hair styled entirely in large coils. She physically resembles Rin somewhat, furthering speculation that the younger Edelfelt sister from the Third Holy Grail War may have married into the Tohsaka family. She is from Finland.

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.original: クロエ・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card. ~!She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Taiga Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother. She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps fr

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago.
