He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot. His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059). __In Fate/Zero:__ ~! Initially summon

characters.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
characters.original: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

characters.name: Issei Ryuudou
characters.description: Issei is the Student Body President of Shirō's school, and another close friend of [Shirō](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Issei often asks Shirō to fix broken equipment for the Student Body to try and reduce save money on the school's bill. Issei and Shirō often have lunch together in the Student Body's office where they talk about what ever comes to mind. His father is the head priest of Ryūdōji Temple, and his brother was a classmate of [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/505/Fujimura-Taiga) and [Neko-san](https://anilist.co/character/187774/Hotaruzuka-Otoko). He dislikes [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) and seems to have some sort of fear of females, although he seems to be unusually at ease around [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria). ~!Issei unknowingly tells Shirō that [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) is a

characters.name: Bazett Fraga McRemitz
characters.original: バゼット・フラガ・マクレミッツ
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm Bazett is a serious, kind, and hardworking individual who possesses a strong sense of justice. She can be short-tempered, but calculating. While she presents herself as a strong-willed and mature woman with an independent streak, she is actually rather lonely. Bazett had always intended to summon [Cú Chulainn](https://anilist.co/character/499/Chulainn-C) for the Fifth Holy Grail War. The reason behind her motive was her desire to save him since childhood. Having had a dispassionate and socially desolate childhood, Bazett found herself immersed with the story of Cú Chulainn. She grieved for the tragedy of his legend, but at the same time felt that it gave her a sense of purpose. She strove to become a strong magus, gambling on the wild hope of summoning him and using the Holy Grail as a means of "saving" him from his inevitable fate. Bazett was born in a coastal village

characters.name: Leysritt
characters.description: Leysritt is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid much like Sella. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Regardless of her thin ego, she developed a sense of reason due to her alignment with Illya. As a result, Leysritt often says what she thinks without any consideration and this gets her often into a verbal conflict with Sella. She and Illya are actually very close friends and should Illya die, Leysritt would die as well. In contrast to Sella, she possesses a casual personality but has difficulty expressing her emotions and comes across as robotic at times. However, she appears to enjoy teasing Sella and also takes a liking to Shirou because his presence makes Illya happy.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Sotsu
title_original: ひぐらしのなく頃に卒
description: Rika Furude and Satoko Houjou are best friends who have lived in the small village of Hinamizawa for their entire lives. Alongside their other friends, they spend every day together, and every moment is filled with fun and laughter. However, as Rika and Satoko begin to grow older, a life-changing opportunity presents itself to both of them. Rika is determined to follow her dreams and wants Satoko by her side. Although Satoko is hesitant, she decides to walk this path with Rika. However, the realization of her dream forms a rift between them. This leaves the girls living in completely different worlds, with Rika enjoying her new life and making new friends while Satoko grows more and more isolated. Longing to return to the nostalgic days in Hinamizawa, Satoko despairs and wishes things could be changed. Just when she is at wits' end, an encounter with a supernatural entity changes Satoko's perception and imparts new revelations about her best friend Rika. This begins her journey to get the future she desires—by any means necessary. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar

characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Shion Sonozaki
characters.description: Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. ~!Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger sister.!~ She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, s

characters.name: Hanyuu Furude
characters.description: Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster"). In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the characters, she can be frightening when angered, and with her spirit-like nature, her appearance can change with her mood until she takes a physical form. She is very meek and often makes the noise "Au au, au au…" when she is nervous or uncomfortable, or sometimes while trying to make a point. She also t

characters.name: Eua
characters.description: A woman with horns not unlike Hanyuu's. ~!Calls Rika her "cat". Awards Satoko with the power to live in loops to provide her with entertainment. Satoko calls her "Uhmera", but her true name and nature are unknown.!~

characters.name: Kuraudo Ooishi
characters.description: Kuraudo Oishi is a veteran police investigator at Okinomiya who has vowed to solve the mystery of the Hinamizawa murders before his retirement, due to personal reasons. Due to his uncouth tactics and the lengths that he goes to in order to solve the mystery, he is looked upon as a nuisance by the villagers. ~!He approaches one of the main characters to become his informant in several arcs, and is sometimes unwittingly responsible for triggering their paranoia.!~

characters.name: Miyo Takano
characters.description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

characters.name: Rumiko Chie
characters.description: Rumiko is the female teacher of Keiichi's class, who is a parody character of Tsukihime's Ciel-Senpai (permission for her usage was given by Type-Moon). The seiyū for her character in the anime series is the same as the seiyū of Ciel from the Tsukihime anime. Going along with the parody, her favorite food is curry rice, just like Ciel, and will go to great and somewhat scary, lengths to uphold the honor of curry, which is shown in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei OVA, where she becomes enraged by Keichi's "offense" to curry. On a stronger note, she is seen wielding wooden T's, shapped, and held, in exactly the same fashion as the Black Keys from Tsukihime.

characters.name: Kyousuke Irie
characters.description: Kyosuke is the head doctor of the village clinic. Despite his young age and the fact that he has a severe maid fetish, he is highly respected in the community. He cheerfully makes house calls and seems to truly care about everyone's health. He has (half-jokingly) admitted that he wishes to marry [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko) when she is older, but is not above chasing after [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) when she is wearing one of the uniforms from the restaurant Angel Mort. In addition, he is the manager of the village's baseball little league team, the Hinamizawa Fighters. ~!In the past, he has performed lobotomies without consent, which led to him being banished from the medical academic society in Tokyo. He is recruited by Takano to direct research the Hinamizawa Syndrome, which he feels will redeem himself. It is later revealed that

title: Harukana Receive
description: The story takes place in Okinawa, where Haruka forms a beach volleyball pair with Kanata. Kanata, who couldn't handle the pressure put on her by her short height, had given up on beach volleyball already, but is convinced by Haruka to step back on the sand once again and aim for the junior tournament.

characters.name: Kanata Higa
characters.description: Kanata Higa is one of the main characters in Harukana Receive. Upon her debut, Kanata was initially somewhat withdrawn. This came from being relatively short compared to the other characters, which gave her a disadvantage at beach volleyball. Though Kanata's distancing makes her rather shy, quiet, and reserved, she can behave eccentrically in unusual situations. ~!After meeting [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/126573/Oozora-Haruka), she begins to open up while develops a new "outotsu" playing-style which lets her adapts her short stature with Haruka's height. As she and Haruka bond, she maintains her friendship with [Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/137105/Tooi-Narumi) to which they believe it's stronger to win together than alone.!~

characters.name: Haruka Oozora
characters.description: Haruka Oozora is one of the protagonists in Harukana Receive. She first came to Okinawa because of her parents' employment and moves in with her grandmother. She is a very energetic and light-headed girl and childish to some extent, but positively straightforward where she is empathetic towards those around her.

characters.name: Akari Ooshiro
characters.description: Akari Ōshiro is a new member and later manager of the Umuru High Beach Volleyball Club in Harukana Receive. Akari is a tsundere-type, thus is constantly embarrassed and nervous when called by her nickname 'Shii-Chan' or when [Claire](https://anilist.co/character/126577/Thomas-Claire) remembers her participation in the drink's advertising in the past as the Shequasar Girl.

characters.name: Emily Thomas
characters.description: Emily Thomas is Claire's twin sister and her beach volleyball partner. She is also part of Umuru High's student council and president of the school's Beach Volleyball Club. Although they often argue with each other and Emily regularly sarcastically comments on her childish antics, they still remain a good pair and Emily refuses to play with anyone other than Claire.

characters.name: Claire Thomas
characters.description: Claire Thomas is Emily's twin sister where they are both American exchange students at Urama High School, and both are the top junior beach volleyball players in the world. Emily makes up one half of Team Eclair. She quickly becomes close with Haruka because of the similarity of their personalities and they can often be seen together if Kanata is not around.

characters.name: Ayasa Tachibana
characters.description: Ayasa Tachibana is Narumi Toi's best friend and partner. She was originally an indoor volleyball player on a scholarship, but transitioned to beach volleyball from being inspired after challenging Narumi.

characters.name: Narumi Tooi
characters.description: Narumi Toi is Kanata Higa's former beach volleyball partner. Together with [Ayasa](https://anilist.co/character/126575/Tachibana-Ayasa), Narumi is a consecutive champion of local beach volleyball competitions and even adapting her "idols" status of this sport.

characters.name: Marissa Thomas
characters.description: Marissa Thomas, the mother of the Thomas Twins, [Claire](https://anilist.co/character/126577/Thomas-Claire) and [Emily](https://anilist.co/character/126576/Thomas-Emily). Marissa is a former US Pro Player and current coach. Their team name is a play on éclair. They are ranked as the second best pairing behind [Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/137105/Tooi-Narumi) and [Ayasa](https://anilist.co/character/126575/Tachibana-Ayasa). Originally, when [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/126570/Higa-Kanata) and Narumi were a team, the pair was defeated by them, with Claire declaring them their rivals (and friends); eventually, Marissa became Narumi and Ayasa's coach, with the Thomas Family becoming close with Kanata's family.

title: Chio-chan no Tsuugakuro
description: Miyamo Chio, a first-year at the completely ordinary high school Samejima Academy. Chio just wants to get through her school life without standing out too much, but for some reason, all kinds of obstacles await her along the path she takes to school. Her long-time friend Nonomura Manana, who's trying to quit being an otaku; the flawless Hosokawa Yuki, who occupies the top caste in the school; and lots of nameless people about town find themselves in Chio's path as she employs the (useless) techniques she's acquired from her Western video games in her daily efforts to get to school. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Chio Miyamo
characters.description: A first-year high school student attending Sameshima Academy. She's a hardcore player of Western PC games. She hates to stand out, and her motto is "be less than average." Her physical strength is nothing to sneeze at. (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Manana Nonomura
characters.description: Manana is Chio's best friend who has been with her since elementary school. Despite their close friendship, the two will occasionally try to backstab each other. Can also be quite vicious when angry.

characters.name: Yuki Hosokawa
characters.description: Yuki is Chio's classmate who is a sports ace and very popular. She is polite and often oblivious to how people see her this is shown when shes wears a track outfit in public

characters.name: Madoka Kushitori
characters.description: Madoka is a senior student at Chio's school who is captain of the Kabaddi Club. She has a strong passion for kabaddi, which she ultimately comes to realize is not based in the sport itself, but rather for it being the perfect excuse to grope other girls.

characters.name: Mayuta Andou
characters.description: Mayuta is a former biker gang leader who is tricked by Chio into quitting his gang and now seeks to earn an honest living as a convenience store clerk. He has a crush on Chio and often goes to absurd lengths to impress her such as replicating a scene from a BL game with one of his former gang members.

characters.name: Momo Shinozuka
characters.description: Momo is a member of the public morals committee at Chio's school.

characters.name: Chiharu Andou
characters.description: Chiharu is Mayuta's younger sister. She loves her older brother dearly and is in search of the women who made him quit his gang. Also has a questionable habit of trying to poke other peoples backsides

title: Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana
title_original: 上伊那ぼたん、酔へる姿は百合の花
title_en: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
description: New university life, new dormmates…and a whole new world of drinks! Botan Kamiina takes her first sip of alcohol after spotting the quiet dorm leader, Ibuki Tonami, enjoying a highball alone. From shochu to whisky, Botan shares the joy of drinking with friends, while Ibuki slowly learns that some pleasures are better when shared. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Ibuki Tonami
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/eve.o0o0.keeey/) Born in Toyama prefecture. She is a third-year at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan). She is the dorm leader of the university dormitory where her and Botan live. She has a neat bob cut and usually wears lax, boyish, and oversized clothes. She is a pretty heavy drinker and has a lot of knowledge about alcohol. This shows especially in her dorm room, which is filled with half-empty liquor bottles. Due to things that happened in her past, she is scared of drinking with other people, so she usually drinks alone. However, this changes when she meets Botan.

characters.name: Botan Kamiina
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kamiina.botan/) Born in Nagano prefecture. The main character of the manga as well as a first-year college student. She is enrolled in the management engineering department of the Faculty of Science and Engineering. She entered college as a ronin, and thus is 20 years old, meaning she is allowed to drink. She has a hard time drinking carbonated drinks and bonds over this with [Ibuki](https://anilist.co/character/309268/Tonami-Ibuki).

characters.name: Chin-Lan Chang
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/chang.chin_lan/) An international exchange student from Taiwan who moves into the dormitory. She has short black hair, a calm atmosphere, and a self-paced personality. Japanese isn't her native language, and she occasionally uses Taiwanese Hokkien when speaking. ~!She very quickly catches onto Ibuki's feelings for Botan and tells Botan to only keep getting closer to Ibuki if she plans on answering her feelings. She also became friends with Gujou rather quickly, after finding out about her unrequited feelings for Ibuki.!~

characters.name: Kanade Gujou
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ka_na_de.206/) Born in Gifu prefecture. She is a student at the same university as Botan and the others and lives in the same dormitory. She has been interested in Ibuki for a long time and is jealous of Botan's relationship with her. She has seen Ibuki drinking alone once before and has asked her to drink together a number of times, however, Ibuki has always refused.

characters.name: Yaeka Kitamori
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/yaeka_journy/) Born in Yamanashi Prefecture. She is a second-year at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan). She seemingly has an intimate relationship with [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/309274/Yusa-Akane).

characters.name: Akane Yusa
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/y0usir_jp/) A second-year student at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan), she also lives in the dormitory. She has a deep knowledge of music and her dorm room is filled with instruments and vinyl records from her dad. She plays guitar as part of the band "YOUs!R". She seemingly has an intimate relationship with [Yaeka](https://anilist.co/character/309271/Kitamori-Yaeka).

characters.name: Aoi Yukimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm A few years ago, Aoi had made a promise with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/69503/Kuraue-Hinata) that they would climb mountains together, but after a bit of a nasty fall of a playground attraction, she ended up with a broken arm and a fear of heights, which eventually lead to a withdrawn personality. However, once Hinata approached her at the start of high school, Aoi once again is drawn towards the lure of the mountain.

characters.name: Hinata Kuraue
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hinata is an exhuberant, energetic girl who used to go on long hikes together with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) when they were both kids. However, that came to an end when Aoi had her accident. Still, with high school starting, she once again saw the opportunity to reignite Aoi's interest in hiking, so she went for it.

characters.name: Master
characters.description: Bartender at Bar Caravin.

title: Seiken no Blacksmith
title_original: 聖剣の刀鍛冶（ブラックスミス）
description: The knight Cecily wants to defend the weak, but her lack of skill makes her an unlikely heroine—until the blacksmith Luke comes to her aid, using magic to forge blades of supernatural strength. Cecily wields this sacred steel and charges forth to face a new threat; a cloaked fiend is unleashing demons upon the land, and though he lurks in shadows, the villain is closer than Cecily knows. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Cecily Cambell
characters.original: セシリー・キャンベル
characters.description: She is a knight from The Knight Guards of the Third Independent Trade City. Since the Devil War, the head of the Cambell family has fought as a knight. Her grandfather and father founded, protected and supported independent cities. When her father dies from an illness, she decides to be knight - even though she's a girl and doesn't know how fight with swords too well. In her first fight she broke her sword, and almost got killed, if Luke didn't save her then. Cecily is very loyal and stubborn. Lisa describes her as "bold." She has red hair and eyes.

characters.name: Luke Ainsworth
characters.original: ルーク・エインズワース
characters.description: He saved Cecily, when she almost got killed. He is often seen together with Lisa. Luke has skill with wielding swords, his father was a swordsmith. He may be arrogant and insensitive, but inside he is quite shy and has a timid personality. He has dark brown hair and blue eyes. He has a weird relation with Cecily, he admires her but he doesn't want her to know that. ~!At the time he lost his childhood beloved Lisa Oakwood, his left eye burst. It looks off during the entire series because it's merely a fake.!~

characters.name: Lisa
characters.description: A cute little girl who is a live-in assistant to Luke. ~!Lisa is actually a demon born from Lisa Oakwood, Luke's childhood friend. Although unconfirmed, it is suggested that in order to protect Luke forever, Lisa Oakwood made a Demonic Pact before dying to Valbanill and sacrificed herself to create Lisa.!~ Lisa greatly resembles Lisa Oakwood when she was young, possessing similar traits, such as blonde hair, purple eyes, and elven ears. She has a sweet personality and is very polite. Seems to be unusually strong for her age (for example, can carry a huge basket of vegetables). Lisa is also able to create a gigantic fireball to assist Luke in forging katana in the heat of battle. Lisa loves Luke and her life revolves entirely around him. She has proven herself very capable at doing chores around the house and takes delight in them. In addition, Lisa assists Luke in the forge. Thus sh

characters.name: Aria
characters.description: Aria is a demon sword with the power of wind who states she is older than about 40 years. She has been used cruelly in previous wars thus is fascinated by Cecily as Cecily is a knight who doesn't like to kill. Aria and Cecily form a strong friendship.

characters.name: Siegfried
characters.description: A recently promoted commander from the Empire. ~!He is actually the cloaked figure who is the source for most of the conflict in the series. He wields the Demon Sword of Corrosion.!~

characters.name: Doris
characters.description: One of the three bodyguards of Charlotte E Firobisher and owner of the Demon Sword of the earth, Claymore. Quote from episode 6 (5:23 into) of Sacred Blacksmith

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: One of Charlotte's companions. She wields a ballock knife, the Demon Sword Assassin (English Dub).

characters.name: Margot
characters.description: One of Charlotte's companions. She wields Rhomphaia, the Demon Sword of Scarlet Light.

characters.name: Hannibal Quasar
characters.description: The captain of the Knights

characters.name: Patty Baldwin
characters.description: Cecily's friend and one who takes care of the knight's swords/weapons

characters.name: Charlotte E Firobisher
characters.description: A young girl from the Empire who is the illegitimate daughter of the Emperor. As proof, she has "E" as her middle name, which is an indication of the royal family. Initially portrayed as a spoiled and selfish girls, she is, in fact, very down to Earth, capable of all the household tasks. She struggles internally to fulfill her mother's dying wish: to be recognized as a legitimate child of the Emperor. However, when the Empire refuses recognize her and brands her as an impostor, she is forced into the tough decision of having to face the death penalty or defect to an opposing nation. After she and her bodyguards were forcefully convinced by Cecily, she renounces her royal status and defects to the opposing nation along with her bodyguards took from wikipedia

characters.name: Hugo Housman
characters.original: ヒューゴー・ハウスマン

title: Koisuru Asteroid
title_original: 恋する小惑星〈アステロイド〉
description: When she was little, Konohata Mira promises a boy she meets at a campsite that they can find an asteroid together. When she enters high school, she joins the astronomy club. But that year, the astronomy club happened to combine with the geology club, making it the astrogeo club?! Won't you find all kinds of sparkles with the astrogeo girls? (Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 3rei!!
title_original: Fate/kaleid liner プリズマ☆イリヤ ドライ!!
description: Illya and the gang have finished their battle against the heroic spirit residing in the eighth class card. They're back in vacation mode again, looking to make the most of what they have left of summer break. But their hopes get crushed in the blink of an eye. An all-too-unrealistic silhouette appears before them when they go to investigate the strange event at Mount Enzō. After a short skirmish, the entire space ends up being warped. Illya wakes up in a wintry Fuyuki City... in a parallel world. This is the world where Miyu was born and raised. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.original: クロエ・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card. ~!She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Sakura Matou
characters.description: __Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night) A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

characters.name: Kirei Kotomine
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm (Fate/Zero), 193 cm (Fate/stay night) ~!Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the 4th Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another. Since the death of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin)'s father, he has also acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.!~

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot. His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059). __In Fate/Zero:__ ~! Initially summon

characters.name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
characters.original: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Daughter of the distinguished lineage of magi of the Edelfelt, Luvia is their young and talented family head. A student in Clock Tower, the Mage's Association academy, she is one of the candidates for the position of student's president for the current academic term. As long as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) is not nearby, Luvia's attitude is always graceful, never blaspheming and with a beauty similar to a swan. Of course, that is just a facade and she is actually very competitive and suffers with perfectionist tendencies. Luvia has long golden blonde hair styled entirely in large coils. She physically resembles Rin somewhat, furthering speculation that the younger Edelfelt sister from the Third Holy Grail War may have married into the Tohsaka family. She is from Finland.

characters.name: Bazett Fraga McRemitz
characters.original: バゼット・フラガ・マクレミッツ
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm Bazett is a serious, kind, and hardworking individual who possesses a strong sense of justice. She can be short-tempered, but calculating. While she presents herself as a strong-willed and mature woman with an independent streak, she is actually rather lonely. Bazett had always intended to summon [Cú Chulainn](https://anilist.co/character/499/Chulainn-C) for the Fifth Holy Grail War. The reason behind her motive was her desire to save him since childhood. Having had a dispassionate and socially desolate childhood, Bazett found herself immersed with the story of Cú Chulainn. She grieved for the tragedy of his legend, but at the same time felt that it gave her a sense of purpose. She strove to become a strong magus, gambling on the wild hope of summoning him and using the Holy Grail as a means of "saving" him from his inevitable fate. Bazett was born in a coastal village

characters.name: Magical Ruby
characters.description: Originally the magical wand of Rin Toshaka. She broke up contract with Rin due to her personal conflict with Luviagelita Edelfelt and also for not cooperating together to fulfill the goal of capturing all magical cards of all classes. It then formed contract with Illya that made her a magical girl - A dream come true?

characters.name: Magical Sapphire
characters.description: The magical wand of Luviagelita Edelfelt who broke up contract with her with the same reason with Magical Ruby. It made contract with Miyu Edelfelt, who was then made to serve Luviagelita.

title: Nukitashi THE ANIMATION
description: The island of the everlasting summer, Seiran Island. Junnosuke Tachibana, whose family home was on this island, returned to it with his sister, Asane Tachibana, after the death of their parents. However, Seiran Island has become a place of madness due to the implementation of the “Perverted Law,” a law designed to combat population decline. This law permits and even encourages lewd sex acts everywhere on the island, and refusing to engage in “reproductive activities” is punished almost as severely as a crime. Junnosuke, a proud virgin and staunch defender of virginity, questions the legitimacy of this law. Determined to protect both his and his beloved sister’s purity, he forms the anti-copulation front NLNS (No Love No Sex) and sets out to destroy the Perveted Law once and for all. “I’ll… destroy the Perverted Law!” (Source: Official Site, translated) Note: Prior to the TV broadcast, a special pre-release screening titled “Nukitashi THE ANIMATION – Seiran Island Special ver. Pre-release Screening Event” was held on June 22, 2025 at Cinem@rt Shinjuku in Tokyo. It featured episodes 1-3.

characters.name: Junnosuke Tachibana
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") A proud virgin who believes that there can't be sex without love. As he stays on Seiran Island and dodges the "SS" committee, he launches the "NLNS (No Love, No Sex)" campaign in order to rebel against the island's deranged laws and customs.

characters.name: Asane Tachibana
characters.description: Junnosuke's sister who understands him the most. She dislikes normal men but loves her older brother and women, especially older and perverted women. Most of the time Asane is relaxed but as soon as she sees a woman who is her type, she loses control of herself completely. Her dream is to have a threesome with her brother and his girlfriend.

characters.name: Hinami Watarai
characters.description: __Height:__ 139 cm (4'7") Contrary to her young and loli appearance, Hinami is a third-year student. She is very kind and has a big heart, and hates constantly being referred to as a loli or a child. She also carries a chair around with her to help her reach high places due to her small stature.

characters.name: Nanase Katagiri
characters.description: The most charismatic and popular "slut" of the school. There are a lot of rumors of Nanase being an uncontrollable sex queen, but in reality Nanase is a virgin and people base everything on her looks. She often uses this to her advantage when attempting to escape.

characters.name: Misaki Hotori
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") A girl who has barely any presence and has a complex over her body, so people easily forget her. However because she was born on Seiran Island, she doesn't care about people staring at her chest during conversations.

characters.name: Ikuko Onabuta
characters.description: The "first commander" of the "SS" committee. She thinks about sex 24/7 every day of the year, and often slacks off from her duties due to this.

characters.name: Touka Reizeiin
characters.description: The student council president of the school and the leader of the "SS" committee. To Touka, sex is just a simple form of communication.

characters.name: Rei Tadasugawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") A third-year student who is the "military tactician" of the "SS" committee, or in other words, controls their members. She doesn't tolerate people who break rules, and always tells Junnosuke, who often runs away from Rei, that corridors are the perfect places to have sex at, among other things.

characters.name: Fumino Kotoyose
characters.description: A mysterious girl who can often be seen aiding the NLNS with her sniping skills from a distance. Is not very talkative due to not interacting with people very often, but is a very earnest girl who has tremendous respect for those who have a strong conviction. ~!She is the illegitimate child of Governor Hitoura, which is the reason everyone belives she is the key to breaking the Perverted Ordinance.!~

characters.name: Hamedori-kun
characters.description: Hamedori-kun is the mascot of Seiran Island.

characters.name: Fuku Umenoki
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") Fuku Umenoki is a member of the FS.

title: Uchi no Maid ga Uzasugiru!
title_original: うちのメイドがウザすぎる！
description: Misha is a little girl who lost her mother at an early age, and now lives with her father. Her father employs a maid named Tsubame, who was a former Self-Defense Force official, and is also a lolicon. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Tsubame Kamoi
characters.description: An ex-Air Self-Defense Force soldier who becomes the Takanashi family’s maid. She claims to only be interested in girls who haven’t menstruated yet, forming a particular attachment towards Misha.

characters.name: Misha Takanashi
characters.description: A Russian girl who has become a rebellious recluse following her mother's death. She is fearful of Tsubame's behavior and often tries to find ways to get rid of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yasuhiro Takanashi
characters.description: Misha's father, who becomes over delighted when Misha shows her any kind of interest. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kumagorou
characters.description: Misha's pet ferret.

characters.name: Midori Ukai
characters.description: Former Air Force colleague of Tsubame, whom she has an unrequited love for. Exhibits highly masochistic and self-deprecating behaviour.

title: Hibike! Euphonium 3
description: Kumiko's third year finally begins! With the concert band at Kitauji High School over 90 members, Kumiko is now the president and does her best with her final high school club activities to try to win her long-desired gold at nationals. (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Kumiko Oumae
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

characters.name: Reina Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

characters.name: Hazuki Katou
characters.description: **Instrument:** Tuba Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

characters.name: Sapphire Kawashima
characters.description: **Instrument:** Contrabass Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Mayu Kuroe
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Euphonium She is a third-year transfer student from the prestigious Seira Girls School.

characters.name: Shuuichi Tsukamoto
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Trombone Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.

characters.name: Noboru Taki
characters.description: __Height:__ 184cm Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

characters.name: Ririka Kenzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'3") __Instrument:__ Oboe Ririka is a first-year student of Kitauji High School and an oboe player in Kitauji Concert Band Club. She has a light and cheerful childlike personality who tries to build a good relationship with [Mizore](https://anilist.co/character/125960/). However, according to [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/133462/), Ririka is aware of her ability to pass off any rude or suspicious behaviour as innocence with her smile. When Ririka's interested in something, she starts from the beginning and goes step by step. Her special skill is making friends.

characters.name: Kanade Hisaishi
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kanade Hisaishi is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a euphonium player in Kumiko's second year. Kanade has a courteous personality and great communication skills, and gives off a good impression to everyone who sees her. However, she has a secret side to her always-polite demeanor. Kumiko describes her as a "hypocritical courtesy" or a girl who is "superficially polite but rude in intent".

characters.name: Mirei Suzuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm __Instrument:__ Tuba Mirei Suzuki is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a tuba player in [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s second year. When Mirei was friends with [Satsuki](https://anilist.co/character/142965/Suzuki-Satsuki) in elementary school, they were called "Sacchan and Micchan", although she dislikes that nickname.

characters.name: Satsuki Suzuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm __Instrument:__ Tuba Satsuki Suzuki is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a tuba player in Kumiko's second year. She is mostly friendly and cheerful who is a sociable person where she can become friends instantly with anyone.

characters.name: Motomu Tsukinaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Contrabass Motomu Tsukinaga is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. He joins the band as a contrabass player in Kumiko's second year. Despite looking adorable on the outside, Motomu is stated as a very crabby boy on the inside. He hates being called cute or by his surname by others.

title: Elfen Lied: Tooriame nite - Arui wa, Shoujo wa Ikani Shite Sono Shinjou ni Itatta ka?
title_original: エルフェンリート 通り雨にて 或いは、少女はいかにしてその心情に至ったか?（REGENSCHAUER）
title_en: Elfen Lied: Just How Did the Young Girl Arrive at Those Feelings?
description: This episode takes place within episode 11 as Nana attempts to fit in the household while trying to find a chore that she can do and get used to Nyu's presence whom she only knows as Lucy. Running away after getting scolded, Nana ends up in the beach and meets Bando whom she promised to bring Lucy to later that night. Leaving the household with Nyu, it begins to rain and Nyu slips, hits her head, and is knocked unconscious. As Bando waits and everyone else worries where they might be, Nana, with an uncoscious Nyu, takes shelter as Lucy's consciousness begins to come out and dreams an old memory of how she was captured and why she doesn't attack Director Kurama. As the rain begins to let up, Kouta and the others find Nana and Lucy and takes them home. There, Nana finally finds the chore that she will be doing - feeding the dog. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kouta
characters.description: Kouta is one of the main characters of the series and is first introduced in Volume 1 when he arrives in Kanagawa Prefecture to attend college, having previously arranged to stay with his cousin Yuka while at school.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.description: Lucy is a Diclonius girl around eighteen years old. She has developed strong emotions of hatred and vengeance towards regular humans mainly because of how she was treated by the majority of them as a child, making fun of her horns and giving her insulting nicknames such as freak.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: Also known as Number 7, she is a young Silpelit girl who has the physical appearance of being 12-14 years old (though because Silpelits age rapidly, she is actually only about 6 years old). Her name, 'Nana', is Japanese for the number seven, the number by which she was called at the research facility ("Nana" is also a fairly common female name in Japan). Most diclonius babies are euthanized at birth in sweeps of hospital maternity wards, but Nana was one of a handful kept alive for use as a test subjects; as a result she has spent her entire life in the diclonius research facility. Kurama sees her as his daughter and cares very much for her. In an attempt to recapture Lucy, Kurama sent out Nana to find her (diclonii can telepathically sense each other), then retreat until Kurama could arrive with soldiers, but Nana wanted to impress Kurama so she tried to capture Lucy herself. Lucy and N

characters.name: Kurama
characters.description: He is the chief of research, aged in his mid-30's, of the diclonius children in the research containment facility. He is also the surrogate father of Nana and biological father of Mariko. ~!His wife, Hiromi Kurama, died from Caesarean section complications shortly after she gave birth to Mariko. Although he had previously been tasked with killing all diclonius births, he falters when he must kill his own daughter. Lucy carries a deep hatred toward Kurama, stemming from his failure to save Aikon Takada (seen in the Elfen Lied OVA); however, she states that she will not kill him but will kill everything that loves him. It is revealed late in the series that the General Director of the diclonius research program kept his daughter alive, increasing Kurama's perceived debt to him. Kurama dies at the end of the anime after the explosives inside Mariko (whom he is cradling in his arms while wal

characters.name: Yuka
characters.description: Yuka is Kouta's cousin. She is planning to attend the same university as Kouta. She moves in with him at the inn after having not seen him in many years. Having had a crush on Kouta since childhood, she is in love with him, and is therefore jealous of Kouta's attention to Nyuu, to the point of being very irrational.

characters.name: Mayu
characters.description: She is a young girl, abandoned by her mother and a victim of sexual abuse by her stepfather. She has run away from home and is homeless at the start of the series, subsisting on bread crusts she is given at a local bakery under the pretence that they are for the small puppy that accompanies her. She found and named the puppy "Wanta." She ends up living with Kohta and Yuka as her legal guardians. Mayu befriends Nana and tries to take her under her wing. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Bando
characters.description: He is an operative in his mid-30's for the National Police Agency's Special Assault Team (SAT). Though he is fully human, he is as homicidal and apathetic to other people as the worst diclonius are. He is a hardy and effective soldier. After being maimed by Lucy and repaired with bionic, cybernetic and prosthetic implants, he escapes on a quest for revenge against her. He gets two or more Desert Eagle hand guns. In the manga he gets other weapons such as a RPG. The guns fire .50 caliber rounds which are so powerful the rounds can not be blocked with vectors. But the bullets can be pushed off course at long range though; however at close range not even Lucy can stop them. ~!He gets sidetracked several times in this quest, and ultimately receives aid from Kurama to "kill a diclonius that was coming." Bando is driven by the will to fight and to prove his superior ability in combat. At the e

characters.name: Kakuzawa Kyouju
characters.description: He is the son of Chief Kakuzawa and also a watered-down diclonius with smaller horns and no vectors in his mid-30's. When he and Kurama were younger, they both went to university together and it was Kakuzawa that originally got Kurama involved in the research on Diclonius. He ends up, coincidentally, being the lecturer for a course at the university in which Kouta and Yuka are enrolled. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Aiko Takada
characters.description: Aiko Takada was the second human to befriend Kaede (Lucy). She made her only appearance in Chapter 85 of the manga series, and in the special OVA episode of the anime, both of which are almost exclusively devoted to her back-story. (Source: Wikia)

title: Tonari no Kyuuketsuki-san
title_en: Ms. vampire who lives in my neighborhood.
description: Human girl Amano Akari is rescued by a vampire, Sophie Twilight, and falls in love with her. She forces herself into Sophie’s home and begins living with her. Though Sophie is a vampire, she never attacks humans, instead buying blood and anime merchandise online like any ordinary person. A modern-day vampire comedy! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Sophie Twilight
characters.original: ソフィー・トワイライト
characters.description: Sophie is a doll-like vampire who prefers to buy blood online rather than drinking it from humans. She's also an anime otaku.

characters.name: Akari Amano
characters.description: Akari is a high school girl who loves dolls. After meeting Sophie, who looks like a doll, Akari barges into her house and ends up living with her.

characters.name: Ellie
characters.description: Ellie is a vampire who is an old friend of Sophie's. She just recently woke up from a 100 year nap, so she doesn't know much about the modern world, and is bad with technology. Unlike Sophie, who purchases blood online, Ellie prefers to drink from cute young girls.

characters.name: Hinata Natsuki
characters.description: Hinata is Akari's childhood friend.

characters.name: Mori-san
characters.description: Sophie's friendly neighbor.

characters.name: Mikage Natsuki
characters.description: Hinata's brother.

characters.name: Mikan
characters.description: Hinata's beloved pet dog.

characters.name: Asahi Aoki
characters.description: Yuu's younger sister.

characters.name: Vampire Hunter
characters.original: ヴァンパイアハンター
characters.description: An aspiring vampire hunter looking to avenge her great-great-great-great-grandfather who was turned into a vampire.

title: Sayonara Lara
description: Long, long ago, there lived a mermaid princess named Lara. She was raised with love by her father, the king of the sea kingdom, and her older sisters. One day, Lara fell in love with a human prince who lived on land. It was a forbidden love, one that was not allowed in the world of mermaids. Still, Lara journeyed to the surface. With a potion, given to her from the witch Grace, she became human. But the potion came at a cost: fail to find true love, she would turn into foam. Though she was a princess of the sea, Lara chose love. Yet, her wish went unfulfilled and perished into the sea. Two hundred years later, Lara awakens once more in Lake Biwa to finally search for her true love. All because of "love". (Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

characters.name: Lara
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm Lara was once a mermaid princess who fell in love with a human prince and disappeared into sea foam before her love could be fulfilled. She has now been reborn as a human being off the shore of Lake Biwa in Shiga Prefecture roughly 200 years later. With her new life, she is once again looking for true love.

characters.name: Mari Ootsu
characters.description: __Height:__ 150cm A high school girl living in Ootsu City, Shiga Prefecture who does boxing. After the loss of her mother at a young age she lives with her grandmother, father, and older brother. One day she encounters [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) and invites her to live with her family.

characters.name: Luca Akizuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm A boy [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) meets by chance who resembles [the prince](https://anilist.co/character/407723/Ouji) she loved 200 years ago.

characters.name: Grace
characters.description: The witch who turned [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) into a human. She is a criminal who was outcast from mermaid society, and now is taking the form of a fish in order to get close to [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/375976/Mari-Otsu).

characters.name: Ema Ootsu
characters.description: Mari's grandmother. She usually serves as the pastor of the church next to her house. Along with Makoto, she watches over the children's growth.

characters.name: Yoshiya Ootsu
characters.description: __Height:__ 178cm Mari's older brother. He is a third-year student at the same high school as Mari. He has lots of friends, but often skips school. His hobby is riding motorcycles.

characters.name: Rowan
characters.description: He is the great King of the Sea and the father of Lara and her five sisters. He despises humans.

characters.name: Makoto Ootsu
characters.description: Mari's father and a freelance photographer. A man of few words, he quietly and warmly watches over the growth of Mari, Shoya, and Lara.

characters.name: Lisa
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm Lara's fourth older sister. She cared deeply for Lara and she was very affectionate toward her. She is close friends with an anglerfish. She has now taken on a human form and is searching for the revived Lara. It seems she harbors special feelings toward humans...

characters.name: Kouta
characters.description: __Height:__ 140cm They are always together with Lisa. They seem to know Lara, but Lara doesn't remember them.

characters.name: Leo Akizuki
characters.description: [Luca's](https://anilist.co/character/392286) younger brother.

characters.name: Luna
characters.description: Lara's fifth sister.

title: .hack//SIGN
description: A young wavemaster, only known by the alias of Tsukasa, wakes up in an MMORPG called The World, with slight amnesia. He does not know what he has previously done before he woke up. In The World, he is suspected to be a hacker of the Crimson Knights, as he was seen accompanying a tweaked character in the form of a cat. Unable to log out from the game, he wanders around looking for answers, avoiding the knights and other players he meets along the way. As Tsukasa explores The World, he stumbles upon a magical item that takes the form of a 'guardian', which promises him protection from all harm. Subaru, the leader of the Crimson Knights, along with several other players who became acquainted with Tsukasa, set out to investigate why Tsukasa is unable to log out, and attempt to get to the bottom of the problem before it gets out of hand. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

characters.name: Tsukasa
characters.description: Tsukasa is a Wavemaster and the main character. He is a young silver-haired boy clad in grey robes, At the start of the series, he is seen waking up to find himself in a dungeon in The World, but he has no idea why he is there or who he is. Not much time passes until Tsukasa discovers he is trapped in the game, unable to log out, while his real body is in a coma. He is initially depicted as a cynical loner who tends to avoid others as much as possible, but at the story progresses he begins to warm up to Mimiru, Bear, Subaru, and others. ~!In the real world, his name is An Shouji, and he happens to be a girl. She was raised by her father after the death of her mother, and was physically and mentally abused by him. His abusive behavior also distanced her from her gender: he treated her like a boy, refusing to allow her to use feminine products and basic hygiene products. There are also sub

characters.name: Subaru
characters.description: Class: Heavy axeman Real name: Mariko Misono Subaru is a female Heavy Axeman introduced as the leader of the Crimson Knights, a player organization designed to fight injustice in The World. At times she seems to be the only character preventing the Crimson Knights from running wild; she knows that they must restrain from abusing their power. She eventually joins in the search of a way to help Tsukasa, and builds a strong relationship with him. ~!In the real world Subaru is restricted to a wheelchair, The World is the only place she can walk.!~

characters.name: Mimiru
characters.description: Mimiru is a Heavy Blade, described on Helba Gate as a tough-it-out-through-anything, devil-may-care fighter who is poor at planning things out and following through on them. She is the first player to meet Tsukasa, and later tries to form a bond with him in order to protect him. She usually hangs out with Bear, trying to solve the mystery of Tsukasa's inability to log out.

characters.name: Bear
characters.description: Bear is an older player of the game and plays a Blademaster. He appears as cool and collected, always willing to help out newbies, giving off an experienced air. He also conducts research in the real world on Tsukasa in the attempt to try to figure out who he really is; he is in fact the first character who discovers Tsukasa's real life identity. Bear is usually seen hanging out with Mimiru and BT. ~!In real life, Bear is a famous novelist named Ryo Sakuma. He's 47 years old and his most acclaimed work is the novel "Annwn". He's divorced from his wife, and is constantly pestered by his son, a Wavemaster that goes by the name Teddy in The World, with demands for money. Ryo Sakuma enjoys various hobbies, like reading books by famous authors, and going to the theatre. He smokes quite a lot, and has several dictionaries in his computer, which enable him to research anytime. In Unison, the co

characters.name: BT
characters.description: BT is a Wavemaster, considered by Helba Gate as a plotting and scheming character who forms friendships just to achieve a goal. She rarely ventures out to fight monsters, but she appears to be good with both offensive and defensive magic. ~!BT teams up with Crim to find the Key of the Twilight, a rumored powerful rare item. Her quest leads her to the upside down dungeon, where she discoveres the AI Harald. A former model in real life, who now makes a career at a dispatch company in the Touhoku region. She lives alone in an apartment, and seems to have little interest in meeting with her old colleagues as it's shown in episode 17 Conflict when she tears the invitation letter of a class reunion into pieces. The envelope of that letter gives her given name as Machiko. Her family name is unknown. She named her character after her favorite food, the B.L.T. (bacon, lettuce, and tomato) sandwic

characters.name: Sora
characters.description: Sora is a Twin Blade player killer who enjoys hunting players down, especially attractive female ones, and demanding their Member Addresses in exchange for their lives. He sees Tsukasa as the strongest link to the Key of the Twilight, and starts to work with BT in the quest for the item. He also helps BT and the others to contact Helba. Sora frequently tangles with Crim, who seems as powerful as himself. ~!In the real world, Sora's player is a boy in the 4th grade named Ryou Misaki.!~ ~!In the series' final episode, Sora betrays Morganna, buying Tsukasa and the others time to escape. After briefly taunting Morganna, Sora attempts to gate out, but fails. Morganna summons Skeith, the first of the 8 Phases. Skeith then performs Data Drain upon Sora, imprisoning him in his wand, and throwing Sora's player into a coma in the real world. !~

characters.name: Silver Knight
characters.description: Silver Knight is second-in-command of the Crimson Knights. As described by Frank Ellis he possesses a strong sense of justice (becoming overzealous at times), but is extremely naive, leading him to end up as more of a tool to be used by whoever is in control. He is extremely overprotective of Subaru. Silver Knight's PC is an edited version of the standard Crimson Knight design. Later in the series, he tells Mimiru that he is 23 and works in a video store.

characters.name: Crim
characters.description: Crim is a powerful Long Arm, friend of Subaru who founded the Crimson Knights organization with her, but afterwards left it as he found it did not match his personality. Amiable, easygoing and sociable; he prefers to keep the real world and the game seperate. Crim's stated goal when playing is simply to have fun, although he never turns down a chance to help somebody in need. In real life, he is a business man, and is frequently sent off on business trips to places all around the world. His age is unknown. He and BT have met in real life. His main hobby is playing The World, and he also likes to read books. Ryo Sakuma is one of his favorite authors and he frequently uses quotes from his books in the game.

characters.name: Balmung
characters.description: He is the Knight of the Azure Sky, as per his titles (given by the web poet W.B. Yates, aka Hokuto) "Souten no Balmung" (Balmung of the Azure Sky/Heaven) and "Fianna no matsuei" (Descendant of Fianna). One of the more powerful denizens of The World, who has been playing long before anyone else listed here, and was one of the original .hackers. In .hack//UdeDen, he was made a System Admin by CC Corp, and he organizes very weird events for the players. He decided to do this after the events of the final episode of .hack//SIGN, UNISON. His class is Blademaster, "sub-class" System Administrator, and uses an angelic-knight avatar. In the 2nd book he is fired as an administrator. He takes on more work than he can handle, often shoving it all to his assistant Reki and falling asleep in front of his computer, putting his character in a napping position.

characters.name: Harald Hoerwick
characters.original: ハロルド・ヒューイック
characters.description: Harald was a genius German programmer who meets his unrequited love interest, Emma Wielant, at a seminar for anthroposophy. Harald immediately falls in love with her, but Emma is only interested in his programming talents. One day Emma calls Harald and asks him to meet her. She never makes it, crashing her car and dying at the age of 28. Harald, unaware of the accident, waits for her under a gingko tree.

characters.name: A-20
characters.description: A-20 is a young female Twin Blade in The World whose carelessness and motivations for playing help Mimiru to realize her own reasons for playing the game. A-20's reasons for joining the game are revealed to be its popularity among her classmates and her desire to complete a difficult dungeon to prove her valor. In real life, "A-20" is her student number at school, along with A-1 through 19; her classmates who are only mentioned. After getting a rare Golden Grunty item (which she describes as "ugly"), she decides to collect them. After this, she continues adventure with Mimiru in The World on occasion. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Aura
characters.description: A mysterious girl in white who appears in almost every part of the .hack series. Aura is an incredibly powerful A.I. program, and is referred to as an "Ultimate A.I.". The story of her creation, and her purpose is the story of the entire .hack series.

title: Samurai Flamenco
description: Hazama Masayoshi has decided to become the superhero Samurai Flamenco in spite of having no special abilities or modifications. Goto Hidenori is a police officer who learns his secret identity by chance, which causes him all sorts of trouble. This is the story of the birth of a true hero featuring these two young men with a touch of comedy and serious drama, while they come face to face with hardships as they search for the true meaning of becoming a hero of justice in this world! (Source: Anime News Network, Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Masayoshi Hazama
characters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm A young man who acts as a model in a fashion magazine. Thanks to his grandfather who loved action heroes, he grew up admiring heroes since he was young, and then he finally makes his debut as the new hero, "Samurai Flamenco," an idea his grandfather came up with. However, his inexperience when it comes to self-defense which often led him to either be cornered or beaten by thugs whom he is trying to apprehend, but later on, he slowly learns how to fight.

characters.name: Gotou Hidenori
characters.description: A police officer working a police box. He's diligent about his work in the police box, but he's normal, average young man with no particular feelings towards justice in his private life. One day he happens to learn about the hero of justice, Samurai Flamenco, by chance. Ever since then his days have been more chaotic...

characters.name: Sumi Ishihara
characters.description: A talented manager working for Ceaser Pro, an entertainment production company. She works hard every day trying to sell justice and heroism to the public.

characters.name: Moe Morita
characters.description: A member of Mineral Miracle Muse. She's currently in high school, and a bit shy and laid back. Her English pronunciation is close to native. She is later on recruited by Mari to form the Flamenco Girls and becomes Flamenco Sapphire. Moe seems to be quite fond of Mari, as she is often hoping to be noticed or even kissed by her.

characters.name: Mari Maya
characters.description: She's a talented idol who works as the center in a three-member idol group, Mineral Miracle Muse, and composes their music and lyrics. She's a bright, happy mood maker who can approach anyone.

characters.name: Joji Kaname
characters.description: An Actor currently playing the lead role in “Red Axe”, an ongoing hero action show. Apparently he travels the world, though he only uses it as an excuse to ditch his promise to aide Hazama's heroic exploits.

characters.name: Mizuki Misawa
characters.description: Mineral Miracle Muse's leader. She's from Kansai. She's very caring and works hard to keep the group together. She is later on recruited by Mari to become her sidekick as "Flamenco Ruby" after Hazama breaks off his so called partnership with the latter.

characters.name: Akira Konno
characters.description: The man who runs High Rollers Hi, a web news site. He takes an interest in Samurai Flamenco and begins plotting to reveal his identity.

characters.name: Jun Harazuka
characters.description: A middle-aged man who works in the development department for the stationary company, Monsters Stationary. He provided Samurai Flamenco the necessary tools to help him do his hero stuffs, which are compose of specially modified offices equipments.

characters.name: King Torture
characters.description: He is the first true arch enemy that Samurai Flamenco has faced.

title: Assault Lily: BOUQUET
description: On Earth in the near future, humanity faced imminent destruction from mysterious giant creatures known as "Huge." The entire world unites against the Huge, and successfully develops weaponry known as "CHARM" (Counter Huge Arms) by combining science and magic. CHARM exhibits high rates of synchronization with teenaged girls, and the girls who use CHARM are viewed as heroes called "Lilies." Throughout the world, "Garden" military academies are established to train Lilies to face the Huge and to serve as bases to protect and guide people. This is a story about fighting girls who aim to become Lilies at one such Garden. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Riri Hitotsuyanagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Charm:__ Gungnir A refugee who was deprived from her home by the Huge. When her life was saved by [Yuyu](https://anilist.co/character/148366/Yuyu-Shirai), she pursued her dream to be miraculously enrolled at Yurigaoka Jogakuin. Riri has the belief that even people with different opinions can understand each other. From this philosophy, she will fight with many Lilies and gradually emerge in the battle against the Huge. She a hard worker and works hard on everything. A little natural but bright and gentle personality. Her favorite food is Ramune juice.

characters.name: Yuyu Shirai
characters.description: __Charm:__ Dainsleif __Height:__163 cm __Rare Skill:__ Lunatic Trancer The Lily who represents all of Yurigaoka. She has fought the Huge in the front lines and has stood victorious across many battlefields. Being one of the most prominent Lilies at Yurigaoka Jogakuin and wielding incredible combat power, Yuyu holds a rare skill called 'Lunatic Transer,' and has garnered many fans because she fights hard with mental instability. Although she was nicknamed 'Shinigami,' having lost her friend from her negligence, Yuyu overcomes many trials and grows into a great Lily.

characters.name: Fumi Futagawa
characters.description: __Charm:__ Gungnir __Height:__ 152 cm With an overwhelming quality and quantity, this 'Lily Otaku' has a wide range of knowledge not only about individual Lillys but also about CHARMs and tactical strategies. Although she does not normally assert herself, she becomes very excited when it comes to Lily-related topics.

characters.name: Thi Mai Yoshimura
characters.description: __Charm:__ Thuân Thiên __Height:__ 156 cm __Rare Skill:__ Shukuchi A genius Lily from Vietnam who dislikes strict training. She has a bubbly, upbeat personality that is unobtrusive and will never get angry even if she is ridiculed. A natural moodmaker, she can be relied upon by her peers.

characters.name: Tazusa Andou
characters.description: __Age:__ 15 __Height:__ 158 cm __Rare Skill:__ Phantasm Because she has lived a harsh life, she has a cold and rebellious attitude towards others because of human distrust. Originally, she was someone that could care for people's hearts, but she has hardly trusted anyone since being betrayed and abused many times. The side effects of Magi Sensitivity, which has been applied as a reinforced lily (boosted lily), can often lead to mental instability, causing Tazusa to be aggressive and never rely on anyone. However, Lily disregards her and deepens the relationship during practical training.

characters.name: Miliam Hildegard von Guropius
characters.original: ミリアム・ヒルデガルド・V・グロピウス
characters.description: __Nationality:__ German __Height:__ 153 cm __Rare Skill:__ Phase Transcendence A bright and friendly personality, but a genius-like troublemaker that causes trouble. Miriam can't control her curiosity and the feeling of playing games, and she loves people and loves talking to people. She has a cute side, so she's not disliked by her peers, but she tends to be shunned by serious people.

characters.name: Kaede Johan Nouvel
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm __Nationality:__ French-Japanese __Charm:__ Gungnir __Rare Skill:__ Register A prodigy who ranked number one in the high school transfer examination at Yurigaoka Jogakuin.
