Kaede is half-French and half-Japanese, and comes from a family who carries the bloodline of both Japanese and French nobility. She boasts high intelligence, a good personality, and a high combat ability that overwhelms the Huge. Known as an impeccable Lily, Kaede has an over-the-top personality of 'loving cute girls.

characters.name: Yujia Wang
characters.description: __Charm:__ Asterion __Height:__ 163 cm Yujia is a self-confident girl thanks to growing up as the middle child of three sisters. Because she is quiet and not good at showing her emotions, she is often misunderstood as "angry". She is roommates with Kuo Shenlin.

characters.name: Shenlin  Kuo
characters.description: __Charm:__ Masolelic __Height:__ 165 cm __Nationality:__ Taiwanese An elegant young lady from Taipei who attends Yurigaoka. Shenlin will speak out against what she believes is wrong, but is usually a very kind girl. She is roommates with Wang Yujia. (Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

characters.name: Shiori Rokkaku
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm She has a careless and gentle personality, but has an indomitable nature that never gives up. In a battle with Huge, her clan left her and was annihilated, and she was alone. She has a battle-specific rare skill "Hand of the Ring" that can handle two CHARMs at the same time, and has two names, "Fudokenhime". She has lost feeling in her left arm, which is her dominant arm, due to past injuries. The work on the battlefield is wonderful and is expected to play the future of Yurigaoka. (Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

characters.name: Kusumi Egawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Kusumi was born and raised in Yurigaoka, but she lost the trust of everyone because of an incident that occurred in middle school. In particular, she is afraid to talk to people because of circumstances involving her best friend, Ichi Tanaka. She is a girl of few words and often spends time alone, but her combat abilities have been revered as one of the best since the construction of Yurigaoka, enough to earn her the nickname "Child of God". Supported by Shiori Rokkaku and Soraha Amano. Her specialty is housework and her cooking is comparable to that of a chef." (Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

characters.name: Soraha Amano
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm An excellent Lily with a combat power based on high physical ability, Soraha has a bright and cheerful personality. At the end of her first year, Chika Takekoshi, who belongs to the legendary Legion of Yurigaoka, "Alveheim", was dismissed and the Legion was disbanded. Being Chika's best friend, Soraha also effectively retired from being a Lily. Before she was about to leave, she met Kusumi Egawa in a special dormitory. While spending time with Kusumi, she changed her mind and chose to stay at Yurigaoka. (Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

title: Kageki Shoujo!!
description: The curtain rises on the Kouka School of Musical and Theatrical Arts. Spotlight on Sarasa Watanabe, a starry-eyed 5'10" student who dreams of performing as Oscar, a male lead role. She forms an unlikely friendship with her new roommate, a former idol who now also hopes to join the all-female Kouka Acting Troupe. Together, they’re in for the role of a lifetime. (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Sarasa Watanabe
characters.description: __Height:__ 5'10" She is a Kouka actress-aspirant at the Kouka School who stands out of the rest of the Centennial Class and the entire school, and not just because of her bubbly demeanor and being the tallest student in the school.

characters.name: Ai Narata
characters.description: A former idol expelled from her group because of her trust issues with men, she applied at the Kouka School to escape her past and men in particular. She finds Sarasa, her classmate and dorm-mate, to be annoying at first.

characters.name: Sawa Sugimoto
characters.description: Being a huge Kouka fan, she enrolls at the Kouka School, skipping her chance to become a prima ballerina. She is the class representative of the Centennial Class.

characters.name: Kaoru Hoshino
characters.description: She is the daughter of a second-generation Kouka actress and is in the same class as Sarasa and Ai.

characters.name: Ayako Yamada
characters.description: Timid, shy, and plagued with problems concerning her weight, she almost quit the school due to the pressure; but, despite being underrated, she is one of the most talented performers in the Centennial Class.

characters.name: Chika Sawada
characters.description: She is one half of the Sawada Twins. Inspired by a bunny lady twins they saw on a Kouka performance, she auditioned for the Kouka school with her twin sister, but delayed her admission when her other twin did not make it, which became a flashpoint in their relationship with each other.

characters.name: Chiaki Sawada
characters.description: She is the more chipper half of the Sawada Twins. Inspired by a bunny lady twins they saw on a Kouka performance, she auditioned for the Kouka school with her twin sister, but because she did not make it on the first try at auditioning for the school, her sister had to delay her admission, which became a flashpoint in their relationship with each other.

characters.name: Sei Satomi
characters.description: The top star of the Kouka Winter Troupe, who is friends with Ai and Sarasa.

characters.name: Taichi Narata
characters.description: Ai's uncle and the only male she trusts. He is an instructor at the Kouka School.

characters.name: Mamoru Andou
characters.description: He is known to Kouka school alumni and theater fans as "The Phantom" for his portrayal in The Phantom of the Opera. He is currently retired from acting after an accident during a performance, and is now an instructor at the Kouka School.

characters.name: Hijiri Nojima
characters.description: One of the second-year students, and is Ai's student-advisor. She would sometimes bully Sarasa a bit, but she is, in her own way, dedicated to guiding Ai.

characters.name: Risa Nakayama
characters.description: The second-year student who is Sarasa's student-advisor. She would stand for her ward whenever Hijiri becomes a bit malicious with her.

title: Aharen-san wa Hakarenai Season 2
title_original: 阿波連さんははかれない season2
description: The quiet, awkward Aharen-san and her schoolmate Raidou went from unlikely friends to nearly inseparable. As another semester begins, new opportunities, challenges, and relationships present themselves as Aharen-san and Raidou navigate their school days. Now, Aharen-san struggles to know how vulnerable she can get with a new transfer student. (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Reina Aharen
characters.description: A small, timid, and unfathomable girl who grows attached to [Raidou](https://anilist.co/character/121704/Raidou-Shouta) after he begins talking to her. She has a bad sense of distance. ~!She eventually confesses her love to Raidou.!~

characters.name: Shouta Raidou
characters.description: A tall, calm, and generally nice guy who looks after [Reina Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Aharen-Reina). He wants to help her with her problems, despite them not being his own to deal with.

characters.name: Mitsuki Ooshiro
characters.description: [Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Reina-Aharen)'s friend since middle school. She is very shy, constantly watching over Aharen-san from a distance, very good at hiding. She's also very good at martial arts.

characters.name: Ishikawa
characters.description: A friend of Raido.

characters.name: Hanako Satou
characters.description: A friend of Raido.

characters.name: Riku Tamanaha
characters.description: Riku Tamanaha is a kind and cheerful girl who is also very shy and has a fear of interpersonal relationships. She is a kogyaru, a type of gyaru who is known for her fashionable style and outgoing personality. However, Tamanaha's shyness often prevents her from expressing herself fully, and she often overthinks situations and makes herself anxious. This is due to a past experience where she was too clingy to her friends in elementary school, which ended up pushing them away. Despite her shyness, Tamanaha is very determined to make friends in high school. She is especially eager to be friends with Aharen again, but she is afraid of being rejected. However, Aharen is actually very happy to see her again and they quickly become friends. Tamanaha is a likable character who is easy to root for. She is relatable to many people who struggle with social anxiety, and her story is one of hope and r

characters.name: Futaba
characters.description: Little girl with black hair. She considers herself a rival of Aharen.

characters.name: Ren Aharen
characters.description: Younger brother to Reina Aharen. He occasionally likes to wear his older sister's clothes, which fooled Raidou into thinking he was Reina.

characters.name: Toubaru-sensei
characters.description: A teacher of literature at the school [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/121703) and her friends attend. She has a unique way of describing things. (Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

title: Yuyushiki
description: Everyone knows you can learn a lot on the internet, and some of it is even true. But if you want to know what's REALLY going on and important, then there's just one place to go: the computer club! Okay, so maybe it's not the club itself, but the three girls you're most likely to find there. And maybe they do spend more time chatting about their social lives and debating things like the virtues of ketchup versus mayonnaise than they do learning about the ins and outs of a keyboard, but whatever they're up to, it's sure to put a smile on your face. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuzuko Nonohara
characters.description: Yuzuko Nonohara is a member of the Data Processing Club. She seems to have an innocent personality, but she will sometimes break out in random bouts of outrageous behaviour.

characters.name: Yui Ichii
characters.description: Yui Ichii is a member of the Data Processing Club. Yui is generally shy, and she is often the target of Yuzuko and Yukari's antics since they like to tease her.

characters.name: Yukari Hinata
characters.description: Yukari Hinata is a member of the Data Processing Club, along with [Yuzuko](https://anilist.co/character/76232/Nonohara-Yuzuko) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/76234/Ichii-Yui). She is kind of an airhead, and she will often copy Yuzuko's antics if she finds them amusing.

characters.name: Chiho Aikawa
characters.description: A relatively shy girl who wants to befriend [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/76234/Ichii-Yui) and her friends.

characters.name: Kei Okano
characters.description: A tomboy who is oddly possessive of [Aikawa](https://anilist.co/character/81093/Aikawa-Chiho).

characters.name: Yoriko Matsumoto
characters.description: The girls' homeroom teacher and advisor of the Data Processing Club. She is often called "Mom" (お母さん Okaa-san) by her students due to her generally kind nature.

characters.name: Ichii no Haha
characters.description: Yui's mother.

title: C³
description: From the light novel series written by Minase Hazuki, comes a story of love, action, and comedy. Yachi Haruaki is a high school boy who is naturally resistant to curses. After his father sends him a mysterious black cube, Haruaki awakes to find a nude girl named Fear standing in his kitchen. She’s the human form of the cursed black cube – and an instrument of torture! Utilizing her special abilities, Fear fights alongside Haruaki to defeat other cursed instruments and their owners. (Source: FUNimation)

characters.name: Haruaki Yachi
characters.description: The male protagonist of C³. An average schoolboy whose father has a habit of sending him random artifacts to remove the curses within as he is immune to all curses. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Konoha Muramasa
characters.description: Konoha attends the same school as Haruaki. She is not human and can transform into a sword. Like Fear, she is a "cursed tool" who has gained a will through the pain and hate that had long surrounded her, making the sword her original form. The wielder of the sword she transforms into also suffers from the injuries they inflict on their opponent. Her ability Killing Counter allows the wielder to focus on the opponent's weapon's weak points and destroys their weapon. Fear refers to Konoha as "Cow boobs." (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Fear Kubrick
characters.original: フィア・キューブリック
characters.description: Fear is the female protagonist of C³. She claims to be a "cursed tool" that has been exposed to so much hatred and negativity that it allowed her to gain a consciousness, and says that she came to Haruaki's home in hopes of purifying her "curse". She's actually a fictitious device called Fear In Cube, a terrible torture device from the Inquisitions. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kirika Ueno
characters.description: Student Body President and classmate of Haruaki. She has two cursed tools. The first, called Ginstrnag's Love, is an article of clothing that prevents the user from dying when worn. In exchange, the user's heart dies and they must wear it forever. The second tool, The River of Black Strings, has the ability to induce the opponent's murderous intents and serial murders and use it against them. She used to be part of an organization called Nightcrawlers. ~!The River of Black Strings curses the user to want to hurt or kill somebody. Kirika usually satisfies the curse by killing herself and coming back to life as she wears the Ginstrnag's Love. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shiraho Sakuramairi
characters.description: A former talented performer in a famous theatrical group. She was once lonely and cold-hearted, but after her father introduced Sovereignty to her, she gradually falls in love with her. She initially posed herself as Sovereignty when she first met Haruaki and his friends but was revealed to be the real Shiraho when they visited her house. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kuroe Ningyouhara
characters.description: A cursed Japanese doll who has recently returned to Haruaki's house. She has the ability to control her hair like arms for many purposes. She owns a beauty parlor. Her curse has already been removed. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sovereignty
characters.description: Her true name is Sovereignty-Perfection-Doll. A cursed doll who causes her target to fall in love with her. She possesses a killing mechanism called Killing Organ with blades hidden in her body. The mechanism activates when it marks the end of love. ~! Sovereignty doll is an androgynous.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Taizou Hakuto
characters.description: Friend of Haruaki. A member of the baseball club and very energetic. He likes Konoha.

characters.name: Kana Miyama
characters.description: One of Haruaki's classmates, who likes Fear.

characters.name: Peavy Barroy
characters.original: ピーヴィー・バロヲイ
characters.description: She is a member of an organization called Knights of Gathering. She is also known as Balancing Toy and has a heavy smoking habit. Her job is to hunt and destroy cursed objects, which are also known as Waas, as it is the organization's call of duty.

characters.name: Amanda Carlot
characters.original: アマンダ・カーロット
characters.description: An Auxiliary that aids Peavey in her mission. She made a deal with Ueno to keep Fear, Konoha and Haruaki safe. ~!However, the plan worked too well and she was killed by Peavey.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gabriel Sekaibashi
characters.original: 世界橋 ガブリエル
characters.description: The superintendent of Taishuu High School. He always wear a face mask to cover his face for some reason. He has a hobby of finding cursed mask. Fear calls him a weirdo for wearing a mask when she first met him. He explained to Fear that he was born with a breathing disorder, which imprisoned him to wear a mask, and if he takes off the mask, he will be hospitalized. On the other hand, he told others different reasons; he told Haruaki that he had a scar on his face, which he does not want others to see it, while he told Konoha that he wears it due to religious reasons.

title: Yuru Yuri San☆Hai!
title_original: ゆるゆり さん☆はい！
description: The members of the Amusement Club are back with more of Kyouko Toshinou's antics, Chinatsu Yoshikawa's schemes, Yui Funami's retorts, and Akari Akaza's small social presence as they strive to make each day as fun as the last! Whether the activity is an arm wrestling contest or making pancakes together, the group of entertainment-seekers are sure to give it their all. The club members are often joined by their friends in the Student Council, who know how to have a good time as well. While it can get a little chaotic when all eight girls get together, it sure doesn't stop them from meeting up and having fun! (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Mirakurun
characters.description: The character in a manga that Kyoko likes. She is known to always battle Rivarun.

characters.name: Rivarun
characters.description: The antagonist of the fictional anime Miracalun, she is an alien invader who plans to conquer earth, and Miracalun's mentor and friend.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

characters.name: Chizuru Ikeda
characters.description: [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/35877/Chitose-Ikeda)'s twin sister. Her personality is pretty much the opposite of Chitose's nice and ditsy nature. When she takes her glass off her yuri goggles activate and she starts drooling. She seems to be fond of the Ayano/Chitose pairing. She has a love for Chitose while she dislikes Kyōko as she constantly tries to play pranks on her and is seemingly a barrier against her fantasies.

title: Senran Kagura
description: Super cute Asuka and her curvy companions appear to be your typical high school students, but they’ve got an outrageous secret: they’re learning the wild ways of the ninja! Get a lesson in action, naughtiness, and sexy slapstick fun as Asuka's gang takes on the toughest (and hottest) fighters in town! Fan service fanatics won’t want to miss a minute! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Ikaruga
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm A third year, Ikaruga is mature and supportive and takes her duty as a ninja very seriously. However, she sometimes loses her composure and acts more naturally. She is an adoptive daughter of a wealthy ninja family, however she was chosen to be the next head of her family over her brother, who is a failure as a ninja. Her summoning animal is the Chinese Phoenix. Her weapon of choice is the Katana, Hien which has been past down to her by her adopted father.

characters.name: Katsuragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A third year, she is the perverted member of the group, who loves to fondle breasts, and especially Asuka's. However, she can be also serious when it concerns her friends. Her summoning animal is the dragon.

characters.name: Asuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm The main character, she is a second year, who barely passed the promotion exam. She wants to follow in her grandfather's footsteps and become a great ninja. She's an upbeat person, though she is naive at times and has a fear of frogs which is (unfortunately) also her family's summon animal.

characters.name: Yagyuu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A first year, she is a ninja prodigy. She cares very much for Hibari who she supports the most. She wears an eye patch over her right eye and carries an umbrella (armed with various weapons) at all times. Her summoning animal is the giant squid. ~!The biggest reason she is sticking together with Hibari because of her little sister; Yagyuu's little sister died due to illness a year before the series, and thought it was her fault that she died. At the start of high school, she saw a girl, Hibari, who looked like her sister. This is also why Yagyuu always promises to protect Hibari, no matter what.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hibari
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm A first year of the group, she is very childish and clumsy and loves cute and sweet things. She is also really close to Yagyuu. Her summoning animal is a large pink rabbit. ~!Unlike the other girls of the cast, Hibari is the only one not to have a tragic or sad past.!~

characters.name: Homura
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm A second year and the leader of Homura Gurentai, the rival group. A second year, the leader of Homura Gurentai, and the main character in Senran Kagura Burst. She fights with 3 katanas in each hand, brandished like claws. ~! It is revealed in episode 9 that she was supposed to enroll in Hanzou Academy, but she killed someone and Hanzou Academy only accepts those with clean records.!~

characters.name: Yomi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm A calm and somewhat slow girl, who however, has also a darker side. She's also obsessed with bean sprouts and puts them in almost everything she cooks. Her obsession stems from her youth, as her parents died in poverty, and she considers bean sprouts to be good food for the poor to live on. She fights with a huge claymore-like sword.

characters.name: Hikage
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm A mysterious, snake-like girl who tries not to show any emotion. She fights using various knives stored in her gauntlets.

characters.name: Mirai
characters.description: __Guardian:__ Pit Viper __Height:__ 150 cm Mirai is short-tempered and has a pathological hatred of being ignored. She will go to extreme lengths to make her presence known. Although she desperately wants to be seen as an adult, she often act childishly. She also has a severe case of breast envy and can get agitated around those bustier than her, but is unafraid to mock other girls with flat chests, like Ryoubi. Despite this, Mirai is quite the opposite of what she outwardly displays. Due to a history of being bullied prior to enrolling in Hebijo Clandestine Academy, Mirai suffers from low self-esteem and is actually very timid and deathly afraid of what others think about her. At times where she feels mistreated, she runs away in a panic and tries to hide. She has also developed a coping mechanism for this; having random outbursts and yelling at others for treating her a certain way. Mi

characters.name: Haruka
characters.description: __Guardian:__ Japanese Keelback __Height:__ 169 cm The scientist of the group. She has a fascination with creating puppets. She fights by using the arm sleeves of her lab coat, as well as a vast repertoire of exploding chemical vials.

characters.name: Kiriya
characters.description: The girls' ninja teacher. He has a habit of appearing in a puff of smoke. He trained Rin when she was a member of the Light Faction. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hanzou
characters.description: Asuka's grandfather.

title: Yama no Susume
description: Aoi prefers indoor hobbies and is afraid of heights, but her childhood friend Hinata loves to show off her passion for mountain climbing. As young children they once watched the sunrise from the top of a mountain, and now they've decided to take up mountain climbing in hopes of seeing that sunrise again. They have cooking battles with mountaineering gear, climb small hills in their neighborhood, and meet new mountaineering friends as they learn the ropes of the hobby. When will they finally see that sunrise again? (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Aoi Yukimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm A few years ago, Aoi had made a promise with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/69503/Kuraue-Hinata) that they would climb mountains together, but after a bit of a nasty fall of a playground attraction, she ended up with a broken arm and a fear of heights, which eventually lead to a withdrawn personality. However, once Hinata approached her at the start of high school, Aoi once again is drawn towards the lure of the mountain.

characters.name: Kaede Saitou
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Kaede meets [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) in the local hiking and camping equipment store, where she asks her for advice regarding the purchase of a sleeping bag. The two exchange phone Email addresses, and Kaede eventually joins the circle of mountaineering friends.

characters.name: Hinata Kuraue
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hinata is an exhuberant, energetic girl who used to go on long hikes together with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) when they were both kids. However, that came to an end when Aoi had her accident. Still, with high school starting, she once again saw the opportunity to reignite Aoi's interest in hiking, so she went for it.

characters.name: Kokona Aoba
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/69503/Kuraue-Hinata) meet Kokona at the slopes of Mt. Takao, where she headed in the hopes of seeing dwarf flying squirrels, but was foiled when one of her shoes' soles partially tore off. Aoi performs some emergency repairs, though, and the three head back down. The three of them, plus Kaede, eventually forms a circle of friendship through their common interest.

characters.name: Kenichi Kuraue
characters.description: The father of Hinata is the one who used to take Hinata and Aoi hiking before Aoi's accident, and is more than happy to supply the girls with any kind of advice and help they'd need.

characters.name: Yuri
characters.description: Aoi and Hinata's classmate. She is good friends with Mio and Kasumi.

characters.name: Mio
characters.description: Aoi and Hinata's classmate. She is good friends with Yuri and Kasumi.

title: Yuri Kuma Arashi
description: At some point, somewhere in outer space, the small planet Kumalia exploded. As the particles of what used to be Kumalia showered upon Earth as a meteor shower, for some reason all the bears on earth stood up to attack humanity! In due time, a great "Wall of Extinction" was built between humans and bears, and they could no longer show aggression towards one another... One morning, Kureha Tsubasa and Sumika Izumino were alone watching lily flowers blooming. Just then, a Bear Warning pierces loudly through the air! Mystery brings on more mysteries, a series of one raging blow after another! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Life Beauty
characters.original: ライフ・ビューティー

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon S: Nippon no Omotenashi (Attend wa Dragon desu)
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴンＳ ニッポンのおもてなし（アテンドはドラゴンです）
title_en: Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid S: Japanese Hospitality (The Attendant Is a Dragon)
description: Note: An unaired episode included with the Vol. S Blu-ray/DVD.

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Chloe
characters.description: She is an American who befriends Kanna when she had quarreled with Kobayashi.

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Taketo Aida
characters.description: Taketo Aida is the grandson of Miss Aida, the owner of the candy store where Ilulu ends up getting a job. Although he starts off being suspicious of Ilulu they end up becoming friends after he's shown her kind side. He's shown to be supportive and kind as he's willing to go out of his way to lend a helping hand.

title: VTuber nanda ga Haishin Kiri Wasuretara Densetsu ni Natteta
title_original: VTuberなんだが配信切り忘れたら伝説になってた
title_en: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
description: Yuki Tanaka is a VTuber at Live-On, one of Japan’s largest VTuber companies, as the polite and ladylike Awayuki Kokorone. One day, she forgets to end the stream, and viewers see her real personality—irreverent, improper, and prone to imbibing after a long day. Yuki is surprised to find that her accident caused her rankings to multiply, so she doubles down and gets to work. She’ll be a star yet! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Awayuki Kokorone
characters.description: __Fanbase name:__ Marshmallows (マシュマロ ) __Affiliation:__ LiveOn (ライブオン) __Illustrator:__ [Noko Shiokazu](https://anilist.co/staff/197988) __Generation:__ 3rd Gen (LiveOn) [Twitter](https://twitter.com/kokoroneawayuki)

characters.name: Sei Utsuki
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who lives up to her Succubus persona with her love of eroge and dirty jokes.

characters.name: Chami Yanagase
characters.description: A member of Live-On's third generation with a cheerful older sister persona despite her extreme social anxiety. Her core fanbase comes from her ASMR content.

characters.name: Hikari Matsuriya
characters.description: A member of Live-On's 3rd generation who is brimming with energy. She is always cheerful and innocent to the point that a lot of [Shuwa-chan's](https://anilist.co/character/317062/Awayuki-Kokorone) jokes go over her head.

characters.name: Mashiro Irodori
characters.description: Another member of Live-On's 3rd generation and [Awayuki's](https://anilist.co/character/317062/Awayuki-Kokorone) character illustrator. She is passionate about her artwork and came up with the nickname "Shuwa-chan."

characters.name: Nekoma Hirune
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who is a cat girl with heterochromia. She is an avid player of terrible games.

characters.name: Shion Kannari
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who acts as the team mom of the Live-On members. Her character concept is of a Nine-tailed fox shrine maiden with an older sister personality.

characters.name: Hareru Asagiri
characters.description: Live-On's founding member and an active staff member in the company. She is seen as the shining light who laid the foundations of the company, and all of the other members look up to her.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai
title_original: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会
title_en: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club
description: Nijigasaki High School is known for their diverse subjects and the freedom they give to students. Second-year student Yuu Takasaki has been turned on to the charms of school idols, so she knocks on the door of the School Idol Club with her friend, Ayumu Uehara. Sometimes friends, sometimes rivals, the members of this club each contribute their own thoughts and motivations to the group. (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.name: Setsuna Yuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") Setsuna Yuki is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was the leader and founder of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her color is scarlet red. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that she read. Setsuna is passionate and headstrong, but kind and mature. She has a habit of taking on too much work and not wanting to burden friends with her problems. Setsuna has an unwavering passion for school idols and her raw emotion combined with a powerful voice is her charm point. She is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School.

characters.name: Kasumi Nakasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kasumi Nakasu is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is pastel yellow. As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. You'll often find her scheming or thinking up new ways to ensure her own victory; however, these plans often fail or aren't as devious as she thinks.

characters.name: Shizuku Ousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") Shizuku Osaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a first year and her image color is light blue. Shizuku is a polite, level-headed and diligent First Year student at Nijigasaki High with a passion for theatre and stage acting. She is a prolific member of the school's theatre club and it often shows in conversations where her enthusiasm for the subject surfaces.

characters.name: Ai Miyashita
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Favorite food:__ Nukazuke Ai Miyashita is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.name: Rina Tennouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Kanata Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Kanata Konoe is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is violet. Kanata is always giving everything her all... even if it doesn't seem that way when she dozes off in the middle of conversations. She cares deeply for her little sister Haruka and will find a bottomless well of energy in matters relating to her. An ideal performance, for Kanata, is a stage in which she sleeps and her fans watch. She also has an aptitude for cooking and home economics. While she loves to be doted on and spoiled, she also looks after everyone in the club as a big sister figure.

characters.name: Emma Verde
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") Emma Verde is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is light green. Emma is from Switzerland and has eight younger siblings. She formerly attended the Y.G. International Academy. Emma sometimes speaks in simple Italian, implying she is from an Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. While she sometimes struggles to adapt to Japanese culture, Emma is a kind and pure-hearted third year who acts as a big sister towards the rest of the group who always provides a shoulder to lean on in times of need.

characters.name: Ayumu Uehara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayumu Uehara is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of A・ZU・NA, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is light pink. She is hard working and believes that trying your best is the only thing to do. She is kind, sociable and wants everyone to succeed. Ayumu can also be rather clumsy at times.

characters.name: Yuu Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Yuu Takasaki is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club and one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is the manager, songwriter, and founder of Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is black. Yuu is the budding school idol enthusiast of Nijigasaki High School, and is often seen with her characteristic thigh-high socks and twin-tails tips dyed green. She is Ayumu Uehara's inseparable childhood friend, having grown up as neighbors in the same apartment building near Odaiba.

characters.name: Haruka Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm Haruka is a first year student at Shinonome Institute, the representative of her class and part of her school's idol group. She is the younger sister of Kanata Konoe and unlike her she is more energetic and hardworking.

characters.name: Himeno Ayanokouji
characters.description: Himeno is a student at Touou Academy.

title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S
title_original: 美少女戦士セーラームーン S
description: This season makes a turning point in the Sailor Moon story. The Sailor Senshi are confronted by a new enemy, the Death Busters. Rei had a premonition that this enemy would rule the world in an era called the Silence. To do this, the Death Busters need to find the three Talismans that would summon the Holy Grail. However, two mysterious Sailor Senshi, Sailor Uranus and Sailor Neptune, plan to find the Talismans before them... but without Sailor Moon's help.

characters.name: Usagi Tsukino
characters.description: __Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to know her sweet and selfless side. Usagi is a bit selfish and very much a crybaby, lazy, clumsy, and also an academic underachiever. She's also not very good at cooking. However, she cares deeply about her friends and family. Usagi is very trusting, and believes that everyone has a better nature. She doe

characters.name: Ami Mizuno
characters.description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

characters.name: Rei Hino
characters.description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate from the other girls.

characters.name: Makoto Kino
characters.description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

characters.name: Minako Aino
characters.description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her to her life as a Senshi. He lives in her home (as [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) lives in Usagi's) and is one of her closest friends.

characters.name: Chibiusa
characters.description: Chibiusa's real name is actually Usagi, but she is nicknamed Chibiusa to distinguish her from [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). She is usually very upbeat, extroverted and outgoing. Though she started out socially awkward, she quickly became popular with her classmates in the 20th-century. Chibiusa's dream is to one day become a real lady, to have her own prince, and to be friends with everyone she knows. Meanwhile, she is a fairly ordinary little girl; she likes pink and red, pudding, pancakes, and rabbits. Her favorite school subject is drawing, while her least favorites are language classes. ~!Chibiusa is actually the future daughter of Usagi Tsukino and [Mamoru Chiba](https://anilist.co/character/4013/Chiba-Mamoru), and was sent back in time to the "present" to stay with them before she was born.!~

characters.name: Setsuna Meiou
characters.description: Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics. Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates, she becomes more friendly, but is still not very emotional, although there are moments in the manga where she expresses much more emotion than the anime. Sailor Pluto is much darker in her initial form in the manga, identified as the "Guardian of the Underworld" with very dark skin and a black sailo

characters.name: Michiru Kaiou
characters.description: Introduced in the third story arc, Michiru fights alongside her partner and lover Haruka in defending the Solar System from outside threats. In both versions of the story, she is elegant, sophisticated, capable of sharp anger, and sometimes cold. She is fully dedicated to her duty as a Senshi. Her Senshi alter-ego is Sailor Neptune, one of the "four soldiers of the outer solar system". As Sailor Neptune, her element of influence is the sea(not with water in general as Sailor Mercury's powers are); as with many of the other Senshi, this element is closely associated with her planet, which is named for the Roman sea god, Neptune. She is one of the Senshi who has natural psychic powers, alerting her when danger is near. She seems to be a character with a very deep understanding of things, sometimes even surpassing the other Outer Senshi due to her unnaturally high psychic endowments. Michir

characters.name: Haruka Tenou
characters.description: Haruka is a stubborn, protective individual, but is also strong-willed, capable, charming, and occasionally even doting. She is formally introduced in the third story arc, although she appears in silhouette alongside [Sailor Neptune](https://anilist.co/character/2829/Kaiou-Michiru) in the final episode of [Sailor Moon R](https://anilist.co/anime/740/-R/). When transformed, she is known as Sailor Uranus, and is part of the group known in Fanon as the Outer Senshi. Haruka is a racecar driver, even though she is barely sixteen years old when she appears. However, the timing of her birthday to the Japanese school year means she is one grade ahead of the Inner Senshi.

characters.name: Hotaru Tomoe
characters.description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

characters.name: Mamoru Chiba
characters.description: Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of [Usagi Tsukino](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted. ~!This may be because when he was young his parents died in a car crash. This blocked his childhood memories of his current lifetime and opened up the memories of his previous life as Prince Endymion. Tuxedo Mask is a disguise Mamoru created for himself in order to hunt for the Silver Crystal incognito and, later, assist the Sailor Senshi in battle. He is always addressed as Mamo-chan by Usagi throughout the series (Chibiusa also addresses him with this nickname later on). After dating for two years, Mamoru gives Usagi an engagement ring at an airport. The couple eventually gets married. In the future, they become king and queen of Earth and Crystal Tokyo and have a child together whom they name, Small Lady, but is in the

characters.name: Souichi Tomoe
characters.description: Souichi Tomoe is generally referred to simply as "Professor Tomoe", and the English dub refers to him as "Doctor" Tomoe. He first appears in Episode 90 of the anime and Act 25 of the manga. In the manga Tomoe is outright malevolent. He joins the Death Busters of his own free will after a lab fire that killed his older wife, Keiko and seriously wounded his young daughter Hotaru Tomoe. He later turns himself into Germatoid to fight Sailor Moon but is killed after being hit by Sailor Moon's Rainbow Moon Heartache. He dies in the manga and does not come back. In the anime he is a more sympathetic character. He displays bizarre, but hilariously over dramatic mannerisms, which are often a source of unexpected humor. It is never specified whether these are mannerisms of Germatoid or repressed aspects of his personality, since little is known of him before or after the posses

title: Strawberry Panic
title_original: ストロベリー・パニック
description: Aoi Nagisa transfers to one of the three affiliated all-girl Catholic schools on Astraea Hill, St. Miator's Girls' Academy. There, she discovers a community of fellow students entwined in an intricate hierarchy, in which two Etoiles represent the three schools. In order to fit in, Nagisa must go to class, join clubs, and make new friends. Meanwhile, Shizuma Hanazono, the sole Etoile of Astraea Hill, finds herself drawn to this new, exciting transfer student. As Shizuma and Nagisa get to know each other, Shizuma finally decides it is time to face her troubled past.

characters.name: Shizuma Hanazono
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5’5’’) The current Etoile, she is a highly respected and much beloved person to most of the other students attending the three schools. She looks very mysterious and also seems to have a number of secrets to match this visage. This makes her a difficult person to figure out or to even talk to for someone just meeting her. She is very skilled on the piano and likes to play it constantly. Much of the time, she doesn't enjoy the dull work of the Etoile, so she often finds ways to skip on her duties, much to the annoyance of Miyuki Rokujō. However, Nagisa manages to persuade Shizuma to resume performing her duties.

characters.name: Tamao Suzumi
characters.description: Tamao is first introduced as Nagisa's roommate. She plays a major role in this anime, as she eventually falls in love with Nagisa. She is shown as overcheerful and takes a large interest in Nagisa. Tamao has a nice, helpful personality and sometimes enjoys gossiping about other people when it comes to matters of love and attraction. Highly literate, she is a member of the Literature Club and loves to write poems. She writes the script for Astraea's adaption of Carmen. She is well-regarded among her fellow Miator students; many of the first-years see her as a viable Etoile candidate.

characters.name: Nagisa Aoi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5’1’’) Nagisa suddenly transfers to an all-girls school called St. Miator Girl's Academy because her parents went overseas for work, leaving Nagisa behind. Nagisa ended up transferring to Miator after her aunt, who is a past graduate of St. Miator, the oldest school of Astraea Hill, recommended she attend. She seems to have a peppy personality, which can usually cause her to get in trouble if it gets the best of her. At first, whenever Nagisa gazed into the eyes of Shizuma Hanazono, she was unable to move at all, as if she was completely paralyzed. Later on, she seems to have developed a strong attraction towards Shizuma; the Etoile may very well be Nagisa's first love. Other things about her include that Nagisa is easily frightened, making her tremble at even the slightest mention of something scary. This continues the theme that she tends to be more childi

characters.name: Kaori Sakuragi
characters.description: Kaori Sakuragi was a young girl who came to attend Miator starting off in her first year. Ever since she was young, Kaori has been physically weak due to an affliction which remains unnamed, but apparently affected her breathing and possibly her heart. She had a placid personality, and dealt with her condition with surprisingly good grace.

characters.name: Miyuki Rokujo
characters.description: Miyuki is the student council president of Miator, Miyuki tries her best at doing her job in keeping everything in line. Often, when Shizuma is neglecting her duties as the Etoile, she gets annoyed at her and scolds her about it, which makes them seem more like a mother-child pair than as classmates. The two have been rooming together since they arrived at Miator years earlier, but their "parent-child" roles were initially reversed. Nevertheless, the two seem to be friends and have considerable knowledge of and insight into each other. After the death of Kaori Sakuragi, Miyuki became Shizuma's assistant and has remained a confidante of some importance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chiyo Tsukidate
characters.description: Chiyo is a young girl who recently arrived at Astraea Hill, where she quickly became the "room temp" for Nagisa and Tamao, which incidentally is exactly what she wanted. Chiyo tends to be a very shy girl who is unable to articulate herself forcefully enough most of the time and is also rather a klutz. Additionally, she too seems to have a crush on Nagisa, which can also be construed as a form of admiration and idolism on her part. Also, she is a member of the Library Club and works as a librarian in Astraea's Library. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mizue Hamasaka
characters.description: Sister Mizue Hamasaka is an old woman who is the main person in charge of Miator. Her main duties include handing out punishments and reprimanding students when they do something wrong. The range of punishments can vary, but they can get rather outrageous, such as dusting the entire staircase in the enormous church. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hikari Konohana
characters.description: A rather shy and quiet girl most of the time, Hikari tends to not be very outspoken and it usually takes a lot for her to say what is really on her mind. Much like Nagisa Aoi, Hikari is also a transfer student, ariving at Spica in the second year. In that same year, she joined the St. Spica Choir (also known as the Saintly Chorus) with her best friend and roommate Yaya Nanto. Later, she starts to develop a crush on Amane Ohtori, and they begin showing intense feelings of attraction for one another. Hikari also seems to be very religious and can be seen praying within the church or at the Spica fountain with a statue depicting the St. Virgin Mary on the school grounds. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yaya Nanto
characters.description: Hikari's roommate. She is a somewhat forceful girl who also seems to look out for Hikari, who she is in fact in love with. Yaya is good friends with Hikari though they've only known each other for about a year once the story begins. Yaya got Hikari to join the St. Spica Choir the previous year, most likely in an attempt to give her more self-esteem which she seems to be lacking in, though Hikari did show interest in singing as well. Yaya is one of the most talented members of the choir, as noted by Tsubomi Okuwaka, though seems to need more dedication, as noted by Hikari. She also has a rebellious side, sometimes going against school rules or what is normally accepted. However, when it comes to matters of love, she seems to be very shy about her feelings, substituing words with actions, sometimes with adverse results. Also, she rather dislikes first year students - such as Tsubomi Okuwak

characters.name: Amane Ootori
characters.description: Amane appears to be a very loved and respected member of the school, much like Shizuma Hanazono, although she is more of a local celebrity of Spica. She is often seen riding a white horse named Star Bright, which makes her seem more like a prince (a title which Shizuma later marks her with) from a fairy tale. Furthermore, she looks very much like a guy and in effect, a lot of the students at St. Spica are her fans. She tends to have a silent demeanor, which also makes her seem intimidating, making her difficult to talk with or approach. She too has a crush on Hikari, showing her affection much in the way a man does for a woman. Amane, much like Yaya, looks out for Hikari and protects her when need be. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Tsubomi Okuwaka
characters.description: Tsubomi tends to act mature for her age, and is often capable of cowing senior students by pure force of personality. She also seems to have a crush on Hikari, although she calls it pure admiration. Also, she often lectures Hikari and Yaya when they do something wrong in regards to their school work and responsibilities. She is a member of the St. Spica Choir and it is believed that the reason she joined was because of Hikari, though Tsubomi denies this. There are some very faint indications that Tsubomi may be developing an interest in Yaya, later in the series. Tsubomi sometimes gets embarrassed when around Hikari due to either what Hikari says or of what others say. She tends to get angry or flustered easily, giving her an outspoken and very expressive personality. In effect, she can be loud in her opinions of others. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shion Tomori
characters.description: The student council president of Spica, she is a very shrewd girl and is constantly scheming something. However, despite her initial demeanor, she is moderate in personality and rather disinclined towards extreme measures and outright obstructionism. This is in contrast to her associates Kaname Kenjō and Momomi Kiyashiki. After the current Etoile graduates, she would like very much for an attendant of Spica to become the next Etoile and is constantly pushing for this to take place. Her best bet right now is to try to convince Amane Ohtori to consider the position. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: High School Fleet
title_original: ハイスクール・フリート
description: A hundred years after catastrophic shifts in tectonic plates caused most of its area to submerge, Japan now thrives as a maritime nation. High functioning cities line the coasts of Japan, and well developed sea routes are defended by specialized naval ships. The marine industry is flourishing, and young girls are eager to join the Blue Mermaids—highly skilled women who devote their lives to protecting the seas. After some time apart, childhood friends Akeno Misaki and Moeka China are reunited at Yokosuka Girls' Marine High School. Here they are joined by others who share their dream of becoming Blue Mermaids. Soon, training exercises commence, with Akeno and Moeka being put in charge of their own ships and crew. Everything is progressing smoothly for Akeno as she settles into her role as captain and builds camaraderie between her fellow crew members aboard the Harekaze, a destroyer ship. However, unexpected engine and navigation failures soon leave their ship stranded and the crew in danger. High School Fleet follows the Harekaze's valiant crew as they navigate treacherous waters and other obstacles on their quest to become fully-fledged Blue Mermaids. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Akeno Misaki
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm (5'0") She is the commanding officer of Harekaze. She has a cheerful, positive personality and is an optimist who believes that "shipmates are family"; no matter what difficulties arise, she maintains the attitude that "things will work out." She possesses incredible luck—winning the top prize in a lottery on her first try, never drawing anything less than "Daikichi" (Excellent Luck) on a fortune slip, and cracking open eggs with double yolks on more than five occasions. She applied to the maritime school in Yokosuka to fulfill the dream of becoming a "Blue Mermaid" that she had shared with her childhood friend since they were young. Her extraordinary luck extended to the entrance exam, where the topics she "happened" to study were the ones that appeared on the test. She successfully passed the exam for the Navigation Department (as evidenced by the official site, the

characters.name: Mashiro Munetani
characters.description: **Height:** 159 cm (5'2") She is the daughter of the Soya family, a prestigious lineage that has produced generations of Blue Mermaids. As the youngest of three sisters, she is a serious honor student who excels in every subject; however, she is incredibly unlucky—incidents include shifting her answers by one spot on an entrance exam and colliding with Akeno Misaki to fall into the sea right after enrolling. Consequently, she is constantly muttering, "I have no luck..." She dislikes the nickname "Shiro-chan," given to her by Akeno, and prefers to be addressed as "Vice-Captain" or "Ms. Soya." Hiromi Kuroki looks up to her with admiration and frequently supports her. While she maintains a serious and dignified demeanor, she loves cute things and keeps a large collection of stuffed animals in her room—which she ends up sharing with Wilhelmina. Incidentally, her favorite stuffed animal is a

characters.name: Shima Tateishi
characters.description: **Height:** 147 cm (4'8") Chief Artillery Officer of the destroyer-class ship, Harekaze. She comes across as quiet, reserved, and soft-spoken. Her speech is halting, limited to just a word or two; when answering, she simply says "Oui." It was the school's decision to assign her to the Harekaze in the hope that the experience would improve her communication skills. As her list of special talents suggests, she excels at softball; she is a true professional who delivers results, even though she says little more than "Oui" during matches. She also loves curry—so much so that she once ate it for every meal for two whole weeks. In fact, she becomes quite articulate whenever the conversation turns to curry. While one might think eating nothing but curry for a fortnight would get tedious, it apparently wasn't a hardship for her at all.

characters.name: Mei Irizaki
characters.description: **Height:** 146 cm (4'8") Mei Irizaki is the Chief Torpedo Officer aboard the Harekaze. She is self-willed and hates to lose. She tends to act impulsively and impatiently—much like the famous depiction of Oda Nobunaga: "If the cuckoo doesn't sing, kill it." She can often be seen with [Shima Tateishi](https://anilist.co/character/89727/Shima-Tateishi), whom she is best friends with.

characters.name: Kouko Nosa
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm (5'1") Secretary of the destroyer-class ship, Harekaze. Usually polite and mild-mannered, she is a "jack-of-all-trades" who can handle literally anything. She holds the "Database Specialist" certification—considered the most difficult domestic qualification in the field—and is constantly seen with a tablet, recording data, performing calculations, and gathering information. It can be inferred that she qualified for the Paymaster Corps. She possesses an exceptional memory—capable of reciting the full, 100-plus-character official name of Bangkok without error—yet she lacks social skills to such an extreme degree that her interview scores were lower even than Shima's; consequently, she has few close friends. Claiming that "fiction holds more truth than non-fiction," she has a habit of escaping reality; she might bring Zimbabwean dollars for a gag performance or present he

characters.name: Rin Shiretoko
characters.description: **Height:** 148 cm (4'9") She serves as the Navigation Officer aboard the Harekaze, an ocean-going training ship of the Yokosuka Girls' Marine High School. Although she often handles the helm on the bridge, she has a terrible sense of direction. She is an incredibly anxious and timid person who always seems somewhat jittery and prone to bursting into tears. Ironically, however, she becomes strangely energetic whenever she decides to make a run for it—sometimes even misusing her talent for running fast to facilitate her escape. Perhaps due to her constant worrying, she suffers from frequent stomach aches and always carries stomach medicine with her. Having spent her life running away from things out of fear since childhood, she decided to become a Blue Mermaid in an effort to change herself. Encouraged by Akeno whenever she falls into a slump, she is striving to pick herself up and move f

characters.name: Wilhelmina Braunschweig Ingenol Friedeburg
characters.original: ヴィルヘルミーナ・ブラウンシュヴァイク・インゲノール・フリーデブルク
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'3") The executive officer of the Deutschland-class ship "Admiral Graf Spee." She has a down-to-earth, sturdy, and serious personality. She refers to herself as "Washi" and speaks with a dialect resembling Hiroshima-ben (often ending sentences with "ja"), a manner of speaking she picked up from watching yakuza movies. She also frequently adds the prefix "do-" (an intensifier) ​​to words. According to Mina, the Spee was en route to a joint exercise with Japan when the ship's electronics suffered a mysterious malfunction and the crew stopped obeying Captain Thea Kreutzer; acting on Thea's orders, Mina escaped the ship to report this abnormal situation. She and Thea have been best friends since junior high school, and Thea entrusted her captain's cap to Mina upon her escape. Aboard the Harekaze, she shared a cabin with Mashiro Soya and remarked that the room—filled with

characters.name: Moeka China
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") As Akeno's childhood friend and a source of mutual encouragement, she aspires to become a Blue Mermaid. After enrolling at Yokosuka Girls' Marine High School, she is appointed captain of the Musashi. She excels academically and possesses strong leadership qualities. It can be inferred that she applied to and passed the entrance exam for the Navigation Department. Having been a model student since childhood—gifted with an exceptional memory and a diligent nature that allowed her to handle anything with ease—she had begun to lose interest in everything around her. However, befriending Akeno changed that completely; she came to feel that being with Akeno was the most exciting thing in the world. Consequently, while she may appear to be the "big sister" figure to Akeno at first glance, she is actually the one who relies more heavily on the other emotionally. After e

characters.name: Maron Yanagiwara
characters.description: **Height:** 146 cm (4'8") She is a childhood friend of [Hiromi Kuroki](https://anilist.co/character/89351/Kuroki-Hiromi) and hails from the same hometown. Although she is a dependent type who fears being alone, she puts on a cheerful front for those around her. Despite being from Choshi City, Chiba Prefecture, she possesses the spirited, straightforward attitude of a true-blue Edokko (native of old Tokyo). Influenced by her grandfather—a fan of period dramas—she grew up watching the genre with him and developed a fondness for the distinctive Edo-style dialect. She is skilled at tinkering with machinery; as the crew member in charge of the engines, she takes such pride in her role that she refers to herself as a "stoker" (or "boiler-tender"). Having studied marine engineering since junior high school, she possesses top-tier technical skills and an exceptional memory—capable of recalling b

characters.name: Hiromi Kuroki
characters.description: **Height:** 169 cm (5'5") She is a childhood friend and fellow native of the same hometown as Maron Yanagihara. According to Maron, "Kuro-chan is cool and composed, yet kind; I want to stay close friends with her forever." Although she appears cool, she tends to get intensely fixated on things once she takes an interest; for instance, a childhood tour of a soy sauce factory got her hooked on making her own soy sauce, and seeing a diesel locomotive sparked a hobby of tinkering with machinery. Perhaps due to this nature, she was once unsure of her future path during junior high; however, after meeting Mashiro Soya at the Blue Mermaid Festa and the entrance exam venue, she developed a strong admiration for her and resolved to become a Blue Mermaid herself. Incidentally, Maron gets jealous, fearing that "Kuro-chan might get snatched away by some random girl." Beyond general machinery, she po

characters.name: Hikari Ogasawara
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm (5'1") She is in charge of gunnery on the Harekaze, primarily handling targeting duties. She acts as the leader when working alongside fellow gunnery crew members Michiru Takeda and Junko Hioki. She has loved games involving throwing objects at targets—such as darts—since childhood; she was so enthusiastic about understanding the mechanics of motion that she even studied her older brother's physics textbooks. While she excels at mathematics and physics, she struggles with subjects like biology and Japanese literature, feeling that they cannot be neatly explained by mathematical formulas. As for her other hobby, the tea ceremony, she is being taught it—somewhat against her will—by an aunt who is a tea ceremony instructor. Although she and Michiru attended different junior high schools, they became friends after frequently running into each other at a café located halfwa

characters.name: Michiru Takeda
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'3") She is in charge of gunnery on the Harekaze, primarily operating the rotation of the main guns.
