She once dreamed of becoming a gunnery officer on a large warship but had to give up that ambition due to deteriorating eyesight. Nevertheless, she remains determined to work in the field of gunnery and aspires to hold a position related to it. Her failing eyesight is attributed to either excessive studying or her obsession with billiards. She even brought a billiard set aboard the Harekaz*, though she is currently at a loss for a place to set it up. She has a somewhat sadistic streak and often plays the "straight man" to the scatterbrained Hikari and Junko. She is poor at geography and believes that deer are the famous specialty of Mie Prefecture. Although she and Hikari attended different junior high schools, they became close acquaintances after frequently hanging

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Season 3
title_original: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー Season 3
description: Since childhood, horse girls Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond have admired and aspired to be like their fellow horse girl named Toukai Teiou. Chasing their dreams, they enroll in Tracen Academy, an institution dedicated to training horse girls and preparing them for legendary races. Soon after, Kitasan Black lands on Team Spica, the same team as Teiou. Beaming with motivation, she remains undefeated until she fails to win her first Grade 1 (G1) race—the most prestigious type of race in the league—but she is determined to unleash her true potential as a horse girl. Meanwhile, Satono Diamond comes from a long line of horse girls who, despite sporting incredible running prowess, have never won a G1 race. It is up to her to finally break this curse and bring the Satono clan the glory it deserves. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Kitasan Black
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm (Season 2) / 162 cm (Season 3) __Team:__ Spica Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine. Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

characters.name: Satono Diamond
characters.description: __Height:__ 135 cm (Season 2) / 158 cm (Season 3) __Team:__ Capella Possesses a will harder than diamonds! She can handle any jinx! Born to an affluent house, she was showered with love and affection growing up. This sheltered upbringing has made her somewhat naive, but her gentle, honest demeanor hides a diamond-hard resolve. She trudges on resolutely, determined to break the Satono family's jinx and bring honor to her family.

characters.name: Satono Crown
characters.description: **Height**: 163cm Turf Magician! An elite sister you can rely on. She is a cheerful and determined older sister who lives in both Hong Kong and Japan. She's also one of the talented members of the Satono family, and carries the family's high expectations. She has a personality that burns more brightly in the face of adversity, and sometimes solves problems as brilliantly as magic.

characters.name: Cheval Grand
characters.description: **Height**: 160cm Ambitious with a timid heart. Aiming to become a great Umamusume. She's introverted, withdrawn, and has an inferiority complex about her talented older and younger sisters. She spends her time working hard to hopefully surpass them both one day, and have her own abilities acknowledged. She's not on bad terms with either of her siblings... but they both have a glamorous temperament, which makes her a bit out of place when they're together.

characters.name: Sounds of Earth
characters.description: **Height**: 161cm The race is her ensemble! A music-loving, artistic, Umamusume. Her racing is an ensemble with the earth, and the girls in the race are her musical partners. She's a natural artist who loves music more than anything else, and isn't afraid to say that "playing the most wonderful sound in a race" is her true calling. She's a very passionate person, and sometimes makes flirtatious advances towards her rivals whom she admires. She's also a violinist, and her favorite flower is the Flowering Dogwood.

characters.name: Duramente
characters.description: **Height:** 166cm The most powerful blood flows through her body. The product of a prestigious family. An elite Umamusume with a promising future, born from a prestigious family known for producing many excellent athletic Umamusume. She is usually quite serious and stoic, but when a race is in front of her, her fighting spirit takes over and she shows her wild side. She has been close friends with [Air Groove](https://anilist.co/character/140846/Air-Groove) from a very young age.

characters.name: Gold Ship
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else! An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

characters.name: Toukai Teiou
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer. A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

characters.name: Mejiro McQueen
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady. Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

characters.name: Special Week
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream. Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

characters.name: Silence Suzuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier. An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

characters.name: Daiwa Scarlet
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose. Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

title: Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta
title_original: 気になってる人が男じゃなかった
title_en: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy At All
description: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Aya Oosawa
characters.description: Part of the popular crowd, her grades aren't great but she has good communication skills and has a lot of friends. Popular with the guys at school but she takes no interest in them.

characters.name: Mitsuki Koga
characters.description: Has a quiet and reserved personality, her classmates mistake her for an anime otaku. She can be a little airheaded in certain circumstances.

characters.name: Megumu Narita
characters.description: In the same class as [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/282093/Oosawa-Aya) and [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/282094/Koga-Mitsuki). An easygoing and refreshing stud (self- proclaimed) who is popular and admired by many. He's reasonably well-liked by the ladies, so when he encounters a girl he can't easily charm, he can't get her out of his head (currently, he can't get Mitsuki and Aya out of his head, but more in the sense that he's watching over them). If someone says something mean to him, he'll smile while actually getting depressed on the inside. However, he bounces back ridiculously fast. As far as his club activities go, he's in the soccer club (but he's probably the type who gets invited to all kinds of clubs).

characters.name: Chizuru
characters.description: Chizuru, along with Mao, used to be Aya's best friend. She doesn't like that Aya spends so much time with Mitsuki lately.

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: Mao is another girl from Aya's inner circle. She always follows Chizuru wherever she goes and is secretly interested in Narita.

characters.name: Joe
characters.description: Mitsuki's uncle. He doesn't have children of his own, so he's all-in on loving his niece. The ultimate doting uncle. He's always pursued what he loves, so he wants Mitsuki to be true to herself as well. When he was young, he worked hard to make a living from music, but now he's the owner of a run-down CD shop.

characters.name: Kanna
characters.description: [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/305502/Joe)'s ex-girlfriend. She works as a stylist in L.A. Mitsuki looks up to her because she focuses on the things she wants to do and pushes hard towards them.

title: Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray Part 2
title_original: ウマ娘 シンデレラグレイ 第2クール
description: Hailing from the humble countryside, Oguri Cap has turned the racing world on its head. Her rampage through the national race scene seemed unstoppable... until it wasn't. Tamamo Cross, the current peak of racing, has bested the Beast and declared Oguri Cap her rival. But Oguri Cap can't afford to keep her attention on Tamamo Cross alone. One by one, racers from all over the world arrive in Japan, ready to demonstrate their own prowess. Up against the best the world has to offer, our ashen racer will need to reach beyond her limits if she wants to stand a chance… Keep those eyes peeled—a Cinderella story full of twists and turns lies ahead! (Source: It's Anime powered by REMOW)

characters.name: Oguri Cap
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside. Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

characters.name: Tamamo Cross
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of! A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funny [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) make for a good comedic duo.

characters.name: Fujimasa March
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Fujimasa March is a scholarship student at the Kasamatsu Training Academy. She was considered the best in her class and set her sights on winning the Tokai Derby. [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) is the first person she would consider as a rival.

characters.name: Belno Light
characters.description: __Height:__ 146 cm Belno Light is a teammate of [Oguri Cap.](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) She is skilled at studying, which allows her to excel at providing insight and analysis. Her family runs a major company specializing in sports goods for Uma Musume, which gives her deep knowledge about racing equipment.

characters.name: Dicta Striker
characters.description: Dicta Striker is the self proclaimed ace of her grade at Tracen Academy and classmate of [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap). She appears rough and violent at first glance, but she is actually caring and good-natured. She is the type who wants to compete with everything she has in order to win.

characters.name: Super Creek
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing. No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains. She is rivals with both Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

characters.name: Ginjirou Musaka
characters.description: [Jou Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/352505/Jou-Kitahara)'s uncle and ~![Oguri Cap's](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) trainer.!~

characters.name: Norn Ace
characters.description: Norn Ace is a well known Uma Musume in her hometown, and roommates with [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) in Kasamatsu. Norn and her friends initially bully Oguri for standing out in class, but eventually become strong supporters.

characters.name: Mini The Lady
characters.description: One of [Norn](https://anilist.co/character/363003/Norn-Ace)'s friends. She has a cunning and mischievous personality but tends to go overboard. She actually excels academically and is ranked 2nd in her grade.

characters.name: Rudy Lemono
characters.description: One of [Norn](https://anilist.co/character/363003/Norn-Ace)'s close friends. She has a rough exterior but is actually the most sensible among the group. She is often dragged into the schemes of [Mini the Lady](https://anilist.co/character/363000/Mini-The-Lady).

characters.name: Sakura Chiyono O
characters.description: **Height:** 156cm Follow your dreams! This Umamusume is honest and hardworking. A pure-hearted, honest Umamusume. She admires [Maruzensky](https://anilist.co/character/140842/Maruzensky), and aims to be her equal in every way. She makes a habit out of filling her "Chiyonotes" with proverbs relevant to her daily experiences—though few but her are able to parse them.

characters.name: Mejiro Ardan
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm She wants to shine bright, no matter how briefly! This well-to-do girl has legs of glass. A sheltered young lady—ephemeral, gentle, and thoughtful. Despite her fragile, "glass" legs putting her at a disadvantage when running, she refuses to let cynicism keep her down. As a child, her frail body kept her from most recreation and social activities, so she finds community life at the academy to be quite the novel experience.

title: NOIR
description: Mireille Bouquet is a professional assassin, and a very good one at that. But when she follows up an e-mail from a young Japanese girl named Yumura Kirika, inviting her to take "a pilgrimage to the past", her life becomes even more dangerous than it already is. Now, with a haunting melody invoking the memory of an event long past, Mireille and Kirika decide to work together to find the truth about a thousand year old organization that has controlled both of their lives since before they were born. And the only clue in their search, the only thing Kirika remembers about herself, becomes their working codename: a name designating an ancient fate, of two maidens who reign over death--Noir. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kirika Yuumura
characters.description: Kirika Yuumura is an assassin who teamed up with [Mireille Bouquet](https://anilist.co/character/2259/Mireille-Bouquet) under the codename Noir. Much about her past is mysterious, even to her; she experienced severe retrograde amnesia almost immediately prior to meeting Mireille, and since then has recovered only fragmentary memories. Despite her young age, memory loss, and a certain naiveté, Kirika possessed the skills of a superbly-trained killer. Her preferred weapon was a Beretta M1934 pistol, although she was also an expert at killing people with whatever was at hand. Kirika has an enigmatic, glacial, troubled, solitary, grim, ruthless, stoic, brooding, and creative personality.

characters.name: Mireille Bouquet
characters.description: An assassin with a painful past, Mireille is very good at hiding her emotions. Based in Paris, France, her operations have her traveling all over the world (even to the humble island country of Taiwan). She was born in Corsica, France, the island where Napoleon Bonaparte was born. A top-notch assassin, she still has some problems handling some tough, superior assassins. Intelligent, analytical, and seemingly cold without feelings, there's perhaps a fire burning with her that she never admits or denies. Her signature outfit is a dark red, almost burgendy, sleeveless blouse, a thin black belt with a silver buckle, and a short black skirt. People who have seen her in her "work uniform" are usually dead. She and her partner, Kirika, are best known as "Noir".

characters.name: Silvana Gleone
characters.original: シルヴァーナ・グレオーネ
characters.description: Intoccabile, the most brutal Princess in the world. Upon the murder of her father, Don Greone, by Noir, Intoccabile took over control of the Cosa Nostra (Sicilian Mafia) in a ritual that involved murdering her grandfather. Having crossed paths with Mireille once before in their youth, this delicate, but deadly flower may prove to be Mireille's most potent opponent yet.

characters.name: Chloe
characters.description: Chloe is an assassin for the Les Soldats who only answers to [Altena](https://anilist.co/character/3844/Altena), a high-ranking member of the organization. Unlike [Mireille Bouquet](https://anilist.co/character/2259/Mireille-Bouquet) and [Kirika Yumura](https://anilist.co/character/2258/Kirika-Yumura), she prefers to fight with knives rather than guns. She claims to be the true Noir, is extremely skilled as an assassin, and shares many qualities of Kirika, making herself a near match for Kirika and at odds with Mireille, although she wishes to be her friend. ~!Chloe watched Kirika perform her first two assassinations when they were children on Mireille's parents, making her Idolize Kirika. Though she claimed to want to be friends with Mireille, she secretly harbors intense jealousy toward Mireille and her close relationship with Kirika. Near the end of the series, when Chloe attempts to

characters.name: Altena
characters.description: Altena is a ranking member of the ruling body which governs Soldats--an ancient, secret society whose power clandestinely reigns over the globe. Not much is known about Altena at the present, but there seems to be a lot of opposition to her motives within Soldats higher echelon. The focus of Altena's efforts lies within a project known only as Le Grand Retour. While the full scope of the Le Grand Retour project remains clouded, it is believed to have something to do with the origin of Soldats and the original purpose of Noir. Should Altena succeed, it is believed that she would have the power to reshape Soldats in any way she sees fit. This prospect does not sit well with the other members of the Soldats hierarchy, but their ability to counter Altena's ambitions remains wanting to say the least. While Altena may seem to be a gentle, motherly figure, this woman certainly possess

characters.name: Milosh
characters.description: Milosh Havul is a retired member of a Foreign Legion. Kirika happens to meet him near the long riverbank. Inspired by his talents, she decides to start drawing and becomes very good at it. Milosh tells her that he will join the Legion again.

characters.name: Dominiques
characters.description: One of the mafia bosses. He worked for Silvana Gleone.

characters.name: Yuri Nazarov
characters.description: Yuri Nazarov is a former Russian KGB officer, and a member of the Norgas. While working as a member of the KGB, he ordered the execution of an ethnic minority known as the Tashkil after seeing his family killed by them as a child. To make amends for this, he began to go around and help the poor and destitute by supplying them with food free of charge. He is accompanied by his white cat named Prince Myshkin. ~! Despite no longer being a member of the KGB, the remaining Tashkil send Mireille and Kirika to kill him. He was killed by Kirika. !~

title: Ninja to Koroshiya no Futarigurashi
title_original: 忍者と殺し屋のふたりぐらし
title_en: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
description: On the way home from school one day, Konoha Koga rescues Satoko Kusagakure, a ninja who escaped her village. Soon, pursuers from the village show up in search of Satoko only to be deftly dealt with by Konoha. As it turns out, the unassuming high schooler is actually an assassin. Thus, the potentially cutthroat cohabitation of a ninja and an assassin begins! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Satoko Kusagakure
characters.description: A recent runaway from a ninja village who is ignorant about the outside world. She is useless at Ninja battle techniques, but has the special ninjutsu ability to turn objects into leaves. Her experience doing chores for the village makes her skilled at cleaning.

characters.name: Konoha Koga
characters.description: Despite looking like a normal high school girl, she is an assassin. She invites [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) to help with her assassin work due to the usefulness of her ninjutsu. Outside of work she is somewhat of a slob and her real name is unknown.

characters.name: Marin Izutsumi
characters.description: A rival assassin to [Konoha](https://anilist.co/character/341513/Konoha-Koga) who uses various inventions instead of combat ability. As an apology for kidnapping [Satoko,](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) she sends [Roboko](https://anilist.co/character/350518/Roboko) to Konoha.

characters.name: Kuro
characters.description: Leader of the fugitive ninjas who convinced [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) to leave the village, she regrets dragging Satoko into her personal business and tries to help her when she can. She has ninjutsu which erases memories and currently is unemployed as she lives with her [girlfriend](https://anilist.co/character/350517/Yuriko).

characters.name: Yuriko
characters.description: Ordinary person who lives together with [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/350516/Kuro). She is a beautiful woman and a good person, but also readily accepts ninjas and assassins so may also be a weird person.

characters.name: Roboko
characters.description: A robot made by [Marin](https://anilist.co/character/350515/Marin-Izutsumi) which resembles [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure). She has many useful features which make [Konoha](https://anilist.co/character/341513/Konoha-Koga) very happy.

title: Tai-Ari deshita.: Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game nante Shinai
title_original: 対ありでした。 ～お嬢さまは格闘ゲームなんてしない～
title_en: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games
description: Mitsuki Aya has one goal at the elite Kuromi Girls’ Academy: to become a refined young lady like the school’s flawless “White Lily,” Yorue Mio. But her image of Mio shatters when Aya accidentally catches her...playing fighting games?! Turns out, the elegant Mio is actually a hardcore gamer—and she wants to duel Aya! The battle (and their friendship) begins. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Aya Mitsuki
characters.description: Aya is a first year student attending Kuromi Girls’ Academy on a scholarship. She's a skilled fighting game player and joined the academy to learn how to become a proper young lady after abandoning her hobby.

characters.name: Mio Yorue
characters.description: Mio is a first year student at Kuromi Girls 'Academy. She excels at fighting games and attends the academy at her mother's request. Mio is addicted to fighting games and doesn't hesitate to break the rules of the academy to play. She cries easily when things don't go her way, but shows strong determination when she has a goal in mind. Fellow students call her Shirayuri-sama, a nickname that infuriates her.

characters.name: Yuu Inui
characters.description: A fun-loving student who is a part of the school dorms' discipline committee, and who has loved fighting games since her early childhood. In her effort to befriend [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/223109/Mitsuki-Aya), [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/223110/Yorue-Mio), and [Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/364057/Ichinose-Tamaki), she slowly but surely gets sucked into their world.

characters.name: Tamaki Ichinose
characters.description: A student who's part of the school council, which should control students and enforce the school's no-games policy, while she has a secret passion for fighting games.

characters.name: Arisa Fujimiya
characters.description: An elementary school gamer with skills that rival those of professionals. She does not tolerate compromise or complacency in fighting game play, and harbors hostility toward players who only fight among friends, like [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/223109/Mitsuki-Aya) and [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/223110/Yorue-Mio). Although she frequently uses harsh language, she remains a capable competitor who stays composed during matches and handles situations calmly in pursuit of victory.

characters.name: Flamberge
characters.description: A well-known commentator who serves as a play-by-play announcer at official fighting game tournaments. He has a close relationship with his audience and is sometimes teased, but his overwhelming skill and passionate delivery energize the crowd and have earned him many fans. His trademark look includes glasses and fingerless gloves.

characters.name: gekido
characters.description: Pro gamer and member of Kobushi Gaming.

characters.name: Seshiro
characters.description: Pro gamer and member of Kobushi Gaming.

characters.name: Hana Ichinose
characters.description: She is the senior high dormitory affairs vice president.

characters.name: CA-FE-O-RE
characters.description: Pro gamer and member of Kobushi Gaming.

characters.name: Natsume Sukisaka
characters.description: Aya's roommate

characters.name: Cammy
characters.description: Shadaloo Cammy's early history is unknown; her first appearance in the Street Fighter chronology was Street Fighter Alpha 3, where she was a soulless Doll sent to assassinate Dhalsim. Dhalsim used his spiritual powers to make her self-aware, and she realized that Shadaloo was controlling her. M. Bison sent Vega to observe her. When Vega confronted her, he revealed to her that she was an "experiment" and was no longer needed. Vega intentionally lost a battle to her, and she wondered why Shadaloo wanted to destroy her, since she had never committed any altercations against them. She later encountered Juli and Juni, two other Shadaloo Dolls, who lacked the benefit of self-awareness. When Cammy confronted Bison, he told her that she was meant to become his next body, after his current physical manifestation was destroyed by his own Psycho Power. Cammy managed to break the twel

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのは
description: 3rd grader Takamachi Nanoha stumbled upon an injured talking ferret after hearing his telepathic cries for help. The ferret turned out to be Yuuno, an archeologist and mage from another world who had accidentally scattered the dangerous Jewel Seeds throughout Earth. Without the strength to collect the Jewel Seeds, Yuuno had resumed a ferret form and needed someone else to take on the task for him. He gave a red jewel to Nanoha explaining to her with this she could transform and use magic to combat the monsters that threatened them due to the Jewel Seeds. But the monsters are the least of their worries, as Yuuno and Nanoha are not the only ones out to collect the Jewel Seeds.

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

characters.name: Lindy Harlaown
characters.original: リンディ・ハラオウン
characters.description: Lindy, the kind-spirited captain of the spaceship Asura, works for the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She enjoys drinking green tea with sugar (and sometimes cream) added, which is ironic given her appreciation of Japanese culture. She is Chrono's mother.

characters.name: Chrono Harlaown
characters.description: Chrono is a young officer of the Time-Space Administration Bureau and wields the S2U,a storage device in the first season and an ice-type Intelligent Device named Durandal in A's. His personality is usually one who looks at things from a logical approach, but he has made jokes on occasion. His mother Lindy is his commanding officer and the Admiral of the Asura, while his father isn't mentioned (revealed in A's to be deceased.) Together they used thier influence within the TSAB to aid in Fate's trial,afterwhich he trained Fate in combat before her return in A's where she became his adopted sister. In the first season Chrono displays his control over shooting-type spells when he aids Nanoha during the attack on the Garden of Time,so much so that Nanoha is speechless at his skill. As of StrikerS he has become the Admiral of his own ship,the Claudia while his mother lives on Earth next to Na

characters.name: Suzuka Tsukimura
characters.description: Suzuka Tsukimura is a minor character of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series. The younger sister of Shinobu Tsukimura, Suzuka is a civilian and best friends with Nanoha Takamachi and Alisa Bannings. In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's, she befriends Hayate Yagami, not knowing of the war between Hayate's protectors the Wolkenritter and the Time-Space Administration Bureau, for which Nanoha works. Suzuka does not exist in Triangle Heart. Suzuka is a grade three student in the same class as Nanoha and Alisa, and already sure what she wants to do with her life: continue on her family tradition of rich, successful engineers. She lives in a huge mansion with her maids Noel and Farin K. Ehrlichkeit, sister Shinobu and many cats, one of which is affected by a Jewel Seed. As a small child, she was bullied by the more aggressive Alisa, but Nanoha stood up to Alisa and the trio became friends. Wh

characters.name: Alisa Bannings
characters.description: Alisa Bannings is a minor character of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series. Best friends with Nanoha Takamachi and Suzuka Tsukimura, Alisa is the daughter of two successful company owners and has plans of succeeding them. Alisa was adapted from the character of Alisa Lowell in Triangle Heart, but besides being a living being, is much friendlier and holds no such grudge against the world. Alisa is an outspoken, dog-loving Anglophone and multimillionaire heiress. She gets angry at Nanoha halfway through the series for keeping secrets from her friends. Despite this, she cares deeply for her friend. She is a strong-willed person the apparent leader in her small circle of friends. When she has bursts of rage at not fully understanding what's going on, Suzuka is usually there to calm her down. Alisa is proficient with English and loves dogs, owning about ten at her large mansion. Similarly

characters.name: Amy Limietta
characters.original: エイミィ・リミエッタ
characters.description: In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, Amy works on the Arthra as the Chief of Operations, and is a good friend to Chrono and Lindy. She is an officer cadet, often tasked with research and intelligence gathering, which are her specialties. In StrikerS: ~! she and [Chrono](https://anilist.co/character/4179/Chrono-Harlaown) are married with twins, a boy and a girl.!~

characters.name: Precia Testarossa
characters.original: プレシア・テスタロッサ
characters.description: Precia Testarossa, also transliterated as Presia, is the first main villain of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series; however, she does not appear in Triangle Heart. A mage and the main resident of the Garden of Time, Precia sends her daughter Fate Testarossa out to Earth to collect a set of Lost Logia (ancient and powerful magical artifacts) known as the Jewel Seeds, while evading the Time-Space Administration Bureau. While a researcher of familiars, she does not have one of her own during Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, and her weapon is unnamed. Precia first appears in episode 7, having previously been mentioned as the reason that Fate is gathering Jewel Seeds. She is abusive and cruel, torturing Fate simply for not getting enough Jewel Seeds and not disposing of potential hindrance Nanoha. Though Arf hates Precia and tells Fate that she is not worth it, Fate asserts that she remembers

characters.name: Alicia Testarossa
characters.original: アリシア・テスタロッサ
characters.description: Alicia is Precia's biological daughter. They lived a happy life until Alicia died at the age of eight, driving her mother insane. ~!Precia preserved Alicia's body in a glass tank and dedicated her life to obtaining the Jewel Seeds, which could lead her to Al Hazard, the legendary place that could restore her daughter. Using Alicia's DNA, Precia created a clone called Fate to gather the jewels for her. Fate, implanted with Alicia's memories, was abused to no end by her "mother," but remained painfully loyal until the truth was discovered. In the end, Alicia's body fell into the void with Precia. In the second season, the Book of Darkness draws Fate into a dream of what she has always wanted: a happy family life. Precia is sane, Alicia is Fate's older sister, and everything appears good. Alicia wishes that Fate could stay in the dream with her forever, but Fate sadly refuses, saying that h

characters.name: Kyouya Takamachi
characters.description: __Triangle Heart:__ Kyouya is the son of Takamachi Shirou, and is the heir to his father's Mikami twin kodachi style. He lives He has vowed to avenge his father who was killed when he was young. He is extremely close with Miyuki, who grew up with him, and he considers her his blood sister even though they're cousins. Although Kyouya is the better swordsman, the team make an excellent team in a fight. He is hired with Miyuki to defend his childhood friend, Fiasse, from a threat to kidnap her. Ellis McGaren, Fiasse's official hired bodyguard and also Kyouya's childhood friend, is initially unhappy with both of them working together to protect Fiasse, and thinks Kyouya will just get in her way. Eventually the two learn to get along and work together. __Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha:__ Kyouya is the real brother of Miyuki and Nanoha here, and lives with his mother, Momoko, and his father, Shir

title: Hidamari Sketch
description: For years, Yuno has dreamed of attending Yamabuki Arts High School, but now that she's been accepted, it means the scary prospect of moving away from her home and family for the first time! Fortunately, Yuno quickly learns that if her new neighbors at the eclectic Hidamari (Sunshine) Apartments aren't technically family, at least the majority share the bond of being fellow art students. From second year students like Hiro and Sae, who try to behave like helpful older sisters (mostly successfully) to her hyperactive new neighbor, classmate and best friend Miyako (who has the scariest apartment ever) Yuno begins to build the support network she'll need for dealing with strange characters like her oddly masculine landlady, her cosplay obsessed home room teacher, her tooth-chattering principal and all of the other odd denizens who inhabit her chosen world of art. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chika
characters.description: Chika is Sae's thirteen-year-old sister. She is more spontaneous and energetic than her older sister. She enjoys cooking and has an infatuation with a Kabuki actor. She has no artistic talent and prefers music and home economics to art. Initially only appearing in the anime adaptation, she made her first appearance in the manga in the June 2012 issue of Manga Time Kirara Carat.

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: Ume is a Metapod that lives on the roof of the Hidamari Apartments and represents the manga's author, Ume Aoki. The character does not actually play any significant role in the story. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kuwahara
characters.description: The school nurse and a very good friend of Yoshinoya and the principal.

characters.name: Maiko no Chichioya
characters.description: Maiko Kishi's father.

title: Mayonaka Punch
description: Meet Masaki, the now former member of the popular NewTuber group, Harikiri Sisters. After a career setback, aka getting fired unexpectedly via a livestream, she joins forces with Live, a partner with superhuman abilities. Together, they aim to create sensational content and reach 1 million subscribers. Will they reach their content dreams or be hit with the block button? (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Masaki Sonoue
characters.description: Producer of the Mayonaka Punch channel. She is in charge of planning, filming, and editing the videos single-handedly. Her biggest problem is her selfish nature, which caused her falling out with her previous channel "Hyped-up Sisters."

characters.name: Live
characters.description: Mayonaka Punch's leader, who recently woke up from a 20 year supernatural slumber. She feels like she has a fated connection to [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/329072/Masaki-Sonoue) and agrees to collaborate on a channel in order to drink her blood.

characters.name: Ichiko
characters.description: Member of Mayonaka Punch channel, who lives with the other members inside Banpai Manor, which she has a strong attachment to as a place. She has a childlike demeanor but sees herself as an older sister type.

characters.name: Fu
characters.description: Member of the Mayonaka Punch channel with a shy personality who often acts as the most sensible person in Mayonaka Punch. She has a part time job at a bathhouse and enjoys music.

characters.name: Tokage
characters.description: Member of the Mayonaka Punch channel who loves gambling and money. She is a wild and free person who often causes problems for others.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A cool beauty who monitors the other vampires on behalf of an entity known as ["Mother."](https://anilist.co/character/343294/Mother) Part of her responsibilities are providing the vampires with their blood supply.

characters.name: Kikka
characters.description: Member of the Hyped-Up Sisters channel, who seems mature but becomes more like an older sister when excited.

characters.name: Otomi
characters.description: Member of the channel Hyped-Up Sisters.

characters.name: Aya
characters.description: A girl from 50 years ago who bonded with [Fu](https://anilist.co/character/329443/Fu) over music, and they planned to make music together.

characters.name: Mother
characters.description: Leader of the vampires. In order to protect the community, the existence of vampires is not allowed to be revealed to the world. Violating that rule will invoke harsh punishment.

title: Lycoris Recoil: Friends are thieves of time.
title_original: リコリス・リコイル Friends are thieves of time.
title_en: Lycoris Recoil -Friends are thieves of time.-
description: A series of shorts showing the daily lives of Chisato, Takina, and others employed in Cafe LycoReco.

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl. ~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco. A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris. She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

characters.name: Mizuki Nakahara
characters.description: Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone. Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time. ~!In some later episodes, it is revealed that Kurumi is actually the hacker Walnut.!~

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees. Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”. ~!In episode 7 of the anime, it is revealed that Mika is gay.!~

characters.name: Fuki Harukawa
characters.description: A 1st Lycoris of DA Tokyo branch. Previously [Takina](https://anilist.co/character/260328/Inoue-Takina)’s partner. She and [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato) fight like cats and dogs.

characters.name: Sakura Otome
characters.description: A 2nd Lycoris of DA Tokyo branch. She is Fuki's partner instead of Takina.

characters.name: Kusunoki
characters.description: DA Commander.

title: Endro~!
description: The anime's story is set on Naral Island, a continent with swords and magic in which humans and monsters coexist. The terrible Demon King lives there. In ancient times, the first-generation hero defeated the Demon King. Over the many successive generations since then, the Demon King has been resurrected, and the hero who opposes him has likewise reappeared. Girls attend a school for adventurers in order to defeat the Demon King when he appears again. Though a bit absent-minded, Yusha has the body of a hero. The holy elf Seyla's trouble never ends because she is too serious. The cheerful warrior Fai loves to eat. Mei is a quiet otaku magician. As the four girls aim to be in the hero party, they live relaxed fantasy lives and show no sign of defeating the Demon King no matter how much time passes. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Yuulia Chardiet
characters.original: ユーリア・シャルデット

characters.name: Seiran Élénoir
characters.original: エレノワール・セイラン

characters.name: Rona Principia O Rabanesta
characters.original: ロ一ナ・プリシパ・オ・ラバネスタ

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: __Classification:__ Demon Lord A new teacher who teaches at the adventurer school where [Yuusha](https://anilist.co/character/128643/Yuulia-Chardiet) and her friends attend. Although mentally mature, because of her young appearance, she is treated like a cute mascot by the students. Her true identity is that of the fearsome demon lord.

title: "Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omou na" to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai
title_original: 「お前ごときが魔王に勝てると思うな」と勇者パーティを追放されたので、王都で気ままに暮らしたい
title_en: ROLL OVER AND DIE: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
description: Flum has been chosen by God to be in the hero's party despite having stats of zero across the board. All she has is the "Reversal" ability that she still doesn't fully understand. Predictably, she proves useless in battle, but she refuses to give up and continues to do all she can for the party. Her partymate Jean, a genius and renowned sage, picks on her at every opportunity and eventually sells her off into slavery. Even as a slave, she's treated as incompetent and persecuted, and ultimately thrown to monsters as bait for her master's entertainment. Flum is left with two options: take up the cursed sword that inevitably brings death to its wielder, or be eaten by monsters. The moment she chooses to fight back is when the "Reversal" of her life begins... (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Flum Apricot
characters.original: フラム・アプリコット
characters.description: A caring, determined, strong, slight yandere, and cruel young girl who will help anyone who needs it. She has reddish-brown hair, orange eyes, and a slave mark on her left cheek. Has the power of "Reversal"

characters.name: Milkit
characters.description: A shy girl with no magical powers, who is rescued by [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Apricot-Flum) from a slave trader. She insists on calling Flum her "Master". Her face is covered in bandages, with only a single blue eye peeking out. She carries a slave mark on her right cheek.

characters.name: Sara Anvillen
characters.description: A nun in training for the Church of Origin. In addition to being able to use curative magic, she is a talented melee fighter.

characters.name: Eterna Rinebow
characters.description: A powerful water magic user, and a member of the party of heroes.

characters.name: Gadhio Lathcutt
characters.original: ガディオ・ラスカット
characters.description: A member of the party of heroes, armed with a huge sword. ~!The sole survivor of his previous party, which included his wife, Tia.!~

characters.name: Cyrill Sweechka
characters.original: キリル・スウィーチカ
characters.description: Possessing the rare attribute "Hero" and high stats, she is a girl at the center of the journey to defeat the Demon King. When the Hero Party was first formed, she got along well with [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Flum-Apricot), who also comes from the countryside, but at some point their relationship became strained...

characters.name: Jean Inteige
characters.description: He is a genius with the rare attribute "Nature" and can use the four elemental magics of Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth. However, he has an overconfident and self-righteous personality, and dislikes [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Flum-Apricot), who has joined the hero's party despite having no combat ability whatsoever.

characters.name: Linus Radiants
characters.original: ライナス・レディアンツ
characters.description: An S-rank wind-attribute adventurer. He is a bright, sociable young man who gives off a frivolous impression, but his archery skills are well-known, and he can hit prey thousands of miles away. He is interested in [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/371344/Maria-Afenjuns), who is traveling with him to defeat the Demon King.

characters.name: Maria Afenjuns
characters.original: マリア・アフェンジェンス
characters.description: A light-attributed nun of the Origin Church. She lost her family at an early age and was raised in the church's orphanage. She hates demons with all her heart, and when she is in front of them her usual gentle smile crumbles, revealing an expression twisted with hatred.

characters.name: Ink Wreathcraft
characters.original: インク・リースクラフト
characters.description: A blind girl who [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Flum-Apricot) rescued. She claims to have run away from home... she is a very cheerful girl, and even though she is blind, she is always smiling. She also likes to play pranks.

characters.name: Dein Phineas
characters.original: デイン・フィニアース
characters.description: An A-rank adventurer from the West Ward. Taking advantage of the guild master's absence, he's taken control of the guild as if it were his own. A cold-hearted and cunning man, he will ruthlessly eliminate anyone who gets in his way, even women and children.

characters.name: Y'lla Jelicin
characters.description: A receptionist at the West Ward Adventurer's Guild. She's siding with [Dein's](https://anilist.co/character/379468/Dein-Phineas) faction to protect herself, but she doesn't seem very keen on it. She's cynical and foul-mouthed, but she's not quite a villain.

title: Shinmai Renkinjutsushi no Tenpo Keiei
title_original: 新米錬金術師の店舗経営
description: Orphaned Sarasa just graduated from the Royal Alchemist Academy, and that means her longed-for life of elegance and riches is close at hand! As a graduation gift, her teacher gifts her a house to set up shop — but Sarasa’s dilapidated new digs are beyond far-flung. What’s a novice alchemist to do when they're stuck in the middle of nowhere with a business to run and supplies to gather from a very dangerous natural world? Whether it’s facing down frightening fantasy creatures or finding creative ways to attract customers, Sarasa has her work cut out for her as she achieves her dream of becoming the greatest alchemist around! (Source: HIDIVE)

characters.name: Sarasa Feed
characters.description: Sarasa is the titular novice alchemist. She was orphaned at a young age and aims to be an alchemist just like her late parents. Although she originally had long hair, she cut it short. She is the disciple of the master class alchemist, Ophelia Millis.

characters.name: Kate Starven
characters.original: ケイト・スターヴェン

characters.name: Ophelia Millis
characters.description: She is a master class alchemist and Sarasa Feed's master.

title: Machikado Mazoku: 2-Choume
title_en: The Demon Girl Next Door Season 2
description: Shamiko, AKA Shadow Mistress Yuuko, aims to break the curse placed on her family by the Clan of Light. Along the way, she forms an unlikely allegiance with Momo, a rival from the Light Clan! They’ll need to work together to find another magical girl who’s gone mysteriously missing, and what this? There’s a dangerous force lurking somewhere in the city, plus Shamiko’s mysterious father might be closer than she thinks? (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Momo Chiyoda
characters.description: **Momo Chiyoda** is the magical girl who is protecting the town of Seiiki Sakuraga-oka. As a magical girl, she is a maniac of muscle training, and her physical power overwhelmingly surpasses that of her rival [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461), the succubus in town. Her magical girl career is mysterious, including rumors that she had once saved the world.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshida
characters.description: Yuuko Yoshida is a demon whose power is suddenly awakened in her first year of high school; aims to overthrow the magical girl in town to break her family's spell. However, although she has the ability to sneak into others' dreams, her physical strength and stamina are much weaker than the ones of her rival, the magical girl [Momo Chiyoda](https://anilist.co/character/141457).

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

characters.name: Mikan Hinatsuki
characters.description: **Mikan Hinatsuki** is a Magical Girl who arrives in town to support [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/141457). She suffers from a curse that brings misfortune to those close to her whenever she gets overly excited or anxious.

characters.name: Seiko Yoshida
characters.description: **Seiko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461) and [Ryouko](https://anilist.co/character/141462/Ryouko-Yoshida)'s mother.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: **Lilith** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s demon ancestor. She appears in her dreams one night and gives her demon powers, and tasks her on defeating a magical girl.

characters.name: Ryouko Yoshida
characters.description: **Ryouko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s younger sister. Ryouko's dream is to support her sister in becoming a fearsome demon.

characters.name: Anri Sata
characters.description: **Anri Sata** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Shion Ogura
characters.description: Shion Ogura is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Lico
characters.description: Lico is a fox demon that serves as the waitress and the chef for Asura Cafe.

characters.name: Shirosawa Tenchou
characters.description: Shirosawa is a tapir demon, and the owner of the Asura Cafe. He is the creator of the character mascot for the Tamasakura shopping street, Tamasakura-chan.

title: Aru Majo ga Shinu Made
description: On Meg’s seventeenth birthday, she learns that she only has one year left to live. Her mentor—the Eternal Witch, Faust—explains that she is cursed and the only way to save herself is to grow a seed of life using one thousand tears of joy. Of course, such tears aren’t easy to come by. As Meg begins her quest, she finds herself drawn into the lives of her friends and neighbors in ways she never imagined. By sharing their burdens and using her magic to comfort them, she learns how precious those moments of connection can be even in the face of death. (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Fine Cavendish
characters.original: フィーネ・キャベンディッシュ

title: Seiyuu Radio no Uraomote
title_original: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ
title_en: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
description: Yuuhi Yugure and Yasumi Utatane, high school classmates and co-hosts of a weekly radio program, paint a picture-perfect friendship for their listeners. Yet, in reality, they couldn’t be more different. Their off-air dynamic is a whirlwind of chaos and insults. As their tumultuous relationship unfolds, they navigate the turbulent waters of friendship and rivalry in the cutthroat realm of showbiz. (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Chika Watanabe
characters.description: She never talks to anyone in class, but when she does open her mouth, she’s incredibly sharp-tongued. An aggressive loner with piercing eyes peering out from behind her long bangs.

title: BIRDIE WING: Golf Girls' Story
description: The story centers on two young women golfers named Eve and Aoi Amawashi. The two come from completely different backgrounds, and have the completely opposite play styles, and together they will shake the world of golf. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Eve
characters.description: Eve is the main protagonist of the BIRDIE WING: Golf Girls' Story series. She is a survivor who made a living by betting on golf. Her struggling past resulted in a rough and powerful playing style. ~!In Part 2, it is revealed that Eve is the daughter of famed golfer Kazuhiko Amawashi and Elanor Burton, the daughter of the CEO of Arios, who both were victims of a tragic cruising accident which also resulted in Eve's amnesia!~

characters.name: Aoi Amawashi
characters.description: Aoi Amawashi is the daughter of the Tenwashi Group, one of the largest corporations in the world, and a thoroughbred in the golf world. Being the ace of the prestigious Raijin Girls’ Academy golf club, Aoi became known as the "Innocent Tyrant" as she enjoys golf and defeats her opponents with a sweet and innocent smile ~!In Part 2, it is reveled that Aoi's father is not famed golfer Kazuhiko Amawashi, but instead is Reiya Amuro, her coach. Aoi sadly seems to also have inherited Reiya's health problems, as she is seen to struggle with a form of fatigue like Reiya did.!~

characters.name: Reiya Amuro
characters.description: Reiya Amuro is the head coach of the golf team at Raijin Girls’ Academy. A former professional golfer who's pro career was cut short, Reiya manages the golf team and acts as Aoi's mentor as she progresses in her own pro career. He also brings Eve onto the team and teaches her to a degree. ~!In Season 2, it is revealed that Reiya is more than just Aoi's coach, he is also her biological father. In his last game as a professional golfer, where Reiya was playing for the right to marry his lover, fellow golfer Seira, a sudden physical illness forced him to drop out of the competition, causing him to lose both the tournament and Seira's hand to Kazuhiko Amawashi. Yet beforehand, he managed to get Seira pregnant with his kid, who would be Aoi. Kazuhiko found out about Reiya and Seira's kid, and agreed to raise Aoi as his own daughter, keeping the affair secret from the public. After hiding the

characters.name: Leo Millafoden
characters.original: レオ・ミラフォーデン
characters.description: Leo Millafoden is an underground golfer and Eve's golf coach for much of her childhood. Through Leo, Eve was able to learn how to use "Bullets", high-energy golf swings. Eventually, Leo left Eve on her own. ~!It is revealed that Leo also tutored Rose Aleon, Eve's main underground golf handler, but quit being her mentor when Rose continued to get herself further and further into the mob scene!~ ~!It is revealed in Season 2 that Leo was unbeatable, and only Kazuhiko Amawashi was able to defeat him in a match. Inspired by Kazuhiko's skills as a golfer, Leo made it his goal to combine Kazuhiko's and his skills into one golfer to create the greatest golfer. He found his opportunity upon discovering that Kazuhiko had a surviving daughter named "Eve", and sought her out in the hopes she inherited Kazuhiko's skills so that he could instill his techniques into her to achieve his goal!~

title: Aoi Hana
description: Fumi and Akira were close childhood friends until Fumi had to move away. Ten years after losing touch with each other, the two girls meet again as high school freshmen. The two struggle to reconnect after so much has changed, and both deal with the trials and tribulations of high school — sometimes independently and sometimes with each other’s help. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Fumi Manjoume
characters.description: A tall, dark haired, bespectacled girl. She is seen by other girls as being strong, refined and genteel, however they become surprised when they realise that Fumi is actually very gentle and shy. Others have noted her for having pretty eyes and a soft, lady-like voice. She is often said to make "scary faces" when she is upset or irked. Despite her size, mature aura and sometimes foreboding presence, Fumi is a reserved crybaby. After moving back to her home town, she makes fast friends with a girl from her youth: Okudaira Akira. Fumi used to live nearby to Akira growing up, and so they were best friends from the young ages of five or six. Fumi relied heavily on Akira in kindergarten, as she is seen incapable of doing anything but crying until Akira comes to "save" her and take care of her. This has not changed much as she got older, as noted by Akira. Fumi has had a cl

characters.name: Akira Okudaira
characters.description: Akira is optimistic and supportive, always comforting those who need her and searching for ways to solve other people's problems, despite knowing that it would be best not to get involved. She is easily embarrassed but is not shy or reserved, often taking a more aggressive stance against situations. She dislikes seeing people hurt and in her own little ways, tries to avert and avoid potential distress for others. She saves Fumi from a pervert on the train ride to school on their first day of high school. She walks a little way with the tall girl, and finds her to be elegant and gentle and wonders if she will ever see her again. She later expresses shock when it turns out that the girl she saved was none other than her childhood friend. Her mother and Fumi's mother are good friends, and so their relationship is rekindled after Manjoume Yoshie visits Okudaira Shouko, bringing Fum

characters.name: Kyouko Ikumi
characters.description: A polite, refined girl who has attended Fujigaya since elementary school. Many people come to her for advice as she has an air of maturity that they others do not possess; despite this, she has a fairly immature side to her that only those who are very close to her are allowed to see. She is the first friend Akira makes in the Academy. She is seen as a great beauty (described as "sexy" by Akira) and has the attention of girls even from the middle school. Kyouko however seems very disinterested in other people save for her friends and for her love interest, who Akira correctly guesses is another female. It is revealed that the person who Kyouko is in love with is Yasuko, with whom she shares a history. However, not only are Kyouko's feelings spurned, but she is also unenthusiastically engaged to her cousin Kou who she treats coldly as she says they are connected by "na

characters.name: Yasuko Sugimoto
characters.description: Yasuko is a popular third-year senior at Matsuoka Girl's High School. She is a cool upperclassman and the captain of the basketball team, though Fumi mistakes her for being in the Literature Club when they first meet. She has almost a star status in Matsuoka and Fujigaya (more so in Fujigaya). She insists on involving Fumi in her visits to Akira's school. Her initial reason was to pawn off the role of Heathcliff to Fumi who is almost as tall as she is, but Yasuko soon grows a deeper interest in her. After visiting Fujigaya Girls' Academy and rejecting Kyouko's confession, she asks Fumi out, who accepts. Yasuko enjoys the arts immensely, as she is shown being a very good artist, is an exceptional actor and reads profusely. Her accomplished aura could be a result of the subconscious conditioning she received as a child. Being the youngest Sugimoto sister, she often had

characters.name: Miwa Motegi
characters.description: Motegi is one of Fumi's friends at Matsuoka Girls' High School. She, Yōko and Misako appear to be long-time friends giving one another the nicknames Mogi, Pon-chan and Yassan respectively. She belongs to the very tiny Drama Club and seems to enjoy theatrics. ~! Mogi begins dating Akira's older brother Shinobu later on in the series after meeting him and spending time with him during a trip to Kyouko's villa during the summer.!~

characters.name: Misako Yasuda
characters.description: Misako is one of Fumi's friends at Matsuoka Girls' High School. She, Yōko and Motegi appear to be long-time friends giving one another the nicknames Yassan, Pon-chan and Mogi respectively. Yassan is very energetic and is known for having a scrappy appearance and bushy eyebrows.

characters.name: Shinobu Okudaira
characters.description: Shinobu is Akira's older brother who attends university. He is constantly worried about his sister, and often takes her places in his car, though Akira often gets very annoyed at how protective her brother is towards her. He is often seen giving up a lot of his free time following her around, much to the chagrin of both his sister and mother. He is often told by his mother that he needs to get his own life in order before he could be concerned about his sister's life. He however claims that his overprotective nature is not as bad as their father's. Despite forcefully volunteering to chaperone Akira and her friends around, he is exasperated by them. He finds the group of girls to be tiresome, save for Fumi, who is not as exicitable as the rest. He eventually comes to find out that Fumi is a lesbian through a conversation he has with Yasuko, which surprises him. He shows int

characters.name: Chizu Hanashiro
characters.description: Chizu is Fumi's older cousin. She is present to see Fumi off for her first day at school. It is implied that she was a large part of Fumi's life in her old town. She is seen (in flashback) spending time with Fumi in her younger teenage years, such as teaching Fumi how to cook. Despite Fumi's attempts to convince Chizu to spend more time with her in Kamakura, Chizu sombrely and apologetically declines, her motives for doing so becoming clear later on. It is revealed that Chizu and Fumi have had a deeper side to their relationship, however, she neglected telling Fumi that she was engaged to be married. The shocking news later causes Fumi to avoid her cousin, stating that she is cruel. She seems very flirtatious, as she often makes comments to make Fumi blush, and she has an air of mature feminine authority to her that her younger cousin latches on to; Fumi is palpable even t

characters.name: Kaori Ueno
characters.description: She is the President of the Literature Club in Matsuoka Girls' High School. She is on good terms with Fumi as the club is rather small; they are seen together reading books and having tea as part of the club's activities. She is a close school friend of Sugimoto Yasuko and is very aware of her popularity, often making fun of Yasuko being "Mr. Matsuoka-sama". She is seen to be very exasperated at Yasuko's presence in the club, as potential members usually leave to follow Yasuko in the basketball club.

characters.name: Sakiko Okudaira
characters.description: Okudaira Sakiko is the mother of Akira and Shinobu. She is long-time friends with Fumi's mother and the Manjoume family. Her relationship with Fumi's mother is rekindled when they move back, and she is rather excited to have her friend again. She has a very close relationship with both her children as she is seen joking around with them and having conversations with them regularly. However, she is also rather stern and blunt. Whenever Akira and Shinobu fight, one glare from her is enough to quieten them. She often has to tell Shinobu to get a life and leave Akira alone. Akiko was considered to be the "outlaw" of the family by Keiko, her very disapproving relative in Yokohama, whom she makes Akira go visit.

characters.name: Shinako Sugimoto
characters.description: Shinako is the eldest Sugimoto sister. She is straight-forward and very blunt, though extremely perceptive and easy-going. She seems to dislike conflict finding it dull and unnecessary, and is rarely ever surprised by people's actions. She appears to enjoy being amused at other people's expense. She is an alumna of Fujigaya Girls' Academy, and during her high school years, she was very well known. Through flashbacks from various characters, it is revealed that Shinako's nature had not changed very much from when she was a teenager. She does not care about people's sexual orientation and openly asks Fumi if she's a lesbian or bisexual when she first meets her. She has said herself that she had many "girlfriends" growing up, though this may be only due to her being bored rather than personal attraction to other women. She is an unrelenting flirt thou

characters.name: Kuri Sugimoto
characters.description: The third eldest Sugimoto sister. Kuri is a rather cynical and dry character. She is the only one in the family who does not spoil Yasuko by letting her do whatever she wants. She is very aware of Yasuko's selfish nature and is concerned about her sister's relationship with Fumi as she knows Yasuko will eventually hurt the younger girl. She enjoys smoking. Kuri also attended Fujigaya as did all the elder Sugimoto sisters. She was also subject to admiration from other girls though she never indulged any of them and ignored them for the most part. Her best friend was in love with her, but she never was privy to this. Kuri was also in love with Kagami, though nobody except Kazusa and Yasuko seemed to be fully aware of this. Yasuko eventually, out of spite, lets the cat out of the bag and eventually even Shinako finds out about it. Unlike Yasuko, she never told Kagami how he felt a

title: Slow Start
description: The story centers around 17-year-old Hana Ichinose, who unbeknownst to her classmates, was a year late in enrolling into high school. Although it may not seem like a big deal, it is a big deal to her. She wants to catch up with everyone else someday. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kamuri Sengoku
characters.description: A childlike girl whose physical development greatly lags behind her actual age. She is an old friend of Eiko from elementary school, whom she adores, and becomes timid around others whenever Eiko is absent. Whenever she is addressed with a sensitive topic, she somehow manages to twitch her hair ribbon as an expression of her feelings. Her main hobbies are eating and sleeping (the latter of which is perhaps the primary reason for her belated development), although she is an extremely fast runner at sports. Her name is derived from _kamuriwashi._

characters.name: Tamate Momochi
characters.description: A bubbly, cheerful girl from [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/124746/Ichinose-Hana)'s class who likes to be friends with everyone she meets. She likes to be called "Tama" because she does not like her full name's association with the word _tamatebako._

characters.name: Hana Ichinose
characters.description: The main protagonist of the series, who just recently moved and now attends the Hoshio Private Academy in her first year of high school. Because she caught mumps and thus had to miss out on her high school entry exams, she was forced to repeat her entire final middle school year. As a result, she is very self-conscious about her current standing and that she does not have anyone of her old school friends in her company, and is therefore very glad to build up an immediate friendship with Eiko, Kamuri and Tamate.

characters.name: Eiko Tokura
characters.description: A tall, gentle, and level-headed girl with a natural charisma which has made her very popular with her peers without any effort.

characters.name: Shion Kyouzuka
characters.description: Hana's adult cousin and the landlady of a boarding house, where Hana resides for the duration of her high school period. She is pretty and extremely well-endowed, but behaves more like a teenager than an adult woman. Her favorite hobby is taking a close interest in Hana's private life.

characters.name: Kiyose Enami
characters.description: Hana's homeroom teacher, who summons up very little enthusiasm for her job.

characters.name: Hiroe Hannen
characters.description: A resident of the apartment building Hana and Shion live in. After an experience not dissimilar to Hana's led her to miss her university exams, the guilt of lying to her peers caused her to become a shut-in. She soon starts to become more confident after meeting Hana and is one of the few people who knows about her situation.

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon S: Mini Dra
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴンＳミニドラ
title_en: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S: Miniature Dragon
description: Short animations streamed on Kyoto Animation's YouTube channel in the lead up to the July 7 premiere of the second season. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: This entry's total count includes episodes 1-13 + the 3 SP episodes that released during the second season's run.

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly.
