Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Josei Kyoushi
characters.description: Kanna and Riko's teacher.

title: mono
description: Satsuki Amamiya was feeling down due to the graduation of the high school Photography Club’s president. However, her best friend and fellow member An Kiriyama encourages Satsuki to dedicate herself to the newly merged Cinephoto Club. Join Satsuki and An as they set out to track down a missing camera, meet new faces, and capture stunning photos and videos along the way. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Satsuki Amamiya
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm (5′1″) **Camera:** 360° camera A girl who adored her senpai so much that she joined her Photography Club. Unfortunately, after her senpai's graduation, Satsuki was left in ruins, until she finally made the initiative to buy not just a camera -- but one that captures the world in 360-degrees!

characters.name: An Kiriyama
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4′11″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera An loves "Sacchan" (Satsuki) so much that she also joined the Photography Club. Her personal camera is a small, but tough-bodied action cam.

characters.name: Sakurako Shikishima
characters.description: **Height:** 145 cm (4′9″) **Camera:** Smartphone The president of the Cinema Studies Club. When all the senior students graduated, she was left behind (alongside fellow member "Ms. Tajima"), and like the Photo Club, Sakurako's club is on the verge of being completely dismantled.

characters.name: Haruno Akiyama
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) **Camera:** Smartphone A 4-koma manga artist, using the pen name "Akino", and was a few steps shy of becoming a full-blown NEET. Lives with her grandmother who runs a cheap sweets shop.

characters.name: Kako Komada
characters.description: **Height:** 175 cm (5′9″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera Kako is a motorcyclist who is into "motovlogging", often recording her scenic rides for people to watch on the Internet on WeTube — her "ISERIDER" account contains multi-part touring videos that might average 20,000 views.

characters.name: Taishou
characters.description: Taishou is a lively cat wandering around the city. Taishou is Haruno's cat.

characters.name: Torayo Kurokuma
characters.description: Famous horror manga artist. She lives in a famous shrine and loves cats

characters.name: Fuuka Inomata
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) She is an alumnus and actress of the old Cinema Club.

characters.name: Rin Shima
characters.description: A solo camper who started camping due to her grandfather’s influence. She experiences camping with another person for the first time when she meets [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Kagamihara-Nadeshiko). She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she worries about Nadeshiko a bit.

characters.name: Chiaki Oogaki
characters.description: A bright and active person, in charge of choosing the camping spots and gear. She’s lively and cheerful, but is also full of emotion and easily brought to tears. Wanting to camp, she forms the outdoor crew with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/124577). (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Aoi Inuyama
characters.description: A gentle girl who speaks with a Kansai accent. Of the reckless outdoor crew members, Aoi is like the secret leader who looks out for everyone during important times. She’s called 'Inuko' by [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/124578). (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Akari Inuyama
characters.description: Younger sister of [Aoi Inuyama](https://anilist.co/character/124577/).

title: Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu!
title_original: 私の百合はお仕事です！
description: Worried about her reputation, Hime covers shifts for a cafe manager she accidentally injures to maintain her picture-perfect princess image. But this cafe has a peculiar theme—private school. To put on her best barista schoolgirl act, she’ll be trained by the most graceful girl there, Mitsuki. Under her guidance, Hime’s feelings start to brew, but there’s just one problem—Mitsuki can’t stand her! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Hime Shiraki
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm A first-year high school student. A liar who is "loved by everyone" and keeps up a facade of friendliness with nearly everyone she meets. She rarely lets down her guard, even to those who know her true face. Hopes to marry rich. Plays the role of an innocent kohai and Mitsuki's "little sister" at the cafe.

characters.name: Mitsuki Ayanokouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 171cm A first year high school student. A serious girl who has social anxiety and difficulty understanding people's emotions. Cares about the integrity of the salon. Plays the role of a kind upperclassman at the cafe, and is Hime's reliable "big sister."

characters.name: Sumika Chibana
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm A third year high school student. Dresses like a gyaru outside of work. Cares a lot about workplace harmony and dislikes seeing her coworkers get hurt because of romance. Plays the role of a cool, bespectacled upperclassman in the cafe, and is ~! Kanoko's "elder sister." !~

characters.name: Nene Nishidera
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm Kitchen staff for the cafe. ~!Formerly worked out front as Sumika's "little sister", but after a complicated romance bloomed between her and another previous employee she came to work behind the scenes.!~

characters.name: Mai Koshiba
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm The manager of Liebe who suffered an arm injury. Plays the role of a kohai character who also serves as the cafe's mascot. Watches over the staff as a mature adult, despite her childlike appearance.

characters.name: Kanoko Mamiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm A first year high school student and Hime's best friend. Is fiercly protective of Hime and has romantic feelings for her, which she doesn't want to see returned. Comes across as soft-spoken, but is actually very blunt. Plays the role of a shy kohai and Sumika's "little sister" at the cafe. Usually wears glasses, except while playing her Liebe character.

characters.name: Youko Goto
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm ~!A former Liebe employee who disrupted the work environment due to her relationship with [Nene](https://anilist.co/character/253967/Nishidera-Nene). She played the role of a seductive, wicked older sister character.!~

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon: Samishigariya no Ryuu
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン さみしがりやの竜
title_en: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: A lonely dragon wants to be loved
description: "I don’t want to let go of her hand. Because, we are a family." Miss Kobayashi, Tohru, Kanna, and Iruru's peaceful lives are shattered when Kanna’s father, Kamun Kamui, leader of the Chaos Forces, arrives and forces her to return to the Dragon World to fix a past mistake. With a war brewing between Chaos and Harmony, Kanna must find a way to unite the two worlds but is torn between her loyalty to her friends and her father's demands. Miss Kobayashi, however, refuses to let her go and tries to mend Kanna and Kamui’s broken bond. As dragons clash, Iruru uncovers a hidden force manipulating the war. Can they stop the war before it consumes both worlds? (Source: Kyoto Animation YouTube Channel, Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Kimun Kamui
characters.description: Kimun Kamui is the father of Kanna Kamui In his human form, Kimun is a large set man with black hair. While in his dragon form he takes on a large, bear-shaped appearance, with two horns coming out the top of his head.

title: SHOW BY ROCK!!
description: Metropolis of music, MIDICITY. A kitty girl wearing gothic lolita clothing named Cyan is scouted by Maple Arisugawa, the president of a music agency. From there, she meets Chuchu (a pun off of the sound that rabbits make) the honor student rabbit girl, a net geek dog girl named Retoree (from "Retriever"), and an alien sheep (?) girl named Moa. Together, they form the band named "Plasmagica," and aim for the top of the world. However, the path there is long and tough, and keeping in high spirits is important. By battling against other strange bands, Plasmagica slowly grows toward a top-grade band. In the end, they'll be a band that becomes the driving force of MIDICITY's music industry... Maybe? Gonna be a music millionaire! (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Retoree
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Bass A girl from the Dog Tribe who is a total internet otaku and smartphone addict. She usually puts on a cool facade, but deep down, she is incredibly shy. Whenever a topic she’s passionate about comes up, she gets so excited that she starts talking a mile a minute. Online, however, she’s quite the barker. She has an aversion to "normies" (people with active social lives) and clothing store clerks.

characters.name: Moa
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Drums A naturally eccentric, high-energy space-sheep girl who arrived from a distant galaxy on a research mission. Her musical sensibilities are truly cosmic—unrivaled among the group members. She has a habit of blurting out whatever crosses her mind, which occasionally lands her bandmates in trouble. Her signature verbal tic—ending her sentences with "pyuru"—is apparently a communication code from her home planet.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A rabbit-girl who embodies the "beloved class president" archetype: an honor student who is both dependable and organized, as well as sociable and charming. She serves as the de facto leader of the band and enjoys the deep trust of her fellow members. However, she also possesses an ambitious streak—secretly, and without the other members' knowledge, she is aiming to make a solo debut. She practices the guitar without fail every single day and takes a very earnest approach to her music.

characters.name: Cyan Hijirikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A cat girl who cherishes a heart-shaped guitar known as [Strawberry Heart](https://anilist.co/character/153391/Strawberry-Heart)—a legendary instrument rumored to possess extraordinary power. Her guitar talent was recognized by [Maple Arisugawa](https://anilist.co/character/153403/Maple-Arisugawa), leading to her recruitment as a member of Plasmagica. Through her band activities alongside [Chuchu](https://anilist.co/character/88975/Chuchu), [Retoree](https://anilist.co/character/88973/Retoree), and [Moa](https://anilist.co/character/88974/Moa), she continues to grow and mature.

characters.name: Crow
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm __Species:__ Hedgehog __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar Fearless and utterly convinced—without a shred of doubt—that he is "the coolest and most popular guy in the world." His signature style features a raw yet razor-sharp vocal delivery that sends shivers down the spines of listeners. He hails from a dairy farming family and absolutely loves milk.

characters.name: Aion
characters.description: __Height:__ 192 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Guitar He has a suspicious demeanor and cannot speak articulately unless he strikes a specific pose—yet, he is incredibly handsome. He is rumored to captivate his female fans with the genius-level guitar technique he displays during live performances.

characters.name: Yaiba
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Bass He respects the spirit of rock and the way of the samurai. His self-proclaimed bass technique is top-notch.

characters.name: Rom
characters.description: __Height:__ 186 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Drums The band's leader, he possesses a fiery personality—one where his fists tend to fly before his words—and serves as the driving force that holds the members together. He successfully balances his career as a company employee with his band activities.

characters.name: Strawberry Heart
characters.description: A sentient instrument that Cyan obtains in her mobile game. It resembles a guitar with a heart-shaped design, and is one of the Legendary Instruments. Serving as Cyan's instructor in Midi City, it gives her advice on how to defeat the dark monsters.

characters.name: Holmy
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Group:__ Criticrista __Position:__ Vocals and Bass A female bassist of the Holstein Cow Tribe. She serves as the Student Council President. Upon entering MIDI City Academy, she was an inconspicuous student with unremarkable grades; however, fueled by a passion for music second to none, she successfully survived the legendary "Hellish Training" rumored to take place beneath the academy—a feat that earned her admission into the Special Performing Arts Department. Earnest and prone to worrying, she is a long-suffering individual who constantly finds herself at the mercy of her free-spirited bandmates.

characters.name: Tsukino
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm __Group:__ Criticrista __Position:__ Vocals and Keyboard A female keyboardist belonging to the Asiatic Black Bear tribe. She serves on the Beautification Committee within the Student Council. Having lived deep in the mountains prior to transferring to MIDI Girls' Academy, she is somewhat naive and unaccustomed to the ways of the world. Armed with perfect pitch—honed amidst the great outdoors—and superhuman strength, she elevates the band's melodies to a level of exceptional quality. Whenever she appears to be spacing out, she is almost certainly thinking about food.

characters.name: Jacqueline
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Group:__ Criticrista __Position:__ Vocals and Drums A female drummer of the Tadpole Tribe. She serves as the Vice President of the Student Council. Possessing a bright, energetic, and kind-hearted nature, she is deeply trusted by her fellow members. She is exceptionally athletic and tends to act on pure instinct. While her skin is typically smooth and supple, if it begins to dry out, her personality undergoes a sudden, drastic transformation into one that is gloomy and withdrawn. She harbors a deep longing for the kind of mature romance experienced by adult frogs.

title: Kemono Friends
description: The anime's story takes place in Japari Park, a "gigantic integrated zoo." In the zoo, due to the mysterious "sand star" substance, the animals start turning into human-shaped creatures called Animal Girls. Japari Park is a place where many people visit and have fun at, but one day a lost child wanders into the park. The lost child starts a journey to return, but because so many Animal Girls join in on the quest it becomes an unexpected grand adventure. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kaban
characters.description: A young girl who finds herself in Japari Park with no memory of who she is or where she comes from. Named by Serval due to the backpack she carries (kaban meaning bag). Shy yet resourceful, she travels through Japari Park along with Serval to find out her identity while encountering more Friends along the way, eventually discovering that she is a human.

characters.name: Serval
characters.description: A serval cat Friend originally from the Savannah Area of Japari Park. She is the first friend to meet Kaban, eager to journey with her in the search for her identity. Energetic and curious, Serval is often amazed by the skills and talents of Kaban and the Friends they encounter on their journey. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Lucky Beast
characters.description: A small, robotic creature also referred to as "Boss" by the Friends. While he does not respond to the Friends themselves, he will directly answer questions and statements made by Kaban, providing information on Japari Park, Friends, and needed items when trouble arises. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Africa Tategamiyamaarashi
characters.original: アフリカタテガミヤマアラシ

title: Top wo Nerae 2! DIEBUSTER
description: While Gunbuster's final mission destroyed the space monsters' star system, the intergalactic war still continues. Earth's only hope lies in the hands of "TOPLESS", an elite mecha group with children possessing supernatural powers and new Buster Machines. Among their ranks is a rookie named Nono and the ace pilot Lal'C - whom Nono looks at as a "big sister". Together with their teammates Nicholas and Chiko they must aim for the top and protect all of mankind from the wrath of the space monsters. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nono
characters.description: Hailing from a rural community in the Martian countryside, Nono is a simple and clumsy girl with a big dream: she wants to be a space pilot. And not just any space pilot, but one to rival 'Nono-Riri'. Of course, dreaming of being a pilot and actually becoming one are two entirely different things, as she soon finds out upon reaching the city. Even after landing a somewhat dead-end job as a waitress in one of the city's bars, Nono stubbornly holds on to her ideals, despite the chiding of her boss and the bar's regular patrons. Her persistence pays off, however, when she encounters a real space pilot in the person of [Lal'C Melk Mal](https://anilist.co/character/3887/Mark-Melk-LalC), member of the elite Fraternity and current pilot of Buster Machine Dix-Neuf. It is through Lal'C (whom she impulsively dubs her Oné-sama, or big sister) that Nono finally finds the means to make her dre

characters.name: Lal'C Mark
characters.original: ラルク・メルク・マール
characters.description: The current holder of the top kill score among Topless pilots, Lal'C, along with fellow pilots Nicola and Tycho, is part of the so-called "Idol" group (pilots with exceptionally high kill rates). She is also the current pilot of Buster Machine Dix-Neuf, the oldest buster machine still in operation. Nicknamed "princess" by her teammates, Lal'C is outwardly cool and self-confident -- traits that draw Nono's admiration for her, much to her initial annoyance. It is Lal'C who helps induct Nono (with some indirect assistance from Nicola) into the Fraternity as an "auxiliary member", despite the fact that Nono manifests none of the traits associated with being a Topless. While initially bothered by Nono's hero-worship of her, Lal'C gradually gets used to her company, to the point where she can talk about things she wouldn't normally tell anyone. She senses some potential in Nono, and admires th

characters.name: Tycho Science
characters.description: The final member of the 'Idol' team, Tycho is brash, impulsive, and utterly determined (at least in the beginning) to best Lal'C's long-standing kill record, seeing it as a chance to wipe the normally smug look off the face of the teacher's pet(another of Lal'C's nicknames among the members of the Fraternity). She has a low opinion of Topless in general (despite the fact that she's a Topless herself) due to an event in her childhood where -- in spite of her powers -- she was unable to cure the illness of a close friend, and is annoyed by Nono's constant attempts to prove herself worthy to become a Buster Machine pilot. Ironically, it is Nono who later helps her change her way of thinking for the better. While it isn't outwardly implied, the two become friends, though not on the same level as Nono and Lal'C. ~!Initially Tycho pilots t

characters.name: Nicola Vacheron
characters.description: The only male member of the 'Idol' team, Nicola is the pilot of Buster Machine Vingt-Sept and, before Lal'C's inclusion into the ranks of the Topless, was considered one of the most powerful Topless of his generation. He is Lal'C's inspiration (in as much as Lal'C is Nono's inspiration), and seems to have a relationship with her, though it is debatable whether it is of a romantic nature or not. He is interested in Nono and sees potential in her to be a Buster Machine pilot, despite the fact that Nono has never manifested any kind of Topless reaction (something that, according to their minder Casio, may not be possible in artificial beings), and secretly helps Nono join the Fraternity under the premise of being an 'auxiliary' member. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Casio Takashiro
characters.description: The only adult member of the 'Idol' team, Casio is their guardian, technician, and confidant rolled into one. A former Topless himself (he was a pilot of Dix-Neuf before Lal'C joined the Fraternity), Casio possesses an intimate understanding of the workings of the Buster Machines, as well as the people forced to pilot them. That is part of why he was one of the first to express his doubts on Nicola's assertion that Nono had the potential to become a pilot. Despite his initial misgivings, however, he joins Lal'C in welcoming Nono into their 'team'. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Pashika Pesuka Perushikumu
characters.original: パシカ・ペスカ・ペルシクム

title: Hoshikuzu Telepath
description: Konohoshi Umika is a high-schooler who is very bad at communicating with others. Feeling almost like an alien trapped on Earth with nowhere to belong, one day she meets a girl who claims to be an actual alien!

characters.name: Umika Konohoshi
characters.description: She is a first-year student of Fujino Misaki High School who was unable to make friends due to extreme fright, and she was escaping from reality, thinking that she could express her feelings to aliens living on planets other than Earth. She is extremely frightened and unable to communicate well with others. After meeting [Yu](https://anilist.co/character/300088/Yuu-Akeuchi), they set a goal to build a rocket to reach the stars in space. Her special skill is swimming.

characters.name: Yuu Akeuchi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Yuu is [Umika's](https://anilist.co/character/288810/Umika-Konohoshi) classmate and a self-proclaimed alien. She has a telepathic ability called "Odekopathy", which allows her to read the thoughts of others by matching her forehead with theirs. She has an abysmal optimism and a bright personality, and she instantly melts away the anxiety and tension of others. She also tends to hate steady effort and studying. With her natural cheerfulness and energy, she can easily open up to her new classmates. Due to a spaceship malfunction, she crash-landed on Earth and possesses a diary written in cosmic language.

characters.name: Honami Konohoshi
characters.description: Honami is Umika's younger sister.

characters.name: Akane Emihara
characters.description: Emihara-sensei is the homeroom teacher of Umika and her friends.

title: Bocchi the Rock! Re:
description: Compilation film of Bocchi the Rock! featuring new animation intro footage. The first of the Bocchi compilation movie duology.

characters.name: Hitori Gotou
characters.description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

characters.name: Nijika Ijichi
characters.description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

characters.name: Ryou Yamada
characters.description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

characters.name: Ikuyo Kita
characters.description: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

characters.name: Seika Ijichi
characters.description: Nijika's older sister and manager of the live house "STARRY".

characters.name: PA-san
characters.description: __Height:__ 162cm Mysterious looking female PA engineer with a mouth piercing. In her private life, she is active as a virtual Youtuber under the name "Otogi Alto" producing gameplay videos.

characters.name: Jimihen
characters.description: The Gotou family dog.

characters.name: Naoki Gotou
characters.description: Hitori and Futari's father.

characters.name: Michiyo Gotou
characters.description: Hitori and Futari's mother.

characters.name: Futari Gotou
characters.description: Hitori's younger sister.

title: Saki
description: Miyanaga Saki is a first year high school girl whose family would get angry if she won the family mahjong games. But losing would also have its consequences. Because of this she develops a new way of playing that allows her to stay on the thin line between winning and losing, the plus/minus zero score, an almost impossible score. In a game that relies mainly on luck, the plus/minus zero score is harder than winning, but Saki can achieve this every time. Having always hated the game, her friend from middle school, Suga Kyotoro, forces her to play in the schools mahjong club. Her developed skill and superhuman luck has made her a worthy mahjong opponent, even to the middle school's national mahjong champion. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: __Position:__ Vanguard Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Kyoutarou Suga
characters.description: A first year student and one of the new recruits for the Kiyosumi Mahjong club, but is not as talented as the rest of the members due to the fact that he is new to the game. As such, he is sent to perform menial tasks more than actually practice. He is attracted to Nodoka due to her physique but so far these feelings are unrequited by Nodoka. He is constantly abused by Yuuki but pays no attention to her pranking ways. He is close with Saki since he has known her since Middle School, but tends to use her to get small things, such as a Ladies' Lunch. Nonetheless, he cares for all of his fellow club members and most likely doesn't mind helping them out, despite being harassed by most of the members.

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutenant A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name. A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most, ~!the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.!~ Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: __Position:__ Sergeant A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

characters.name: Mihoko Fukuji
characters.description: A third year student serving as the Captain of the Kazekoshi Mahjong Club as well as being the team's ace player. She has a very kind nature, being nice to everyone she meets regardless of who they may be; her kindness extends even to the point where she offers Yuuki, an opposing player from the contending school team, Kiyosumi, her bento so that she would calm down. She even becomes very teary when her teammates help her out, as she feels that it was her fault that her teammates had to work in her place because it was her responsibility. She has been revealed to be very ineffective when working with technology. ~!She keeps her right eye closed to hide her heterochromia from others; while her left eye is reddish-gold, her right eye is actually sapphire blue. She never opens her right eye unless confronted with a dire situation during a Mahjong game. With both eyes open, she is shown to a

characters.name: Koromo Amae
characters.description: Premier member of the reigning champion Mahjong team, Ryuumonbuchi, and one of the most idolized yet feared players in the game. She is said to be possessed by a demon when playing; she even outranked a professional Mahjong player at a previous tournament. She is also the key player that brings an end to Kazekoshi's winning streak. She has a bad habit of wanting to crush her opponent's pride. ~!Her mahjong playing style pressures her opponents and her abilities can prevent them from reaching tenpai. This, together with the mahjong move she favors most, Haitei Raoyue or "last tile win" is a combination that slowly drives her opponents into despair. Haitei Raoyue's literal meaning is "to scoop up the moon from the seabed." Her abilities include being able sense when her opponents are in tenpai and the approximate value of their hands. She usually goes for big hands.!~ She is Touka's cousin

characters.name: Jun Inoue
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Plays the game by reading the flow and manipulating it. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 井丿上惇 instead

characters.name: Tomoki Sawamura
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 澤村智貴 instead

characters.name: Hajime Kunihiro
characters.description: Hajime is a 2nd year student at Ryuumonbuchi High School and is Touka's personal maid. A level-headed cool girl, she, according to Touka, is a strong mahjong player, capable of accomplishing almost anything that she sets her mind to: indeed, Hajime is a proven skilled player, capable of beating any regular player save the "monster" players, such as Saki, Koromo, and Takei. In the past, Hajime used lived with her Father, both of whom who struggled to make a living working as magicians: it is because of this occupation that Hajime is skilled in performing magic tricks, in particular, the "sleight-of-hand" trick, which she used when she played for her school team when she was younger: Hajime utilized her magician skills to make an illegal move, seemingly winning the game for her team. However, later investigations revealed the violation, causing Hajime's team to lose and Hajime herself to q

characters.name: Touka Ryuumonbuchi
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Comes from a very rich family and loves being in the spotlight which leads her to hate Nodoka because of her popularity as the middle school champion. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 龍円渕透火 instead

title: BIKINI WARRIORS
title_original: ビキニ・ウォリアーズ
description: Set in a an RPG-style world with swords and magic where adventurers form a party to challenge the demon king's right to rule, adventurers all have beautiful breasts, enormous breasts, and bikini armor!! (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Mage
characters.description: The youngest and most timid member of the adventure party, the Mage is a petite purple-haired girl skilled in the art of sorcery.

characters.name: Paladin
characters.description: A beautiful blonde woman who (most unbecoming to her vocation) harbors closeted sexual desires.

characters.name: Dark Elf
characters.description: A member of the Dark Elf race who assists the party with a versatile combination of combat and magic-using skills. Initially quite haughty when she first joined, she has shed much of her attitude as the four of them have kept adventuring together.

characters.name: Fighter
characters.description: A redhaired, somewhat impulsive and stubborn woman, and the party's leader. She is also the daughter of a legendary warrior who saved the country in the past.

characters.name: Hunter
characters.description: A survivalist with horrible cooking skills who becomes a very close partner of Valkyrie.

characters.name: Valkyrie
characters.description: A lady of noble birth who has decided to dedicate her life to fighting evil. Valkyrie is very arrogant and tsundere in nature.

title: Centaur no Nayami
description: Himeno is a sweet, shy girl, who struggles with the high school life. The difference is she's a centaur; but she's not alone. In fact, all of her classmates are supernatural creatures, sporting horns, wings, tails, halos, or some other unearthly body appendage. Yet despite their fantastical natures, Himeno and her best friends are down-to-earth, fun-loving teenagers who grapple with issues of life and love. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Manami Mitama
characters.description: Race: angel/cat-man Appearance: angel Mother: angel Father: cat-man (specific species name unknown. Because of his appearance, cat-man used as a alternative name). Sisters (oldest to youngest): Chigusa, Chinami, Chiho, Suetsumi She is the class president of Nozomi's class. Her family runs a shrine and she works part-time as a shrine maiden. She has four sisters all younger than her own. The first three younger sisters are triplets and have the appearance of cat-man, despite being half-angel like Manami. The youngest sister has the appearance of both angel and and her father's species. Unlike Manami, Suetsumi does not have a halo. The halo of angels is not magical in any way. As a matter of fact, it is a hair decorated in a circular shape to promote the angel's culture, similar to how Christians wears crucifixes.

characters.name: Shino
characters.description: Himeno's cousin who is in kindergarten. She loves Himeno very much.

characters.name: Sasusasusuru Quetzalcoatl
characters.original: ケツァルコアトル・サスサススール
characters.description: A foreign exchange student from Antarctica who resembles a snake. Since her race has a logical way of thinking, she feels like an alien within Japanese culture, but she is gentle, friendly and adaptable.

characters.name: Mitsuyo Akechi
characters.description: A ram-horned girl who has a cheeky personality. She is a lesbian who is in a relationship with Inukai, but enjoys teasing other girls too.

characters.name: Inukai
characters.description: An alicorn-horned girl and Mitsuyo's girlfriend.

title: ViVid Strike!
description: Raised up in the same orphanage, Fuuka and Rinne were once close friends but parted ways after a quarrel ended up with Rinne overwhelming Fuuka with her martial art skills. Fuuka lived a life of poverty after leaving the orphanage but an accidental encounter with renowned martial arts champion Einhard Stratos leads to the discovery of Fuuka's hidden talent in fighting. Einhard offers Fuuka a job and through her coaching and encouragement, she is set to meet Rinne again, in the ring.

characters.name: Rinne Berlinetta
characters.original: リンネ・ベルリネッタ
characters.description: She is a character first introduced in and the main protagonist of ViVid Strike! alongside Fuka Reventon.

characters.name: Fuuka Reventon
characters.original: フーカ・レヴェントン
characters.description: She is a character first introduced in and the main protagonist of ViVid Strike! alongside Rinne Berlinetta. She becomes a part-time staff of Nakajima Gym after encountering Einhard Stratos.

characters.name: Lutecia Alpine
characters.original: ルーテシア・アルピーノ
characters.description: A Belkan Bug Summoner. Lutecia travels with Zest and Agito. The 3 works with Scaglietti on getting Relics, but Lutecia is only of the 3 that trusts Scaglietti and his Numbers. Zest and Agito have tried to convince that Scaglietti isn't worth trusting, but have been unsuccessful as Lutecia views Scaglietti as a kind man. Because of her trusting attitude, Scaglietti has been able to manipulate her actions to an extent. She and Zest have been referred to on one occasion as Relic Weapon Experiments by Scaglietti. And as it turns out, she and Zest have been searching for very specific Relics, Lutecia specifically in search of Relic number 11. ~!As revealed in Episode 24, she is the daughter of Megane Alpine, who was involved in the Combat Cyborg incident where Zest was presumed to have been killed. In the Epilogue she is seen living with her mother. She is named for the Renault Lutecia,

characters.name: Vivio Takamachi
characters.description: (StrikerS), 10 (ViVid) __Eye color:__ Green & Brownish red __Hair color:__ Golden Blond __Handedness:__ Right __Intelligent Device:__ Sacred Heart aka Cris After being found by Caro and Erio during their break, she was taken into Nanoha and Fate's care. Her most visible feature is heterochromia. Quattro has referred to her as the "Vessel of the Saints". Also has Nanoha as her mother and Fate as her step-mother who is really her Godmother.

characters.name: Nove
characters.description: Still a fairly recently born Number by the time of StrikerS, Nove is an offensive-type fighter with a combat style that focuses in high-speed movement and kicking attacks. A bad-mouthed, constantly upset character among the Numbers she is the one who possesses the greatest combat potential when it comes to ground-based engagements. As a result of being put under Cinque's care right after her completion, Nove developed great love and care towards the eye-patched Number. She cannot oppose Cinque or Sein due to their natural kindness towards the younger Numbers and usually acts in a banter fashion towards her other sisters. ~!In episode 23, she (along with Wendi and Deed) was captured upon losing a three-on-one battle against Teana.!~ (Source: Wikipedia) In Sound Stage x: ~!Nove, along with Wendi, Dieci, and Cinque, is adopted by Genya Nakajima into the Nakajima family.!~

characters.name: Einhart Stratos
characters.original: ハイデイ・E・S・イングヴアルト / アインハート・ストゥラトス
characters.description: A user of Kaiser Arts that has given herself the name of the previous Sankt Kaiser. She picked street fights in order to prove that Hegemon's strength is the greatest of all Belkan warriors, . Like Vivio, she has a child form and an adult form, though the latter is taxing on her mind, and she also has heterochromia. Her true identity is discovered by Nove and the Nakajimas, who decide to help her better understand everyone and become acquainted with Vivio. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Ixpellia
characters.description: A contemporary of the Sankt Kaiser, who has been in stasis since that era. She is discovered and rescued by Subaru during the Sound Stage X radio drama, and befriends Vivio. She has been asleep since then and later appears in ViVid. Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Rio Wezley
characters.description: **Intelligent Device:** [Solfège](https://anilist.co/character/220248/Solfge) (ソルフェージュ) One of [Vivio](https://anilist.co/character/4174/Vivio-Takamachi)'s best friends. Like Vivio, she attends St. Hilde Academy of Magic in Midchilda. Specialized in a mix of martial arts and close combat magic.

characters.name: Corona Timir
characters.description: (ViVid) Eye color: Light Blue Hair color: Light Brown Intelligent Device: Brunzell Vivio's best friend. She frequently studies and has a unique magic ability; she is a Golem Summoner.

characters.name: Chantez Apinion
characters.original: シャンテ・アピニオン
characters.description: She is a character first introduced in Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha ViVid. She is a sister and a Church Knight of the Saint Church, being an apprentice of Schach Nouera and a fellow of Sein.

characters.name: Fabia Crozelg
characters.original: ファビア・クロゼルグ
characters.description: Fabia is not a mage but a True Witch. Her Device is the Witch Broom "Hell Gazer", and her special skills are Devil Tamer and Enchant Curse.

characters.name: Megane Alpine
characters.original: メガーヌ・アルピーノ
characters.description: The mother of Lutecia Alpine. She once worked with Zest Grangaitz and Quint Nakajima investigating an incident involving Combat Cyborgs. However, she was overpowered, and then captured. After the IS incident, she is freed from her stasis and currently under rehabilitation, spending time with her daughter. Named for the Renault Mégane and the Renault-bought Alpine brand. -Wikipedia-

title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston
title_original: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン
description: A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden! (Source: J-Novel Club)

characters.name: Nia Liston
characters.description: A young lady of the Liston family. Although she died of illness at a tender age, she was resurrected via a forbidden ritual; outwardly, she appears to be a charming young noblewoman. However, the soul inhabiting her body is that of a warrior once hailed as a "God-Slaying Hero"—a spirit that still craves life-or-death battles against formidable foes. Aiming to popularize her family's business—"magic imagery"—she appears on broadcasts and becomes an idol?

characters.name: Neil Liston
characters.description: [Nia's](https://anilist.co/character/325674) older brother.

characters.name: Lynokis Funk
characters.description: [Nia's](https://anilist.co/character/325674) attendant.

characters.name: Lynette Blanc
characters.description: [Neal's](https://anilist.co/character/325675) attendant.

characters.name: Hildetaura Altoire
characters.original: ヒルデトーラ・アルトワール
characters.description: The third princess of the Kingdom of Altoir. Although a member of the royal family, she is a star talent with the Royal Capital Broadcasting Station, and her catchphrase is “A Princess You Can Actually Meet.” She invites the new students, [Nia](https://anilist.co/character/325674/Liston-Nia) and [Relia](https://anilist.co/character/405064/Silver-Reliared), and the three of them work together to promote magical videos. Despite her young age, she also has an ambitious side, aiming to conquer the world through magical videos.

characters.name: Reliared Silver
characters.original: レリアレッド・シルヴァー
characters.description: The youngest daughter of the Silver family. She is a popular TV personality at the Silver Domain Broadcasting Station, beloved for her age-appropriate, straightforward, and lively personality. She views [Nia](https://anilist.co/character/325674/Liston-Nia)—who is the same age and in a similar position—as a rival, though she is sometimes exasperated by Nia’s wild antics. She ends up working alongside Nia and [Hilde](https://anilist.co/character/405063/Altoir-Hildetora) to promote magical videos.

characters.name: Bendelio
characters.description: The production manager for the Liston Territory Channel and the host of the program *Tales of the Liston Territory*. Viewers often remark that he spends his time on location doing nothing but drinking, and he is known for his persistent, cloying smile. He also has a tendency to foist grueling filming schedules onto Nia.

characters.name: Anzel
characters.description: A hired bodyguard in the criminal underworld. Confident in his combat skills and adept at using magic weapons, he challenges Nia to a fight under his boss's orders. He is a heavy smoker with a cold, rational mindset.

characters.name: Sharro White
characters.description: A promising young actress with the theater troupe "Ice Rose." Although she lands her long-awaited first starring role, her intense passion for the stage causes her to overreach and stumble. She also struggles to be open and honest, at times harshly critiquing Nia, her co-star.

characters.name: Fressa
characters.description: An underworld bodyguard and an assassin who employs concealed weapons hidden all over her body. She also works as a waitress at the tavern "The Dim Shadow-Rat Inn." Nia has remarked that she wears surprisingly cute underwear.

characters.name: Gandolf Rogen
characters.original: ガンドルフ ・ローゲン
characters.description: A muscular and earnest martial artist who passionately instructs students at the Artoire Academy dojo, serving as the acting assistant instructor for the Tenha-ryu school. He is admired by his students, and rumors suggest that, despite his youth, his skills surpass even those of the master instructor.

characters.name: Hyurence Altoire
characters.original: ヒュレンツ ・アルトワール
characters.description: The 14th King of the Kingdom of Altoire. He is a capable monarch with the ambition and cold-bloodedness of a ruler, but he is aloof in his personal relationships, much to the exasperation of his daughter, Hildetora. He values Nia’s fearless courage as he works to popularize Magic Vision.

title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon: Sailor Stars
title_original: 美少女戦士セーラームーン セーラースターズ
description: Like the R Season, SailorStars is divided into two arcs: The first arc solves some conflicts from the SuperS season, and also sees the return of the Outer Senshi, Haruka, Michiru, Setsuna, and Hotaru (now reborn as a child). The second arc is the actual plot from the manga. Usagi bids farewell to Mamoru, who is going to America to study abroad. In his place comes the Three Lights, an idol trio consisting of three boys, Seiya, Taiki, and Yaten. The new enemy is Galaxia, a woman who desires to rule the entire galaxy by collecting the Star Seeds of humans. Three new Senshi appear, the Sailor Starlights, who also intend to stop Galaxia without Sailormoon's help.

characters.name: Usagi Tsukino
characters.description: __Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to know her sweet and selfless side. Usagi is a bit selfish and very much a crybaby, lazy, clumsy, and also an academic underachiever. She's also not very good at cooking. However, she cares deeply about her friends and family. Usagi is very trusting, and believes that everyone has a better nature. She doe

characters.name: Ami Mizuno
characters.description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

characters.name: Rei Hino
characters.description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate from the other girls.

characters.name: Makoto Kino
characters.description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

characters.name: Minako Aino
characters.description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her to her life as a Senshi. He lives in her home (as [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) lives in Usagi's) and is one of her closest friends.

characters.name: Setsuna Meiou
characters.description: Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics. Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates, she becomes more friendly, but is still not very emotional, although there are moments in the manga where she expresses much more emotion than the anime. Sailor Pluto is much darker in her initial form in the manga, identified as the "Guardian of the Underworld" with very dark skin and a black sailo

characters.name: Michiru Kaiou
characters.description: Introduced in the third story arc, Michiru fights alongside her partner and lover Haruka in defending the Solar System from outside threats. In both versions of the story, she is elegant, sophisticated, capable of sharp anger, and sometimes cold. She is fully dedicated to her duty as a Senshi. Her Senshi alter-ego is Sailor Neptune, one of the "four soldiers of the outer solar system". As Sailor Neptune, her element of influence is the sea(not with water in general as Sailor Mercury's powers are); as with many of the other Senshi, this element is closely associated with her planet, which is named for the Roman sea god, Neptune. She is one of the Senshi who has natural psychic powers, alerting her when danger is near. She seems to be a character with a very deep understanding of things, sometimes even surpassing the other Outer Senshi due to her unnaturally high psychic endowments. Michir

characters.name: Haruka Tenou
characters.description: Haruka is a stubborn, protective individual, but is also strong-willed, capable, charming, and occasionally even doting. She is formally introduced in the third story arc, although she appears in silhouette alongside [Sailor Neptune](https://anilist.co/character/2829/Kaiou-Michiru) in the final episode of [Sailor Moon R](https://anilist.co/anime/740/-R/). When transformed, she is known as Sailor Uranus, and is part of the group known in Fanon as the Outer Senshi. Haruka is a racecar driver, even though she is barely sixteen years old when she appears. However, the timing of her birthday to the Japanese school year means she is one grade ahead of the Inner Senshi.

characters.name: Hotaru Tomoe
characters.description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

characters.name: Seiya Kou
characters.description: **Membership:** American Football **Responsibilities:** Lead Vocal, Keyboard Kou Seiya is the leader of the Sailor Starlights and the lead vocalist for the Three Lights. In general, Seiya acts arrogant and tends to be, at least on the surface, confident in their own abilities. Over the course of the series, Seiya develops strong feelings for [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino), and his attempts to forge a bond with her provides the primary romantic tension of the season. From their first meeting on, Seiya calls Usagi odango, like [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/4013/Mamoru-Chiba) does. The two even go on a date at an amusement park, which prematurely ends when [Sailor Iron Mouse](https://anilist.co/character/12418/Sailor-Iron-Mouse-) attacks. The relationship between Sailor Star Fighter and [Princess Kakyuu](https://anilist.co/character/11900/Kakyuu-Koujo) is s

characters.name: Taiki Kou
characters.description: __Band Responsibilities:__ Guitar Kou Taiki is the most intelligent of the Starlights. His abilities rival that of [Ami Mizuno](https://anilist.co/character/2366/Ami-Mizuno), whose romantic notions he considers foolish. However, Ami's wish for him to see the good in dreaming begins to have effect: In combat with a phage, Star Maker is the first of the Starlights to willingly allow [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino) to heal the monster rather than trying to kill it. Like [Yaten](https://anilist.co/character/2878/Yaten-Kou), Taiki believes that [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/2876/Seiya-Kou) should stay away from Usagi after learning she is Sailor Moon despite their wish shared by [Princess Kakyuu](https://anilist.co/character/11900/Kakyuu-Koujo) and the Guardian Senshi for them all to work together. In the anime, he sometimes wears glasses. (Source: Wikipe

characters.name: Yaten Kou
characters.description: Kou Yaten is a distant and cynical member of the Starlights. They don't socialize or do sports, they view humans as untrustworthy, and their remarks are often sharp-edged and blunt—further separating them from the world. In one episode, the other Starlights even chastise them for their behavior, fearing it might reduce their number of fans. However, Yaten gets along well with [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna), who inspires them to keep on fighting. In the anime, Yaten has the most spiritual awareness of the group and is able to sense when Starseeds are taken by [Sailor Galaxia](https://anilist.co/character/4900/Sailor-Galaxia). When it comes to light that [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino) is Sailor Moon, Yaten wants [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/2876/Seiya-Kou) to stay away from her, despite the wish shared by [Princess Kakyuu](https://anilist.c

title: Queen's Blade: Rurou no Senshi
title_original: クイーンズブレイド 流浪の戦士
description: In a land where a queen is chosen every few years solely by winning a tournament, there can be no short supply of formidable opponents. For one woman warrior however, an early defeat clearly shows her that she is lacking in experience though she may be bountiful in body. Fortunately, while defeat could spell one's doom, her life is saved by a powerful stranger. But unfortunately for this savior, less-than-pure motives and shrewd family members mean her reward is a prison cell. Her release is prompt when the unseasoned warrior she saved, tired of her current lifestyle of nobility, sets off to prove herself. (Source: Media Blasters)

characters.name: Claudette Vance
characters.description: Claudette is Reina's and Elina's big sister. As the "Lightning General", Claudette's able to throw thunderbolts at her opponents using a magic sword. She doesn't show her feelings to others and acts tough, but is secretly concerned about Reina's and Elina's safety.

characters.name: Nanael
characters.description: An angel who descended to Earth with duty of "broadcasting" Queen's Blade fights. Because of her goofy actions, Head Angel put her on probation and exiled to the mortal world. She was given a vial of 'holy milk' twice by the Head Angel, which she must not allow even one drop to be spilled. First time served a test which, in which she spilled of it and tried to fool Head Angel by filling the vial with Earthly milk. Second vial was given to her when she was ordered to enter Queen's Blade tournament, but this time, the more she spills, the weaker she becomes. Since she completely failed to keep the milk safe last time, Head Angel is confident that this will serve as a handicap! Unwilling to treat dwellers of the "lower world" as equals, her combat technique involves the telekinetic manipulation of her celestial saber to keep opponents at bay. She is i

characters.name: Reina Vance
characters.description: The nomad warrior Reina is the direct heir to the house of Vance and Claudette's and Elina's sister. But, instead of accepting her father's heritage, she escapes and enters the Queen's Blade tournament. Her partially naive character and strong sense of justice gets her into trouble pretty often.

characters.name: Tomoe
characters.description: A Shinto priestess from the island of Hinomoto (an alternate reading of the kanji for Japan), she is a member of the elite society of priestesses that protect their homeland. She was designed and illustrated by the artist Eiwa.

characters.name: Shizuka
characters.description: A kunoichi from Hinomoto, Shizuka is a money grubbing assassin. She couldn't care less about the affairs of the battle as long she gets paid; she just hates working hard in general and instead have a personal group of ninjas to aid her. Shizuka does not have a game book of her own, yet has been featured in the anime, voiced by Hitomi Nabatame, manga, collectible cards ver2.0, and even had a PVC figurine released. She was created by Eiwa - By Wesker_CDA

characters.name: Risty
characters.description: A wild bandit who walks into Reina having a battle with Melona. Reina is almost killed by Melona but Risty saves her life. Reina then spends all her time in the anime trying to follow Risty before she goes to the Queen's Blade competition.

characters.name: Elina Vance
characters.description: The daughter of Count Vance, and younger sister of Reina, a prominent Queen's Blade competitor. She was trained from a young age in all manner of martial arts, from stealth to strict military discipline, and acts as both bodyguard, spy, and assassin for her father. Unlike Reina Erina's personality is vicious. She was created by Hisayuki Hirokazu.

characters.name: Melona
characters.description: Melona is one of the four servants of The Swamp Witch and her strongest minion. Nicknamed "The Protean Assassin" due to her nearly unlimited ability to change form at will, she is skilled in obtaining information and assassination. It is assumed that she was ordered to bring about chaos to the Queen's Blade tournament. Seductive and alluring, she revels in humiliating her opponents and will not hesitate to kill them if given the opportunity. Despite her malevolent nature she hates being called a monster and becomes very upset, to the point of strangling someone to death for instance. Despite this, she can be reasoned with and is willing to work with her enemies as long as it benefits her and furthers her own goals. She is a shapeshifter not limited by shape or texture who can change the shape of her body freely and instantly. Her mimicry is so proficient that she can even imitate the tec

characters.name: Menace
characters.description: Thousands of years ago, in the ancient Amara, a princess was dethroned out of her kingdom. She would have been the next queen, but was betrayed by the high statesmen at the same time Amara fell into ruin after being invaded by an enemy kingdom. History tells that princess Menace's fate was the same as her collapsing kingdom. In the present the "Marshland Witch" managed to resurrect Menace with a powerful magic in her plan to conquer the continent. Despite that, Menace pridefully refused to serve anyone and fled.
