She is quite popular due to her cool appearance. She loves stargazing. ~!Born as Hatsune Misumi, she is the illegitimate child of [Sadaharu Togawa](https://anilist.co/character/352933/Togawa-Sadaharu) and one of the Togawa family housekeepers. She was raised on an island by her biological mother and foster father, alongside her half-sister Uika. Upon arriving in Tokyo, she was scouted and debuted as an idol using her sister's name.!~

characters.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first-year high school student. Mutsumi used to be a member of the band CRYCHIC, where she was in charge of the guitar. She is very stoic and a taciturn. Her father is a famous comedian called Wakaba, and her mother is Mori Minami, an actress. One of her hobbies is ballet.

characters.name: Umiri Yahata
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Umiri is one of Taki's classmates. She is somewhat playful as she enjoys teasing Taki. Umiri is an exceptionally proficient bassist who has played as a support artist for over 30 different bands.

characters.name: Nyamu Yuutenji
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") Nyamu is a popular beauty influencer and the drummer of Ave Mujica.

characters.name: Soyo Nagasaki
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm Soyo Nagasaki is a first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the bassist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)** Soyo is a very kind and mature girl and she is often compared to an older sister. Due to this, she is often relied on by her peers. She has a habit of fiddling with her fingertips when she's thinking or planning something. Although not outwardly hostile, Soyo can be quite cunning at times.

characters.name: Anon Chihaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Anon Chihaya is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the rhythm guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/). Anon is an honor student who is very social and also assertive at the same time. Despite this, it is shown that she has had a hard time making friends. Anon also loves following and trying out the newest trends. She approaches [Tomori](https://anilist.co/character/302095/Takamatsu-Tomori) after learning about her in hopes of creating a band together with her. Although she initially created the band in order to gain attention, to the point where she wanted to name the band after herself, she ends up becoming dedicated to her band activities and taking practicing seriously.

characters.name: Tomori Takamatsu
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm Tomori Takamatsu is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the vocalist and lyricist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**. Tomori is a kind but sensitive girl who has an awkward personality. She has a tendency to stutter while talking and not make eye contact. She also tends to blame herself for the conflicts that happen around her, even if they weren't caused by her. She is infamously known as "Haneoka's Weirdo Girl" due to her peculiar personality. She likes collecting all sorts of things, such as band-aids (especially ones with animals such as pandas or penguins on them), slippery things, just-the-right-size things, and even rocks and fallen leaves that she picks up from the ground. She also likes pill bugs and has been shown often drawing them in her notebooks.

characters.name: Taki Shiina
characters.description: **Height:** 156 cm Taki Shiina is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer and composer of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**. Taki is a loner who enjoys being all alone. She works part-time at RiNG, but due to her blunt personality, short temper and the fact she has a tendency to glare at people, she isn't good at customer service. She is a bit of a perfectionist, but at the same time has an inferiority complex towards her older sister.

characters.name: Raana Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Raana Kaname is a third-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' Junior High School and the lead guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO) Raana is an eccentric girl. She is a very talented guitarist who also has a very frank personality, as she always states what she likes and doesn't like. She is somewhat of a glutton and loves sweets, especially matcha parfaits, but also dislikes hot foods as she has a sensitive tongue.

characters.name: Mana Sumita
characters.description: Mana became popular thanks to her cute smile and pure personality. She loves eating donuts.

characters.name: Minami Mori
characters.description: Minami is Mutsumi's mother. She's a famous actress.

title: Bad Girl
description: Yuu Yuutani is a first-year high school student with sharp eyes, large piercings and flashy two-tone hair. She's become notorious as a bad girl… but she's really not. At heart, Yuu is an incredibly good girl, but her mind is always full of thoughts of the beautiful and popular Atori Mizutori, the school’s Madonna and head of the student disciplinary committee. So, on her mission to attract the attention of Atori, Yuu decided to quit being an honor student and become a "bad delinquent!” (Source: HIDIVE)

characters.name: Yuu Yuutani
characters.description: A first year student with perfect attendance, good grades, and even the respect of teachers. However, in order to get the attention of her beloved [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) she acts as a poor imitation of a rule breaker. Her poor acting skills make her behave suspiciously when talking to Atori.

characters.name: Atori Mizutori
characters.description: A third year student who is admired by everyone both inside and outside of school. Some people have even begun to see her as a god-like figure. She is the head of the moral committee at school, but often acts eccentrically. She thinks of [Yuu]( https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) like a small animal.

characters.name: Suzu Suzukaze
characters.description: A first year student and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) childhood friend. Her poor eyesight makes her squint and she has naturally blonde hair so she is often mistaken for a delinquent. She often doesn't take Yuu seriously, but still cares about her and gives advice.

characters.name: Rura Ruriha
characters.description: A second year student who uses her cute appearance as a weapon in her career as a beauty YTuber and model. She is popular and well known, even declaring herself the idol of the school, but has no friends.

characters.name: Kiyoraka Sumiki
characters.description: A friend of [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) and head of the library committee at school. She is a beautiful and intelligent honor student, but she is also secretly known as a lady killer.

characters.name: Mizuka Mizutori
characters.description: [Atori's](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) younger sister and a 1st year student. She has communication issues and a severe sister complex, which makes her wary of [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) suddenly befriending her sister.

characters.name: Maria Komari
characters.description: Kindergartner at a primary school visited by [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) during student council activities. Within 10 minutes of meeting Atori, she became a fan of her and forms the other kindergarten girls into an "Atori Daisuki Club."

title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san
description: About best friends Inugami Yachiyo and Nekoyama Suzu. Inugami likes cats and has a dog-like personality. Nekoyama likes dogs and has a cat-like personality.

characters.name: Aki Hiiragi
characters.description: Yachiyo's friend and Suzu's classmate who often serves as the straight-man trying to bring Yachiyo and Suzu's relationship back down to reality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yukiji Ushiwaka
characters.description: Mikine's senior in the biology club who, much like her cow-like name suggests, has ample breasts.

characters.name: Kiri Hiiragi
characters.description: Aki's younger sister.

characters.name: Kaede Hiiragi
characters.description: Aki's youngest sister.

characters.name: Tamaki Nekoyama
characters.description: Suzu's older sister.

characters.name: Sora Sarutobi
characters.description: Class 1-A Representative.

title: Sasameki Koto
description: Murasame Sumika is popular in the high school for her excellence in the marks and sports. However, she has a secret: she is in love with her classmate Kazama Ushio. Ushio also has a liking to the love between girls, but she hasn't noticed Sumika's feeling and always been refused by other girls.

characters.name: Sumika Murasame
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5’9’’) Sumika is in love with her best friend, Ushio. Much to Sumika's dismay, Ushio only likes cute girls. While the athletic, sarcastic and long-legged Sumika is just not cute. She wishes she were born the kind of girl one wants to protect, while being a little shorter and maintaining a little clumsiness, but it's a lost cause. Sumika loves karate, but gave up practicing it formally because it was "uncute". She is prone to jealousy as she is forced to watch Ushio crush again and again on girls who cannot return a mutual feeling. Sumika always ends up patching up her broken heart as her feelings always end up unrequited. Despite her own feelings, Sumika wants Ushio to be happy and wishes her friend could find love, even if it's not with her.

characters.name: Ushio Kazama
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5’3’’) Ushio is the best friend of Sumika, the protagonist, and always has been —oblivious to Sumika's feelings for her (though she does at one point recognize that Sumika is in love, and feels guilty, even, for not realizing it sooner; she just doesn't understand that it's her Sumika feels that way with). Ushio has made it clear that Sumika isn't her type; Ushio's "type" consists of —cute— girl; small and feminine and innocently curious, the kind one would want to protect, and Sumika far from falls into that category. Ushio is constantly falling for girls like that —only to find her crushes unrequited again and again, leaving Sumika to end up consoling her when her heart breaks. She wishes just once that she could find a girl who would return her feelings. Her spirits are lifted, however, upon a lesbian couple in her class forming the Girls Club for women interested

characters.name: Tomoe Hachisuka
characters.description: Tomoe is a classmate of Sumika and Ushio. The two don't pay much attention in particular to her until they walk on her kissing her girlfriend, Miyako, one day after school (though they don't realize the identity of the couple until later). Tomoe and Miyako one day catch Sumika and Ushio "practicing" kissing with a plastic mask (an idea suggested by Ushio upon realizing Sumika has feelings for someone - though Ushio doesn't know that someone is her) and draw the conclusion that they, too, are a couple. When they confront Sumika about the kiss, they learn that her feelings are one-sided. They still know, however, that Sumika and Ushio are interested in girls - and Tomoe seizes the opportunity to form a Girls Club, just for girls interested in girls. The two end up joining. Tomoe is not in denial about her sexuality nor ashamed of it, and she and Miyako are unsepera

characters.name: Miyako Tamae
characters.description: Miyako is a classmate of Sumika and Ushio's, who they don't pay much attention to until they walk in on her and her girlfriend, Tomoe, kissing in a classroom after school (though they don't realize the identity of the couple until later). When Miyako and Tomoe similiarly catch Sumika and Ushio kissing in the same classroom, the latter wearing a plastic mask and unaware of the former's feelings for her, they assume the two are a couple and Miyako snaps a picture of the kiss on her cell-phone. Upon confronting Sumika about it, they learn of her one-sided feelings. Miyako is not as tactful as Tomoe and thinks that Sumika should come right out and confess to her friend. She and Sumika often tease each-other about various things and may not seem to get along particularly well, but, in truth, Miyako and Tomoe are grateful for her and Ushio's friendship; the two, insepe

characters.name: Masaki Akemiya
characters.description: Akemiya is a classmate of Sumika's, though Sumika doesn't take notice of him until he one day tells her he thinks she's cute. This is a comfort to Sumika, who feels "uncute" but wants to appear that way in hopes that her best friend, Ushio, may return her feelings; Ushio makes it clear again and again that she likes "cute" girls. What Sumika doesn't realize until later is that Akemiya notices Sumika's insecurity to a great extent because he was a girl Sumika saw in a store the previous day and wanted to emulate because she looked like the type Ushio would crush on. Akemiya developed feelings for Sumika, but, once he realized that Sumika was in love with Ushio, his younger sister, amused, convinced him into cross-dressing to gain her attention. She sent a photo of him dressed as a girl to a magazine. The magazine hired him, and, before he knew

characters.name: Kiyori Torioi
characters.description: Kiyori is Sumika and Ushio's best school friend whom not much is known about. She is always seen with them at school, however, and accompanies them on various outings. She is in the music club in school, and she does not spend a lot of time outside with either Sumika or Kazama because of her club activities taking up most of her time. Kiyori has a cheerful demeanor and is always eating or snacking. She isn't interested in girls but is well used to the fact that her friend is a lesbian. She does seem exasperated (like most others) of Ushio's fleeting crushes and constant talk of wanting a cute girlfriend. She is supportive to Kazama and the formation of the Girls Club; doesn't enter but stays with them because "It might be fun". Her biggest complaint is that Sumika's occasional jealousy-induced awkwardness with, sadness around, and meanness towards Ushio

characters.name: Manaka Akemiya
characters.description: Manaka is Masaki's elementary-school-aged younger sister. She's a devious girl who first started having him dress up as a cute girll to impress Sumika and then sent pictures of him to a modeling agency that ended up hiring him. Despite her awareness of Sumika's feelings for Ushio, she fails to understand why Sumika rejected him and is angry with her for doing so, even going as far as to blackmail her to go on a date with Masaki. She doesn't take into much consideration Sumika's feelings or well-being nor her brother's embarassment, and her intentions motivating some of her schemes involving him are questionable...

characters.name: Azusa Aoi
characters.description: Aoi is a classmate of Sumika, Ushio and the rest's. She developes a crush on Sumika and starts hanging out with her and her friends when, after having her first kiss stolen by Tomoe and being ganged up on by her classmates, she's driven to run out of class. Sumika follows her and comforts her. Aoi is a gushing fan of the yuri light novels penned by Ushio's brother and a member of his fanclub (though she believes the author is a sensitve, beautiful woman and has no idea of his real identity. Sumika and Ushio desire to keep it that way). Aoi draws doujinshi for his books, but is inspired to create her own original yuri romance and wants to do so with Sumika. She becomes extremely saddened when Sumika at first is reluctant, to the concern of her parents, but ends up helped and again comforted by her in the end. At first, she is convinced that she and Sumika have a mutual love for each other

characters.name: Chizuka Nishikigi
characters.description: A second-year that and Uisho's co-worker at the school library. She is very shy and talks very softly Uisho develops feelings for Chizuka, noticing that she is very cute and Uisho's "type." But Chizuka breaks her heart when she gets very angry and gives her a menacing, tear-filled glare. Uisho is heartbroken and breaks down crying in Sumika's arms. Uisho and Chizuka have felt uncomfortable around each other ever since.

title: Rinne no Lagrange
description: Madoka Kyouno is an energetic girl who is full of passion. As the proud, and only, member of the Kamogawa Girls' High School Jersey Club, she goes around helping people in need. Madoka's life is turned upside down when she is suddenly asked by a mysterious girl named Lan to pilot a robot. Motivated by her desire to protect the people and city of Kamogawa, Madoka agrees to pilot the resurrected Vox robot to fight against extraterrestrials that have come to attack Earth. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Madoka Kyouno
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Jersey Club, Pharos __Ovid:__ Vox Aura (Midori) The sole member of a Jersey Club who often helps out other clubs and people in need and is passionate about her home town of Kamogawa. She has a habit of saying "maru" (meaning 'circle', the kind used to mark tests) when she finishes helping someone. She soon discovers she has the ability to pilot a strange robotic aircraft known as the Vox Aura, which she previously encountered ten years ago when she almost drowned. She names this Vox unit Midori, after its green color.

characters.name: Laffinty Fin E Ld Si
characters.original: フィン・エ・ルド・スイ・ラフィンティ, ラン
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Le Garite, Jersey Club, Pharos __Ovid:__ Vox Rympha (Orca) An alien who was sent to protect Madoka and the aircraft. She is not used to earth culture and often picks up terms from the strangest sources. She was initially unable to properly utilize her Vox unit as the knowledge of a supposed fate concerning Vox pilots caused her to become afraid. However, Madoka helps her overcome her fear and she becomes able to use her Vox unit, Vox Rympha, which she names Orca. She is jealous of Muginami, who shows a lot of interest in Madoka, which leads to her to join the Jersey Club and begin living with Madoka. Due to her luxurious upbringing as princess of the planet Le Garite, Lan has little understanding of the commoners' lifestyle.

characters.name: Muginami
characters.description: **Affiliation:** Jersey Club, Pharos, KISS **Ovid:** Vox Ignis (Hupo) An Ovid pilot who transfers to Madoka's class and joins the Jersey Club. Although she appears to have a slow-witted personality, she is actually sharp and perceptive and appears to have a hidden agenda, particularly concerning the memoria on Madoka and Lan's bodies. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kirius Rakus Lestrine Ha
characters.original: ラクス・レストリネ・ハ・キリウス
characters.description: **Affiliation:** De Metrio, KISS **Ovid:** Libertas A De Metrio Ovid pilot whose comrades are Izo and Array. Despite his serious appearance, he has a comical fascination with Earth conventions, from which he draws peculiar conclusions. He applies to work at BWH with Izo and Array at the end of the first season.

characters.name: Izo Sofiro Karia Los
characters.original: ソフィロ・カリア・ロス・イゾ
characters.description: **Affiliation:** De Metrio, KISS **Ovid:** Voluntas A De Metrio Ovid pilot whose comrades are Kirius and Array. He appears brash, but is actually a thoughtful person. Madoka's classmates think he's her boyfriend when he shows up at her school and demands to see her. He applies to work at BWH with Kirius and Array at the end of the first season.

characters.name: Array Danon Ci
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ De Metrio, KISS, Novumundus __Ovid:__ Teneritas A De Metrio Ovid pilot whose comrades are Izo and Kirius. After being defeated by Madoka early in the series, he reappears later as Astelia's maid, complete with maid outfit. Despite being relieved from his duty, he has continued wearing the outfit because he doesn't have a change of clothes. However, Astelia has given him a credit card so he is not short on money, which caused Izo and Kirius to question why he hasn't bought new clothes with it. He applies to work at BWH with Izo and Kirius at the end of the first season.

characters.name: Youko Nakaizumi
characters.description: Madoka's cousin, though Madoka refers to Youko as her sister. She is a marine archaeologist researching the Vox. She is a pillar of strength for Madoka and always supports her. She's also the former club president of the Jersey Club, whom inspired a young Madoka to follow her steps.

characters.name: Astelia Lizamarie de Rochefort
characters.original: アステリア・リーザマリー・ド・ロシュフォール
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Novumundus The acting chairman of Novumundus. She has substantial influence as shown by her ability to bring U.S. President to tears over the phone. She is the person behind Lan's "woof" greeting; she tricked Lan into believing that it was a normal greeting on Earth.

characters.name: Souta Serizawa
characters.description: Youko's assistant marine archaeologist, who is researching the relationship between the ancient language and legend of the Vox with her. He appears to have feelings for Youko.

characters.name: Shouzou Tadokoro
characters.description: Affiliation: Pharos The commanding officer of Pharos. A bachelor who dislikes formalities like neckties.

characters.name: Balance T. Moid
characters.description: Affiliation: Le Garite, Pharos A mysterious and superficially polite man stationed on Pharos. He seems to know more about the Rin-ne flower than he lets on. His favorite food is pudding a la mode, which he enjoys mixing together into a soup before eating.

characters.name: Hiroshi Nakaizumi
characters.description: Madoka's uncle and the owner of the surf shop/restaurant "Be With Hiroshi" (BWH).

title: Akikan!
description: Hobbies are often a great way of meeting new people, but how could Kakeru Diachi, who collects rare juice cans, have ever suspected that he'd meet a fascinating new girl when he attempted to DRINK her? Naming her Melon, because she's got great melon... soda, Kakeru quickly learns that she's an Akikan—a beautiful girl who's also a special can created to fight other Akikans in a strange experiment to determine what kind of container is better: steel or aluminum! Will becoming involved in this ridiculously twisted research project gone amuck complicate Kakeru's life incredibly? Of course it will, but because Melon's steel body needs carbon dioxide to breathe, he's now stuck with her since she's too CO2 dependent! And when his wealthy, attractive, best childhood friend Najimi gets HER own aluminum Akikan, the trouble really begins! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Kakeru Daichi
characters.description: The series's main protagonist, A perverted high school virgin studying at Kyuugetsu Academy. He enjoys collecting rare juice cans. One day, he bought a melon soda that transformed into a girl, which was an Akikan.

characters.name: Melon
characters.description: A steel Akikan who came from a melon soda, owned by Kakeru. She's competitive and strong-willed, which was the reason why she was always having a fight with Kakeru. Although she likes her owner she cannot express her feelings well, which ends up telling opposite of what she wants to say. She likes watching baseball matches, even with midnight telecasts, though she has stated she has no clue on how the game is played. She basically hates Aluminum Akikans and is always having small quarrels with Yell. She mostly uses carbon dioxide based cool drink sorcery in battle.

characters.name: Najimi Tenkuuji
characters.description: Kakeru's childhood-friend and classmate, whose charm point is her "antenna" hair which changes form according to her mood. She's an heiress to the Tenkuuji group of companies and she holds a romantic feeling toward Kakeru. She's gentle and easy-going, but her weird sense of imagination tend to warp her into her own world. She has the history of being saved by Kakeru from being kidnapped. She also has the tendency to become a Kuribo look-alike (from the Super Mario series) when struck by jealousy; she starts kicking Kakeru's calf.

characters.name: Yurika Kochikaze
characters.description: Kakeru and Najimi's classmate who claims to be Najimi's lover. She's always having fights with Kakeru and Yell as her rival for Najimi. She's also a self-proclaimed witch and she often uses cards to throw at Kakeru (which, from the back, look like tarot cards but are normal poker cards). In some instances she shows mysterious powers. Her birthday is on Halloween, which could relate to the reason she believes she is a witch. Her nickname is Yuriri.

characters.name: Budoko
characters.description: An Aluminum Akikan who came from a grape juice. She's small but strong willed and talks in a funny way. She loves to watch the stars together with her owner, Misaki Miyashita. (source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yell
characters.description: An Aluminum Akikan who came from a sports drink. She's usually cool and composed but she becomes furious when someone tries to insult her owner. She's got sharp vision which was the cause for her being sensitive to moving objects, which causes her the urge to play with it. She also loves animals and she herself has a pet turtle called "Kame". She uses the "isotonic sword" as her cool drink sorcery, which can cut through anything made of organic matter. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Airin Kizaki
characters.description: Otoya's secretary. She's strict but shy by nature and is always having a problem with Otoya calling her by her given name, which she was emabarassed to be heard by others. She's also one of the few ordinary persons in the series. Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Gorou Amaji
characters.description: Kakeru's classmate and friend. He was nick-named Gigolo by Kakeru but he was far from being a ladies' man. He is often forgotten by his friends due to his lack of Existence. He's also got crush for Yurika Kochikaze but always ends up not being able to tell her or being ignored. But, he is a reliable person at times of need, always ready to help his friend. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hidehiko Otoya
characters.description: A government official designated to Department of Economy. He is the person who established the "Akikan Elect" and "Intelligence Port project", though his motive for their establishment is not yet clear. A self-proclaimed gay who loves pretty boys. He's often having contact with Kakeru, harassing him sexually. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Misaki Miyashita
characters.description: Budoko's owner and a junior high sophomore student. She was a timid girl who hid inside her shell and didn't have friends. Her hobby is drawing, and she often refers to people with otaku terminologies.

characters.name: Miku
characters.description: A mixed juice Steel Akikan who appears in the anime. ~!Her can was girlished by a cat (the same cat that is usually found on the roof of Daichi and Melon's house) who ran off right away. This caused her to have a hatred of Akikans, both Aluminum and Steel, with owners, and she began absorbing their powers and calling herself The Strongest Akikan. Her main cool drink sorcery is Rainbow Splash Mixer, and she also has the ability to make clones of the Akikans she had captured called Zeros. Since she was never given a name, Kakeru gives her the name 'Miku', a name she likes but doesn't admit to it. Daichi offered the idea to be her Owner, something she considered until Otoya showed her a picture of her true Owner and ran off to find it. At the end of the series she is friends with the main cast and still chasing her Owner.!~

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear GX
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギアGX
description: Following the events of Senki Zesshou Symphogear G , Hibiki Tachibana, Tsubasa Kazanari, and Chris Yukine continue to operate under the command of Genjuurou Kazanari. Meanwhile, Maria Cadenzavna Eve, Kirika Akatsuki, and Shirabe Tsukuyomi are taken into protective custody. With peace restored, everyone returns to their daily lives; however, the appearance of the alchemist Carol Malus Dienheim and her subordinates—the "Autoscorers"—threatens to draw everyone back into a conflict. Armed with a strange and magical power, Carol wishes to initiate the apocalypse and bring destruction to the world... and she is willing to sacrifice everything to do so. Against this mysterious new foe, the six Symphogear wielders must rise to the challenge in order to protect what they hold dear. However, will Carol and her Autoscorers prove to be too much to handle in this fight to protect the fate of the world? (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve
characters.original: マリア・カデンツァヴナ・イブ
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Black Gungnir ~!__Symphogear post G:__ Airgetlám!~ An energetic singer who reached the top of the American music charts about 2 months after her debut. Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Elfnein
characters.description: A girl from the world of alchemy who bears a resemblance to Carol. She comes before the other Symphogear users to provide them with a means of combating the Alca-Noise. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Carol Dienheim
characters.original: キャロル・マールス・ディーンハイム
characters.description: Carol grew up in a peaceful life in medieval Europe with her father, who taught her alchemy. After her father was burned at the stake for practicing alchemy, Carol interpreted his last words of "learn more about the world" to mean that she must take it upon herself to dissect the world down to its fundamental components. She then spends several centuries plotting how to accomplish this using alchemy to create artificial homunculus bodies and transferring her memories to them to make her biologically immortal. She has a mastery of alchemy after so long, and has complete control over an alchemical version of noise known as alca-noise, the Aristotelian elements (silver, wind, fire, earth, water) as well as the faust robe Dur da Blá. The use of such powers require the burning of memories as a fuel-source. Due to Carol's long life, she has a large amount to burn, and thinks nothing of losing

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Shinji Ogawa
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari; he works as Tsubasa's manager on the scenes.

characters.name: Sakuya Fujitaka
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

title: Lapis Re:LiGHTs
description: Tiara has just been accepted to the Flora Girls Academy for young witches. Her lifelong dream of becoming a powerful “light” to cleanse the world of magical beasts is now possible. But not before she hits the magical music books! Oh, and little did Tiara know that she’s about to take center stage in a classroom full of potential dropouts. Challenge accepted. (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Ashley
characters.description: **Unit:** LiGHTs A young lady from a family of knights, who claims that "being a witch is a step towards becoming a knight". Her country of origin is Dordtgard. Influenced by her long history of training, she has an uptight personality. She aims to be a knight admiring her father who is a heroic knight, but was told "You can't be a good knight with strength alone", so was recommended to study as a witch. Because her mother was a seamstress, she has a fondness for cute outfits, as well as stuffed toys, so she is secretly a member of the craft making club. She belongs to the unit LiGHTs. She is stuck with having Lavie as her roommate. She is in charge of making costumes for LiGHTs, and although it doesn't seem to contribute to her wish of becoming a knight, she's created many costumes, even if she doesn't like wearing them herself. (Source: Lapis Re:Lights Wiki)

characters.name: Lynette
characters.description: **Unit:** LiGHTs A library committee member who loves books. Her country of origin is Marlseillu. She's a girl brought up around extreme bibliomania due to her grandmother being a well-known magic librarian. Because she spent all her time reading books when growing up, she has a shy and quiet personality. She aspires to be a witch who can shine in public, and is a witch otaku who has an abundant knowledge on witches. She is an avid daydreamer, even occasionally fantasizing about "her other classmates making out with each other". She belongs to the unit LiGHTs. She is the least competent within her unit as a witch, but has unrivalled knowledge of magic and sense of writing lyrics making her an indispensable part of LiGHTs (Source: Lapis Re:Lights Wiki)

characters.name: Rosetta
characters.description: **Unit:** LiGHTs An honor student in the top 3 of all her classes. Her country of origin is Waleland. She comes from an aristocratic family, has excellent grades and a cool personality. She is popular amongst her juniors but has a side of her that is less befitting of a noble such as being absentminded, liking to save money and keeping an account book. She has a younger sister called Henrietta, but since they aren't able to meet often she diverts her feelings of loneliness by getting hooked on the cabaret club suggesting she has somewhat of a sister complex. She belongs to the unit LiGHTs. She is childhood friends with the leader Tiara, so they often compose music together. She is an excellent student who works as the class representative, but she has a surprising amount of weaknesses which Tiara says are "Rose's cute points".

characters.name: Tiara Victoria
characters.description: **Unit:** LiGHTs A bright and cheerful mood maker. Her country of origin is Waleland. Because she was prone to sickness as a child, she has a strong desire to cheer people up by singing. Due to having to stay in her room a lot when younger, she came to love flowers after taking care of the plants she received from her older sister. Also because of this, she joined the gardening club at her academy, although she looks after many dangerous plants such as "Mandragoras that want to sing" and "Carnivorous Tulips". She is the leader of LiGHTs. Her fellow member [Rosetta](https://anilist.co/character/163912/Rosetta) is her roommate and childhood friend. Although she looks like a normal girl among special classes, she is actually the second princess of Waleland. Admiring her sister as the first princess, she became a witch, but no one except Rosetta knows her true identity.

characters.name: Lavie
characters.description: **Unit:** LiGHTs Able to do any sport, she is a child prodigy with all the makings of a witch. Her country of origin is Marlseillu. She has a lot of self-confidence, and is the self-proclaimed "special class ace". She has a naïve personality but is horrendously bad at studying making her always at the bottom of the class in tests. She grew up in a fairly normal home, admiring the leader of the legendary unit "Ray", [Eliza](https://anilist.co/character/163920/Eliza), making her come to Flora Girls' Academy. She is in the cheerleading club where her dancing skills are top class within the academy. She belongs to the unit LiGHTs, of which her fellow member [Ashley](https://anilist.co/character/163910/Ashley) is her roommate. She claims that "Ashley and I are best friends!", but since their personalities are the exact opposite of each other, they often argue. She is in charge of creating the

characters.name: Champe
characters.description: **Unit:** Sugar Pockets

characters.name: Camilla
characters.description: Daughter of a vampire aristocrat, Camilla is a top witch often called "The Young Noble of Chastity". With the looks of a prince and her boyish pitch, she has many female fans, however her personality fundamentally comes down to a sadist who is mesmerized with the pleasure of captivating others. Contrary to her appearance, rather than enjoying a sip of blood, she would rather drink a fine cup of green tea. On her off days she passes her time tending to her bonsai tree in a traditional Yamato themed room. She loves Yamato culture. She casually calls normal humans her "emergency food". and is often seen saying such lines as "I condemn thee be dragged around the city" or "By my work, you're going to kill yourself. I shall be your suicide assistant." During her active years, was extremely popular for her prideful haughty MC. She is a member of Ray. She is often seen fighting with Yuzuriha say

characters.name: Angelica
characters.description: A self-proclaimed normal girl of the health committee. She is a very talented witch but for some reason makes a special effort to live a normal life. Despite being skilled at singing, dancing and magic, as well as being tall, she doesn't want to stand out at the academy. After meeting the members of the legendary unit "Ray", she became a fan of Ange-chan, sometimes even mimicking her by saying "Kyarurun, Ange-chan's here★". However, since Ange-chan is a very short witch, Angelica is often mocked by her classmates for mimicking her. Because she specializes in using healing magic, she is a member of the health committee. She is the leader of "Sadistic★Candy". She has an unfortunate but inseperable relationship with Lucifer, so they often argue with each other. However, they still accept each other as partners. (Source: Lapis Re:LiGHTs Wiki)

characters.name: Ratura
characters.description: Though Ratura's parents' estate is wealthy, she does not receive much of an allowance to help keep her financially disciplined, so in secret she works a part-time job. She comes from the country of Firenza. She spends all the money she secretly earns on magical girl goods. She is a magical girl otaku, and she refuses to let her love for magical girls be less than anyone else. At the manga research club, she loves to draw manga. Additionally, because her estate runs a major fashion brand, the clothes she designs often appear in the manga. She is a member of the unit "Sugar Pockets". She excels at stage performance, and whether it is on stage or during practice lessons, she draws people to her. As a result, she is an effective leader. Though she is good friends with her teammates Champe and Maryberry, her heart longs to make friends with other magical girl otakus she can talk with.

title: Oshi ga Budoukan Ittekuretara Shinu
title_original: 推しが武道館いってくれたら死ぬ
title_en: If My Favorite Pop Idol Made It to the Budokan, I Would Die
description: Passionate music-lover Eripiyo only wants to see her favorite underground pop group, ChamJam, make it to the big stage at Budokan. Because they’ve enriched her life by their very existence, Eri is willing to dedicate everything she has to see this dream fulfilled – even her health. At their last performance she got a crazy nosebleed. Hey, no one said being a super-fan was easy! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Eripiyo
characters.description: The show's main character. One day she stumbled upon a ChamJam performance. Ever since then, she's been the biggest fan of Maina, spending most of her income on concerts and merch. Usually wears a salmon pink tracksuit, the same color as Maina's clothes.

characters.name: Maina Ichii
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm __Birthplace:__ Kurashiki City, Okayama Prefecture __Member color:__ Salmon pink As the least popular member of ChamJam, she has very few fans. She's very shy and often has trouble getting her feeling across.

characters.name: Motoi
characters.description: A relatively new fan of ChamJam, specifically Sorane.

characters.name: Kumasa
characters.description: A hardcore otaku and one of the original fans of ChamJam. He followed Reo's career even before the new group was formed.

characters.name: Rena
characters.description: Motoi's younger sister.

characters.name: Reo Igarashi
characters.description: __Height:__156 cm __Birthplace:__ Katsuta-gun, Okayama Prefecture __Member color:__ Pink ChamJam's oldest member and leader.

characters.name: Sorane Matsuyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Birthplace:__ Okayama City, Okayama Prefecture __Member color:__ Blue Member of ChamJam.

characters.name: Maki Hakata
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Birthplace:__ Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture __Member color:__ Yellow Member of ChamJam.

characters.name: Yumeri Mizumori
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm __Birthplace:__ Kanagawa Prefecture __Member Color:__ Purple / Dark blue Member of ChamJam.

characters.name: Yuuka Teramoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Birthplace:__ Tamano City, Okayama Prefecture The youngest member of ChamJam. Yuuka has long indigo-colored hair and matching color eyes. She wears a teal dress, with a matching tie, and a flat ribbon on her head. She has a bright personality and poor memory, but she is good at dancing. Her hobby is playing social games.

characters.name: Aya Yokota
characters.description: **Height:** 147 cm Aya has long plum-colored hair tied back in two ponytails by two green bows and matching colored eyes.

characters.name: Yoshikawa
characters.description: A staff member at the underground idol concerts.

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru
description: At Lillian Girls’ Academy, a renowned all-girls Catholic school, pairs of girls become soeurs, or “sisters”, in order to support and guide each other during their time at school. The shy Yumi Fukuzawa thought she was far too ordinary to attract a soeur as popular and beautiful as Sachiko Ogasawara, but for some reason, Sachiko has set her sights on Yumi — but why does she want to become Yumi’s soeur, anyway, and just what will become Sachiko’s soeur entail? (Source: Maiden Japan)

characters.name: Yumi Fukuzawa
characters.description: She is the main character of the series. In the beginning of the series, Yumi is bashful beyond words, very timid and unsure of herself. She first met Sachiko, the star of Lillian School and had her tie fixed by Sachiko, which mortified Yumi. Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Other characters often comment on how her emotions 'show on her face'. ~!After Yumi first meets Sachiko, Sachiko is arguing with the Roses in the Rose Mansion. The Roses say that Sachiko cannot object to their plan, as she did not have a petite sœur. Sachiko runs out of the meeting and knocks Yumi over. She asks if Yumi has a grande sœur, and promptly offered Yumi her rosary. Sachiko thought that if she had a petite sœur, the Yamayurikai could not force her to play Cinderella alongside a male

characters.name: Rei Hasekura
characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Youko Mizuno
characters.description: Youko entered Lillian during her first year of middle school. Despite coming from an outside schooling system she was asked to give the welcome speech for first year students. She is characterized as being calm but sharp with a mischievous side, in the manga she is described to be "lily" like. Her greatest day was seeing the Rose Mansion filled with ordinary students during the Bouton's card hunt. During Youko's second year of high school, Rosa Gigantea and Rosa Chinensis (Sei and Youko's onee-sama's respectively) tricked Youko into taking an interest in Ogasawara Sachiko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. She had Sachiko quit her after school lessons (or in the novel, hinted about it) and once scolded her for not expressing he

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuki Fukuzawa
characters.description: The brother of Yumi (born one year apart), he loves her very much and tries to help her in everything he can. He has good relations with the students of Lillian and is somewhat popular. At the beginning of the series, he did not empathize with Suguru, but Suguru invites Yuuki to stay over for new year's in his house; subsequently Suguru begins to perturb Yuuki by giving him the nickname "Yukichi". Yuuki becomes the president of the Student Council of Hanadera due to his neutral personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizuka Kanina
characters.description: Also known as Rosa Canina (for the Dog Rose), she is the star singer of the school choir. Yumi meets her without knowing that she was the candidate running against the Yamayurikai. She admired Sei greatly and it was revealed that she was in love with her schoolmate, yet she never tells Sei her feelings because she knows they will be met with rejection. Later on it is shown that she has also found an interest in Sei's petite soeur, Shimako. Possibly because she wanted to know what sort of girl the elusive and lonely Sei decided to choose as a soeur. Sei confronts her and asks Shizuka if she would have preferred to have been her soeur, and Shizuka sadly admits that she would not have, and wanted something else from Sei. She left Lillian at the end of her second year to pursue a singing career in Italy. Shizuka meets Yumi again in Italy during the Lillian school trip, and she takes her

characters.name: Suguru Kashiwagi
characters.description: The cousin and arranged fiance of Sachiko; in order that a trusted man inherit the Ogasawara company, their engagement was arranged, although Sachiko detests it and denies that he is her fiancé. (It is later revealed that Sachiko once loved him and had her feelings spurned, which resulted in her disdain.) First introduced when he is given the role of the prince in Cinderella: the joint play put on by the Hanadera school and Lillian Jogakuen. He has prestige in the Hanadera school since he is president of the Student Council there. However, by the time Sachiko reaches her third year, Suguru has already graduated. ~!He is gay, and has a crush on Yumi's younger brother, Yuuki. He is often seen in the company of Yuuki, taking him along on trips and gatherings, doting on him much in the way that Sachiko dotes on Yumi. He is very arrogant, and is especially disliked by Satou Sei, as both are o

characters.name: Shiori Kubo
characters.description: Sei Satō's ex-lover and best friend who was Sachiko Ogasawara's classmate. Her parents died when she was young. She left Lillian in her first year to pursue her dream of becoming a nun, which broke Sei's heart. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Lycoris Recoil (Shinsaku Animation)
title_original: リコリス・リコイル 新作アニメーション
description: Lycoris Recoil new anime project. Note: Title and Relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

title: Zombie Land Saga: Yume Ginga Paradise
title_original: ゾンビランドサガ ゆめぎんがパラダイス
description: Can zombie idols save Saga—and the world!? In the year 2025, Earth is abuzz with excitement over the Saga Expo. Franchouchou is appointed as the event’s ambassador and begins preparing for the main event: a grand live performance at the SAGA Arena. But suddenly, a massive spaceship appears in the skies above Saga and launches a full-scale attack across the prefecture. The members of Franchouchou are thrown into panic. Is there really nothing ordinary idols can do in the face of such a crisis…? Just then, the legendary Tae Yamada—the only one who hadn’t regained her self-awareness as a zombie—awakens. Declaring her departure from Franchouchou, she heads alone into enemy territory to put an end to the invasion. Can the now-splintered Franchouchou come together once more, restore their bond, and save Saga!? (Source: Official website, translated)

characters.name: Sakura Minamoto
characters.description: __Year of death:__ April 7, 2008 __Cause of death:__ Collision with a pickup truck on her way to an idol audition Before becoming a zombie, Sakura was an ordinary girl with nothing special going on in her life. She is shown to be an energetic girl and becomes very passionate whenever she is singing as an idol. ~!When she regains her memories of her life but loses her memories of her Zombification, Sakura becomes very defeatist and detached due to the failures she kept facing in life no matter how hard she tried. After she regained all of her memories with the encouragement of her friends she regains her confidence and her love of performing.!~

characters.name: Saki Nikaidou
characters.description: __Death:__ August 30, 1997 Formerly a biker who conquered the entire Kyushu with her biker gang Dorami. Saki has a tough and rebellious attitude, calling [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) a goody-two-shoes, and outright stating that she has no respect for those who don't have guts. However, after a successful performance, Saki takes being an idol very seriously and becomes leader of Franchouchou. Saki also occasionally shows a soft side, as seen in episode 6 where she comforts [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/127539). When she was alive, she was fond of her Tamagotchi and enjoys going to Drive in Tori. ~!She died in a game of Chicken against a rival Biker Gang driving over a cliff.!~

characters.name: Ai Mizuno
characters.description: __Death:__ August 4, 2008 She was a popular idol in the early 2000s from the idol group called Iron Frill. ~! __Cause of death:__ struck by lightning during a concert. Because of how she died, she is afraid of lighting. !~ When alive, Ai demonstrated a cheerful and determined personality, but after becoming a zombie she became rather skeptical and suspicious. As she gradually begins to warm up to her group, she begins to act like herself. She has shown a supportive side when aiding the other members with her idol experience.

characters.name: Junko Konno
characters.description: __Death:__ December 9, 1983 __Height:__ 155cm (5'1") Konno Junko was an idol from the 80s whose popularity caused the idol boom of said decade. She died in 1983 on a plane crash. She is titled as the Legendary Showa Idol. Junko seems to be calm, collected, little shy, but also a little serious if not daring. This serious side is shown when she tries to escape the mansion, collaborates with [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/127538) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) in going in the Hot Springs, and when it comes to idols. She seems prone to panic whenever something disturbing happens. Because of the different time period she lived in, her views of Idols contrast from modern times.

characters.name: Tae Yamada
characters.description: A mysterious girl with an unknown past, titled only as the Legendary Tae Yamada. She is the only one of the girls who has not fully regained consciousness, and so has remained a mindless zombie. As such, Tae is unpredictable and driven by pure instinct, doing things such as biting at the other members and launching herself at the crowd. However, she does seem to have some semblance of awareness, being able to at least understand the members to some degree and be cooperative enough to participate in the practices and performances.

characters.name: Yuugiri
characters.description: __Death:__ December 28, 1882 Yuugiri was a high-ranking courtesan from the Meiji era. After being resurrected from the dead, she becomes a member of the zombie idol group, Franchouchou. Yuugiri remains very calm and traditional in various situations, probably due to the period in which she lived and where she worked. Despite this, she seems to calmly accept and adapt to the changes in modern Japanese society. Every time she sees someone depressed, she physically hits people to get them out of their mood. The problem is that most of the time, they have already recovered when Yuugiri slaps them and tells them exactly what they were trying to say. Although she is not immune from freaking out around others, she is generally able to remain calm and composed in most of her outlandish situations, which is even more impressive because she is the oldest of the group. In reality, she has never bee

characters.name: Lily Hoshikawa
characters.description: ~! __Death:__ November 30, 2011 __Cause of death:__ mental shock from growing a facial hair !~ Lily is often seen with a smile, and due to her young age, is shown to be quite playful as well. She has also demonstrated a professional aspect from her experiences before her death.

characters.name: Koutarou Tatsumi
characters.description: He is the energetic producer of the idol group Franchouchou. He's the one who resurrected the girls from different eras as zombies to be part of his idol group. ~!He seems to have known [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540/Minamoto-Sakura) in high school!~

characters.name: Romero
characters.description: Koutarou's pet zombie dog. Supposedly a toy poodle, although according to various people his size always seems to change. Being a zombie dog, Romero can gobble up food that would be bad for most dogs. His favorite food is cuttlefish. His gender is male. *Never feed dried squids to living dogs!

characters.name: Suenaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") Although he is more of a threat to zombies than he realizes they are to him, his reasons for repeatedly trying to kill them on sight are perfectly understandable, as he is just an ordinary, generally affable, scared cop.

characters.name: Maria  Amabuki
characters.description: Daughter of [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/150564/Reiko-Amabuki) and modern leader of Dorami Biker Gang. ~!In [Season 2](https://anilist.co/anime/110733/ZOMBIE-LAND-SAGA-REVENGE/) she has rebranded Dorami into a dance group.!~

characters.name: Maimai Yuzuriha
characters.description: One of Franchouchou's avid fans. Maimai appears to be a second year high school student belonging to Class 2-3 of her school. ~!After having been fetched along by [Koutarou](https://anilist.co/character/127543/Tatsumi-Koutarou) after an accident in the bath house, Maimai is the first outsider to figure out Franchouchou’s hidden identity as zombies. Additionally, she is also the first and only temporary member of the group. With her being the temporary "Zombie" #7, but she realized they were too different from her, and therefore left the group after their first performance together.!~

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear XV
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギアXV
description: Humanity is finally confronted with the threat of the Custodians—the ancient, sentient species held responsible for cursing humanity to speak different languages thousands of years ago. The Symphogear wielders—Hibiki Tachibana, Tsubasa Kazanari, Chris Yukine, Maria Cadenzavna Eve, Kirika Akatsuki, and Shirabe Tsukuyomi—are sent to the Antarctic in order to retrieve an ancient relic. After securing it and rescuing the scientific staff present there from a Coffin, the automated defense mechanism protecting it, the relic is given to American researchers due to international agreements. The criminal organization Noble Red, a remnant of the previously fought Bavarian Illuminati, starts targeting the relic. Will the Symphogear wielders and their supporting organization S.O.N.G. be able to foil the plans of the organizations conspiring against them? (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve
characters.original: マリア・カデンツァヴナ・イブ
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Black Gungnir ~!__Symphogear post G:__ Airgetlám!~ An energetic singer who reached the top of the American music charts about 2 months after her debut. Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Kanade Amou
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/51733/Kazanari-Tsubasa).

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Shinji Ogawa
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari; he works as Tsubasa's manager on the scenes.

characters.name: Sakuya Fujitaka
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.name: Aoi Tomosato
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

title: Strike Witches 2
title_original: ストライクウィッチーズ 2
description: After discovering that Neuroi are capable of communication with humans and making peace with the nest above Gallia the Witches squads are now on a mission to re-establish communication when a sudden attack vanishes the Neuroi; they now discover a new and massive nest that just appeared covering almost all Europe. Ruthless and without mercy it annihilates allied forces along with Witches. Word of the attack reaches Fuso and a support battalion is deployed to rescue the survivors. Among the rescue team is the former Striker captain Mio Sakamoto and the now civilian Yoshika Miyafuji who want to save their dear friends. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Yoshika Miyafuji
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11'') The main character of the series, age fifteen and hailing from the Fuso Empire. A typical young girl who comes from a family of clinicians who use their magic powers to heal people. Yoshika gains the features of a mame-shiba when using said power. Her father designed the Striker Units the Strike Witches use to fight. However, because her father died in the war she is vehemently against fighting when [Mio Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/7627/Sakamoto-Mio) appears to recruit her. Only after entering combat for the first time, helping to defend the Fuso fleet heading to Britannia from a Neuroi attack, does she decide to join the 501st. Now she holds the rank of Sergeant. Yoshika has a talent for cooking, but tends to care more about her food's health benefits than its taste, such as when she introduced the other Witches to natto. Carries a 13mm Type99 Mach

characters.name: Mio Sakamoto
characters.description: The first Strike Witch and sub-commander of the unit, with the commissioned rank of Squadron Leader and official rank of Major. Mio is also the oldest witch at nineteen (later, twenty) years old and, like Yoshika, comes from Fuso. She is seemingly the toughest and most mature of the Witches, being an experienced veteran of the early fighting against the Neuroi. She knew Yoshika's father while he was first designing the Striker Unit and was the first person to pilot one. Her usual task is to train new recruits, and in this role she becomes a very strict disciplinarian, appropriately gaining the ears and tail of a Doberman when equipped with her Striker. Otherwise she is quite friendly, if a little too forward at times, with a very distinct laugh. Under Mio's eyepatch is a magic eye that grants her increased visual prowess and the ability to spot Neuroi cores when used. Being 19/20 years o

characters.name: Perrine H. Clostermann
characters.original: ぺリーヌ・クロステルマン
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (4'9") A wealthy and proper fifteen year old Gallian girl who looks down on some of the less-refined habits of her peers. The emotional scars left by the Neuroi's destruction of her homeland cause her numerous problems. She often refuses to work as a team, and develops something of a dislike for the upstart newcomer Yoshika due to her attachment to Mio. When wearing her Striker Unit, she gains the dark ears and tail of a Chartreux. Perrine holds the rank of Flying Officer and her original unit was the Armée de l'Air 802nd Flying Corps. Carries a rapier into battle along with a Bren light machine-gun. Her Striker Unit is based on the Arsenal VG 39 and she is named after Pierre Clostermann.

characters.name: Lynette Bishop
characters.original: リネット・ビショップ
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Fifteen years old, Lynette is the only Witch in the 501st who is native to the Britannia Federation. The middle child of eight sisters, Lynette developed very domestic and practical habits from helping to take care of her siblings. Similarly domestic is the Scottish Fold, from which her Striker-equipped animal features are based. Plagued by occasional clumsiness and sometimes overlooked, she nevertheless strives to do her best. Holds the rank of Sergeant and her affiliation is the Royal Air Force 610th Fighter Squadron. Her armaments are a Mk. I Boys Anti-tank Rifle and a Bren light machine gun. She serves as the squadron's sharpshooter and possesses an almost magical degree of eyesight similar to Mio's. Her Striker Unit is based on the Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX, and her pilot archetype is Billy Bishop. Lynette also has an older sister, Wilma, who is also a Strike Wit

characters.name: Charlotte E Yeager
characters.original: シャーロット・E・イェーガー
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm A sixteen year old girl hailing from the United States of Liberion with the rank of Flight Leiutenant. Magnanimous in character and buxom in appearance, Charlotte is a thrill-seeker who is fascinated by speed. Like a speedy hare, she gains the ears and tail of a rabbit when equipped with her Striker. Concerned with cleanliness, Charlotte had her personal bath transported all the way to the Strike Witches' Britannia base when she was transferred from the Liberion Army 363rd Fighter Wing. In combat her armament can consist of a M1918 Browning Automatic Rifle, Thompson M1 A1, or Colt Government M1911 A1. The P-51D Mustang serves as the basis for her Striker Unit, while she herself is based on Chuck Yeager. ~!Near the end of episode 5, she broke the sound barrier at 1200 km/h (Mach 1), although she ended up ramming through a Neuroi (and destroying it) thereafter.!~

characters.name: Eila Ilmatar Juutilainen
characters.original: エイラ・イルマタル・ユーティライネン
characters.description: The fifteen year old top ace of the Suomus Air Force 24th Unit with the rank of Flying Officer. Eila's hobby is fortune-telling with tarot cards, although the accuracy of her predictions is questionable at best. Somewhat mischievous, like the black fox whose features she gains in flight. She has a talent for analyzing the thoughts and feelings of her companions, and this skill translates well to the battlefield where her judgment is used to consistently outwit her opponents. In combat her weapons of choice are the MG42 and Suomi M1931 submachine gun. Eila's Striker Unit is based on the Messerschmitt Bf-109G-2 and she herself is based on Eino Ilmari Juutilainen.

characters.name: Francesca Lucchini
characters.original: フランチェスカ・ルッキーニ
characters.description: **Height:** 148 cm Joining the 501st from the Duchy of Romagna, Francesca is the youngest soldier of the unit at a mere twelve years.
