Her rank is that of a Warrant officer and her unit affiliation was with Romagna's Regia Aeronautica 4th Air Unit. Francesca is often childish and self-indulgent, shirking training and other duties in order to have fun around the base or nap. However, in battle she displays a true talent and passion for flying. Also displayed are the ears and tail of a black leopard. Good friends with the similarly casual Charlotte. During battles she carries a M1919 A6, Breda-SAFAT 12.7 mm machine gun, or Beretta Model 1938A. Her Striker Unit is based on the G.55 Centauro, and her ace archetype is Franco Lucchini.

characters.name: Minna-Dietlinde Wilcke
characters.original: ミーナ・ディートリンデ・ヴィルケ
characters.description: The ranking officer of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing at eighteen years old, Minna has a sisterly air that shows her concern for those under her command. Whether in or out of battle, her first priority is the safety of her subordinates. Her more gentle demeanor means that she often acts as the "good cop" to Mio's "bad cop" when it comes to discipline. Alluding to her namesake, Minna gains wolf features when equipped for combat. Holds the commissioned rank of Wing commander, official rank of Lieutenant Colonel, and her affiliation is the Karlsland JG 3 Luftwaffe. During combat she arms herself with an MG42. Her Striker Unit model is the Messerschmitt Bf-109G-2 and her ace pilot archetype is Wolf-Dietrich Wilcke. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Erica Hartmann
characters.original: エーリカ・ハルトマン
characters.description: Karlsland's sixteen year old "ultra ace" of the Luftwaffe JG 52 with more than 200 confirmed victories and the rank of Flying Officer. While extremely efficient and strategic in battle, Erica is surprisingly sloppy with her belongings and often neglects cleaning tasks. With her Striker Unit equipped, Erica gains Dachshund features. A serious individual. Her armaments are the MG42 and a MP40. Her Striker Unit is based on the Messerschmitt Bf-109G-6 and her ace archetype is Erich Hartmann. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gertrud Barkhorn
characters.original: ゲルトルート・バルクホルン
characters.description: Eighteen year old Witch from Karlsland; a Flight Lieutenant formerly of the Luftwaffe JG 52. Quiet, efficient, and private, Gertrud tends to support her comrades from the shadows. Her naturally calm attitude grants her great battlefield stamina, allowing her to rack up an impressive shot-down tally. A long-time acquaintance of Minna and Erica, she is often seen supporting the former. In flight she gains the features of a German Wirehaired Pointer. For battle her armament consists of an MG42, MG131, or MG151 which she dual wields. Her Striker Unit is based on the Focke-Wulf Fw 190D-6 and her pilot archetype is Gerhard Barkhorn. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sanya V. Litvyak
characters.original: サーニャ・V・リトヴャク
characters.description: The single Witch out of the Orussia Empire at thirteen years old. Preferring to stay indoors during the day, Sanya has been described as "nocturnal." At times she is literally asleep on her feet, counting on [Eila](https://anilist.co/character/7631/Juutilainen-Eila-Ilmatar) to move her around. Despite this somewhat limiting her contact with the other members of the 501st, her low profile makes her ideal for night missions and sneak attacks. Gains the ears and tail of a black cat with her Striker Unit equipped. Sanya's rank is Flying Officer and her original unit affiliation is the Orussia Imperial Army 586th Fighter Regiment. Her weapon of choice is a modified Fliegerfaust called the "Fliegerhummer." Her Striker Unit design is based on the MiG60 (a fictional warbird combining features of the MiG-1, MiG-3, and Yakovlev Yak-1) and her pilot archetype is Lydia Litvyak.

characters.name: Amaki Suwa
characters.description: Amaki Suwa is a Strike Witch in the Army Air Force 47th Squadron. ~!Appeared in episode 12 of the anime. Like Yoshika, she is a Witch from Fuso. She gives Yoshika a letter from her father Dr. Miyafuji, but whether or not this means he is alive is unclear. This scene was repeated in episode 1 of the Strike Witches 2.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Zatsu Tabi: That's Journey
description: When aspiring manga artist Chika’s storyboards get rejected, she ditches her desk for an adventure! Armed with a quirky social media poll, she sets off on a spontaneous journey of random crowdsourced destinations. From hilarious mishaps to heartwarming encounters, Chika discovers inspiration, friendship, and herself, one unpredictable stop at a time. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Based on the real life travels of mangaka Chika Suzugamori.

characters.name: Chika Suzugamori
characters.description: [Twitter](https://x.com/suzugamori2) Draws the manga [Ashita no Ashita](https://anilist.co/manga/178185/Ashita-no-Ashita/) .

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

title: Tenchi Muyou!
description: Tenchi Masaki may be a 17-year-old young man in rural Japan, but little does he know how bad his day will be getting. When a space pirate chased by a pair of Galaxy Police officers crash-lands at his grandfather's temple, Tenchi is sucked into a new adventure that will literally blast him off into outer space and beyond. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Tenchi Masaki
characters.description: A young man from Okayama Prefecture; his grandfather, Katsuhito Masaki, is a Shinto priest who drilled swordsmanship into him. His life—filled with cosmic-scale trouble and a chaotic communal existence involving various beautiful women—begins after he breaks the seal on Ryouko, a legendary demon his grandfather had imprisoned seven hundred years prior.

characters.name: Washu Hakubi
characters.description: Washu Hakubi, the greatest scientific genius in the universe, is a key character in the Tenchi Muyo! metaseries. In the Tenchi Muyo OVA Washu is one of the Chousin; three sister goddesses who created the multiverse, the other two being, Tsunami and Tokimi In the Magical Girl Pretty Sammy OVA, she is an Earth child prodigy known as Washu Kobayashi. Graduating from M.I.T. at eleven years old, she became the high school science teacher at Raioh Academy. In Magical Project S, Washu Fitzgerald Kobayashi is an American and. She is a teacher at Sasami school and the first human to be fully aware of Sasami's secret identity as Pretty Sammy and only moved in next door to Sasami's house to keep an eye on Sasami and analyze her magic for research purposes.

characters.name: Ryouko Hakubi
characters.description: Ryoko Hakubi is a main character in the Tenchi Muyo! metaseries. She is a semi-reformed space pirate who is madly in love with [Tenchi Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/274/Masaki-Tenchi), the main protagonist. She is always shown to have a very competitive relationship with [Princess Ayeka](https://anilist.co/character/5724/Masaki-Jurai-Ayeka), who also has a very strong romantic interest in Tenchi. In the Tenchi Muyo OVA Ryoko is a binary clone, the product of combining the DNA from an ova of [Washu Hakubi](https://anilist.co/character/2404/Hakubi-Washu) with the DNA of a powerful aquatic lifeform, known as Masu. In the Pretty Sammy OVA, Ryoko appears as a schoolgirl, Ryoko Orikasa, a yankee. She and Ayeka constantly bicker over Tenchi Kawai's affections. ~!In the Pretty Sammy TV series, Ryoko appears in the last few episodes starting with episode 23 as Oryo, or "Overly Splendid" Or

characters.name: Mihoshi Kuramitsu
characters.description: A First-Class Detective with the Galaxy Police, she is known as a "genius of coincidence"—inexplicable phenomena tend to occur around her for some reason. She headed to Earth to apprehend a criminal but met with an accident, leading her to become a live-in guest at the Masaki household. In anime installments other than Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki, she has a partner named Kiyone. She and Kiyone—who is level-headed (though prone to sudden outbursts of passion)—form a duo whose "straight man/funny man" dynamic rivals that of professional stand-up comedians; their interactions feature perfectly timed banter, complete with Kiyone’s trademark slaps and Mihoshi’s evasive maneuvers. In Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki, her partner is Noike Sakutsuki. Their relationship is best described as that of a "highly capable, perfect older sister" (Noike) and a "ditzy younger sister" (Mihoshi).

characters.name: Sasami Masaki Jurai
characters.description: Sasami is a key character in the Tenchi Muyo! metaseries as well as the protagonist of her own various non-canonical spinoffs. In the Tenchi continuities, Sasami is the younger sister of [Ayeka](https://anilist.co/character/5724/Masaki-Jurai-Ayeka) and so is also a princess of the planet Jurai. Within the Masaki extended family, Sasami usually takes on the dual role of younger sister/mother. She may be the most responsible of the group and takes care of all the cooking duties. Sasami has appeared in every Tenchi Muyo! series, as well as/including several spinoffs based around her as the central protagonist. In almost every incarnation her personality, background, primary outfits, relationships, and abilities change. In some incarnations, her art style is altered more than others, though her basic coloring and structure remaining the same. In the Pretty Sammy series Sasami is called Sasam

characters.name: Ayeka Masaki Jurai
characters.description: __Height:__ 161cm She is the First Princess of the planet Jurai. By blood, she is the great-aunt of the protagonist, Tenchi. A princess who had been searching for her fiancé—who was also her older half-brother, Youshou—after he went missing following a battle with Ryouko, a space pirate who had attacked Jurai. Driven by her longing for Youshou—and terrified by the fact that he was on the verge of being declared legally dead, leading to a flood of political marriage proposals that threatened to force her into a union against her will—she fled Jurai aboard her ship. She entrusted the ship's control to the Royal Tree governing the vessel and her personal guardians, Azaka and Kamidake, instructing them to "wake me up if you find a clue about my brother," before entering cold sleep and drifting through space as a self-imposed recluse. She eventually arrived on Earth, where she encountered Ryo

characters.name: Kiyone Makibi
characters.description: __Height:__ 174cm A Class-1 Detective with the Galaxy Police. She appears as Mihoshi's partner. Across all her appearances, she remains a long-suffering voice of reason who constantly finds herself in dire straits after being dragged into Mihoshi's antics—specifically, Mihoshi's extreme airheadedness (or "probability skew," to use the series' terminology). She was originally a brilliant, cool, and beautiful career woman—albeit a rather rigid one—but her luck ran out when she met and was partnered with Mihoshi. As she was constantly pushed around by Mihoshi's outrageous behavior, she strayed far from her elite career path and eventually devolved into a bit of a bungler herself. Consequently, she makes no secret of her hostility toward her partner, often snapping, "I'm going to kill her someday!" Yet, Mihoshi's airheaded antics inevitably disarm her and sap her will to kill, leaving her to

characters.name: Ryououki
characters.description: Ryououki is a cabbit: A cross between a cat and a rabbit. Overall, Ryououki personality, traits and abilities vary greatly depending from series to series, but they usually include shapeshifting and a love for carrots. In Tenchi Muyo! Ryououki, Ryououki is a unique artificial lifeform created by the universe's greatest scientist, Washu. Following an incident later in, she gains the ability to shift to two humanoid forms — a child form and an adult form. In the Tenchi Universe continuity, Ryououki is not a product of Washu. Her origin is not explained as a scientific experience, but rather as an animal species In Pretty Sammy series, Ryououki is male and has the ability to talk in the same language as Sasami. His real form is actually of a humanoid boy with physical features resembling a cabbit.

characters.name: Nobuyuki Masaki
characters.description: Nobuyuki is the father of Tenchi Masaki. He works as an architect.

characters.name: Katsuhito Masaki
characters.description: Tenchi Masaki's grandfather. He serves as the head priest of the Masaki Shrine. While he acts as a strict grandfather toward Tenchi, he also possesses a kind heart and watches over him with care. Although he usually appears laid-back, he is a brilliant strategist and proves to be more reliable than anyone else in times of crisis. ~!In reality, he is the Crown Prince of the planet Jurai, and his true name is Masaki Yousho Jurai. He maintains a youthful appearance thanks to Funaho's power, meaning his elderly appearance is merely a disguise. He had been missing for 700 years after pursuing Ryoko, but he was actually living in hiding on Earth. Incidentally, the deity enshrined at the shrine he manages—"Masaki Amato"—is actually himself.!~

characters.name: Kagato Jurai
characters.description: Kagato Jurai was once a swordsman whose skill was well renowned throughout the Jurai empire. Some said that if things hadn't turned out the way they did, Kagato might have been renowned as Jurai's greatest swordsman. But Kagato had became overly obsessed with refining his own Jurai power, and challenged many people to duels... and won. As his obsession grew, he began to lose more and more of himself. Finally, his brother Youshou had challenged him, in which Youshou had won. Kagato had later disappeared into the darkness of the galaxy, building his own dark Jurai power until he felt he could return to Jurai and claim the throne. By then, Youshou had already left Jurai for Earth.

characters.name: Nagi
characters.description: Nagi is a bounty hunter with a fierce reputation who has lost but one target in her distinguished career — the space pirate Ryouko — and wishes to wipe that blemish off an otherwise perfect record. Traveling with her cabbit Ken-Ohki, Nagi makes a living hunting down wanted criminals in the galaxy. So far, she has only one quarry to have eluded her - Ryouko. She had tracked the space pirate to Earth, where she had taken Tenchi Masaki hostage, thinking he and Ryouko were lovers. Originally, the two were to fight in space, but a complication occurred, Ken-Ohki and Ryou-Ohki had fallen in love and would not fire upon each other. So a "wild west" setting was created by Washuu on the planet Venus so that the two would fight it out. It ended with Ryouko about to kill Nagi, but the cabbits intervened; Ken-Ohki threatening to fight and Ryou-Ohki begging her to spare Nagi. So

title: Yuru Yuri Nachuyachumi!+
title_original: ゆるゆり　なちゅやちゅみ！＋
description: Two new Yuru Yuri Nachuyachumi! episodes that aired on TV in 2015 with an episode in August and another in September. Summer vacation is drawing to a close, but the Amusement Club members make the most of the last days. Between outdoor activities in the sun, reminiscing on their recent camping trip, and a sleepover, the members of the Amusement Club, and their classmates in the student council, continue to make summer memories.

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Rise Matsumoto
characters.description: The current student council president who has very little presence and often speaks in a whispery quiet voice that only a few people such as [Nana](https://anilist.co/character/45529/Nishigaki-Nana) can understand.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sakurako's older sister. She's always quiet and has a cool demeanor. ~!Nadeshiko is dating a girl, whose identity is currently unknown; it is one of the main mysteries of the Ohmuro-ke manga. It is hinted that the girlfriend might be one of her three classmates –with whom she is on good terms with– after a phone call that revealed that the two girls visit the same school.!~

characters.name: Hanako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 127 cm Sakurako's younger sister who is an elementary school student.

title: Harmony
description: In the future, utopia has finally been achieved thanks to medical nanotechnology and a powerful ethic of social welfare and mutual consideration. This utopia isn't perfect, and three young girls stand up to totalitarian kindness and super-medicine by attempting suicide via starvation. It doesn't work, but one of the girls—Tuan Kirie—grows up to be a member of the World Health Organization. As a crisis threatens the harmony of the new world, Tuan rediscovers another member of her suicide pact, and together they must help save the planet...from itself. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Miach Mihie
characters.description: Miach is one of Tuan's best high school friends. She is brilliant and intelligent, who doesn't agree with present world. Her personality is that of a calm and philosophical girl; she is very charismatic and capable of manipulating those around her to an impressive extent. She was a problem student with the best grades in the class, who only conversed with Tuan and Cian. Miach is the one who influenced them in order attempt suicide as the ultimate act of rebellion against the world.

characters.name: Tuan Kirie
characters.description: Tuan Kirie is a Helix Inspector for the Japanese branch of the Admedistration, which governs society. She spends most of her time on peacekeeping missions to escape the stultifying nature of the normal world. ~!In her past she had entered a suicide pact with her two friends Miach Mihie and Cian Reikado into to rebel against society, but only Miach died.!~

characters.name: OsCara Stauffenberg
characters.original: オスカー・シュタウフェンベルク
characters.description: Chief Inspector at the WHO.

characters.name: Elijah Vashlov
characters.description: Special Agent for Interpol

characters.name: Cian Reikadou
characters.description: A high school friend of Tuan and Miach.

characters.name: Nuada Kirie
characters.description: Tuan's father

title: Ochikobore Fruit Tart
title_original: おちこぼれフルーツタルト
description: Former showbiz stars Roko, Hayu, and Nina live together in a dormitory for dropout idol girls. As timing would have it, young dreamer Sakura happens to move in with the other girls just as an announcement is made to tear down the dorm due to a 100-million-yen debt! This leads to the unexpected formation of a new idol group called Fruit Tart. Their sole mission: earn some yen and stop the demolition. (Source: Funimation)

characters.name: Hemo Midori
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Chiba, Japan __Height:__ 145 cm A third-year middle school student, Hemo was a former Cat Productions idol prospect, now signed on as a promising new addition to Rat Productions. She is intensely devoted to [Ino](https://anilist.co/character/164772/Sakura-Ino). Shy and soft-spoken, Hemo is a polite girl who looks up to the members of Rat Productions and is seemingly capable of performing her duties as a new idol. However, she also has a strong fixation on Ino and can be extremely defensive if anyone attempts to harm her, be it verbally or physically. In fact, her infatuation is so intense that she considers her morning ritual of helping Ino cook breakfast, and slowly taking in the same fresh morning air that Ino breathes, as a form of "lovemaking.

characters.name: Nina Maehara
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Kanagawa, Japan __Height:__ 170 cm (Self-described) Nina is a member of Rat Production's idol group, Fruit Tart, and is in charge of costumes. Ever since she was a little girl, she had been a fashion model for western-style clothes. But now at age sixteen, Nina's height increased - and continues to increase - rapidly. This resulted in difficulty finding work as a model in Japan since such in-demand fashion clothes could barely fit her. She is sometimes the biggest draw of Fruit Tart, owing mostly to her physical appearance and not necessarily because of her singing or dancing. Somewhat the antithesis of [Roko](https://anilist.co/character/164773/Sekino-Roko), Nina is seen as timid and soft-spoken, and just as likely prone to tears whenever she is put on the spot. Like Roko, she is sensitive about her stature and had somehow developed a love for small things as a way to c

characters.name: Hayu Nukui
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm She is a a classmate of [Ino](https://anilist.co/character/164772/Sakura-Ino) at their high school. Coming from a wealthy family in Kanagawa, Hayu had decided to pursue becoming a musician against her father's wishes. As a result, she was forced to survive on her own at Nezumi House, and work as a talent for Rat Productions. Now a current member of Fruit Tart, Hayu helps write the group's song compositions along with Ino. While a terrible singer, Hayu is nevertheless passionate about working to become an idol. Charismatic and fun to be around, Hayu's tomboyish attitude perfectly matches her image as a rock musician. However, deep down she retains her feminine side, secretly reading comics for girls and holding on to her childhood dream of wanting to become a cute, blushing bride. Hayu's personality is thus a product of an overbearing mother and a father who had disowne

characters.name: Ino Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm She's a first-year in high school. One of her favorite things is cooking. She's not good at dieting. Raised in the countryside somewhere in Okayama, a prefecture some 350 miles west from Tokyo, Ino had always been surrounded by farm life. Like many children with humble upbringings, she had yearned to become someone big, and after watching Brocco perform on television, Ino knew she wanted to sing and dance just like her. Years passed, and when Ino turned fifteen, she finally made the move to Tokyo as a new idol for Rat Productions. Although far from being the stereotypical "girl from the sticks," Ino nevertheless holds a somewhat romanticized view of Tokyo, one where the scenery is filled with nothing but giant skyscrapers, and where high school girls flocking to karaoke parlors after school is the norm. Perhaps due to being raised in the laid-back environment of the co

characters.name: Roko Sekino
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm Roko is a second-year high school student and a former child actor who struggles to find work. She was once loved by many for her role in a popular series of broccoli commercials. Known by many TV viewers as "Brocco," Roko had joined Rat Productions after forcing herself out of the agency that kept pushing her to play the same character, which was already seven years passed its prime. After Fruit Tart was formed, Roko would eventually learn that she was in fact the group's leader. Roko has a younger sister named [Chiko](https://anilist.co/character/168416/Sekino-Chiko), who is a member of Cat Production's idol group, Cream Anmitsu. While her days of performing as a child actor are over, Roko has a tendency to still act rather childish and be brought to tears whenever something annoys her, such as the constant teasing from her sister, Chiko. She can be somewhat hostile

characters.name: Hoho Kajino
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Hoho is a manager for Rat Productions and a totally unreliable adult. A twenty-five-year-old employee for the Rat Productions agency, Hoho is a manager who represents individuals wishing to make it big in the entertainment world. She is also the caretaker of a company dorm called Nezumi House, where her talents [Roko](https://anilist.co/character/164773/Sekino-Roko), [Hayu](https://anilist.co/character/164771/Nukui-Hayu), and [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/164770/Maehara-Nina) also live. However, because the three never found work while staying there, a decision was eventually made by the company to sell off the dorm. With even her own living situation at stake, Hoho quickly rounded up an idol prospect named [Ino](https://anilist.co/character/164772/Sakura-Ino) and brought her to Nezumi House. She would then reveal to the girls that they had to form a new idol gro

title: Mouretsu Pirates
description: When Marika Katou learns that her late father was the captain of a pirate ship, it’s the second biggest surprise of her life. The biggest? Learning that his crew needs her to take over her father’s old job due to the terms of their Privateer’s contract! It looks like joining her school’s yacht club is certainly about to pay off for Marika, because who wants to go into space piracy without a bunch of friends their own age to keep it fun? Toss in some outer space rivals, princesses in peril, and a pirate crew pulling double duty as high school teachers, and the next voyage of the good ship Benten Maru is going to be one of the wildest adventures ever! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Marika Katou
characters.description: First year student of Hakuhou Girls Academy at Umi no Akehoshi. She is a member of the Yacht Club. Marika was a normal high school girl with positive attitude and good grades, but suddenly one day she was requested to become the Captain for pirate ship Benten Maru. She has many friends due to her cheerful character.

characters.name: Chiaki Kurihara
characters.description: Mysterious girl who transfers into Hakuhou Girls Academy from the branch school at Umi no Morihoshi. For some reasons she can manipulate computers as weapons and other things, and she knew a lot regarding the state of the pirates. ~!Like Marika, she is the daughter of a famous pirate captain, the captain of the _Barbalusa_.!~

characters.name: Gruier Serenity
characters.original: グリューエル・セレニティ
characters.description: The 7th Imperial Princess of Serenity Planet Commonwealth royal family. A clarion person with great nobility, but being raised as a princess, she is estranged to daily routines. ~!left the imperial palace in search of the ghost ship, it is said one of the first colony ships. Adventure is finished, choose to join the crew of Bentenmaru. !~

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

characters.name: Mami Endou
characters.description: Marika's closest school friend and a co-worker at the retro-maid cafe, she has a thing for cosplay given that in ep 16 where she prepared the outfits that were used by the yacht club members whom are in their first pirating job aboard the Princess Apricot.

characters.name: Ririka Katou
characters.description: Marika's mother and Gonzaemon's former wife, who was once a space pirate herself known as "Blaster Ririka". Marika rarely calls her "Mother", instead calling her by her given name. However, Marika does call her "Mother" when she's serious. While no longer a space pirate, she now works as an Air Traffic Controller.

characters.name: Misa Grandwood
characters.original: ミーサ・グランドウッド
characters.description: The Bentenmaru's medic. At Hakuho Academy, she is the school's doctor.

characters.name: Kane MacDougall
characters.original: ケイン・マクドゥガル
characters.description: He's the Bentenmaru's helmsman, he is also a school teacher in Hakuhou Girls Academy and the adviser of the school's yacht club. ~!It is revealed in ep.25 that he has a twin brother who is also a helmsman on board the Parabellum his name is Shane McDougal.!~

characters.name: Hyakume
characters.description: He's the Bentenmaru's radar and sensor operator and he's also the ship's technical analyst.

characters.name: Coorie
characters.description: The Bentenmaru's electronic warfare specialist. ~!Actually she is quite pretty but prefer to keep her "nerdy" image most of the time. She change it to normal only in special cases such as negotiations with suppliers.!~

characters.name: Schnitzer
characters.description: A cyborg and close friend of Ririka. (Source: Wikipedia) He's also in charge of weapons and security of Bentenmaru.

characters.name: Luca
characters.description: She is the navigator of the pirate ship Bentenmaru.

title: Kimi no Hikari: Asagao to Kase-san.
title_original: キミノヒカリ ～あさがおと加瀬さん。～
title_en: Your Light: Kase-san and Morning Glories
description: Yamada may be shy and rather clumsy, but the flower gardens at her school have always brought her happiness. Suddenly, a different sort of beauty catches her eye—the vivacious track star, Kase-san. Although the two girls don't seem to have much in common, they soon start a romance where each must learn an important lesson in tending their budding relationship. Can the two girls, so different from each other, learn how to make their first love blossom? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Yui Yamada
characters.description: A quiet girl who is in charge of greenification. She's poor at sports and singing.

characters.name: Tomoka Kase
characters.description: A popular and handsome girl in the class next door to [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/125397)'s. She's the ace of the track and field club.

characters.name: Mikawa
characters.description: Yamada's classmate and best friend. She's in the tennis club. She can't handle the sight of blood well.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai 2
title_original: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会 2
title_en: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Season 2
description: The Nijigasaki High School Idol Club continues to gain popularity as its reputation grows, even catching the attention of aspiring school idol Zhong Lanzhu. However, when Lanzhu visits the club and interacts with its members, she realizes that their ideals differ from her own. This sparks the beginning of a rivalry between Lanzhu and the club members, as she challenges them to see who can captivate a larger audience at the upcoming School Idol Festival. Thus, the school idol club starts a new chapter in its quest to achieve idol stardom. Being more united than ever before, the girls continue to practice for the festival—wanting to show Lanzhu what it truly means to be a school idol. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.name: Setsuna Yuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") Setsuna Yuki is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was the leader and founder of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her color is scarlet red. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that she read. Setsuna is passionate and headstrong, but kind and mature. She has a habit of taking on too much work and not wanting to burden friends with her problems. Setsuna has an unwavering passion for school idols and her raw emotion combined with a powerful voice is her charm point. She is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School.

characters.name: Kasumi Nakasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kasumi Nakasu is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is pastel yellow. As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. You'll often find her scheming or thinking up new ways to ensure her own victory; however, these plans often fail or aren't as devious as she thinks.

characters.name: Shizuku Ousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") Shizuku Osaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a first year and her image color is light blue. Shizuku is a polite, level-headed and diligent First Year student at Nijigasaki High with a passion for theatre and stage acting. She is a prolific member of the school's theatre club and it often shows in conversations where her enthusiasm for the subject surfaces.

characters.name: Ai Miyashita
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Favorite food:__ Nukazuke Ai Miyashita is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.name: Rina Tennouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Kanata Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Kanata Konoe is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is violet. Kanata is always giving everything her all... even if it doesn't seem that way when she dozes off in the middle of conversations. She cares deeply for her little sister Haruka and will find a bottomless well of energy in matters relating to her. An ideal performance, for Kanata, is a stage in which she sleeps and her fans watch. She also has an aptitude for cooking and home economics. While she loves to be doted on and spoiled, she also looks after everyone in the club as a big sister figure.

characters.name: Emma Verde
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") Emma Verde is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is light green. Emma is from Switzerland and has eight younger siblings. She formerly attended the Y.G. International Academy. Emma sometimes speaks in simple Italian, implying she is from an Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. While she sometimes struggles to adapt to Japanese culture, Emma is a kind and pure-hearted third year who acts as a big sister towards the rest of the group who always provides a shoulder to lean on in times of need.

characters.name: Ayumu Uehara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayumu Uehara is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of A・ZU・NA, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is light pink. She is hard working and believes that trying your best is the only thing to do. She is kind, sociable and wants everyone to succeed. Ayumu can also be rather clumsy at times.

characters.name: Yuu Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Yuu Takasaki is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club and one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is the manager, songwriter, and founder of Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is black. Yuu is the budding school idol enthusiast of Nijigasaki High School, and is often seen with her characteristic thigh-high socks and twin-tails tips dyed green. She is Ayumu Uehara's inseparable childhood friend, having grown up as neighbors in the same apartment building near Odaiba.

characters.name: Shioriko Mifune
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Shioriko Mifune is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is jade. Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. Although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko often yearns to connect with others, deep down.

characters.name: Mia Taylor
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Mia Taylor is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is third year student and her image color is platinum silver. She recently transferred from New York and is fluent in both English and Japanese. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old.

title: Candy☆Boy
description: Twin sisters, Yukino and Kanade Sakurai, room together in the dorms at their high school, enjoying school life with their friends and one another. One day, Sakuya Kamiyama, an underclassman, seeks out Yukino, while Kanade learns from a friend that Sakuya has admired Yukino for a very long time. This innocent revelation sets into motion a chain of events that eventually lead to Yukino expressing her feelings for her sister.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Sakuya Kamiyama
characters.description: A younger girl who is in deeply infatuated with [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/7324/Sakurai-Kanade) with the point that she is almost stalking her. She is extremely wealthy and often tries to spend her money after the twins. She likes collecting old paraphernalia, junk and pictures that belong to Kanade, most of which goes to her makeshift shrine. Despite her overwhelming presence, the twins seem to like her. [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino) is amused by her and Kanade seems more irritated than anything, but they both seem to have some sort of affection for the girl. Initially, her presence was seen as a threat to Kanade as she assumed Sakuya was interested in Yukino. She became aware that Sakuya was madly in love with her when Yukino clears the situation up.

characters.name: Shizuku Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade and Yukino's much younger sister. Shizuku is a lot more level-headed than her sisters. She is deeply affected by the actions of Kanade, who she seems to care about more than Yukino. Unlike her sisters, she buries all her emotions deep down without expressing them but they later resurface in various ways, such as her cutting school. She also appears to be very passive-aggressive. Despite Yukino's attempts to become closer to her, Shizuku clearly spurns the attention of her older sister. This is possibly due to jealousy she feels, as Kanade spends more time with Yukino, and Shizuka would prefer that Kanade pays more attention to her instead. She seems quietly aware of the deeper relationship that her sisters may have.

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear AXZ
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギア AXZ
description: Hibiki Tachibana has defeated many powerful enemies, saved countless innocent lives, and escaped from numerous desperate situations, but she is currently finding herself unable to escape from her most desperate situation yet—summer homework! Although her high school life is relatively unremarkable, her career as a member of the military organization S.O.N.G. is anything but. Using powerful, ancient armor known as Symphogear, Hibiki and her teammates work with the United Nations to deal with international disputes and disasters. During a mission briefing at headquarters, Hibiki is made aware of a mysterious organization known as the Bavarian Illuminati, who has been responsible for several major disasters in the past and currently operate in the war-torn country Val Verde. Together, Hibiki and her team infiltrate one of the Bavarian Illuminati's manufacturing plants and free hundreds of slaves. Exposed, alchemists Saint-Germain, Cagliostro, and Prelati reveal themselves as the organization's top brass, and—using alchemical powers—declare a global revolution while sacrificing thousands of lives. Faced with yet another threat to the world's survival, Hibiki and her allies must confron

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve
characters.original: マリア・カデンツァヴナ・イブ
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Black Gungnir ~!__Symphogear post G:__ Airgetlám!~ An energetic singer who reached the top of the American music charts about 2 months after her debut. Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Saint-Germain
characters.description: A beautiful female alchemist who dresses as a man and aims for perfection. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Cagliostro
characters.description: An alchemist who used to be male until she met Saint Germain and attained a "perfect," eternally youthful female body. Cagliostro used to be a lying swindler but is now honest about everything. (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Prelati
characters.description: An alchemist who used to be male before meeting Saint-Germain and attaining a perfect female body. Prelati used to be a showy pleasure-seeker, but now works diligently as a researcher. (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Tiki
characters.description: Tiki is an autoscorer from the Bavarian Illuminati.

characters.name: Adam Weishaupt
characters.original: アダム・ヴァイスハウプト
characters.description: Adam Weishaupt is the main antagonist of Senki Zesshou Symphogear AXZ.

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

title: Shakunetsu no Takkyuu Musume
description: Ever since their champion was defeated, the world of girls' junior high ping pong has been in turmoil. Koyori is the new smirking transfer student at her junior high and she's ready to shake up girls' ping pong. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Agari Kamiya
characters.description: She is a second year at Suzumegahara Middle School in the table tennis club who was the undisputed ace prior to [Koyori Tsumujikaze](https://anilist.co/character/90204/Tsumujikaze-Koyori) joining the club.

characters.name: Kumami Tsukinowa
characters.description: A second year who was formerly part of Suzemegahara's table tennis club, before transferring to Tsumebame after being enticed by their captain. On the day she left, Agari asked her to play one match with her before leaving but refused. She has a talent for ventriloquism that involves talking with her hairpin she calls Kumanosuke. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mayuu Kanenashi
characters.description: __Birthday:__ September 10th

title: Vividred Operation
title_original: ビビッドレッド・オペレーション
description: Friendship is the key to protecting the world. That is everyone's wish. Here in a world where science has solved all questions. This story is set in Oshima. The happy, carefree 14 year old Akane Isshiki lived a poor, but well loved life together with her reliable little sister, Momo, who does all the housework, and her grandfather, Kenjirou, a genius inventor who only created useless devices. When the weather is clear, they can see the artificial island, Blue Island, across the sea. In the center of that island rises the revolutionary Manifestation Engine, a discovery that solved the world's energy problems. It is a peaceful future, just like everyone dreamed of. One where everyone can smile and be happy... But suddenly, the world is visited by danger. An unknown enemy, the Alone, appear, targeting the Manifestation Engine. As none of their weapons worked and they fell into despair, a lone girl takes a stand wearing a red "Palette Suit" which wields a great, hidden power. Before long, allies gather around her to fight. And their friendship becomes the only hope for saving the world! (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Akane Isshiki
characters.description: A middle school sophomore living together with her little sister and grandfather in Izu Oshima. She works many part-time jobs to support her family in place of her mother. She's always bright, energetic, and honest. She's very athletic, but she's afraid of heights. She loves mayonnaise.

characters.name: Aoi Futaba
characters.description: Akane's best friend who is from a wealthy family and often bedridden because of her weak health. She is a honest and polite girl who lives alone in Oshima as her parents are too busy to come visit her. She hates tomatoes.

characters.name: Wakaba Saegusa
characters.description: A determined sword fighter. She is the captain of New Oshima Academy's Female Kendo Club, and president of her class. She is competitive and hates to lose, but she also loves cute things. She is a bit awkward because of her earnestness, and she often draws the short straw. (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Himawari Shinomiya
characters.description: She's one of Akane's classmates, but she withdrew to her room after a certain incident and hasn't come to school since. She has a case of anthrophobia and doesn't pay any attention to fashion or her appearance. She's a super hacker who favorites PCs and machines. She loves factoryscapes. ~!The incident that Himawari was in was about how her classmate betrayed her after Himawari promosed to help her from bullies by hacking into the computer so that their names would show up.!~ (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Rei Kuroki
characters.description: A classmate of Akane and her friends. She is mysterious and is never shown to interact with other people. She also seems to have a connection to the Alone and could be called an enemy. ~!Rei comes from an another world where she lost everything dear to her. There, a crow made contract with her that in order to get her world back to its normal state, she has to destroy the Manifestation Engine using Alones. Rei has a mark of feathers which indicate the amount of arrows she can still fire, and when the last arrow is fired, she disappears completely if the Manifestation Engine isn't destroyed.!~

characters.name: Momo Isshiki
characters.description: Momo is Akane Isshiki's sister. The two of them live with their grandfather, Kenjirou Isshiki.

characters.name: Kenjirou Isshiki
characters.description: Akane and Momo's grandfather and self-proclaimed mad scientist. He's one of the developers of the Manifestation Engine, but now he keeps a research lab in Izu Oshima and focuses on his inventions. He pours most of his money into his research, which is one reason why the Isshiki family is poor. He has stated that whilst he does own various patents, he chooses not to profit from them as atonement for the accident that occured seven years ago. He is the developer of the Vivid System, which allows Akane and the others to fight against the Alone. However, as the result of an explosion that occurred upon completing the experiment, his mind has been transferred to the body of a stuffed otter named Uso-kun (うそくん?), with his human body kept in the fridge for preservation. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: Appears in episode 1.

title: Aki-Sora: Yume no Naka
description: A sequel to Aki-Sora under a new name.

characters.name: Sora Aoi
characters.description: The protagonist of this story. His first name is written as 蒼空 (Soukuu) in kanji. He attends the same high school as his sisters, Aki and Nami. Unlike his sisters, he is good at cooking and housework. His effeminate appearance makes him a perfect candidate for cross-dressing, which he finds himself engaging in involuntarily. He is deeply in love with Aki, and doesn't resist her the second time she tries to have sex with him.

characters.name: Aki Aoi
characters.description: Sora's elder sister. Attractive, athletic, and intelligent, she's considered a model student at school. However, at home, she has no culinary talents and fails to keep her own room clean. She is deeply in love with Sora. She first attempts to have sex with Sora in the shower but is unsuccessful. However, her second attempt, in his room, is successful, and they have engaged in sexual intercourse several times since.

characters.name: Nami Aoi
characters.description: Sora's identical twin sister. When they were children, she'd often pretend to be Sora. Even through they look alike, their personalities are polar opposites. Unlike the quiet and mild-mannered Sora, she has a strong and stubborn attitude. She often forces Sora to cosplay for her own amusement. She's secretly in love with Kana. In spite of this, she actively tries to get Kana and Sora together. ~!Eventually, she snaps when she sees them having sex after a successful date (which she assumed wouldn't be). In a rage, she almost snips off Sora's penis with scissors, thinking that could be why Kana prefers him over herself. Despite not going through with it, she angrily rapes him on the spot, fantasizing about Kana. Once she comes to her senses, she threatens to snip it off if he tells anyone. Later, she thinks about how her attraction to Kana seemed more like an obsession than anything else.

characters.name: Kana Sumiya
characters.description: Sora's classmate and Nami’s best friend. Kana and Nami are the only members of the cosplay club. She makes female outfits for Sora and Nami forces these outfits unto her brother. She has feelings for Sora but is too shy to confess them. She is unaware of Nami's feelings towards her. ~!It is later revealed that the one she truly likes is Nami.!~

title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon: Crystal - Death Busters-hen
title_original: 美少女戦士セーラームーン Crystal デス・バスターズ編
title_en: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Crystal: Season 3
description: The new season will assemble all 10 Senshi — specifically, the popular outer Senshi such as Sailor Uranus, Sailor Neptune, and Sailor Saturn will join Sailor Moon, Sailor Chibi Moon, and the others. The new season will adapt the arc from the fifth and sixth volumes of the complete edition of Naoko Takeuchi's original Sailor Moon manga. Note: VIZ Media has labeled the 3rd cour as "Season 3", while they have labeled the 1st and 2nd cour of the first season as "Seasons 1-2".

characters.name: Usagi Tsukino
characters.description: __Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to know her sweet and selfless side. Usagi is a bit selfish and very much a crybaby, lazy, clumsy, and also an academic underachiever. She's also not very good at cooking. However, she cares deeply about her friends and family. Usagi is very trusting, and believes that everyone has a better nature. She doe

characters.name: Chibiusa
characters.description: Chibiusa's real name is actually Usagi, but she is nicknamed Chibiusa to distinguish her from [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). She is usually very upbeat, extroverted and outgoing. Though she started out socially awkward, she quickly became popular with her classmates in the 20th-century. Chibiusa's dream is to one day become a real lady, to have her own prince, and to be friends with everyone she knows. Meanwhile, she is a fairly ordinary little girl; she likes pink and red, pudding, pancakes, and rabbits. Her favorite school subject is drawing, while her least favorites are language classes. ~!Chibiusa is actually the future daughter of Usagi Tsukino and [Mamoru Chiba](https://anilist.co/character/4013/Chiba-Mamoru), and was sent back in time to the "present" to stay with them before she was born.!~

characters.name: Setsuna Meiou
characters.description: Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics. Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates, she becomes more friendly, but is still not very emotional, although there are moments in the manga where she expresses much more emotion than the anime. Sailor Pluto is much darker in her initial form in the manga, identified as the "Guardian of the Underworld" with very dark skin and a black sailo

characters.name: Michiru Kaiou
characters.description: Introduced in the third story arc, Michiru fights alongside her partner and lover Haruka in defending the Solar System from outside threats. In both versions of the story, she is elegant, sophisticated, capable of sharp anger, and sometimes cold. She is fully dedicated to her duty as a Senshi. Her Senshi alter-ego is Sailor Neptune, one of the "four soldiers of the outer solar system". As Sailor Neptune, her element of influence is the sea(not with water in general as Sailor Mercury's powers are); as with many of the other Senshi, this element is closely associated with her planet, which is named for the Roman sea god, Neptune. She is one of the Senshi who has natural psychic powers, alerting her when danger is near. She seems to be a character with a very deep understanding of things, sometimes even surpassing the other Outer Senshi due to her unnaturally high psychic endowments. Michir

characters.name: Haruka Tenou
characters.description: Haruka is a stubborn, protective individual, but is also strong-willed, capable, charming, and occasionally even doting. She is formally introduced in the third story arc, although she appears in silhouette alongside [Sailor Neptune](https://anilist.co/character/2829/Kaiou-Michiru) in the final episode of [Sailor Moon R](https://anilist.co/anime/740/-R/). When transformed, she is known as Sailor Uranus, and is part of the group known in Fanon as the Outer Senshi. Haruka is a racecar driver, even though she is barely sixteen years old when she appears. However, the timing of her birthday to the Japanese school year means she is one grade ahead of the Inner Senshi.

characters.name: Mamoru Chiba
characters.description: Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of [Usagi Tsukino](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted. ~!This may be because when he was young his parents died in a car crash. This blocked his childhood memories of his current lifetime and opened up the memories of his previous life as Prince Endymion. Tuxedo Mask is a disguise Mamoru created for himself in order to hunt for the Silver Crystal incognito and, later, assist the Sailor Senshi in battle. He is always addressed as Mamo-chan by Usagi throughout the series (Chibiusa also addresses him with this nickname later on). After dating for two years, Mamoru gives Usagi an engagement ring at an airport. The couple eventually gets married. In the future, they become king and queen of Earth and Crystal Tokyo and have a child together whom they name, Small Lady, but is in the

characters.name: Ami Mizuno
characters.description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

characters.name: Rei Hino
characters.description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate from the other girls.

characters.name: Makoto Kino
characters.description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

characters.name: Minako Aino
characters.description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her to her life as a Senshi. He lives in her home (as [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) lives in Usagi's) and is one of her closest friends.

characters.name: Hotaru Tomoe
characters.description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

characters.name: Luna
characters.description: Luna was a talking cat and advisor to [Usagi Tsukino.](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino) It was she who first detected Usagi's power, but at the time did not realize that she was the Moon Princess. Luna and her partner [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis) were advisors to [Queen Serenity](https://anilist.co/character/17010/Queen-Serenity) in the Silver Millennium, and when the kingdom was ruined Serenity used the power of her Silver Crystal to send the two cats to Earth's future in order to awaken the Sailor Senshi. She and Artemis one day married and had a daughter named [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/11899/Diana) who became the advisor to [Chibiusa.](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) Chibiusa's toy Luna P was also modelled on Luna. (Source: Wikimoon)

title: Anima Yell!
description: The story follows Kohane Hatoya, a 1st year high school student who is a bit clumsy and scared of heights but who has a very bubbly and outgoing personality. Kohane decides to join the cheerleading club to try to make friends and overcome her weaknesses. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Kana Ushiku
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Kana Ushiku is Hizume's former teammate. She looks up to Hizume affectionately, despite them being in the same year. She usually looks apathetic, but has a complete attitude change when it comes to talking about Hizume.

characters.name: Kotetsu Tatejima
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm __Favorite food:__ Sweets __Favorite color:__ Pink and brown __Favorite things:__ Piano, tea time Kotetsu Tatejima is Kohane's classmate. She is shy and constantly recedes from any risk of drawing attention, but is very frank about what she thinks. She doesn't think very highly of her given name.

characters.name: Uki Sawatari
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Uki Sawatari is Kohane's childhood friend who always ends up bringing Kohane down to Earth, despite Kohane's constant antics. She may project a pragmatic and realistic front, but she actually likes cute things.

characters.name: Kohane Hatoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm Kohane Hatoya is a constantly optimistic person who loves to support others. She usually has more drive than others, but she is also clumsy and has poor reflexes. She began to be fascinated by cheerleading since a performance she saw toward the end of her middle school years.

characters.name: Hizume Arima
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Hizume Arima is a girl experienced with cheerleading. She can be serious to a fault. Her stoic attitude distanced her from her former cheerleading teammates. She is usually expressionless, but can act out a good smile. (Source: ANN)

title: BanG Dream! 3rd Season
description: The girls of Poppin'Party have come a long way, but the competition coming up is the biggest yet - the BanG Dream! Girls Band challenge at the legendary Budokan! Slots to compete are limited and the usual competitors will be vying for the chance, but the band to beat is the new RAISE A SUILEN, whose founder, Chiyu, has sworn to destroy both Roselia and Poppin'Party! Indeed, Chiyu's main goal is to make Roselia's lead Yukina pay for denying Chiyu a spot as a producer, and the musical prodigy has the connections and resources to push the competition up to the next level! Can Poppin'Party keep up with the increased tempo and meet challenges like producing their own music video? They'll have to if they want to make it to the big show! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Kasumi Toyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the vocalist and rhythm guitarist in the band Poppin'Party. When she viewed the stars one night as a child, she heard a sparkling "Star Beat" and had been searching for it. She believes that she found it after founding Poppin'Party. She also has a little sister named [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/152338/Toyama-Asuka), who she calls "Aa-chan". It's not always clear who is the more responsible out of the two. Cheerful and always in high spirits, Kasumi is a playful, active and generally positive girl that always finds something to be excited about. She is capable of sharing a mental wavelength with [Kokoro Tsurumaki](https://anilist.co/character/127272/Tsurumaki-Kokoro), something nobody else seems to be able to do. She is also the type to believe in (or fall for) the strangest explanations. However, Kasumi i

characters.name: Arisa Ichigaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Instruments:__ Roland JUNO-DS 61 W and Roland AX-Synth (White) Arisa is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the keyboardist of [Poppin'Party](https://anilist.co/staff/153185/PoppinParty). In the second season of the anime, she is a second-year student and the student council secretary. Arisa's grandparents run a pawnshop called "Ryuuseidou", and she lives in a big and traditional house, which includes a basement where the Poppin'Party members practice most of the time. When Arisa was younger, she started to learn the piano but then quit it halfway because she didn't have any motivation to continue - when she befriended [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Toyama-Kasumi) and heard about her plans to start a band, she picked it up again. Arisa is an introvert whose hobbies include tending for bonsai plants and internet surfing. Ev

characters.name: Rimi Ushigome
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") __Instrument:__ ESP Viper Bass A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the bassist of Poppin'Party. Outside of the band, Rimi is friends with Misaki, and similarly to Himari, one of Kaoru's fangirls. Rimi's pink bass guitar is a hand-me-down from her older sister Yuri, who is two years older than her and is the lead vocalist of the band Glitter Green. During Rimi's high-school entrance ceremony, she heard Kasumi's self-introduction that was filled with boundless optimism, and this sparked her interest in her. Though Rimi wanted to change her cowardly and shy personality, she had initially been unable to do anything about it. At first, Rimi declined Kasumi's invitation to become a member of the band Poppin'Party because of her stage fright, but everything changed when she became inspired by Kasumi who sang on stage at Live House Space until Glitter Gree

characters.name: Tae Hanazono
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") __Instrument:__ ESP Snapper Guitar A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the lead guitarist of Poppin'Party. The other members call her O-Tae. Tae lives with her parents and 20 rabbits. She has considerable skill with the guitar, since she started playing it when she was in elementary school. As a huge lover of music, she started working part-time at a live house after entering high school. Tae at first doubted Kasumi's idea to audition at Space, because the band needed a considerable skill level to pass. But when Kasumi, Arisa, Rimi, and Tae performed for the first time in front of their friends and family, Tae realized how much fun she had performing with them and joined the band as its fourth member. A relaxed individual who lives at a steady pace, Tae sometimes surprises the people around her with her keen observations and understanding of music.

characters.name: Saaya Yamabuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Instruments:__ Pearl Drums Antique Gold 4-Piece Reference Pure RFP924XSP-C102, Pearl Drums Electric Blue Sparkle EXX725/C 5-Piece Export Standard Drum Set with Hardware (1st season) Saaya is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer of Poppin'Party. She became good friends with her classmate [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Toyama-Kasumi) during their high school entrance ceremony, and since then they often eat lunch together. Saaya is the oldest of three children in her family; she has a younger brother named [Jun](https://anilist.co/character/152364/Yamabuki-Jun), and a younger sister named [Sana](https://anilist.co/character/152363/Yamabuki-Sana). Saaya's family owns the Yamabuki Bakery, at which she helps out, even during the school term. She also used to play in a girls' band called CHiSPA when she was in middle s

characters.name: Rokka Asahi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Instrument:__ .strandberg* Boden J6 RAS LOCK Caribbean Light Blue Guitar A first year high-school student at Haneoka Girls' High School. She goes by the moniker LOCK as the guitarist for the band RAISE A SUILEN. She is a Poppin'Party fan. Rokka usually wears large glasses, but takes them off when she performs. She is from Gifu Prefecture. She attends Haneoka instead of Hanasakigawa, the closer school, due to Haneoka's scholarship program. She in the same class as Asuka and Ako.
