After his mother's death, Chris tried to travel to Gazth-Sonika to meet with his father (whom he never knew personally), but Enfant prevented him from entering the country. In the end, a Nafrecian civil servant Piederico Moré secretly "smuggled" Chris into the country and hired Madlax as his bodyguard. With Madlax's help, Chris reached Galza's headquarters, but hasn't found his father there. Instead, Friday Monday explained to him, that Min Durk was just a red herring created by Enfant, and that he, Chris Krana, thus, cannot exist. Krana's ultimate fate is unknown. In episode 21, while Carrossea and Margaret perform the ritual, a young Chirs Krana appeared with Margaret and Poupée during the plane crash in 1999, this explains most of Krana's myster

characters.name: Baggis
characters.description: Badgis is a friend of Vannessa Rene, and an expert computer technician - in other words, a hacker. He has unlimited access to a super-computer he and his students built for scientific purposes. He lends a hand in Vanessa's search for evidence of Bookwald's involvement with the Gazth-Sonikan war. Using his machine, the two of them slice into the Bookwald mainframe and retrieve the necessary data; however, Friday Monday intercepts their attack and Badgis is forced to shut down his system. What happened to him afterwards is unknown. Apparently, Badgis has some romantic interest in Vanessa. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nakhl
characters.description: Lady Quanzitta's servant and agent. She is the most capable hand to hand and bladed weapons fighter in Gazth-Sonika and, effectively, the only one to ever defeat Madlax in combat. ~!She follows Carrossea and tries to take Secondari from Margaret but fails. Eventually, she accompanies both Madlax and Elenore in addition to rescue Margaret. She is last seen praying next to her master's corpse. !~

characters.name: SSS
characters.description: Madlax's mysterious contact who regularly supplies her with details on any available missions that come up. Not much is known about him, but it is suspected that he adopted, raised, and trained Madlax to become an assassin sometime after 1999. Any other details concerning his personal life are unknown, even the name of the organization he represents.

title: Ookii Onnanoko wa Suki desu ka?
title_original: 大きい女の子は好きですか？
description: Souta was suddenly made dorm manager and coach of the Hokuei University Women's Volleyball Club as prompted by his older sister, Kaori. There, he had a fateful reunion with Ayano, his first love... In the girls' dorm! In the gym! In a hotel?! What awaited him were days of being bossed around by girls bigger than him! A Happy Harem Rom-Com of Size Differences♡ Born Huge on the Northern Plains!! (Source: OceanVeil) Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on March 13th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

characters.name: Souta Tachibana
characters.description: [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/391311/Kaoru-Tachibana) younger brother. He used to work part-time at a restaurant, but Kaoru made him the dorm manager and supervisor. He's good at housework and has common sense, but has the annoying habit of instantly forgetting his sense of self and running around violently whenever someone calls him "Chibita." He's small.

characters.name: Ayano Hasegawa
characters.description: A rival who has stood in front of [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/391311/Kaoru-Tachibana) time and again in past matches. And for [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/391309/Souta-Tachibana), she was his first love. Though outwardly a pure-looking black-haired beauty, she stands head and shoulders above even the most sexually liberated club members as a true sex monster. She's big.

characters.name: Kaoru Tachibana
characters.description: [Souta's](https://anilist.co/character/391309/Souta-Tachibana) older sister, though they share no blood since both were stepchildren. She shows a stoic side when it comes to volleyball, even practicing in her uniform. The girls' volleyball team captain is actually her childhood friend from elementary school. She's tall.

characters.name: Sanae Yamada
characters.description: The captain of the girls' volleyball team. She plays the libero position, a specialized back-row role that, by rule, does not participate in plays like spikes or blocks. As a result, she is unusually petite among the team members. She has a driver's license. She is small.

characters.name: Sakura Asakura
characters.description: The club member whose trademark is her glasses. She owns many pairs and switches them up depending on the day. She's deeply immersed in otaku and internet culture, using unique phrases. She's actually a member of both this club and the manga research club. She's big.

characters.name: Kyouka Teshigawara
characters.description: A club member with a cool demeanor. She hides a certain secret, but the other members are already well aware of it. After a certain incident causes her to change her image, she suddenly gains more female fans. She's big.

characters.name: Julia Mackenzie
characters.original: ユリア・マッケンジー
characters.description: A club member who came from America, always doing things at her own pace. She's the type who doesn't sweat the small stuff. She'll join in on games she doesn't even know the rules to, as if it's perfectly normal. She tends to forget to shave her underarms. She's big.

title: Hotel Inhumans
title_original: ホテル・インヒューマンズ
description: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one’s identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next? (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Doctor
characters.description: The hotel's in-house doctor, who has a habit of asking people he meets for the first time to sign an autopsy permit.

characters.name: Toshiya Kase
characters.description: A man who strives for perfection both in his private and public life. He pretends to be a salaryman who travels a lot for work.

title: Kuttsukiboshi
description: Kiiko is your normal girl, besides her secret of being able to move objects with her mind. When a new student named Aaya moves in, Kiiko starts to develop feelings toward her. The two will eventually then start their romantic relationship. Although everything seems fine, Kiiko does not know that Aaya has another secret, a secret that could ruin Kiiko's feelings and trust for Aaya. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kiiko Kawakami
characters.description: Kiiko is the protagonist of the series. She is not a shy girl, but she is very reserved considering that she has many secrets she has to keep from everyone around her. She becomes fast friends with Aya when her first secret is discovered. ~!After surviving a car accident, dormant telekinetic powers awaken in Kiiko, and Aya catches her using said powers and the two become friends after Aya decides to study it and help Kiiko hone her telekinesis properly.!~ Soon, Kiiko begins falling in love with Aya-- her second secret which she wonders how long she'll be able to keep to herself. She is a fan of Aya's brother's music and owns his debut CD. ~!Aaya's brother had manipulated her into having sex with him before he dies, and Kiiko catches them on the move. Kiiko separates the wire stars by accident because she was extremely shocked by what she saw. They obviously broke up and lose touch with e

characters.name: Aaya Saitou
characters.description: A classmate and friend of Kiiko. She likes to perform experiments with Kiiko's powers, but in reality she is in love with her. For one of the experiments she made two joined wire stars and told Kiiko to try and separate them. She usually takes the lead when it comes to activities and has an outgoing personality. She lives with her brother. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kouta Saitou
characters.description: Aaya's older brother, a famous musician who has generally seen Aaya as more than a sister. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Oni Chichi
description: Based on the erotic game by Blue Gale. Marina and Airi's mother divorced few years ago and got remarried recently to a young man. While Marina accepts her new stepfather, Airi detests him. Little do they know that really he's a pervert that sniffs their underwear and wants to make them his own by making a love drug that will turn Marina and Airi into sex-hungry sluts. When Airi comes home and notices her schoolmate Sana giving him a blowjob, he sprays the drug on her. Now he will do with them whatever he pleases.

characters.name: Airi Akizuki
characters.description: The younger daughter. The main focus of episode 1 is on her.

characters.name: Marina Akizuki
characters.description: The elder step daughter.

characters.name: Kouzou Akizuki
characters.description: The male protagonist of the anime, who lust for his step daughters & best friends.

characters.name: Sana Kuranaka
characters.description: Airi's best friend in class. She was the first that got 'addicted' to the male protagonist.

title: Arne no Jikenbo
description: Arne Neuntöte is a vampire detective who manipulates supernatural powers. Lynn Reinweiß is a nobleman’s daughter who loves vampires. Their worlds should never have crossed, but they join hands to solve a bloody mystery. In the darkest of nights, Lynn finds herself in desperate need of help. Then she wanders into the mysterious city of "Lügenberg", where non-humans live. Lynn's world changes drastically when she encounters "Arne", a vampire who is called "the worst" in the city. And tonight, a new "murder case" has occurred. What is the truth behind the bizarre incidents that take place in a world where humanity and the bizarre intersect? "Come on, human. You may dance merrily under the crimson moon.” (Source: The Case Book of Arne Steam page)

characters.name: Arne Neuntöte
characters.original: アルネ・ノインテーター
characters.description: A vampire who practices detective work under the belief that “solving mysteries is meant to be enjoyed.” Originally the “most fearsome” being with nine hearts, he has now lost several of them and switches between the forms of a boy and an adult depending on the situation.

characters.name: Lynn Reinweiß
characters.original: リン・ラインヴァイス
characters.description: The only daughter of the noble House of Reinweiß. She has a bright and affectionate personality, with keen intuition that allows her to quickly notice people's secrets. She's also an extreme vampire otaku, and when she gets switched on, her rampage leaves her companions utterly dumbfounded.

characters.name: Louis Hartmann
characters.description: He lives with his father, who runs the Hartmann Detective Agency in Blumstadt. He loves comics featuring monsters and heroes, but also possesses his father's keen observational skills. His catchphrase is, “The case is happening in the real world!”

characters.name: Zishe
characters.description: A mysterious being living within the mirror who calls himself the “Lying Wolf Boy.” While usually cooperative with [Arne](https://anilist.co/character/378163/Arne-Neuntte) and possessing excellent information-gathering skills, he may withhold information if it seems interesting, deliberately complicate cases, or even become hostile.

characters.name: Nachzehrer
characters.description: He has a tough, Yankee-like way of speaking and a simple, easily-tempered personality. He is always hungry, and there is an anecdote that when he was born, he ate his own clothes and body. ~!His true identity is that of a legendary vampire, one of the "Nine Kings" who gave birth to [Arne](https://anilist.co/character/378163/Arne-Neuntte).!~

characters.name: Amy
characters.description: A necromancer who is always calm and collected, with a constant expression and whose thoughts are difficult to read. However, she is unusually kind to [Lynn](https://anilist.co/character/378164/Lynn-Reinwei). She has the ability to control corpses and throw her sewn-together arms like a rocket punch, making her fighting ability extremely high.

title: Kashimashi: Girl Meets Girl
title_original: かしまし〜ガール・ミーツ・ガール〜
description: Hazumu was a shy boy who enjoyed gardening, collecting herbs, and long walks in the mountains. One day he finally worked up the courage to confess his love to Yasuna, but she rejected him. Depressed, he wandered up Mt. Kashimayama, the place where they first met, to reconsider his feelings. After getting lost, he wished upon a shooting star and received a bizarre twist of fate. Now he is a she, and she stumbles headfirst back into social life and relationships only to find that the entire landscape has changed! (Source: Media Blasters)

characters.name: Hazumu Osaragi
characters.description: The story begins with Hazumu, the main character, as a boy, who always seemed to have a crush on his friend and classmate Yasuna Kamiizumi ever since he first met her. He was not very masculine in either his appearance or his actions, and so as a child he would get teased for being so feminine. In addition, several flashbacks have been featured in both the manga and anime featuring Hazumu dressed like a girl at a young age. Whether he wanted to do this of his own accord or his mother just dressed him up is never specified but regardless he didn't seem to be bothered by it; indeed he was shown to enjoy it. Once in high school, he confesses his love to Yasuna one day, but is rejected. Afterwards, he climbs the nearby Mt. Kashima to clear his feelings. He is fatally injured by an alien spacecraft crash-landing on the mountain. In an attempt to rectify the accident, the alien pilot revives H

characters.name: Yasuna Kamiizumi
characters.description: Yasuna tends to be a quiet and often lonely girl compared to the rest of her friends. Since her parents are rarely around due to being overworked, she seems to depend on her close friends for love and support, especially when it comes to Hazumu, who unfortunately doesn't tend to show her the type of affection Yasuna desires from her. Yasuna and Hazumu first met as classmates, though they rarely ever talked with each other, which means that Hazumu was simply admiring Yasuna from afar. One day when on Mt. Kashima sometime before the main story began, Yasuna found that they shared an interest in gardening. It was also at this point where she pointed out how feminine Hazumu appeared, which is also the main reason she could see most of his figure minus his face, which as a male was always shown with his hair covering it. As fate would have it, Yasuna rejected Hazumu's first confession of love

characters.name: Tomari Kurusu
characters.description: Tomari is Hazumu's childhood friend who has been with Hazumu for a long time, and most importantly protected him often from bullies. In direct contrast to Hazumu, her most obvious quality is that she is a tomboy which is shown through her actions and lack of interest in traditionally feminine things such as clothing or shopping. Indeed, Tomari's friends of both genders consider her very masculine which often causes Tomari to get angry at such comments. Additionally, she is a member of the Track and Field Club and enjoys physical activities. Before Hazumu's change, she shows some latent interest in Hazumu and is at first just as shocked as everyone else when he is transformed into a girl. Tomari has always put a lot of effort into supporting Hazumu and defending him whenever he is in despair. Though Hazumu has always been grateful for Tomari's support, at times Tomari later seems to be je

characters.name: Ayuki Mari
characters.description: Ayuki is Tomari's best female friend, who, much like Yasuna, is quiet and reserved, though seems to be more social than Yasuna. Indeed, she serves to act as the voice of reason between the interactions of the other characters. Additionally, Ayuki seems to have an interest in observing the people around her and she enjoys learning about the sciences, though most specifically, biological sciences. It is suggested indirectly that Ayuki is also interested in Hazumu, and later in the anime, she also seems to be interested in Tomari. However, she says that she prefers not to get involved with the developing love triangle and simply observes from the sidelines.

characters.name: Asuta Soro
characters.description: Asuta is Hazumu's best male buddy before and after the UFO crash, though his opinion of Hazumu changes somewhat due to his taking interest in Hazumu's new female form and feminine personality. Asuta is a good deal more manly than Hazumu ever was, and was trying to find Hazumu to give him some adult magazines (which Hazumu hates) on the night of the Mt. Kashima incident as an attempt to try to console him for getting turned down by Yasuna. Asuta has found himself more and more attracted to Hazumu after the transformation, leaving Hazumu completely oblivious of this fact. Eventually, Asuta resolves to simply being Hazumu's best male friend and sees that her main interest is indeed with Yasuna.

characters.name: Namiko Tsuki
characters.description: She is the homeroom teacher of Hazumu's class who has an excessively cute style shown through her loud expressions of love towards Hitoshi Sora or her passion for protecting her students in her class. Also, she is extremely clumsy which gives rise to her being the butt of many jokes.

characters.name: Hitoshi Sora
characters.description: Hitoshi Sora is a cultural anthropologist and space alien. His research brought him to visit Earth, and he is currently in disguise as the biology teacher at Hazumu's high school. His unfamiliarity with human ways provides the series with an outside perspective on love - the focus of Sora's research. Additionally, his views on other subjects, such as friendly competition or war, provide a somewhat existentialist point of view. The alien's research, explained in the manga, is of great importance to the survival of his species as he fears that if his currently rather unemotional people do not rediscover passions like love, they may all eventually die out.

characters.name: Jan Puu
characters.description: Jan Puu is an artificial intelligence employed by Hitoshi Sora as the automatic pilot of his spaceship. Though Jan Puu is very enthusiastic about new people, she seems to have few social skills and often acts like a human child. Her human body is modelled after Hazumu's female body, whom she addresses as onee-nii-sama (お姉兄さま literally meaning "older sister-brother").

characters.name: Touru Osaragi
characters.description: He is Hazumu's father, who loves taking pictures of Hazumu. This often consists of him trying to get Hazumu in provocative poses and expressions which leads his wife to wrestle him down to the ground. Additionally, he repeatedly attempts to take a bath with his daughter but is always stopped.

characters.name: Kahoru Osaragi
characters.description: She is Hazumu's mother, who loves to buy new feminine clothes for Hazumu to wear. Usually she buys these clothes without consulting Hazumu herself and regardless Hazumu ends up wearing them, though Hazumu doesn't put up any resistance to her new and ever increasing wardrobe.

title: Bible Black
description: Based on the erotic game by Active. Minase, a high school student, found a book of magic in an isolated room in his school. He started practicing black magic that has extreme sexual effects that benefited him and some of his friends. Intrigued, Minase got deeper and deeper into using the craft, not realizing the evils that will come forth. Eventually, the origins of the book was revealed, and so did the incident twelve years ago on the night of the Walpurgis, the night when the power of evil is at its strongest. After coming to his senses, Minase struggles to get himself out of the darkness that he had put himself into. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kurumi Imari
characters.description: [Minase](https://anilist.co/character/7752)'s childhood friend and de facto girlfriend. She comes over to wake Minase up every morning. She knows everything about Minase, and tries to help him in every way. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Taki Minase
characters.description: He is the main protagonist/antagonist of Bible Black: Night of the Walpulgiss. At school, Minase finds the mysterious Bible Black spell book and uses the magic contained within to seduce and pervert his fellow students. He wins the love of the popular girl Rika Shiraki with a magic prop, attracting the attention of his occult-obsessed classmate Kaori Saeki and the evil school nurse Reika Kitami, who puts him under her control to help her exchange bodies with his friend Kurumi Imari.

characters.name: Hiroko Takashiro
characters.description: The school art professor. She’s in charge of the art club, which both [Minase](https://anilist.co/character/7752) and [Imari](https://anilist.co/character/7751) are part of. She’s very popular among the students for her good looks and personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Reika Kitami
characters.description: A school nurse who is possessed by a demon, and uses her powers to control the students. (Source: animevice.com)

characters.name: Nami Kozono
characters.description: As a student, Kozono becomes both the victim and perpetrator of dark magic rituals. She is magically seduced by the unpopular Academy student [Hiratani](https://anilist.co/character/26131). When released from the spell, she unsuccessfully attempts to gain the Devil's power herself by joining [Hiroko Takashiro](https://anilist.co/character/18612)'s witchcraft club and kidnapping [Reika Kitami](https://anilist.co/character/26132), the newly transferred student she develops a crush on.

characters.name: Kaori Saeki
characters.description: Saeki Kaori is a classmate of [Minase](https://anilist.co/character/7752) (protagonist of Bible Black) with a fascination for the arcane arts. She has researched the history of the school’s magic club and the ritual held 12 years before the story opens, and when she discovers that Minase is able to use real magic she is determined to find out his secret whatever the cost. Unfortunately for her she finds herself quickly wrapped up in events beyond her control, and becomes one of the first to succumb to the tide of evil sweeping the school.

characters.name: Mika Itou
characters.description: Mika Ito is one of the supporting characters in the h-anime Bible Black. Although she attends the same school as [Minase](https://anilist.co/character/7752), [Imari](https://anilist.co/character/7751), and the others she is never shown interacting with them. Her trademark features are her bluish-green hair and a black bow she wears on her head, the ends of which look like rabbit ears. Her role in the original series is [Kitami](https://anilist.co/character/26132)'s first potential candidate for a new body, but she dismisses her when it's discovered that she wasn't a virgin. She had a bigger role in Only, where she has sex on a school rooftop, and lures a boy into an orgy with the swim team.

characters.name: Rie Morita
characters.description: Friend of Hiroko Takashiro & Saki Shindou who together form a witchcraft club at their school. They occasionally play games of tarot together and imitate black magic rituals they find in books.

characters.name: Saki Shidou
characters.description: Friend of Hiroko Takashiro & Rie Morita who together form a witchcraft club at their school. They occasionally play games of tarot together and imitate black magic rituals they find in books.

characters.name: Rika Shiraki
characters.description: The head of the student council. Wealthy and untouchable, she’s very popular among the boys. She also has a crush on [Minase](https://anilist.co/character/7752). (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yukiko Minase
characters.description: [Taki](https://anilist.co/character/7752)'s sister.

characters.name: Ayumi Murai
characters.description: [Minase](https://anilist.co/character/7752)'s classmate and one of [Saeki](https://anilist.co/character/19331)'s followers. She finds out that Minase can use black magic, and asks him to chant an incantation for her. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Queen's Blade: Gyokuza wo Tsugu Mono
title_original: クイーンズブレイド 玉座を継ぐ者
description: After experiencing the numerous trials encountered on her journey, Reina has grown as a warrior. Determined to take part in the Queen's Blade tournament, she arrives at the capital city Gainos, where Queen Aldora awaits. There gathers a number of beautiful warriors who, like Reina, are there for the Queen's Blade. Amongst them is Reina's sister, Claudette, determined to restore the glory of House Vance; Tomoe and Shizuka, who are both fighting for their homeland of Hinomoto; Nanael who has been ordered to participate by the Archangel; and the subordinates of the Marshland Witch. All these beautiful fighters who gather in Gainos have been one objective, to win through the Queen's Blade, the tournament to select the strongest, most beautiful queen. Who would ascend to that glorious throne? That can only be determined via battle. (Source: AnimeNfo)

characters.name: Claudette Vance
characters.description: Claudette is Reina's and Elina's big sister. As the "Lightning General", Claudette's able to throw thunderbolts at her opponents using a magic sword. She doesn't show her feelings to others and acts tough, but is secretly concerned about Reina's and Elina's safety.

characters.name: Nanael
characters.description: An angel who descended to Earth with duty of "broadcasting" Queen's Blade fights. Because of her goofy actions, Head Angel put her on probation and exiled to the mortal world. She was given a vial of 'holy milk' twice by the Head Angel, which she must not allow even one drop to be spilled. First time served a test which, in which she spilled of it and tried to fool Head Angel by filling the vial with Earthly milk. Second vial was given to her when she was ordered to enter Queen's Blade tournament, but this time, the more she spills, the weaker she becomes. Since she completely failed to keep the milk safe last time, Head Angel is confident that this will serve as a handicap! Unwilling to treat dwellers of the "lower world" as equals, her combat technique involves the telekinetic manipulation of her celestial saber to keep opponents at bay. She is i

characters.name: Reina Vance
characters.description: The nomad warrior Reina is the direct heir to the house of Vance and Claudette's and Elina's sister. But, instead of accepting her father's heritage, she escapes and enters the Queen's Blade tournament. Her partially naive character and strong sense of justice gets her into trouble pretty often.

characters.name: Tomoe
characters.description: A Shinto priestess from the island of Hinomoto (an alternate reading of the kanji for Japan), she is a member of the elite society of priestesses that protect their homeland. She was designed and illustrated by the artist Eiwa.

characters.name: Risty
characters.description: A wild bandit who walks into Reina having a battle with Melona. Reina is almost killed by Melona but Risty saves her life. Reina then spends all her time in the anime trying to follow Risty before she goes to the Queen's Blade competition.

characters.name: Airi
characters.description: A scythe-wielding ghost girl in a maid costume, Airi was given human form by the evil Swamp Witch in her quest for domination. Airi serves every whim of her mistress quite willingly. Used primarily for assassinations, she can literally suck the vitality of her enemies simply by touching them.

characters.name: Aldra
characters.description: Aldra is the victor of the past two Queen's Blade tournaments and reigning queen. As the child of a priestess and the lord of the underworld, she is a cursed half-demon. She has the powers of "petrifying gaze" and "flesh-rending secret cleaver". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizuka
characters.description: A kunoichi from Hinomoto, Shizuka is a money grubbing assassin. She couldn't care less about the affairs of the battle as long she gets paid; she just hates working hard in general and instead have a personal group of ninjas to aid her. Shizuka does not have a game book of her own, yet has been featured in the anime, voiced by Hitomi Nabatame, manga, collectible cards ver2.0, and even had a PVC figurine released. She was created by Eiwa - By Wesker_CDA

characters.name: Elina Vance
characters.description: The daughter of Count Vance, and younger sister of Reina, a prominent Queen's Blade competitor. She was trained from a young age in all manner of martial arts, from stealth to strict military discipline, and acts as both bodyguard, spy, and assassin for her father. Unlike Reina Erina's personality is vicious. She was created by Hisayuki Hirokazu.

characters.name: Melona
characters.description: Melona is one of the four servants of The Swamp Witch and her strongest minion. Nicknamed "The Protean Assassin" due to her nearly unlimited ability to change form at will, she is skilled in obtaining information and assassination. It is assumed that she was ordered to bring about chaos to the Queen's Blade tournament. Seductive and alluring, she revels in humiliating her opponents and will not hesitate to kill them if given the opportunity. Despite her malevolent nature she hates being called a monster and becomes very upset, to the point of strangling someone to death for instance. Despite this, she can be reasoned with and is willing to work with her enemies as long as it benefits her and furthers her own goals. She is a shapeshifter not limited by shape or texture who can change the shape of her body freely and instantly. Her mimicry is so proficient that she can even imitate the tec

characters.name: Menace
characters.description: Thousands of years ago, in the ancient Amara, a princess was dethroned out of her kingdom. She would have been the next queen, but was betrayed by the high statesmen at the same time Amara fell into ruin after being invaded by an enemy kingdom. History tells that princess Menace's fate was the same as her collapsing kingdom. In the present the "Marshland Witch" managed to resurrect Menace with a powerful magic in her plan to conquer the continent. Despite that, Menace pridefully refused to serve anyone and fled. During her escape, she met a merchant who recommended participating in the Queen's Blade. Menace decided to enter the tournament with the goal of reviving the kingdom of Amara. Despite her gentle nature, Menace is a master of martial arts passed down by the royal family. Her punch emits a cursed aura that can drain her opponent's life with a simple touch. She also carries a myste

characters.name: Cattleya
characters.description: A former adventurer, Cattleya settled down with her fellow adventurer and blacksmith husband Owen. They ran a weapons shop and had a son named Rana. Their happiness was destroyed when Owen disappeared. Cattleya now adventures to find him, with her son Rana by her side. She fights with the enormous two-handed sword "Giant-Killer". Her combat ability is hampered by her son constantly clinging about her knees. She was designed by Kaneko Hiraku

title: Saki: Zenkoku-hen
description: After their success in the regional tournament, the Kiyosumi High School mahjong team faces off against a whole new level of competition at the National Tournament in Tokyo. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: __Position:__ Vanguard Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutenant A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name. A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most, ~!the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.!~ Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: __Position:__ Sergeant A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

characters.name: Kyoutarou Suga
characters.description: A first year student and one of the new recruits for the Kiyosumi Mahjong club, but is not as talented as the rest of the members due to the fact that he is new to the game. As such, he is sent to perform menial tasks more than actually practice. He is attracted to Nodoka due to her physique but so far these feelings are unrequited by Nodoka. He is constantly abused by Yuuki but pays no attention to her pranking ways. He is close with Saki since he has known her since Middle School, but tends to use her to get small things, such as a Ladies' Lunch. Nonetheless, he cares for all of his fellow club members and most likely doesn't mind helping them out, despite being harassed by most of the members.

characters.name: Mihoko Fukuji
characters.description: A third year student serving as the Captain of the Kazekoshi Mahjong Club as well as being the team's ace player. She has a very kind nature, being nice to everyone she meets regardless of who they may be; her kindness extends even to the point where she offers Yuuki, an opposing player from the contending school team, Kiyosumi, her bento so that she would calm down. She even becomes very teary when her teammates help her out, as she feels that it was her fault that her teammates had to work in her place because it was her responsibility. She has been revealed to be very ineffective when working with technology. ~!She keeps her right eye closed to hide her heterochromia from others; while her left eye is reddish-gold, her right eye is actually sapphire blue. She never opens her right eye unless confronted with a dire situation during a Mahjong game. With both eyes open, she is shown to a

characters.name: Koromo Amae
characters.description: Premier member of the reigning champion Mahjong team, Ryuumonbuchi, and one of the most idolized yet feared players in the game. She is said to be possessed by a demon when playing; she even outranked a professional Mahjong player at a previous tournament. She is also the key player that brings an end to Kazekoshi's winning streak. She has a bad habit of wanting to crush her opponent's pride. ~!Her mahjong playing style pressures her opponents and her abilities can prevent them from reaching tenpai. This, together with the mahjong move she favors most, Haitei Raoyue or "last tile win" is a combination that slowly drives her opponents into despair. Haitei Raoyue's literal meaning is "to scoop up the moon from the seabed." Her abilities include being able sense when her opponents are in tenpai and the approximate value of their hands. She usually goes for big hands.!~ She is Touka's cousin

characters.name: Jun Inoue
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Plays the game by reading the flow and manipulating it. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 井丿上惇 instead

characters.name: Tomoki Sawamura
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 澤村智貴 instead

characters.name: Hajime Kunihiro
characters.description: Hajime is a 2nd year student at Ryuumonbuchi High School and is Touka's personal maid. A level-headed cool girl, she, according to Touka, is a strong mahjong player, capable of accomplishing almost anything that she sets her mind to: indeed, Hajime is a proven skilled player, capable of beating any regular player save the "monster" players, such as Saki, Koromo, and Takei. In the past, Hajime used lived with her Father, both of whom who struggled to make a living working as magicians: it is because of this occupation that Hajime is skilled in performing magic tricks, in particular, the "sleight-of-hand" trick, which she used when she played for her school team when she was younger: Hajime utilized her magician skills to make an illegal move, seemingly winning the game for her team. However, later investigations revealed the violation, causing Hajime's team to lose and Hajime herself to q

characters.name: Touka Ryuumonbuchi
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Comes from a very rich family and loves being in the spotlight which leads her to hate Nodoka because of her popularity as the middle school champion. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 龍円渕透火 instead

title: Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita!: Precious Friends
title_original: 私に天使が舞い降りた！プレシャス・フレンズ
title_en: WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me -Precious Friends-
description: The sketch comedy about becoming friends with super cute girls is headed for the big screen! Good friends Hana, Hinata, Noa, Koyori, and Kanon are once again having a fun snack party at home with Miyako’s homemade sweets. They notice that the flower-shaped cookies look just like Hana’s trademark hair clip, a treasured item that was given to her by her grandmother when she was little. The girls get excited to learn about the story, so they decide to visit grandma’s house. The curtain rises on everyone’s first trip together! (Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

characters.name: Miyako Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A college student who is shy around strangers and spends most of her time indoors. She becomes smitten by [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and starts making her snacks in exchange for getting her to dress up in cosplay outfits she makes.

characters.name: Hana Shirosaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 142.3 cm (4'8") An elementary school student who is classmates with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477). She is often disturbed by [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s behavior but puts up with it in order to eat her snacks.

characters.name: Hinata Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 140.7 cm [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s younger sister and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s classmate. She is particularly fond of her sister, who she nicknames "Mya-nee".

characters.name: Noa Himesaka
characters.description: __Height__: 142.7 cm (4'8") [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477)'s classmate who moves next door to [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and Hinata. She constantly sees herself as cute, often becoming downhearted when someone else (usually Hana) is said to be cuter.

characters.name: Koyori Tanemura
characters.description: __Height__: 138.6 cm (4'6") A class representative in Hana's class. She aspires to be someone that everyone can rely on, but is often unreliable herself.

characters.name: Kanon Konomori
characters.description: __Height:__ 141 cm (4'7") Another class representative in [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s class and [Koyori](https://anilist.co/character/131478)'s best friend. She is kind and often seen as very reliable, much to Koyori's chagrin.

characters.name: Kouko Matsumoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 164.8 cm (5'4") A girl who was in a club with [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) during high school. While Miyako hardly remembers her, she has been obsessively fixated on her, acting like a stalker.

characters.name: Chizuru Hoshino
characters.description: Miyako and Hinata's mother.

characters.name: Emily Himesaka
characters.description: Noa Himesaka's mother.

characters.name: Yuuna Matsumoto
characters.description: Yuuna is [Kouko Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/136814)'s little sister who appears for the first time when [Miyako Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and [Hinata Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131477) go outside to go shop.

characters.name: Haruka Shirosaki
characters.description: Hana Shirosaki's mother.

title: Hidamari Sketch × 365
description: Yuno, Miyako, Hiro, Sae and the rest of the denizens of the most fascinating piece of surreal estate in Japan are back. And they're still spurning the "A happens after B, happens after C" pattern so prevalent in the rest of the world. In fact, instead of just taking place after Yuno's first year at Yamabuki High, this season of Hidamari Sketch continues on both sides, around the edges and in-between. Filling in the details in an ever-expanding collage that's both avant-garde and slice of life! (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chika
characters.description: Chika is Sae's thirteen-year-old sister. She is more spontaneous and energetic than her older sister. She enjoys cooking and has an infatuation with a Kabuki actor. She has no artistic talent and prefers music and home economics to art. Initially only appearing in the anime adaptation, she made her first appearance in the manga in the June 2012 issue of Manga Time Kirara Carat.

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: Ume is a Metapod that lives on the roof of the Hidamari Apartments and represents the manga's author, Ume Aoki. The character does not actually play any significant role in the story. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Misato
characters.description: The former occupant of room 201 prior to the arrival of Yuno. She was an eccentric upperclassman, 2 years senior of Hiro and Sae, who likes to pull various pranks on the tenants. She was very talented in art, which won her many competitions, and wished to travel the world during college despite the lack of funds.

characters.name: Toudou
characters.description: Todo is the president of Yamabuki High School's Broadcasting Club, and is a third-year student when Yuno and Miyako are in the first year and Hiro and Sae are in the second year. She is an original character in _Hidamari Sketch x 365_ anime and doesn't appear in _Hidamari Sketch_ manga.

title: Saki: Achiga-hen - episode of side-A
title_original: 咲-Saki-阿知賀編 episode of side-A
description: The Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara once defeated regional mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. It advanced into the national team semifinals but lost to the eventual champion, and the mahjong club was later disbanded. Six years later, elementary school student Shizuno Takakamo befriends transfer student Nodoka Haramura. The two eventually enter Achiga Girls', but Nodoka transfers out of the school in the second year. When Shizuno sees Nodoka on television the following year as the national middle school individual mahjong champion, she decides to revive Achiga's mahjong club.

characters.name: Shizuno Takakamo
characters.description: Shizuno Takakamo is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and the main protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". In her elementary school days, she befriended [Nodoka Haramura](https://anilist.co/character/17275/Haramura-Nodoka) and together played mahjong in Achiga's mahjong club. She was the club's second best player before it was disbanded. Upon seeing Nodoka on television as the middle school individual champion, she decides to re-establish the club upon entering high school. Her goal is to go to the national high school team tournament and play against Nodoka. ~!Her special ability allows Shizuno to block other players abilities. The more tiles is taken from the corner of the wall, the stronger her ability is. Literary "the deeper players go in the mountains, the closer they to her territory". That's why she was cal

characters.name: Kuro Matsumi
characters.description: Kuro Matsumi is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Before the club was disbanded, Kuro was its number one player. She kept the room clean in hopes that someone would eventually return to the club. She is the younger sister of Yuu Matsumi. ~!Kuro's abilities are briefly commented on. During a match with Nodoka Haramura, Ako states that it was never possible to her to get any dora because they all gather toward Kuro. Because of this she has earned the nickname The Dragon Lord. The downside to this is that she can't discard any dora. If she does, Kuro will not be able to get a single dora for several games.!~

characters.name: Ako Atarashi
characters.description: Ako Atarashi is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is an elementary school friend of Shizuno Takakamo and Nodoka Haramura. She was the third best player in Achiga's mahjong club as an elementary school student. When the club disbanded, she attended a different middle school in order to continue playing and intended on entering mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. When Shizuno re-established the club, she decided to return to the school. ~! Ako likes to play fast and has a good sense for the flow of the game. Ako is the most skilled player on the Achiga team but is overlooked because of the upperclassmen's special abilites. !~

characters.name: Arata Sagimori
characters.description: Arata Sagimori is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is a childhood friend of Kuro and Yuu Matsumi; her family owns a bowling alley in the area. As a kindergartener, she grew up playing mahjong with adults at the Matsumi inn but stopped playing after her first year of elementary school. She is an admirer of Harue Akado and thus lost interest in the game after Harue stopped playing following Achiga's loss in the national tournament. When Kuro informs her that Harue has begun playing mahjong again, Arata agrees to join Achiga's mahjong club. She was assigned on the position of Achiga mahjong club president by Harue as most level-headed member of the team.

characters.name: Yuu Matsumi
characters.description: Yuu Matsumi is a third-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is Kuro Matsumi's older sister. When she was younger, she wanted to join others in Achiga's mahjong club but felt it would be awkward because she was older. Yuu is very sensitive to the cold and covers herself head to toe when she goes anywhere, even in the summer. ~! Yuu's ability is that she can draw alot of manzu and chun tiles, so her hand is manly composed of these tiles. She also draws these tiles because she feels warmer drawing in warm tiles. As a result, her tile possession distribution is generally skewed toward the character tiles. When that playing style fails, Yuu draws in all red tiles and becomes difficult to defend against. According to Kuro, Yuu is just as good as she is at mahjong. According to Toki

characters.name: Harue Akado
characters.description: Harue Akado is the mahjong club coach at her alma mater Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Harue was once known as the "Legend of Achiga" for taking the school to the national high school team mahjong tournament. After the team's defeat, she lost confidence and stopped playing mahjong for some time, leading to the team's eventual disbandment. She was later scouted by a professional team but returns home several years later when the company decides break the team up. ~!Harue's defeat in the national semifinal came at the hand of Sukoya Kokaji, who would eventually become a professional player and commentator in subsequent national high school tournaments in the main "Saki" manga.!~

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: __Position:__ Vanguard Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Kyoutarou Suga
characters.description: A first year student and one of the new recruits for the Kiyosumi Mahjong club, but is not as talented as the rest of the members due to the fact that he is new to the game. As such, he is sent to perform menial tasks more than actually practice. He is attracted to Nodoka due to her physique but so far these feelings are unrequited by Nodoka. He is constantly abused by Yuuki but pays no attention to her pranking ways. He is close with Saki since he has known her since Middle School, but tends to use her to get small things, such as a Ladies' Lunch. Nonetheless, he cares for all of his fellow club members and most likely doesn't mind helping them out, despite being harassed by most of the members.

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutenant A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name. A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most, ~!the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.!~ Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: __Position:__ Sergeant A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

title: Dokidoki! Precure
title_original: ドキドキ! プリキュア
description: Aida Mana is a girl who is always eager to do things for the sake of others. One day, when she was visiting the Clover Tower during her school's orientation program, an enemy who called themselves "Selfish" appeared suddenly, and tried to manipulate her inner heart! To fight this enemy, she borrowed power from a magical fairy Sharuru to transform into Pretty Cure! To protect the peace of the world, other legendary Pretty Cure soon joined her in battle! A mysterious baby also appears, making each day a "Heartthrob" experience! The 4 Cures, always holding "love" in their hearts, are battling for the world's fate! (Source: Asahi TV)

characters.name: Mana Aida
characters.description: Aida Mana is one of the five main cures and is the leader of the group. Mana is a cheerful girl who is great at sports and her studies. Her kindness makes her popular at school, and she has the trust of not only the students but adults as well. However, she often rushes into things before thinking it through. She is childhood friends with [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/75224/Rikka-Hishikawa) and [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/75222/Alice-Yotsuba). She is also a fan of the idol [Kenzaki Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/75226/Makoto-Kenzaki) Cure Heart is Mana's Pretty Cure alter ego. She represents love.

characters.name: Alice Yotsuba
characters.description: Alice is the mistress and heiress of Yotsuba Enterprises, an extremely successful business conglomerate. She is gentle and quiet, has a somewhat bubbly manner and is always calm. Due to her upbringing, she is a girl of many talents, however she sometimes says or does things which deviate from popular sentiment, shocking her friends. Despite her quiet nature, her anger is something to be wary of Cure Rosetta is Alice's Pretty Cure alter ego. She represents warmth.

characters.name: Rikka Hishikawa
characters.description: While she is kind and usually calm-minded, Rikka can be bluntly stern and she's not afraid to speak her mind. She strives to lead a quiet school life but is often dragged into various things by [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/75220/Mana-Aida), and as her childhood friend she feels obligated to look out for her and keep her out of trouble. Rikka enjoys things like studying and is one of the top ten scoring students in the national trial exams. Rikka is at the top of the class and constantly placed as the first place in her school, however, if she becomes distracted by other things, like a current hobby, her grades are shown to suffer.

characters.name: Makoto Kenzaki
characters.description: Makoto is the royal guard of the Trump Kingdom. She is a stubborn girl with a strong sense of justice who is willing to defend others by sacrificing her own safety during battle. She dislikes violence and fighting and as such, preferred to stand alone to keep others out of harms way. Deep down she holds regret at not being able to defend the Trump Kingdom and wishes to find Princess Marie Ange. Her true personality is often masked by how she acts and only [Davi](https://anilist.co/character/76048/Davi ) knows what she is really thinking. Cure Sword is Makoto's Pretty Cure alter ego. She represents courage.

characters.name: Raquel
characters.description: Raquel is a dog-like fairy mascot, one of the four main mascots in Doki Doki! Pretty Cure. She is very reliable, much like her partner, Cure Diamond. She ends her sentences with "~quel!".

characters.name: Lance
characters.description: Lance is a bear-like fairy mascot, one of the four main mascots in DokiDoki! Pretty Cure. He is the youngest out of the four mascots, and is a little spoilt. His partner is Cure Rosetta. He ends his sentences with "~de lance!".

characters.name: Davi
characters.description: Dabyi is a cat-like fairy, one of the four main mascots in Doki Doki! Pretty Cure. She is very independent, much like her partner, Cure Sword, but she often worries about Sword. She ends her sentences with "~dabyi!". She is Makoto's manager.

characters.name: Sharuru
characters.description: Heart's rabbit-like fairy partner. The most passionate of all the four mascots, she has a passionate heart and always works hard. She ends her sentences with "~sharu!".

characters.name: Aguri Madoka
characters.description: Aguri is composed, calm, and wise beyond her young years. She can be strict and expects others to follow the rules, so she can appear to be bossy and accidentally say hurtful things. However, she has an appreciation for good food, most notably sweets. ~!Cure Ace is Aguri's alter ego. Cure Ace represents love. As Cure Ace, Aguri has limited time to be in this form, five minutes at most.!~ ~!One year prior to the season, Princess Marie Ange fell ill to a terminal disease. Only the Eternal Golden Crown, one of the Three Sacred Treasures, had the knowledge to save her. Desperate to save his daughter, the king of the Trump Kingdom stole the crown but was consumed by the evil and transformed into the [Selfish King](https://anilist.co/character/86963/King-Jikochuu). Unable to fight her father, Princess Marie Ange broke her heart into two parts: The part that loves her father, which is her bad s

characters.name: Ira
characters.description: Ira is the youngest member of the Selfish Trio. He first appears in Episode 1 along with Marmo. He has light blue hair and olive eyes. Like the rest of the trio, he has bat wing-like objects behind his ears. He wears a dark purple jacket with a high collar over a red shirt, grayish-black pants that stop at his knees, a red choker around his neck, and red and black boots. Ira has a playful personality, mostly acting like a bratty kid and therefore being referred to as 'kid' at points by the other members of the trio. He is also known for getting angry easily, and he often takes out his anger by bowling in the Selfish Trio's bowling alley hideout. ~!But despite his flaws he has displayed a certain level of honor as seen in Episode 26 when he saves the Cures from Gula, though it is unknown whether it is because he was grateful for Rikka treating his injuries and helping him gain his memorie

characters.name: Michiko
characters.description: Michiko is a little girl who Mana helps in episode 1. She appears later on when a Jikochuu attacks the area she's in and Mana runs to save her.

characters.name: Bel
characters.description: Bel is the leader, as well as the oldest member of the Selfish Trio. He first appears in Episode 3. Bel has a gray beard and moustache, with his hair combed backwards. He wears glasses and a black coat with green lining. His eye color is olive, the same as Ira's and Marmo's. Bel is an extremely lazy person who does not really enjoy doing any work himself rather he sends Marmo and Ira to do all the dirty work. ~!Despite his seemingly calm and cool demeanor it has been shown that he has a sadistic side when he tried to torture Cure Heart by taking Ai hostage and thus making her unable to fight back or when he set up a trap for Mana and Regina trying to make one of them betray the other and let her fall into the lava. He also has no qualms on killing other members, namely Leva and Gula, taking joy on their painful deaths. !~ (Source: Pretty Cure Wiki)

title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Dai-Mankai no Shou
title_original: 結城友奈は勇者である-大満開の章-
title_en: Yuki Yuna is a Hero: The Great Mankai Chapter
description: The magical girls of the Sanshu Middle School Hero Club have one goal: to make people smile whenever they can and to always help those in need. Through teamwork and the help of their magical powers, Yuna, Mimori, Fuu, Itsuki, Karin and Sonoko have vanquished deadly Vertexes, recovered a missing friend and balanced their lives as magical girls and regular middle school students. Now a new adventure begins, one that will test their skills and their bond as friends alike. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuuna Yuuki
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic. She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

characters.name: Mimori Tougou
characters.description: [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident. ~! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !~

characters.name: Fuu Inubouzaki
characters.description: A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating. As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

characters.name: Itsuki Inubouzaki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times. As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

characters.name: Karin Miyoshi
characters.description: A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere". As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense

characters.name: Sonoko Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

characters.name: Wakaba Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School A second-year middle school student and one of the Heroes of the first Hero Team and the ancestor of [Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/88641/Sonoko-Nogi). Wakaba is a serious, strong-willed girl that believes in rewarding favors. She seeks revenge on the Vertexes and is willing to take risks to get it. She is a natural, charismatic leader who is wildly popular with the general public. However, she is also a kindhearted girl who is dismayed that her serious exterior sometimes scares people off, and she has a hidden soft side which enjoys being spoiled by [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/126245/Uesato-Hinata). As a Hero, Wakaba fights using a sword named Ikutachi. It can cut through Vertexes with ease, even if the user is not transformed. Ikutachi is one-handed, meaning she has no need to hold onto it with both hands.

characters.name: Yuuna Takashima
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School One of the Heroes of the first Hero team. Yuuna is a bright and energetic girl and can be thought of as the "mood maker of the team". She thinks friends and family are two of the most important things, and she is sensitive to other's feelings. Yuuna is also selfless and will throw herself into battle for her friends, even to her own detriment. However, she has a habit of hiding her own emotions. When Yuuna is in Hero form, her weapon is the tekko. Hers, in particular, are imbued with a divine power called Ama-no-Sakate, a cursed from a land god with rage-filled hatred to destroy.

characters.name: Chikage Koori
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Grade:__ 3rd Year of Middle School A Hero of the first Hero team. Chikage is a shy, quiet and lonely girl who is not good at interacting with other people. She enjoys playing video games, like most introverts. Despite how mistrustful and silent towards others she seems, she is a good person at heart who only wishes for acceptance. She is seen bonding with [Yuuna Takashima](https://anilist.co/character/126201/Yuuna-Takashima) the most, but does care about other members of the team. ~!She was killed in action during a battle with the Vertexes, protecting Wakaba. Following her death, her record was erased by the Taisha.!~

characters.name: Mebuki Kusunoki
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School Kusunoki Mebuki is the main character appearing in her titular series, Kusunoki Mebuki is a Hero. She is strong-willed and diligent, willing to go to any lengths to achieve victory. She is also very stubborn, whether it's about being a Hero or an artisan, her passion.

characters.name: Gin Minowa
characters.description: [Sumi](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Mimori-Tougou)'s and [Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/88641/Sonoko-Nogi)'s classmate and fellow hero. Gin is the youngest and the shortest out of the three friends, also being physically the strongest and the most sporty one. She uses a pair of large blades in her hero form. Gin is a kind, energetic girl, with a lot of spirits and positive attitude. She is a tomboy but has a girly side. Her main interests consist of sports and different kinds of competitions. During her free time, mostly before going to school, she looks after her younger brother. That, along with her helpful nature which makes her give a hand to everyone needing it, often causes her to be late for her classes and meetings. ~!During the fourth battle with the Vertexes, she, along with Sumi and Sonoko, fell into a trap in which they all got seriously injured. Gin, being the o

characters.name: Tamako Doi
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm One of the Heroes of the first Hero team. Tamako is an energetic, emotionally-driven girl that is very fond of the outdoors. She tends to laugh a lot and gets angry easily. She is also fond of making puns with her own name, and refers to herself in third person. She is protective of her friends and tries to prevent them from being hurt. As a Hero, Tamako uses a retractable six-bladed shield named Kamuyatatehime to battle. It can be used as a weapon similar to a yo-yo because it can be thrown and returned, but it can also be used as a blade when swinging around.

title: Grow Up Show: Himawari no Circus-dan
title_original: グロウアップショウ ～ひまわりのサーカス団～
description: The anime's story is set in the late 1950s and early 1960s, during the height of Japan's economic boom, when the circus is a major form of entertainment. Different circus troupes travel throughout Japan to perform and compete for a chance to participate in the world-renowned festival called "Circus Collection." One troupe called the "Sunflower Circus," led by its ringmaster Maria, travels around Japan to perform, despite struggling with financial difficulties. However, they meet a circus prodigy named Mizuka Tsurumaki. This is the story of a one-of-a-kind circus show of young girls with big dreams. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Mizuka Tsurumaki
characters.description: An easygoing, free-spirited girl with exceptional physical abilities. While she is a woman of action, her tendency to speak without reading the room often rubs those around her the wrong way. She ends up crossing paths with the Himawari Circus due to a certain turn of events.

characters.name: Ouka Kawasumi
characters.description: The star performer of Himawari Circus, she serves as the "flyer" on the trapeze, soaring through the air. She is earnest and dedicated, though she has a slightly ditzy side.

characters.name: Imari Agano
characters.description: A magician who has a friendly but clumsy demeanor. She is friends with Rin.

characters.name: Isuzu Ikazuchi
characters.description: A tomboyish acrobat with a strong sense of justice.

characters.name: Aoi Yura
characters.description: Akane's twin sister and her partner in juggling.

characters.name: Akane Yura
characters.description: Aoi's twin sister and her partner in juggling.

characters.name: Shizuku Sakawa
characters.description: A performer whose job is to catch trapeze performers. She is long-time friends with Svetlana.

characters.name: Svetlana
characters.description: A performer who specializes in aerial silks. She is treated like an older sister by the other circus members.

characters.name: Rin Mamiya
characters.description: The circus's accountant, who also does other management-related work. She is bothered by the circus's constant financial issues.

characters.name: Maria
characters.description: A clown and the ringmaster of the Sunflower Circus, who is often mistaken for being a child despite being an adult.

characters.name: Black Lotus
characters.description: [Mizuka](https://anilist.co/character/396508/)'s father. The former ringmaster of the legendary circus "Lotus Circus" that every circus performer aspires to join. As a father, he drilled circus techniques into Mizuka. Currently, he is wandering somewhere in the world.

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのは EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
title_en: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
