description: Thirty years ago, the world was nearly destroyed by the sudden appearance of unknown "invasive alien species." Humans and these “invasive species” continue to vie for living space, and while humanity’s safety is currently barely secured, the world could be destroyed at any moment. Living in fear of death and destruction, people go about their daily lives as if trying to avert their eyes from danger and disaster. In this world, the United Nations Hazardous Species Investigation Agency, "EXCEEDS," has begun operations to ward off crises and disasters caused by invasive species. The story begins on the island nation of "Mizuho" in the Far East. Shina Hisase is a young invasive species extermination hunter living on a remote island. What incident will befall Shina, who wishes only to live quietly with her younger sister Setsuna, her sole remaining family member? Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Shiina Kuze
characters.description: __Height:__ 166cm

characters.name: Setsuna Kuze
characters.description: __Height:__ 137cm

characters.name: Raising Heart
characters.description: Raising Heart is Nanoha's Intelligent Device. Her standby appearance is that of a simple, red, spherical pendant. In combat, she can shift into a variety of forms as the situation dictates to support Nanoha. After being badly damaged in the fight against the guardian knights of the Book of Darkness, she requests to be rebult with the Belkan Cartridge System, taking up the name Raising Heart Excelion after her rebuild is complete. (Source: Magical GIrl Lyrical Nanoha the Movie 1st and Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha the Movie 2nd A's)

characters.name: Bardiche
characters.description: An Intelligent Device created for [Fate Testarossa](https://anilist.co/character/1896/Fate-Testarossa) by [Rynith](). He receives a number of upgrades in the series.

characters.name: Yuuna Kitamori
characters.description: __Height:__ 172cm

characters.name: Shiori Aizawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 163cm

characters.name: Aoi Niina
characters.description: __Height:__ 152cm

characters.name: Yuzu Kodera
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm

characters.name: Towa Yorumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm

title: Kirio Fanclub
description: What would you do if your crush had ear-splitting farts? For Aimi and Nami, the answer is to cry tears of joy for being able to pinpoint at a distance the object of their affections, Kirio, from a single toot. These are the kinds of deep, philosophical questions the two friends/rivals in romance pose to each other to prove their love for this boy who hardly seems to know they exist. That won’t stop them from conducting nightly rituals to entice him into their dreams, though, or listing out what exactly they like about him, down to the very last organ. But when push comes to shove, will they choose their hilarious friendship over a shot at love? Get ready for a rip-roaring romcom about the friendship behind what is fair in love and war! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Murder Princess
description: A scientist known as Dr. Akamashi launches a coup d'état in the Forland Kingdom using his army of beasts and two android minions. With his dying breath, the king tells his daughter, Princess Alita, to escape at all cost and find Prince Kaito - her older brother who's currently on a diplomatic mission abroad - in order to guarantee her own safety and possibly take back the kingdom. As Alita flees, however, she ends up in a predicament that results in her dying and swapping bodies with Falis, an infamous bounty hunter who happened to be out hunting in a nearby forest together with her monster sidekicks, Dominikov and Pete. With the two women retaining their respective skills and personalities but changing appearances, Alita, now in Falis's body, begs her to go back to her kingdom and make things right, offering her body and soul as collateral - to which Falis, now in Alita's body, agrees, leading to the birth of the so-called Murder Princess, who ends up not only having to take back and protect the kingdom, but also, unravel a much deeper intrigue that soon unfolds.

characters.name: Alita Forland
characters.original: アリタ・フォーランド
characters.description: Alita is the princess in the kingdom of Forland. When she escapes because of the rebellion, she meets Falis in the forest. Her soul and Falis's soul switch bodies, and Alita (in Falis's body) becomes Falis's (in the body of Princess Alita) servant named Milano.

characters.name: Falis
characters.description: Falis is one of the strongest and the most infamous bounty hunters in the world, even attributed with having slain a dragon. When operating near the border of Forland Kingdom, Princess Alita runs into her, and the two of them end up switching bodies by accident. Now stuck in Alita's body, she makes a deal with Alita to assume her identity and defend her kingdom. Falis' weapon of choice is the ancient katana Himetsuru (姫鶴, ひめつる, Himetsuru, lit. Crane Princess); she sometimes uses a dagger in conjunction with the sword. [Wikipedia]

characters.name: Dominikov
characters.description: A fellow bounty hunter working for Falis. In the manga he is a Shinigami with extensive knowledge, while in the anime he is a cyborg. His weapon of choice is a large scythe. [Wikipedia]

characters.name: Pete Armstrong
characters.original: ピート・アームストロング
characters.description: Fellow bounty hunter working for Falis. While he is big, ferocious, and overpowering in hand to hand combat, beneath his purple skin is a gentle soul. Like Dominikov, Pete is a cyborg in the anime version. [Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kaito
characters.description: Prince of Forland, Kaito is Alita's older brother and eight years her senior. She speaks of him fondly, bragging of his swordsmanship as well as his kindness. Prince Kaito left the country to hold peace talks with Forland's western neighbor, the kingdom of Grandel, but no one has heard from him since. ~!When he comes back, it is revealed that he is the man clad in a heavy, dark-colored set of armor that accompanies Cecilia. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Cecilia
characters.description: A sorceress who is tracking Alita's every move. Not much about her is known so far, although Falis has an unpleasant memory that involved her. [Wikipedia]

characters.name: Yuna
characters.description: Twin android created by Professor Akamashi. Yuna is the quietest of the two and usually hides behind Anna. (Source: Broccoli Books) She goes berserk when she sees the Professor get hurt.

characters.name: Ana
characters.description: Twin android created by professor Akamashi. Anna is the more talkative one, and is very protective of the professor. (Source: Broccoli Books)

characters.name: Dr. Akamashi
characters.description: Formerly a scientist working for the late King Forland. He has abused lost technology entrusted to the Forland royal family, and conspires to take over the kingdom in order to gain complete possession over said technology. [Wikipedia]

characters.name: Jodo Entolasia
characters.original: ジョドォ‧エントラシア
characters.description: The trusted of the royal king Xenos and the royal family of Forland.

title: Yokohama Kaidashi Kikou: Quiet Country Cafe
title_original: ヨコハマ買い出し紀行 Quiet Country Cafe
description: In the near-future Japan, global warming has brought the large city Yokohama underwater, and only the hills remain above the ocean surface. What used to be one of the largest cities in Japan now feels like a small town. Basically, the existence of the island country itself has been threatened. However, there is no feeling of desperation, devastation, nor hopelessness. People are enjoying laid-back lives, and they seem to appreciate each other's company, enjoying the quiet and peaceful time together. This is especially so with Alpha, a carefree young woman who runs a cafe, named Cafe Alpha. She enjoys her life immersing herself in the beautiful nature all around her. There is nothing more precious to her than spending quality time with her kind friends. Oh, the fulfillment and the joy she finds in life... it all indicates her to be a compassionate human being, but she is not quite a human. She is actually a type A7M2 robot. One day, upon hearing a radio forecast warning an approaching typhoon, her old friend who lives close by invites her to the gas station he runs, worried that her old cafe may not withstand the typhoon. Indeed, the passing of typhoon leaves Alpha with her cafe sev

characters.name: Alpha Hatsuseno
characters.description: Alpha is the main character of the series. As an A7-M2 model robot, one of the few production prototypes, she is one of the first of the A7 series and was named "Alpha". She has an unusual affinity with machines and people. Unlike most characters with cheerful personalities, Alpha is sweet without being saccharine. Her pleasant disposition has won her several friends and loyal customers yet she is also capable of making deep insights and displays an unusual level of maturity during her more private moments. As the story progresses, she interacts more with her surroundings and the people around her, gaining more knowledge about life with her experiences.

characters.name: Kokone Takatsu
characters.description: A type A7M3 production robot who works as a courier out of Yokohama. She is the first other robot that Alpha met when she delivered a package (containing a camera) and a message from Alpha's owner. They quickly become friends. Kokone is sweet, shy, and somewhat intellectual, but because of her job she has more experience with people than Alpha.

characters.name: Oji-san
characters.description: A middle-aged man with a perpetual grin, he is Alpha's closest neighbor and a regular customer at her café. He runs a gas station and sells vegetables on the side. He is a grandfather-figure to Alpha and the actual grandfather of Takahiro. Ojisan refers to himself as a bum and seems to regret not pursuing a relationship with Sensei when they were younger. His real name is never given.

characters.name: Takahiro
characters.description: The grandson of Ojisan, who lives with his grandparents. He meets Alpha at age nine and she quickly takes to him as if he were a younger brother. He is the first character in the series to meet the Misago. As he grows up, Takahiro becomes fascinated with engines of all types and eventually moves away in his mid-teens to work with Nai.

characters.name: Matsuki
characters.description: A girl a few years younger than Takahiro. She likes Takahiro and is initially jealous of Alpha. Makki eventually becomes close to Alpha after learning that the latter would never consider having a relationship with Takahiro because mortal humans move through time in a different way compared to the immortal robots. She is skeptical of Takahiro's stories of the Misago until she meets the wild-woman herself. In her early teens, Makki works for a while at Alpha's café before moving away to become a courier with Kokone's company. She later settles down at Hamamatsu with Takahiro.

characters.name: Nai
characters.description: A robot of unknown model. He is unusual in that, for unknown reasons, male robots rarely survive long. He flies a modified T-6 Texan aircraft to run a delivery service. Nai is quiet and impassive.

characters.name: Misago
characters.description: An ageless wild-woman who lives in the inlets and bays near Café Alpha. She is always naked and eats raw fish caught with her short fangs and inhuman speed. She only shows herself to young children and shies away from contact with adults. She does not age and, according to omake material, doesn't understand how children grow up. According to Ayase, she existed decades before robots were created.

title: SHOW BY ROCK!!#
description: Metropolis of music, MIDICITY. A kitty girl wearing gothic lolita clothing named Cyan is scouted by Maple Arisugawa, the president of a music agency. From there, she meets Chuchu (a pun off of the sound that rabbits make) the honor student rabbit girl, a net geek dog girl named Retoree (from "Retriever"), and an alien sheep (?) girl named Moa. Together, they form the band named "Plasmagica," and aim for the top of the world. However, the path there is long and tough, and keeping in high spirits is important. By battling against other strange bands, Plasmagica slowly grows toward a top-grade band. In the end, they'll be a band that becomes the driving force of MIDICITY's music industry... Maybe? Gonna be a music millionaire! (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Retoree
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Bass A girl from the Dog Tribe who is a total internet otaku and smartphone addict. She usually puts on a cool facade, but deep down, she is incredibly shy. Whenever a topic she’s passionate about comes up, she gets so excited that she starts talking a mile a minute. Online, however, she’s quite the barker. She has an aversion to "normies" (people with active social lives) and clothing store clerks.

characters.name: Moa
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Drums A naturally eccentric, high-energy space-sheep girl who arrived from a distant galaxy on a research mission. Her musical sensibilities are truly cosmic—unrivaled among the group members. She has a habit of blurting out whatever crosses her mind, which occasionally lands her bandmates in trouble. Her signature verbal tic—ending her sentences with "pyuru"—is apparently a communication code from her home planet.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A rabbit-girl who embodies the "beloved class president" archetype: an honor student who is both dependable and organized, as well as sociable and charming. She serves as the de facto leader of the band and enjoys the deep trust of her fellow members. However, she also possesses an ambitious streak—secretly, and without the other members' knowledge, she is aiming to make a solo debut. She practices the guitar without fail every single day and takes a very earnest approach to her music.

characters.name: Cyan Hijirikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A cat girl who cherishes a heart-shaped guitar known as [Strawberry Heart](https://anilist.co/character/153391/Strawberry-Heart)—a legendary instrument rumored to possess extraordinary power. Her guitar talent was recognized by [Maple Arisugawa](https://anilist.co/character/153403/Maple-Arisugawa), leading to her recruitment as a member of Plasmagica. Through her band activities alongside [Chuchu](https://anilist.co/character/88975/Chuchu), [Retoree](https://anilist.co/character/88973/Retoree), and [Moa](https://anilist.co/character/88974/Moa), she continues to grow and mature.

characters.name: Crow
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm __Species:__ Hedgehog __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar Fearless and utterly convinced—without a shred of doubt—that he is "the coolest and most popular guy in the world." His signature style features a raw yet razor-sharp vocal delivery that sends shivers down the spines of listeners. He hails from a dairy farming family and absolutely loves milk.

characters.name: Aion
characters.description: __Height:__ 192 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Guitar He has a suspicious demeanor and cannot speak articulately unless he strikes a specific pose—yet, he is incredibly handsome. He is rumored to captivate his female fans with the genius-level guitar technique he displays during live performances.

characters.name: Yaiba
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Bass He respects the spirit of rock and the way of the samurai. His self-proclaimed bass technique is top-notch.

characters.name: Rom
characters.description: __Height:__ 186 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Drums The band's leader, he possesses a fiery personality—one where his fists tend to fly before his words—and serves as the driving force that holds the members together. He successfully balances his career as a company employee with his band activities.

characters.name: Ailane
characters.description: __Height:__ 142 cm __Group:__ BUDVIRGINLOGIC __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar The majestic lion girl who looks down on everyone. A charismatic beauty with a strong soul of language (kotodama) who carries the aura of a king. Her stature is short. Music and principles of being a good emperor have been taught to her since her childhood. However this turned her into a rather nonathletic person who finds everything bothersome. Furthermore a clumsy person who falls and drops things often. She likes high places and prefers things smaller than her.

characters.name: Chitan
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm __Species:__ Blue Unicorn __Group:__ ARCAREAFACT __Position:__ Lead Vocals, Piano His parents are renowned musicians. While he inherited his talent from them, he possesses a fiercely competitive nature and has worked harder than anyone else since childhood. On the surface, he appears cool and maintains a poker face—even adopting a detached attitude toward his fellow members—yet he harbors a burning fighting spirit deep within and is quick to get fired up. He dislikes boats.

characters.name: Strawberry Heart
characters.description: A sentient instrument that Cyan obtains in her mobile game. It resembles a guitar with a heart-shaped design, and is one of the Legendary Instruments. Serving as Cyan's instructor in Midi City, it gives her advice on how to defeat the dark monsters.

characters.name: Holmy
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Group:__ Criticrista __Position:__ Vocals and Bass A female bassist of the Holstein Cow Tribe. She serves as the Student Council President. Upon entering MIDI City Academy, she was an inconspicuous student with unremarkable grades; however, fueled by a passion for music second to none, she successfully survived the legendary "Hellish Training" rumored to take place beneath the academy—a feat that earned her admission into the Special Performing Arts Department. Earnest and prone to worrying, she is a long-suffering individual who constantly finds herself at the mercy of her free-spirited bandmates.

title: Akuma no Riddle Special
description: Unaired episode 13 of Akuma no Riddle released with the seventh Blu-ray/DVD volume.

characters.name: Haru Ichinose
characters.description: __Height:__ 159cm (5'2") Haru is shown to be a bright and cheerful girl of Black Class. As claimed by Tokaku, Haru poses a naive character and trusts anyone without a single thought. She is shown to have a highly optimistic attitude, which is sometimes bothersome for Tokaku since she is not used to friendliness. All in all, Haru's rival classmates appreciate her gullible nature; deeming her as an easy target. She is very forgiving and doesn't mind anyone for bearing any kind of grudge towards her as seen when she still talks in a caring and friendly manner towards every other girl who loses their purpose after chasing her with killing intents. ~!Like the other women of her clan, Haru possesses the "Queen Bee" power of manipulating others to protect her and let her live the position of highest hierarchy; making others be simply a "worker bee". Haru inhibits and implies this power without

characters.name: Tokaku Azuma
characters.description: __Birthday:__ March 3 __Height:__ 170cm (5'6") Tokaku is a distant and cold girl. Even at first glance, she has the appearance of an assassin.She eventually grows to care for Haru in time, even coming to the point of calling herself Haru's protector. Azuma dislikes it when other people try to get close to her, and she especially hates being called by her first name, but Haru compromises and calls her "Tokaku-san". She is skilled with using knives, and has exceptionally quick reflexes. It is soon revealed that Azuma has never killed anyone before, despite possessing very useful skills as an assassin. Her family is a well known family of assassins. They say that the east's Azuma and the west's Kuzunoha are two assassination clans that existed in the country since ancient times. The Kuzunoha was the main branch and the Azuma is a branch family. However, interactions between these two clans

characters.name: Mahiru Banba
characters.description: A rather shy and mysterious-looking young woman who's a former assassin who's developed a second personality at some point in her past named Shin'ya Banba who's a quite more rude and violent personality than the actual Mahiru. Both are like two souls who share the same body, thus both never appear at the same moment throughout the plot, yet both are able to communicate with each other to a certain degree. Mahiru is a shy and timid girl who often has trouble speaking for herself. She is easily subject to bullying, and is often defenseless. However, when the sun sets, Mahiru's alternate personality, Shin'ya Banba, appears. Shin'ya is the complete opposite of Mahiru, and refers to herself (or even himself) as "ore (俺)", a masculine term. In contrast to her host personality, Shin'ya has an aggressive and borderline insane appearance cultivated to protect Mahiru. Shin'ya is able to enter a te

characters.name: Sumireko Hanabusa
characters.description: Sumireko is a high class, polite girl. She's considerably warmer to people than [Tokaku](https://anilist.co/character/86241/Azuma-Tokaku) is, but she's hinted to be one of the more dangerous members of Class Black.

characters.name: Nio Hashiri
characters.description: Hashiri Nio is an energetic and upbeat girl with a knack for peeping into other people's businesses. Despite being a part of the Black Class group, she is also affiliated with the academy in some way.

characters.name: Kouko Kaminaga
characters.description: A girl with glasses who insists of being the 'rep' of everything, such as Black Class' class representative. She is shown to use grenades as a weapon.

characters.name: Shiena Kenmochi
characters.description: Shiena seems to have a normal personality compared to the rest of the members of Class Black. Although she is somewhat scatterbrained and forgetful, she is also strict at times, as shown when directing the play in Episode 5. She says she will do anything to protect the place she belongs to. Shiena is skilled at analysis, as seen when she is able to gather information about Hitsugi and Chitaru by simply watching them during rehearsals for the class play. She is also a skilled hacker as seen in the final episode where she successfully hacks into Myojo Academy's system. When she was younger she got bullied a lot. She had one friend whom she talked to on the phone called Yukarin, but one day she asked Shiena if she wanted revenge on the people who bullied her. Yukarin told Shiena about the group called Collective Dismissal and that they will give her her 'vengeance'. Shiena asks what they wa

characters.name: Hitsugi Kirigaya
characters.description: Kirigaya Hitsugi is a girl who has the body of an elementary school student. She has a bad sense of direction, as demonstrated when she gets lost on her way to Myoujou Academy. Although Hitsugi looks like the horribly unreliable type, she also has her reasons for being in the Black Group. She is also quite attached to Chitaru, as she is a nice and caring person.

characters.name: Chitaru  Namatame
characters.description: Chitaru is a kind and caring girl who really looks out for others, especially those that appear to be heavily dependent (such as Hitsugi and Haru). She states early on that she has no plans to target Haru whatsoever. She appears to be quite attached to Hitsugi, but mainly in a motherly way.

characters.name: Haruki Sagae
characters.description: Tomboyish yet fashionable girl who is always shown eating snacks. Haruki is the typical lazy student who sleeps at class and is always looking for thrills, but is very sensitive about her family, which is full of siblings.

characters.name: Suzu Shutou
characters.description: Suzu is generally calm, affable and knowledgeable in many subjects. ~!She appears to be the same age as her classmates, but in truth she suffers from a disease that stopped her from ageing. Thus, she is actually over one hundred years old. This condition gives her different priorities than most people, as she seems to care more about entertainment than the actual success of her assassination attempt. Long ago, Suzu cared for a very special person. He was one year younger than her and their birthdays were only one day apart. They used to laugh about how people don't stay the same age forever but as he grew older, she stayed the same. This caused him to abandon her, which made her resent her condition.!~

characters.name: Otoya Takechi
characters.description: **Height:** 165cm (5'4") Takechi Otoya is an extremely playful girl with a rather intrusive personality. She likes to tease others, but her actions are seen as borderline bullying. ~!In truth, she is actually a sadistic serial killer. She is quite obsessed with scissors to the point where she carries a whole bag of them around on her waist, which she uses to carry out killings. Otoya kills for a kind of sexual pleasure and targets beautiful women. She also seems to have some knowledge of poisonous flowers and spiders, as she was able to recognize and use the poisonous Gelsemium elegant flowers to incapacitate Haru, and compares her killing style to that of a spider. If she were to be successful in killing Haru, she wanted "serial killer insurance." This was so she could continue her murder spree without any fear of being captured.!~ (Source: Akuma no Riddle Wiki, edited)

title: Kyochuu Rettou Movie
title_en: The Island of Giant Insects Movie
description: After an airplane crash during a school trip, Oribe Mutsumi and her classmates were stranded on a seemingly deserted island. Mutsumi found the other survivors, and used her wilderness knowledge to help them. She expects that they will be rescued in about three days, which doesn't seem so long to endure. However, she didn't account for the fact that the island is populated with gigantic killer insects. Her knowledge of butterflies, wasps, and more may be the only thing that will help any of her classmates survive to be rescued. (Source: MangaHelpers) Note: Announced at the 2019 Crunchyroll Anime Awards.

characters.name: Atsushi Kamijo
characters.description: Hooligan. He tries to dominate the group with violence, but it doesn't go well with the confluence with Amami and repeated attacks of giant insects. Team up with Misuzu and take a brute force to dominate the group.

characters.name: Ayumi Matsuoka
characters.description: A girl student from softball club with a distinctive jersey and hachimaki. She called "Captain" by Amami. She has physical strength, but little weak mental side. Homosexual.

characters.name: Chitose Naruse
characters.description: Amami's best friend and class chairman. An ace who belongs to the brass band and kendo club. She led a survivor group apart from Amami's group.

characters.name: Mami Miura
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student and an Idol.

characters.name: Kazuhiko Kai
characters.description: A male student with naturally curly hair. He familiar with mechanics and perform power restoration in hospital facilities. Good at lock-picking.

characters.name: Mirei Jinno
characters.description: She is good at leading someone around by the nose and has a physical relationship with male teachers and students. She think that only oneself will survive. Joins forces with Atsushi and takes aggressive measures to dominate the group.

characters.name: Mutsumi Oribe
characters.description: The main character of this work. Enrolled in the first class at Hoho Senior High School. Usually a quiet girl, but good at survival . He is also familiar with the ecology of insects, and when he encounters a giant insect, he quickly responds, but he has no resistance to killing insects. Don't let go of a waterproof rucksack called "Sesame husband" Insect knowledge was learned from Inaho, and was rather weak in the past.

characters.name: Inaho Enoki
characters.description: A woman who made Amami interested in insects. She is a Amami's master and familiar with the ecology of insects. She has a unique naming sense and calls Amami "girl".

characters.name: Ai Inou
characters.description: She belongs to the "Wonder Vogel Club" and works with Chitose to make island maps. Uses "boku" as first-person pronoun. Misuzu calls her “Wonder”.

characters.name: Emiko Miyazono
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student.

characters.name: Hiroshi Tsuge
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student.

characters.name: Marika Chuujou
characters.description: A homeroom teacher at Houshou Private High School.

title: Frame Arms Girl
title_original: フレームアームズ・ガール
description: The story begins when Ao opens a package that arrives at her doorstep. Inside the package is Gourai, a Frame Arms Girl: a small robot capable of independent movement. Gourai is a newly-developed prototype: a Frame Arms Girl equipped with an "Artificial Self," an advanced AI that gives her a personality. Ao is the only one that has activated her. Gourai begins to gather both battle data and emotions, starting a day-to-day life with Ao, who knows nothing about Frame Arms Girls. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Gourai
characters.description: Gourai is a test model for Frame Arms Girl that was mistakenly delivered to Ao. When it comes to being a Frame Arms Girl, the system, weapons, and equipment, she is a wealth of knowledge. However, her knowledge is lacking in what human emotions like “happiness” and “sadness” are. (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Ao Gennai
characters.description: Ao is an extremely normal first year student in high school. When Frame Arms Girl Gourai is accidentally delivered to her, she boots it up. As a result, she becomes the only person in the world to have a Gourai model. Ao is completely in the dark when it comes to Frame Arms Girls and plastic models, but she learns that if she battles, she can win prizes. So, she decides to treat it like a part time job and tries out a test battle with Gourai. (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Jinrai
characters.description: A proud F.A. Girl who has a particularly obsession with the Sengoku period and specializes in ninja techniques. She is characterized by her eyepatch and antiquated speech patterns.

characters.name: Baselard
characters.description: Baselard may appear to be an innocent young girl, but actually she is sharp and has bountiful knowledge. Baselard loves things that shine and sparkle, so she unintentionally collects them. She loves to cause problems, so if everyone gets sucked in, she is pleased with herself. (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Stylet
characters.description: Stylet is a tsundere and is very proud. However, when she is with Baselard and Gourai, she plays the straight man. In order to dispel the frustration she feels from losing when she fought Gourai, Stylet lives with Ao in her room. (Source: Honey's Anime)

title: Sengoku Otome: Momoiro Paradox
title_original: 戦国乙女～桃色パラドックス～
description: Hideyoshino is an average girl who always seems to find trouble wherever she goes. One day Hideyoshino visits a local shrine to pray in order to pass her upcoming test. However Hideyoshino sees a blue light coming from inside the Shrine and looks inside to find a mysterious person performing a magic spell. Hideyoshino in a stroke of bad luck trips on a small bell and crashes into the shrine prompting the stranger to catch her. However upon catching Hideyoshino the magic spell spirals out of control and sends Hideyoshino back in time to the Sengoku Era. Hideyoshino then encounters Akechi Mitsuhide and Oda Nobunaga. But unlike what really happened during the era, Hideyoshino realizes that everyone in the world is female. She then decides to help Oda Nobunaga find the Crimson Armor which is said to allow the person wearing the armor to conquer all of Japan.

characters.name: Yoshino Hide
characters.original: 日出 佳乃, 豊臣ヒデヨシノ
characters.description: A ditsy schoolgirl who finds herself transported to an alternate Feudal Japan made up on women. She often brings a lot of modern ethics to this time, including finding uses for her mobile phone despite not being able to get a reception. She is made Oda's retainer after showing skill with a staff. She is nicknamed "Hideyoshi" after Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

characters.name: Nobunaga Oda
characters.description: A feudal lord who desires to gather pieces of a mystical armor to unite the nations. She wields a large sword and appears to be able to control flames.

characters.name: Mitsuhide Akechi
characters.original: 明智ミツヒデ, アケリン
characters.description: Nobunaga Oda's right-hand-man who has loyally served her for many years. She is known as being very intelligent and very good at coming up with plans and tactics. Hideyoshi calls her "Akerin" because she greatly resembles a friend of Hideyoshi's, whom Hideyoshi called "Akerin," from our world. ~!She has romantic feelings for Oda, and often becomes jealous of Oda's friendly, older sister-like relationship with Hideyoshi.!~

characters.name: Masamune Date
characters.description: A mysterious warrior who appears to Hideyoshi and the others several times over the course of the series. She was shown giving Mitsuhide information on the Crimson Armor once. She bears a striking resemblance to Hideyoshi's homeroom teacher, Date-sensei. ~!She is, in fact, Date-sensei. A descendant of the One-Eyed Dragon, Masamune Date, she has taken up the responsibly of avenging her ancestor and returning honor to her family. Her goal was to steal the Crimson Armor, this way, she could use it to unite Japan and bring glory to the Date name. She was visited by a Date clan member from the future, who gave her a device that would allow her to travel to the past. When she used it, instead of ending up in the Sengoku period in Japan, she wound up in a Japan in an alternate universe. It was because of her, attempting to time travel in the local shrine, that Hideyoshi accidentally ended

characters.name: Yoshimoto Imagawa
characters.description: A priestess and sister figure to Ieyasu, who she has lived with and raised for many years. She is not aware of Ieyasu's true nature.

characters.name: Ieyasu Tokugawa
characters.original: 徳川イエヤス, トクニャン
characters.description: A sorceress from the Tokugawa clan, she excels in dark magic. She was raised by Yoshimoto Imagawa and currently lives with her. Hideyoshi calls her "Tokunyan" because she greatly resembles a friend of Hideyoshi's back in our world who was nicknamed such. ~!Despite her cute appearance, she is the main antagonist of the series whose personality is actually quite devious, if not downright evil. Throughout the series, she plots to steal the Crimson Armor and is usually the one behind the several disasters that occur.!~

characters.name: Shingen Takeda
characters.description: Kenshin's rival, but best friend at the same time, even though she won't admit it. She rules a clan of warriors by the sea, directly next-door to Kenshin. The two are always butting heads over everything and are constantly fighting. Oda sets out to battle her for a piece of the Crimson Armor, which was handed down to her by her ancestors.

characters.name: Kenshin Uesugi
characters.description: Shingen's rival, but best friend at the same time, even though she won't admit it. She rules a clan of warriors by the sea, directly next-door to Shingen. Oda sets out to battle her for a piece of the Crimson Armor, which was handed down to her by her ancestors.

characters.name: Hattori Hanzo
characters.description: Hattori is a ninja working under Ieyasu Tokugawa. She is first seen in Season 1, Episode 7. ~! In episode 7, Hattori attempts to ruin Hideyoshi's play as ordered by Ieyasu by secretly changing out Nobunaga's script. However, after thinking that it wasn't enough, she then decides to act on her own accord and set the curtain on fire. Unfortunately, the curtain catches on fire quicker than expected and begins to burn down the entire stage. For ruining the whole thing, Hattori is promptly punished by Iyeasu. !~ Source: the official site (http://sengokuotome.com/character/index.html)

characters.name: Shiro
characters.description: A male dog which wears a feudal helmet and has the ability to talk, though he only talks around Hideyoshi. He is knowledgable about the world and time, and the fact Hideyoshi is not from it.

title: Dounika Naru Hibi
description: A forbidden crush. An ex’s wedding. Burgeoning feelings for a childhood friend. Happy-Go-Lucky Days tells three universally frank stories about the young people of Japan on the bittersweet journey of adolescence. (Source: HIDIVE) The movie was streamed in advance on Chicago Asian Pop Up Cinema from September 15-19, 2020. Official theater release in Japan began on October 23, 2020.

title: Master Piece THE ANIMATION
title_original: Master Piece マスターピース THE ANIMATION
description: When Yuuji's parents passed away, he was adopted by the Tsubakihara family. That's how his life with a widow and her two twin daughters under the same roof began...

characters.name: Mira Tsubakihara
characters.description: Widow and mother to twin daughters. Her hobby these days is seducing her son-in-law. A MILF weak to kisses.

characters.name: Nina Tsubakihara
characters.description: The younger of the twins, she is chairman of a committee. She is very established, but is slow when it comes to romance. She is actually a scaredy-cat and likes cute things.

characters.name: Yuna Tsubakihara
characters.description: The elder of the twins. Her following at school is so large that she has a fanclub, but is a bit shy.

title: Vampire Miyu (TV)
description: Evil Shinma (shape-shifting monsters and vampires) roam the Earth on a mission to unleash their darkness upon the Human race. Miyu Royal Princess from the dark is the Chosen One—the one being who must banish the Evil Shinma from the Earth. She has the power to offer Humans the gift of eternal happiness, yet is herself, trapped between two worlds; destined for perpetual solitude and internal conflict. Miyu's only companion is Larva, once an evil Shimna; now her devoted guardian. Together they share a dark journey through the weakness of the human heart and the tragic loss of innocence. Cut off from humanity by the knowledge of what she is, Miyu lives an endless quest as both the hunter and the hunted, on the edge of darkness. (Source: AniDB)

characters.name: Miyu Yamano
characters.description: A girl who appears to be 13 or 14 years old but in fact is much older, being a vampire. Even though she is a vampire, Miyu isn't harmed by sunlight, holy water or crucifixes, and her reflection can be seen. Though she does need to drink blood to survive, she chooses her 'victims' carefully. She chooses people who have suffered a tragic loss, and offers them their greatest wish – to be with their lost loved ones, at least in their dreams – in exchange for their blood. These people live an endless dream state forever.

characters.name: Larva
characters.description: Shinma from the western world. Larva faced Miyu after she had become the Guardian. After he had struck her down, she drank his blood. He pledged to be by Miyu's side. Larva can use his nails to slash things and he can also wield a scythe. Larva chooses to stay with Miyu because of her sorrow, something he was able to glimpse at during both blood-bond scenes.

characters.name: Shiina
characters.description: A Shinma who looks like a cute pink bunny. However, her right ear covers a bulging, bloodshot yellow eye which enables her to see great distances and dispel illusions

characters.name: Reiha
characters.description: A child-like snow demon, she is Miyu's rival who seeks to destroy shinma, believing Miyu is not fit to do the job. She is less sympathetic than Miyu, and is known to kill innocents who get in her way of destroying shinma. Reiha's father was the head of a group of shinma protectors whose task was to ensure that a guardian (in this case, Miyu) would emerge. When Reiha's father was struck down by the Bird Shinma, Black Kite, he called out Miyu's name instead of Reiha's before he died. Reiha has never forgiven Miyu for this.

characters.name: Chisato Inoue
characters.description: Chisato Inoue is Miyu's best friend at her school who befriends her early on in the show. She is left unaware of her best friend's vampire activities that are a part of her double life.

characters.name: Yukari Kashima
characters.description: Miyu and Chisato's classmate. Yukari is slightly tomboyish.

characters.name: Hisae Aoki
characters.description: Miyu and Chisato's classmate. Hisae is a bookworm.

characters.name: Moru
characters.description: A shinma who lives in the cracks of the human mind.

characters.name: Ruri Sone
characters.description: She is a young girl who attends Miyu's school. Miyu befriends the girl and learns some disturbing details about her. ~! The most disturbing being that Ruri, when she was five, was responsible for her mother's death. However, it turns out that she was being manipulated by the Shinma, Moru.!~

title: Hina Logi: from Luck & Logic
description: On a spring day when the cherry blossoms have started to fall, the naïve princess of a small country, Lion begins her days at a school in Hokkaido. The school houses a special facility run by ALCA that trains Logicalists who protect the peace of the world. Lion has a lot of unique classmates in Class 1-S, including Nina, a Logicalist. This is the story of the energetic and adorable days the Logicalists-in-training spend together. It’s time to Trance! (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Liones Yelistratova
characters.original: リオネス・エリストラートヴァ
characters.description: __Height:__ 150cm She is a peppy and excitable princess from a small country that came to study at a school in Hokkaido that train logicalists to protect the peace of the world

characters.name: Nina Alexandrovna
characters.original: ニーナ・アレクサンドロヴナ
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm She is a strong and experienced Logicalist that was sent to school to work on teamwork and socializing. She likes fluffy things.

characters.name: Mahiro Kyobashi
characters.description: A girl who loves tinkering with machines.

characters.name: Yayoi Tachibana
characters.description: __Height:__ 153cm A serious and caring class representative. She stems from a rich family.

characters.name: Strafansky Yelistratova
characters.description: Liones' father.

title: Ichijouma Mankitsu-gurashi!
title_original: 一畳間まんきつ暮らし！
description: High school girl in the manga cafe! Meiko is a countryside girl who enters a rich girls' school. All expenses will be paid if she participates in activities... But who knew it would mean live-in work in a manga cafe?! Living in a small manga cafe booth turns out not to be so bad! Would you like to have your fill of the manga cafe staffed by cute high school girls? (Source: Bookwalker, translated)

characters.name: Meiko Morita
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm A first-year high school student from Akita. In order to send money home to her parents, she transfers to Amamiya Girls' Academy in Tokyo and begins working and living at Hedgehog, a manga cafe and student dormitory. The eldest of five siblings, she has a serious, caring, big sister-like personality. Perhaps because of this, she tends to get pushed around by those around her. She excels at cooking but struggles with machines, and her dialect occasionally slips out. She also has a vivid imagination.

characters.name: Rie Amamiya
characters.description: A first-year high school student who lives and works at Hedgehog. She is the only daughter of the chairman of Amamiya Girls' Academy and serves as both the manager and dorm supervisor of Hedgehog. She is extremely wealthy, easygoing, and has a strange sense of money. She loves manga and has a massive collection, particularly enjoying yuri manga. She mistakes [Meiko](https://anilist.co/character/369052/Meiko-Morita) for a new manga artist named Mori Meiko.

characters.name: Marika Suzuki
characters.description: A high school freshman living and working at Hedgehog. Lazy and slovenly. Prone to both cold and heat, she wears thick clothes year-round and loves her kotatsu, though she often wears only underwear underneath. She is currently active as a popular video streamer under the name Marika Belltree. Her family is the head of a flower arrangement school, and they are apparently very strict.

characters.name: Neo Nakano
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm A high school freshman who lives and works at Hedgehog. Usually innocent, but when she gets fired up, dark words and actions peek through. She aims to be a pro gamer and dedicates herself to gaming day and night. Good at IT and is in charge of the computers at the store. She resents being treated like a child because of her small stature. In fact, she is quite strong.

characters.name: Michika Narumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 150cm A first-year high school student from another school who works at the cat cafe in the same building as Hedgehog. She loves cats and has a tsundere personality like one. She initially viewed Hedgehog as a rival, but eventually started frequenting Hedgehog in search of cat manga.

characters.name: Miori Morita
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm [Meiko's](https://anilist.co/character/369052/Meiko-Morita) younger sister. She is the second daughter and a junior high school student. Although she is a reliable person, she worries about her innocent and easygoing older sister moving to Tokyo. She is a big fan of female professional wrestler Tank Kashiwagi, and is crazy about watching professional wrestling.

characters.name: Gao
characters.description: __Height:__ 148cm She is a hugely popular video streamer who runs the "GaoTube" channel. She gained popularity for her cuteness and quickly became a famous μTuber. Apparently, she started streaming videos because she admired a certain streamer in the past, but...

characters.name: Majikarumomorin Gouda
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm A wandering 18-year-old. She drifted to Hedgehog, liked it so much that she decided to live there. Loves history and admires samurai so much that she often speaks in a samurai-like tone. She can see the aura that emanates from objects such as antiques. And she is concerned about her flashy name.

characters.name: Berna
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm An unknown spy and maid who serves [Gao](https://anilist.co/character/393215/Gao). She is a huge fan of Gao and would do anything for her. For some reason, she seems to dislike [Marika](https://anilist.co/character/393175/Marika-Suzuki)...

title: Hidamari Sketch × ☆☆☆
description: Some say that life is like an unfolding tapestry, but living at the Hidamari Apartments is more like being part of a patchwork quilt, one that constantly changes as bits and pieces of the lives and dreams of the young artists who make this extraordinary residence their home are added to the ever-expanding pattern. When we first met Yuno, she'd just been accepted to the prestigious Yamabuki Art School and it was up to her new neighbors at Hidamari to help her find her way in the big scary world. Now a seasoned vet of the Hidamari Apartments herself, Yuno's newest challenge is to help the latest arrivals, Nazuna and Nori, acclimate to life on their own. Of course, since it IS Hidamari, there are still lots of trials and tribulations ahead, and nothing will ever go quite as expected. But with friends like Miyako, Hiro and Sae ready to lend a hand, there will always be a ray of sunshine at the end of every storm. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Nazuna
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm She lives in room 203. She has sandy blonde hair, braids, and large side bangs. She used to live in the neighborhood, but after entering Yamabuki Art High School her father was transferred somewhere for work and her mother followed with him. She appears very quiet and reserved, but has an inferiority complex. She is not in the art department.

characters.name: Nori
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Nori lives in room 103 and is in the art department and likes to play with computers. She is honest and straightforward, and seems to be the most level-headed and normal out of everyone and is usually the one to point out the others' weird ways.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chika
characters.description: Chika is Sae's thirteen-year-old sister. She is more spontaneous and energetic than her older sister. She enjoys cooking and has an infatuation with a Kabuki actor. She has no artistic talent and prefers music and home economics to art. Initially only appearing in the anime adaptation, she made her first appearance in the manga in the June 2012 issue of Manga Time Kirara Carat.

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: Ume is a Metapod that lives on the roof of the Hidamari Apartments and represents the manga's author, Ume Aoki. The character does not actually play any significant role in the story. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Kanamemo
description: Nakamachi Kana is a junior high school girl. Her grandmother passed away and she was left all alone. She finds a newspaper carrier station and starts working as a live-in carrier. Her room has a hole on the wall. Other female workers living next door comes in through the hole and start a wild merrymaking.

characters.name: Kana Nakamachi
characters.description: Kana is forced to leave the house when her grandma dies. (Her parents passed away a long time ago.) While looking for a place to stay, she ends up at an newspaper carrier office. Hesistant and overwhelmed at first, she decides to stay and starts working as a newspaper carrier since it seems like it's the only place that's willing to take her in. Kana likes to cook and enjoys watching sumo-wrestling and drama shows and is scared easily.

characters.name: Saki Amano
characters.description: Saki is the assistant chief at the newspaper carrier office, but everyone calls her 'Chief'. Even though she is only in grade school, she seems to be the most serious one of the bunch. She is also in charge of the office's administrative work.

characters.name: Yume Kitaoka
characters.description: Yume is the mood maker of the group. Always bright and lively, but sometimes clumsy, she is definitely a free spirit and one of the warmer and friendly persons Kana meets. She is a bit immature and ignorant but has a very innocent heart. For example, she earnestly thinks that the "teru teru bozu" monk does in fact exist (this is the equivalent to someone thinking that Santa Claus is real). She is an apprentice at a local patisserie, hence her fondness of everything sweet. She tends to sweeten every meal she cooks with heaps of sugar or chocolate, much to the disgust of everyone (however, only Yuuki willingly eats her food). Her love for sweets even extends to her wanting to be a pâtissier as a full time job. She seems to be dating Yuuki who she happily and openly loves. Yume is not afraid to express open affection for Yuuki, kissing her goodbye in public and hugging her w

characters.name: Yuuki Minami
characters.description: Yuuki is a cool, calm and collected beauty. While being serious at most times, she has her despairing moments, most of which happen when she thinks Yume is going to leave her or when she thinks Yume is ignoring her. She is very, very deeply in love with Yume and seems to be a bit insecure about Yume's feelings for her. Despite Hinata's warnings that coddling Yume is a bad thing, Yuuki explains (with a rather sly and sinister expression) that as long as Yume is dependent on her in some way, she will be fine. Unlike the rest of the workers, she does not have a hard time dealing with the pushy customers, an attribute which Yume seems to find attractive.

characters.name: Hinata Azuma
characters.description: Hinata is a bit of a selfish person and tends to be stingy. She is addicted to everything that involves money, and spends a lot of her money on horse gambling tickets, stocks and the sorts. She wishes to go to college, but so far has managed to fail the entrance exam three times. Hinata is also very cheap. She will try to find any way to cut corners and save money, such as going so far as to bring her laundry to a bathhouse to both bath herself and wash her clothes, thus saving money from going to a laundromat. However, the only times she seems to splurge is when it comes to her family. She has a lot of siblings and buys things for them without even thinking twice about the cost.

characters.name: Haruka Nishida
characters.description: While Haruka is the oldest one in the bunch, it doesn't mean she's the most mature one. She often acts like a drama queen and when she's intoxicated, she gets very rowdy and lecherous. She's currently studying bio-chemistry in college. Despite being wasted most of the time, it seems she puts at least some effort into her work and into her studies. She often likes to ferment alcohol in school, trying new techniques. Sometimes she brings home her projects for the older girls to try out. She likes to harass Saki and Kana, especially when she had a drink or two too much. (She's always in for a drink, and has a preference for sake.) Haruka has a gigantic fetish for anything cute. She often gets very excited when it comes to thinking of girls having a clichéd moe appeal to them (such as seeing Kana in a school swim suit and calling Mika a "loli" becaus

characters.name: Mika Kujiin
characters.description: Mika is a newspaper deliverer at another center, although she won't admit it unless directly confronted. She is quick to blame others, and frequently turns her mistakes into inconveniences. When she becomes lost during a route, she literally runs into Kana, then forgives her by "allowing" her to escort her to her next stop. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nao-chan
characters.description: Kana and Mika's classmate. Wears glasses.

characters.name: Marimo
characters.description: Marimo is a minor character who appears in the eighth and twelfth episodes. She is a former Fuhshin Gazette employee before she graduated from college, and has a reputation as the worst employee the newspaper company ever had. Nevertheless, she was well liked by everyone. She and Saki shared a special friendship; they were so close that Saki started calling her nee-san (big sister), which the rest of the Fuhshin staff picked up, as well. Marimo was the first person with whom Saki had truly opened up and revealed her true feelings (and as far as the series has shown, the only person). She is also the only staff member, overall, to call Saki by her name, instead of addressing her as chief. Before the events of the anime (roughly the most recent spring season), the day before Marimo's graduation, there was a snow storm with record low temperatures, and on that day Marimo was late returning

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The MOVIE 1st
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのは The MOVIE 1st
title_en: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 1st
description: The movie is based on the first season's story but features new battle animations and a new transformation sequence.

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

characters.name: Lindy Harlaown
characters.original: リンディ・ハラオウン
characters.description: Lindy, the kind-spirited captain of the spaceship Asura, works for the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She enjoys drinking green tea with sugar (and sometimes cream) added, which is ironic given her appreciation of Japanese culture. She is Chrono's mother.

characters.name: Chrono Harlaown
characters.description: Chrono is a young officer of the Time-Space Administration Bureau and wields the S2U,a storage device in the first season and an ice-type Intelligent Device named Durandal in A's. His personality is usually one who looks at things from a logical approach, but he has made jokes on occasion. His mother Lindy is his commanding officer and the Admiral of the Asura, while his father isn't mentioned (revealed in A's to be deceased.) Together they used thier influence within the TSAB to aid in Fate's trial,afterwhich he trained Fate in combat before her return in A's where she became his adopted sister. In the first season Chrono displays his control over shooting-type spells when he aids Nanoha during the attack on the Garden of Time,so much so that Nanoha is speechless at his skill. As of StrikerS he has become the Admiral of his own ship,the Claudia while his mother lives on Earth next to Na

characters.name: Suzuka Tsukimura
characters.description: Suzuka Tsukimura is a minor character of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series. The younger sister of Shinobu Tsukimura, Suzuka is a civilian and best friends with Nanoha Takamachi and Alisa Bannings. In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's, she befriends Hayate Yagami, not knowing of the war between Hayate's protectors the Wolkenritter and the Time-Space Administration Bureau, for which Nanoha works. Suzuka does not exist in Triangle Heart. Suzuka is a grade three student in the same class as Nanoha and Alisa, and already sure what she wants to do with her life: continue on her family tradition of rich, successful engineers. She lives in a huge mansion with her maids Noel and Farin K. Ehrlichkeit, sister Shinobu and many cats, one of which is affected by a Jewel Seed. As a small child, she was bullied by the more aggressive Alisa, but Nanoha stood up to Alisa and the trio became friends. Wh

characters.name: Alisa Bannings
characters.description: Alisa Bannings is a minor character of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series. Best friends with Nanoha Takamachi and Suzuka Tsukimura, Alisa is the daughter of two successful company owners and has plans of succeeding them. Alisa was adapted from the character of Alisa Lowell in Triangle Heart, but besides being a living being, is much friendlier and holds no such grudge against the world. Alisa is an outspoken, dog-loving Anglophone and multimillionaire heiress. She gets angry at Nanoha halfway through the series for keeping secrets from her friends. Despite this, she cares deeply for her friend. She is a strong-willed person the apparent leader in her small circle of friends. When she has bursts of rage at not fully understanding what's going on, Suzuka is usually there to calm her down. Alisa is proficient with English and loves dogs, owning about ten at her large mansion. Similarly

characters.name: Amy Limietta
characters.original: エイミィ・リミエッタ
characters.description: In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, Amy works on the Arthra as the Chief of Operations, and is a good friend to Chrono and Lindy. She is an officer cadet, often tasked with research and intelligence gathering, which are her specialties. In StrikerS: ~! she and [Chrono](https://anilist.co/character/4179/Chrono-Harlaown) are married with twins, a boy and a girl.!~

characters.name: Precia Testarossa
characters.original: プレシア・テスタロッサ
characters.description: Precia Testarossa, also transliterated as Presia, is the first main villain of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series; however, she does not appear in Triangle Heart. A mage and the main resident of the Garden of Time, Precia sends her daughter Fate Testarossa out to Earth to collect a set of Lost Logia (ancient and powerful magical artifacts) known as the Jewel Seeds, while evading the Time-Space Administration Bureau. While a researcher of familiars, she does not have one of her own during Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, and her weapon is unnamed. Precia first appears in episode 7, having previously been mentioned as the reason that Fate is gathering Jewel Seeds. She is abusive and cruel, torturing Fate simply for not getting enough Jewel Seeds and not disposing of potential hindrance Nanoha. Though Arf hates Precia and tells Fate that she is not worth it, Fate asserts that she remembers

characters.name: Alicia Testarossa
characters.original: アリシア・テスタロッサ
characters.description: Alicia is Precia's biological daughter. They lived a happy life until Alicia died at the age of eight, driving her mother insane. ~!Precia preserved Alicia's body in a glass tank and dedicated her life to obtaining the Jewel Seeds, which could lead her to Al Hazard, the legendary place that could restore her daughter. Using Alicia's DNA, Precia created a clone called Fate to gather the jewels for her. Fate, implanted with Alicia's memories, was abused to no end by her "mother," but remained painfully loyal until the truth was discovered. In the end, Alicia's body fell into the void with Precia. In the second season, the Book of Darkness draws Fate into a dream of what she has always wanted: a happy family life. Precia is sane, Alicia is Fate's older sister, and everything appears good. Alicia wishes that Fate could stay in the dream with her forever, but Fate sadly refuses, saying that h

characters.name: Linith
characters.description: Linith is Precia's familiar and maid of the Testarossa household. She trained Fate in magic and took care of her as she was growing up. She had no memories of her life before she became a familiar. She cared more for Fate like she was her own daughter. ~!It was revealed in the movie that she found out that Fate was not Precia's real daughter.!~

title: Baku Ane: Otouto Shibocchau zo! THE ANIMATION
title_original: ばくあね 弟しぼっちゃうぞ! THE ANIMATION
description: Based on the erotic game by Atelier Kaguya Bare & Bunny. The protagonist is a famous soccer player, but due to a leg injury from a game, he must now rest until it heals. When he returns home, he is warmly greeted by his 4 older sisters whom he hasn't seen for a long time. However, because his clubmates have play a prank on him and fill his bag with ero manga, their relationships immediately plummet after they find out about it. While trying to explain the situation to no avail, one of them suggests that they themselves should help him escape the 2D world and be interested in healthy adult women. Little does he know, all of his sisters love him more than a brother. And so, this is the beginning of a ridiculous erotic life between our protagonist and his 4 tempting older sisters. (Source: Official Site) Note: A director's cut edition was released 2017/09/29 with additional scenes added.

title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon SuperS: Sailor 9 Senshi Shuuketsu! Black Dream Hole no Kiseki
title_original: 美少女戦士 セーラームーン SuperS セーラー9戦士集結! ブラック・ドリーム・ホールの奇跡
title_en: Sailor Moon SuperS the Movie: Black Dream Hole
description: Everywhere around the world, the children sleep. Unaware of danger lurking in the shadows. But tonight, a strange darkness floats in the wind. And the children, one by one, begin to disappear. It seems to be a supernatural force that feeds on their dreams. The evil queen, Badiyanu, and her loyal fairies assist in using the "Black Dream Hole" to swallow the earth. It is up to Sailor Moon and the Sailor Soldiers to prevent the approaching Darkness. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Usagi Tsukino
characters.description: __Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to know her sweet and selfless side. Usagi is a bit selfish and very much a crybaby, lazy, clumsy, and also an academic underachiever. She's also not very good at cooking. However, she cares deeply about her friends and family. Usagi is very trusting, and believes that everyone has a better nature. She doe

characters.name: Ami Mizuno
characters.description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

characters.name: Rei Hino
characters.description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate from the other girls.

characters.name: Makoto Kino
characters.description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

characters.name: Minako Aino
characters.description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her to her life as a Senshi. He lives in her home (as [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) lives in Usagi's) and is one of her closest friends.

characters.name: Chibiusa
characters.description: Chibiusa's real name is actually Usagi, but she is nicknamed Chibiusa to distinguish her from [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). She is usually very upbeat, extroverted and outgoing. Though she started out socially awkward, she quickly became popular with her classmates in the 20th-century. Chibiusa's dream is to one day become a real lady, to have her own prince, and to be friends with everyone she knows. Meanwhile, she is a fairly ordinary little girl; she likes pink and red, pudding, pancakes, and rabbits. Her favorite school subject is drawing, while her least favorites are language classes. ~!Chibiusa is actually the future daughter of Usagi Tsukino and [Mamoru Chiba](https://anilist.co/character/4013/Chiba-Mamoru), and was sent back in time to the "present" to stay with them before she was born.!~

characters.name: Mamoru Chiba
characters.description: Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of [Usagi Tsukino](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted. ~!This may be because when he was young his parents died in a car crash. This blocked his childhood memories of his current lifetime and opened up the memories of his previous life as Prince Endymion. Tuxedo Mask is a disguise Mamoru created for himself in order to hunt for the Silver Crystal incognito and, later, assist the Sailor Senshi in battle. He is always addressed as Mamo-chan by Usagi throughout the series (Chibiusa also addresses him with this nickname later on). After dating for two years, Mamoru gives Usagi an engagement ring at an airport. The couple eventually gets married. In the future, they become king and queen of Earth and Crystal Tokyo and have a child together whom they name, Small Lady, but is in the

characters.name: Peruru
characters.description: Perle is a fairy who appears only in the Sailor Moon SuperS movie who protects the Sugar Energy of children. His older brother, Poupelin, as well as two other fairies, Banane and Orangeat, work for Queen Badiane.

characters.name: Joou Badiane
characters.description: Queen Badiane is the villain of the Sailor Moon SuperS movie. She is a witch from another world who planned to kidnap children and bring them to Marzipannu Castle, where she would seal them in Dream Coffins and use the energy generated by their dreams to power her Black Dream Hole.

characters.name: Setsuna Meiou
characters.description: Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics. Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates, she becomes more friendly, but is still not very emotional, although there are moments in the manga where she expresses much more emotion than the anime. Sailor Pluto is much darker in her initial form in the manga, identified as the "Guardian of the Underworld" with very dark skin and a black sailo

characters.name: Michiru Kaiou
