description: Based on the erotic game by Blue Gale. Continuing after the events of Oni Chichi: Re-birth... Airi, Marina, and their step father, Takami, leave for a trip to a hot springs resort. But Marina makes last minute plans and just the two of them go. Takami still constantly tries to drug Airi.

characters.name: Airi Akizuki
characters.description: The younger daughter. The main focus of episode 1 is on her.

characters.name: Marina Akizuki
characters.description: The elder step daughter.

characters.name: Kouzou Akizuki
characters.description: The male protagonist of the anime, who lust for his step daughters & best friends.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai: NEXT SKY
title_original: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会 NEXT SKY
title_en: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club: NEXT SKY
description: A new Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai original video animation released in Summer 2023.

characters.name: Ayumu Uehara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayumu Uehara is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of A・ZU・NA, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is light pink. She is hard working and believes that trying your best is the only thing to do. She is kind, sociable and wants everyone to succeed. Ayumu can also be rather clumsy at times.

characters.name: Yuu Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Yuu Takasaki is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club and one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is the manager, songwriter, and founder of Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is black. Yuu is the budding school idol enthusiast of Nijigasaki High School, and is often seen with her characteristic thigh-high socks and twin-tails tips dyed green. She is Ayumu Uehara's inseparable childhood friend, having grown up as neighbors in the same apartment building near Odaiba.

characters.name: Shioriko Mifune
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Shioriko Mifune is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is jade. Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. Although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko often yearns to connect with others, deep down.

characters.name: Mia Taylor
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Mia Taylor is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is third year student and her image color is platinum silver. She recently transferred from New York and is fluent in both English and Japanese. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old.

characters.name: Lanzhu Zhong
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Lanzhu Zhong is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is rose gold. She recently transferred from Hong Kong and is fluent in both Mandarin and Cantonese. Despite showing herself as a charismatic girl, her unique personality tends to catch others off guard by how demanding she can be with them so that they achieve excellent results like her, which leads her to make questionable decisions and to treat people in a way that usually makes them feel insulted. Even so, she doesn't hesitate to seek every possible way to befriend others.

characters.name: Setsuna Yuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") Setsuna Yuki is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was the leader and founder of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her color is scarlet red. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that she read. Setsuna is passionate and headstrong, but kind and mature. She has a habit of taking on too much work and not wanting to burden friends with her problems. Setsuna has an unwavering passion for school idols and her raw emotion combined with a powerful voice is her charm point. She is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School.

characters.name: Kasumi Nakasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kasumi Nakasu is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is pastel yellow. As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. You'll often find her scheming or thinking up new ways to ensure her own victory; however, these plans often fail or aren't as devious as she thinks.

characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.name: Shizuku Ousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") Shizuku Osaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a first year and her image color is light blue. Shizuku is a polite, level-headed and diligent First Year student at Nijigasaki High with a passion for theatre and stage acting. She is a prolific member of the school's theatre club and it often shows in conversations where her enthusiasm for the subject surfaces.

characters.name: Ai Miyashita
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Favorite food:__ Nukazuke Ai Miyashita is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.name: Rina Tennouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Kanata Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Kanata Konoe is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is violet. Kanata is always giving everything her all... even if it doesn't seem that way when she dozes off in the middle of conversations. She cares deeply for her little sister Haruka and will find a bottomless well of energy in matters relating to her. An ideal performance, for Kanata, is a stage in which she sleeps and her fans watch. She also has an aptitude for cooking and home economics. While she loves to be doted on and spoiled, she also looks after everyone in the club as a big sister figure.

title: Queen's Blade: Utsukushiki Toushi-tachi
title_original: クイーンズブレイド 美しき闘士たち
description: Queen's Blade OVA. Contains short stories from the lives of the warriors after the Queen's Blade competition.

characters.name: Nanael
characters.description: An angel who descended to Earth with duty of "broadcasting" Queen's Blade fights. Because of her goofy actions, Head Angel put her on probation and exiled to the mortal world. She was given a vial of 'holy milk' twice by the Head Angel, which she must not allow even one drop to be spilled. First time served a test which, in which she spilled of it and tried to fool Head Angel by filling the vial with Earthly milk. Second vial was given to her when she was ordered to enter Queen's Blade tournament, but this time, the more she spills, the weaker she becomes. Since she completely failed to keep the milk safe last time, Head Angel is confident that this will serve as a handicap! Unwilling to treat dwellers of the "lower world" as equals, her combat technique involves the telekinetic manipulation of her celestial saber to keep opponents at bay. She is i

characters.name: Tomoe
characters.description: A Shinto priestess from the island of Hinomoto (an alternate reading of the kanji for Japan), she is a member of the elite society of priestesses that protect their homeland. She was designed and illustrated by the artist Eiwa.

characters.name: Elina Vance
characters.description: The daughter of Count Vance, and younger sister of Reina, a prominent Queen's Blade competitor. She was trained from a young age in all manner of martial arts, from stealth to strict military discipline, and acts as both bodyguard, spy, and assassin for her father. Unlike Reina Erina's personality is vicious. She was created by Hisayuki Hirokazu.

characters.name: Melona
characters.description: Melona is one of the four servants of The Swamp Witch and her strongest minion. Nicknamed "The Protean Assassin" due to her nearly unlimited ability to change form at will, she is skilled in obtaining information and assassination. It is assumed that she was ordered to bring about chaos to the Queen's Blade tournament. Seductive and alluring, she revels in humiliating her opponents and will not hesitate to kill them if given the opportunity. Despite her malevolent nature she hates being called a monster and becomes very upset, to the point of strangling someone to death for instance. Despite this, she can be reasoned with and is willing to work with her enemies as long as it benefits her and furthers her own goals. She is a shapeshifter not limited by shape or texture who can change the shape of her body freely and instantly. Her mimicry is so proficient that she can even imitate the tec

characters.name: Alleyne
characters.description: One of the oldest and most seasoned veteran warriors of a tribe of forest elves, Alleyne is taciturn and blunt in her dealings with others. She's had a long relationship with Echidna, who she often chastises for her loose ways but is mocked in return for her inexperience with men. The appearance of the half-elf Nowa in the forest elf community marked a turning point for Alleyne, who appointed her "guardian of the forest". The elf village elders did not approve however, and drove her from the village with the excuse that she must join the Queen's Blade tournament. Distraught, Alleyne secretly set out for the tournament as well, to protect the girl whose sudden appearance had awoken feelings long dormant in the veteran elven warrior. She is illustrated by Matsuryuu. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nowa
characters.description: Described as the 'Guardian of the Forest', the half elf Nowa and her monkey companion protect the creatures who live there. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Airi
characters.description: A scythe-wielding ghost girl in a maid costume, Airi was given human form by the evil Swamp Witch in her quest for domination. Airi serves every whim of her mistress quite willingly. Used primarily for assassinations, she can literally suck the vitality of her enemies simply by touching them.

characters.name: Melpha
characters.description: A high-ranked priestess in a fundamentalist sect, Melpha is widely respected by her followers as a holy woman. Compared to the other competitors her fighting ability is minimal, but she possesses the ability to heal her own wounds and inflict divine punishment on her opponents through the use of provocative "holy poses". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Aldra
characters.description: Aldra is the victor of the past two Queen's Blade tournaments and reigning queen. As the child of a priestess and the lord of the underworld, she is a cursed half-demon. She has the powers of "petrifying gaze" and "flesh-rending secret cleaver". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Reina Vance
characters.description: The nomad warrior Reina is the direct heir to the house of Vance and Claudette's and Elina's sister. But, instead of accepting her father's heritage, she escapes and enters the Queen's Blade tournament. Her partially naive character and strong sense of justice gets her into trouble pretty often.

characters.name: Shizuka
characters.description: A kunoichi from Hinomoto, Shizuka is a money grubbing assassin. She couldn't care less about the affairs of the battle as long she gets paid; she just hates working hard in general and instead have a personal group of ninjas to aid her. Shizuka does not have a game book of her own, yet has been featured in the anime, voiced by Hitomi Nabatame, manga, collectible cards ver2.0, and even had a PVC figurine released. She was created by Eiwa - By Wesker_CDA

characters.name: Menace
characters.description: Thousands of years ago, in the ancient Amara, a princess was dethroned out of her kingdom. She would have been the next queen, but was betrayed by the high statesmen at the same time Amara fell into ruin after being invaded by an enemy kingdom. History tells that princess Menace's fate was the same as her collapsing kingdom. In the present the "Marshland Witch" managed to resurrect Menace with a powerful magic in her plan to conquer the continent. Despite that, Menace pridefully refused to serve anyone and fled. During her escape, she met a merchant who recommended participating in the Queen's Blade. Menace decided to enter the tournament with the goal of reviving the kingdom of Amara. Despite her gentle nature, Menace is a master of martial arts passed down by the royal family. Her punch emits a cursed aura that can drain her opponent's life with a simple touch. She also carries a myste

title: BIKINI WARRIORS OVA
title_original: ビキニ・ウォリアーズ
description: The first episode will focus on Hunter and Valkyrie, who were guest characters in the television anime, as well as two new characters: Cleric and Kunoichi. Hunter and Valkyrie meet Cleric and think she will join them as their healer, but something is strange about her. Then they are attacked by Kunoichi, who seeks legendary bikini armor. The second episode will focus on Fighter's party after they have overcome hardships, spoken with god, and earned the legendary bikini armor. However, the armor is invisible to idiots. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Hunter
characters.description: A survivalist with horrible cooking skills who becomes a very close partner of Valkyrie.

characters.name: Valkyrie
characters.description: A lady of noble birth who has decided to dedicate her life to fighting evil. Valkyrie is very arrogant and tsundere in nature.

characters.name: Cleric
characters.description: A petite-looking priestess of a war deity, whose specialty lies in combat-related magic at the expense of her clerical healing capacities.

characters.name: Kunoichi
characters.description: A young female ninja who intends to steal all the bikini armor she can find in order to eventually get her hands on the most legendary bikini armor.

characters.name: Mage
characters.description: The youngest and most timid member of the adventure party, the Mage is a petite purple-haired girl skilled in the art of sorcery.

characters.name: Paladin
characters.description: A beautiful blonde woman who (most unbecoming to her vocation) harbors closeted sexual desires.

characters.name: Dark Elf
characters.description: A member of the Dark Elf race who assists the party with a versatile combination of combat and magic-using skills. Initially quite haughty when she first joined, she has shed much of her attitude as the four of them have kept adventuring together.

characters.name: Fighter
characters.description: A redhaired, somewhat impulsive and stubborn woman, and the party's leader. She is also the daughter of a legendary warrior who saved the country in the past.

characters.name: Black Knight
characters.description: A very determined and strong fightress who likes to express herself with otherworldly (i.e., computer game-related) terms. However, despite her grimness, she is deadly afraid of the undead.

characters.name: Necromancer
characters.description: A demon-like, childish girl who can awake and control the dead with her magic, and even transform the living coming into contact with her into undead. A necro-fetishist, she wishes to attach herself to another girl, preferrably Black Knight, and make them her zombie companion.

title: Resort BOIN
description: Based on the game by Crossnet-Pie. On spring break, Daisuke is excited for his vacation on a tropical island for some well deserved relaxation and girl watching. He finds himself quite inexplicably popular with the ladies as well. Nao and Mitsugu follow him there as well competing, as usual, for his attentions. Meanwhile he meets his cousin Maya again after a long time as well as the wild Kanae and her friend Mika. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nao Iihara
characters.description: She has strong feelings for Daisuke and seems to have no problem sharing him with others girls as long as he makes love with her equally as much.

characters.name: Maya Koromogae
characters.description: Cousin of Daisuke.

characters.name: Daisuke Ichijyo
characters.description: The male protagonist of the anime and visual novel.

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm She tends to look down on people with courage, but she's sweet to obedient people. She answers various requests by saying "That's cute!".

characters.name: Mitsugu Tsukushino
characters.description: A rich girl who is very loyal to Daisuke, but seems to have no problem sharing him with other girls. She is rivals with Nao.

characters.name: Momona Amamiya
characters.description: Momona is a shy and clumsy girl who has strong feelings for Daisuke.

title: Hidamari Sketch × SP
description: Even though studying at a prestigious art school like Yamabuki is hard work, the girls who live at the Hidamari Apartments always manage to squeeze in time for a little fun and exploration. And when they actually get a day off? Watch out world! Yuno, Sae, Hiro, Miyako and new students Nori and Nazuna return to create another masterpiece of life as art, with all new adventures that include swimming, pajama parties, trips to the art museum and even an all-you-can-eat diner courtesy of the landlady! Of course, there’s always a little housework that has to be squeezed in, but with a pinch of resourcefulness and a dash of creativity, even the most onerous of chores can be turned into something magical. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Nazuna
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm She lives in room 203. She has sandy blonde hair, braids, and large side bangs. She used to live in the neighborhood, but after entering Yamabuki Art High School her father was transferred somewhere for work and her mother followed with him. She appears very quiet and reserved, but has an inferiority complex. She is not in the art department.

characters.name: Nori
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Nori lives in room 103 and is in the art department and likes to play with computers. She is honest and straightforward, and seems to be the most level-headed and normal out of everyone and is usually the one to point out the others' weird ways.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: Ume is a Metapod that lives on the roof of the Hidamari Apartments and represents the manga's author, Ume Aoki. The character does not actually play any significant role in the story. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: Reflection
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのはReflection
description: A pair of researchers remain on their dying planet of Eltria with their two daughters, Amitie and Kirie, in hopes of finding a way to revive the planet, but it was no use. Against her older sister's wishes, Kirie sets off with her childhood friend Iris to seek help from a distant alternate world. They arrive in Japan on Earth to search for the key to their planet's regeneration. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Amitie Florian
characters.original: アミティエ・フローリアン
characters.description: Amitie Florian, also known as the Guardian of Destiny, is a character introduced in Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's PORTABLE -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-. Amitie is hot-blooded, but sometimes her efforts prove futile for her hot-blooded personality. It is revealed in the game that she is an android, in which is important in the plot because it signifies that she is not human. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Kyrie Florian
characters.original: キリエ・フローリアン
characters.description: Kyrie Florian, also known as the Right Hand of Time, is a character introduced in Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's PORTABLE -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-. By contrast to her sister Amitie Florian, her personality is cool and cynical. She is a natural airhead. She seemingly has no problems showing of her sexuality, often being depicted with an impish grin when under dressed. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Iris is Kyrie Florian's childhood friend who resides in an old church on Eltria. She is first introduced in Reflection. Iris is a cheerful and obliging girl who cannot leave people in trouble unhelped.

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

characters.name: Lindy Harlaown
characters.original: リンディ・ハラオウン
characters.description: Lindy, the kind-spirited captain of the spaceship Asura, works for the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She enjoys drinking green tea with sugar (and sometimes cream) added, which is ironic given her appreciation of Japanese culture. She is Chrono's mother.

characters.name: Shamal
characters.description: Shamal, being Yuuno's counterpart, does not actually fight, but uses her ring devices to defend, create portals, absorb victims' Linker Cores into the Book of Darkness, and the like. Shamal acts as the 'mother' of the group, doing the shopping, worrying excessively over the others' well-being, and constructing excuses to Hayate as to why they're out so often ("The grocery store doesn't have our brand of olive oil"). She knows that Hayate does not want them to fight anyone for her, but it is still no question that they must. Now in StrikerS She is A soft-spoken member of the Wolkenritter that specializes in defense and healing. She is a medical officer.

title: COLORs
description: A short anime directed by Tetsurou Araki in collaboration with music by Hiroyuki Sawano and Motohiro Hata. Note: A part of the "TOHO animation: Music Films" project, in commemoration of the 10th anniversary of TOHO Animation.

title: Kanamewo
description: A story about a girl who finds a tree spirit in the rain.

title: Hidamari Sketch: Sae Hiro Sotsugyou-hen
title_original: ひだまりスケッチ 沙英ヒロ 卒業編
description: Sae and Hiro take their final exams while the rest of the Hidamari Apartment's residents cheer them on and prepare for their eventual graduation. (Source: Anime News Network)

(Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show
title_original: ネクロノミ子のコズミックホラーショウ
title_en: Necronomico and the Cosmic Horror Show
description: We all need a chance to change our lives! The story follows Miko Kurono, who began her dream career as a livestreamer under the name "Necronomico" after graduating middle school. Amidst spending her days with childhood friend Mayu Mayusaka and rival Kanna Kagurazaka, she's introduced to a new VR game project!? Upon encountering the game, the girls start pursuing the 'irreplacable now'. (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Candy☆Boy EX02 - Shiawase Kyouyuu Riron
title_original: Candy☆Boy EX02 - シアワセキョウユウリロン
title_en: Candy☆Boy EX02 - Theory of Happiness Sharing
description: Final episode (designated as Episode 8) of Candy Boy which came with DVD volume 2. The episode centres around a day at the pool.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Sakuya Kamiyama
characters.description: A younger girl who is in deeply infatuated with [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/7324/Sakurai-Kanade) with the point that she is almost stalking her. She is extremely wealthy and often tries to spend her money after the twins. She likes collecting old paraphernalia, junk and pictures that belong to Kanade, most of which goes to her makeshift shrine. Despite her overwhelming presence, the twins seem to like her. [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino) is amused by her and Kanade seems more irritated than anything, but they both seem to have some sort of affection for the girl. Initially, her presence was seen as a threat to Kanade as she assumed Sakuya was interested in Yukino. She became aware that Sakuya was madly in love with her when Yukino clears the situation up.

characters.name: Shizuku Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade and Yukino's much younger sister. Shizuku is a lot more level-headed than her sisters. She is deeply affected by the actions of Kanade, who she seems to care about more than Yukino. Unlike her sisters, she buries all her emotions deep down without expressing them but they later resurface in various ways, such as her cutting school. She also appears to be very passive-aggressive. Despite Yukino's attempts to become closer to her, Shizuku clearly spurns the attention of her older sister. This is possibly due to jealousy she feels, as Kanade spends more time with Yukino, and Shizuka would prefer that Kanade pays more attention to her instead. She seems quietly aware of the deeper relationship that her sisters may have.

title: Yuri Seijin Naoko-san
description: Naoko-san is an alien from the planet Yuri, who is plotting to conquer the Earth by yurifying it. Misuzu is a junior high girl and is always troubled by Naoko-san, who lives on the roof of her house. They hear rumors that a molester is wandering around in the area, so they decide to investigate.

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: Rondo Rondo Rondo
title_original: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト ロンド・ロンド・ロンド
description: A compilation film recapping the anime series.

characters.name: Futaba Isurugi
characters.description: Futaba Isurugi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A highly unorthodox Stage Girl who came to Seisho Music Academy along with her childhood friend Kaoruko. Kind-hearted despite her rough words, she takes care of Kaoruko while always griping. Tiny but athletic, she shows deadly aptitude for staged swordfights.

characters.name: Nana Daiba
characters.description: Nana Daiba is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. This Stage Girl is the de facto mother of the 99th class, kind and caring to her classmates. Nicknamed "Banana". Talented not only in singing and dancing but also as a director. Still delighted by the group performance of "Starlight" back in her first year.

characters.name: Kaoruko Hanayagi
characters.description: Kaoruko Hanayagi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Granddaughter of the head of a traditional Japanese dance school, this Stage Girl has refined skills in traditional song and dance. Raised in privilege, she is all too reliant on Futaba Isurugi. While she is always smiling, she is more calculating than anyone else. Speaks in the elegant Kyoto dialect.

characters.name: Junna Hoshimi
characters.description: Junna Hoshimi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A top student who serves as the class representative. Has great decision-making and analytical skills, but is prone to overthinking. After choosing to pursue acting against her parents' wishes, she now frets over the gap in skill between herself and those with natural talent like Maya.

characters.name: Claudine Saijou
characters.description: She is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as the second seat in the class. Born to a Japanese father and a French mother, this talented Stage Girl already has a long career as a child actress. Upon entering the school, she meets the brilliant [Maya Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126666/Tendou-Maya) and immediately begins a staunch rivalry.

characters.name: Maya Tendou
characters.description: She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as head of the class. Practically born for the theater world, with a renowned stage actor and a prima donna for parents. Blessed with a good physique and a carrying voice, she refuses to rest on her laurels and always strives to reach greater heights.

characters.name: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki
characters.description: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki is the tritagonist in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Though she sings and dances her heart out on stage, this Stage Girl is normally withdrawn and contemplative. She admires her roommate Karen's cheery and outgoing nature, but her feelings are put in a difficult place when Karen's old friend Hikari shows up.

characters.name: Hikari Kagura
characters.description: Hikari Kagura (神楽 ひかり, Kagura Hikari) is the deuteragonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Karen's childhood friend. A born performer who studied at an acting school in England. Her fate has been linked with Karen's since viewing a performance of "Starlight". Reuniting with her old friend, she is driven by a strong desire to join the mysterious Revue. (Source: Revue Starlight Wiki)

characters.name: Karen Aijou
characters.description: The protagonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. She set out on the road to becoming a Stage Girl after being captivated by a performance of "Starlight" she saw as a child. She is always boisterous and cheerful but hates early morning lessons. She joins the mysterious Revue with Hikari Kagura, who crossed fates with her when they were young girls.

characters.name: Kirin
characters.description: The Giraffe is a talking, unnamed giraffe that oversees the Revues and controls the Stage of Fate.

title: Discipline
description: The story revolves around Takuro Hayami who transferred to the mostly female Saint Arcadia School. Seemingly all of the girls want to have sex with him because the school only recently started admitting male students. Takuro seems like a normal student, but what the girls later realize when they try to take advantage of him is that he has a secret. Takuro has an "Ultimate Sex Power" that becomes the focus of St. Arcadia's sexual power struggle.

characters.name: Takuro Hayami
characters.description: Takuro transferred to St. Arcadia Academy to get a good education. What he gets is an education in sexual politics. Almost all of his roommates are after him and once his secret gets out, the rest of the women on campus won't stop until they get a piece of him. He has feelings towards Saori. Clues to his "ultimate sex power" are his stamina, his penis continuing to grow inside a woman, and most bizarrely, the ability to ejaculate copious amounts of semen. However he doesn't appear to be very strong physically as he is often over powered by female students and teachers who rape him. Although, due to him liking his situation in the first episode, it could be hinted that he could be enjoying it. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Saori Otokawa
characters.description: A classmate of Takuro's, she's the first person he meets when arriving at his new home. In the original game she is just an ordinary student living in the same dormitory as Takuro (though she performs all of the household chores willingly). The anime series makes her the caretaker of the facility as well. Another change between game and anime series is the afterschool club she's a member of. In the game she is in a Biblical Studies group, whereas in the anime series she is a member of the Paranormal Research Club. She is a kind person by nature, but has a strong will when required. She also has feelings towards Takuro, but has a hard time expressing them. Unlike most of the women that Takuro has met, she is not out to exploit him. Her closeness to Takuro makes her a target in Leona Morimoto's schemes.

characters.name: Reona Morimoto
characters.description: The Head of the Social Club who is highly respected and feared. With the fact that most students are in debt to the Morimoto Financial Group and her sister is the headmistress, she practically controls the school and will do whatever it takes to get what she wants. When Takuro arrives at St. Arcadia, she goes to great lengths to make him a member of the Social Club and to make him her personal sex slave.

characters.name: Maiko Kaneda
characters.description: Maiko wears glasses and is the brains of the group. She spends most of her time reading books and using her computer. She may seem to be the quiet bookworm type, but again, her looks belie her ravenous sex drive. Maiko loves to masturbate whenever or wherever she can. Her sex drive is apparently so great that she required a gang bang to feel properly satisfied.

characters.name: Yuuki Miyagishi
characters.description: A roommate in Takuro's dorm, Yuuki is an unapologetic woman who likes to masturbate. She is proud of her body and knows how to use it. She even takes advantage of Takuro once in a while when he thinks of dirty or nice things (like Saori).

characters.name: Ruri Nonomiya
characters.description: From her looks, Luli is the innocent one out of the cast, but looks are deceptive. She loves sex just like all the other girls. She is closest to Yuuki and likes to do things together with her. This includes taking advantage of Takuro.

characters.name: Reina Morimoto
characters.description: Leona's older sister.

characters.name: Kaori Matsuno
characters.description: Matsuno is Hayami's homeroom teacher and Morimoto sisters' slave subject to many kink.

title: Wonderful Precure!
title_original: わんだふるぷりきゅあ！
description: Animal Town is a town where animals and people live together. Iroha loves animals and is good friends with her dog, Komugi! One day, a mysterious creature, Garugaru, wreaks havoc in the town! However, in order to protect Iroha, Komugi transformed into human form and became a Precure...! I have to save the child animal whose heart is being garugaru-ed...! Let's join forces and return the animals to Niko Garden! (Source: Crunchyroll News)

characters.name: Komugi Inukai
characters.description: Inukai Komugi is the main protagonist of Wonderful Precure! Komugi's true form is of a Papillon dog; however she can transform into a human. She is the leader of the group alongside her owner [Inukai Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/323116/Iroha-Inukai). Komugi is full of curiosity, and is a glutton. She is athletic, and loves going for walks.

characters.name: Iroha Inukai
characters.description: Inukai Iroha is the deuteragonist of Wonderful Precure! She is the co-leader alongside her pet dog [Cure Wonderful](https://anilist.co/character/323117/Komugi-Inukai). Iroha adores animals and wants to befriend them all.

characters.name: Yuki Nekoyashiki
characters.description: Nekoyashiki Yuki is one of the four main cures in Wonderful Precure! Yuki's true form is of a cat; however she can transform into a human. As Cure Nyammy, she forms the Nyanderful Precure duo alongside her owner [Mayu Nekoyashiki](https://anilist.co/character/323119). Yuki is gentle, yet aloof and judgmental. She is very smart, and teases Mayu about her lack of social skills.

characters.name: Mayu Nekoyashiki
characters.description: Nekoyashiki Mayu is one of the four main cures in Wonderful Precure! As Cure Lillian, she forms the Nyanderful Precure duo alongside her pet cat, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/323118). Mayu is socially awkward and wants to befriend others but runs away from social interaction. She deeply cares for Yuki.

characters.name: Satoru Toyama
characters.description: [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/323116/Iroha-Inukai)'s classmate and childhood friend. He has a rabbit named [Daifuku](https://anilist.co/character/326088/Daifuku), and hopes to be able to communicate with him one day. He is very good at studying and has a very kind and gentle personality. When he learns about the Precure, he assists them with his extensive knowledge about animals. He tends to become shy easily when it's about his crush on Iroha. ~!He later on becomes Iroha's boyfriend.!~

characters.name: Daifuku Toyama
characters.description: [Toyama Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/326087/Satoru-Toyama)'s brave pet rabbit.

characters.name: Mehmeh
characters.description: The first Niko Garden Animal to be saved by the Precure after becoming a Garugaru. He is a butler to Niko, the creator of the Niko Garden. He usually manages the Niko Garden and considers himself a capable butler, but sometimes he is a little careless. His special skill is making Niko Garden's signature tea.

characters.name: Niko
characters.description: She is the god-like being that created the Niko Garden. She has magical powers that the other Niko Garden and Kirarin animals do not have. She is affectionately called "Niko-sama" by everyone. Although she looks cute, she has a strong and majestic presence. Despite her strict side, she is very kind and cares for all life.

characters.name: Gaou
characters.description: A mysterious being who controls Garugaru with his voice. He hates humans and orders Garugaru to destroy them.

characters.name: Torame
characters.description: Torame is an energetic boy who loves to be funny, and admires Gaou, often competing with Zakuro for his attention. Like his companions, he hates humans and is very stubborn.

characters.name: Zakuro
characters.description: Zakuro is a lovesick girl who adores Gaou. She hates humans and is extremely stubborn. Like her fellow wolves, she is self-righteous, believing that their harsh methods can demonstrate to animals how humans are the enemy. She is also very jealous towards happy couples, always hoping to find ways to disrupt or break them up.

title: Boy Meets Harem THE ANIMATION
title_original: ボーイ・ミーツ・ハーレム THE ANIMATION
description: What you get when you go on a school field trip to the southern islands, plane crashes and the only survivors are your teacher in love, two popular female classmates, and a sexy flight attendant. Well, Naoki, his teacher, Momoka and Kana, and Asami are certainly actively trying their best to find a way out... (Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated)

characters.name: Momoka Kiriyama
characters.description: She is one of Naoki's classmates.

characters.name: Asami Kakinuma
characters.description: She's a flight attendant.

characters.name: Sanae Nakazono
characters.description: She is the teacher of the group.

characters.name: Kana Miyamura
characters.description: She is one of Naoki's classmates.

title: Koakuma Kanojo THE ANIMATION
title_original: 小悪魔カノジョ THE ANIMATION
description: Episode 1 Tsun Devil & Sister's Ring There's a rumor about a DVD that curses anyone who watches it. Though no one seems to believe in the curse few are brave enough to see what's on the DVD... Mika Akuno watches the DVD... and gets transformed into a succubus. She tries to keep the change a secret but loses control when her crush Kazuya approaches her... Later, Kana agrees to watch the DVD after two of her friends ask her. As a result of the curse she grows something regular women don't have. Her sister Mai tries to help her get back to normal, but the two get more than they bargained for... Episode 2 Katakoi There is a wizarding school where the school is where people learn about magic, and there is a scene about the famous drug / stimulant problem that makes people lust and can also fall in love with the drug. The protagonist tried to use the stimulant to seize the person he liked named Elena. The elf girl who is very beautiful and popular in the school.

characters.name: Elena
characters.description: Elena is a blonde elf, example student, and model. She is one of the main characters of chapter 2 and the girl with whom Kazuki is in love.

title: Yuri Seijin Naoko-san (2012)
description: Naoko-san is an alien from the planet Yuri, who is plotting to conquer the Earth by yurifying it. Misuzu is a junior high girl and is always troubled by Naoko-san, who lives on the roof of her house.

title: Venus Versus Virus
description: After a lifetime of seeing ghosts, young Sumire is recruited by powerful Lucia to fight demons! The girls battle darkness as members of the Venus Vanguard, a group dedicated to ridding the world of its greatest threat—Virus. As they discover why every life is worth saving, they also learn their own unlocked potential for evil. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Lucia Nahashi
characters.description: Lucia is a strong, young girl who lead the fights against Viruses alongside the other members of the Venus Vanguard, sworn to fight and kill all Viruses. Her left eye holds a mysterious powers, though is almost always covered with an eye patch. Use of her powers is taxing and wears her out, but can often be disastrous to her enemy in many ways. Birthday: July 7th

characters.name: Sumire Takahana
characters.description: Sumire is a young high school girl and the newest member of the Venus Vanguard, despite being terribly scared of Viruses. While initially she cannot be of much help to Lucia, they eventually find out that whenever her body reacts to the special chemical used to defeat Viruses (the so called Vaccine), she transforms into a "Berserker Mode", or a living Anti-Virus. With this strange ability, she becomes stronger and violent, and is capable of defeating Viruses with her bare hands, though when under the influence of this power, she cannot discern friend from foe.

characters.name: Lola
characters.description: Voiced by: Ayumi Tsuji (Japanese), Kim-Ly Nguyen (English) A mysterious blonde girl who lives with Lucia and Nahashi. She loves chocolate and is often seen eating it. She has a twin named Layla and in the anime neither of them seem to age since they are soulless dolls created by Lucif and Nahashi's teacher. She is a major character right from the beginning in the anime, but in the manga she does not arrive right away. In the English version of the anime, her name is rendered as "Laura". (wikipedia)

characters.name: Souichirou Nahashi
characters.description: Souichirou, who is always referred to by his surname (as per Japanese standard), is the guardian of Lucia, who loves her as if he were her real father. Before Lucia was born, Nahashi was studying to become a mage, along with Lucia's mother Lilith and Lucia's father Lucif. He harbored an unrequited love for Lilith, but never got close with her as she was in love with Lucif. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Yoshiki Kusanagi
characters.description: Yoshiki is a young man Sumire met one day in a park while he was reading a book. After a few more meetings together while exchanging books to read, Yoshiki starts to develop romantic feelings for Sumire. ~!However, it is later discovered that he is actually one of Lucif's followers named Aion, he tries to take Sumire's fragment but stops because he truly cared for her, thus, he betrays Lucif, but Lucia, not knowing of his betrayal, kills him. !~

characters.name: Layla
characters.description: Layla is Lola's twin. In the anime, after Lucif left to find the True World, Layla went with him and Lola stayed with Nahashi and Lilith. Layla loves konpeito candy as much as Lola loves chocolate. Like Lola, she does not seem to age. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Ruka
characters.description: Ruka is a young girl who serves under Sonoka. She has a sadistic personality and has the power to control water and wind, however she states her specialty is electricity. In the English version of the anime, her name is rendered as "Luca". (Source: Wiki)

characters.name: Gai
characters.description: One of Sonoka's henchmen. He has a fairly sadistic personality, and is skilled in both controlling fire and earth.

characters.name: Riku Mikumo
characters.description: Riku is Nene's younger brother who has a crush on Sumire. Multiple times, Riku attempts to ask Sumire out on a date, but something always interferes, leaving him heartbroken each time. He has a timid personality, which makes it even more difficult to ask Sumire out. (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Youji
characters.description: In episode three of the anime, and chapter 4 of the manga. Yohji's sister, Tsukuyo, goes to Venus Vanguard to request helping in getting Yohji out of his room, which he has locked himself inside. ~! The real problem is that his sister is a virus and wants attack him. After beating Tsukuyo, Lucia gives Yohji a necklace of the sun and the moon, which represent him and his departed sister. !~

characters.name: Lucif
characters.description: Lucif is Lucia's father who, before she was born, left to find the path to the True World. His past is filled with mysteries, and Nahashi refuses to talk about the subject with Lucia. In the anime, it is thought he turned himself into a Virus so he could obtain the True World. In the manga, it appears he was possessed by Aion. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nene Mikumo
characters.description: Nene is Riku's older sister, and Sumire's cousin. She has a very loud and cheerful personality, and always tries her best to look out for Sumire. She also often encourages Riku on his attempts to ask Sumire out.

title: Shoujo Sect
description: Shinobu Honda and Momoko Naitou know each other since childhood. Shinobu fell in love with Momoko from the first day they met. Now in high school, Momoko has forgotten about the past, but Shinobu hasn't. Both follow their own ways but Shinobu still hopes for Momoko to remember their promise from long ago. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Shinobu Handa
characters.description: (Manga Based) Shinobu is one of the main characters of the story. She has no trouble with money or making her way in the world. She is a bourgeois only child. She loves women regardless of age. In regards to coming in late, sleeping in class, generally being a delinquent and failing grades, she is ahead of the curve. However, it seems that she used to be a perfect student straight out of some movie. Although Shinobu is involved in a harem with most of her classmates, she is in love with Momoko Naitou the most. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Momoko Naitou
characters.description: The main character of the series. Momoko is a member of the schools disciplinary committee which is a duty that she takes very seriously and often puts her at odds with Shinobu. She is very gluttonous (though never seems to gain any weight), irritable, and has very little tolerance for other peoples antics (though she is shown to have a mischievous side of her own). She is kind to her classmates however which makes her very popular. Momoko always wears a rather strong-smelling perfume which usually gives away her presence before she even makes it known. Several years before the series she first met Shinobu in a park when they both were very young. Shinobu gave her a cookie and Momoko in return gave her a kiss. This encounter left Shinobu with deep feelings of love for Momoko, though Momoko does not remember at all. Momoko finds it hard to warm up to Shinobu due to latters promiscuity, bu

characters.name: Kyouko Hayato
characters.description: A teacher at the all-girls school. She is very tall and beautiful yet acts somewhat childish which makes her popular among her students. Her favorite student is Momoko, with whom she is infatuated. She often hangs around with Momoko after school and allows her to stay at her place. She has a hard time with money due to her expensive tastes but remains constantly upbeat. After seducing Momoko in her apartment she is struck terribly ill and is forced to resign from school.

characters.name: Shigure Komai
characters.description: A third-year student and Chizuru's older sister. She is beautiful, intelligent, and serene with a good grip on things. She could easily be a class leader but chooses to go straight home after school instead. She is deeply in love with Chizuru but is much more subtle about her feelings and even tries to suppress them, though she eventually gives in after going to Shinobu for advice and realizing that both her and her sister's feelings are too strong to ignore. (From Wikipedia)

characters.name: Maya Enjyoji
characters.description: One of the many girls in the school who is infatuated with Shinobu. Maya is a pretty smart girl, but she is also very submissive and weak-willed so she'll go along with anything anyone tells her to do. One day when Maya was on clean-up duty she found Shinobu sleeping in an empty room. Her infatuation got the better of her and she kissed Shinobu unaware that she was in the process of waking up. Shinobu later confronted her about it and Maya broke down and began apologizing, saying that she'll do anything to make it up to her. Shinobu brought Maya to an empty club room where she proceeded to seduce her. After some encouragement from Kirin, Maya pledged herself as Shinobu's servant. Maya's devotion to Shinobu continues to grow and she ends up staying with her to the very end where they form a three-way relationship between themselves and Momoko. Shinobu helps Maya to bre

characters.name: Sayuri Ookami
characters.description: A shady third-year student who longs to make Shinobu hers and hers alone. Ookami is the top of her class and is well-respected by her teachers as well as most of her underclassmen for her model behavior but also proves to be a calculated schemer in her pursuit of Shinobu. She attempts to seduce Shinobu in an empty room but is repeatedly, yet, half-heartedly refused because Shinobu doesn't want to hurt her. Her true plan was to get Momoko to lose her temper and get herself expelled so that she would be separated from Shinobu. Her plan is realized when Momoko attacks her with a fire extinguisher. The matter is settled quietly out of court and Momoko is allowed to stay but she chooses to leave anyway. Despite the fact that her plan ultimately succeeded it proves to be in vain as Momoko and Shinobu consummate their feelings several months later.(From Wikipedia)

title: Energy Kyouka!!
description: Based on the adult manga by Satou Kimiatsu. Kyouka is a beautiful and lively school student that goes out too much and has been struggling to pay for her cell phone every month… Without a quick way to make money, she decides to make use of her natural gifts—and there is no better place to do so than her own school. The man-eater Kyouka explodes with power as she pins down all the virgin men! (Source: Coolmic, edited)

characters.name: Kyouka  Shiraishi
characters.description: Shiraishi Kyouka is the main character of the hentai Energy Kyouka!!. She is a student in high-school and a prostitute. She is nymphomaniac and bisexual.

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear G: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギアG 戦姫絶唱しないシンフォギア
title_en: Symphogear G: Non-Songs of the Valkyries
description: Shorts released with the Blu-ray and DVD releases of Senki Zesshou Symphogear G.

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve
characters.original: マリア・カデンツァヴナ・イブ
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Black Gungnir ~!__Symphogear post G:__ Airgetlám!~ An energetic singer who reached the top of the American music charts about 2 months after her debut. Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Shinji Ogawa
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari; he works as Tsubasa's manager on the scenes.

title: Futabu!!
description: A relaxing vacation at the Manra Valley onsen is just what the members of the Futabu, or Futanari Club, signed up for. Officially, their goal is to research the harvest festival native to the area for a high school project. Unofficially, they're there to have a little fun, and the springs are an aphrodisiac...

characters.name: Mao Asakura

She befriends Mio Minato, the school's top idol, and becomes an idol herself. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Aine Yuuki

Lively and positive, Aine has a kind heart that takes into account other people's feelings. She is from a large family, and they own the "Penguin Cafe" supported by their neighbors. Aine herself enjoys helping around the house. While a very ordinary girl, her encounter with Mio triggers an interest in idol activities. She serves as the muse of her own brand, Sugar Melody.

characters.name: Mio Minato
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. She is active as a popular idol and is the featured model for "Aikatsu! Style Times". Mio has excellent fashion sense, and demonstrates her talents by serving as both the designer and muse of her own brand, Material Color. While Mio is smart, earns good grades and is able to do anything, she has always felt that she's missing something. However, her encounter with Aine seems to spark something inside of her, leading Mio to invite Aine into the world of Aikatsu! (Source: Wikipedia)

Sensitive to the latest trends, Mirai is a bright girl who loves social media. She often takes pictures of her everyday life. She is a fashion leader who enjoys a not only cute, but poisonous sense of style that strays from traditional rules. As an idol, Mirai believes that it's bad to be the same as everyone else, and constantly puts an overwhelming amount of effort in searching for individuality and originality. She serves as both the designer and the muse of her own brand, Milky Joker. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Karen Kamishiro
characters.description: She is a graduate of Star Harmony Academy and a second-year high school student. She forms the unit "Love Me Tear" with Mirai Asuka; together, they won the Diamond Friends Cup. An elite who received gifted education from a young age, she is also a quintessential "high-class lady." While she has a gentle and refined personality, she also possesses a surprisingly wild side; for instance, the sight of her smiling while triggering traps during an event set on Karen Island is genuinely terrifying. She keeps wild beasts—specifically a bear named Choco, a wild boar named Maron, and a tiger named Mocha—whom she refers to as her "cute friends." She also keeps various other animals as pets. Having consistently reached the top in various fields, she initially pursued nothing but victory in the world of Aikatsu. With her agile dancing as her weapon, Maika has good reflexes and is good at taking action, but while reliable, she's also afraid of ghosts.

characters.name: Ema Hinata

An energetic and active girl, she belongs to the lacrosse club in addition to being an idol. Her lacrosse skills are to the point where she is a candidate to be a Japanese representative. Ema is not only good at singing with a great sense of rhythm, she is capable of playing musical instruments. Casually attentive, she is good at reading the atmosphere.

characters.name: Kaguya Shirayuri

characters.name: Sakuya Shirayuri

characters.name: Chiharu Hachiya

Her signature verbal tic—ending her sentences with "pyuru"—is apparently a communication code from her home planet.

She serves as the de facto leader of the band and enjoys the deep trust of her fellow members. However, she also possesses an ambitious streak—secretly, and without the other members' knowledge, she is aiming to make a solo debut. She practices the guitar without fail every single day and takes a very earnest approach to her music.

By her own admission, she is occasionally seized by an impulse to destroy everything around her; she struggles desperately to resist it, though there are times when she simply cannot hold back and ends up breaking things anyway. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Alice is a good-natured and lively young girl whose only issue is that her inner, feminine identity is at odds with her male biological body and typically virile first name, Kintarou. She is a great fan of Sachiko's, and dreamed to be born as biologically female to enter Lilian High School just to be Sachiko's petite sœur. She seems to be good friends with Yuuki, and as a member of the Hanadera Student Council, gets to interact with the Yamayurikai for their respective school festivals.
