Before Akane joined, she was the lowest ranking member and was picked on incessantly. If left alone, she would cum non-stop for the entire day. She's the leader when it comes to milk. A young Futa who may be small, but is able to release an incredible amount of cum. It's always necessary to update her data.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke wo: Reo x Mai Diaries
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを 玲緒麻衣だいありぃ
description: Short picture episodes of Reo and Mai during their daily life as a couple.

characters.name: Mai Sawaguchi
characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who often takes care of her siblings at home. Mai has a streak of tomboy which shows up occasionally.

title: Akikan! OVA
description: The story revolves around a typical high school boy named Kakeru Daichi and the can of melon juice soda that he bought from a vending machine. The can suddenly transforms into a beautiful but standoffish girl that Kakeru nicknames "Melon," and more "Akikan" ("empty can") girls appear. However, Akikan girls need to be infused with carbon dioxide in order to turn into a human. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

characters.name: Kakeru Daichi
characters.description: The series's main protagonist, A perverted high school virgin studying at Kyuugetsu Academy. He enjoys collecting rare juice cans. One day, he bought a melon soda that transformed into a girl, which was an Akikan.

characters.name: Melon
characters.description: A steel Akikan who came from a melon soda, owned by Kakeru. She's competitive and strong-willed, which was the reason why she was always having a fight with Kakeru. Although she likes her owner she cannot express her feelings well, which ends up telling opposite of what she wants to say. She likes watching baseball matches, even with midnight telecasts, though she has stated she has no clue on how the game is played. She basically hates Aluminum Akikans and is always having small quarrels with Yell. She mostly uses carbon dioxide based cool drink sorcery in battle.

characters.name: Yurika Kochikaze
characters.description: Kakeru and Najimi's classmate who claims to be Najimi's lover. She's always having fights with Kakeru and Yell as her rival for Najimi. She's also a self-proclaimed witch and she often uses cards to throw at Kakeru (which, from the back, look like tarot cards but are normal poker cards). In some instances she shows mysterious powers. Her birthday is on Halloween, which could relate to the reason she believes she is a witch. Her nickname is Yuriri.

characters.name: Najimi Tenkuuji
characters.description: Kakeru's childhood-friend and classmate, whose charm point is her "antenna" hair which changes form according to her mood. She's an heiress to the Tenkuuji group of companies and she holds a romantic feeling toward Kakeru. She's gentle and easy-going, but her weird sense of imagination tend to warp her into her own world. She has the history of being saved by Kakeru from being kidnapped. She also has the tendency to become a Kuribo look-alike (from the Super Mario series) when struck by jealousy; she starts kicking Kakeru's calf.

characters.name: Budoko
characters.description: An Aluminum Akikan who came from a grape juice. She's small but strong willed and talks in a funny way. She loves to watch the stars together with her owner, Misaki Miyashita. (source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yell
characters.description: An Aluminum Akikan who came from a sports drink. She's usually cool and composed but she becomes furious when someone tries to insult her owner. She's got sharp vision which was the cause for her being sensitive to moving objects, which causes her the urge to play with it. She also loves animals and she herself has a pet turtle called "Kame". She uses the "isotonic sword" as her cool drink sorcery, which can cut through anything made of organic matter. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Airin Kizaki
characters.description: Otoya's secretary. She's strict but shy by nature and is always having a problem with Otoya calling her by her given name, which she was emabarassed to be heard by others. She's also one of the few ordinary persons in the series. Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Gorou Amaji
characters.description: Kakeru's classmate and friend. He was nick-named Gigolo by Kakeru but he was far from being a ladies' man. He is often forgotten by his friends due to his lack of Existence. He's also got crush for Yurika Kochikaze but always ends up not being able to tell her or being ignored. But, he is a reliable person at times of need, always ready to help his friend. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hidehiko Otoya
characters.description: A government official designated to Department of Economy. He is the person who established the "Akikan Elect" and "Intelligence Port project", though his motive for their establishment is not yet clear. A self-proclaimed gay who loves pretty boys. He's often having contact with Kakeru, harassing him sexually. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Misaki Miyashita
characters.description: Budoko's owner and a junior high sophomore student. She was a timid girl who hid inside her shell and didn't have friends. Her hobby is drawing, and she often refers to people with otaku terminologies.

characters.name: Miku
characters.description: A mixed juice Steel Akikan who appears in the anime. ~!Her can was girlished by a cat (the same cat that is usually found on the roof of Daichi and Melon's house) who ran off right away. This caused her to have a hatred of Akikans, both Aluminum and Steel, with owners, and she began absorbing their powers and calling herself The Strongest Akikan. Her main cool drink sorcery is Rainbow Splash Mixer, and she also has the ability to make clones of the Akikans she had captured called Zeros. Since she was never given a name, Kakeru gives her the name 'Miku', a name she likes but doesn't admit to it. Daichi offered the idea to be her Owner, something she considered until Otoya showed her a picture of her true Owner and ran off to find it. At the end of the series she is friends with the main cast and still chasing her Owner.!~

title: Ghost Concert: missing Songs
title_original: ゴーストコンサート: missing Songs
description: The year is 2045, in a world where songs have been banned. Instead of humans playing instruments and creating music, a music app titled "MiucS" is in charge of these things. High school student Seria goes out with her friends one day, but she happens to hear someone singing, which is supposed to be prohibited. What she finds is a lone ghost, a "Great Ghost" who has appeared from outside this world. Now Seria must decide whether to stay silent or risk everything to bring music back to the world. (Source: Anime News Network, Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Seria Aiba
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm A high school girl who lives in an apartment overlooking Mount Tsukuba. She loves history. She has had the ability to see and touch spirits since she was a child.

characters.name: Cleopatra
characters.description: An ancient Egyptian queen. One of the Great Ghosts released from the spirit world, she possesses [Seria](https://anilist.co/character/378042/Seria-Aiba) in the human world.

characters.name: Akari Murayama
characters.description: A high school student belonging to “TERA.” With a straightforward personality, she fights wielding the massive sword “Ibukimaru,” as tall as herself, and mastering the “Konpen Matoi Ki,” which wraps spiritual power around her body.

characters.name: Kaede Saionji
characters.description: A young girl belonging to the psychic group “TERA.” The daughter of the prestigious Saionji family. Cool-headed and composed, she fights by possessing others using her psychic powers. She seems to have had some connection with [Seria](https://anilist.co/character/378042/Seria-Aiba) during her childhood, but...

characters.name: Riku Aoki
characters.description: A woman who belongs to "TERA." She can also be quite sharp-tongued. She has the ability to subjugate the spirits around her, transforming them into plant-like forms and using them as her servants. She has been active in "TERA" for the longest time, second only to [Setsutei](https://anilist.co/character/392080/Setsutei).

characters.name: MiucS
characters.description: An AI (artificial intelligence) that creates and manages music on behalf of humans. It has the authority to ban humans from singing anywhere in the world and to immediately punish violators with drones and other means.

characters.name: Setsutei
characters.description: He is the leader of the Ibaraki branch of "TERA" and an uncharacteristic monk. He uses secret arts to support psychics. Aside from the organization's goals, he is plotting to destroy the music app "MiucS."

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: She is an internationally popular model and a beautiful woman who can be seen all over town. She is also the daughter of the president of ActPluto, a leading IT company.

characters.name: Youtetsu
characters.description: A young man dispatched from "TERA" headquarters to manage and assist the Ibaraki branch. He often visits [Setsutei](https://anilist.co/character/392080/Setsutei) as a liaison with headquarters. He always has a gentle smile on his face.

characters.name: Rui Ichikawa
characters.description: A quiet girl who belongs to "TERA." She takes care of all the household chores at the temple. She controls "Soul-Stitched Spirit Beasts," stuffed animal specimens that have spirits inhabiting them.

characters.name: Rembrandt
characters.description: A Painter who was active in 17th Century Holland. Throughout his life he continued to depict 'light and shadow'. He had fallen under Nero's control who sought to control ghosts with exceptional artistic talent

characters.name: Florence Nightingale
characters.original: フローレンス・ ナイチンゲール
characters.description: A military nurse also known as 'The Angel of Crimea'. She had possessed and coexisted with Nao Ogata, who belongs to the TERA Tokyo HQ, since Nao was a child.

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear GX: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギアGX 戦姫絶唱しないシンフォギア
description: Shorts released with the Blu-ray and DVD releases of Senki Zesshou Symphogear GX.

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve
characters.original: マリア・カデンツァヴナ・イブ
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Black Gungnir ~!__Symphogear post G:__ Airgetlám!~ An energetic singer who reached the top of the American music charts about 2 months after her debut. Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Shinji Ogawa
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari; he works as Tsubasa's manager on the scenes.

characters.name: Elfnein
characters.description: A girl from the world of alchemy who bears a resemblance to Carol. She comes before the other Symphogear users to provide them with a means of combating the Alca-Noise. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Carol Dienheim
characters.original: キャロル・マールス・ディーンハイム
characters.description: Carol grew up in a peaceful life in medieval Europe with her father, who taught her alchemy. After her father was burned at the stake for practicing alchemy, Carol interpreted his last words of "learn more about the world" to mean that she must take it upon herself to dissect the world down to its fundamental components. She then spends several centuries plotting how to accomplish this using alchemy to create artificial homunculus bodies and transferring her memories to them to make her biologically immortal. She has a mastery of alchemy after so long, and has complete control over an alchemical version of noise known as alca-noise, the Aristotelian elements (silver, wind, fire, earth, water) as well as the faust robe Dur da Blá. The use of such powers require the burning of memories as a fuel-source. Due to Carol's long life, she has a large amount to burn, and thinks nothing of losing

title: Jitaku Keibiin
description: Based on the erotic game by Beelzebub. Tsunetaka Kareki. Codename: Noir Set. He is a private home security officer with 20 years of military experience. Exceptionally trained in technology and intelligence gathering, he perceives and records the smallest of details of the home to which he is dispatched. His new assignment is directly from his father, Takao Kareki. He must look after his father's new lover, a potential bride. Nothing but the best professional will do to keep her safe. But in her home, he sees all. (Source: DLsite English)

title: Hibike! Euphonium 3: Extra Episodes
title_original: 響け！ユーフォニアム３Extra Episode
description: A series of extra episodes that is included with each Hibike! Euphonium 3 Blu-ray/DVD volume.

characters.name: Kumiko Oumae
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

characters.name: Reina Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

characters.name: Hazuki Katou
characters.description: **Instrument:** Tuba Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

characters.name: Sapphire Kawashima
characters.description: **Instrument:** Contrabass Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kaori Nakaseko
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm **Instrument:** Trumpet A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.

characters.name: Natsuki Nakagawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Euphonium Natsuki is a reserved girl who is seen rarely talking, and she has an aloof and calm attitude. It is later revealed that the second-years are like this because of an event which occurred the year before [Kumiko Oumae](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s first year at Kitauji. However, Natsuki is normally friendly to everyone, and tends to be mature and calm in most situations. She is also understanding of situations and takes everything quite nicely.

characters.name: Nozomi Kasaki
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Flute Nozomi is a second-year student who used to play flute for the Kitauji High School's Bass Band Club in her first year. She and most of the first year members quit the club due to a conflict between the first-year members and the third-year members at that time. Sound! Euphonium Season 2 Spoilers: ~!Nozomi tried to rejoin the band as well as get Asuka's approval. However, Asuka initially rejected due to the fear of Mizore possibly being affected by Nozomi's sudden return, causing a negative impact on Mizore's performance for the competition. However, due to an unexpected move by Nozomi to talk to Mizore causing her to run off, the latter managed to talk things out with Nozomi and restore their friendship. It is also revealed that Mizore played the oboe for the sole reason that it was the only thing that connected her with Nozomi.!~ Liz and the Blue Bird Spoilers: ~!I

characters.name: Kanade Hisaishi
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kanade Hisaishi is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a euphonium player in Kumiko's second year. Kanade has a courteous personality and great communication skills, and gives off a good impression to everyone who sees her. However, she has a secret side to her always-polite demeanor. Kumiko describes her as a "hypocritical courtesy" or a girl who is "superficially polite but rude in intent".

characters.name: Mayu Kuroe
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Euphonium She is a third-year transfer student from the prestigious Seira Girls School.

characters.name: Kaho Hariya
characters.description: __Instrument:__ Euphonium Kaho Hariya is a new first-year student at Kitauji High School in [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s third year and a member of the concert band.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Instrument:__ Trumpet Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words. However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band. By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she

characters.name: Haruka Ogasawara
characters.description: __Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

title: Penguin Musume♥Heart
description: Sakura Nankyoku is a total otaku. Due to a fluke, she gets elected as her class' Student Council President. Everything takes off from there into a series of crazy misadventures revolving around Sakura, her family, and her classmates. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Sakura Nankyoku
characters.description: The lead character who is obsessed with manga and anime. Whenever she cosplays as someone, she obtains the abilities of that outfit. She is part of a very rich family and is nicknamed Penguin due to her penguin-like hairstyle and her surname which means "South Pole".

characters.name: Cha Chi
characters.description: A strong fighter from China. She made a promise with Kujira at a younger age, (who was still under the delusion she was a boy) that if Chi-Cha could defeat her, Kujira would become her husband. While Kujira has since realized she was a girl and has made it very clear to all, Chi-Cha still remains clueless and vows to make her her husband someday.

characters.name: Mary Chupacabra W. Whitebear
characters.description: Penguin's rival, represented by a polar bear. A tragic moment in her past has caused her to despise the Nankyoku company, and constantly seeks to overwhelm it, normally by building something bigger than what they have. Later on though, she becomes bankrupt and has to use tattered clothing whilst maintaining her lady-like dignity. She is also referred to as 'Shirokuma' (a literal translation of Whitebear) and is sometimes called 'Kuma-san' by Penguin. (Wiki)

characters.name: Kujira Etorofu
characters.description: A girl who is skilled in Etorofu martial arts. She was raised as a boy by her father to become a strong fighter, and whilst she has since realised she is actually a girl, her father hasn't. She is generally hounded by Penguin due to a likeness to one of her favourite anime stars. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nene Kurio
characters.description: A calm girl who always remains composed with a smile on her face, no matter what happens. She lives near the shrine and works as a shrine maiden.

characters.name: Kare Ijuin
characters.description: One of Mary's four knights. ~!Actually a man who really enjoys wearing dresses.!~

characters.name: Miho-chan-sensei
characters.description: Based on a real person. Introducing new penguin musume goods at the end of each episode.

characters.name: Saki Hojiro
characters.description: Maguro's little sister. Just like her sister, she is bashful and mostly communicates through text messages. She immediately becomes the victim of Penguin's affections, but luckily seems to rather enjoy them. form : http://www.wikipedia.com

characters.name: Sebastian
characters.description: Works as the Nankyoku family's butler. He has a wide variety of skills used to serve Penguin and Kaede, and occasionally dresses in women's clothing. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaede Nankyoku
characters.description: Kaede is Penguin's sister. Even though being just in elementary school, she is a very mature kid. Kaede is strict towards her sister but nevertheless loves her.

characters.name: Maguro Houjiro
characters.description: Maguro Hojiro is Marie's right-hand woman and one of her four knights. She wears an eyepatch and a maid's outfit. Maguro has a fierce composure, but becomes shy around Kujira and communicates with cutesy text messages.

title: Fushigi no Kuni no Miyuki-chan
title_original: 不思議の国の美幸ちゃん
description: Miyuki, a cute girl, is in over her head. When late for school, she is suddenly transported to another world (Alice In Wonderland style), except that all the inhabitants of the other world are female...and they all seem to be in love with Miyuki. And the world behind her mirror is even weirder. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Miyuki
characters.description: An average yet pretty school girl. She appears to be pretty bright, if a bit scatterbrained. She's also very innocent, claiming to have never even had a boyfriend before. So when she lands in several strange worlds filled with pretty women trying to "get to know her better," she becomes very panicky and wished for nothing more than to return home. Miyuki's travels lead her to seven different worlds.

characters.name: Humpty Dumpty
characters.original: ハンプティ・ダンプティ

title: Megane no Megami
description: Hot for eyeglasses Hiroki is dating one of the girls in his school, Kurumizawa Hitomi. Faithful, cute, and absolutely perfect… But, Hiroki is a bit dissatisfied with their sex. This is because she won’t wear her glasses as they have sex. As they're studying together, they decide to fuck. Convinced by Hiroki, she puts on her glasses. Seeing her with glasses on, he ends up fucking her twice in a row. After a rough fucking, he gets busted by his sister and gets punished by her…!?

characters.name: Hitomi Kurumizawa
characters.description: [Hiroki](https://anilist.co/character/139786)'s girlfriend.

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: [Hiroki](https://anilist.co/character/139786)'s elder sister.

characters.name: Hiroki
characters.description: He has a fetish for glasses.

title: Shoujotachi no Sadism THE ANIMATION
title_original: 少女達の茶道ism THE ANIMATION
description: One of the School Clubs invites his mentor teacher in club activities, but his mentor teacher is just being toyed by members of his club and making his mentor teacher to take powerful stimulants. To stop it, he had to take a drug neutralizer stimulants, but the drug neutralizer stimulants was poured into the feet of the club members. The only way, and inevitably, the tutor should lick their feet one by one to get the neutralizer of the stimulant drug. (Source: Nekopoi, translated)

title: Choujin Densetsu Urotsukidouji
title_original: 超神伝説 うろつき童子
description: Legend has it that the human race is not the only dominant civilization living on Earth. Two other races exist in this world: the Makai (a demon race) and the Juujinkai (a half-man, half-beast race). Once every 3,000 years, a supreme being known as the "Choujin" (Overfiend) will emerge and bring balance to all three realms on Earth. But now, Amano, along with his sister Megumi and their sidekick Kuroko, must protect Nagumo and his new girlfriend Akemi Ito from the Makai, who believe that Nagumo is not the Choujin, but an evil entity bent on destroying all living beings on Earth.

title_original: いっしょにとれーにんぐ026[おふろ] BATHTIME WITH HINAKO&HIYOKO
title_en: Issho ni Training 026: Bathtime with Hinako & Hiyoko
description: Viewers take an exercise in the bathtub and an after-bath stretch with Hinako and the new character Hiyoko. A microSD card containing the OVA data will be bundled with the DVD so that users can watch the anime on their cell phones. Stretch Time segment included.

characters.name: Hinako
characters.description: Hinako used to be a shut-in who just liked eating snacks and watching anime all day in her dark living room until her dream of becoming an anime character comes true! No longer unfit, no longer sloppy-- Hinako is a young, busty and energetic girl who is on a mission to make her fellow otaku hikkikomori get into shape. She likes push-ups, squats, crunches, showering and sleeping, and loves to dream that she is a magical girl. Hinako also enjoys wearing lingerie and school gym outfits (though she does not seem to go to school). If there's anything Hinako loves more than lingerie, anime and exercising, it's sleeping! She appears to be a great advocate of sleep.

characters.name: Hiyoko
characters.description: Hinako's senior who comes to join her for a bath.

title: Sweet Home: H na Onee-san wa Suki Desu ka?
title_original: Sweet Home～Hなお姉さんは好きですか？～
description: Ryuichi is a university student. He used to live alone and enjoyed his school life. But one day, his apartment was destroyed by a fire.... He reluctantly comes back to his house. But his house has been changed to a boarding house for girls...! It seems there is no place for him to live. But they all allow him to stay there together! His new life begins like this.... (Source: Himeya Shop)

characters.name: Chinatsu Furuhashi
characters.description: Chinatsu is an upperclassman attending the same university as Ryuichi, allowing her to make fun of him. She has a slightly boyish personality, and has no problem with making aggressive moves on Ryuichi.

characters.name: Kyoko Moroboshi
characters.description: Kyoko is the loving and caring step-mother of Ryuichi, but is also the reason why Ryuichi moved out in the first place. A defenseless and heavy sleepwalker who finds herself in Ryuichi’s bed almost every night every since the passing of her husband.

characters.name: Kaede Soga
characters.description: Kaede is an instructor at the university Ryuichi is attending. While she has the appearance of a reliable person, she is clumsy and not too attentive to her surroundings. Despite this, her serious personality won't allow her to admit defeat.

characters.name: Manami Amagi
characters.description: Manami is an airheaded girl who works as a waitress at a nearby restaurant. While she is usually passive, she has taken a liking to Ryuichi and is not afraid to show it. Despite looking harmless, she is very well trained in judo since her family runs a dojo.

characters.name: Risa Tomosato
characters.description: Risa is the brash and loud. She lives by herself nearby, so she enjoys coming by to visit and save money on food. She is a classic tsundere who won't admit her feelings for Ryuichi.

title: Ochi Mono RPG Seikishi Luvilias
title_original: 堕ちモノRPG 聖騎士ルヴィリアス
description: Based on the erotic doujin game by Daijobi Kenkyuujo (ダイジョビ研究所). Standing up against the demon army that suddenly invaded the peaceful human world, Knight Luvilia confronts the Demon King, Vois. With the Demon God, Tia, Vois defeats Luvilia and makes her into his property. Luvilia shouts and cries telling him to stop but can’t stop moaning from the intense stimulation. Vois enjoys his victory by indulging in the finest of women. When he’s done though, she teleports away. In preparation for their next battle, Vois adds his little succubus who is also his younger sister, Ilis, and big-breast loli witch, Lufilia to his team.

characters.name: Tia
characters.description: A deity that serves the current demon lord, Vois. She is known for being one of the demon lord's strongest fighter and most priced woman. She constantly guard and support him whenever he is going to battle Luvilias.

characters.name: Luvilias
characters.description: A knight that wields the holy sword. She serves Fonica and act as the ultimate warrioress that defends the empire from the demon lord's army.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Demon girl with big breasts, red eyes and pointy ears.

characters.name: Lifulia
characters.description: She is a witch

title: Sukeban Deka
description: The last time Saki left school it was to change her school uniform for prison greys, but when the Feds needed someone to infiltrate a ruthless criminal organization operating within an exclusive high school, they knew they needed the baddest bad girl of them all! Now Saki's back on the streets for the ultimate final exam, armed with a top-secret weapon that only LOOKS like a yo-yo, and a license to use whatever force necessary to achieve her goal. Saki's lovely, lethal and ready to lay it all on the line-because if she fails this test, the next outfit she'll be wearing is a body bag! (Source: ADV Films)

characters.name: Saki Asamiya
characters.description: The bitter heroine of the story. Saki is a natural born fighter who enjoys getting into scuffles with various people. She never backs down and is very stubborn.

characters.name: Remi Mizuchi
characters.description: The eldest daughter, a beautiful blonde who is completely ruthless and sociopathic. When Remi first arrives at the high school, many of the students admire her because of her striking beauty. However, throughout the entire Sukeban Deka manga series, Remi serves as a deadly antagonist to Saki. She seems to be the least dangerous of the three but in fact is the most. ~!She is responsible for Junko's death, setting up Ayumi's death with a malfunctioning shotgun to fight Saki, and a brainwashed assassin to kill her father Gozo and sister Emi.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Ayumi Mizuchi
characters.description: The dark haired middle child of the Mizuchi family. She has four hulking bodyguards who follow her around for protection. Ayumi is a drug addict and dealer, and is extremely greedy. However, she is the least evil out of the Mizuchi sisters. Despite her cold demeanor, she is loyal to her father and sisters. ~!In the OVA she is betrayed and killed by Remi, who gives her a malfunctioning shotgun that backfires, and steals all her money.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kyouichirou Jin
characters.description: Saki's mentor.

characters.name: Emi Mizuchi
characters.description: The youngest sister who is an artist. Emi is an egomaniac who sees herself as a great artist when at best her talent is borderline, which leads her to use her father's influence to bribe judges and copy the works of other artists. Emi steals Junko's work and copies from it to win an art contest. ~!In the OVA she is killed by a brainwashed assassin along with her father sent by Remi.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sanpei Nowaki
characters.description: Saki's ardent admirer who follows her all over the school campus. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gouzou Mizuchi
characters.description: The patriarch of the antagonist Mizuchi crime family. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Koutetsu no Majo Annerose
title_original: 鋼鉄の魔女 アンネローゼ
description: Based on the erotic game by Black Lilith. The stage is set in an abandoned city called Amidahara, inhabited by monsters, criminals and armed refugees. There lives Annerose, a female witch blade, who runs a private detective agency. One day, a girl named Miki comes by and asks Annerose for help in finding her brother. Starting from her request, Annerose gets involved in fierce power struggles between the dark forces in the city... (Source: DLsite English)

characters.name: Annerose Vajra
characters.original: アンネローゼ・ヴァジュラ
characters.description: Annerose is a feared and powerful witch living in Amidahara. She is half human, half demon and makes a living by running a detective agency. She wields the legendary sword Kongo Yasha and her skill as a swordsman is second to none. While she is not down right evil Annerose is still ruthless when it comes how she conducts business.

characters.name: Rikuro Tachibana
characters.description: The main protagonist.

characters.name: Lee Mayfeng
characters.description: Lee Mayfeng is a witch and a skilled assassin. As a result of the "werewolf" scandal, she was hired by the Chinese mafia "Kowloon Kai"; one of the three major organizations in Amidahara. Unlike Annerose, Lee Mayfeng was once human; but when she killed a witch in the course of her assassination work, a "tattoo," which was the source of the witch's power, was implanted in her back, giving her the witch's power to refine poison at will and coat her weapons with it. Lee Mayfeng's street name is "White Snake". Due to trouble with Annerose in the past, they are bitter enemies.

characters.name: Mitico Fleuretty
characters.description: She is Annerose's maid.

characters.name: Aishwarya Ray
characters.original: アイシュワリヤ レイ
characters.description: A sorceress that is the de facto ruler of Amidahara. She controls the "Crimson Tower", a casino-like establishment where the citizens of Amidahara engage in gambling and perverted activities, some of which Aishwarya herself takes part in. She is given the nickname of the "Crimson Queen". Aishwarya is a long time friend of Annerose and an occasional client.

title: Toshoshitsu no Kanojo: Seiso na Kimi ga Ochiru made THE ANIMATION
title_original: 図書室ノ彼女~清楚ナ君ガ堕チルマデ~ THE ANIMATION
title_en: The Girl in the Library ～Fall of Purity～ THE ANIMATION
description: Yukiha Serizawa is a newly minted high school girl, who enjoys working as a library assistant with Aida, a boy she likes. But things are about to change for her... One day the school janitor asks to see Yukiha, to thank her for helping him the previous day. She trustingly goes along with him. The next thing the pure Yukiha notices is that she's been given a drug that made her pass out, and the janitor had his way with her. She wakes up in the middle, and finds she loves the rough sex she's experiencing. Although she wanted to save her virginity for Aida, she finds she can't resist the allure of sex. (Source: J-List)

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica: prima aurora
title_original: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora

characters.name: Sakiko Togawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Sakiko is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School. She is a refined person who comes from a rich family, and used to attend Tsukinomori Girls' Academy. She often plays the piano in the school's music room. Sakiko is currently the producer, composer, and keyboardist of the band Ave Mujica. She used to be a member of CRYCHIC.

characters.name: Uika Misumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") In addition to being the guitarist, Uika is also in charge of composing and writing lyrics for sumimi's songs. She is quite popular due to her cool appearance. She loves stargazing. ~!Born as Hatsune Misumi, she is the illegitimate child of [Sadaharu Togawa](https://anilist.co/character/352933/Togawa-Sadaharu) and one of the Togawa family housekeepers. She was raised on an island by her biological mother and foster father, alongside her half-sister Uika. Upon arriving in Tokyo, she was scouted and debuted as an idol using her sister's name.!~

characters.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first-year high school student. Mutsumi used to be a member of the band CRYCHIC, where she was in charge of the guitar. She is very stoic and a taciturn. Her father is a famous comedian called Wakaba, and her mother is Mori Minami, an actress. One of her hobbies is ballet.

characters.name: Umiri Yahata
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Umiri is one of Taki's classmates. She is somewhat playful as she enjoys teasing Taki. Umiri is an exceptionally proficient bassist who has played as a support artist for over 30 different bands.

characters.name: Nyamu Yuutenji
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") Nyamu is a popular beauty influencer and the drummer of Ave Mujica.

title: Kiddy GiRL-AND
description: Twenty-five years after Éclair and Lumière, (from the flagship Kiddy Grade series), rescued the galaxy from destruction's doorstep, the GTO (Galactic Trade Organization), created after the defeat of the GOTT (Galactic Organization of Trade and Tariffs), act on behalf of universal peace by combating criminal activity. Their special ES division mirrored after the GOTT's ES (Encounter of Shadow-work) force, now includes publicly acknowledged ES member candidates. The series follows two such trainees, Ascoeur and Q-feuille, as they work their way to ES membership. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Q-feuille
characters.description: She has qualities reminiscent of Lumière: her intelligence and serious nature, in addition to a heightened sensitivity to embarrassment. She also is an anime otaku, particularly of a Cardcaptor Sakura parody show, Card Getter Sakura. Like Ascoeur, she is an ES member candidate, but currently works as a waitress for the Touch & Go! cafe. Her special ability, "Parfum," is foresight, but is seldom used as it seems to be weak. However, with Di-air's kiss she is able to predict actions with precision. She has inherited Troisienne's ability to stop time. Though she should be sixteen-years-old, she reveals to Di-air that she is seven-years-old. Her name is from the French "Quatre Feuille" or "Four leaf", as in clover.

characters.name: Ascoeur
characters.description: Relative to the series' predecessor Kiddy Grade, she retains elements of Éclair's personality: her recklessness and simple nature, in addition to being spastic and childish. While she and Q-feuille are ES member candidates, they are currently waitresses for the Touch &amp; Go! cafe within the GTO headquarters. She is also known to have a strong love for pumpkin pudding, to the point she would break into the GTO to get some. Her special ability, "Push-Pull," is teleportation. She has inherited Trixie's ability to bend space. While powered-up by Di-air's kiss she is able to teleport further, faster and while carrying multiple bodies. Her name is French for "have heart." ~!It is later revealed that her real name is Lieselotte and that Geacht'er is her biological brother, as they share the same rose birthmark.!~

characters.name: Di-air
characters.description: An ES member candidate, apprenticing under Ascoeur and Q-feuille. Her past is shrouded in a mystery even she does not know, but is implied it was a life of perpetual darkness. Although her hair seems adorned by red hair clips, she can twitch them at will like ears. Her special ability is called "A-quare" which allows her to increase the magnitude of other people's abilities, through a lips-to-lips kiss.

characters.name: Éclair
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm __Rank:__ GOTT ES Member, C-Class (Actually is G-Class) __Partner:__ Lumière __Abilities:__ Power Éclair works for the Galactic Organization of Trade and Tariffs, or GOTT for short. While her primary job is to be a receptionist her job also incorporates being sent on missions as an ES member of the so-called "Shadow Unit" in order to ensure normal economic operation on the various planets around the Galaxy. She does this with the assistance of her younger partner and fellow receptionist Lumière, her Guard robot Donnerschlag and the space-ship La Muse. Known for her childish nature, she often dresses up in either a skimpy or amusing, but loosely related to the situation, costume. She has a tendency to shout "Ta-da!" (じゃっじゃ～ん！) whenever she arrives on the scene to arrest someone. Her rash nature also often makes her overreact to situations, despite this, she is naturally

characters.name: Lumière
characters.description: __Rank:__ GOTT ES Member, C-Class (Actually is G-Class)(physical) __Partner:__ Éclair __Abilities:__ Puppet (and later, Particle) Lumière is one of the two main characters of the 2002 anime series Kiddy Grade. Lumière is a GOTT receptionist and ES member like her partner Éclair. Lumière has little to no physical abilities. She instead makes up for this with her adept, controlled mind, her wit and her ability to control any computer unit. Even though she is younger than Éclair she is far more mature, from the way she dresses, from her politeness, to her tastes (she likes the opera and fine wine). She is always trying to convince Éclair to be more lady-like through her catch-phrase, "A Lady should really be more elegant." Lumiere also possesses a friendship with the AI unit of the La Muse, Wirbelwind, which she created. Her computer abilities do not manifest in the typing sense, as long as

characters.name: Tweedledee
characters.description: Rank: GOTT ES Member, S-Class Partner: Tweedledum Abilities: Strom (her own), and Windstoß (combined with Tweedledum) Tweedledee, who is both the sister and partner of Tweedledum, has a commanding presence and values loyalty above all else. She is an "S Class" ES Member rivaling Alv and Dvergr. Tweedledee has the ability to control electricity and can create an effect similar to Lumiere's Puppet. She often scolds her brother for calling her "sister" while on duty. Tweedledee also has a strong sense of pride. While she doesn't agree with Eclipse's secretive nature towards the ES Members, she still trusts her. She also seems to have a deep bond with Lumiere, probably because of their similar abilities. Tweedledee's name comes from the character in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland.

characters.name: Tweedledum
characters.description: Tweedledum, who is both the brother and partner of Tweedledee, is fiercely loyal to his sister. However, he isn't really sociable with anyone else other than Tweedledee. Although he doesn't mean to offend, Tweedledum doesn't really show interest in anyone else other than his sister. Tweedledum has the ability to control the magnetic fields around him, combining with Tweedledee to create a powerful gravitational force. Because of their extremely strong bond, Tweedledum seems jealous when his sister shows interest in Lumiere. Tweedledum's name comes from the character in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland. Rank: GOTT ES Member, S-Class Partner: Tweedledee Abilities: Magnetfeld (his own), and Windstoß (combined with Tweedledee)

characters.name: Un-ou
characters.description: Un-ou (Japanese/Sanskrit, 吽王, one of the two Buddhist Deva Kings) - GOTT ES Member (S Class), apparent age 14, partner to A-ou. Special ability: "Amazing". A mostly cynical and impulsive person, Un-ou enjoys the danger that comes with his job. He and A-ou were formerly mercenaries who were constantly at odds with Eclair and Lumiere. Hardened by his past as a mercenary, Un-ou doesn't seem to agree with the values held by the GOTT, but merely as an outlet from their past rivalries with Eclair and Lumiere. His relationship with Eclair is especially competitive. Un-ou's "Amazing" ability allows him to listen to the various life energies which allow them to track down their enemies. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: A-ou
characters.description: A-ou (Japanese/Sanskrit, 阿王, one of the two Buddhist Deva Kings) - GOTT ES Member (S Class), apparent age 19, partner to Un-ou. Special ability: "Amplifier". The older and more stoic member of the Duo, A-ou (unlike his partner) has a stronger sense of honor and justice. He is also more of a pacifist and he often speaks in a profound and meaningful manner, giving him a rather preachy presence among other people. He and Un-ou have had a long and eventful past together during their days as mercenaries. However, despite their differences, the two have forged a strong bond as a team. "Amplifier" gives him the ability to improve his visual perception tenfold. He also uses the energy seen by Un-ou to increase the power of his physical attacks. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Belle
characters.description: One of the GTO receptionists, and frequent customer of "Touch & Go!" Belle often speaks common sense when things get out of hand.

characters.name: Alisa
characters.description: One of the GTO receptionists, and frequent customer of "Touch & Go!" Alisa has quite a lively spirit and is a keen follower of dramas.

characters.name: Hiver
characters.description: The current Bureau Chief of the GTO (her name is French for "winter"). Hiver is the reincarnation of Pfeilspitze (Mercredi). She has shown the ability to travel through a dimensional door, which explains how she always seems to appear out of nowhere.

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear AXZ: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギアAXZ 戦姫絶唱しないシンフォギア
description: Original short episodes featuring characters in super-deformed style. Bundled with Blu-ray/DVD volumes 3 to 6 of the anime.

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve
characters.original: マリア・カデンツァヴナ・イブ
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Black Gungnir ~!__Symphogear post G:__ Airgetlám!~ An energetic singer who reached the top of the American music charts about 2 months after her debut. Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Sakuya Fujitaka
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.name: Aoi Tomosato
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.name: Yumi Itaba
characters.description: During most of her appearances throughout the series, she is mostly seen referring to anime, using phrases like, "What is this—an anime?"

characters.name: Elfnein
characters.description: A girl from the world of alchemy who bears a resemblance to Carol. She comes before the other Symphogear users to provide them with a means of combating the Alca-Noise. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: 3Ping Lovers!☆Ippu Nisai no Sekai e Youkoso♪ THE ANIMATION
title_original: 3PingLovers!☆一夫二妻の世界へようこそ♪ THE ANIMATION
description: Based on the erotic game by Hadashi Shoujo. An Otaku stuck in the world of RPG Eroge game, when being attacked by a monster he was suddenly saved by the Heroine he had. From that moment they embark on the adventure and enjoyment of the harem sex. (Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated)

characters.original: レイチェル・ハーフリング

characters.name: Kachua Haalfling
characters.original: カチュア・ハーフリング

title: Muchi♥Muchi Kyousei Seichouchuu!!!
title_original: むち♥無知ッ強制成長中っ!!!
description: Based on the CG set/voiced game by Maron☆Maron (まろん☆まろん). The protagonist is a teacher in a small garden. One day girls in the garden who ate cookies that induce a rapid physical development become grown-up. They behave just as their usual days despite the voluptuous bodies... Receiving lots of their unintentional temptations, his patience is about to run out... (Source: DLsite English)

characters.name: Cocoa
characters.description: She is a spoiled angelic child. She wants to be an Idol.

title: Android wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka??: 5-kakan Tsuzukete......?
title_original: アンドロイドは経験人数に入りますか？？ 5日間続けて……？
title_en: Does it Count if You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?: Five Days Running...?
description: Akane manages to take five days of paid leave, partly due to her recent health issues. Still, since she usually works nonstop and struggles to find meaningful ways to spend her time, Nadeshiko surprisingly proposes a five-day slow erotic session! Akane is shocked by the offer, but considering her gratitude toward Nadeshiko, she steels herself and accepts. An intense five days begins... or so it seems... He was not very masculine in either his appearance or his actions, and so as a child he would get teased for being so feminine. In addition, several flashbacks have been featured in both the manga and anime featuring Hazumu dressed like a girl at a young age. Whether he wanted to do this of his own accord or his mother just dressed him up is never specified but regardless he didn't seem to be bothered by it; indeed he was shown to enjoy it. Once in high school, he confesses his love to Yasuna one day, but is rejected. Afterwards, he climbs the nearby Mt. Kashima to clear his feelings. He is fatally injured by an alien spacecraft crash-landing on the mountain. In an attempt to rectify the accident, the alien pilot revives H

characters.name: Yasuna Kamiizumi
characters.description: Yasuna tends to be a quiet and often lonely girl compared to the rest of her friends. Since her parents are rarely around due to being overworked, she seems to depend on her close friends for love and support, especially when it comes to Hazumu, who unfortunately doesn't tend to show her the type of affection Yasuna desires from her. Yasuna and Hazumu first met as classmates, though they rarely ever talked with each other, which means that Hazumu was simply admiring Yasuna from afar. One day when on Mt. It was also at this point where she pointed out how feminine Hazumu appeared, which is also the main reason she could see most of his figure minus his face, which as a male was always shown with his hair covering it. In direct contrast to Hazumu, her most obvious quality is that she is a tomboy which is shown through her actions and lack of interest in traditionally feminine things such as clothing or shopping. Indeed, Tomari's friends of both genders consider her very masculine which often causes Tomari to get angry at such comments. Additionally, she is a member of the Track and Field Club and enjoys physical activities. Before Hazumu's change, she shows some latent interest in Hazumu and is at first just as shocked as everyone else when he is transformed into a girl. characters.description: Ayuki is Tomari's best female friend, who, much like Yasuna, is quiet and reserved, though seems to be more social than Yasuna. Indeed, she serves to act as the voice of reason between the interactions of the other characters. Additionally, Ayuki seems to have an interest in observing the people around her and she enjoys learning about the sciences, though most specifically, biological sciences. It is suggested indirectly that Ayuki is also interested in Hazumu, and later in the anime, she also seems to be interested in Tomari. However, she says that she prefers not to get involved with the developing love triangle and simply observes from the sidelines.

characters.name: Asuta Soro
characters.description: Asuta is Hazumu's best male buddy before and after the UFO crash, though his opinion of Hazumu changes somewhat due to his taking interest in Hazumu's new female form and feminine personality. Asuta is a good deal more manly than Hazumu ever was, and was trying to find Hazumu to give him some adult magazines (which Hazumu hates) on the night of the Mt. Asuta has found himself more and more attracted to Hazumu after the transformation, leaving Hazumu completely oblivious of this fact. Eventually, Asuta resolves to simply being Hazumu's best male friend and sees that her main interest is indeed with Yasuna.

Also, she is extremely clumsy which gives rise to her being the butt of many jokes.

characters.name: Hitoshi Sora
characters.description: Hitoshi Sora is a cultural anthropologist and space alien. His research brought him to visit Earth, and he is currently in disguise as the biology teacher at Hazumu's high school. His unfamiliarity with human ways provides the series with an outside perspective on love - the focus of Sora's research. Additionally, his views on other subjects, such as friendly competition or war, provide a somewhat existentialist point of view. The alien's research, explained in the manga, is of great importance to the survival of his species as he fears that if his currently rather unemotional people do not rediscover passions like love, they may all eventually die out.

When mysterious forces try to steal Densuke, Hibari discovers that Densuke is not just an ordinary patapi. Densuke has magical powers that allows it to transform into a powerful cyber-fighter who looks like Hibari. Hibari's friends also receive similar patapis, and together they form the Cyber Team in Akihabara. (Source: AnimeNfo)

Mikaze is a troubled girl that is a trainee pilot for a Meteor Sweeper team that dreams of becoming a prestigious Comet Blaster pilot. She always seems to be around whenever Mirai and Riko use magic making her wonder if witches exist. Every time she says she sees a "witch", everyone tells her she is seeing things. She has a habit of saying "maru" (meaning 'circle', the kind used to mark tests) when she finishes helping someone. She soon discovers she has the ability to pilot a strange robotic aircraft known as the Vox Aura, which she previously encountered ten years ago when she almost drowned. She names this Vox unit Midori, after its green color.

She was initially unable to properly utilize her Vox unit as the knowledge of a supposed fate concerning Vox pilots caused her to become afraid. However, Madoka helps her overcome her fear and she becomes able to use her Vox unit, Vox Rympha, which she names Orca. She is jealous of Muginami, who shows a lot of interest in Madoka, which leads to her to join the Jersey Club and begin living with Madoka. characters.original: ソフィロ・カリア・ロス・イゾ

Despite being relieved from his duty, he has continued wearing the outfit because he doesn't have a change of clothes. However, Astelia has given him a credit card so he is not short on money, which caused Izo and Kirius to question why he hasn't bought new clothes with it. He applies to work at BWH with Izo and Kirius at the end of the first season.

characters.description: Madoka's cousin, though Madoka refers to Youko as her sister. She is a marine archaeologist researching the Vox. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. title: Tsumamigui 3 THE ANIMATION
description: Based on the erotic game by Alice Soft. Akito Natsuki decides to spend his one month long summer holiday in his hometown after his workplace closes down for renovations. With no money and nothing to do he decides to take it easy. At home Miyuri, his sister-in-law he was once fond of, and Sayoko who always treated him like her own son, were waiting for him. Akito tried to hide his feelings as always and acted out the part of the brother-in-law, but after a slip of the tongue his real feelings are revealed. Then his stagnant relationships with Miyuki and Sayoko start to develop again, and eventually he gets deeply involved with them. (Source: Getchu, English)

characters.name: Akito Natsuki
characters.description: A normal company employee. Bachelor, and has no girlfriend. As he lost both parents, his only family left is his older brother. For himself, he can't do anything seriously, but for others, he'll give his all. An extremely softhearted person. After his brother married Miyuri, the woman he loves, he quit university and left his hometown. He works with undivided attention to try and forget Miyuri, but even until now he still has lingering affection towards her.

characters.description: The priestess of the temple near Akito's home and the mother of Ai. She's an enchanting cool beauty who has a gaze which seems to see through everything, as well as a pair of bountiful breasts. A kind, doting parent who always prioritizes her daughter over anything else. She shows no mercy to any man who tries to come close to her daughter. Akito, the only person who Ai likes aside from her mother, is treated a little harshly by Sumire. She needs to give birth to a man who can succeed the temple. However, her husband left the house and his whereabouts are currently unknown. Considering her age, conception is difficult and may soon become impossible, so her back is currently pressed against the wall.

She used to play with Akito when she was young, but after she went to school and lived in the dorm, they haven't met even once. She hates her father who left her and Sumire alone.

She dotes on Akito so much, and was excited with their life as a family of three after her marriage with Kazuto, but she was saddened because it became a dream which can never be realized.

Their relationship changes after an argument in which Yuuto complains that Erika is too absorbed in her studies and no good at household chores. She ends up offering to help him in another way by giving him sexual favors which he readily accepts. They attempt to keep to their relationship a secret, but others notice the change in the siblings. Among them is Yuhi, a fellow female classmate, who is romantically interested in Erika.

She wants to win the title of Cosmo Beauty - a title held years ago by her mother. It's not an easy task for her as fear, doubt and peer pressure get in her way, but friends, rivals and fans slowly encourage her to overcome her obstacles and become the best of the Battle Athletes. characters.name: Akari Kanzaki
characters.description: Akari is the very protagonist of this series. Tomoe Midou's daughter, holder of many unbeaten record and seen as a symbol for the athletes living in the satellite-university, she fights every day with the promise made to the mother to be able to reach herself the satellite and becoming Cosmo Beauty, one day. Akari is of weak nature, always ready to cry and surrender, although this part of her personality will evolve mainly in the last episodes of the series.

Born and grown up in an American ghetto, she had to take care alone of her little brother, seeing as both their parents were dead. Since then, a black priest of a local church took care of her, and he nurtured her running skills, that she had always used to run from her chasers after the stealing she did for surviving. Thanks to that priest and a meeting with Tome Midou, Jessie starts dedicating herself to athletics, with the intent to becoming Cosmo Beauty. Such community lives in a profound symbiosis with nature, and refuses every kind of technology, preferring to live in harmony in an environment unpolluted. Kris, especially, belongs to a family of priests, able to feel spirits and talk with them. On the satellite-university, Kris shares her room with Akari and Anna, as well as Gyubei, her cow brought from the moon and whose milk Kris believes she can't survive. characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's normal division. She's good at making friends, and her goal is to make a million of them. Lively and positive, Aine has a kind heart that takes into account other people's feelings. She is from a large family, and they own the "Penguin Cafe" supported by their neighbors. Aine herself enjoys helping around the house. While a very ordinary girl, her encounter with Mio triggers an interest in idol activities. She serves as the muse of her own brand, Sugar Melody.

characters.name: Mio Minato
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. She is active as a popular idol and is the featured model for "Aikatsu! Style Times". Mio has excellent fashion sense, and demonstrates her talents by serving as both the designer and muse of her own brand, Material Color. While Mio is smart, earns good grades and is able to do anything, she has always felt that she's missing something. However, her encounter with Aine seems to spark something inside of her, leading Mio to invite Aine into the world of Aikatsu! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Alicia Charlotte

characters.description: Alicia has fair skin and sharp, steel blue eyes. She has short, fluffy milk blue hair that loosely frames her face with a curled strand on each side and a braid of hair tied at the side of her neck, one worn over the shoulder. She has two, thin, knee-length segments of hair that loosely flow, and her bangs curve inward, overlapping each other. She is the princess of the Sorbet Kingdom, and part of I Believe along with Hibiki Tenshou (source: Aikatsu Friends wikia)

characters.name: Maika Chouno
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. A cool and mysterious girl who looks dignified and mature. Maika has loved festivals from a young age, and is the type of girl whose blood boils when it comes to competitions. She passionately supports local soccer teams on a daily basis. With her agile dancing as her weapon, Maika has good reflexes and is good at taking action, but while reliable, she's also afraid of ghosts.

The population decreased to the lowest number ever seen...until only the women were left alive. They live huddled in small corners of a world mostly reclaimed by nature. There are those who accept their inevitable extinction and live a carefree life... There are those who try to continue on the race with the help of science... It is a society of constant conflict over their differences of principles and policies. The story takes place in the center of Tokyo. It is one of the places left for them. The conflict over the specimen of "ICE" and the chance it may provide to save humanity begins. (Source: AnimeNfo)

When she met the captain of the Guardswomen, she immediately wanted to be friends with her, as she saw this as a change of fate.

characters.description: As head of the Kisaragi Family and the spiritual leader of the Black Roses, Kisaragi believes that both science and foolish men (now extinct) have directly caused the downfall of the human species. Furthermore, if the world is on a course for ruin, the remaining women should simply let extinction run its course rather than look for hope in the science that caused those problems--instead electing to enjoy what remaining life they have. Kisaragi herself is a product of a genetic experiment, and is half human and half jellyfish. She has pale skin, long white hair, and gills down the sides of her body.

She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. characters.name: Sei Satou

She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Morimoto Leona and Otokawa Saori are newly arrived boarding students at St. Alcadia Academy. Morimoto Leona desires to subjugate every person within the school, severely punishing those who are of no use to her. Even the teachers are not spared. Fellow boarders Yuuki, Ruri and Maiko, who are oblivious of the situation, fall prey to the limitless sexual desires of the male students.

characters.name: Saori Otokawa
characters.description: A classmate of Takuro's, she's the first person he meets when arriving at his new home. In the original game she is just an ordinary student living in the same dormitory as Takuro (though she performs all of the household chores willingly). The anime series makes her the caretaker of the facility as well. Another change between game and anime series is the afterschool club she's a member of. In the game she is in a Biblical Studies group, whereas in the anime series she is a member of the Paranormal Research Club. She is a kind person by nature, but has a strong will when required. She also has feelings towards Takuro, but has a hard time expressing them. Unlike most of the women that Takuro has met, she is not out to exploit him. Her closeness to Takuro makes her a target in Leona Morimoto's schemes.

characters.description: The Head of the Social Club who is highly respected and feared. With the fact that most students are in debt to the Morimoto Financial Group and her sister is the headmistress, she practically controls the school and will do whatever it takes to get what she wants. When Takuro arrives at St. Arcadia, she goes to great lengths to make him a member of the Social Club and to make him her personal sex slave.
