characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") Setsuna Yuki is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was the leader and founder of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her color is scarlet red. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that she read. Setsuna is passionate and headstrong, but kind and mature. She has a habit of taking on too much work and not wanting to burden friends with her problems. Setsuna has an unwavering passion for school idols and her raw emotion combined with a powerful voice is her charm point. She is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School.

She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Shioriko Mifune
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Shioriko Mifune is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is jade. Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. Although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko often yearns to connect with others, deep down.

characters.name: Mia Taylor
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Mia Taylor is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is third year student and her image color is platinum silver. She recently transferred from New York and is fluent in both English and Japanese. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old.

As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. title: Koutetsu Tenshi Kurumi 2-shiki
description: Taking place 75 years after the first series, Steel Angel Kurumi 2 brings the Steel Angels in a new mis-adventure. High school student and aspiring cellist Nako Kagura accidentally discovers and kisses Kurumi Mk. II at her home, thus making her Kurumi's master. But things go awry as Nako's best friend Uruka gets jealous and tries anything - including her father's army of top-secret mecha - to destroy Kurumi and win back Nako. Things get more out of control when Saki Mk. II is awakened by Uruka, and Karinka Mk. II joins in to steal Nako away from Kurumi. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nako Kagura
characters.description: Great granddaughter of either Nakahito or Kamihito, Nako is a soft-spoken, shy, and clumsy 9th grade student at an all-girls school. She lives at the old Kagura shrine with her mother, Misaki (which proves even further that dark blue hair just runs in the family), and lives next door to her very rich neighbor and best friend, Uruka. Nako is also a very skilled cellist, and may prove to one day be famous. The day she found Kurumi was the day she gave her first kiss(es), and from then on was blessed (or cursed) with being the new master of Steel Angel Kurumi. Now being the receiver of the same affection that was given to her great ancestor Nakahito, Nako is constantly chased and protected by Kurumi. -Wikipedia

characters.name: Uruka Sumeragi
characters.description: Best friend of Nako until Kurumi came along. Uruka is in love with Nako, and had originally hoped to be the one to take Nako's first kiss. On the day that Kurumi appeared, she was the first witness to see the fateful kiss, to which she could not get over for an entire day. Uruka now sees Kurumi as an obstacle to Nako and will try anything to remove Kurumi, even if it means asking her father to call upon the family's private army to take her down. When they find that Saki is a Steel Angel, the family army decides to use her as a weapon against Kurumi, the "source of Uruka-chan's unhappiness." On the day that Saki was to be awakened, Uruka was there to supervise the process, but got involved in a fantasy of her own, involving Nako, and ended up kissing Saki. Saki then falls in love with her new master, and Uruka wants nothing to do with her. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Issho ni H Shiyo
description: Episode 1 The energetic Miyazawa Akina is a member of a softball team. She becomes drunk during the post-game celebrations, hops onto a train, and arrives at the house of her childhood friend. Episode 2 Takai Haruka is an obedient girl whose long hair really suits her. Today is the first day that she is visiting the house of her boyfriend, a senior at school. Episode 3 Tsuji Suzuran, from the Worldwide Maid Organization, completely messed up her assigned household chores. To compensate, she uses her body to satisfy her employer. Episode 4 One night, the protaganist's sister-in-law, Hamada Yui, returns home bringing along her friend Fukunaga Aoi. The two are drunk and create such a fuss that the protaganist is unable to study. He goes to complain to them, but they have other plans... Episode 5 Yuuki decides to pay a visit to her step brother. He left home five years ago and hasn't been in contact with the family since then. Yuuki is worried that maybe some woman has been deceiving him, or worse! Episode 6 You dream of being a farmer. So maybe your cousin on the farm can help.

title: PriPara 2nd Season
description: In season two of PriPara the story continues with Laala and her friends Mirei and Sophy, who are part of the "SoLaMi♡SMILE" PriPara idol unit, which is rising in popularity. In the PriPara amusement park, a new zone called "Dream Theater" has opened, and it's said that when a fateful five-man team filled with charm that performs there, a new event called the "PriPara Dream Parade" will be held. However, it is not known which five people make up this team, and the PriPara idols scramble give the greatest performance in the new zone. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Laala Manaka
characters.description: Laala has a bright and cheerful personality, and is often seen bouncing off the walls. As her house is a restaurant, she has a habit of saying her informal catchphrase Capisce! (Kashikoma!) when taking requests. Laala has a very loud speaking voice which she is very conscious about; when she is singing, she tends to be very quiet due to this. It seems that she can only gain the courage to sing loudly when performing in PriPara.

characters.name: Mirei Minami
characters.description: Mirei Minami is a 7th grader at Paprika Academy. When performing, Mirei has lemon yellow hair that is partly tied up to two buns at the top with blue and yellow ribbons. Normally she has short lemon yellow hair that looks the same as her performance hair minus the buns and ribbons. She has bright blue eyes. She also tends to say "pri" at the end of her sentences. She is smart and very good at puzzles. Because of this, she is captain of the displicinary committee at school.

characters.name: Sophy Hojo
characters.description: Sophy has apparently been working in the idol industry since she was very young. She is also very popular at her school, and admired by many of the students. When she eats a Red Flash (pickled plum), her personality - likewise with her appearance - changes. Her public personality is cool and on top of things, while her other personality (aka 'Fancy Mode') is extremely disoriented and directionless. It is also hinted that she has low blood pressure. While she is in her Fancy Mode, she says "Pshu~" a lot. In Fancy Mode, she is quite naive and oblivious to what's around her, but since forming her friendship with Laala and Mirei, she has been working on improving herself.

characters.name: Sion Toudou
characters.description: Sion Toudou is a 6th grader at Paprika Private Academy. She is the only known 6th grader in the series. She is an idol at PriPara, and is also a Cool type idol. She is voiced by Saki Yamakita, a member of i☆Ris. Her preferred brand is Baby Monster. She is the last of the main six girls to debut, as Dorothy and Reona made cameo debuts in Episode 11 and Episode 12, respectively. Her name (Sion) is based on seventh note of the Solfège scale. Sion is really good at a game called Go. When thinking that other things as Go, she succeeds the task she needs to do. She is calm and reassuring on the surface, but her roots have a hot personality. She is currently in the unit Dressing Pafé, with Dorothy West and Reona West. (Source: PriPara Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Dorothy West
characters.description: Dorothy is the older twin sister of Reona West and is of Canadian (her father) and Japanese (her mother) heritage. She sometimes mixes English with Japanese when speaking. Her preferred brand is Fortune Party.

characters.name: Reona West
characters.description: Reona is the younger twin of Dorothy West and is of Canadian (father) and Japanese (mother) descent. Reona is quite shy and would wither away if not for Dorothy. Often Reona follows whatever Dorothy does as an example, such as pretending to faint if she would or dislike someone if she does. This changes as the season continues and Reona starts to gain more confidence to do more without Dorothy and also becoming slightly more outgoing. Reona is relaxed and can easily calm others, most notably young children. This is emphasized by the catchphrase "(Tension) relax!". Reona is also shown to be quite feminine. (Source: Pripara Wiki)

characters.name: Falulu
characters.description: Falulu is a mysterious vocal doll who appears in episode 1 and later makes her debut as an idol in episode 17. At the beginning of the series, she is very naive and doesn't know a lot of words so she tends to repeat the words and actions of others (even copies Laala's and Mirei's catchphrases and actions). Her voice sounds slightly robotic, and she tends to call certain things (like the Prism Voice and Laala) sparkling. Despite not knowing what emotions are, she still expresses anger, fear and happiness. She is also very smart, being able to solve long equation problems within seconds. Episode 37 spoilers ~!After her re-awakening in Episode 37, Falulu's personality becomes much more human-like and vivacious and her speaking voice, as well as her singing voice, loses its robotic quality. She also became more responsible and worrisome since she now has 100 little sisters to watch over.!~

characters.name: Aroma Kurosu
characters.description: Aroma is a Cool Type Idol whose brand is LOVE DEVI (previously Holic Trick Classic). Aroma is a troubling girl who acts like a devil. She is also portrayed as an evil person who will do anything to achieve her goals, including petty tricks and sabotage if it suits the situation. She is portrayed as blunt and somewhat cruel, but she also cares for Mikan very much and values her friendship, even when she doesn't act like it. This stems from the fact that they have been together since they were really little and Mikan's presence is part of the reason why Aroma is the way she is today. It was later revealed that Aroma acts this way to overcome her original personality - that of a shy and quiet young girl. By acting like a devil, she has been able to become more confident. However she is prone to breaking out of character, in which she abandons her archaic manner of speaking and speaks normal

characters.name: Mikan Shiratama
characters.description: Mikan Shiratama is a character who debuts in the second season of PriPara. She makes her anime debut in Episode 39. Her preferred brand is Silky Heart, and she is a Lovely Type Idol. Mikan is a happy-go-lucky girl with a cheerful personality, who acts like an angel. Even though at first it doesn't seem like it since all she does is follow Aroma around, she has a strong and close bond with her. (Source: PriPara Wikia)

characters.name: Gaaruru
characters.description: Gaaruru is a Vocal Doll and Mini-Falulu that represents the negative feelings of girls who believe they can't become idols. Gaaruru can be considered a little terror when she first debuts. She's mischievous and a troublemaker and causes many problems for those around her. She's very disobedient and is unwilling to listen as shown with her growling towards and her biting those around her when they try to talk to her. Gaaruru also appears to not be fond of others and would always be by herself according to Falulu. She also doesn't appear to like idols as well as dancing and singing. ~!Later, after eating one of Sophy's pickled plums, it's revealed that Gaaruru had swallowed a "Spiny Bug" which turned out to be the source of her bad behavior. She then became a lot nicer and felt bad for the way she acted towards everyone and later stated that she was jealous because she couldn't sing and da

characters.name: Fuwari Midorikaze
characters.description: Fuwari is a character who debuts in the second season of PriPara. Her preferred brand is CoCo Flower. True to her name, Fuwari is gentle and soft. She is free-spirited and isn't afraid to go about things her own way which tends to cause trouble for others. She's a friendly person and seeks to befriend everyone. She can also be seen with sheep and goats, and in fact has one that is with her very often. (Source: PriPara Wikia)

characters.name: Hibiki Shikyouin
characters.description: A first-year high school student and the grandchild of one of Paprika Private Academy's chairman investors. Their alter ego in PriPara is the Kaitou Genius, who makes their first appearance in Episode 57 stealing Dressing Flower's PriTickets. Their preferred brand is Brilliant Prince. Hibiki is fixated on finding the "Best Princess" for reasons that are currently unknown. They believe that not everyone can be an idol, which, given the nature of series, makes them appear nihilistic and cynical. Because many of their motives are shrouded in mystery, this, combined with their cunning and manipulative personality gives them an overall shady character. Hibiki hates sentence-enders, and whenever they hear one, they freak out. (Source: PriPara Wikia)

title: Ane☆Haramix
description: Since the early death of his parents, Takami Akitoshi has lived alone with his beautiful elder sister, Hitomi, while concealing his dirty desires for her. One day, a mysterious girl named Mina enters his room. She introduces herself as Death and explains that she came to take his soul because he had reached the end of his lifespan. Hearing his screams, Hitomi runs in and, after the situation is explained to her, asks Mina to spare him. Mina, moved by her earnestness, tells them that if Takami fathers a child within a week, she will let him live another 10 years. Hearing her condition, he turns his face to Hitomi… (Source: AnimeNfo)

characters.name: Hitomi Takami
characters.description: Akitoshi's older sister who took care of him since their parents died. ~!After Mina comes for Akitoshi's life, she reluctantly (at first) chooses to become pregnant with his child to extend his life. Soon she starts to see Akitoshi as more than a brother and has sex with him more frequently.!~

characters.name: Mina
characters.description: Mina is the personafication of Death who has come for Akitoshi's soul since he has reached the end of his life. However she will give him an extension of ten years if he fathers a child within a week. ~! Despite having come purely for his soul, she soon develops feelings for Akitoshi and makes love to him, but is soon caught by Hitomi. However, they soon have a threeway together, both getting pregnant with Akitoshi's children. !~

While there he peeks at her sketchbook and discovers that she likes to draw yaoi manga, but some parts are off due to her inexperience with boys. Jokingly, he offers to show her what she has not seen, and one thing leads to another... Things get complicated when Shinobu Fukuhara, the class president and Igawa's childhood friend, gets involved because she likes him. And later even their teacher Susie Fujikawa joins the fun...

He is a reclusive boy from an otaku subculture who's always stammering while speaking with others. Takuji rarely attends class as he spends most of his time secluded in his secret hideout that he had constructed under the school’s old drained swimming pool. ~!The original Mamiya Takuji died as a child during an incident in which he attempted to kill his younger sister, Hasaki, due to brainwashing by his mother. On the verge of death, Takuji (seemingly) uses the last of his remaining strength to take over the body of Mamiya Tomosane, his elder brother. Tomosane's personality would then disappear entirely for the next 6 years, only to resurface as Yuuki Tomosane after. At the end of the story in Jaberwocky II, Tomosane regains control over the body, erasing Mamiya Takuji forever.!~

characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Yuki's schoolmate from a neighbouring class, Zakuro, is the protagonist of the "Looking-glass Insects" chapter. She has a tendency to get lost in her thoughts and frequently spaces out. Due to her timid and soft-spoken nature, she is often a target of tasteless pranks and bullying. She considers her classmate Kimika to be her only friend, though their relationship appears to be occasionally ambiguous. ~!After constant bullying, she is completely driven to the brink of insanity, coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of an angel warrior sent to save the world. Tsukikawa Usami and Mizuo Ayumi who've gone through similar experiences as her claim that to get their angel powers back, they must have a near-death experience. This leads to Zakuro committing suicide on July 12th which leads to Mamiya Takuji going insane and setting the events of the week leading up to

She speaks enigmatically, in riddles, and frequently makes literary references and strange jokes that others find more unsettling than amusing. Her conversations are often about "The End Sky" (終ノ空 - Tsui no Sora), a concept that only she herself seems to truly understand.

characters.name: Iroha Sakayori
characters.description: A 17-year-old high school girl. A model student who excelles in both academics and sports. She works hard to pay her living expenses and tutition fees. She's a fan of [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/378973/Runami-Yachiyo), Tsukuyomi's top livestreamer. She's also a talented musician, but doesn't compose anymore.

characters.name: Yachiyo Runami
characters.description: The top livestreamer of the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." A mysterious 8,000-year-old (allegedly) AI who can sing, dance, and even create clones.

Since it was almost 10 years ago, he finding that he is running into a lot of dead ends. Upon reporting to Kiyosato, he learns that Dr. Takao (the doctor who was operating on Shuji’s father when he died) is now the assistant director of the hospital. Also on the same day, he sees Misako, his girlfriend from the time that his father died. However, Shuji soon learns that Misako is now married to Dr. Takao under some suspicious circumstances. This leads Shuji to investigate Dr. Takao and take back Misako by what ever means are necessary . . .

Member of the Amber Project. Plunged into cryogenic sleep about fifty thousand years ago. Her goal after awakening in a new era is to guide people to the development of civilization and to help repel new attacks of the Honkai energy.

characters.name: Rita Rossweisse
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm The vice captain of "Immortal Blades" and the trusted adjutant of Durandal. Rita is one of the three S-rank valkyries in Schicksal. Diligent in her duties to be the ultimate maid, Rita will learn anything that might better fulfill her master's wishes from clearing enemies on the battlefield to playing video games.. Not much is known about Rita as she keeps her secrets hidden very well. Perhaps only Durandal and fellow valkyries of "Immortal Blades" would know anything about her.

characters.name: Seele Vollerei
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (before X-10) An orphaned girl who became Bronya's closest friend at Cocolia's orphanage. ~!Her alter ego, Hei Seele Vollerei (黑希儿·芙乐艾), has control of her True Stigmata's power. Hei Seele's personality is drastically different from Seele's and is initially ruthless and unkind, but this later on changes as she learns to care for Seele, and eventually even her friends. She has a violent reaction with people she sees as a threat to herself or Seele, and is particularly overprotective of her, showing worry any time she battles. She also has the habit of staring at Seele's face while she is sleeping. A lot of the time she is quite dishonest about her feelings, putting up a tough act rather than admitting she cares deep down. She is easily provoked and jealous, and quick to suggest more forceful means of action in most situations. She also dislikes being considered a monste

characters.name: Bianka Ataegina
characters.original: 比安卡・幽兰黛尔・阿塔吉娜
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Durandal is an enigmatic figure that rarely interacts with the other main characters. She is one of very few S-rank Valkyries within Schicksal. Her squad is known as the Immortal Blades and Rita Rossweisse is her vice captain. The two girls share a long history, but not much is known about it...

characters.name: Hei Seele Vollerei
characters.description: Hei Seele is a being awakened inside Seele Vollerei, originally referred to by the latter as "the other me". She originates from the stigma on Seele's chest, giving her greater control over the stigma's power. Hei Seele vowed to protect Seele, the meaning of her existence, from all harm that should come her way. Hei Seele acts violent, cruel, and even sadistic towards her enemies, but is straightforward in conveying her genuine feelings of goodwill to those she cares about. Still, she prefers fighting and violent solutions to solve problems, especially to protect Seele and her friends. A being born from the desire for protection, her identity revolves around being Seele's protector. However, this means that as Seele continues to grow more independent and mature, Hei Seele is starting feel anxious about being forgotten and left behind. ~!Eventually, Hei Seele and Seele are split apart, ga

characters.name: Mei Raiden
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'8") Raiden Mei is one of the main protagonists along with Kiana Kaslana, Bronya Zaychik, Theresa Apocalypse and Murata Himeko. She is the daughter of the Massive Electric Industries' CEO. When she was young, her father was arrested for fraud and most of her family assets were seized due to her father’s criminal activities, and was later captured to be part of a Honkai-related experiment. This event has caused her to be cold and distant towards others, though her friendship with Kiana has caused her to become more gentle and caring. ~!She also has a Ruler sealed within her, which was unleashed during the Choukuu City event, and later awakened as the 3rd Herrscher. After Kiana stopped her, she joined Schicksal shortly after learning on how to control her power.!~

characters.name: Kiana Kaslana
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") A Schicksal Valkyrie and a student at St. Freya's Academy. She is the 69th successor of the Kaslana family and daughter to Siegfried Kaslana and Cecilia Schariac. Her mother died when she was young and her father later abandoned her. She attended various schools before ending up in the same school as Mei and Bronya. She becomes a Valkyrie to find out what happened to her parents. Kiana also has rather open feelings for Mei, something that, among other things, sparks her rivalry with Bronya.

characters.name: Bronya Zaychik
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'10") Bronya is a high-performance cyborg without emotions, who was raised to be a deadly assassin and led to her being the infamous cold-blooded sniper, the Silver Wolf until she got knocked out by Cocolia and met [Seele Vollerei](https://anilist.co/character/142952/Vollerei-Seele) at an orphanage, in which unbeknownst to them, was actually the supply of experimentation subjects of a project called the X-10 Experiment. After losing Seele when she dissolved in a quantum state, Bronya entered St. Freya's Academy as a mole of Anti-Entropy with hopes of saving her former lover.

characters.name: Siegfried Kaslana
characters.description: Heir of the Kaslana family, Siegfried was a small child with big dreams. The only specific details about his childhood is that he enjoyed the TV show Arahato. Siegfried ran away from his home in Schicksal at 15 years old. He spent the next 4 years traveling around the world, saving people from Honkai and pretending to be a ninja.

characters.name: Rozaliya Olenyeva
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (no horns) She grew up in the same orphanage as Bronya and Seele, along with her sister, Liliya. Due to an accident, her body has been modified. Though she is often chided for being obnoxiously loud and rambunctious, many have noted that her mature side shines through when she looks after her sister.

title: Kawarazaki-ke no Ichizoku 2
description: Based on the erotic game by Elf. The continuation of the first OVAs, just with a little twists in the main story line, but it refains the same as the first one. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Kaisoku Tantei Miko
description: Jinguuji Miko and her male assistant Kanda Rokuro hunt phantoms together. The phantoms invade peoples bodies and control them. Trained as a skilled Phantom Hunter Miko must use exorcism to send the phantoms back to where ever they came from.

characters.name: Miko Jinguuji
characters.description: Trained in the Phantom exorcism arts, Miko opens up an exorcist agency to get clients that need help with their phantom problems. To her help she has an assistant Rokuro that she secretly have a crush on.

characters.name: Rokuro Kanda
characters.description: Deep in love with Miko he watches over her as her assistant.

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: Mao has a hard time, always being an easy target for phantoms to invade her. She also has a crush on Rokuro.

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: The phantom hunter teacher that has an extra interest in beautiful women.

characters.name: Azusa Ryougetsuin
characters.description: Another competing phantom hunter that is Mikos sempai.

characters.name: Kayano
characters.description: A female phantom hunter in training that is still receiving teachings from her sensei.

title: Kanariya wa Kago no Naka
description: Sakimi, a student, finds herself in a pinch. Having been betrayed by her previous boyfriend, she finds herself in incredible amounts of debt. She turns desperate, and seeks help from a man who runs a "gentleman's service", who confines her to a room 24/7, only allowing her out to preform her tasks." In there, she discovers Mana Fujidoh, a mysterious young girl. Sakimi seeks to break the bonds placed on her, and free her and Mana from this hellish world of sexual desires and cosplay perversions. Source: ANN

title: Gakuen Sodom
description: The students of Aoi College, who are all 19 by the way, have always suspected that Professor Ohse might be some sort of pervert or cretin, but no one could have guessed how depraved he really is. As it turns out, he's really a terrorist who decides to hold the entire campus hostage, and make all of its comely young lasses submit to his desire for torture and depravity. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Kojin Jugyou
description: Even as a young girl, Sara Iijima was a large-breasted woman. Because of this, she had felt self-conscious about herself... especially with men who were constantly leering at her. This only intensified when she was attacked by a rapist with a breast fetish. Although she escaped unharmed, this only made worse her insecurities. It was only because of the intervention of Dr. Chang that she was able to feel good about herself. Out of gratitude, Sara became Dr. Chang's protege in the method of psychic feedback, the method which was used to cure her of her insecurities. However, Dr. Sara's method of therapy is vastly different than what Dr. Chang had used. By swinging her huge breasts in a circle, she is able to induce a hypnotic trance in her patients, after which she is able to learn what is bothering the patient and offer the proper solution. characters.name: Sara Iijima
characters.description: Dr. Sara Iijima treats her patients with "sexual psychiatry". She has red hair and huge breasts.

title: Juuninin no Onna Kyoushi
description: A horny headmaster and his naughty nephews are out to train twelve teachers to be sex slaves. They'll use any scheme in their arsenal to get the hot lady professors to share their carnal knowledge. But even if the women give their bodies over freely, that doesn't mean they'll just take it lying down. The extracurricular activities are nonstop in every nook and cranny of this institute of lustful learning. (Source: AniDB)

title: Penetrate Blue: Vapor Trail Another Age 2824
title_original: ペネトレイト・ブルー -Vapor Trail Another Age 2824-

title: Tsuki Kagerou
description: Based on the game by Studio Miris. Taishō era. The interval between Meiji and Shōwa. A season where yellow and red petals swoop down from the trees. A young man comes down from the Imperial city, clinging to a large trunk, faintly smiling at the sight of the streets, a suitable young man indeed. Just as told by his father, he reached to this town to help for an autumn festival. Walking down the streets brings a surge of nostalgia. Encounter with a girl. Two girls. As days drift by, the young man soon links with one of the girls. Not a love by chance. It was a fated love. Was it the reason this young man was made to come to this town? (Source: VNDB)

title: Mikagura Tanteidan
description: * Based on a game by ELF It was Taisho era. Mikagura Tokito was the director of a detective agency, which has solved a lot of cases. One day he disappeared involved in an accident.Tomoe, Shigeno, and Chizuru, who adored him, got anxious about him. Hearing that Shigeno's elder brother had seen him at a church in a foreign country, so they travelled there hoping to meet him again. However, it was a dead body of a priest in a church which they found there. Furthermore, they found his arms had been cut off from his body. Because they thought his death had something to do with Tokito's disappearance, they would investigate the case. Suddenly they were attacked by men. Being involved in danger, they tried to find Tokito but will they find him? (Source: AnimeNfo)

title: Sailor Senshi Venus♡Five
title_original: セーラー戦士 ヴィーナス♡ファイブ
description: A struggle between two old gods continues on in the modern age. On the side of justice and the goddess Aphrodite is Venus 5, a team of beautiful lady warriors who can wrap up any battle with a happy ending. In the name of their goddess, they punish the followers of the god Apollo, their ancient and naughty, naughty enemy. But winning a war is never easy, and the lovely women in Aphrodite's sailor-suited fivesome have to beat off more than their fair share of tentacled villains in order to save the day. (Source: Kitty Media)

characters.name: Hikari Misono
characters.description: A natural blonde Japanese student of Golden Star University. She has good judgement and is friendly, though she also has a bit of a mean streak. Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Kiyomi Mikawa
characters.description: Hikari's best friend. Quickly labeled a 'brain' due to her looks and modest personality.

characters.name: Ikumi Mihari
characters.description: Recently enrolled at Golden Star, Ikumi is soft spoken and kindhearted, but has a tough side due to her involvement in a gang from her previous school.

characters.name: Moyu Miyama
characters.description: A fairly snobby rich girl who attends Golden Star, but she lightens up once she gets acqauinted by the rest of the Venus team. Source: Wikipedia

title: Lesbian Byoutou
description: Based on a live-action adult movie by DEEP'S. Ryoka University Hospital is a prestigious medical center consisting solely of women. At night, the hospital begins a special type of treatment meant only for VIPs.

title: Yagate Kimi ni Naru
description: Yuu has always loved shoujo manga and awaits the day she gets a love confession that sends her heart aflutter with bubbles and hearts, and yet when a junior high classmate confesses his feelings to her…she feels nothing. Disappointed and confused, Yuu enters high school still unsure how to respond. That’s when Yuu sees the beautiful student council president Nanami turn down a suitor with such maturity that she’s inspired to ask her for help. But when the next person to confess to Yuu is Nanami herself, has her shoujo romance finally begun? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

characters.name: Yuu Koito
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works. ~! She later falls in love with Touko. !~

characters.name: Touko Nanami
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5’4”) A second year high school student, and the busiest member of the student council. She consistently ranks number one with her test scores and grades, and excels in sports as well. Due to this, and her beauty, admirers frequently confess to her - only to be turned down, as the confessions never make her feel anything.

characters.name: Sayaka Saeki
characters.description: Sayaka is [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529/Nanami-Touko)'s best friend from her first year of high school. She is a second-year high school girl and the student council vice president.

characters.name: Koyomi Kanou
characters.description: Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She wants to become a writer.

characters.name: Seiji Maki
characters.description: Maki is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council. He grew up surrounded by two older sisters and a younger sister, so he finds it easy to talk with girls.

characters.name: Akari Hyuuga
characters.description: Akari is Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She is a member of the basketball club.

characters.name: Miyako Kodama
characters.description: Owner of a small café. Riko's girlfriend.

characters.name: Riko Hakozaki
characters.description: A literature teacher and the student council's staff advisor. Miyako's girlfriend.

characters.name: Suguru Doujima
characters.description: Doujima is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council.

characters.name: Rei Koito
characters.description: Yuu's older sister. Hiro's girlfriend.

title: Tensei Shitara Slime datta Ken
title_original: 転生したらスライムだった件
title_en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
description: As players of Monster Hunter and Dungeons & Dragons know, the slime is not exactly the king of the fantasy monsters. So when a 37-year-old Tokyo salaryman dies and wakes up in a world of dragons and magic, he's a little disappointed to find he's become a blind, boneless slime monster. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Rimuru Tempest
characters.description: __Species:__ Human (past life) → Slime __Kind:__ Reincarnated, Otherworlder Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

characters.name: Veldora Tempest
characters.original: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト
characters.description: __Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) __Species:__ True Dragon __Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally __Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

characters.name: Ranga
characters.description: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

characters.name: Milim Nava
characters.description: __Kind:__ Inhabitant "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

characters.name: Shizu
characters.description: Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students. She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

characters.name: Benimaru
characters.description: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

characters.name: Souei
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre) Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

characters.name: Shuna
characters.description: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

characters.name: Daikenja
characters.description: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. ~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~ ~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

characters.name: Rigurd
characters.description: Formerly the chief of the goblin village [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru) comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

characters.name: Rigur
characters.description: Rigur was named after his late elder brother. Rigur, after making [Gobta](https://anilist.co/character/129350/Gobta) the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348/Rigurd).

title: Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta
title_original: 気になってる人が男じゃなかった
title_en: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All
description: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Aya Oosawa
characters.description: Part of the popular crowd, her grades aren't great but she has good communication skills and has a lot of friends. Popular with the guys at school but she takes no interest in them.

characters.name: Mitsuki Koga
characters.description: Has a quiet and reserved personality, her classmates mistake her for an anime otaku. She can be a little airheaded in certain circumstances.

characters.name: Megumu Narita
characters.description: In the same class as [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/282093/Oosawa-Aya) and [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/282094/Koga-Mitsuki). An easygoing and refreshing stud (self- proclaimed) who is popular and admired by many. He's reasonably well-liked by the ladies, so when he encounters a girl he can't easily charm, he can't get her out of his head (currently, he can't get Mitsuki and Aya out of his head, but more in the sense that he's watching over them). If someone says something mean to him, he'll smile while actually getting depressed on the inside. However, he bounces back ridiculously fast. As far as his club activities go, he's in the soccer club (but he's probably the type who gets invited to all kinds of clubs).

characters.name: Joe
characters.description: Mitsuki's uncle. He doesn't have children of his own, so he's all-in on loving his niece. The ultimate doting uncle. He's always pursued what he loves, so he wants Mitsuki to be true to herself as well. When he was young, he worked hard to make a living from music, but now he's the owner of a run-down CD shop.

characters.name: Kanna
characters.description: [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/305502/Joe)'s ex-girlfriend. She works as a stylist in L.A. Mitsuki looks up to her because she focuses on the things she wants to do and pushes hard towards them.

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: Mao is another girl from Aya's inner circle. She always follows Chizuru wherever she goes and is secretly interested in Narita.

characters.name: Chizuru
characters.description: Chizuru, along with Mao, used to be Aya's best friend. She doesn't like that Aya spends so much time with Mitsuki lately.

title: Mieruko-chan
description: One day, she could see…everything. What’s a girl to do when hideous monsters appear no matter which way she turns? And on top of that, nobody else can see them! Obviously, there’s only one thing that makes sense—ignore them. Kinda hard to put theory into practice, though, when the ghosts know she’s watching… (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Miko Yotsuya
characters.description: __Height:__ 160cm __Family:__ [Mamoru Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/250703/Mamoru-Yotsuya) (Father), [Touko Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199025/Touko-Yotsuya) (Mother), [Kyousuke Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199026/Kyousuke-Yotsuya) (Younger Brother) Miko has the ability to see frightening supernatural things that most people can't, but she pretends that she can't see them to avoid conflict. Her Spiritual-Awareness power overpowers her sight, like the reflection in glass is overpowering and you're unable to see what lies beyond it. She tries to have a stoic exterior when confronted with spirits, but is internally frightened by them. She also cares deeply for her friend [Hana Yurikawa](https://anilist.co/character/139632/Hana-Yurikawa), using her power to protect her in various ways, such as diverting her from certain routes with spirits and bringing her food whe

characters.name: Hana Yurikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) close friend. She is clueless of the supernatural terrors that afflict her friend, but she does unknowingly attract a lot of them due to her unusual amount of life energy.

characters.name: Yulia Niguredou
characters.description: __Height:__ 140cm An aspiring spirit medium who believes she's somewhat special because she has the power to see spirits. However, she doesn't know that she can only see lesser spirits, and misinterprets [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) attempts to protect her from the greater dangers she cannot see as acts of malice.

characters.name: Touko Yotsuya
characters.description: Mother of [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/139631) and [Kyousuke](https://anilist.co/character/199026).

characters.name: Kyousuke Yotsuya
characters.description: [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) younger brother. Kyousuke is a young boy with short black hair. He is very protective of Miko, even going far enough to assume she has a boyfriend to be wary of.

characters.name: Romm Shindou
characters.description: __Powers-&-Abilities:__ High-Level Spiritual Awareness, Aura Awareness __Etymology:__ Romm's surname Shindou means "prodigy, wonder child" (神童). He can see spirits and humans simultaneously, like one's reflection in glass and the scenery behind it. He sells many items which interact with the far shore. He was given the name "Romm" by his former master, Mitsue Takeda, as part of the tradition of adding a 2nd name to apprentices. Romm has been seen to be very bold, running a business geared only to those adapted to seeing spirits. Even though many have called him a fraud, Yuria Niguredou believes in his ways and has been roped into buying some of his products. He is also very mischievous, taking amusement in the unpredictable actions made by Miko Yotsuya. He enjoys teasing Mitsue Takeda. ~!Shindou was brought to Mitsue as a child, and she took him in as her apprentice. She trained him in t

characters.name: Mamoru Yotsuya
characters.description: Father of Miko and Kyousuke. ~!Already deceased.!~

characters.name: Kido
characters.description: School nurse.

title: Tonikaku Kawaii
description: First comes marriage, then comes an earthbound love that is out of this world! From the day his parents named him, Nasa Yuzaki has been destined for outer space…or so he believes. But while trying to join the space program, he is thrown for a loop when an accident introduces him to Tsukasa, a mysterious girl with strange powers. Is she an alien, a moon goddess or something else? Since she insists on marrying him, Nasa has plenty of chances to find out! (Source: VIZ Media) Notes: The 16th volume includes the 4 chapter prequel "FLY ME TO THE MOON".

characters.name: Nasa Yuzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 169.5 cm __Likes:__ Math, Physics, Finances Kindhearted, charismatic, and intelligent, albeit only in certain areas. Nasa Yuzaki decided he had no need for a high school education, and, well, he was mostly right. He is the type of person who would worry if his friends got hurt when they tripped over a pebble, while he ended up falling down a cliff. He is very in love with his wife.

characters.name: Tsukasa Yuzaki
characters.description: **Height**: 154 cm **Relatives**: [Tokiko Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/188292/Tokiko-Tsukuyomi) (grandaunt), [Enishi Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190386/Enishi-Yuzaki) (father-in-law), [Kanoka Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190388/Kanoka-Yuzaki) (mother-in-law) Tsukasa Yuzaki is the wife of [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki). Not much is known about her, but what is known is that she's mysteriously cute. Tsukasa has long pink hair with a clasp on the back and pink-red eyes. She wears elegant clothing and a skirt. While at home she is usually seen wearing modern clothing. During her trip to Kyoto, she wore a floral Yukata. Tsukasa comes across as calm and level-headed; seemingly unsurprised by Nasa's rash and illogical actions. Despite this, she agreed to marry him and love him dearly. She gets embarrassed easily whenever Nasa proclaims

characters.name: Kaname Arisugawa
characters.description: She's been helping the bathhouse for a long time. Despite being young, she is very mature and always gives good suggestions to [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) to help him out with his couple life. Like her mom, she really likes dirty jokes and apparently, she has no fear of cleaning the males' bath while Nasa is in there. She isn't shy and prefers a direct approach.

characters.name: Aya Arisugawa
characters.description: She is [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa)'s older sister. She is a lazy ditz but, [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) considers her on the "genius side" for her great learning capacity. In contrast with that, she usually misunderstands important things and she gets really confused in the blink of an eye. Her favorite hobby is probably playing video games and she usually nags [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) into playing with her.

characters.name: Chitose Kaginoji
characters.description: Apparently, [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) saved her from falling off a cliff when they were children. Chitose wants to use her own life for the sake of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) to pay her back. She obviously doesn't want [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) falling into [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s hands. She has two maids: [Aurora](https://anilist.co/character/137516/Aurora) and [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte). Chitose has a personality that quickly bends from being strong to whining. She considers [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) her sister. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

characters.name: Aurora
characters.description: She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She is usually serious and cold-minded. Probably the exact opposite personality of [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte): the second maid of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji). She always appears with [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte) and she usually tries to stop her from being too impulsive. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She quickly changes her personality from being simple-minded and innocent to going berserk with a giant sword in her hands. However, she is always happy with a big smile on her face. She will probably do everything [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji) tells her to do without hesitation.

characters.name: Naoko Yanagi
characters.description: She is a teacher from the middle school that [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) had frequented. She is always super busy with work and doesn't have much time for her life. However, once she sees how happy [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s marriage is, she becomes more open to future relationships. She considers herself a boring person.

characters.name: Kyuuma Kagami
characters.description: She is Kaname's classmate and is always looking for her. She lacks logic and always draws queer conclusions. In a word: a klutz. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

characters.name: Ouka Nakiri
characters.description: She was Nasa's classmate in middle school and is the same age as him. She currently owns an electronics store and apparently, she doesn't have any clear desire for affective relationships. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

characters.name: Kaguya Gekkou
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm She is a senior high school student and has very long hair. She is very clever. Indeed, she can easily compute the trajectory of a rocket heading for the moon. She can be described as a sociopath since she doesn't really care about or understand people's morals or emotions. Everything can be explained by logic.

characters.name: Ginga Onimaru
characters.description: He is not a Yakuza, but everything about him recalls one. Indeed he always dresses as such and often changes normal terms with words more shadier and fishy. Besides that, he is a high school student and Nasa's cousin. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

title: Dead Dead Demon's Dededededestruction
title_original: デッドデッドデーモンズデデデデデストラクション
description: The Japan Self-Defense Forces are still looking for a way to combat the alien threat, but so far conventional weapons have had no effect. Maybe it’s time to try something unconventional. Meanwhile, Kadode Koyama and her best friend avidly track the aliens’ movements on social media and less enthusiastically study for college entrance exams. When the end of the world looms overhead, you learn to take things one step at a time. (Source: VIZ Media) Notes: - Winner of the 66th Shogakukan Manga Award in the general category. - Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Ouran Nakagawa
characters.description: A girl in her third year of high school. She is [Kadode](https://anilist.co/character/88566/Koyama-Kadode)'s best friend. She has long black hair, which she often wears in twintails, secured by skull-shaped hairties. Ouran has an older brother, [Hiroshi](https://anilist.co/character/89578/Nakagawa-Hiroshi) who is a NEET. She likes to play video games along with Kadode. Ouran is a very flamboyant character. She often rambles on about her goal to enslave mankind or lead the human race to destruction. However, despite her seemingly flamboyant and sociable personality, Ouran tends to only show her true self to her friends and family.

characters.name: Kadode Koyama
characters.description: A girl in her third year of high school. She loves the iconic manga character [Isobeyan](https://anilist.co/character/208124/Isobeyan). She also has a crush on [her teacher](https://anilist.co/character/89581/Watarase-Naoki). [Her dad](https://anilist.co/character/208125/Koyama-Nobuo) went missing during the initial appearance of the alien mothership over Japan. She appears to have a rocky relationship with [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/89585/Koyama-Manami), who's constantly worried about her own health and the A-Rays that were released when the aliens invaded.

characters.name: Keita Ooba
characters.description: He was a member of an idol group and also acted in some movies. He disappeared during the event of 8/31. When she was younger, Kadode was obsessed with him. ~!His body was taken over by an invader child during the 8/31 event and ever since he has been living as an invader in the human body.!~

characters.name: Hiroshi Nakagawa
characters.description: The chubby older brother of Ouran, harmless to all, who has a handsome face. He bemoans the "sad" world and is a neet who spends his days "monitoring" the internet.

characters.name: Futaba Takemoto
characters.description: She decided to come to Tokyo in order to participate in the efforts to protect the invaders.

characters.name: Makoto Tainuma
characters.description: A classmate of Futaba's from middle school. He likes to wear women's clothing as he simply wishes to be cute and beautiful.

characters.name: Naoki Watarase
characters.description: Kadode's teacher.

characters.name: Rin Hirama
characters.description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. She is a quiet girl who is into boy's love. She is Ai's childhood friend.

characters.name: Kiho Kurihara
characters.description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. She has a boyfriend named Kohiruimaki.

characters.name: Ai Demoto
characters.description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. Rin's bespectacled childhood friend.

characters.name: Manami Koyama
characters.description: Kadode's mother. She fears the negative health effects of the A-Lines.

characters.name: Hikari Sumaru
characters.description: She works in the public relations department at S.E.S.'s Hujin Development Center. She is in a relationship with Watarase, Kadode's teacher.

title: Ao no Flag
description: High school senior year, spring—one of life's important forks in the road. Taichi Ichinose finds himself in the same class as Futaba Kuze, who he feels strangely averse to, and his popular childhood friend, Touma Mita. One day, Futaba confides in him her love for Touma, and asks him for help. How will Taichi respond? This new “pure” love story begins as the three are colored in the emotions of youth. (Source: MANGA Plus)

characters.name: Futaba Kuze
characters.description: An impossibly naive girl who fell for Touma. She ends up befriending Ichinose in an attempt to learn more about him, but they end up becoming close friends with each other and Touma as well. She is very sweet and tries her hardest, but her natural clumsiness and naivete make it hard for her to befriends others in her class.

characters.name: Masumi Itachi
characters.description: Kuze's best friend. She is a dark and mysterious girl who is very protective of her smaller best friend. She is in a separate class but is often seen hanging around with the rest of the main characters. She intends to become a veterinarian.

characters.name: Touma Mita
characters.description: Ichinose's childhood friend and the most popular boy in their school, loved by everyone for his niceness, looks and being the school's baseball team's ace and captain. He gets close to Ichinose and Kuze once they end up in the same class. He is very kind-hearted and loud and cares deeply for his new found friends. His dream is of playing in the grounds of Koushien Stadium and become a professional baseball player.

characters.name: Taichi Ichinose
characters.description: An ordinary high school student. Ichinose used to be Mita's best friend, but they drifted apart during high school. They get closer again when they end up in the same classroom. He is usually shy and meek, but is known for being extremely nice.

characters.name: Mami Yagihara
characters.description: A girl that is within Touma's group of friends and grows upset with his newfound interest in hanging out with Futaba and Taichi instead of her. She is interested in Touma, but he does not reciprocate her affection.

characters.name: Seiya Mita
characters.description: Touma´s elder brother.

characters.name: Akiko Mita
characters.description: Touma's former tutor and current sister in law, married to his brother Seiya. She is a very cheerful and nice woman. She is really happy about Taichi and Touma being close again and also acts as Masumi's confidant.

characters.name: Shingo Niimura
characters.description: Mami's friend.

characters.name: Yokki
characters.description: Taichi's friend.

characters.name: Mon
characters.description: Taichi's friend.

characters.name: Omega
characters.description: Taichi's friend.

title: Tamen De Gushi
description: Sun Jing has a massive crush on a girl she sees at the bus station—feminine, blonde, and absolutely adorable, Qiu Tong is everything Sun Jing desires. But the tomboyish, outgoing Sun Jing cannot bring herself to utter a single word in Qiu Tong's presence. Once she musters up the courage, however, Sun Jing successfully introduces herself and secures a friendship with the cute girl. Although they are only friends for now, Sun Jing will do anything to see Qiu Tong smile; and with her genuine kindness, she might just win Qiu Tong's heart. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

characters.name: Jing Sun
characters.description: Sun Jing is the main protagonist of Tamen de Gushi. She's a freshman, seventh class at Second High School. She's completely and utterly in love with Qiu Tong.

characters.name: Tong Qiu
characters.description: Qiu Tong is a main protagonist of Tamen de Gushi. She is a second year in class 3 of South High. Qiu Tong is pretty popular at her school, but despite that has only a few friends. She is the love interest of Sun Jing.

characters.name: Fang Qi
characters.description: Qi Fang is Sun Jing's best friend. He attends Second High and is in the same class as her.

characters.name: Xiaonan Mo
characters.description: Xiaonan Mo has a crush on Jing Sun. She attends Second High but is in a different class.

characters.name: Xuezhang
characters.description: Despite his intimidating appearance, Xuezhang is a good-hearted and stoic person who quietly wants his affections returned by his underclassman Qin Xiong.

characters.name: Xiong Qin
characters.description: Qin Xiong is the classmate of Sun Jing. He attends Second High and is in the same class as her (1st year, Class 7). Qin Xiong is the love interest of his Xuezhang (upperclassman).

title: Shimanami Tasogare
title_en: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare
description: Not only is high schooler Tasuku Kaname the new kid in town, he’s also terrified that he’s been outed as gay. Just as he’s contemplating doing the unthinkable, Tasuku meets a mysterious woman who leads him to a group of people dealing with problems not so different from his own. In this realistic, heartfelt depiction of LGBT+ characters from different backgrounds finding their place in the world, a search for inner peace proves to be the most universal experience of all. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Tasuku  Kaname
characters.description: Tasuku Kaname is a high school student at Shimanami High, who is troubled by his sexual orientation and his affection for his schoolmate Touma Tsubaki.

characters.name: Touma Tsubaki
characters.description: Touma Tsubaki is a character from the manga Shimanami Tasogare, the ace of the Shimanami High volleyball club and Tasuku Kaname's crush. He and Tasuku are on the Health Committee together.

characters.name: Haruko Daichi
characters.description: Haruko is a frequent visitor of the Lounge and a member of the Cat Clowder. After being commissioned by Anonymous, she renovated the Lounge with friends she met through a gay community on Twitter. She's living with her wife, Saki, who she met through that community.

characters.name: Natsuyoshi Utsumi
characters.description: Utsumi is a friend of Haruko, who he met through a gay community on Twitter. He is a member of the Cat Clowder Vacant House Restoration Non-Profit and a frequent visitor of the lounge. ~!In chapter 11, it is revealed that he is a trans man.!~

characters.name: Chaiko
characters.description: Chaiko is an older gentleman who often hangs out around the lounge and enjoys playing classical music. ~!Chaiko is gay, and his partner of 30 years is in the hospital for terminal cancer.!~

characters.name: Anonymous
characters.description: Anonymous is the mysterious founder and owner of the Lounge. They are asexual and, as Kamatani Yuuki has stated, of indeterminate gender identity.

characters.name: Shuuji Misora
characters.description: Misora is in sixth grade and prefers to dress as a girl whenever he's at the lounge. He is unsure about what gender he identifies as. He has multiple older sisters and is called Shuuji at home.

title: Sabishisugite Rezu Fuzoku ni Ikimashita Report
title_original: さびしすぎてレズ風俗に行きましたレポ
description: A hugely popular comic on Pixiv, My Lesbian Experience With Loneliness offers readers an honest and heartfelt look at one young woman’s exploration of her sexuality, mental well-being, and growing up in our modern age. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Kabi Nagata
characters.description: [Staff Profile]( https://anilist.co/staff/120310/Kabi-Nagata)

characters.name: Yuka
characters.description: A cheerful girl from a lesbian escort agency.

title: Innocent
description: In the 18th century, seeking "freedom and equality," the event that gave birth to modern French society, the French Revolution, began. There was one protagonist that lived within the darkness, Charles-Henri Sanson. He was the fourth-generation head of the Sanson family, and the executioner of Paris. This is the story of a man nobly facing his harsh fate... (Source: Shueisha, translated) Notes: - Nominated for the 18th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize "Reader Award" in 2014 - Nominated for the 8th Manga Taishou Award in 2015.

characters.name: Charles-Henri Sanson
characters.original: シャルル＝アンリ・サンソン
characters.description: Charles-Henri Sanson is one of the main characters and protagonist of Innocent series. Born in 1739 to Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson and his first wife Madeleine Tronson, he was the fourth in a six-generation family dynasty of executioners. Charles is described as a beautiful young man with straight long dark hair. Older Charles has longer and wavy hair that is usually always shown to be slicked back. He resembles his father more with large shoulders and rib cage, but still has soft facial features and hands. His complexion, hair reflexions and eye color is odd and changing from volume to volume but are generally a ghostly greyish, bluish, purplish shade except for two examples where it is white with green or brownish shadows. ~!Charles was shown as man of pure and kind nature, who respects life, which was considered an unusual trait for a person who was born into a family of executioners

characters.name: Marie-Joseph Sanson
characters.original: マリー＝ジョセフ・サンソン
characters.description: Marie-Josèphe Sanson is the younger half-sister of [Charles-Henri Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/89944/Sanson-CharlesHenri) and one of the two main characters of the series. Born in 1751 to [Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/131350/Sanson-CharlesJeanBaptiste) and Jeanne-Gabrielle Berger Sanson. Her looks are considered to be too unladylike as she tends to style her sun-blond hair in buzzcut and undercut styles. Usually shaving left side of her head or both sides. She even completely shaved her hair once. Despite her tomboyish appearance Marie is considered as a very beautiful young woman with blonde hair and piercing blue eyes. She has strong physical resemblance to her older brother Charles-Henri Sanson. ~!Marie becomes a Prévôté de L'hôtel at the age of 11. After witnessing her successful standing decapitation of Marquis Georges de La Tour, the future Duk

characters.name: Subyss
characters.description: Tormentor attached to the High Court of Justice.

characters.name: Jean de Chartois
characters.original: ジャン・ド・シャルトワ
characters.description: The 14-year-old son of Earl Chartois.

characters.name: Nicholas-Charles Gabriel Sanson
characters.original: ニコラ＝シャルル・ガブリエル・サンソン
characters.description: Little brother of the "Third Generation", Baptiste. Executioner directly controlled by the Palace of Versailles Administration of Justice.

characters.name: Robert-Francois Damiens
characters.original: ロベール＝フランソワ・ダミアン

characters.name: Anne-Marthe-Dubut Sanson
characters.original: アンヌ＝マルト・デュビュ・サンソン
characters.description: Little sister of the first generation's second wife. The "Iron Law" of the Sanson family.

characters.name: Marie-Jeanne Becu
characters.original: マリー=ジャンヌ・ベキュー

characters.name: Charles-Jean-Baptiste Sanson
characters.original: シャルル＝ジャン・バチスト・サンソン
characters.description: Third head of the Sanson household.

characters.name: Andre Legris
characters.description: One of the servants of the Sanson family who also serves as an assistant at the prison, and is a childhood friend of Nicola. Prepares the necessary materials at the direction of Nikola. Later he became a full-time servant under Marie-Joseph.

title: My Broken Mariko
title_original: マイ・ブロークン・マリコ
description: Tomoyo Shiino has stood by her friend Mariko through years of abuse, abandonment, and depression. However horrific her circumstances, their friendship has been the one reassuring constant in Mariko's life-and Tomoyo's too. That is, until Tomoyo is utterly blindsided by news of Mariko's death. In life, Tomoyo felt powerless to help her best friend out of the darkness that ultimately drove her over the edge. Now, Tomoyo is determined to liberate Mariko's ashes for one final journey together... to set free her dear, broken Mariko. (Source: Yen Press) Notes: - Includes the one-shot "YISKA". - includes the extra "Home Sweet Home!".

title: citrus
description: Yuzuko Aihara, a high school girl whose main interests are fashion, friends and having fun, is about to get a reality check. Due to her mom’s remarriage, Yuzu has transferred to a new, all-girls school that is extremely strict. Her real education is about to begin. From Day One, happy-go-lucky Yuzu makes enemies, namely the beautiful yet stern Student Council President Mei. So what happens when a dejected Yuzu returns home and discovers the shock of her life: that Mei is actually her new step-sister who has come to live with her? Even more surprising, when Mei catches Yuzu off-guard and kisses her out of the blue, what does it all mean? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

characters.name: Mei Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

characters.name: Yuzu Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei). Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

characters.name: Harumi Taniguchi
characters.description: Harumi, most known as "Harumin", befriends Yuzuko being that she is a "Gyaru in Disguise". As she isn't one of the students who have been attending the academy since Elementary School, she takes no interest in following around the Student Council President and often packs items within her cleavage. As an individual, Harumi is perky, caring and an overall good friend towards Yuzuko.

characters.name: Matsuri Mizusawa
characters.description: Matsuri is a second-year in middle school and Yuzu's childhood friend who lived close to her before she moved to the Aihara residence. Matsuri makes her first appearance in chapter 8. She is a pretty girl who is always seen with a pair of headphones around her neck. being very sly and fake toward an unidentified friend. She comes across Yuzu and Harumin at an arcade and invites them out to karaoke. Harumin is appears to be quite wary and suspicious of her. Upon deducing the nature of Yuzu's feelings toward Mei, Matsuri professes a romantic interest in Yuzu and kisses her in front of Mei. She sells masturbation videos she finds on the Internet to old men through a phone app, and tells them they are hers, as a means of income. She considers men to be dense and believes that all can be manipulated easily.

characters.name: Himeko Momokino
characters.description: Himeko is a Student Council Member and Mei's childhood friend. Himeko has a rather stuck-up and stubborn personality, and despises people who don't follow the school regulations.

characters.name: Shiraho Suzuran
characters.description: One of Yuzu's friends.

characters.name: Kayo Maruta
characters.description: Kayo Maruta is a supporting character and ex-vice-president of the student council. She is best friends with Mitsuko, who she affectionately calls Micchan. Kayo is one of the few people who dares to talk to Mitsuko casually and lives to see another day; she also is seen at Micchan's side for much of the latter half of the manga. Glasses-senpai talks formally with everybody else. While on the student council at Aihara Academy, Maruta was dedicated and very diligent at making sure people are rule-followers, even chastising Yuzu while it's her first day there. Eventually, the brunette lightens up later on and shows her softer side for Micchan and the readers, as well as the group that went on the summer trip in volume 8. During the extra in volume four of the manga, she reveals her surname and her past position in the council.

characters.name: Sara Tachibana
characters.description: A young-looking silver-haired girl who Yuzu befriends in the Tokyo Train Station after they both miss a train (coincidentally, to the same place, Kyoto). Sara believes in things such as fate and soul mates, and as such believes she and Yuzu were "destined to meet."

characters.name: Nina Tachibana
characters.description: Sara's younger twin sister, who is skeptical and does not believe in fate.

characters.name: Shou Aihara
characters.description: Mei's father, later Yuzu's new stepfather

characters.name: Ume Aihara
characters.description: Biological mother of [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Yuzu-Aihara), stepmother of [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Mei-Aihara)

title: Boku wa Mari no Naka
description: College dropout Isao Komori wakes up one morning to find himself in the body of a high school girl. How did this happen and what happened to the girl whose body his is possessing? (Source: Denpa)

characters.name: Mari Yoshizaki
characters.description: An "angel-like" beautiful high school girl with a certain secret she has been hiding from everyone.

characters.name: Yori Kakiguchi
characters.description: A classmate of Mari, she seems to have some kind of relation with her. ~!It is revealed that Yori was stalking Mari and she is very strict with how "Isao" acts while inside of Mari's body as to not ruin her in any way. The two slowly become genuine friends and eventually begin to date before it is revealed that the "Isao" within Mari was not the real him and just a projection of him Mari conjured in her mind and assumed as her own persona due to family trauma and wishing to escape from it. At the end of the manga once Mari returns to being herself it is unclear if Yori and her are dating but they are still friends.!~

title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau
title_original: ささやくように恋を唄う
description: Bubbly, energetic first-year high school student Himari falls head over heels for her senpai Yori after hearing her band perform on the first day of school. Himari tells Yori she just loves her, and to Himari's surprise, Yori says she loves Himari back! But when Himari realizes that she and her senpai are feeling two different kinds of love, she begins to ask herself what "love" really means... (Source: Kodansha USA) Notes: - Eighteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category - First place in Yuri Navi’s best Yuri Manga of 2020

characters.name: Himari Kino
characters.description: Himari is a very joyous, cheerful girl and often likened to a puppy by other characters. She is able to instantly befriend anyone, even hard to approach characters like [Shiho](https://anilist.co/character/215602/Izumi-Shiho). Himari is always wanting the best for her friends and cheering them on in whatever they pursue.

characters.name: Yori Asanagi
characters.description: A third year high school student who sings while playing guitar at the school rooftops and loves collecting cat merchandise. She is also a part of the "SS Girls" band in which she is positioned as the guitarist and vocalist.

characters.name: Miki Mizuguchi
