characters.description: She is part of the brass band club who indirectly helps [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari)'s and [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori)'s relationship by collecting information.

characters.name: Shiho Izumi
characters.description: She is a third-year high school student and the main vocalist for the band Laureley.

characters.name: Momoka Satomiya
characters.description: She is a second year and President of the Culinary Research Club, she is also Laureley's bassist.

characters.name: Mari Tsutsui
characters.description: She is a third-year student and drummer in SS GIRLS.

characters.name: Kaori Tachibana
characters.description: She is a third-year student and keyboardist in SS GIRLS.

characters.name: Aki Mizuguchi
characters.description: Aki is a third year high school student and the bassist for the SS Girls. She is best friends with [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori) and was one of the first people to encourage her to pursue [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari). ~!Yori and Aki are best friends. Aki sometime after they became friends fell in love with her, having wanted several times to take an "extra step" but decided to not confess her feelings and only stay by her side as a friend in fear of losing their current relationship.!~

characters.name: Hajime Amasawa
characters.description: She is a third year high school student and Laureley's drummer.

characters.name: Ayaka Kohara
characters.description: Ayaka is in the same club as Miki. She has been in love with Miki ever since she joined the club.

title: Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san
title_original: 履いてください、鷹峰さん
description: Takane Takamine is the goddess of her high school. With perfect grades, athletic prowess, and unrivaled beauty, this student council president is the apple of everyone's eye-including Koushi Shirota, a below-average student with no friends or social prospects whatsoever. But he'll soon find out the secret behind Takamine's unbelievable success-her underwear! When she strips, she can undo any of her past actions, and now that Koushi knows, Takamine won't let him off so easy... (Source: Yen Press) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

characters.name: Takane Takamine
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Student Council President She is a perfectionist and wants to be the best at everything. She has an ability called "The still untouched, unknowing maiden. (The eternal aisle)". Every time she takes off a piece of underwear she can make what was done into something it wasn't.

characters.name: Koushi Shirota
characters.description: Once he is introduced to Takane Takamine, he is soon told that he will become her "closet", in which he has to replace her underwear once she has used her ability.

characters.name: Ellie Evergreen
characters.original: 絵梨依・エバーグリーン
characters.description: Takashi's old childhood friend

title: Kimi to Tsuzuru Utakata
description: Shizuku is a shy girl who hardly talks to other people. Instead, she loses herself in creative writing, crafting a novel that she never plans to show anyone. But when Kaori–Shizuku’s cute, popular classmate–gets her hands on Shizuku’s manuscript, everything changes. Kaori is a huge fan, and suggests that Shizuku can get inspiration for her writing if the two of them start dating! Can these very different young ladies create their own love story together? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Shizuku Hoshikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shy girl who avoids speaking with others, she's constantly haunted by her past of having bullied a friend. In secret, she wrote a novel expressing her innermost feelings she has never shared with anyone. Although she had planned to erase herself along with her novel when she finished writing, it didn't work out that way because her classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/204142) borrowed her novel after noticing it by chance. Having read it, Kaori asks when her next novel will be. Everything changes from then on, as they agree to go out until summer ends.

characters.name: Kaori Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 149cm Cheery and energetic, she accidentally stumbled upon her classmate Shizuku's novel when she approached her. After borrowing the novel in order to read it, she has started take an admiration towards Shizuku and asks when her next novel will be. Distraught to know she wasn't planning to write another one, Kaori asks to go out together so she can be inspired to write a new story. Unbeknown to Shizuku, she knew her from elementary school. There's also something she's hiding from her...

characters.name: Shizuka Hoshikawa
characters.description: Shizuku's older sister. She is enrolled in a beauty school and is studying to become a hairstylist.

characters.name: Shiori Asaka
characters.description: Kaori's little sister.

characters.name: Seri Ichihara
characters.description: She is friends with [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/308867/Ichinose-Ruri).

characters.name: Ruri Ichinose
characters.description: Ruri Ichinose was Shizuku Hoshikawa's classmate in fifth grade of elementary school. She is currently attending a different high school.

title: Kakegurui
description: Hyakkaou Private Academy. An institution for the privileged with a very peculiar curriculum. You see, when you're the sons and daughters of the wealthiest of the wealthy, it's not athletic prowess or book smarts that keep you ahead. It's reading your opponent-the art of the deal. What better way to hone those skills than with a rigorous curriculum of gambling? At Hyakkaou Private Academy, the winners live like kings, and the losers are put through the wringer. But when Yumeko Jabami enrolls, she's gonna teach these kids what a high roller really looks like! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Yumeko Jabami
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") A girl who transfers into Hyakkaou Private Academy. She might look like an attractive young lady, but she is actually a "Kakegurui," someone who finds pleasure in taking risks. Attractive, smooth as silk, and silver-tongued, Yumeko is a natural-born gambler. Gathering the attention of her peers and the entire student council, there's no denying she enjoys the attention she receives. Despite all odds in a gambling match, she somehow manages to turn the tables in the most daring ways, often times using her perceptiveness to decipher her opponent's tricks.

characters.name: Mary Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") Mary Saotome is a deuteragonist of _Kakegurui_, and also the main protagonist of the spin-off series _Kakegurui Twin_. She is a student at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and a classmate of [Yumeko Jabami](https://anilist.co/character/121889) and [Ryota Suzui](https://anilist.co/character/122688) who is the first character in the entire series that challenges Yumeko and loses against her. At first, Mary is shown to be incredibly sadistic and twisted, such as how she treats her classmate Ryota Suzui after he turned into a "housepet", due to his low social status within the academy, and is shown cruelly taunting her fellow opponents during their gambling matches. She's also shown to be extremely egotistical both in and out of matches, often being confident in her victory. Mary also possesses a habit of mocking her opponents and laughing at them, especially when match se

characters.name: Ryouta Suzui
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Yumeko’s classmate. Cowardly and poor, he quickly ends up being treated as Meari’s livestock, and is called ‘Pochi’ (a common name for a dog). However, he is saved from this predicament by Yumeko.

characters.name: Sayaka Igarashi
characters.description: Secretary of the Student Council and the right hand of Student council president. She is determined to become Kirari's 'Number 1,' and thinks of Yumeko as a plague. Sayaka is intelligent, serious and deeply cares about school and Student Council. She's endlessly loyal to the Student Council President, Kirari Momobami and will do anything for her. It seems that she has a crush on Kirari, as she expressed concern and sadness when she drove off without telling her where she went and what she was doing. While she seems to be reserved and calm, her subduing of a violent student, Jun Kiwatari and telling him what he now owes in the debt recollection game shows that she's every bit as terrifying as the rest of the Student Council.

characters.name: Midari Ikishima
characters.description: A third-year student and head of the Student Council Beautification Committee. She gets pleasure from taking risks such as starting games of Russian roulette by herself.

characters.name: Kaede Manyuda
characters.description: A second-year student and student council treasurer. He has a strong desire for power and is very ambitious, to the point where he is plotting to overthrow his seniors, even in the student council, as soon as he has a chance. He is the manipulative Treasurer of the Student Council, having his own goal to take down Kirari Momobami. ~!Became a Housepet with 10 billion Yen debt after losing to Jabami. As a result from his gamble with Yumeko Jabami, his hair turned white. This is an alleged condition called Marie Antoinette syndrome that causes the hair to turn white after facing an abundance of emotional stress.!~

characters.name: Kirari Momobami
characters.description: Kirari Momobami is the 105th student council president at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and as well as the one responsible for the current hierarchy on the academy.

characters.name: Yuriko Nishinotouin
characters.description: A third-year student, member of the student council, and president of the Tradition Culture Research Society. She ends up challenging [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko) to an original gambling match.

characters.name: Itsuki Sumeragi
characters.description: She's a first-year student belonging to the "flower" class at Hyakkaou Private Academy and a member of the Student Council. Her father is the president of a prominent toy company in Japan. Her hobby is collecting other people’s nails. ~!Since [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/122692/Manyuda-Kaede) betted his lifeplan [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko) received it, but gave it to Itsuki. Its apparent, that she actually has feelings for him. She watches over him, as he lays in bed, still under shock. She goes on to collect quite a few votes during the election. And she is also present during Yumemis battle against Kawaru!~

characters.name: Runa Yomozuki
characters.description: She is a member of the Student Council and also a leader of the Election Committee, serving as a referee during election gambling matches. ~!Runa is a sadistic and two-faced person, who seems to be very cute and nice at first but in reality she enjoys watching other people fail and loves to mock them.!~

characters.name: Ririka Momobami
characters.description: She is the vice president of the student council and is seen almost entirely throughout the whole time wearing a mask that covers her whole face. Ririka is a very quiet and stoic person. She often acts as an observer.

characters.name: Yumemi Yumemite
characters.description: A second-year student in charge of PR for the student council. She also works as an idol, but there’s a huge gap between her facade and her true face. Yumemi has a two-faced personality. On the outside, she is a sweet and lovely girl who loves her fans above all. However, in reality, she's an arrogant, calculated and sadistic person, who will do everything to be on top. She's also disgusted by her fans as she often calls them 'pigs' but at the same time, she doesn't want to turn in meetings with them, due to her dream of becoming a famous actress in Hollywood and winning an Academy Award. Yumemi never enjoys the dancing routines the fan club comes up with and has shown to be disgusted by their 'sweaty gross palms'. She is motivated by stating on top and achieving an academy reward which is why she involves herself with the fans as much as she can. Even though she is mostly focused on her

title: Tenkuu Shinpan
description: High-school girl Yuri suddenly finds herself on the rooftop of a high-rise building. She's trapped in a bizarre world surrounded by skyscrapers, where a masked man cracked open a man's head with an axe before her eyes. The original author of "Ajin," Tsuina Miura works in collaboration with Takahiro Oba, the artist of "Box!", to bring you this thrilling skyscraper suspense!

characters.name: Yuri Honjou
characters.description: Main protagonist of the series. One day, she founds herself in a weird world where masked people try to kill her. After realizing that her brother is in the same world as her, she is determined to stay alive and meet her brother.

characters.name: Mayuko Nise
characters.description: Nise was bullied and neglected by classmates and family alike. Thus, she learned to not trust anyone. This behaviour reached extreme heights when she reached this world, turning her into a seemingly cold-blooded killer, that is, until she met [Yuri Honjo](https://anilist.co/character/127441/Honjou-Yuri).

characters.name: Kuon Shinzaki
characters.description: Shinzaki Kuon is a God Candidate. She is sometimes referred to as the Railgun User.

characters.name: Rika Honjou
characters.description: Brother of [Yuri Honjou](https://anilist.co/character/127441/Honjou-Yuri).

characters.name: Sniper Kamen
characters.description: Sniper Mask also known as the "White Grim Reaper" ~!After Kuon Shinzaki's "death" her powers were transfered to him. Becoming a God Candidate.!~ ~!His real name is Yuuka Makoto (誠勇火).!~

characters.name: Mamoru Aikawa
characters.description: Mamoru Aikawa is a God Candidate and a major antagonist of Tenkuu Shinpan. As he witnessed his father's suicide as a young child, for which his father wrote a note to "those who betrayed him" on his business and social ventures, Mamoru grew to despise those who were betrayed, believing them to be a cancer to society and worthy of suicide. He explains this belief to Rika and anyone who will listen, with his doctrine explained as: those who earn betrayal earn death.

characters.name: Kazuma Aohara
characters.description: A God Candidate who controls the Angels Ain and Zwei.

characters.name: Shinji Okihara
characters.description: A God Candidate.

characters.name: Dealer Kamen
characters.description: Dealer Kamen is an Angry Mask.

title: Centuria
description: Sold into slavery by his own mother, Julian has known nothing but pain and brutality. All that changes when, aboard a slave ship, he experiences the kindness and the tender touch of a loving person for the first time. But fate has plans for Julian in the blood awakening of an ancient god who strikes a cruel bargain: an innocent life in exchange for extraordinary powers—ones he must use to protect a helpless baby in a cruel and violent world! (Source: VIZ Media) Notes: - Ninth place at the Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2024. - Second place at the Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2025. - Won the Daruma Award for Best Suspense/Thriller Manga at Japan Expo in 2026.

characters.name: Julian
characters.description: He is a runaway slave who has chosen to use his freedom to raise his adoptive sister [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/343699/Diana).

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: Diana is the daughter of Mira and the adoptive sister of Julian.

characters.name: Angvall Selma
characters.description: She is a female solider and Titi's guardian. She is also the accommodator of Julian and Diana.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: Mira was a former slave who was close to Julian. She provided Julian with a new purpose in life by entrusting him with the care of her newborn daughter Diana.

characters.name: Arkos
characters.description: Arkos is the son of the king and serves as a defender of the country's western border.

characters.name: Titi
characters.description: Titi was raised by [Angvall](https://anilist.co/character/337336/Angvall) after the latter found her abandoned on the battlefield as a child. ~!After the timeskip, she lives with Julian and Diana!~

characters.name: Lukas
characters.description: Lukas is a young man of average height with short dark hair and a scar around the left side of his neck. He wears a dark V-neck shirt with matching pants and shoes and has bandages wrapped around his arms.

title: Tsukiatte Agete mo Ii ka na
title_original: 付き合ってあげてもいいかな
description: Shy Miwa has always dreamed of finding love, but living in small-town Japan made finding the right match difficult—especially since she likes girls! Even going away to college didn’t seem to help, until one day her outgoing classmate Saeko suggests they might as well start dating each other since it’s not like either of them has other options. At first it seems like things won't work out as their personalities clash and misunderstandings abound. But when their casual friendship starts to become something more, Miwa begins to wonder—can a pragmatic proposal lead to true love? (Source: VIZ Media) Notes: - Includes eight extra chapters. - Placed 13th in the Tsugimanga 2019 Award in the Web Manga Category.

characters.name: Saeko Sawatari
characters.description: Whether concerts or theme parks, she just like things that stimulate her. She dresses like she doesn't really care. Despite that, women love her.

characters.name: Miwa Inuzuka
characters.description: **Height:** 166 cm (5'5") She got her hair styled like [Shiina Ringo](https://anilist.co/staff/103213) in order to fuel her creative process. Likes the fine arts and literature, but also enjoys more niche, sub-cultural hobbies.

characters.name: Rika
characters.description: The crazy girl of the club. She's uninhibited when it comes to sex and is occasionally an airhead

characters.name: Mikkun
characters.description: He is the vocalist of Miwa and Saeko's band. Extremely pessimistic but cheerful, he is good at singing

characters.name: Tsuruta
characters.description: Fell in love with Miwa at first sight

characters.name: Usshi
characters.description: The one with the most common sense. She has anxieties about her lack of romantic experience.

characters.name: Shiho Kumagai
characters.description: She and Miwa went to the same high school and were both in the tennis club. Shiho currently lives in Okinawa

characters.name: Yuria Washio
characters.description: A student at a technical school studying to become a beautician.

characters.name: Tamaki Shishio
characters.description: A first-year who came to the band club's welcome party, she kind of resembles Shiho

title: Darling in the Franxx
title_original: ダーリン・イン・ザ・フランキス
description: In a devastated post-apocalyptic future, Earth is a ruinous wasteland. Humanity’s only remaining strongholds are mobile fortress cities called Plantations. Massive beasts known as klaxosaurs, the planet’s new apex predators, have pushed mankind to the edge of extinction, and within the walls of the Plantations, things are no less dire. Humans no longer love or reproduce–adults live on in sterile immortality while children are regarded as nothing more than parasites, artificially created to pair up and pilot the Plantations’ giant defense robots known as Franxx. Former child whiz kid Hiro fails out of the piloting program after falling out of sync with his co-pilot, and a fateful decision to skip his group’s graduation ceremony puts him on a collision course with a horned girl known as Zero Two, whose co-pilots always end up dead. She claims Hiro as her “darling,” but what can that word even mean in such a loveless world? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Classification:__ Parasite __Affiliation:__ Thirteenth Plantation __Occupation:__ Stamen __Partners:__ [Zero Two](https://anilist.co/character/124381), ~! [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/144621/Naomi) (formerly), [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/124382/Ichigo) (temporarily), [001](https://anilist.co/character/126290/Kyouryuu-no-Hime) (temporarily), [9'α](https://anilist.co/character/161730/9-Alpha) (temporarily) !~ __FRANXX:__ Strelizia, Delphinium (temporarily), ~! 9 Model (temporarily) !~ Hiro was known as a prodigy Parasite with the codename "016" of Thirteenth Plantation, where he's partnered in a boy-girl pair with Zero Two to pilot a FRANXX called Strelizia.

characters.name: Zero Two
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Classification:__ Parasite __Affiliation:__ APE's Special Forces Unit __Partner:__ [Hiro](https://anilist.co/character/124380/Hiro) __FRANXX:__ Strelizia Zero Two is an elite FRANXX pilot who is a member of a race of humans with Klaxosaur blood, and the pistil of the FranXX Strelizia.

characters.name: Ichigo
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5’0”) Ichigo is a former Parasite with the codename "015" of the Thirteenth Plantation, where she was partnered in boy-girl pair with [Goro](https://anilist.co/character/124383/Goro) to pilot a FRANXX called Delphinium.

characters.name: Goro
characters.description: Goro pilots the Franxx Delphinium with [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/124382).

characters.name: Miku
characters.description: Miku is a former Parasite with the codename "390" of the Thirteenth Plantation, where she is partnered in boy-girl pair with [Zorome](https://anilist.co/character/124385/Zorome) to pilot a FRANXX called Argentea. She is the most assertive and head-strong of the girls and is not afraid to clash with the boys. She is motivated to strive and she shares an attitude almost identical to Zorome’s, which makes them perfectly compatible.

characters.name: Zorome
characters.description: __Height:__ 161cm Zorome is a former Parasite with the codename "666" of the Thirteenth Plantation, where he is partnered in a boy-girl pair with [Miku](https://anilist.co/character/124384/Miku) to pilot a FRANXX called Argentea. Aside from being the most immature member of the squad, he is the most loyal to the adults and APE, and his long-reaching goal is to become an adult himself. He presents himself as somewhat of a bully and pervert but he is also a dedicated member of the squad and willing to do whatever it takes to help his squadmates.

characters.name: Kokoro
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Pilots the Franxx Genista with [Futoshi](https://anilist.co/character/124387/Futoshi). ~!After the partner shuffle, she rides with [Mitsuru](https://anilist.co/character/124389/Mitsuru). Kokoro becomes pregnant with Mitsuru's child later on in the anime.!~

characters.name: Futoshi
characters.description: Pilots the Franxx Genista with [Kokoro](https://anilist.co/character/124386/Kokoro).

characters.name: Ikuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'7") Pilots the Franxx Chlorophytum with [Mitsuru](https://anilist.co/character/124389/Mitsuru).

characters.name: Mitsuru
characters.description: Mitsuru pilots the FRANXX Chlorophytum with [Ikuno](https://anilist.co/character/124388/Ikuno), and is part off Plantation 13. ~!Later in the anime, he switches partners with [Futoshi](https://anilist.co/character/124387/Futoshi), and ends up piloting the FRANXX Genista, along with [Kokoro](https://anilist.co/character/124386/Kokoro). They fall in love and Kokoro gets pregnant with his child.!~

characters.name: Franxx Hakase
characters.description: Creator of the FRANXX used to fight Klaxosaurs.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: Parasite administrator of APE Operational Headquarters. ~!She was a FranXX Pilot in the same squadron as [Hachi](https://anilist.co/character/124853/Hachi).!~

title: Shimeji Simulation
title_original: シメジ シミュレーション
description: A girl who shut herself in a closet for the last 2 years of middle school realizes she has to go to high school. When she exits her closet for the first time in two years and looks at herself in the mirror, she notices that she grew shimeji mushrooms out of her head.

characters.name: Majime Yamashita
characters.description: [Shijima](https://anilist.co/character/136264/Tsukishima-Shijima)'s classmate. Cheerful and not diligent at all, contrary to her name. Was apparently born with a sunny-side egg on her head.

characters.name: Shijima Tsukishima
characters.description: Was a shut-in for two years before entering high-school, during which two stalks of Shimeji mushrooms grew on her head. Can't be bothered to do anything and is a pessimist.

characters.name: Mogawa Sensei
characters.description: Teaches art at Shijima and Majime's school, and is the advisor for the hole-digging club. Often sinks into a depressive spiral of thoughts, and loves drinking.

characters.name: Shijima no Ane
characters.description: Lives together with Shijima as something of a parent figure. She quit university and is currently focusing on some sort of incomprehensible research.

characters.name: Yomikawa Senpai
characters.description: Likes to read. Can't carry anything heavier than a book even though she is on a hole-digging club.

characters.name: Sumida Senpai
characters.description: A second-year student and a member of the Hole Digging Club. She does not like to talk, and communicates by writing in her sketchbook most of the time.

characters.name: Yoshiko
characters.description: Classmate of Shijima and Majime. Bassist in the light music club

characters.name: Ayaka
characters.description: Classmate of Shijima and Majime. Vocalist and Pianist of the light music club

characters.name: Chito
characters.description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

characters.name: Yuuri
characters.description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

title: Umibe no Étranger
description: "There's nothing wrong with liking another guy." To be in the arms of the person I love... I thought that was an unobtainable dream......... On an island off the coast of Okinawa, two young men meet on a beach. Shun Hashimoto is gay and aspires to be a novelist. He is interested in Mio Chibana, a somber high school student, and starts to flirt with him. Day by day, the two of them grow closer, but then, suddenly, Mio decides to leave the island. Three years later, Mio returns and approaches Shun with the words, "I've thought about it for the past three years. I like you, Shun, even if you're a guy." However, when faced with the prospect of finally becoming lovers with Mio, Shun cannot take the first step towards commitment... This is a tantalizing love story about a gay novelist and a younger part-time worker. It's a manga that will touch and purify your heart. (Source: Renta!)

characters.name: Shun Hashimoto
characters.description: Hashimoto Shun, a gay novelist in the making, lived on the island Okinawa with his family. On Okinawa, he met a boy named Chibana Mio, who later left to pursue his studies for three years. When he returned, he confessed his attraction to Shun and developed a relationship with him. Originally from Hokkaido, he moved to Okinawa to live with his grandmother after his parents discovered his sexual orientation.

characters.name: Mio Chibana
characters.description: Mio is a 20-year-old freeter. After his mother's death, he briefly moves to Okinawa, where he meets Shun. Initially offended at Shun's attitude, he soon falls in love and pursues him romantically when he returns to Okinawa. Mio attempts to get better understanding of Shun's concerns, despite Shun constantly dismissing his advances.

characters.name: Sakurako
characters.description: Sakurako is Shun's childhood friend who has known he was gay since high school. Through an arranged marriage, she was also Shun's fiancée until he came out to his parents during the wedding ceremony. Despite this, Sakurako is still in love with him. ~!In Harukaze no Étranger, A few years after Shun and Mio move into the main house, She ends up cutting her hair, claiming that she feels like a bunch of weight has come off her shoulders.!~ ~!It's also said that The adopted son of the Hashimoto household, [Fumi](https://anilist.co/character/185464/Fumi-Hashimoto), has a crush on her because of the kindness she gave him!~

characters.name: Eri
characters.description: Eri is a woman who previously lived with Shun and his grandmother in Okinawa before moving out to live with her girlfriend, Suzu.

characters.name: Oba-chan
characters.description: Shun's grandmother. He stays at her place.

characters.name: Suzu
characters.description: Eri's girlfriend.

characters.name: Wada
characters.description: Shun's old classmate. Shun used to have a crush on him.

title: Marriagetoxin
description: A hitman and a marriage swindler set out on the world’s most grueling battle for marriage! Gero is a young man from a clan of hitmen, which has been in existence for hundreds of years. As someone who’s never gone to school and lived his life dealing in the dark side of the business, he considers himself to have “no prospects with women” and marriage as “something not for him.” However, one day, in fear that their lineage would dissolve, his clan warns Gero that if he doesn’t marry and produce an heir, they would have no choice but to…force his little sister into doing “that.” Driven to his wits’ end, Gero asks the target of his work, a marriage swindler, to… (Source: MANGA Plus)

characters.name: Hikaru Gero
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Poison User Hikaru Gero is part of the Gero Family, one of the top five families of specialists. He is the current heir to the Poison clan. A poison-using hitman from the clan of assassins. In order to keep his sister from being forced into having a child to continue the lineage of the clan, Gero decides to try and get married and have a child of his own.

characters.name: Mei Kinosaki
characters.description: ~!__Gender:__ Male!~__Occupation:__ Swindler Mei Kinosaki is a marriage swindler who charms both men and women in order to get money from them to help keep their sick brother alive. Mei was saved by [Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) after being captured by a crime syndicate that they had wronged. Mei agreed to help Gero find a wife in exchange for Gero's protection, and help with keeping their sick brother alive.

characters.name: Shiori Ureshino
characters.description: She is the next heir of the Ureshino Family. After the death of her father, he would leave her in charge of the company. This would cause her to be under the care of her uncle who would try to help her in everything she needed. After her uncle informed her that a murderer was after her, she agrees to be escorted by someone.

characters.name: Kimie Arashiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm (5'7'') __Specialist Type:__ Hamster User She is from Beast Clan. After her brother disappeared, Kimie would try to take a job in his place, this would cause Kimie to be kidnapped by a group of terrorists who wanted her organs. At that moment a small [Hikaru Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) would come to save her. From that moment on, Kimie would become a big fan of Gero.

characters.name: Kyouko Himekawa
characters.description: She is a famous art thief known in the underworld. Himekawa is an animal lover as she is friend with a shark named Jawshua. She is also able to see the feelings of painting.

characters.name: Piichi Nakagawa
characters.description: An ordinary human, but a genetic anomaly with abilities far beyond a regular assassin. He possesses exceptional information-processing skills along with superhuman physical abilities. Needs to sleep more than 10 hours a day to function properly, but after sleeping his body can heal almost any injury or ailment. In terms of pure talent, he is among the very best in the modern era. His dream is to open up a cafe with his girlfriend, [Marin](https://anilist.co/character/336020).

characters.name: Shizuku Ushio
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Water User A businessman of the underworld. Highly professional and thorough in her work, she completes all of her tasks with precision. She has a laid back personality and respects Hikaru Gero for what he has done for the poison clan. Due to having hypersensitive skin, she's usually dressed in a diving suit.

characters.name: Akari Gero
characters.description: She is a specialist part of the Gero Family alongside her brother and Teruaki.

characters.name: Toshiki Hanamaki
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Bug User He is a specialist from Hanamaki Clan a sub-branch of the Gero Family. He's Gero's best friend.

characters.name: Toshiro Dogo
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1'') __Specialist Type:__ Beast User He is member of the Dogo Family, one of the top five families of specialists.

characters.name: Genya Naruko
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Sound User A direct descendant of the "Sound" lineage. Possesses a unique aura and distinctive way with words. Not only is he extremely handsome, but he is also highly popular among the ladies. Since he needs to stay relaxed to use his abilities, he's come up with his own unique ways to unwind.

characters.name: Tonako Dogo
characters.description: __Specialist Type:__ Wolf User She is the current head and member of the Dogo Family.

title: Lonely Girl ni Sakaraenai
title_original: ロンリーガールに逆らえない
title_en: I Can't Say No to the Lonely Girl
description: In this juicy yuri manga, the goody-goody high school girl Sakurai meets a lonely girl—and ends up entangled in a web of blackmail that might just lead to romance. It's hard to keep up with school when you can never say no to a devious classmate! (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Chapter count includes five extra chapters.

characters.name: Sora Honda
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm She's a student who was persuaded to return to school on the condition that "[Ayaka](https://anilist.co/character/183577/Sakurai-Ayaka) listens to one of her requests every day." She has a quiet, clever, and introverted personality.

characters.name: Ayaka Sakurai
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm She is a model student with top-of-the-class grades, but she suffers from anxiety during tests, causing her to attend a lower-level high school than she hoped for. She is the class representative and has an outgoing, quiet, and guarded personality. She adores baby chick dolls and has an entire collection in her room.

characters.name: Wakana Morinaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm Wakana is a high-spritied gal from Osaka. She is athletic but does not want to join an athletic club because it is too tiresome. She is pretty good at playing the piano.

characters.name: Chizuru Koike
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm Chizuru is a member of the volleyball club. She likes sports in general and quickly became friends with [Honami](https://anilist.co/character/234571/Sakaue-Honami) after entering high school.

characters.name: Yuina Minami
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm Yuina likes fashion and trendy things. She reads hair styling and fashion magazines and doesn't participate in any school clubs.

characters.name: Honami Sakaue
characters.description: **Height:** 145 cm Honami has been a member of the track team since junior high and enjoys running. [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/234570/Minami-Yuina) taught her how to wear her hair in a bun

characters.name: Michiko Egawa
characters.description: **Height:** 170 cm Ayaka's homeroom teacher

title: LOVE-BULLET
description: In this contemporary world, Cupids solve problems of love not with bows and arrows but with guns! However, when the Cupids get in an argument over how to solve a love triangle…a full on shoot-out occurs?! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Kanna
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm [Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s mentor. She's known to be laid-back and often runs away from fights between cupids. However, she will do anything to let Koharu succeed.

characters.name: Koharu
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm A shy, inexperienced cupid, mentored by [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/342734). Despite being new to the job, her insight gives her amazing matchmaking abilities.

characters.name: Chiyo
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm A reckless cupid who loves fighting other cupids more than anything. Her energetic nature seems to land her in trouble a lot.

characters.name: Ena
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A cautious, yet strong-willed cupid. Having a fair amount of experience, Ena is determined to make sure the job of matchmaking is done well.

characters.name: Aki Tamaki
characters.description: [Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s best friend from high school. Aki is bold and brutally honest, unafraid to express her opinion. She confessed to Koharu right before the latter died.

title: Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaete mo Omaera ga Warui!
title_original: 私がモテないのはどう考えてもお前らが悪い!
title_en: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
description: Kuroki Tomoko is a super popular, high school girl, who has had 50 years of dating experience, and 100 boys... in the Otome game world. In the real world, she is a 15 year old shut in, who has all of the qualities of a "mojo" (喪女, a gloomy or unpopular woman). However, when school isn't going as she expected, and she isn't as popular as she had thought she was, she takes a look at herself in the mirror for the first time in a few years, and has some shocking revelations...

characters.name: Tomoko Kuroki
characters.description: Socially inept and often desperate, the series chronicles her various attempts to try to be more popular at her school, Makuhari Shuuei High School. She is 15 years old at the time of the series' debut and was born towards the end of February of either 1994, 1997, or 1998. Tomoko started off very excited about high school. After all, she had had over 50 years of dating experience with over 100 boys in otome games, and she could not have been more enthralled with the years of popularity her secondary education was bound to bring! However, after going two months without speaking to anyone in her class, Tomoko is baffled by her continuing lack of notoriety and becomes more determined than ever to gain her peers' approval. In both the manga and anime, Tomoko debuts looking up the definition of "unpopular girl"--"mojyo" spelled in the English titles later--on the internet only to discover she

characters.name: Yuu Naruse
characters.description: Yuu is Kuroki Tomoko's old friend from middle school. Back then she had rather average looks and average grades. After she entered high school she saw that everyone was being flashy and she felt out of place. Soon after, she started wearing contacts, bleached her hair and now looks all flashy and beautiful as well.

characters.name: Tomoki Kuroki
characters.description: Tomoko's younger brother.

characters.name: Kiko Satozaki
characters.description: Kiko is a cousin of Tomoko and Tomoki Kuroki. She first appears in the manga Chapter 14 and in the anime Episode 8 to visit the Kuroki family. While she is first amazed with Tomoko's stories about having a boyfriend, when she finds out Tomoko has been lying to her all this time, she starts to act superior to her. Eventually, Tomoko suspects that Kii treats her like a pet dog. It is implied that she is cheerful, since she is usually smiling. However, she is not as gullible as she once was before going into middle school, and Tomoko soon catches wind of this. (Source: WataMote Wikia)

characters.name: Hina Nemoto
characters.description: Hina Nemoto is a classmate of Tomoko since her first year in high school. Hina first met Tomoko during their entrance exam; however, Tomoko quickly forgot about her. She is Tomoko's high school classmate who wants to become a voice actress. While appearing friendly and vivacious, she often tries to keep herself above others while inwardly accusing them, including Tomoko, over "looking down" on her. She lost her middle school friends then vowed to put on an act in high school. She confesses to Tomoko that she wants to live a "slice-of-life anime lifestyle." Outwardly sociable, friendly and cheerful, she is usually seen talking and laughing with Okada, Kiyota, and Suzuki in class and hanging out with them after school. She inwardly worries how others see her and whether or not they feel they are better than her. She will subtly denigrate others and becomes upset if she feels they have exce

characters.name: Kotomi Komiyama
characters.description: Kotomi Komiyama is Tomoko and Yuu's classmate in middle school. She and Tomoko do not like each other very much and are usually forced to get along with each other when Yuu is around. She attends the same high school, Makuhari Shuuei High School, as Tomoko, though Tomoko had more or less completely forgotten about her. She has a crush on Tomoki, but Tomoko seemingly more or less ruined her chances of being with him. Kotomi is a shy girl but does not have the difficulty with social interactions that Tomoko has. If given the chance, she will willingly pontificate upon baseball and her favorite team to anyone. Much of her character is depicted reacting to Tomoko, making her appear resentful, judgmental, and jealous. However, she appears a much nicer person to other people. Despite her sometimes petty-level rivalry with Tomoko, she does not truly hate her. She can also become friends with he

characters.name: Yuri Tamura
characters.description: Yuri Tamura (田村 ゆり Tamura Yuri?) is Tomoko's classmate in her second and third year in high school. She officially meets Tomoko during class when the teacher puts her, Yoshida, and Ucchi in Tomoko's group for the school field trip to Kyōto. Prior to meeting Tomoko during their field trip, Yuri's apparent only friend was Mako. Through this field trip she becomes an acquaintance of Yoshida and meets Ucchi. She remains very untrusting of people, and she often sets up obstacles that can push people away. She appears aware of this tendency, and she confesses to herself that it bothers her.

characters.name: Yoshinori Kiyota
characters.description: Tomoko's Classmate.

characters.name: Megumi Imae
characters.description: The Student Council President of the School Tomoko attends.

characters.name: Ogino
characters.description: Tomoko's Gym Teacher. Later becomes her Homeroom teacher for 2nd and 3rd year of school.

characters.name: Akane Okada
characters.description: Very outspoken individual. Is also classmates with Tomoko.

characters.name: Tomoko no Haha
characters.description: The mother of Tomoko and Tomoki Kuroki.

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン
description: Miss Kobayashi is your average office worker who lives a boring life, alone in her small apartment–until she saves the life of a female dragon in distress. The dragon, named Tohru, has the ability to magically transform into an adorable human girl (albeit with horns and a long tail!), who will do anything to pay off her debt of gratitude, whether Miss Kobayashi likes it or not. With a very persistent and amorous dragon as a roommate, nothing comes easy, and Miss Kobayashi’s normal life is about to go off the deep end! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Damocles
characters.description: Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown. Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru. However, unlike other Chaos Dragons, he respects the non-interference laws preventing dragons from killing humans of Earth, although when angered, he attacks Kobayashi and threatens to leave her at the brink of death. Despite this, he cares for his daughter and is concerned for her safety and happiness.

title: Kase-san Series
description: Yamada may be shy and rather clumsy, but the flower gardens at her school have always brought her happiness. Suddenly, a different sort of beauty catches her eye–the vivacious track star, Kase-san. Although the two girls don’t seem to have much in common, they soon start a romance where each must learn an important lesson in tending their budding relationship. Can the two girls, so different from each other, learn how to make their first love blossom? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Volume 1: Asagao to Kase-san. (あさがおと加瀬さん。, Kase-san and Morning Glories) Volume 2: Obentou to Kase-san. (おべんとうと加瀬さん。, Kase-san and Bento) Volume 3: Shoutokeiki to Kase-san. (ショートケーキと加瀬さん。, Kase-san and Shortcake) Volume 4: Epuron to Kase-san. (エプロンと加瀬さん。, Kase-san and an Apron) Volume 5: Sakura to Kase-san. (さくらと加瀬さん。, Kase-san and Cherry Blossoms)

characters.name: Yui Yamada
characters.description: A quiet girl who is in charge of greenification. She's poor at sports and singing.

characters.name: Tomoka Kase
characters.description: A popular and handsome girl in the class next door to [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/125397)'s. She's the ace of the track and field club.

characters.name: Mikawa
characters.description: Yamada's classmate and best friend. She's in the tennis club. She can't handle the sight of blood well.

characters.name: Akane Inoue
characters.description: Akane Inoue, also known as Inoue-senpai, is a graduate and former member of the track and field club at Yui Yamada and Tomoka Kase's high school. ~!As a result of rumors, she is long believed by Yamada to be Kase's ex-girlfriend, although this is eventually proven to be false.!~

title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon
title_original: 美少女戦士セーラームーン
description: Usagi Tsukino is a normal girl until she meets up with Luna, a talking cat, who tells her that she is Sailor Moon. As Sailor Moon, Usagi must fight evils and enforce justice, in the name of the Moon and the mysterious Moon Princess. She meets other girls destined to be Sailor Senshi (Sailor Scouts), and together, they fight the forces of evil! (Source: Kodansha USA) Notes: - The tankoubon release contains 52 Acts and 9 bonus chapters across 18 volumes; chapter/volume counts follow the tankoubon release. - The shinsouban release contains the original 52 Acts plus 8 new Acts across 12 volumes, but no bonus chapters as all 9 were released separately in Sailor Moon Short Stories alongside another bonus chapter that was previously released in an artbook. - The kanzenban release contains both the 60 Acts and the 10 bonus chapters from the short story shinsoubans across 10 volumes.

characters.name: Usagi Tsukino
characters.description: __Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to know her sweet and selfless side. Usagi is a bit selfish and very much a crybaby, lazy, clumsy, and also an academic underachiever. She's also not very good at cooking. However, she cares deeply about her friends and family. Usagi is very trusting, and believes that everyone has a better nature. She doe

characters.name: Ami Mizuno
characters.description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

characters.name: Rei Hino
characters.description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate from the other girls.

characters.name: Makoto Kino
characters.description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

characters.name: Minako Aino
characters.description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her to her life as a Senshi. He lives in her home (as [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) lives in Usagi's) and is one of her closest friends.

characters.name: Chibiusa
characters.description: Chibiusa's real name is actually Usagi, but she is nicknamed Chibiusa to distinguish her from [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). She is usually very upbeat, extroverted and outgoing. Though she started out socially awkward, she quickly became popular with her classmates in the 20th-century. Chibiusa's dream is to one day become a real lady, to have her own prince, and to be friends with everyone she knows. Meanwhile, she is a fairly ordinary little girl; she likes pink and red, pudding, pancakes, and rabbits. Her favorite school subject is drawing, while her least favorites are language classes. ~!Chibiusa is actually the future daughter of Usagi Tsukino and [Mamoru Chiba](https://anilist.co/character/4013/Chiba-Mamoru), and was sent back in time to the "present" to stay with them before she was born.!~

characters.name: Setsuna Meiou
characters.description: Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics. Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates, she becomes more friendly, but is still not very emotional, although there are moments in the manga where she expresses much more emotion than the anime. Sailor Pluto is much darker in her initial form in the manga, identified as the "Guardian of the Underworld" with very dark skin and a black sailo

characters.name: Michiru Kaiou
characters.description: Introduced in the third story arc, Michiru fights alongside her partner and lover Haruka in defending the Solar System from outside threats. In both versions of the story, she is elegant, sophisticated, capable of sharp anger, and sometimes cold. She is fully dedicated to her duty as a Senshi. Her Senshi alter-ego is Sailor Neptune, one of the "four soldiers of the outer solar system". As Sailor Neptune, her element of influence is the sea(not with water in general as Sailor Mercury's powers are); as with many of the other Senshi, this element is closely associated with her planet, which is named for the Roman sea god, Neptune. She is one of the Senshi who has natural psychic powers, alerting her when danger is near. She seems to be a character with a very deep understanding of things, sometimes even surpassing the other Outer Senshi due to her unnaturally high psychic endowments. Michir

characters.name: Haruka Tenou
characters.description: Haruka is a stubborn, protective individual, but is also strong-willed, capable, charming, and occasionally even doting. She is formally introduced in the third story arc, although she appears in silhouette alongside [Sailor Neptune](https://anilist.co/character/2829/Kaiou-Michiru) in the final episode of [Sailor Moon R](https://anilist.co/anime/740/-R/). When transformed, she is known as Sailor Uranus, and is part of the group known in Fanon as the Outer Senshi. Haruka is a racecar driver, even though she is barely sixteen years old when she appears. However, the timing of her birthday to the Japanese school year means she is one grade ahead of the Inner Senshi.

characters.name: Hotaru Tomoe
characters.description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

characters.name: Mamoru Chiba
characters.description: Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of [Usagi Tsukino](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted. ~!This may be because when he was young his parents died in a car crash. This blocked his childhood memories of his current lifetime and opened up the memories of his previous life as Prince Endymion. Tuxedo Mask is a disguise Mamoru created for himself in order to hunt for the Silver Crystal incognito and, later, assist the Sailor Senshi in battle. He is always addressed as Mamo-chan by Usagi throughout the series (Chibiusa also addresses him with this nickname later on). After dating for two years, Mamoru gives Usagi an engagement ring at an airport. The couple eventually gets married. In the future, they become king and queen of Earth and Crystal Tokyo and have a child together whom they name, Small Lady, but is in the

characters.name: Seiya Kou
characters.description: **Membership:** American Football **Responsibilities:** Lead Vocal, Keyboard Kou Seiya is the leader of the Sailor Starlights and the lead vocalist for the Three Lights. In general, Seiya acts arrogant and tends to be, at least on the surface, confident in their own abilities. Over the course of the series, Seiya develops strong feelings for [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino), and his attempts to forge a bond with her provides the primary romantic tension of the season. From their first meeting on, Seiya calls Usagi odango, like [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/4013/Mamoru-Chiba) does. The two even go on a date at an amusement park, which prematurely ends when [Sailor Iron Mouse](https://anilist.co/character/12418/Sailor-Iron-Mouse-) attacks. The relationship between Sailor Star Fighter and [Princess Kakyuu](https://anilist.co/character/11900/Kakyuu-Koujo) is s

title: Kemono Jihen
description: Inugami is a Tokyo detective who specializes in the occult. One day, answering a call to a remote village leads him to Dorotabo: a peculiar boy nicknamed after a yokai that haunts muddy rice paddies. The boy has no parents and is somewhat unnerving, emitting a foul odor that draws the ire of those around him. Inugami, however, quickly realizes that there’s something more monstrous about Dorotabo than just his nickname–a fact proven when the two of them investigate an inhuman creature attacking local livestock. Perhaps Inugami can take this mistreated boy under his wing and train him to face the secret, supernatural beasts hidden in the world…using the eerie powers of his own body. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Kabane Kusaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm __Species:__ Half-Human/Half-Ghoul __Abilities:__~!• *Regeneration:* Kabane is able to regrow body parts that have been ripped off. Even as to being decapitated, he can regrow his body. His regeneration powers are also seen even his body is burnt leaving only his skull alone. Due to this, his regeneration powers are utilized by [Nobimaru](https://anilist.co/character/154753/Homuramaru-Nowaki) to defeat [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/154756/Yui). However, there are restrictions to his regenerative powers, he cannot regrow back his body when enclose in a small space like a suitcase. If his body is set on flames, there is a possibility that the rate at which he burns will exceed the way he regenerates, possibly resulting to his body breaking down. When decapitated, his separated body cannot be attached back to his head, hence, the separated body will remain as a corps

characters.name: Akira
characters.description: __Height__: 159 cm __Species__: Snow Kemono Akira, is the fifty-sixth child of Shirona of the Snow Village in Mount Iwaki. He's currently an employee of the Kemono office. Akira is a very energetic and approachable person but sometimes clumsy, sometimes even not being able to complete tasks properly. He also likes cute things and is seen constantly talking selfies to commemorate what he feels and currently doing. Akira is very fragile and gets grossed out and gets scared easily to the sight of insect, other dirty things and when in danger. However, despite these weaknesses, Akira can be seen as a reliable friend, willing to overcome his fears just to save his friends. Akira came to Inugami to look for his older brother. Before coming to Tokyo, he lived deep in the mountains of Aomori with his family. However, when they tried to run away, they got separated. Because Akira is a Yuki-onoko

characters.name: Shiki Tademaru
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Species:__ Half-human/Half-Arachne Up until he came to Inugami's detective agency and before his uncle took care of him, he lived in Kinshi-Go in the Gunma Prefecture with his mother. Shiki initially comes off as a bully, holding his age of one year over Kabane as an authority, and telling the other boy they aren't friends because they're both hybrids. But this is shown to only be a facade, as he shows surprise at Kabane never having had pizza, and laughing when the other first had trouble trying it. But as Akira says, he's only self-conscious due to the fact another hybrid sits under the same roof as him. When on a job, he can see things in a calm and cautious manner. He is also able to judge and react to things in a fast manner, like using his thread to protect him and Akira from Kon's attacks. However, he can also be seen with a short temper. When faced with intim

characters.name: Kohachi Inugami
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm __Species:__ Bakedanuki A detective that specializes in the occult. Inugami runs a Kemono detective agency in Tokyo. After meeting [Kabane](https://anilist.co/character/154749/Kusaka-Kabane), he took him with him in order to help him find his parents. Inugami is a calm person who doesn't like conflict and is kind enough to follow Kabane and the others casually. He is good at taking care of the children, even helping them in their own various circumstances. As the head of the detective agency, he is good at solving and making sure the job is done right.

characters.name: Mihai Florescu
characters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm __Species:__ Vampire Member of the Inugami Detective Agency. Mihai is a several hundred years old vampire Kemono from Romania. Over his life, he has apparently acquired professional-level expertise and knowledge in numerous fields, to the point that he had run out of things to do. Sometime in the past, he became an acquaintance to [Kohachi Inugami](https://anilist.co/character/154747/Inugami-Kohachi). When Mihai had started to become disillusioned with life, Inugami asked him to come to Japan and work for the former's detective agency, where he become absorbed in Japanese online games. Mihai is a callous and self-centered individual who considers the people around him to be toys for his amusement. He is willing to lie and manipulate others into perilous situations for his own entertainment. He does not seem to be able to understand how other people react to the result

characters.name: Kon
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Species:__ Kitsune Kon formerly worked under [Yoko Inari](https://anilist.co/character/154758). Kon idolizes Inari and wants her attention as well as her approval. While seeming emotionless at first Kon does her best to please Inari who she perceives as a mother. She gets extremely mad at those who insult her. Kon was ignored and abandoned by Inari after failing her mission. Kon is not very intelligent or emotionally stable. Because she wants to be a "good girl" more than anything she will do anything to fulfill that role. If anything happens that she believes will prevent her from fulfilling that role, she becomes disoriented and goes into a blind rage.

characters.name: Yui
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm __Species:__ Snow Kemono Yui is Akira's older twin brother. ~!He is the former user of the nil calculus. In the snow village of mount Iwanki, Yui and his twin brother, Akira, were born. It has been said that a male Yuki-onna in their village is born once every hundred years. When growing up, the two would go near the barrier that protects the village but, kept getting caught. In a magazine Akira found on the mountain, he and his brother found about the Inugami detective agency and Tokyo. When the women of the village are deciding which of the twins should be chief, Yui volunteered to be it as he didn't want Akira to suffer. As chief, he would have sex with the women to make sure the village survived. He asked the women of the village to let them out of the barrier and promised them he would impregnate all of them if they accepted his request. They agreed and Yui talked

characters.name: Aya Tademaru
characters.description: __Height:__ 121 cm __Species:__ Half- Arachne The younger half-sister of Shiki Tademaru and revealed to be the Golden Thread. When first introduced Aya seemed to be shy and innocent to those around her. However, she is quickly revealed to be quite confident, loud-mouthed, and bratty- especially to Shiki. Despite being described as obnoxious by others, Aya is kind and often tries to help those that need her abilities. Aya is the result of many experiments of Akio Tademaru to be able to create the golden thread. She had the healing thread powers when she was born.

characters.name: Youko Inari
characters.description: Species: Kitsune The head of the Metropolitan Police Department. When she is first introduced to the story, she and Inugami were allies although they didn't particularly like each other. They become enemies and hate each other after she tried to steal Kabane's Life Calculus multiple times, and Inugami's group attacked her human meat company. Inari is selfish and cruel, she uses her illusions to control the police department and will throw away anyone that no longer fits her agenda. On the outside, she portrays herself as a nice and cheerful lady. She also doesn't hesitate to kill anyone just to cool down her anger. She is manipulative and sadistic, even using Kon as a servant, and making her believe that she is useful and important to her and even muddied her memories.

characters.name: Nowaki Homuramaru
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm __Species:__ Kitsune __Abilities:__ Replication: Nobimaru is able to replicate himself, producing many copies of himself to confuse the enemy. Transformation: Nobimaru is able to change his form from kid to an adult Subordinate of [Yoko Inari](https://anilist.co/character/154758/Inari-Youko). He is also the leader of the Special Investigation Unit. He has a polite and elusive personality. He always follows Inari's order to him without any hesitation. On the other hand, he sometimes shows his ruthless and brutal side, obliterating enemies with his own power if he feels he doesn't need them. Although he faithfully follows Inari's orders, he dislikes Inari secretly and acted according to his own considerations.

characters.name: Kaede Hanagata
characters.description: __Height:__ 196 cm __Species:__ Kitsune __Abilities:__ Fire Manipulation Kaede is a member of the Special Investigation Unit, headed by Nobimaru, under Inari's command. Kaede is the exact opposite of Akagi. Kaede has a bright and friendly personality even greeting strangers with a cheerful smile. But in reality he is self-centered, uninterested in others, ferocious, cruel, and very warlike. Sometimes considered as a little bit of an "airhead", when doing his job, he tends to act recklessly and just do whatever he wants. However, when given a job, he does not hesitate to kill anyone that prevents him from accomplishing it. Kaede can manipulate fire and the flames are powerful enough to burn up the Yashima Temple. This can be done by simply rubbing his fists

characters.name: Kazuaki Akagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm __Species:__ Kitsune __Abilities:__ Illusion Manipulation Member of the Special Investigation Unit, headed by Nobimaru, under Inari's command. Ever since he was a child, he has been taking medications because of his mysophobia. Even though he doesn't have an inferiority complex being unable to use flames, he felt a harshness to life. One day, he was approached by Nobimaru and agrees to join the Special Investigation since then, with Kaede as his work partner. Akagi has a calm personality. Because of his calm and collected personality, he plays the role of a stopper to control the outburst of Kaede as a buddy. He is also the type of person not idle enough to deal with trivial matters. Akagi has the power to manipulate illusions. However, he cannot perform his illusions since he's a germophobe and can't use his abilities without tissues.

title: Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou.
title_en: I’m in Love with the Villainess
description: The story of a reincarnated gamer pursuing her villainous lady love at a fantasy girls’ academy! Ordinary office worker Oohashi Rei has just woken up in the body of the protagonist of her favorite girls’ otome game, Revolution. To her delight, the first person to greet her is her favorite character, Claire Francois–who just so happens to be the main antagonist of the story. Now, Rei is determined to do what the game never allowed: romance Claire instead of one of the male leads. But how will her villainous lady love react to that?! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Aleah
characters.description: ~!Aleah is one of Rae and Claire's daughters, she was adopted along with her twin sister May.!~

characters.name: Misha Jur
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm (5'0") Misha is Rae's best friend and roommate at the Academy. She is a noble from a house that fell from grace and became impoverished. Despite the Jur family's struggles with money, she still holds some reputation. She is accepting of her position and, rather than hold onto the noble status, portrays herself as equal among people with common background. This allowed for Rae and Misha to form their longstanding friendship.

characters.name: May
characters.description: ~!May is one of Rae and Claire's daughters, she was adopted along with her twin sister Aleah.!~

characters.name: Lene Aurousseau
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm (5'1") Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid.
