Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

characters.name: Thane Bauer
characters.description: The second heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. Thane is often stoic and feels his abilities are inferior to his brothers, giving him a complex about it. Thane is considered as the least popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Yuu Bauer
characters.description: ~!Gender: Female!~ The third heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. A charismatic and attractive prince type who uses charm to mask a cunning mind. Yu is the second most popular capture target within the game. ~!Later in the story it is revealed that Yuu was born as female, but she was raised as a boy. She wishes to live as a girl again.!~

characters.name: Rod Bauer
characters.description: The eldest heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family and first in line to the throne. He is a energetic young man who becomes interested in Rae, much to her dismay. Rod is the most popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Manaria Sousse
characters.description: Manaria Sousse is the first crown princess of the kingdom of Sousse. She is a distant relative of Claire. She is the world's first confirmed quad-caster who possesses the highest aptitude in every element. ~!Manaria was Claire's first love, although she was first mistaken for a boy, and helped Claire overcome the trauma of losing her mother. They grew close after this incident and would continue writing to each other for years to come.!~

characters.name: Loretta Kugret
characters.original: ロレッタ・クグレット
characters.description: Loretta is from the House Kuguret, a family well known for their history of military service.

characters.name: Pipi Barlier
characters.description: Pipi is the daughter of the House Barlier, a family with deep-seated connections in Bauer’s business world. She is childhood friends with Claire François and Loretta Kugret.

title: 2.5 Jigen no Ririsa
description: “I have no interest in real girls!” So claims Okumura, the president of the school’s manga club. He’s your typical otaku, obsessed with a sexy (fictional) 2D manga character known as Lilliel. Then the new school year starts, and a (real!) 3D girl named Lilysa whose passion is cosplay joins the club. Lilysa convinces Okumura to become her photographer–and guess who her favorite manga character is? Not only that, but Lilysa is into modeling the fetishy stuff! The boundaries between 2D and 3D start to blur as this hot-blooded romantic comedy unfolds. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Notes: - Won 4th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category. - Includes 40 extra chapters.

characters.name: Masamune Okumura
characters.description: Masamune Okumura is a cosplay photographer and the president of the Manga Research Club.

characters.name: Ririsa Amano
characters.description: Ririsa is a beautiful first-year student who joins the manga club. Due to her passion for cosplay, she recruits [Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/169256/Okumura-Masamune) to be her photographer. Like Okumura, she is also a fan of Liliel. She was first inspired to become a cosplayer when she visited a cosplay event. Though initially oblivious, she starts to slowly fall in love with Okumura later on.

characters.name: Mikari Tachibana
characters.description: Mikari is a first-year student who is [Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/169256/Masamune-Okumura)'s childhood friend and [Ririsa](https://anilist.co/character/169257/Ririsa-Amano)'s classmate. A gorgeous and popular model, she has had a crush on Okumura since they were young, though he has never noticed.
One of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay. She considers [Mayura](https://anilist.co/character/321628/Hanyuu-Mayuri) her greatest rival.

characters.name: Mayuri Hanyuu
characters.description: One of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay.

characters.name: Noa Ebisu
characters.description: A first-year high school student who suffers from extreme communication disorder. Cosplays under the name "Nonoa" and is attracting attention as one of the rising stars of cosplay alongside [Ririsa Amano](https://anilist.co/character/169257/Amano-Ririsa). Famous for having a stoic expression while cosplaying, due to her communication disorder, with people calling her an "ice queen" as a result

characters.name: Marina Abe
characters.description: Vice president of the student council and Okumura's childhood friend.

characters.name: Yoki Hoshizuki
characters.description: One of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay.

characters.name: Ogino
characters.description: Magino's photographer.

title: Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete
title_original: 魔法少女にあこがれて
description: Hi, I'm Hiiragi Utena. I'm a normal magical-girl-loving middle school girl—or at least I was, but then some talking mascot showed up out of the blue and cast a spell on me! Now's my chance to join my beloved magical girls as...a villain? Hang on, something's wrong with my outfit! This can't be happening! (Source: J-Novel Club) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

characters.name: Utena Hiiragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Utena is a shy and introverted girl who longingly admires magical girls, collects their memorabilia, and talks passionately about them. Her obsession with Tres Magia even reached to the point where she wished to fight alongside them, but that ultimately led to her being tricked by [Venalita](https://anilist.co/character/301180). At times, she can be simple-minded.

characters.name: Kiwi Araga
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm She became a member of Enormeeta to beat up magical girls, because she hated that they got more attention than her on social media. Although Kiwi was initially hostile towards [Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), after undergoing shock training, she became docile and developed a crush on Utena. Now she is content with Utena's acknowledgement alone. Kiwi frequently fantasizes about going to a love hotel with Utena. Despite appearances she is decent enough academically to help Utena avoid her grades deteriorating. She and [Magia Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859) instinctively have it out for each other. They immediately devolve to insults and fighting at every opportunity — even in their civilian forms, despite not recognizing each other due to recognition inhibition.

characters.name: Korisu Morino
characters.description: __Height:__ 128 cm Korisu is a quiet and reserved girl, and the youngest member of Enormeeta. She has a large collection of old toys that are precious to her. Her theme is Alice in Wonderland.

characters.name: Nemo Anemo
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm __Favorite Food:__ Takoyaki __Least Favorite Food:__ Shiitake Mushrooms __Something That Made Her Happy Recently:__ Pulled Three SSRs In A Social Game Nemo is a snarky and crude girl. She is also quite arrogant, since she has a habit of taunting her opponents. She is also childhood friends with [Akoya Matama](https://anilist.co/character/255890). They have good teamwork when fighting together. However, they also argue often. In spite of this, they may have romantic feelings for each other.

characters.name: Matama Akoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm __Favorite Food:__ Sweet Rolled Omelettes __Least Favorite Food:__ Coriander __Recent Ambition:__ To Have A Video Of Her Singing Go Viral On Social Media Matama is a cheerful girl. However, she is also quite narcissistic and very sensitive to criticism. She fears both [Lord Enorme](https://anilist.co/character/288448) and [Magia Baiser Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), finding them both similar in that they use sexual harassment as punishment. She is terrible at singing except when engaging in exhibitionism, a fact discovered when Utena made her perform in the nude on threat of [Nemo](https://anilist.co/character/255889) being harmed.

characters.name: Sayo Minakami
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm Sayo is a calm and composed person, part of which is attributed to her being a shrine maiden. As shown in the flashback leading to her making the decision to become Magia Azul, she is also a brave person who does not hesitate to help others. Due to being restrained and tormented by Schiavo multiple times, Sayo began to develop masochistic tendencies. Her masochism and obsession with "fighting" with Enormeeta has gone to the point where she shows envy when [Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/191857/Hanabishi-Haruka) or [Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859/Tenkawa-Kaoruko) get the chance to fight them but she does not, as seen when she glares enviously and drools after seeing Magenta without her panties after the latter fought [Nero Alice](https://anilist.co/character/191858/Morino-Korisu).

characters.name: Haruka Hanabishi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Haruka is an extremely energetic and compulsive girl, always smiling and acting on her feelings. She cares a lot about Sayo and Kaoruko, admiring their strength and skill as magical girls. However, she is extremely naïve and gullible and seems to lack intelligence and common sense as well. Despite all this, Haruka is an extremely caring girl who cares about her friends and will go through any trial to protect them. When reflecting on being controlled by Baiser, she felt shame and regret over attacking Sulfur and Azul.

characters.name: Kaoruko Tenkawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 146 cm Kaoroku puts on a calm and cool mask for the public, but in reality she is a crude, foulmouthed, and short-tempered girl. She is also the most intelligent and cunning member of Tres Magia. She is not hesitant to start conflict, and will goad and taunt others, whether as herself or as Magia Sulfur.

characters.name: Momo Momomori
characters.description: A member of the Shio-chans, Momo seems to be very polite and respectful in her manner of speech. However, she is in reality an extremely perverted himejoshi. When Tres Magia was training, she created a hot spring near Sulfur and Magenta to entice them into bathing. She secretly joined them and listened to their conversation.

characters.name: Randa Tada
characters.description: Berserga is abjectly infatuated with Imitatio. She is also unstable, prone to sudden violent outbursts, proclaims herself to be completely emotionally deadened towards everyone other than Imitatio, and is perfectly ready to point a blade at her crush if she starts getting visibly excited by other girls, with Imitatio being forced to try to talk down the enraged Berserga rather than order her to cool it. ~!She was scouted by Vatz at some point in the past, going by the name Magia Blanc, but she has since changed her name and undergone La Verità. She was confirmed by Loco Musica and Leberblume to be a survivor of the Magical Girl Hunt, in which Lord Enorme let her go because of how weak she was.!~ ~!Randa became obsessed with Enorme as a result of this crushing defeat, and after Enorme was cast out of Enormeeta, Randa nursed her back to health in an attempt to get close to her. She was rej

characters.name: Lord Enorme
characters.description: Lord Enorme is cruel and remorseless, being the mastermind who caused the defeat and possible deaths of many magical girls. She is extremely arrogant and very self-entitled, believing that the world exists solely for the sake of being ruled by her. She takes pride in her actions, and does not hesitate to torture others for any reason, even her own subordinates.

characters.name: Venalita
characters.description: Venalita is a mascot who recruits magical girls for Enormeeta. He is shrewd and pragmatic, using whatever means necessary to recruit members into Enormeeta. He is also quick of mind, as he was able to successfully get Utena to forgive him for tricking her by making up a story about how his people are being killed by magical girls, and that he doesn't mind being labelled as evil as long as he can save them.

title: Ikemen Girl to Hakoiri Musume
title_original: イケメン女と箱入り娘
description: When Okuma Satomi's friend seeks her help wrangling guys for a crossdressing cafe, Satomi winds up with a boyfriend! Sort of. After asking her handsome and aloof classmate, Kanda Mizuki, to help out in the cafe, Mizuki agrees, but on one condition: the two of them must go on a date. Satomi eagerly agrees, delighted to have such a good-looking guy interested in her, but Mizuki realizes that Satomi has completely misunderstood something crucial: Mizuki is a girl! Will this case of mistaken identity blossom into something beautiful, or will the truth leave both girls brokenhearted? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes five bonus chapters.

characters.name: Satomi Ooguma
characters.description: An eccentric girl with a crush on her younger classmate, Kanda, who she wrongly believes to be a boy.

characters.name: Mizuki Kanda
characters.description: A boyish girl who ends up in a relationship with her older classmate, Ooguma, who believes her to be a boy and wants her to work at a cross-dressing cafe.

characters.name: Kai
characters.description: Kanda's friend

characters.name: Naru Kanda
characters.description: Kanda's little brother.

characters.name: Secchan
characters.description: Ookuma's friend.

characters.name: Shiba
characters.description: Kanda's friend.

characters.name: Akita
characters.description: Kanda's friend.

title: Pashiri na Boku to Koisuru Banchou-san
title_original: パシリな僕と恋する番長さん
title_en: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School
description: "Be mine." Unoki has always been bullied, and high school is no different. Right away, the top troublemaker, Boss Toramaru, makes him her personal errand boy. The only thing is...she thought she was asking him out?! So Toramaru is sure they're dating, while Unoki is convinced he's under her thumb. The stage is set for a rom-com of misunderstandings! (Source: One Peace Books) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

characters.name: Kanade Toramaru
characters.description: The top delinquent in the school, who's also in love with protagonist, Unoki.

characters.name: Tzuka
characters.description: A girl Toramaru often fights with

characters.name: Unoki no Haha
characters.description: Fuyuhiko's mother.

characters.name: Unoki no Imouto
characters.description: Fuyuhiko's sister.

characters.name: Toramaru no Haha
characters.description: Kanade's mother.

title: BURN THE WITCH
description: Historically, 72% of all the deaths in London are related to dragons, fantastical beings invisible to the majority of the people. While unknown to most, some people have been standing up to these dragons. Only inhabitants of Reverse London who live in the hidden "reverse" side of London can see the dragons. Even then, only a selected few become qualified enough as witches or wizards to make direct contact with them. The protagonists of the story are witch duo Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole. They are protection agents for Wing Bind (WB), an organization for dragon conservation and management. Their mission is to protect and manage the dragons within London on behalf of the people. (Source: Official Anime Site) Note: Chapter count includes the one-shot, labeled as “Chapter 0.8”.

characters.name: Noel Niihashi
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Wing Bind __Profession:__ Witch, High School Student __Position:__ 1st Order Conservation, Ranger "Pipers" __Partner:__ [Ninny Spangcole](https://anilist.co/character/127130/Ninny-Spangcole) __Base of Operations:__ Reverse London A Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Ninny Spangcole.

characters.name: Ninny Spangcole
characters.original: ニニー・スパンコール
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Wing Bind __Profession:__ Witch, Singer __Position:__ 2nd Order Conservation, Ranger "Pipers" __Partner:__ [Noel Niihashi](https://anilist.co/character/127129) __Base of Operations:__ Reverse London A Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Noel Niihashi.

characters.name: Balgo Ywain Parks
characters.description: __Race:__ Human, Dragon __Type:__ Dragonclad __Affiliation:__ Wing Bind A human who became a Dragonclad after living with Selvie for 10 years and being bitten by him. He is currently looked after by Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole.

characters.name: Osushi
characters.description: __Race:__ Dragon __Type:__ Disguiser/Dark Dragon __Owner:__ [Balgo Parks](https://anilist.co/character/185999/Balgo-Ywain-Parks) A Dragon masquerading as Balgo Parks's pet dog in London. In his dog form, Osushi is a small Pomeranian with light-colored fur and dark paws. In his Dark Dragon form, Osushi is a large, black dragon with a light underbelly, four thick legs and two enormous wings. He is heavily scaled and possesses many sharp teeth.

characters.name: Bruno Bangnyfe
characters.original: ブルーノ・バングナイフ
characters.description: The leader of the Inks division of Wing Bind.

characters.name: Roy B. Dipper
characters.description: The leader of the Anthems division of Wing Bind.

characters.name: Sullivan Squire
characters.original: サリバン・スクワイア
characters.description: The leader of the Sabres division of Wing Bind.

characters.name: Wolfgang Slashhaut
characters.original: ウルフギャング・スラッシュハウト
characters.description: The leader of the Gallows division of Wing Bind.

characters.name: Billy Banx Jr.
characters.description: Billy Banx Jr. is a member of the Pipers of Wing Bind and Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole's commanding officer. He was briefly a member of the Sabres until he was demoted for laziness.

characters.name: Macy  Baljure
characters.original: メイシー・バルジャー
characters.description: Former member of the pop idol group Cecile Die Twice.

characters.name: Elly
characters.description: Macy's pet dragon.

characters.name: Cquntnire Milieve
characters.original: キュントナイア・ミリーヴ
characters.description: The leader of the Sacreds division of Wing Bind.

title: Munou na Nana
description: An academy on an island in unnavigable waters. There, students trained tirelessly, to fight back against the enemies of humanity. The protagonist, a student newly transferred there, also sets out with the intention of eradicating all enemies of humankind. An unpredictable, intellectual suspense story of justice and evil. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Nana Hiiragi
characters.description: A main character of Talentless Nana. Her talent is mind-reading. ~!Her mind-reading ability is a lie and she's talentless. She uses logical deductions and improvisation to fake her ability.!~ A cute and observant, though somewhat pushy girl. Despite her mind-reading talent, she admits she's not good at reading the room. ~!Nana Hiiragi is actually the protagonist of Talentless Nana. Cruel and calculating, she is an antiheroine who has been sent to the island by the government to stop the Talented from fostering their abilities by assassinating them one by one.!~ ~!Has had a personal vendetta against the Talented ever since they killed her parents in a break-in. She blames her ditzy young self for it.!~ ~!Becomes disillusioned with her goal and vows to never kill again after she learns that each of the Talented's theoretical "body counts" are entirely fabricated.!~

characters.name: Kyouya Onodera
characters.description: ~!Kyouya's immortality allow's him to take attacks that would usually kill someone, and it is shown when he is attacked that he can somewhat regenerate. Although he has immortality he can still feel pain to an extent.!~ ~!The price of his immortality is that he can only remember the last 2 years. He writes about his experiences in notebooks, so he can read them and remember past events.!~

characters.name: Nanao Nakajima
characters.description: ~!Can neutralize other people’s powers.!~ ~!After his ability mutates, he is able to neutralize the human body functions too. This can mean neutralizing their bodily functions (breathing, heartbeat, etc.). In addition, the extent of neutralizing human body functions allows him to neutralize people's moral capacity, turning them into temporary killing machines. He is essentially able to mind-control them into the killing.!~

characters.name: Moguo Iijima
characters.description: __Talent:__ Fire powers. He can engulf his fists in flame and shoot beams of fire from them.

characters.name: Michiru Inukai
characters.description: ~!She has a Healing ability. Although unlike normal healing, she is giving up her lifespan to heal another. Often times after she heals a major injury, she feels lightheaded and sick. Her healing was shown to be of Type Heavy Injuries as she was able to completely heal Nana having received a fatal injury. She can do Resurrection, though it is at the cost of her life.!~ ~!Her body is revealed to still be cared for. While her heart has stopped, her body is still warm even after events of the island. !~

characters.name: Youhei Shibusawa
characters.description: Youhei has the ability to go back in time up to 24 hours, however the further back he goes, the more tired he is when he returns. If someone from the past sees him, he's sent back to the present immediately.

characters.name: Jin Tachibana
characters.description: __Talent:__ ~!Transformation. He can shapeshift into any living animal or Talented human, unless someone is watching him.!~ ~!His real ability is Telekinesis.!~ A former Talented student from five years ago. Presumed dead. ~!The only survivor from the previous class of Talenteds. Has been living on the island ever since the previous class destroyed themselves in a brutal war.!~ ~!While it's unclear if his real name is Jin Tachibana, the body he uses the most often is not his own.!~

characters.name: Seiya Koori
characters.description: __Talent:__ Ice powers. He's been shown to freeze objects and water. He can not freeze living things. A regular flirt, despite having a girlfriend.

characters.name: Tsunekichi Hatadaira
characters.description: ~!his talent is to see the future and to take photos of it.!~

characters.name: Shinji Kazama
characters.description: __Talent:__ Necromancy, he can manipulate dead bodies at will, see through their eyes, access their memory, and use their talents. Close friend of Yuka Sasaki. ~!His real talent is Super Strength. Yuka, the true necromancer, has been controlling Shinji's corpse and lied about her and Shinji's talents.!~

characters.name: Yuuka Sasaki
characters.description: __Talent:__ Super Strength. Disabled when her animal allergies act up. Close friends with Shinji Kazama. ~!Her true talent is Necromancy. She can manipulate the dead, as well as call on their memories and use their talents.!~

characters.name: Kirara Habu
characters.description: __Talent:__ Venom. Her saliva is poisonous, but she has to eat poisonous animals to refuel it. Friends with Kaori Takanashi, and bully of Michiru.

title: Mahou Shoujo Site
description: Asagiri Aya has a difficult life. The middle school girl the target of cruel bullying at school by day, and violent abuse at home by night. One day, while surfing the web, she came across a creepy figure who granted her a gift of magic power… (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

characters.name: Aya Asagiri
characters.description: At school she gets tacks put in her shoes, glue put on her desk, her head shoved in a toilet, and even worse than that. At home, her older brother who is stressed from trying to live up to their father's expectations ties her up, strips her, and beats her to relieve his stress. All Aya thinks about every day amidst the hell that is her life is dying. But one day a strange website called "Mahou Shoujo Site" pops up on her computer. The next day, the bullies at her school push her past the limit once again, but this time things go a little differently.

characters.name: Tsuyuno Yatsumura
characters.description: __Height:__ 5'0" She is a magical girl with the power to stop time. She tells Aya information about the magical girls and allies with her so they can be safer together. Unlike Aya, she does not have a problem using her power to injure or kill people who she dislikes. She was born in a city called Kanagawa, her hobbies are sleeping, gaming, and swimming, her advantages are that she's friendly, fit and takes the initiative. Tsuyuno doesn't like meat or waking up in the morning, but does like vegetables, games on her phone, honey, yogurts, cute things and advertising mascots.

characters.name: Kayo Komura
characters.description: is a protagonist of Mahou Shoujo Site. She is the daughter of Detective Keiji Komura and Sachiko Komura and the older sister of Airi Komura. Thanks to her compact-shaped staff obtained by an Administrator, she can copy the staffs of the Magical Girls when she touches their hands or touches any part of their bodies and use their abilities, although she has a limitation, that is that she can only use alone once the ability of each copied staff, Best friend of Sakura

characters.name: Kogami Kii
characters.description: A normal high school freshman, doesn't want to get involved in anything bothersome or build up unneeded stress.

characters.name: Fukumoto Tsukune
characters.description: Childhood friend of Kogami Kii __10 years ago arc__ ~!When Kogami enters her room, he finds disgusting looking drawings of these mahou shoujos in this box she kept, which therefore proves that she has something to do with this whole thing.!~

characters.name: Hanzawa Yoruka
characters.description: Sophomore student

characters.name: Rintarou Akuta
characters.description: Rintarou Akuta was a police officer before the magical girl attack where his sanity had slipped by the time he met the survivors from the high school, who sought refuge in the mall where he was apparently working.

characters.name: Kaede Sayano
characters.description: In the same year as Kii. Along with Ootsuki, she cruelly bullied Tsukune. ~!She confesses to Kii that she has always loved him since elementary school.!~

characters.name: Kosame Amagai
characters.description: A mahou shoujo with healing powers. She can heal others by cutting her wrist and letting them drink her blood. ~!She received her stick from Hatchi, the admin of another mahou shoujo site, after being diagnosed with cancer.!~

characters.name: Kaname Asagiri
characters.description: Aya's older brother. He introduces himself to parents and teachers as a studious and serious boy but uses his adoptive sister to let off steam, beating and humiliating her.

characters.name: Nijimi Anazawa
characters.description: Nicknamed Nijimin, she is the most popular idol of the idol group 'Inu Asobi' (Puppy Play). Aya and Tsuyuno try to meet her based on a Slaughter Note of wands Rina was carrying. Though her normal demeanor is very perky and friendly, when shown a picture of Rina she becomes very upset and homicidal.

characters.name: Rina Shioi
characters.description: She is a very intelligent girl, analyst, strategist and somewhat clumsy, but when discovering the truth about the Tempest her way of acting changed radically to a more sinister, aggressive, psychopathic attitude and with murderous instincts to obtain all the possible magical objects. She is also quite sarcastic and sometimes does not take the situations seriously. She also has a warmer personality that is not usually shown when she wanted to shake hands with Tsuyuno.

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai
title_original: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい
title_en: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
description: At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye. Everyone, that is, except Sheena, who wishes for nothing more than the growing conflict around her to end. On the night of her roommate's death, Sheena meets a strange girl covered in blood, who smiles despite the turmoil surrounding them. The next day, the girl appears as a new student in Sheena's class and introduces herself as Mimi. Initially thought to be a school myth, there are now whispers in the orphanage's halls that Mimi is their secret weapon—an immortal who cannot die. When Mimi is later assigned as Sheena's new roommate, Sheena's world grows even more complicated when she begins living with someone who loves and welcomes death, when all Sheena wants to do is stop it… (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Sheena Totsuki
characters.description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

characters.name: Mimi Kagari
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena). She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

characters.name: Seiran Lizzy
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm She is a serious person with a strong sense of justice. Whenever one of her classmates behaves in a frivolous manner, she scolds them. But every time she does so, [Ali](https://anilist.co/character/229291/Maud-Ali) calms her down. She shows glimpses of a strong connection with Ali that goes beyond friendship.

characters.name: Ali Maud
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm She has a calm personality, always smiling, and is more mature than the other students. She has a bold personality and expresses her thoughts directly, which makes [Seiran](https://anilist.co/character/229290/Lizzy-Seiran) worry about her.

characters.name: Halfred Anhalt
characters.original: アンハルト・ハルフレズ
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena)'s classmate. When younger, they disliked wearing the hand-me-down skirts from their older sisters, and asked for their brother's shorts instead, leading them to be criticized for not acting "like a girl" and causing problems for their family. At present, they are still figuring out their identity, and about relationships. They are intrigued by Mimi and Sheena's bond. Their favorite food is anything easy they can carry to their room.

characters.name: Esta Nino
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm An upperclassman from class 16. Esta puts on a cheery demeanor and is kind to both her juniors and classmates. She would often ignore her own health and lets others have priority when it comes to getting treatment, regardless of how bad her own condition might be. She is roommates with a classmate named [Heather](https://anilist.co/character/402132/Heather).

characters.name: Omi
characters.description: The homeroom teacher for Class 14, to which [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and the others belong. Despite her detached demeanor, she truly cares about her students.

characters.name: Fran
characters.description: The school nurse at the school [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and her friends attend. She is skilled in healing magic and is indispensable to the school. She’s always looking out for [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi).

characters.name: Heather
characters.description: An upperclassman from class 16. She is roommates with a classmate named [Esta](https://anilist.co/character/380872/Nino-Esta).

title: After God
description: Japan has been invaded by Gods, leaving giant Danger Zones where once were cityscapes. While patrolling the area, Anti-God researcher Tokinaga discovers Kamikura Waka looking forlornly through the protective fence. In her eyes, he spots something deep and dangerous. Something capable of changing the world... (Source: Comikey)

characters.name: Sachiyuki Tokinaga
characters.description: Tokinaga is a young male veterinarian who belongs to the Anti-God Science Institute, Anti-God Weapon Development Department, Biotechnology Section.

characters.name: Waka Kamikura
characters.description: Kamikura Waka is a high school girl who has the eyes of a "God". Waka is originally from Saga prefecture, and came to Tokyo in the hopes of meeting a god. When she was in her third year of middle school, she suddenly received the eyes of a god for reasons unknown to her.

characters.name: Nyababa
characters.description: An artificial being belonging to the Anti-God Science Institute, Anti-God Weapon Development Department, Biotechnology Section. Combining the loveliness of a cat, the curiosity of a mouse, the sense of rhythm of a parakeet, and the intelligence of a human, it looks like a fat cat with wings.

characters.name: Obikawa Kiyoshi
characters.description: Obikawa is a resident in Tsurukame Villa along with Tokinaga and the landlord Ikari-san. ~!He is, in actuality, the snake Ipo known as Orokapi, who had eaten the original Obikawa Kiyoshi and took over his body.!~

title: Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi
title_original: カナン様はあくまでチョロい
description: Kanan, a female demon, infiltrates a high school with the goal of devouring some delicious human souls. She sets her sights on the perfect target, a teen boy named Kyogi Yoji, and goes for the kill—only to somehow end up in a relationship with him instead?! Kanan’s never been in love before, and this oddly innocent demon creates absolute chaos as the two venture into romance with a first date and beyond! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Kanan Zebul
characters.description: Kanan Takakiyo, at first glance, is an ordinary teenage girl who is president of her high school's public morals committee. However, this is all a facade - her true identity is Kanan Zebel, a thousand-year-old demon who is the daughter of [Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/), the Great Demon of Gluttony. Eager to consume human souls, she descended to the human world and used hypnotism to convince an ordinary family that she was their firstborn - all so that she could find a student to consume. Her search brought her to [Youji Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/), her kohai in school who mistakenly believes she wants to go out with him. Unfortunately, there is one caveat to her plan... she has never been in a relationship before.

characters.name: Youji Kyougi
characters.description: A high school boy one year Kanan's junior. Kanan has chosen him as a target to devour his soul, but he mistakenly believes that she's confessing to him and becomes her boyfriend. Aggressively in love with Kanan.

characters.name: Ami
characters.description: Kanan’s childhood friend and loyal maid. As a succubus, she often takes… snack breaks daily.

characters.name: Jeanne
characters.description: Jeanne is one of the Lord's servants who descended from Heaven and is on a mission to protect Kyougi from demons.

characters.name: Lilim Zebul
characters.description: Lilim is the mother of [Kanan](https://anilist.co/character/282076/Zebul-Kanan), [Miel](https://anilist.co/character/318831/Zebul-Miel), and [Milch](https://anilist.co/character/318832/Zebul-Milch), as well as the wife of the [Great Demon Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/Beelzebub). She is afraid of men who are not her husband.

characters.name: Miel Zebul
characters.description: Miel is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the youngest child of the Zebel family. She is deeply fond of her oldest sister but gets a rush whenever she witnesses moments of proximity between Kanan and Youji. ~!In her free time, she streams online under the alias Honey Bunny.!~

characters.name: Milch Zebul
characters.description: Milch is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the middle child of the Zebel family. She’s always interested in Kanan’s things, including her new boyfriend. The brattiest of the bratty little girls.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.description: He's the father of Kanan, Miel and Miltie as well as the husband of Lillum.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Masurao
characters.description: She's a classmate of [Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/Kyougi-Youji) as well as his childhood friend. She doesn't like it when people call her Masurao because it comes off as manly.

characters.name: Kodagon
characters.description: She's the daughter of [Dagon](https://anilist.co/character/399870/), the man that [Lillum](https://anilist.co/character/318830/) rejected.

title: Exorcist wo Otosenai
title_original: エクソシストを堕とせない
title_en: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love
description: A boy was chosen by god to become the world's strongest exorcist and to face deadly demons in battle. Burdened with the fate of humanity, all he really wants to do is quietly bake sweets, when one day a certain girl enters his life… A story of love and hope blooming during a bloody holy war! (Source: MANGA Plus)

characters.name: Shinpu
characters.description: Father-kun was sent by God to protect the innocent, his main mission is to protect [Imuri Atsuki](https://anilist.co/character/284738/Imuri-Atsuki) from different demons sent by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/305829/Satan) himself. He is a boy who is quite calm in general, he likes peace, baking, and cute things.

characters.name: Imuri Atsuki
characters.description: A young girl who loves painting and drawing, she likes very much the works that represent themes related to religion. ~!She works for Satan in order to trap the Priest, but it seems that may not happen as planned, love feelings could disturb it.!~

characters.name: Mammon
characters.description: Mammon is the Demon Lord of Greed and part of the Seven Deadly Sins.

characters.name: Leviathan
characters.description: Leviathan is the Demon Lord of Envy and one of the Seven Deadly Sins.

characters.name: Satan
characters.description: Satan is the main antagonist and the Demon Lord of Wrath, one of the Seven Deadly Sins. He rules over all of Gehenna. He once challenged God to battle and became a fallen angel as a result.

characters.name: Mikhail
characters.description: A powerful exorcist of the church and a famous influencer who is obsessed with his own cuteness.

characters.name: Barbara
characters.description: Barbara is a nun sent by the Vatican to supervise Imuri Atsuki under the cover of becoming her new guard along with Leah.

characters.name: Leah
characters.description: Leah is a German nun sent by the Vatican to supervise Imuri Atsuki under the cover of becoming her new guard along with Barbara.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.description: Beelzebub is the Demon Lord of Gluttony and one of the Seven Deadly Sins.

characters.name: Vergilius
characters.description: Vergilius, is the Witch of Gluttony. He is one of the strongest witches of his Sabbath, despite only having been a witch for a decade. His former, human name is unknown, and he wants to kill God.

characters.name: Dante
characters.description: Mr. Priest's master, and a former friend of Vergilius. ~!He is later revealed to be Vergilius' ex-lover.!~

characters.name: Asmodeus
characters.description: Is the Demon Lord of Lust and one of the Seven Deadly Sins.

title: Mahou Sensei Negima!
description: After graduated from a magic academy, 10-year-old genius boy Negi Springfield was assigned to a huge Japanese school as an English teacher for practical training. To his surprise, the 8th grade class assigned for him is all-girl. In addition to teaching (and being teased by) those 31 pretty girls while trying to keep his magic capability in secret, he's also looking for clues about his father, who was once known as "Thousand Master" but mysteriously disappeared years ago. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Negi Springfield
characters.original: ネギ・スプリングフィールド
characters.description: Negi Springfield is the teacher of Mahora Girls' Jr High School class 3-A (formerly 2-A) with formerly 31 students, now reduced to 30. Negi Springfield is the son of the master mage Nagi Springfield, famously known as the legendary "Thousand Master", and Princess Akira of the Ostian Empire in the magic world. At present, Negi has formed 11 temporary pactio with his students (Asuna, Nodoka, Setuna, Konoka, Yue, Haruna, Chisame, Kazumi, Kaede, Ku Fei, and Chachamaru) and 1 temporary pactio with Theo, which gives him the ability to allow him to use any of his partner's artifacts. Negi specializes in wind and lightning spells (his father's specialty) though he is initially lacking in battle experience. He later trains under Ku Fei in martial arts to make up for his weakness in close combat, advancing very quickly (even learning how to do instant movement, otherwise known as Shundou) and appl

characters.name: Asuna Kagurazaka
characters.description: __Affiliations:__ Art Club As one of the main characters of the series, Asuna has been known to have quite a short temper and frequently her actions are a bit rash, but at the same time, has some aspects that display her maturity, especially when it comes to doing the right thing. Although at first she really detests Negi, over time she becomes like a big sister role model to him, as she does resemble Negi's cousin, Nekane, in a way.

characters.name: Setsuna Sakurazaki
characters.description: Setsuna is a Shinmeiryu swordswoman from Kyoto who was taken in by Eishun Konoe, Konoka's father and the leader of the Kyoto Mage Association. She is childhood friends with Konoka and her protector. Setsuna spends the beginning of the series being relatively cold to Konoka, wishing to protect her from the shadows due to not forgiving herself for being unable to save Konoka when she almost drowned when they were kids. She does eventually open up to Konoka after the Kyoto arc and begins calling her "Oujo-sama" and "Kono-chan". Setsuna's pactio, Sica Shishikushiro is a wakizashi which she can summon and multiply at will to strike targets like missiles. Due to her training she's also skilled in anti-demon arts and is the one who taught Negi how to create shikigami from paper. Setsuna is a hanyou like Koutaro, in particular a crow. She was expelled from her people because white wings are cons

characters.name: Chisame Hasegawa
characters.description: __Seat Number:__ 25 Chisame Hasegawa is the grumpy, unsocial computer hacker of the class, intentionally isolating herself due to her dislike of freaks and weirdos. However, Chisame secretly lives a double life as the famous web idol Chiu, where she can be popular without putting up with the local idiots. She likes small, powerful devices, such as sub-notepad PCs, but dislikes useless people and unexpected events.

characters.name: Evangeline Athanasia Katherine McDowell
characters.original: エヴァンジェリン・A.K.・マクダウェル
characters.description: __Seat Number:__ 26 __Clubs:__ Go Club, Tea Ceremony Club __Height:__ 130 cm (4'3") Evangeline is a centuries-old true blood vampire, cursed to remain at the school by [Nagi Springfield](https://anilist.co/character/4912/Springfield-Nagi). Initially an antagonist for [Negi](https://anilist.co/character/146/Springfield-Negi) due to his father's actions, she eventually becomes an important teacher and guide for the young mage and his allies. However, Eva remains a cruel, powerful mage in her own right, yet with the sensitivities of her former human life. Evangeline, having the reputation of a coldblooded killer, is feared in the magic side of the world. The legends surrounding her have gained her many monikers such as the Advent of Evil, the Apostle of Calamity, the Doll Master, and the Gospel of Darkness. In UQ Holder, a semi-sequel set 70 years into the future, she takes on the form of a

characters.name: Nodoka Miyazaki
characters.description: __Seat Number:__ 27 Class 2/3-A's resident bookworm, Nodoka is of the quiet but kind variety, harboring romantic feelings for her homeroom teacher, Negi Springfield. She has since confessed her feelings to him, but not much progress in their relationship has been made; they still remain friends. Nodoka is the second person to establish a probationary contract with Negi and gain a pactio card (it occured during the field trip to Kyoto). Her artifact is a book that can show one's thoughts in picture diary format.

characters.name: Konoka Konoe
characters.description: __Affiliations:__ Fortune-Telling Club, Library Exploration Club

characters.name: Yue Ayase
characters.description: __Seat Number:__ 4 Yue is Nodoka's best friend, and is often seen around both her and Haruna. She's short and at times has a blunt way of speaking to people, but is generally a friendly person. She likes to read but (ironically) doesn't like to study, and is one of the Baka Rangers (a name for the 5 worst students in Negi's class). When she finds out that Negi is a mage she gets excited about learning magic herself. At first she shows no romantic interest in Negi, but as time goes by she finds herself developing a crush on him. However she doesn't want to hurt Nodoka, so she tries to keep it bottled up as much as she can. She's supportive of Nodoka and wishes her the best of luck when it comes to her and Negi's relationship. Yue became the 5th person in Negi's class to make a Pactio with him, following Asuna, Nodoka, Setsuna, and Konoka.

characters.name: Albert Chamomile
characters.original: アルベール・カモミール
characters.description: A perverted lingerie stealing (once again a throw back to the typical manga male stock character archetype), chain-smoking, talking ermine, (though he has a long, and prehensile tail), that Negi freed from a trap when he was five years old. Since then, Chamo has been going to Negi whenever he ran into trouble. Chamo cares strongly for Negi and will fight to protect him, but he is not above using him to try to make a fast buck. Chief among those methods is attempting to make probationary contracts between Negi and as many of his students as possible, since the act nets him 50,000 Ermine Dollars per contract. Chamo often acts as Negi's trusty advisor in most things, though there are times his judgement and/or advice leaves much to be desired. He is skillful at analyzing dangerous situation and coming up with countermeasure when most of the others are in state of panic, but his plan usually

characters.name: Sister Shakti
characters.original: シスターシャークティ
characters.description: Sister Shakti is a mage teacher, who heads the Mahora nun patrol squad. She seems particularly skilled in combat and uses floating crosses in battle. Both Misora and Cocone are under her guidance at the church on Mahora's campus. Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Kaede Nagase
characters.description: __Seat Number:__ 20 __Clubs: Strolling Club__ Kaede Nagase is a practitioner of the Japanese martial art, ninjutsu. She trains in the mountains and is able to use a wide range of ninja abilities, such as creating clones. She has an easy-going attitude, and spends most of her time with her eyes nearly closed. Only in special situations does she open one eye, and in some cases both eyes. She is also the blue Baka Ranger, which in the anime is made up of 5 girls with the lowest grade averages in the class. She likes pudding and relaxing but hates frogs.

characters.name: Misora Kasuga
characters.description: __Seat Number__: 9 __Clubs:__ Track Team At the beginning of the manga, she doesn't have an active role. However, later ~!she is revealed to be able to use magic. She disguises herself as a sister when she uses and she's also shown a strong resistance in order to protect her secret identity (in vain, since Asuna noticed at first glance that she was Misora). Her artifact is a pair of super jet shoes.!~

title: Nettaigyo wa Yuki ni Kogareru
title_original: 熱帯魚は雪に焦がれる
title_en: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow
description: Konatsu is doing her best to adapt to her new school, but being required to join a club has introduced additional pressures. Her friendly classmate Kaede invites her to join the Home Ec Club, but Konatsu hasn’t even had time to consider which club she’s interested in. Meanwhile, Koyuki is like a ray of sunshine in Konatsu’s cloudy world. Will Konatsu join the Aquarium Club? (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Koyuki Honami
characters.description: She's the president of Nanahama High School's Aquarium Club. Her peers see her as out of reach, and by behaving in line with that impression others have of her, she feels a little smothered and lonely.

characters.name: Konatsu Amano
characters.description: She's a high school first-year student who transfered into Nanahama High School. While she was having trouble blending in with those around her, she met Koyuki, the sole member of the Aquarium Club and later joined the club.

characters.name: Kaede Hirose
characters.description: She's Konatsu's classmate. She has a cheerful personality and she has a lot of friends. She's friendly even to Konatsu who arrived as a transfer student.

title: Kakeochi Girl
description: Maki's first love was her high school classmate, a girl named Midori. But Midori broke up with Maki at graduation, saying they were now "too old to be fooling around dating girls." Ten years later, Maki still can’t get Midori off her mind, and when the two women reconnect after a chance encounter, Maki realizes that, while her feelings haven’t changed, Midori has long moved on—in fact, she's engaged. Yet the more Maki hears Midori talk about her soon-to-be-husband, the more red flags she notices. And Midori has another secret, one she hasn’t yet shared with Maki. Will it be the last blow to Maki's hopes that their romance might be rekindled? Or will it be the push that sets them on a new path—one they'll travel together? (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.name: Momo Makimura
characters.description: Midori’s former highschool girlfriend.

characters.name: Midori Oonishi
characters.description: Maki’s former highschool girlfriend.

characters.name: Tazune Tonoike
characters.description: Midori’s fiancé.

characters.name: Kon
characters.description: ~!Midori and Maki’s daughter, her father is Tazune.!~

characters.name: Komari Nikaidou
characters.description: Maki’s friend and confidante whom she met online. Still in school.

characters.name: Tama
characters.description: Komari’s friend.

characters.name: Azuki Doumyou
characters.description: Midori’s coworker.

title: Watashi wo Tabetai, Hitodenashi
title_original: 私を喰べたい、ひとでなし
title_en: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
description: “I’ve come to eat you.” So softly utters the mermaid Shiori as she emerges from the sea and takes high school girl Hinako by the hand. Hinako lives alone in a town by the sea and possesses an unusually delicious body that is irresistible to nearby monsters. To ensure that she matures to the best condition, Shiori seeks to protect Hinako—all so that someday, she can devour every piece of her. What will become of Hinako’s feelings as this looming unjust death closes in on her…? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Hinako Yaotose
characters.description: A High school girl living a quiet life in a seaside town, but she feels somewhat detached from her friends during the summer months. She lost her family on a trip when she was six years old. She has a deep, logical, calm and introverted personality. Rarely, she attracts aggressive monsters to her, including sea monsters from the shore. She seems to have signs of PTSD.

characters.name: Shiori Oumi
characters.description: The new transfer student and [Hinako Yaotose](https://anilist.co/character/250490/Yaotose-Hinako)'s classmate who's secretly a Mermaid. She enrolled to the same academy as Hinako even before summer break with the intent to eat Hinako. She has translucent eyes which resembles the ocean. She has an insightful, mysterious and refined personality.

characters.name: Miko Yashiro
characters.description: An energetic girl who happens to be [Hinako](https://anilist.co/character/250490/Yaotose-Hinako)'s classmate and childhood friend. However, she is often sick and therefore, absent from school. After "the incident", Miko was the only one to treat Hinako normally. She dislikes [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/259352/Oumi-Shiori), but is not necessarily enemies with her. ~!She appears to be human, but she is in fact a fox spirit with an appetite for human flesh. She calls in sick to fight her instinct to eat other humans. After failing to protect the rest of Hinako's family, she tasked herself with protecting Hinako from other monsters.!~

characters.name: Iso-Onna
characters.description: A youkai that tries to attack Hinako.

characters.name: Mutsuki Yaotose
characters.description: Hinako's older brother. He died in an accident along with their parents.

characters.name: Yuri Yaotose
characters.description: Hinako's late mother.

characters.name: Daichi Yaotose
characters.description: Hinako's late father.

characters.name: Oba
characters.description: She took in Hinako after the accident.

title: Happy Sugar Life
title_original: ハッピーシュガーライフ
description: Theft. Murder. Anything goes. To be with her. This must be what love is. That is what she thought. In order to protect this feeling… …she would do anything. (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes the one-shot "White Sugar Garden, Black Salt Cage" and four extra chapters.

characters.name: Satou Matsuzaka
characters.description: Satou Matsuzaka learns to love for the first time after meeting [Shio Koube](https://anilist.co/character/126755) and lives with her in a shared apartment. Publically, she tells people that she resides with her aunt in her apartment, and keeps the fact that she lives with Shio a secret. Satou is a freshman at Makikou High School and primarily works at Cure á Cute, maintaining a kind nature and getting along well with other people in order to sustain her lifestyle with Shio. While she wishes she could spend her time with Shio forever in their apartment, she is aware of the fact that they cannot live on peacefully if she does not work and earn money for food, utilities, etc. Because of this, Satou often has to confront the outside world where people interfere with her relationship due to her past history of accepting anyone who has confessed to her and changing partners every three days. S

characters.name: Shio Koube
characters.description: Shio Kobe is a young, innocent girl who lives with Satou Matsuzaka in their apartment. She loves and cares for Satou deeply, but often remains blissfully unaware of Satou's endeavors aside from Satou's necessary attendance in school and work, as she is not allowed outside of the apartment. Shio is a kind and innocent girl who tries her best to work hard and watch over the house while Satou is away at school and work. She routinely greets Satou whenever she returns home and is always genuinely happy to spend time together with Satou. Shio believes that both she and Satou need to stay together, otherwise they would both be broken and incomplete forever.

characters.name: Asahi Koube
characters.description: A young boy in a hood who is constantly searching for his younger sister, [Shio](https://anilist.co/character/126755/Koube-Shio), in order to reunite their family. He regularly prints out posters to put up around the city and sleeps underneath the park bench at night. Asahi is devoted and kind. As a child, he was quiet and well-behaved, listening to his mother at all times and did his best to support her physically and emotionally. When Shio was born, Asahi encouraged his mother to work hard for Shio because she became a symbol of hope for the both of them. He cared so much about his mother and Shio to the point where he urged his mother to leave the house with her and that he would stay behind with their abusive father so that he wouldn't pursue Asahi's mother. Due to his father's extreme abuse, Asahi grew resentful of adults and chose to never trust them. He wants nothing more than to

characters.name: Taiyou Mitsuboshi
characters.description: Taiyou Mitsuboshi is Satou Matsuzaka's coworker who first met her at Princess Imperial, ~!but soon quit due to getting sexually abused by his manager.!~

characters.name: Shouko Hida
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5’2”) Shouko Hida is Satou Matsuzaka's coworker. She considers Satou to be a good friend since they used to spend time together hanging out with guys as they both searched for their one true love. ~!She is killed by Satou after having taken a picture of Satou and Shio together and sending the photo to Asahi !~

characters.name: Daichi Kitaumekawa
characters.description: Daichi Kitaumekawa is Satou Matsuzaka's teacher who is renowned for his good looks and nice personality among his students. However, underneath this facade lies a deeply perverted man who takes an interest in Satou, obsessing over her after a school event. At school, Daichi is considered to be a kind and helpful teacher who demonstrates his concern for his students by speaking to them privately about personal matters and offering assistance in any way he can. ~!But in reality, he is a perverted man who wants to have a harem of women, regardless if they are his students. He tries to hit on his students a lot despite the fact that he has a wife and a young daughter.!~ ~!Satou uses this fact against him as she knows that despite his cheating, he doesn't want to lose his family or take the blow to the reputation that would come if he were found out.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Satou no Oba
characters.description: A relative of Satou who had taken full custody of her after her parents died many years ago. She is basically the one responsible for making Satou the deranged psychopath that she is today. (Source: Wikipedia, edited)

characters.name: Sumire Miyazaki
characters.description: Sumire Miyazaki is a minor character in Happy Sugar Life. She is Satō Matsuzaka's next-door neighbor and co-worker who refers to her as "senpai." Among her friends, her nickname is Su-chan. Sumire is a self-conscious girl, referring to herself as plain and awkward and idolizing Satou for being the exact opposite of herself. ~!She has a rather obsessive personality, becoming infatuated with Satou, blushing over sniffing her work uniform, and going as far as to break into her locker to know more about her.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Shizuka Kitaumekawa
characters.description: Shizuka Kitaumekawa is the wife of Daichi Kitaumekawa and the mother of Minori Kitaumekawa. Shizuka is the dutiful housewife of Daichi. She only sees her husband in a positive light ~!and is oblivious to his dark and obsessive side. This is shown evident when Daichi is arrested after being reported for taking advantage of his students and Shizuka looks on in shock with Minori.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Minori Kitaumekawa
characters.description: Minori Kitaumekawa is the preschool daughter of Daichi Kitaumekawa and Shizuka Kitaumekawa. Minori appears to be a cheerful preschooler who loves her family. ~!She is happily unaware of her father's dark nature.!~ (Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

characters.name: Yuuna Koube
characters.description: Shio and Asahi's mother. After having been forced into marriage under unfortunate circumstances, she gave birth to and raised the two children until being separated from Asahi while escaping their father; afterwards abandoning Shio.

title: SHY
description: Earth was on the brink of a third World War when super-powered individuals came forth from each country around the globe, ending the conflict and ushering in a new era of relative peace. Among those heroes, Japan is represented by a timid young girl known as “Shy.” She may spend more time worrying about her own shortcomings than she does battling villains, but she’ll show the world that despite it all she still has the heart of a hero! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

characters.name: Teru Momijiyama
characters.description: __Nationality:__ Japanese __Height:__ 149 cm A shy girl with a burning passion. Akin to her hero name, Momijiyama is a timid hero who has trouble communicating with large groups of people. Despite this, she cares very much about others and wants to provide them with help if she can.

characters.name: Iko Koishikawa
characters.description: __Nationality:__ Japanese __Height:__ 156 cm A kind girl with a secret pain inside of her, but despite that is very strong-willed and thoughtful. Her headband is decorated with a crescent moon on it. She used to be a hardworking member of the rhythmic gymnastics club at her previous school. Her love for superheroes was influenced by her little brother, Kinakomochi.

characters.name: Pepesha Andreanova
characters.original: ペペシャ＝アンドレアノワ
characters.description: __Nationality:__ Russian __Height:__ 174 cm A flying alcoholic and bubbly Russian lady with a penchant for being at the right time. At first, it was planned for her to be a more serious older sister type of character. She is Shy's mentor and assists her on multiple occasions.

characters.name: Pilse Dunant
characters.description: __Nationality:__ Swiss __Height:__ 155 cm An angel in black with a temper, with the signature catchphrase of "are you stupid!?". Although she can be very frank about what she doesn't like, it doesn't prevent her from caring for others and being an extraordinary apprentice nurse. She's part of the heroes of the Black Cross organization. She likes volunteer activities and the color black. ~!She lost both of her legs in an accident. She's wearing prosthesis that looks like real legs.!~

characters.name: Uni-lord
characters.description: Uni-Lord is a celestial emperor who is the leader of the world's heroes. She lives at the Heroes' Hideout and monitors the world's heroes' activities back on Earth. She is not a hero, but she has strong authority and gives orders to the heroes as a supervisor. Although she exudes an air of nobility, she is soft-spoken and sometimes tells jokes.

characters.name: David W. Jones
characters.description: __Nationality:__ British __Height:__ 179 cm Stardust is the world's renowned rock star/superhero, as the very picture of unwavering resolve and patience, he's a studious seeker of what makes a human being. He is responsible for establishing the international relief organization called Black Cross.

characters.name: Ai Tennouji
characters.description: A strange girl with a weak constitution who claims to have run away from home to experience the outside world. Actually happens to be a ninja princess who is being hunted by the Amalaraiks. Ai wields the heart blade Purity, a katana which can read the heart of everyone who holds it and talk to her

characters.name: Li Ming Ming
characters.description: __Nationality:__ Chinese He has a habit of falling asleep at odd places and times. He wants to get better at fighting and is somewhat insecure about not being "manly" enough. His power is being able to send people to sleep.

characters.name: Kfufu
characters.description: Kfufu is a member of Amalareiks.

characters.name: Stigma
characters.description: Stigma is the leader of Amalareiks

characters.name: Adam Rockwell
characters.original: アダム・ロックウェル
characters.description: Century is the United States' hero

characters.name: La Toile Renoir
characters.description: __Nationality:__ French La Toile is France's hero. First appearance: Chapter 75.

title: Onii-chan wa Oshimai!
title_original: お兄ちゃんはおしまい！
description: Mahiro Oyama was just a normal erotic-game loving dude…until he woke up one morning as a woman! Turns out his mad-scientist little sister, Mihari, tried out one of her new experiments on him…with a disastrous outcome, as far as Mahiro’s concerned! But Mihari is as determined to study him as he is determined to go back to his shut-in, game-playing life, and one thing’s for sure…life is going to get a whole lot weirder from here on out! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Mahiro Oyama
characters.description: He was a hikikomori neet and loner, until he woke up one morning as a little girl thanks to his [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari) drugging him.

characters.name: Mihari Oyama
characters.description: [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro)'s little sister. A genius scientist that skipped grades and is now attending college. She is responsible for drugging Mahiro, turning him into a young girl.

characters.name: Kaede Hozuki
characters.description: Kaede is a close personal friend of [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari). They became friends in middle school. Mihari has progressed further in the academic system than Kaede, but they still are close, and see each other regularly.

characters.name: Miyo Murosaki
characters.description: Miyo-chan is a classmate of Mahiro in middle school. She is friends with [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) and [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/130824/Ouka-Asahi). Miyo-chan is somewhat quiet and shy, and many times does not express herself verbally. However, she likes to hug and embrace her girl school friends, and takes a great interest in them and their activities. She has become particularly interested in Mahiro, although she is younger then her by a couple of years. Miyo-chan seems to be socially interested only in girls, and limits her time and attention to only select girls. She gives the appearance of showing her love and affection as a Shoujo Ai or Yuri shipping (girl with girl relationships). As such, Miyo-chan is always quick to ascribe a Yuri motive to any two girls talking or playing around with one another, as she likes to watch, on the side, su

characters.name: Momiji Hozuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Momiji is the younger sister of [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/130819). She is in middle school, and is in the same class that [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822) enters when they reenter school. Momiji likes to dress, look, and act as a tomboy, and many times she is taken for a young teen/tween boy. However, Momiji gives no indication that she is in any way a transgender tween. She appears to only be gender non-conforming. However, she can be quite feminine in appearance on select occasions, like when she wears the middle school female uniform, a cute jumper dress, to school. She forms a strong friendship with Mahiro, and helps Mahiro navigate the middle school academic and social challenges of school. Many times she comes to Mahiro's defense when Mahiro is bewildered or frightened by somebody or something happening at school, or if it is perceived tha

characters.name: Asahi Ouka
characters.description: Asahi is a classmate of [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) in middle school. She befriends Mahiro, and the two become quite close to one another. Asahi talks with a pronounced Osaka accent. In the English language, such characters are usually given a heavy southern accent, similar to a southern, country girl drawl so reminiscent of a southern belle/dixie chick. She pronounces Mahiro's name as "Maa-high-row". She loves to hug people, especially her friends. Mahiro tells herself that Asahi always smells like the fresh, clean, morning sun! She likes to talk about sports, and is very good at girl's track and field. Asahi also has the curious conversational habit of always referring to herself in the third person, as if she is always on the outside looking in at herself. She is also not the least bit afraid or bothered by offering her thoughts and/or opinions in a rath

characters.name: Nemu Fujimi
characters.description: Nemu is frequently seen sleeping. She sleeps throughout the entire day, even sleeping in gym class and while standing up.

characters.name: Nayuta Tenkawa
characters.description: ~!Nayuta is one of 4 other characters to know about Mahiro's gender bending, not including Mahiro herself, the other 3 being Mihari, Mahiro's mother and Chitose.!~

characters.name: Chitose Azuma
characters.description: Chitose is [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823)'s senpai from their college. She is supposedly related to [Nayuta](https://anilist.co/character/190203) in some way, whether it be by blood or some other way is yet to be confirmed.

title: Fukakai na Boku no Subete wo
title_original: 不可解なぼくのすべてを
title_en: Love Me for Who I Am
description: Mogumo is a cute but lonely high school student who just wants a few loving friends. Fellow student Iwaoka Tetsu invites Mogumo to work at his family’s café for “cross-dressing boys,” but he makes an incorrect assumption: Mogumo is non-binary and doesn’t identify as a boy or a girl. However, Mogumo soon finds out that the café is run by LGBT+ folks of all stripes, all with their own reasons for congregating there. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Ryuunosuke Mogumo
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") A non-binary teenager who is invited by their classmate Tetsu to work at his family's maid café. Their greatest wish is to find friends who will understand them. They have an interest in video games, and have a particular fashion sense attuned to not entirely feminine or masculine. A bit shy at first, but when opened up, are quite more confident and stand up for themselves more.

characters.name: Tetsu Iwaoka
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") A high school student and cook for his sister's maid café "Question". ~!He falls in love with Mogu, making Tetsu realize that he's attracted to people regardless of their gender, and the two start dating.!~

characters.name: Mei Tatebayashi
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5'5") A waitress at the "Question" café. Someone who slowly comes to terms with more and more of her identity from an "otokonoko" to a transgender woman.

characters.name: Tenmaru Inui
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") A waiter at the "Question" café. A diligent student with a passion for cosplay.

characters.name: Sou Suzumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") A waiter at the "Question" café. He is in a relationship with a boy.

characters.name: Kotone Mizunoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Ryuunosuke Mogumo's childhood friend who frequently takes care of them. Kotone is very attached to Mogu and doesn't want them to be anything besides a girl, directly clashing with Tetsu and how he supports Mogu being non-binary. ~!She eventually comes to terms with her identity as a lesbian.!~

characters.name: Satori Iwaoka
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Tetsu's older sister and the owner of the maid café "Question". She is a transgender woman.

characters.name: Sakura Mogumo
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Ryuunosuke's younger sister.

characters.name: Ayumu
characters.description: Satori's friend who is also a transgender woman. Ayumu loves makeup and skin care, and is the one who taught Satori how to do makeup in the past. She's a dependable person and a mentor to Mei.

characters.name: Kame-chan
characters.description: A photographer who helps taking Ten-chan's pictures when he is cosplaying.

characters.name: Haruto Aikawa
characters.description: Sou's boyfriend and classmate. Very protective of Sou, and naturally accepting of others.

characters.name: Ema
characters.description: Minami's girlfriend. Together, they try to help Kotone come to terms with her sexuality.

title: Kaketa Tsuki to Doughnuts
title_original: 欠けた月とドーナッツ
description: Uno Hinako throws herself into makeup, fashion, and falling in love, hoping that will make her seem “normal” to the other people at her job. But no matter how hard she tries, she’s a self-doubting mess inside, and her attempts at “normal” romance with men just keep failing. When she starts to think she might be alone forever, a new normal presents itself–in the form of her relationship with Sato Asahi, a level-headed woman who works at her company, which starts as respect until it becomes far more intimate. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Hinako Uno
characters.description: She's a kind and extroverted office lady who can be clumsy sometimes, and has a bit of low-self-esteem.

characters.name: Asahi Sato
characters.description: A dependable, reserved, and introverted office woman. Her coworkers are scared of her cold and intense stare. She's five years older than Hinako.

characters.name: Subaru Sato
characters.description: [Asahi's](https://anilist.co/character/244850) younger sister.

characters.name: Fuuka Yokoyama
characters.description: Asahi's classmate from high school and "one and only friend."

title: Fangkai Nage Nüwu
description: A modern-day engineer is transmigrated to a different world... where he becomes a prince. His surroundings remind him of medieval Europe, but it's not quite the same. In this world, witches actually exist, and they have real magic powers! Magic powers... that can be used as a productive force! The witches must be saved. Their powers must be liberated! We must open our map, fight off demons, solve the conspiracy, and climb the tree of technology! (Source: Webnovel)

characters.name: Roland Wimbledon
characters.description: Roland Wimbledon is the King of the Kingdom of Graycastle and the leader of the Witch Union. His true identity is Cheng Yan, an engineer from modern day China, who somehow wakes up in the body of the original Roland after both of them died. After realizing this was real, he decided to live in this new world according to his morals and ideals.

characters.name: Anna Wimbledon
characters.description: Anna Wimbledon is a witch from Border Town, and the first witch Roland meets.

characters.name: Veronica Gilen
characters.description: Nightingale is the first witch from the Witch Cooperation Association to come into contact with Roland.

characters.name: Nana Pine
characters.description: Nana Pine is a witch from Border Town. She is the daughter of Tigui Pine.

characters.name: Wendy
characters.description: Wendy is a witch and the leader of Witch Union. She was one of three Witch Cooperation Association founders.

characters.name: Leaf
characters.description: Leaf is a witch of Witch Union and former member of Witch Cooperation Association. She is one of the first witches who killed demons since the Second Battle of Divine Will.

characters.name: Tilly Wimbledon
characters.description: Tilly Wimbledon is the second princess of the Kingdom of Graycastle and the leader of Sleeping Spell.

characters.name: Maggie
characters.description: Maggie is a witch and a member of the Witch Union. She was formerly a member of Sleeping Island.

characters.name: Soraya Zoen
characters.description: Soraya Zoen is a witch of Witch Union and former member of the Witch Cooperation Association.

characters.name: Lightning
characters.description: Lightning is a witch from the Fjords, who had joined the Witch Cooperation Association, before leaving to help Nightingale. She is a member of the Witch Union and founder of the Neverwinter Exploration Group.

characters.name: Scroll
characters.description: Scroll is a witch and a member of the Witch Union. She was one of three Witch Cooperation Association founders.

characters.name: Ashes
characters.description: Ashes was a Transcendent witch, and Tilly Wimbledon's bodyguard and lover.

title: GIRL FRIENDS
description: When it comes to grades, bookish high school student Mariko Kumakura is at the top of her class. Socially, however, she is shy and lonely, typically eating lunch by herself. Enter the charismatic and beautiful Akko Oohashi, whose goal is to befriend Mariko and burst her out of her introverted shell. In the process of transforming Plain Jane Mariko into one of the cutest, most popular girls in school, deep feelings begin to emerge that suggest something deeper than friendship. Will these feelings destroy the budding relationship between Mariko and Akko, or will it turn into something else? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.

characters.name: Mariko Kumakura
characters.description: **Height:** 155cm (5'1") Initially just a reserved girl, Mari comes into her own when she suddenly is swept up into a whirlwind friendship with a popular classmate, Akko. She gets her hair cut off, and from that moment, it seems Mari begins to shed her closed up and shy personality. Despite being dowdy, Mari comes to enjoy things like shopping for cute clothes and dressing up, though mostly this is because of Akko's encouragement. Mari has a good family life in contrast to Akko, having both her parents there for her (probably more than she'd like) and a younger brother who she gets along with most of the time. She also becomes good friends with Sugi and Tamamin, though she is surprised to learn that girls would be so open as to casually kiss each other without having any emotion behind it. She is a bit flustered around them and their energy, but she considers the two to be her very good

characters.name: Akiko Oohashi
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") Akko is not far away from being the image of the "typical teenage girl". She loves shopping, goes to mixers, and enjoys hanging out with her friends immensely. She is a little on the wild side (as compared to quiet girls like [Mariko](https://anilist.co/character/15456/Kumakura-Mariko)), though she mostly just enjoys having a good time. She develops a strange fascination with Mari and eventually befriends the quieter girl, much to Mari's surprise. Her charisma and honest, forthright nature captivates those around her, and she easily makes friends, as Mari observes.

characters.name: Tamami Sekine
characters.description: **Height:** 150cm (4'11") Tamami is a cute and funny girl who is best friends with Sugi. She is also a major otaku who is often seen talking or buying manga. She draws doujinshi from time to time, some including people she knows personally including their homeroom teacher Naru-chan-sensei. Despite having a physically affectionate relationship with Sugi, neither she nor Sugi have romantic feelings for one another. It is heavily implied that by the end of the manga, she has begun dating Harada ~!Mari's ex-boyfriend.!~ (taken from the character profiles in vol.05)

characters.name: Satoko Sugiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Weight:__ 50kg (110bs) __Hobby:__ Improving her appearance __What she wants the most:__ a soul-mate OR authority (most likely a reference to another Morinaga work, Koi no Susume) (taken from the character profiles in vol.05) Sugi-san is the sexy, mature girl in the group of friends Mari joins. She juggles boyfriends, gives relationship advice, and seems vaguely above it all and ia somewhat detached - except when it comes to Tamamin (Sekine Tamami). The two of them kiss - allegedly for fun - all the time, yet she seems to think that girl-girl relationships are impossible. Despite being a carefree hedonist, Sugi is the only person to notice what is going on between Akko and Mari, and it raises her concern as a friend. In fact, she realises that Akko is in love with Mari even before Akko has a clue about it herself. She is concerned by this because she sees her tw
