As if puberty wasn’t awkward enough, the club consists of a brooding writer, the prettiest girl in school, an agreeable comrade, and an outspoken prude. Fumbling over their own discomforts, these five teens get thrown into chaos over three little letters: S…E…X…! Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Niina Sugawara
characters.description: Kazusa's friend, a melancholic girl who the guys call a "crane" because of her fragile beauty. Initially, Niina ignores the boys because of a harassment experience in her childhood but gradually begins to develop feelings for Izumi because of his caring and kindness. Thus, her loyalty to her friend and their common love of one boy quickly becomes one of the main conflicts of the story.

characters.name: Momoko Sudou
characters.description: A shy girl and Kazusa’s best friend. At first, like the other girls, she becomes interested in relationships with boys. However, as the story progresses, she gradually realizes her true feelings and growing attraction toward other girls. At first, she dismisses it as a misunderstanding about why girls like boys, but eventually she develops a one-sided crush on Sugawara.

characters.name: Rika Sonezaki
characters.description: The president of a literary club, a tall, prudish girl who is ashamed of her interest in the opposite sex because of her strict upbringing and serious nature. Nevertheless, in spite of her purism, she gets the most healthy relationship with guys compared to other girls. Over time she comes to realize that romantic affection and sexual attraction are not the same thing, thus she begins to lower her guard and starts a relationship with [Shun Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/141291/).

characters.name: Hitoha Hongou
characters.description: A blunt girl aspiring to publish erotica novels. Being a virgin, she relies on online adult chatrooms to get inspiration and feedback on her sexual writing. When her editor describes her first draft as if it was written by a virgin 40 year old man, she decides that she needs to go further on her journey for sexual knowledge.

characters.name: Kazusa Onodera
characters.description: Kazusa is the series main lead. Since childhood, she has been in love with Izumi, but all this time she was afraid to take a step forward, while the mockery of more popular classmates did not motivate her to be more active in an attempt to attract his attention. However, as the story progresses, she notices that Izumi is clearly sexually attracted to Sugawara’s outstanding beauty and tenderness. She is Sugawara's friend and is childhood friends with Izumi and Momoko.

characters.name: Izumi Norimoto
characters.description: Kazusa's childhood friend and the subject of interest from her and Sugawara. A kind and caring young guy, he doesn't have any sexual experience or knowledge about love in general, therefore his problems with the differentiation of love and sexual attraction quickly become the cause of a love triangle and a conflict between him and two girls.

characters.name: Hisashi Saegusa
characters.description: A famous director, who also works in acting classes for little children, including one Sugawara attended.

characters.name: Shun Amagi
characters.description: A boy infatuated with Sonezaki even when her class looked down on her.

characters.name: Tomoaki Yamagishi
characters.description: A young male teacher who is blackmailed into being the advisor for the Literature Club by [Hitoha](https://anilist.co/character/141294/), in the absence of their former advisor and imminent disbanding. He is given the nickname Milo-sensei by Hitoha and is called by that nickname by the rest of the club. Hitoha later seems to develop a relationship with him that he is highly reluctant.

characters.name: Satoshi Sugimoto
characters.description: A boy who attends the same cram school as Momoko and tries to start a relationship with her.

characters.name: Sonoe Juujou
characters.description: Juujou is one of the most popular girls in the school, and is initially what causes Rika Sonezaki to start having her own struggles with sex and relationships. Later in the series she befriends Sonezaki.

title: Satougashi no Dangan wa Uchinukenai: A Lollypop or A Bullet
title_original: 砂糖菓子の弾丸は撃ちぬけない A Lollypop or A Bullet
description: Yamada Nagisa is a bored teenager who finds everyday life extremely unappealing: thus her plans to join a military academy as soon she graduates. On the last term of middle school, a strange girl named Mokuzu Umino, who claims to be a mermaid, transfers into Nagisa's class and, much to her bewilderment, begins to follow her around incessantly. An annoyed and discomfited Nagisa initially strives to avoid these encounters, but then she begins to catch glimpses of the pain...

characters.name: Nagisa Yamada
characters.description: Aloof, apathetic middle-schooler who intends to join the JSDF after graduation.

characters.name: Mokuzu Umino
characters.description: A transfer student who claims to be a mermaid.

characters.name: Masachika Umino
characters.description: He's the father of Umino Mokuzu. He's a singer. ~!He's rumored to have abused his daughter Muzuko since she was a child.!~

characters.name: Tomohiko Yamada
characters.description: Nagisa's older brother. He's a hikikomori who likes collecting strange things although he used to be a straight A student.

title: Gwangyejichim
description: “Ugh! Life’s been miserable ever since that one stupid kiss! I NEVER should've done that! 'You wanna try?' she asked—It’s all her fault, and now she’s ignoring me! I can’t stop thinking about her!!!" Poor, unfortunate Ji-Won, stuck in a hormonal, teen game of cat and mouse. Kissed by her best friend, she’s left to her own devices to figure out what the hell is going on. Watch as cat turns to mouse, mouse to cat, and see how two childhood friends tiptoe the boundaries of their relationship. (Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.name: Myeong-In Lee
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm An exemplary student loved by her teachers. She is not good at expressing her emotions and tend to put others in an awkward situation due to her bluntness. However, she is a thoughtful person.

characters.name: Ji-Won Chae
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm A happy-go-lucky person who expresses her emotions a bit too well. She doesn't like complicated and thought-provoking things, so she prefers to look for fun things to do instead.

title: SANDA
description: In a near-future Japan, Christmas has faded into myth, and the birth rate has dropped so dramatically that children are now the most precious commodity. Society has artificially extended adolescence to preserve their youth, and traditional holidays, like Christmas, are a mere legend of the past. Volume 1 of SANDA introduces Sanda Kazushige, a middle-school student who unexpectedly becomes entangled in a strange and dangerous mystery. When his classmate, Fuyumura Shiori, accuses him of carrying a curse that could help find her missing friend, Ono Ichie, Sanda's life takes a dramatic turn. Together, they embark on an incredible adventure to unravel the truth behind Ichie's disappearance and uncover the hidden magic of Christmas itself. As they delve deeper into the mystery, the duo faces external threats and internal challenges—questions about loyalty, courage, and the power of belief. Along the way, they confront the true meaning of friendship, trust, and the possibility of magic in a world that has all but forgotten it. (Source: Titan Manga)

characters.name: Kazushige Sanda
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm A second year middle school student at Daikoku Aigo Academy who is a descendant of Santa Claus. He was determined to hide the curse of Santa Claus, but his powers were recently unleashed. When he transforms into Santa, he becomes a muscular old man who works hard to grant the wishes of children.

characters.name: Shiori Fuyumura
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm One of [Sanda's](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda) classmates who is unusually tall for her age. She broke the seal on Santa Claus's powers in order to request his help in solving the mysterious disappearance of her friend [Ono](https://anilist.co/character/363834/Ichie-Ono).

characters.name: Saburou Yagiuda
characters.description: Captain of the Special Search Unit of The Red Coats.

characters.name: Niko Kazao
characters.description: Sanda's state-mandated marriage partner.

characters.name: Misuzu Hyouda
characters.description: Yagiuda's junior in the Red Coat Special Investigations Unit. She hates kids.

characters.name: Hitoshi Amaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm He is [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommate.

characters.name: Hifumi Ooshibu
characters.description: Principal of Daikoku Aigo Academy. ~!Underwent a total of 72 reconstruction surgeries to maintain his youthful appearance.!~

characters.name: Hajime Mogi
characters.description: One of [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommates.

characters.name: Ichie Ono
characters.description: [Fuyumura](https://anilist.co/character/246681/Shiori-Fuyumura)'s best friend who mysteriously went missing.

title: Inkya Gyaru Demo Ikigaritai!
title_original: 陰キャギャルでもイキがりたい！
description: Ichiko and Kulan are members of the pop-culture research club. They like pop culture. They like cute. These two "gals in the shadows" spend their days in a new kind of youthful moratorium. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Genjitsu Touhi Shitetara Boroboro ni Natta Hanashi
title_original: 現実逃避してたらボロボロになった話
description: Nagata Kabi’s downward spiral is getting out of control, and she can’t stop drinking to soothe the ache of reality. After suffering from unbearable stomach pains, she goes to the hospital, where she is diagnosed with pancreatitis—and is immediately hospitalized. A new chapter unfolds in Nagata Kabi’s life, as she struggles to find her way back to reality and manga creation in the wake of her breakdown. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Kabi Nagata
characters.description: [Staff Profile]( https://anilist.co/staff/120310/Kabi-Nagata)

title: Genkai OL-san wa Akuyaku Reijou-sama ni Tsukaetai
title_original: 限界OLさんは悪役令嬢さまに仕えたい
title_en: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
description: Natori Midori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she’s suddenly laid off. But just as she’s feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she’s currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game’s cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who’s trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she’s psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Midori Natori
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm After being terminated from her job, she was summoned to the game "Fairy Tale of Jewels" as [Lapis](https://anilist.co/character/285681/Tenebrae-Lapis)' retainer, and in acknowledgment of her abilities, she was officially appointed Lapis' secretary. She possesses no magical or special abilities, but because she played the game, she knows of the scenario that the game world would follow, and she falsely claims to others that she has foresight. She struggles to make changes to the games storyline in order avoid a future in which Lapis dies.

characters.name: Lapis Tenebrae
characters.description: **Height:** 185 cm She was the game's last boss, murdered by her fiancé after duping the protagonist. She has the extreme opinion that the aristocrats are the only group that is important and that the ordinary person is only a pawn. While she gets frustrated by [Natori](https://anilist.co/character/285680/Natori-Midori)'s meddling, she plans on using [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/306915/Diana)'s power to further her own ideals. She is the fiancée of [Gran Magnaresk](https://anilist.co/character/306914/Magnaresque-Gran), the first prince.

characters.name: Gran Magnaresque
characters.original: グラン・マグナレスク
characters.description: **Height:** 188 cm He is Lapis' fiancée, and Diana regards him as an admirable person who had previously helped her. If the story had followed the original scenario, he would have had a predestined reunion with Diana, but because he intimidated Natori, Diana is now wary of him.

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm She was the game's main character, and she is lively and pure. She was unsure how to control her power after wounding Natori in a mock battle with Lapis during the summoner's exam, but she regained her confidence after getting a "prediction" from Natori.

characters.name: Vino
characters.description: **Height**: 157 cm He is a spy working for Lapis. ~!He is able to read minds using magic.!~

title: Machikado Mazoku
description: Yoshida Yuko was living a perfectly normal (if poverty-stricken) life, but at the age of fifteen, she suddenly sprouts demon horns and a tail! Her mother explains that she's actually a demon named Shadow Mistress Yuko, once sealed away and cursed so that her family would remain poor for generations. Now Yuko can break that very curse if she defeats Chiyoda Momo, a magical girl who goes to her school…but Momo is stronger than she is, knows how to manage magical powers, and is so freaking nice that she's actually helping Yuko out of scrapes. Yuko's too weak and uncoordinated to straight-up kill Momo, even if she wanted to, but she can't just be buddies with this generous magical girl, either–she has to break the curse on her family somehow. What's a demon girl to do? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Momo Chiyoda
characters.description: **Momo Chiyoda** is the magical girl who is protecting the town of Seiiki Sakuraga-oka. As a magical girl, she is a maniac of muscle training, and her physical power overwhelmingly surpasses that of her rival [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461), the succubus in town. Her magical girl career is mysterious, including rumors that she had once saved the world.

characters.name: Mikan Hinatsuki
characters.description: **Mikan Hinatsuki** is a Magical Girl who arrives in town to support [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/141457). She suffers from a curse that brings misfortune to those close to her whenever she gets overly excited or anxious.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: **Lilith** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s demon ancestor. She appears in her dreams one night and gives her demon powers, and tasks her on defeating a magical girl.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshida
characters.description: Yuuko Yoshida is a demon whose power is suddenly awakened in her first year of high school; aims to overthrow the magical girl in town to break her family's spell. However, although she has the ability to sneak into others' dreams, her physical strength and stamina are much weaker than the ones of her rival, the magical girl [Momo Chiyoda](https://anilist.co/character/141457).

characters.name: Seiko Yoshida
characters.description: **Seiko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461) and [Ryouko](https://anilist.co/character/141462/Ryouko-Yoshida)'s mother.

characters.name: Ryouko Yoshida
characters.description: **Ryouko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s younger sister. Ryouko's dream is to support her sister in becoming a fearsome demon.

characters.name: Anri Sata
characters.description: **Anri Sata** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Shion Ogura
characters.description: Shion Ogura is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Lico
characters.description: Lico is a fox demon that serves as the waitress and the chef for Asura Cafe.

characters.name: Shirosawa Tenchou
characters.description: Shirosawa is a tapir demon, and the owner of the Asura Cafe. He is the creator of the character mascot for the Tamasakura shopping street, Tamasakura-chan.

title: After Hours
description: The club is hopping and Emi isn’t…so she ends up hiding in a corner after her friend ditches her to flirt with a guy! Emi figures the night is a bust, but then someone amazing comes to her rescue. Kei is a DJ, and her effortless self-confidence captivates Emi. Is this just a wonderful night out or the start of the rest of her life? (Source: VIZ Media)

title: Giselle-ssi-ui Pi
description: A rebellious spirit trapped in her marriage to a violent husband, Giselle leads a miserable life playing the role of a meek wife and lady. But one night, wandering her new home, Giselle discovers what seems to be a young boy trapped inside a cage. An inheritance from her husband’s eccentric father, the boy is considered a monster, an immortal “flower that feeds upon blood”. Despite her fear, Giselle begins to visit the boy nightly. Will these illicit meetings shatter life as she knows it? (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.description: An inheritance from the Giselle's husband’s eccentric father, the boy is considered a monster, an immortal “flower that feeds upon blood”.

title: Toumei Ningen no Hone
description: An emotional father. An indifferent older brother. A mother who silently endures. Aya Kinomiya is a young girl growing up in a broken household. One day, she wishes “I don’t want to be here…” and suddenly, she gains the ability to become invisible. This is the story of a girl’s journey to reclaim "normality" in her life—and to rediscover her pain. (Source: MANGA MILLION)

characters.name: Aya Kinomiya
characters.description: As a child, Aya bore witness to an abusive father towards her mother. Feeling that she had no place she could call a home, she awakens to a strange power that turns herself invisible at will. ~!One day, after an event where her father abusiveness pushes her mother to the point of almost killing herself, Aya uses her powers to murder her father. As a result, her family situation became a lot more peaceful, however, Aya continues to live her life with the heavy burden of being a murderer.!~ Despite the burden she carries, Aya is a fairly normal, albeit meek, and kind girl that can smile like anyone else as shown through her various interactions with her friends. However, she does not value herself as a human being nor does she feel that she deserves happiness.

characters.name: Shiori Nakayama
characters.description: Shiori is a second year in high school and is a senior to Aya and Kana. She loves creating music and singing, which is what draws Aya towards her, and her curious nature drives her to understand various emotions that she's never experienced herself so that she may turn them into songs, which is what draws her towards Aya.

characters.name: Kana Minakami
characters.description: Kana is a sweet girl in her first year of high school and is next door neighbors with Aya. It is said that she is Aya's "ideal self", a girl who is bright and enjoying life the fullest, the exact opposite of Aya.

title: CLOVER
description: Kazuhiko is a young, but already deeply wounded black ops agent of a baroque, retro-tech future - pulled out of retirement to escort Sue, a mysterious waif, to a destination she alone knows. Suu and Kazuhiko have never met . . . yet she knows him, having grown up since the age of four with her only human contact being two distant voices: that of her elderly "grandma," General Ko, and of Kazuhiko's dead girlfriend, Oruha. And Suu has been kept in that cage all these years because of what she is, and what the Clover Leaf Project found her to be -- a military top secret, and the most dangerous person in the world. (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Suu
characters.description: Suu is the main character of the series. In the futuristic world that she inhabits, the military conducted a search for gifted children nicknamed "Clovers", who seemingly have the magical ability to manipulate technology. Demonstrations of their powers include teleportation and summoning weapons from thin air. Suu is one of these children. Being isolated from the rest of mankind, Suu craves for company, and as for her only wish, she asks to visit "Fairy Park." Her escort is Kazuhiko, an ex-military soldier who has been forced to undertake the task. It is later revealed that Kazuhiko and Sū are connected through Kazuhiko's deceased lover, Oruha. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Fay Ryu Kazuhiko
characters.description: Kazuhiko served in the army until Oruha was killed onstage on her birthday. he then swore to seek revenge for his lost lover, and is later assigned to protect Suu on her journey.

characters.name: Oruha
characters.description: Possessing a beautiful singing voice and the love of Kazuhiko, Oruha (also spelled "Ora" or "Oluha") has a secret. She also has amazing fashion sense. She is not seen until volumes 3 and 4 (which are prequels), though is referenced in volumes 1 and 2.

characters.name: Gingetsu
characters.description: Silence and calm is the charatcer of Gingetsu. After found Lan (Ran), he decided to live with him but of course it's not easy to get the permission from The Wizard. Since himself is the owner of two-leaf clover and Ran is three-leaf, if they combine their power The Wizard will sure cannot control them anymore. Gingetsu granted his life to The Wizard that they can kill him anytime if he try to do so. And that's the reason they let them stay together. (Source: Happiness)

characters.name: Lan
characters.description: Lan's actual name is simply C - it's Gingetsu who decides to name him Lan (Ran). He was called C because he was one of the three-leaf clovers that once existed, and those triplets' names were A, B and C. Now he's the only one living left, and as he's living away from the Clover Project research facility, he's aging quickly (that's why we can see Ran as a child in the last volume flashback, and as a boy in his late teens or even early twenties in the other volumes, even when two years have passed only since he met Gingetsu for first time). Actually, his life will end in five years - and though he knows it, he still wants to be away from the facility... and not only because he wants to be free - but specially because he wants to be next to the person who's most important to him. Ran's character isn't much developed until the last volume eit

characters.name: A
characters.description: He's the other twins of Ran. He loved Ran and he believe that Ran wouldn't be happy if he's not with him. When he know that Ran is happy with others person, A get angry and he try to kill Gingetsu (He killed B before because B and Ran get to close) in order to take Ran back to him. But then after he know that Ran wouldn't go back with him even with Gingetsu death. He leave Ran with Ran's promise that he will not love anyone else more that A. (Source: Happiness)

title: Doushitara Osananajimi no Kanojo ni Naremasu ka!?
title_original: どうしたら幼馴染の彼女になれますか！？
title_en: How Do I Turn My Best Friend Into My Girlfriend?
description: Minami and Yuzu have been inseparable since elementary school. But now that they’re in high school, Minami just can’t accept that Yuzu may someday get a boyfriend. How come some random guy gets to wake her up in the morning, feed her lunch, take baths with her…? It doesn’t take long for Minami to realize that her feelings can’t quite be described as “friendship” anymore, but how can she get Yuzu to see her the same way? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Murasakiiro no Qualia
description: Through the uncanny purple eyes of Yukari, all people appear to her as robots. Her talent is both a blessing and a curse. She is able to assist the police in sizing up threats, since her “skill” allows her to evaluate humans’ quirks and physical capabilities like cataloging the parts of a machine–yet her strange sight has cost her the friendship of her peers. She does have one friend in her corner: Hatou “Gaku” Manabu, a girl at school who cares deeply for Yukari. When Yukari is recruited into a secret organization, the real trouble begins. Gaku is thrust into a realm of mystery, quantum experimentation, and alternate universes, with only her wits–and her love for Yukari–to guide her along the way. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: School Zone
description: A quirky yuri comedy about the chaotic daily life of high school girls! Yokoe and Sugiura have been together forever, and they’ve mastered the art of making trouble when life’s a bore. High school might be a drag, but these girls in love know just how to inject a little chaos and comedy into their sloppy school life. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Kei Sugiura
characters.description: **Height:** 151 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 2-A A short, boyish girl who starts every day with a frown. Hangs out with [Yokoe](https://anilist.co/character/196831/Yokoe-Rei) constantly, despite the two of them bickering with pretty much every line of dialogue. While she is actually quite pretty, always being near the facial Harvard Yokoe makes her never stand out as such. Her chest size also appears much smaller in clothes and rumor has it her breasts are pretty big (according to [Yatsude](https://anilist.co/character/196832/Negoro-Yatsude)). She's good at sports and terrible at intellectual pursuits. She prefers summer over winter.

characters.name: Rei  Yokoe
characters.description: **Height:** 171 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 2-A A tall and gorgeous birdbrain. She's harbored a crush on [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/196830/Sugiura-Kei) since middle school, but prefers teasing her to confessing her feelings. She believes she's the prettiest girl in the world and is wildly popular. She's compared her face with the deviation score of Harvard University. She doesn't believe in monsters but does believe in UFOS. Her eyes are quite bad, so she usually wears contacts outside and sometimes glasses at home. She's super anemic all year round and is very weak to changes in weather.

characters.name: Tsubaki Hinase
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 1-C A serious siscon who keeps about 15 voyeur photos of her younger twin in her wallet at all times. An honor student who excels both physically and intellectually. She's a member of the Film Studies club and has great respect for [Yatsude](https://anilist.co/character/196832/Negoro-Yatsude). Often sleeps on her back with her arms folded over her chest.

characters.name: Yatsude Negoro
characters.description: **Height:** 161 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 2-B The stern, wry, sometimes mischievous third wheel to Kei and Rei's antics. President of the Film Studies club (which only has 2 members). She always speaks in Kansai-ben and loves to meddle in others' affairs. Has a favorite idol and frequently goes to her handshake events. Has a habit of sleeping in class and has never been caught thanks to her eyes usually being so narrow.

characters.name: Ren Utsugi
characters.description: **Height:** 148 cm **Ritsuryou East Girls High School:** Class 1-6 Still very much like a grade schooler both on the inside and outside and will stop at nothing to befriend [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/196828/Hinase-Hiiragi). She's very friendly and sociable and loves to play pranks. Often falls asleep on the train home. Actually has a special talent to predict tomorrow's weather

characters.name: Hiiragi Hinase
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm **Ritsuryou East Girls High School:** Class 1-6 Tsubaki's younger twin. Always has an unreadable expression and aloof demeanor. Has a lot of admirers at her all-girls school for being a prince-type girl. Takes great care of a goldfish she received from the school nurse Akutami, whom she is also very attached to. ~!She developed self-esteem issues because of unfavorable comparisons to Tsubaki. She went to a different school to create an identity for herself, but the attitude she took with her doesn't make her any more popular.!~ **Note from the author:** Even though she's very smart and also good at sports, her life in general isn't going well at all.

characters.name: Matsuri Fuji
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 2-B A classmate of Yatsude's who grapples with ethics and the philosophy of good deeds whilst engaged in the Sisyphean task of winning a stuffed animal from a crane game. Since her family lives at a shrine, she's often asked to help with ceremonies and special events there. Both she and her grandmother have made it their lives' mottos to perform lots of good deeds no matter what life throws at them.

characters.name: Yuka Kishiya
characters.description: **Height:** 170 cm A smoker who works part-time at an arcade. She let Fuji believe she's in university when in fact she's a first-year in high school. She's very excited about living together with her senpai Kyoumoto Akane, which doesn't appear to be the case in return. She's actually pretty smart and can analyze and deal with many situations well. Because of that, she's very popular both with the same and opposite sex.

characters.name: Hinako Nakatani
characters.description: **Height:** 160 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 1-C A pushy and aggressive gyaru with a tendency to monopolize people. Once she gets attached to someone, she becomes caring to the point of being meddling and bothersome. Got the nickname "Piyoko" from Kaname. Her hair is actually straight and she uses a curling iron every morning. Practiced karate until middle school but stopped because it wasn't popular. **Note from the author:** She's so easy to manipulate!

characters.name: Kaname Yamashiro
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm **Nishitaga High School:** Class 1-C A free-spirited gyaru. She's hard to get a read on because of her elusive nature, but her speech and actions often strike at the essence of people's issues. Her parents work overseas, so she lives alone in the penthouse of a high-rise apartment building. **Note from the author:** A while ago I bought a book about psychopaths for future reference and it had a lot of things to say about Kaname-chan.

title: Koi yori Aoku
description: Takamine, a girl who can’t seem to find something she likes or even really enjoys, has a chance encounter with Sakura, a student from a different school. When the two accidentally swap books, a connection is made that neither expected. While Sakura enjoys reading and talking about books, Takamine finds she quite likes Sakura’s excitement and wonders if she’ll ever feel so passionate about something…or someone. A sweet, slow burn romance about two young women and the relationship that blossoms between them. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Urijibe Nolleowa!
description: Hell yeah! A major publisher wants Mai Sohn to write a webcomic on relationships. But she’s struck with heartbreak as her girlfriend abruptly dumps her. It’s hard writing about relationships without being in one, so she needs to find the inspiration for love—and find it fast. And what’s up with her possibly homophobic neighbor? Why is she cool with Mai one minute and then so awkward and weird to her the next?! Can't a girl catch a break? (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: U-Ri Son
characters.description: A photography major at Yeon Gol university. She writes a famous romance webcomic.

characters.name: Cheong-Yeon Lee
characters.description: A computer engineering major at Yeon Gol university. She is religious and takes an interest on Mai. ~!She and Mai start dating at the end of Season 1!~

characters.name: Chan-Mi
characters.description: Chungyeon's childhood best friend. She is very protective of her and is anti-LGBTQ. ~!After learning Chungyeon likes Mai, she joins a LGBTQ parent meeting and studies about the community!~

characters.name: Su-Hui O
characters.description: A rich coffee shop owner. She is Mai's best friend. ~!She develops feelings for Chanmi.!~

characters.name: Ji-Won Go
characters.description: Mai's ex-girlfriend.

title: Maitsuki Niwa-tsuki Ooya-tsuki
title_en: Monthly in the Garden with My Landlord
description: Manga editor Asako Suga decides moving into a new home is just the thing she needs to get over a painful breakup with her toxic ex-girlfriend. She finds the perfect place for rent—affordable, spacious, lovely garden included—but there’s one catch. The house comes with a live-in landlord! It’s disappointing enough that Asako can’t have the single life she hoped for, but her cute landlord also seems to be hiding a big secret...Will living together bring them closer, or turn out to be more trouble than it’s worth? (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes five extra chapters.

characters.name: Miyako Kitano
characters.description: Former leader of the Idol group ELM, currently works as a landlord

characters.name: Matsuba Kitano
characters.description: Miyako's grandmother

characters.name: Hato Hatomori
characters.description: Mangaka who works with [Suga-san](https://anilist.co/character/286529) as her editor.

characters.name: Taki Nakajou
characters.description: Sub leader of ELM.

characters.name: Kotori Kozakura
characters.description: The youngest and tallest member of ELM

characters.name: Ruri Samukawa
characters.description: Ruri became the leader of ELM after Miyako's departure from the group.

characters.name: Nojiko Matsu
characters.description: The older member of ELM, she known for her huge appetite.

title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
title_original: ぼくの好きな人が好きな人
description: When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Asahi Suzukaze, the president of the mysterious “Clinical Trials Club.” When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated…? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Fragtime
description: In this light science fiction romance manga, Moritani Misuzu has a unique power: for three minutes each day, she can stop time. Her life changes when she uses that same power to peek at a beautiful classmate’s underwear. To Moritani’s surprise, this classmate—Murakami Haruka—is immune to Moritani’s time-freezing technique. Bound together by their odd powers, the two girls begin to grow closer…and find that it’s more than their strange abilities attracting them to each other. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Includes chapter 0.

characters.name: Misuzu Moritani
characters.description: Main character of the story. She can stop time for 3 minutes a day.

title: Jaesu Joeun Namja
description: The most important exam of his life… and Jeong-Seok blew it. Dumped by his girlfriend and rejected by his college of choice, the future looks bleak. But instead of moping, Jeong-Seok checks himself into a boarding cram school for a year. Sealed off from the outside world with nothing but a bunch of stressed-out, horny students for company, things start getting steamy in no time. How distracting! Perhaps some one-on-one lessons with the gorgeous, busty Ms. Kang will help him focus? Study hard, Jeong-Seok. Nice and hard… (Source: Lezhin US, edited) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Doku Mushi
description: A group of very different people wake up together in the sealed environment of an abandoned school building. They include the college students Yumi and Reiji, a cabaret girl named Akane, an occult-obsessed salaryman named Yukitoshi, a punk factory worker named Toshio, an unemployed pedophile named Taichi, and a nine-year-old girl named Michika. The building in which they find themselves has running water, no food, and a timer set for seven days. When they find a cleaver and a hot pot in an upstairs classroom, they begin to guess the intention behind their imprisonment; they're meant to kill and eat one another to survive. In principle, they should be able to survive just by waiting out the seven days in hunger, but nothing is ever that simple.

title: Octave
description: This story revolves around 18 year old Miyashita Yukino and her life as a former idol. As a child, Yukino had always been fascinated with TV. And before she knew it, she wanted to be one of those idols behind the screen. At 15, she entered the entertainment industry and debuted as a member of the four-person group "She'sN". However the group wasn't very successful and they broke up shortly afterwards. Returning home in disgrace, Yukino was welcomed with people’s curious looks and hurtful words. Wanting to find herself, regain her pride, and perhaps experience love, Yukino decides to move back to Tokyo. There she meets a certain woman, former composer Iwai Setsuko. Together they embark on a very interesting and mysterious relationship.

characters.name: Yukino Miyashita
characters.description: The main character, an idol by the age of 15 who dropped out of high school. Part of the J-pop group She'sN that is now split up. The story begins with Yukino at age 18 working in Tokyo for her former company. She meets Iwai Setsuko, and from there her life begins to move forward.

characters.name: Setsuko Iwai
characters.description: The love interest of Yukino, the other main character and also a former idol.

characters.name: Mari Iwai
characters.description: Mari is the twin brother of Setsuko. He owns the laundry shop where Yukino and Setsuko first meet. His warm and outgoing nature at first puzzles Yukino who eventually comes to see Mari as a trusted friend. His sister is often and easily annoyed by his antics. The siblings dislike whenever anyone points out their physical similarities especially since their personalities are quite contrasting. Mari switches interests easily and runs through various methods of entrepreneurship until finally finding a stable job.

characters.name: Murakoshi
characters.description: Yukino's boss in the company. He also used to be the Manager of She'sN.

characters.name: Chisato Kurusu
characters.description: She was a member of the She'sN group. After the group disbanded and with the encouragement of Yukino, she kept developing her career and became a star performer. Despite her success and lack of communication with the old members of the group, she still sees Yukino as a valuable and irreplaceable friend.

characters.name: Ryouko Kamoda
characters.description: Yukino's friend since high school. ~!She doesn't agree with Yukino's relationship with Setsuko, and eventually "outs" Yukino to their former classmates.!~

characters.name: Shiori
characters.description: A newcomer of Yukino's company. Yukino is her manager. ~!She has a crush on Yukino!~

characters.name: Oosawa
characters.description: Mari's friend. He dreams of becoming a chef. He immediately is attracted to Yukino whom he remembers from her idol days.

title: Shinju no Nectar
title_en: The Nectar of the Divine Mantra
description: Sakura, the last surviving princess of a fallen kingdom, is being hunted down for the power of Ambrosia she possesses - the ability to grant divine strength, but only to a human. With no human companion, she decides to summon one from another world in a desperate attempt to find a knight to protect her, but the man who answers her call is less than what she had hoped for.

characters.name: Doronea
characters.description: First Princess Doronea, Princess of the Dwarven Kingdom Garandoa. She has the Ambrosia of Efreet. Efreet is the Spirit of the Dwarves, Lord of Fire and Creation. She later joins the party as she falls in love with Kai

characters.name: Sakura Shakuntala Adoniera
characters.original: サクラ・シャクンティーラ・アドニエラ
characters.description: The Adaari Princess, The Sole Survivor from the Kingdom of Adaar. She possess the Ambrosia of Indra. She also possess Shakuntala a Goddess from Old time of the Gods. It has been shown she cares a great lot about Kai even though at the start of the Series she called him Pathethic. As the story progresses and Kai grows so does their relationship. Their relationship deepens after Kai rescues her from Suriyah Shakuntala calls Kai her Servant.

characters.name: Shiera
characters.description: Shiera is from the Nereid Tribe.| After drinking the Pure Mermaid Blood created from The Heart of Oceanos himself she becomes one of the Sea Folk. Making her a Mermaid in the Sea. On land she gains back her legs. She later possess the Ambrosia of Oceanos. Shiera later rises the Ancient Empire's Sacred City above the Waves and was made Queen of Nereid. She named Neraia Isle and the City as Nereid Kingdom proclaiming it Sovereign and Free. For the time being The Nereid Kingdom would be under Albion's Protection Later it is revealed under The Nereid Kingdom that there are The Ships of the Gods hidden in the deepest part of the Kingdom. The Ships were made during the Time of the Old Gods. Kai can call for the ships to come to him anytime When he uses the Oceanos Ambrosia. Thus giving Kai a War Fleet. Shiera tells Kai if He were to ever call for those ships that she will come along with those

characters.name: Suzuri
characters.description: The High Mother of the Hasas Lady Suzuri is a Imma, In the West they call her a Mare. As an Imma has the ability to Sap a person's spirit and enter their mind, Her body floats freely between different states and ages giving her the ability to Look Younger or Older. She possess the Ambrosia of The Northern Wind Norori. Guardian Spirit of the Northern Lands. During her Ambrosia state her body is everything at Once. Suzuri is often seen in her Young state making Kai uncomfortable at first when Suzuri agrees to hes Contract with the condition of Him using her Ambrosia.

title: Kimi to Shiranai Natsu ni Naru
title_original: 君としらない夏になる
description: Haru and Hii-chan are two young women in college buckling under the weight of adult responsibilities. Getting into university, then job hunting, then preparing for careers after graduation–it’s what they’re expected to do, because that’s what “everyone” does, but what do they really want for themselves? Finally, Haru and Hii-chan decide to take life into their own hands, toss their resumes into the sea, and move to an island together! They soon find that island living isn’t all blue skies and breezing through sunny days…but whatever the future holds, they can face it together. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title: Alien 9
description: In the future, alien invasion is a daily occurrence and everyone must be prepared. Elementary School #9 has assigned three students to fight off the extra-terrestrial threat.

characters.name: Yuri Ootani
characters.description: __Height__: 146 cm A quiet girl, who was voted by her 6th-grade classmates to be their representative on the Alien Party. Yuri is very reluctant to merge with her [Borg](https://anilist.co/character/7553/Borg).

characters.name: Kumi Kawamura
characters.description: The most independent member of the Alien Party, and a 6th-grade student. She has been a member of the Student Council for years and has assisted her widowed mother in her writing activities as well as an above average number of chores for a student her age.

characters.name: Kasumi Tomine
characters.description: Kasumi Tomine is the most energetic of the group. She views the Alien Party as a fun activity. She's well mannered, a great skater, and seems to be able to do anything that she sets her mind to. She enthusiastically approaches every task and still takes time to enjoy life around her. She's had a wide variety of experiences since she was small. When handling situations, she draws on the skills she's developed through her experiences. She's the genius type.

characters.name: Megumi Hisakawa
characters.description: Organizer of the Division 9 Elementary School's Alien Party, she is responsible for Yuri, Kasumi and Kumi. With her vast knowledge of the borgs and the aliens attacking the school, it is up to Megumi to train the girls to deal with the alien threat.Though she has a cheerful disposition, she is determined on making her girls the best in the country. With her computer information at hand, she seems to be hiding something from her party.

characters.name: Borg
characters.description: A symbiotic lifeform, whose sole purpose is to protect their host, incapacitate, and ultimately capture other aliens, using anything available to their arsenal.

characters.name: Miyu Tamaki
characters.description: A close friend of Yuri, Miyu is often there to support Yuri when she needs someone to talk to about her horrid duties. Since she seems to often be cheerful and hopeful, she is a good friend to Yuri. She has her best interests at heart, and if Yuri is feeling down she'll try and cheer her up by inviting her out and showing her a good time to help her forget her troubles, at least for awhile.

characters.name: Hiroshi Iwanami
characters.description: Hiroshi is a boy from Yuri's class. He is given an attack alien to put on his head. He gets addicted to the alien and attacks more them once.

characters.name: Yellow Knife
characters.description: Yellowknife is a new alien type known that lands on the school. ~!After landed, it used Kasumi's desperate loneliness following her older brother's departure to lure and consumed her.!~

title: Yuru Yuri
description: Right after starting middle school, Akari Akaza joins the Amusement Club which is composed solely by her two childhood friends, Kyouko Toshinou and Yui Funami. Chinatsu Yoshikawa, Akaza's classmate, becomes a member after finding out about the dissolution of the Tea Club. The Amusement Club, situated at the tea room facility since the Tea Club disbanded, has no clear purpose, being free for the girls to do whatever they want. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Mirakurun
characters.description: The character in a manga that Kyoko likes. She is known to always battle Rivarun.

characters.name: Rivarun
characters.description: The antagonist of the fictional anime Miracalun, she is an alien invader who plans to conquer earth, and Miracalun's mentor and friend.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

characters.name: Chizuru Ikeda
characters.description: [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/35877/Chitose-Ikeda)'s twin sister. Her personality is pretty much the opposite of Chitose's nice and ditsy nature. When she takes her glass off her yuri goggles activate and she starts drooling. She seems to be fond of the Ayano/Chitose pairing. She has a love for Chitose while she dislikes Kyōko as she constantly tries to play pranks on her and is seemingly a barrier against her fantasies.

title: Futaribeya
description: About to start her first year of high school, Sakurako Kawawa settles into her new lodgings. But when she meets her new roommate -- the beautiful Kasumi Yamabuki -- everything changes! From day one the responsible, level-headed Sakurako and lazy, easygoing Kasumi find themselves at odds with one another, but with their matching mugs and one bed to share, Sakurako and Kasumi's friendship is just beginning! (Source: TOKYOPOP) Note: Includes 38 extra chapters.

characters.name: Kasumi Yamabuki
characters.description: Kasumi is Sakurako Kawawa's lazy, easygoing roommate.

characters.name: Sakurako Kawawa
characters.description: Sakurako is a high-school girl who shares a room with Kasumi Yamabuki.

characters.name: Shouko Akashi
characters.description: Shouko is Seri's frank, spirited roommate.

characters.name: Koruri Masui
characters.description: One of Sakurako and Kasumi's college friends, who studies human life sciences with Kasumi. She has a poor sense of direction and finds it difficult to throw things away.

characters.name: Moka Nenashi
characters.description: One of Sakurako and Kasumi's college friends, who studies psychology with Sakurako. She prioritizes freedom when it comes to love, and often spends the night at Koruri's house.

characters.name: Yukari
characters.description: One of Sakurako and Kasumi's close friends. She's also in the same club as them.

characters.name: Seri Furuyashiki
characters.description: Seri is Shouko's roommate. Due to being a sheltered rich girl, she's naturally polite to everyone.

characters.name: Fujiho
characters.description: Fujiho is Hinako's roommate, which she may complain about, but she goes along with Hinako's requests.

characters.name: Hinako Kawawa
characters.description: She's Sakurako's little sister, who tends to act spoiled.

title: What Does the Fox Say?
description: As the newest hire of a game dev studio, beautiful Seong-Ji draws all the attention of her coworkers — but it's her bossy and blunt team leader Su-Min that intrigues her. Love is a whole new game for Seong-Ji, and with company president Se-Ju breaking (or was it laying?) down the rules, this new girl’s got her work cut out for her if she wants to win. Will she be able to give Su-Min what she wants? (Source: Tappytoon, edited)

characters.name: Seong-Ji Ju
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm The newest employee at Hello Studio. She's the cool beauty type. However, her personality is a gap moe character. She has a huge soft spot for dolls, which you can tell by the stacks of them in her room. She has never tried her hand at cooking, as she has a destructive talent for anything that requires dexterity.

characters.name: Su-Min Seong
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm Seong Sumin is the team director of Hello Studio, a game development company. She's short, blunt but never means any harm, likes to smoke, has a tattoo and exercises regularly. She likes to drink, but can't hold her liquor very well.

characters.name: Se-Ju Baek
characters.description: Se-Ju is the president of Hello Studio. When you dine together with her, if you order the wine that sounds like her name, she would politely reject it. (Baek Seju can also be translated as "hundred year-old wine")

characters.name: Da-Un Kim
characters.description: An old friend of Seongji Ju.

characters.name: Nam-Mi
characters.description: Sumin's only friend. A former famous model who now runs a modeling agency.

characters.name: Won Do
characters.description: She is a former professional swimmer. ~!In the side story, she ends up confessing and dating Seju!~

title: Tsumetakute Yawaraka
description: Can Takara find happiness with the girl she loved in middle school? Or is she 20 years too late? After 20 years apart, Takara reconnects with Ema, the girl she nearly kissed in middle school—who’s now a beautiful, married woman. Takara’s world turns upside down when her best friend from middle school reenters her life. She’s bewildered by how the shy, quiet girl she once knew has grown into a charming woman with an air of mystique. Despite Ema being married, Takara can’t help but think there’s something special about Ema’s cool, soft hands against her skin... (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Ema Natsume
characters.description: Managing director of the popular cafe Log Group, which her husband runs. Takara and Ema were classmates in the second year of middle school. Her maiden name is Nonohara. She used to be withdrawn and meek, but now exudes an air of mystery. She likes strawberry milk candy.

characters.name: Takara Itozaki
characters.description: Originally from Kumamoto, she works at a real estate agency in Tokyo. She had been living with her boyfriend for two years and things were going smoothly, but she was suddenly dumped by him. She never felt disappointed about losing a boyfriend. She used to write novels, but now she blogs and posts on social media.

characters.name: Hario Natsume
characters.description: Ema's Husband. He runs the Log Group, a popular chain of cafes that perpetually have lines of waiting customers. He adores Ema.

characters.name: Momoka Hino
characters.description: A senior coworker from Takara's old job. Acts as Takara's confidante. She loves her husband and child.

characters.name: Kannonzaki
characters.description: An interior designer. Has been friends with Ema since college and is currently her colleague.

title: River's Edge
description: Haruna Wakakusa and Yamada become friends after she saves him several times from her boyfriend's constant bullying. Through him she gets to know Kozue Yoshikawa, a fellow student who also models professionally. The three emotionally stunted teens' lives briefly yet intensely intertwine for one semester before splintering from the aftereffects of one disastrous night. For both Wakakusa and Yamada, their emotional awakening fosters an unlikely friendship between the two battered souls.

title: Tensei Kyuuketsuki-san wa Ohirune ga Shitai
title_original: 転生吸血鬼さんはお昼寝がしたい
description: A polite and lethargic boy was reincarnated in another world as a vampire bishoujo. In this world of swords and magic, this protagonist who was reborn replete with all kinds of cheat powers was searching for one thing――! “Three meals a day, snacks and an afternoon nap, I guess.” Are you really the protagonist! And thus begins the fantasy comedy of a vampire looking for the ideal moocher lifestyle…?

characters.name: Argento Vampir
characters.original: アルジェント・ヴァンピール
characters.description: Formerly male human, reincarnated into a different world as a beautiful vampire girl. She likes sleeping and has a horrible naming sense.

title: prism
description: School girl Megumi, suffering from an uneventful life after a fleeting grade school romance, hopes to end such boring days with her entrance into high school. Still dreaming about the peaceful days with her past love, Hikaru, she encounters a stunningly beautiful girl on her way to the entrance ceremony. Suddenly, the girl calls out for Megumi and gives her a hug! Hikaru enters back into Megumi's life not only as a classmate, but as a girl. How will Megumi handle the shocking revelation? Includes 4 extra chapters.

characters.name: Hikaru Aihara
characters.description: Formerly tomboyish, now the most beautiful girl in the school.

characters.name: Megumi Hoshino
characters.description: A dense and slightly awkward first-year high school student seeking a more exciting love life.

characters.name: Takeru Aihara
characters.description: Hikaru's oldest brother. He is 27 and married as of chapter 4. He seems especially eager to embarrass Hikaru in front of Megumi.

characters.name: Masaru Aihara
characters.description: Hikaru's second oldest brother. He is 24 as of chapter 4. He can sometimes be scary like Hikaru.

characters.name: Wataru Aihara
characters.description: The youngest of Hikaru's three older brothers. He is 20 as of chapter 4. Like his two older brothers, he enjoys teasing Hikaru.

characters.name: Arisu Hirose
characters.description: A quiet, observant, and socially awkward classmate of Megumi and Hikaru.

characters.name: Erika Senoo
characters.description: Megumi's closest friend as the story begins.

title: Kono Koi wo Hoshi ni wa Negawanai
title_original: この恋を星には願わない
description: A beautiful and delicate love story in which different kinds of "love" intersect. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

characters.name: Fuyuki Kousaka
characters.description: She is sincere and earnest, but she also has a timid side. Enjoys reading, stargazing, and listening to music.

characters.name: Eri Shirai
characters.description: Empathetic and good-natured, but a little possessive.

characters.name: Kyo Natsume
characters.description: He is friendly and tolerant, but also has a somewhat argumentative side. His hobbies include watching movies, reading, and watching sports

title: Sukeban to Tenkousei
title_en: The Delinquent and the Transfer Student
description: Riri is a transfer student with a unique fascination—she wants the school delinquent, Atsuko, to say adorable things! Despite her fearful reputation, Atsuko goes along with it, thinking Riri is just a harmless weirdo. However, she soon finds herself getting increasingly flustered every time she reads one of Riri's lists of cute words. And she's not the only one whose heart races after each interaction! Will this game bring them closer together and lead to an entirely new relationship? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Started as a self-published web-comic before being picked up for serialization on Web Comic Action on 2021-10-22.

characters.name: Riri Kanzaki
characters.description: Transfer student at Ibarano High. Atsuko's classmate.

characters.name: Atsuko Nagumo
characters.description: Ibarano High's most notorious delinquent.

title: Murenase! Seton Gakuen
title_original: 群れなせ！シートン学園
description: Seton Academy, a school full of animals where, thanks to population decline, there are fewer humans than any other creature. Mazama Jin, an animal hater and the only human male in his class, falls in love with Hino Hitomi, the only female human, the moment he lays eyes her. However he soon finds himself entangled with various other creatures after he reluctantly joins the 'pack' of Lanka the wolf, the only other member of her pack.

characters.name: Jin Mazama
characters.description: __Species:__ Human After he got beaten by bears as a kid, he started hating all animals, knowing they can't understand each other ever again. He is easily annoyed by animals, especially when they are wild and noisy.

characters.name: Ranka Ookami
characters.description: __Species:__ Wolf Ranka behaves a lot like a dog/wolf, like protecting territory, food or chasing bones. When she is happy, she would wave her tail like a dog and can be easily won with food. She loves to act like a boss of a pack, but in reality she didn't have one and was desperate and willing to do anything in order to become friends with someone. Although she is a bit of an airhead, she is really kind and understands how awful it is to be alone. ~!When she was young, she was saved by a boy from three bears. In reality the boy was beaten by them, but Ranka remembered it differently and since that was the first time someone of different specie protected her, she was happy and ever since then dreamed of forming a friendship and pack with different animals.!~

characters.name: Hitomi Hino
characters.description: __Species:__ Human The only other human in the academy, and incidentally, the only female human.

characters.name: Miyubi Shishio
characters.description: __Species:__ Sloth Since Miyubi is a sloth, she is usually very slow and easily gets overheated or tired. She keeps some moss on her head, if she gets hungry. She is usually very quiet and not everyone can hear her. As she is a sloth, she doesn't really have friends and spends most of her time alone. When Ranka invited her in the club, she found some friends, which made her really happy. (Source: Murenase! Seton Gakuen Wiki)

characters.name: Kurumi Nekomai
characters.description: __Species:__ Cat A cat who likes using her purrs to sway others.

characters.name: Chloe Mashima
characters.description: __Species:__ Grevy's Zebra

characters.name: Yukari Komori
characters.description: __Species:__ Koala

characters.name: King Shishino
characters.description: __Species:__ Lion

characters.name: Gigasu Terano
characters.description: __Species:__ Tyrannosaurus

characters.name: Shiho Ihara
characters.description: __Species:__ Impala

characters.name: Miki Hadano
characters.description: __Species:__ Naked Mole Rat

characters.name: Iena Madaraba
characters.description: __Species:__ Spotted Hyena

title: Kanojo ni Naritai Kimi to Boku
title_original: カノジョになりたい君と僕
description: Hime Sakuragaike has secretly been in love with her childhood friend Akira Yonezawa since they were kids, but Hime only recently found out that Akira identifies as female. Although surprised, Hime offers her full support, and this is initially kept a ​secret between them for a few years, but Akira decides to start living as a girl full-time upon starting high school with Hime. However, since Akira garners a certain amount of attention, Hime takes it upon herself to aggressively stick up for Akira whenever necessary. Not wanting Akira to be singled out as an object of ridicule, Hime decides that her only option is to put herself in Akira's shoes.

title: Adamas no Majotachi
description: Satou Yukinari has a very strange condition: he ejaculates diamonds. Although these special diamonds are worth a fortune, and he could orgasm his way to great riches, they come with a price–each diamond costs him a year of his life! And beyond that, his condition has attracted a horde of beautiful seductress witches who want his precious stones, regardless of what it costs him. Watch Yukinari try to overcome sexy but deadly temptation in this outrageous, raunchy comedy! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Reina Endou
characters.description: One of the girls after Saitou's jewels. She specializes in foot-fetish techniques.

title: K-On! college
description: Yui, Mio, Ritsu, and Tsumugi embark on their college adventures! It will take some time for the girls to get used to life away from their families and adjust to the pace of college life, but there's one aspect of their new situation that there's no uncertainty about-joining the pop music club! But they aren't the only high school band making their debut on the college scene. Is Afterschool Tea Time ready to perform alongside the hard-rocking rhythms of The Girlz?! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Yui Hirasawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

characters.name: Mio Akiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble. She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

characters.name: Ritsu Tainaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by [Tsumugi Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/19568/Tsumugi-Kotobuki) and [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She was the one who rebooted the Light Music Club when it was on the verge of being disbanded, and has become the natural leader of the club since then. Ritsu plays a yellow Rick Marotta Signature Yamaha Hipgig drum kit with an add-on floor tom (in the opening credits only) combined with a cymbal set from Avedis Zildjian, though is shown playing a white Yamaha Absolute Series drumkit in the anime's closing credits.

characters.name: Tsumugi Kotobuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Mugi plays a Korg Triton Extreme 76-key keyboard, though she is also seen playing a Korg RK-100 keytar in the closing credits of the first season.

characters.name: Sawako Yamanaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school. An alumna of the school and a former member of the light music club, she does not want people to know she was formerly a member of a heavy metal band, thus she covers up by being mild and gentle to her co-workers and especially to students. She is forced to be the adviser of the light music club, as Ritsu blackmails her after the girls learn of her past, though it is unknown whether she stopped being the adviser for the wind instrument club as the story progresses. Though she has a mature and gentle demeanor in the school, Sawako, affectionately addressed as "Sawa-chan" by both Ritsu and Yui, displays a totally different, completely authentic character when she is alone with the light music club. In reality, she is a rather wild, lazy and quite an irresponsible teacher who enjoys dressing up the light

characters.name: Nodoka Manabe
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Nodoka is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s childhood friend and confidant who is a member of the school's student council. As a normal, well-mannered and intelligent girl, she is generally taken aback by the light music club's odd behavior, and easily gets annoyed with [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) whenever she forgets to fill in the club's application forms. She shares the same class as [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) in their second year, who appreciates her companionship tremendously, as being the only person [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) knows in her class. In her third year, she becomes the student council president.

characters.name: Ui Hirasawa
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of p

characters.name: Ayame Yoshida
characters.description: Another one of Akira's friends, who has short blonde hair. She is OnNaGumi's drummer and is in the same department as Ritsu. Due to their similarities, Ayame and Ritsu become friends very quickly. Ayame tends to follow the latest fashion trends, and has done so since high school. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sachi Hayashi
characters.description: One of Akira's friends, who has long hair. She is OnNaGumi's bassist and is in the same department as Mio. She is taller than Mio, and easily becomes embarrassed about her height if anyone mentions it. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Akira Wada
characters.description: A new character introduced in the restarted manga who is in a band called OnNaGumi (女組?, "Gang of Girls") with her friends Ayame and Sachi. Akira joins the university's light music club alongside Yui and her friends. She has short black hair and often looks intimidating whenever her hair is messy. She studies in the Education department along with Yui. She is easily irritated to a degree but finds herself in a similar position to Azusa from high school as Yui seems to enjoy hugging her. She originally had longer hair in high school, but when a boy she admired accused her band of only being popular because of their cuteness, she decided to cut off her hair and vowed to become popular through talent. She plays an ebony Gibson Les Paul Custom electric guitar which she nicknames "Rosalie". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kana Yoshii
characters.description: The president of J. Women's University's light music club who has a sweet appearance, but is generally obsessed over things such as money and looking youthful and can put out a threatening aura when she gets passionate about either one. She was once in a popular band with Hirose though retired upon entering university since wearing school uniforms would be considered silly at their age. However, Kana is still obsessed with school uniforms. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chiyo Hirose
characters.description: An upperclassman in the light music club who was once in a band with Kana. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Tadokoro-san
description: Shy and introverted, Tadokoro Kageko passes her free time in class drawing instead of hanging out with her classmates. But even when her classmates approach her, it’s only to make fun of her drawings and appearance. In stark contrast, Nikaidou Sakurako is well-liked among her peers as she has both beauty and smarts. And while everyone makes fun of Tadokoro, Nikaidou on the other hand, is totally infatuated with her. Just one look at one of Tadokoro’s drawings and Nikaidou fell in love with the art and eventually, the artist herself. When Tadokoro offers to draw Nikaidou a portrait, Nikaidou becomes ecstatic as this may be her chance to get closer with the girl she has been obsessing over. (Source: Lilyka Manga)

characters.name: Kageko Tadokoro
characters.description: Tadokoro is a high school student, who was bullied for her gloomy looks as a child and thus became introverted and developed an interest for manga with cool looking guys. When her classmates started bullying her for her hobby again, Sakurako, the person adored by everyone, stands up for her and they start befriending each other.

characters.name: Sakurako Nikaidou
characters.description: A smart and beautiful girl adored by others. She stands up for Tadakoro, when their classmates ridicule Tadakoro for drawing manga. She starts developing an interest for the reclusive girl.

title: Arachnid
description: “In order to survive, I have no choice but to kill!!” Arisu is a high school student who faces bullying at school and abuse at home by her uncle. One day, she witnesses her uncle being killed by an assassin called "Arachnid." Thinking that she'll be killed next, Arisu has no choice but to fight back. Soon after, she wakes up at Arachnid's house, and he takes her in as his deadly apprentice. (Source: Comikey)

characters.name: Alice Fujii
characters.description: After her mother commited suicide, she had been living with her abusive uncle. On the day that her uncle was killed, the assasin "Kumo" took her in and trained her to kill. She has a disorder called C.E.C (Congenital Excessive Concentration), which means ones she focuses on one thing she is unable to focus on anything else especially what happens around her. Because of this, she had been the subject of criticisms, abuse and often seen as "dull". When she is faced with life-threatening situations, however; her reflexes and judgments are improved. Alice is normally kind, however, when in this mode, she becomes violent and believes that "before they kill her, she has to kill them". After killing Kumo, she was chased out of the apartment which belonged to "the organization" and is now living in Yori's house. She is also constantly targetted by other organization members.

characters.name: Kumo
characters.description: Kumo is an assasin of the organization, nicknamed "Arachnid". At the beginning of the series, he received the order to kill Yoshio and Alice. However, noticing her abilities, he instead took her in and trained her to kill, because "it's worth putting her to use" and "he can kill her any time". It was also him who taught Alice to use the Kumoito (lit. Spider's thread). ~!It is later revealed that the reason he took her in was to kill him, as because of his abilities, no one could kill him. Kumo is not his real name but rather a name given by the organization.!~

characters.name: Yoshio Fujii
characters.description: Yoshio is Alice's uncle. He was killed by Kumo in the first chapter.

characters.name: Sasori
characters.description: A member of the Organization who disguised as a nurse in order to kill Alice. A maniac, she claims that she collects the screams of those she killed. After failing to kill Alice, she escaped but announced that they will fight again.

characters.name: Yori Tajima
characters.description: A student at Alice's school. She used to be in a group that bullied Alice, however, after seeing her with a gun, she became curious and came to ask Alice, but she refused to answer because "if she tells her, she will get involved". Later, she indirectly saved Alice from Sasori and offered her a place to stay. She also lives alone, for unknown reasons.

characters.name: Oki Megumi
characters.description: A student in Alice's class and also a member of the Organization. Like her nickname suggests, she can quickly sense an attack and move out of the way like a cockroach. She also uses this ability, which she calls "Air Direction", to sense certain objects such as Alice's Kumoito. She wears her hair in twin tails and has two antennas which are shown to move when she sense the flow of air. A sadomasochistic girl, she likes being hated as much as she loves to abuse others.

characters.name: Kabutomushi
characters.description: Kabutomushi is considered one of the strongest insects in the clan. She is capable of destroying walls and floors effortlessly as well as ejecting her enemy from miles away. Kabuto fights with a spear that references the horns of the rhinoceros beetle and has armored vital organs. She was hired by the Spider to protect Alice from the clan's assassins after her death.

title: RWBY
description: The first RWBY manga. The series adapts and expands upon the four color-coded trailers used to promote the animated series before release. It also features an original story set between seasons one and two. When the people of Remnant aren’t fighting monsters, they still find conflict among themselves. Now they are at fierce odds. Ruby Rose, Weiss Schnee, Blake Belladonna and Yang Xiao Long are Team RWBY. Together they are learning the deadly craft of hunting the monstrous species known as the Grimm. From the acclaimed creator of Dogs: Bullets & Carnage , an action-packed prequel story to the global hit animation series from Rooster Teeth. (Source: VIZ, custom)

characters.name: Weiss Schnee
characters.description: Weiss Schnee is a student of Beacon Academy and one of the four members of team RWBY. The heiress of the vastly influential Schnee Dust Company, Weiss made her first appearance in the "White" Trailer. After enrolling in Beacon against the wishes of her father, she becomes a member of Team RWBY alongside [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Ruby-Rose), [Blake Belladonna](https://anilist.co/character/132314/Blake-Belladonna), and [Yang Xiao Long](https://anilist.co/character/132223/Yang--Xiao-Long). Her weapon of choice is a Multi Action Dust Rapier (MADR) named Myrtenaster.

characters.name: Ruby Rose
characters.description: Ruby Rose is a student of Beacon Academy and the main protagonist of RWBY. She first appeared in the "Red" Trailer visiting the grave of her deceased mother, Summer Rose. After an invitation from Headmaster [Ozpin](https://anilist.co/character/268340/Ozpin) following an altercation with [Roman Torchwick](https://anilist.co/character/133837/Roman-Torchwick), Ruby attends Beacon Academy in order to become a Huntress.
