He hopes Umino can succeed and drags his feet when his superiors pressure him not to give her a chance, but he regularly points out the almost certain futility of what she's doing. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chouko Ryuugasaki
characters.description: Heiress to the Ryugasaki family and one of the top female tennis players in Japan. One of the primary antagonists to Miyuki.

characters.name: Keiichirou Ootori
characters.description: The son of one of the grande dames of Japanese tennis, he went to school with Miyuki and she turns to him for assistance getting her tennis career started. He is thoroughly under the thumb of his tyrannical mother however and this limits the assistance he will give her. He is a good tennis player but his mother decides he lacks the potential to be the best and forbids him to pursue a professional career in tennis.

characters.name: Thunder Ushiyama
characters.description: Miyuki's rather lecherous tennis coach. He used to train big-name tennis players but was banned from the sport for life when he was accused of rigging a game. Nonetheless, he is apparently an exceptional coach and was personally hired by Madame Ohtori to coach Miyuki.

characters.name: Alan Carrington
characters.description: Wendy Palmer's coach. He and Thunder Ushiyama have known each other since childhood.

characters.name: Wendy Palmer
characters.description: She's an american tennis player born in Pasadena, California and coached by Alan Carrington.

title: Majo ga Koisuru 5-byoumae
title_en: 5 Seconds Before a Witch Falls in Love
description: Solitary witch Meg likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for her nemesis, Lilith the Witch Hunter. But when an altercation goes sideways, and Meg turns Lilith into a cat, a cascade of unfortunate events means witch is now responsible for saving witch-hunter! Sparks were flying between these antagonistic ladies before–what will their relationship be like after this cat-astrophe? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes one-shot: Demons Harem and one extra chapter .

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: A witch nicknamed as "The Untouchable Sorceress". She's solitary, and likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for Lilith.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: A top-class Witch Hunter.

characters.name: Samael
characters.description: She is a fallen angel.

characters.name: Belphegor
characters.description: She is a demon

title: Akuma no Riddle
title_en: Akuma no Riddle: Riddle Story of Devil
description: At Myojo Private School, an elite all-girls boarding academy, the Class Black is comprised of thirteen students, twelve of whom are assassins. Their prey is the thirteenth student, Haru Ichinose, an upbeat girl who vows to survive school and graduate unharmed! Enter Tokaku Azuma, a cold-blooded killer who transfers from another school to kill Haru. What should have been a routine hit turns into a far more complicated affair as Tokaku is unable to pull the trigger on Haru. As Tokaku copes with her budding feelings, will she decide to protect Haru's life from the other assassins or to end it before they do? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Haru Ichinose
characters.description: __Height:__ 159cm (5'2") Haru is shown to be a bright and cheerful girl of Black Class. As claimed by Tokaku, Haru poses a naive character and trusts anyone without a single thought. She is shown to have a highly optimistic attitude, which is sometimes bothersome for Tokaku since she is not used to friendliness. All in all, Haru's rival classmates appreciate her gullible nature; deeming her as an easy target. She is very forgiving and doesn't mind anyone for bearing any kind of grudge towards her as seen when she still talks in a caring and friendly manner towards every other girl who loses their purpose after chasing her with killing intents. ~!Like the other women of her clan, Haru possesses the "Queen Bee" power of manipulating others to protect her and let her live the position of highest hierarchy; making others be simply a "worker bee". Haru inhibits and implies this power without

characters.name: Tokaku Azuma
characters.description: __Birthday:__ March 3 __Height:__ 170cm (5'6") Tokaku is a distant and cold girl. Even at first glance, she has the appearance of an assassin.She eventually grows to care for Haru in time, even coming to the point of calling herself Haru's protector. Azuma dislikes it when other people try to get close to her, and she especially hates being called by her first name, but Haru compromises and calls her "Tokaku-san". She is skilled with using knives, and has exceptionally quick reflexes. It is soon revealed that Azuma has never killed anyone before, despite possessing very useful skills as an assassin. Her family is a well known family of assassins. They say that the east's Azuma and the west's Kuzunoha are two assassination clans that existed in the country since ancient times. The Kuzunoha was the main branch and the Azuma is a branch family. However, interactions between these two clans

characters.name: Mahiru Banba
characters.description: A rather shy and mysterious-looking young woman who's a former assassin who's developed a second personality at some point in her past named Shin'ya Banba who's a quite more rude and violent personality than the actual Mahiru. Both are like two souls who share the same body, thus both never appear at the same moment throughout the plot, yet both are able to communicate with each other to a certain degree. Mahiru is a shy and timid girl who often has trouble speaking for herself. She is easily subject to bullying, and is often defenseless. However, when the sun sets, Mahiru's alternate personality, Shin'ya Banba, appears. Shin'ya is the complete opposite of Mahiru, and refers to herself (or even himself) as "ore (俺)", a masculine term. In contrast to her host personality, Shin'ya has an aggressive and borderline insane appearance cultivated to protect Mahiru. Shin'ya is able to enter a te

characters.name: Sumireko Hanabusa
characters.description: Sumireko is a high class, polite girl. She's considerably warmer to people than [Tokaku](https://anilist.co/character/86241/Azuma-Tokaku) is, but she's hinted to be one of the more dangerous members of Class Black.

characters.name: Nio Hashiri
characters.description: Hashiri Nio is an energetic and upbeat girl with a knack for peeping into other people's businesses. Despite being a part of the Black Class group, she is also affiliated with the academy in some way.

characters.name: Isuke Inukai
characters.description: Isuke is a truly sadistic girl who is always shown to be with clothing that show her stomach. She is also very blunt and quick to express her opinion, and likes to command other people, such as making [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/88212/Sagae-Haruki) call her "Isuke-sama". Isuke's family includes her gay parents, who aren't related to her by blood at all.

characters.name: Kouko Kaminaga
characters.description: A girl with glasses who insists of being the 'rep' of everything, such as Black Class' class representative. She is shown to use grenades as a weapon.

characters.name: Shiena Kenmochi
characters.description: Shiena seems to have a normal personality compared to the rest of the members of Class Black. Although she is somewhat scatterbrained and forgetful, she is also strict at times, as shown when directing the play in Episode 5. She says she will do anything to protect the place she belongs to. Shiena is skilled at analysis, as seen when she is able to gather information about Hitsugi and Chitaru by simply watching them during rehearsals for the class play. She is also a skilled hacker as seen in the final episode where she successfully hacks into Myojo Academy's system. When she was younger she got bullied a lot. She had one friend whom she talked to on the phone called Yukarin, but one day she asked Shiena if she wanted revenge on the people who bullied her. Yukarin told Shiena about the group called Collective Dismissal and that they will give her her 'vengeance'. Shiena asks what they wa

characters.name: Hitsugi Kirigaya
characters.description: Kirigaya Hitsugi is a girl who has the body of an elementary school student. She has a bad sense of direction, as demonstrated when she gets lost on her way to Myoujou Academy. Although Hitsugi looks like the horribly unreliable type, she also has her reasons for being in the Black Group. She is also quite attached to Chitaru, as she is a nice and caring person.

characters.name: Ataru Mizorogi
characters.description: He is the homeroom teacher of Haru and Azuma for the Black Class. Ataru is a young and friendly teacher wanting his students to think of him as a big brother.

characters.name: Chitaru  Namatame
characters.description: Chitaru is a kind and caring girl who really looks out for others, especially those that appear to be heavily dependent (such as Hitsugi and Haru). She states early on that she has no plans to target Haru whatsoever. She appears to be quite attached to Hitsugi, but mainly in a motherly way.

title: Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.
description: Hinase falls into an identity crisis when their coming of age clashes with societal expectations in this unique teen drama! In this world, people are born without a gender. Their bodies shift toward their desired gender when they reach twelve years old. Until Hinase's eighteenth spring, they lived content without a gender. But the bubbly girl Ritsu and thoughtful boy Shiori pull Hinase in opposite directions when they both confess their feelings on the same day! Romance was never on Hinase's mind, so how can they respond? Hinase may be forced to choose a new identity as they arrive at the cusp of adulthood. Who will they choose, and who will they become? (Source: Square Enix) Note: Twentieth place of the 6th Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2020.

title: Hayama-sensei to Terano-sensei wa Tsukiatteiru
title_original: 羽山先生と寺野先生は付き合っている
description: Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei are two women who work at the same school…and just started going out. They’re a little shy about their budding relationship, but their co-workers–and even their students–are rooting for them as they bumble their way through love! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Asuka Hayama
characters.description: Hayama-sensei is a health and physical education teacher. Her normal personality can be a bit formal and stiff, but around Terano-sensei she is softer.

characters.name: Saki Terano
characters.description: Terano-sensei is a biology teacher. She is often mistaken for a student due to her small physique. Terano-sensei is beloved by her students and fellow teachers for her soft and kind personality.

characters.name: Rui Bandou
characters.description: Bandou-sensei is a Japanese teacher and a mutual friend of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei. She loves yuri romance and is a vocal supporter of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei's budding relationship. Bandou-sensei can frequently be found with Miyazawa-sensei.

characters.name: Elena Miyazawa
characters.description: Miyazawa-sensei is an English teacher and a mutual friend of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei. Miyazawa-sensei can often be found with Bandou-sensei. She often goes heavy on the teasing, but is also a supporter of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei's relationship.

title: King's Maker: Triple Crown
description: The King is back. With the defeat of his father, Wolfgang Goldenleonard has achieved all that he's sought -- the love of Shin Soo-Hyuk, the power of the throne, and vengeance over the kingdom's tyrannical ruler. But, Soo-Hyuk, a "possession" of the former king, views their rocky relationship as one of war trophy and victor, despite Wolfgang showering him with affection. As uncertainty grows in the royal courts, forces beyond their control are preparing a second coup d'etat. Will these two be able to keep a grasp on the throne and on each other? The saga of King's Maker continues in this official second season of the hit BL series! (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.name: Randolph Goldenleonard
characters.description: Randolph is one of the many sons not recognized by the previous king.

title: Sakura Trick
description: Yuu and Haruka were inseparable during junior high but a cruel twist of fate put them on opposite sides of the class when entering senior high. Forced to spend more time with their other classmates, they decide to do something to keep their relationship special. A comedy 4koma. (Source: YuriProject)

characters.name: Haruka Takayama
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Haruka is a student at Misato West High School and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda) best friend. Haruka also has a tendency to become jealous, especially when it comes to Yuu.

characters.name: Yuu Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Yuu is a student at Misato West High School and [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama)'s best friend. She tends to slack off at school. Her older sister is [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/87710/Mitsuki-Sonoda).

characters.name: Kotone Noda
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Kotone is a student at Misato West High School and comes from a rich family. She gave [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama) the nickname "Harupoppo".

characters.name: Shizuku Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Shizuku is a shy student at Misato West High School, who currently lives together with [Kotone](https://anilist.co/character/87706/Kotone-Noda).

characters.name: Kaede Ikeno
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Kaede is a student at Misato West High School, and also the class president. Her best friend is [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87709/Yuzu-Iizuka). ~!Later in the manga it’s confirmed that Kaede has feelings for Yuzu.!~

characters.name: Yuzu Iizuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Yuzu is a student at Misato West High School. She goes to school on her moped. Her best friend is [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87708/Kaede-Ikeno).

characters.name: Mitsuki Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mitsuki is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council president. Her younger sister is [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda).

characters.name: Sumi Otokawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Sumi is a student at Misato West High School and a member of the student council.

characters.name: Rina Sakai
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Rina is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council vice president.

title: Hana to Hoshi
description: Hanai is a junior higher and the best at table tennis. She's never lost, and she's won many tournaments, but after some freshman she's never heard of beats her like it was nothing, she starts losing every game after that and she can't get rid of that feeling of defeat. Now it's her first day of high school and she's decided to quit table tennis and live an ordinary high school life, but on the first day, she runs into the very girl that first defeated her. It turns out that she's also quit table tennis, but this girl always has a cold expression on her face and Hanai can't help but feel that this girl is always looking down on her and trying to mess up her perfect high school life. One day the girl falls asleep in class, and Hanai reaches over to wake her up. As she does so, the girl, still half asleep, looks up at her with a smile and almost kisses her. The girl later tells Hanai that she was having a dream about her, but Hanai coldly brushes it off thinking she's just messing with her and walks away - as the girl behind her looks down while blushing... Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

title: Ookami no Kawa wo Kabutta Hitsujihime
title_original: 狼の皮をかぶった羊姫
description: Aki Rikujo, a Wolfa, works as a butler at the royal castle in the land of Sheepa. Her quiet and peaceful days get shaken up when she saves the life of Princess Momo Shiudafaris. The shy sheep princess immediately latches onto Aki who, before she knows it, becomes the princess’s private tutor. Momo wants more than just math lessons from Aki, and even sneaks into the wolf-woman’s bedroom to seduce her! Aki soon realizes that, under the timid woolly exterior, Momo is a wild animal! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Aki Rokujou
characters.description: The responsible and serious wolf-woman who's working as a butler in the Land of the Sheep. She's appointed as the Third Princess's private tutor.

characters.name: Momo Siaudafares
characters.description: The third sheep Princess in the country of sheep. She's nicknamed as the "Ice Princess" by her maids because she rarely laughs or talks. She particularly never leaves her room, only her exclusive maids enter her room.

characters.name: Bluebell
characters.description: Momo's exclusive maid.

characters.name: Maribronde Siudafares
characters.original: マリベロンで＝シウダファレス
characters.description: Momo's mother.

characters.name: Kunya Lala
characters.description: The first princess of the Hyena kingdom.

title: Juingongi Villain-im
description: "Why did I turn into a character from an adult game?" The time has come now to take action! Lucius the loser character has transformed into a villain overnight. With his new found vengeance, Lucius will set out to enjoy the action packed, harem fantasy adventure!! (Source: TOPTOON+) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Eve Peta
characters.description: She is said to be as strong as the Demon King.

characters.name: Erina Ahildern
characters.description: She's the Princess of Ahildern.

characters.name: Elsie
characters.description: Werecat of the Marimba Clan.

characters.name: Eiei
characters.description: ~!He later gets turned into a woman by drinking The Forbidden Medicine!~

characters.name: Sonya Yaiban
characters.description: Exiled Magician.

characters.name: Karin Belix
characters.description: Dungeon Raid Party Member.

title: Ikemen Sugi desu Shiki Senpai!
title_original: イケメンすぎです紫葵先パイ！
title_en: The Girl I Want is so Handsome
description: When Hinami bumps into an older girl named Shiki, she falls head over heels. Shiki is sexy, easygoing, and has an amazing undercut. In order to get closer to Shiki, Hinami starts lurking around the basketball club. But though Hinami's crush is obvious to everyone else, it goes right over Shiki's head. When Hinami tries to confess her feelings to Shiki, Shiki thinks Hinami wants to become the club manager! Can Hinami get Shiki to understand her true feelings? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Shokei Shoujo no Virgin Road
title_en: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
description: The Lost Ones are strangers from another world, hailing from a place no one has ever heard of called “Japan.” These wanderers have been associated with catastrophes since many years ago and the solemn duty of exterminating them without remorse falls to Menou, a young Executioner. But when her mission is complicated by a Japanese girl named Akari who refuses to die, Menou embarks on a peculiar journey to find something that can slay even an immortal who insists on traveling with her would-be-killer! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Akari Tokitou
characters.description: The Lost One. She is affectionate and easy-going. Menou is unable to kill her because of her ability even though she is not aware of it herself. She begins her journey with Menou, without knowing her true intentions.

characters.name: Menou
characters.description: The Executioner. A young executioner girl who has exceptional magical talent. She is strongly dedicated to her mission and tries to finish off [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696) before her power gets out of hand. She gets close to her targets with friendly manner to grasp their ability before killing them. Her main weapons are short blade and sacred scripture.

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: Apprentice priestess working under [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou). She is deeply attached to Menou but has near zero religious faith. She is good at fighting with a fretsaw, but has poor skill with scripture magic.

characters.name: Ashuna Grizarica
characters.original: アーシュナ・グリザリカ
characters.description: Traveling Princess Knight. Princess of the Grizarica Kingdom, who is strong and beautiful. People call her the "Princess Knight" and she carries a sword with the royal crest as she always is ready for a fight.

characters.name: Mitsuki
characters.description: He was summoned from another world with the ability "nothingness" and was immediately thrown out of the castle. He wandered around aimlessly until he met [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)

characters.name: Flare
characters.description: Skilled priest and executioner, who has killed the most Lost Ones from other worlds. She is [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)'s mentor and Menou is considered her successor.

characters.name: Orwell
characters.description: The Archbishop. She is trusted by many people and has the greatest skill in magic of her era. She offers [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou) help in killing [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696/Akari-Tokitou) because in the central cathedral she controls a chamber that can contain and even kill otherworldly pure concepts.

characters.name: Manon Libelle
characters.description: Representative of the Libelle Family Head. Sole daughter of Count Libelle, who acts as the representative of the family after the Count fell ill. She is always dressed in a kimono and carries herself gracefully.

characters.name: Sicilia
characters.description: Priest of the port city Libelle. She works under Flare and they seem to be acquainted but further details are unclear.

characters.name: Shoujo
characters.description: ~!One of the four Human Errors, demon of the fog Pandemonium which was sealed away. She takes the form of a young girl, but her true body is still inside the fog. She has lost the memories and personality from before she became a Human Error.!~

title: Tada de wa Dakaremasen
title_original: タダでは抱かれません
description: Miyako Kirishima, a university student and aspiring teacher, is a poor girl who enjoys being frugal. One day, she has a meal with Yui Nakano, her friend whom she occasionally tutors. On the way home, Yui invites her to a love hotel. Miyako is reluctant, unwilling to have sex with a friend. However, Yui cuts her off, offering her 30000 yen for sex! Subsequently, Miyako ends up in more "transactions" with her other friends at her women's university!? The curtain rises on a tale of yuri, friendship, money, and sex♡. Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.

characters.name: Miyako Kirishima
characters.description: A university student and aspiring teacher, is a poor girl who enjoys being frugal.

characters.name: Yui Nakano
characters.description: The founder of "Nakano's Club" and Miyako's supporter. Has many friends with benefits.

characters.name: Mizuki Sayama
characters.description: A quiet and introverted let's player.

characters.name: Hina Asakura
characters.description: An otaku girl who loves VTubers.

characters.name: Chinatsu Matsushima
characters.description: The subject of Miyako's admiration, having helped her with studies since they were young.

characters.name: Kaoru Doumyou
characters.description: Ace of the press team. Has exposed various scandals.

characters.name: Emi Tonami
characters.description: A first year part of the swimming club. Gets horny when she sees swimsuits.

characters.name: Kyouko Iguchi
characters.description: She works at the Aisa stationary sales department.

characters.name: Rina Tachibana
characters.description: A first year university student and model.

characters.name: Juli Kakei
characters.description: Nakano's Club's number one showoff. Got her skin tanned at a salon.

characters.name: Akane Ootaka
characters.description: A super popular 4th year student, having won the miss beauty contest 4 years straight.

characters.name: Kyouka Hoshimiya
characters.description: A rich young lady from the house of a famous designer. Keeps her maids as pets.

title: K-On! highschool
description: As the only member of the pop music club not to graduate, the responsibility of recruiting new members has fallen to Azusa. Ui and Jun have agreed to help out their friend, but they might be more interested in having actual afterschool teatime than making music. Even when Azusa secures the necessary four members to keep the club alive, the lack of musical experience (and musical instruments) is going to be a challenge! Will the high school pop music club survive to take the stage once more?! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Sawako Yamanaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school. An alumna of the school and a former member of the light music club, she does not want people to know she was formerly a member of a heavy metal band, thus she covers up by being mild and gentle to her co-workers and especially to students. She is forced to be the adviser of the light music club, as Ritsu blackmails her after the girls learn of her past, though it is unknown whether she stopped being the adviser for the wind instrument club as the story progresses. Though she has a mature and gentle demeanor in the school, Sawako, affectionately addressed as "Sawa-chan" by both Ritsu and Yui, displays a totally different, completely authentic character when she is alone with the light music club. In reality, she is a rather wild, lazy and quite an irresponsible teacher who enjoys dressing up the light

characters.name: Ui Hirasawa
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of p

characters.name: Azusa Nakano
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Azusa Nakano, nicknamed "Azu-nyan" by [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is a main character in the K-ON! series. She is a second year student at Sakuragaoka High School. She decided to join the Light Music Club after seeing the band's performance in the school festival, and thus became Ho-kago Tea Time's second guitarist. Azusa plays a Fender Japan '69 Reissue Mustang in Candy Apple Red.

characters.name: Jun Suzuki
characters.description: **Role:** Bassist **Instrument:** Bass Guitar Jun is [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano)'s and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) to reprimand her. [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) tries to get her to join the light music club but ultimately fails due to a strange visit to the club room. However, she starts to regret it when she hears about all the activities the club does. She has a pet cat and plays the bass. Jun has an older brother, Atsushi Suzuki, nicknamed Acchan by her. He plays the bass at a university and helps Jun on "secret training sessions" because she apparently "still sucks at bass".

characters.name: Sumire Saitou
characters.description: Sumire is a shy blonde girl who meets Azusa, Ui and Jun after Yui and the others graduate. She is a freshmen, two years below the other light music club members. She is currently working in the Kotobuki household as a maid and originally came to the light music room to try to retrieve Tsumugi's teaset that was left behind after she graduated. After being scared off a few times by Sawako, she eventually agrees to join the light music club and eventually becomes its drummer. Similar to Tsumugi, she is quite talented at preparing tea, but feels inclined to keep her role as a maid a secret from the others due to the fear of being punished by Tsumugi. As her family, who came from Austria were taken in by the Kotobuki household before she was born, Sumire grew up as Tsumugi's playmate, often regarding her as her older sister and inadvertently sparking Tsumugi's interest in yuri by introducing

characters.name: Nao Okuda
characters.description: Another freshman in the same class as Sumire. Generally poor at physical activities, she goes through several trial runs through various clubs before deciding to join the light music club as she feels it is where she can try her best. Like the kanji in her name, she is overly honest about her shortcomings. After reading up on music theory, she ends up having an advanced knowledge of music but lacks the ability to physically play it. However when she is introduced to music creation software, she decides to become the band's producer. She is the oldest among the five siblings in her family. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yui Hirasawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

characters.name: Mio Akiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble. She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

characters.name: Ritsu Tainaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by [Tsumugi Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/19568/Tsumugi-Kotobuki) and [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She was the one who rebooted the Light Music Club when it was on the verge of being disbanded, and has become the natural leader of the club since then. Ritsu plays a yellow Rick Marotta Signature Yamaha Hipgig drum kit with an add-on floor tom (in the opening credits only) combined with a cymbal set from Avedis Zildjian, though is shown playing a white Yamaha Absolute Series drumkit in the anime's closing credits.

characters.name: Tsumugi Kotobuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Mugi plays a Korg Triton Extreme 76-key keyboard, though she is also seen playing a Korg RK-100 keytar in the closing credits of the first season.

characters.name: Atsushi Suzuki
characters.description: Atsushi Suzuki is [Jun Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/31526/Suzuki-Jun)'s older brother. He is currently a university student who plays the bass. He and Jun often meet to practice bass, because Jun is still unsure about her own skills, so she trains with her more experienced brother.

title: Goukaku no Tame no! Yasashii Sankaku Kankei Nyuumon
title_original: 合格のための！やさしい三角関係入門
description: In pursuit of Akira, the senpai she admires and loves, Mayuki Yukishita does her best to pass her exams and get into the same school as her, only to end up dead last on a mock test. To help her out, her mom gets her a private tutor, Rin Mochizuki, a polyamorous girl from the same school as her senpai who ends up taking Mayuki's first kiss, and who is closer to Akira than Mayuki knows...

characters.name: Mayuki Yukishita
characters.description: A third-year junior high school student who belongs to the basketball club, she is aiming to attend the same high school as Akira.

characters.name: Akira Hanamaki
characters.description: Akira is a first-year high school student at Ohtomo High School. She performs exceptionally well in academics as well as athletics. She has been a member of the basketball club since junior high school and is a senpai that Mayuki looks up.

characters.name: Rin Mochizuki
characters.description: Rin is a first-year high school student at Ohtomo High School. Because Mayuki's mother and Rin's mother are friends, Mayuki's mother hires Rin as a private tutor to help her daughter get into Ohtomo High School.

title: Food Court de, Mata Ashita.
title_original: フードコートで、また明日。
title_en: See You Tomorrow at the Food Court
description: To their classmates, Wada is a quiet rich girl while Yamamoto is an intimidating lone wolf…but what they don’t know is that Wada is a mobile game addict in a passionate love-hate relationship (with a 2D character) and Yamamoto has a penchant for urban legends with eyes only for her favorite YouTuber. And their biggest not-so-secret secret—these unlikely friends meet at the food court every day after school to rant, rave, and learn what makes each other tick! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Originally published as a Twitter webcomic. It received a 15-chapter serialization in Comic Newtype between 2020-03-10 to 2021-01-12. Additional serialization resumed on 2022-09-06.

characters.name: Yamamoto
characters.description: - Low-energy. - Expressionless. - Despite her looks, has fantastic grades. - Thinks like a normal person. - Actually has a part-time job. - Puts a lot of effort in but tries to hide it. - Hates annoying things but hangs out with [Wada](https://anilist.co/character/150313/Wada) anyway. - Kind of good at looking after people. - Loves kids. - Usually somewhat careless. - Doesn't care about the internet, ignores social media. - Names of celebrities and other people go in one ear and out the other (has absolutely zero interest).

characters.name: Wada
characters.description: Complains about everything. Brain all over the place. Hates celebrities. Hates athletes. Hates broadcasters. Generally hates people with talent. Writes about everything online. Likes picking fights online. Has twenty sockpuppet accounts. Gets angry easily. Likes hating on popular things. Loathes normies. Doesn't have the greatest vocabulary, very emotional.

title: Onna Doushi to ka Arienai deshou to Iiharu Onnanoko wo, Hyakunichi-kan de Tetteiteki ni Otosu Yuri no Ohanashi
title_original: 女同士とかありえないでしょと言い張る女の子を、百日間で徹底的に落とす百合のお話
description: "It's impossible between girls!" proclaimed the popular JK Marika Sakakibara. That was when the cool beauty Fuwa Aya hit her with a million-yen offer. "I'll pay you 10,000-yen a day for a hundred days, to convince you that you can fall in love with a girl." "Huh? What!" Confident that she would never fall for a girl, Marika agreed to the offer. Now every day after school, Marika goes over to Aya's house for some hand-holding, headpats, and maybe even some XX…? Will Marika still say "impossible" after a hundred days? (Source: MangaUP!, translated)

title: Erio to Denki Ningyou
description: The war between humanity and AI, which began a hundred years ago, came to an end when humanity chose to abandon electricity. In a world that has lost electric power, the last electric automaton, Ange, and the human girl she raised, Erio, set out on a steampunk adventure in a future not far from our own. (Source: MANGA MILLION)

characters.name: Erio
characters.description: She's a human girl who can generate electricity due to her peculiar physical condition.

characters.name: Anju
characters.description: She's a combat android remnant of the defeated A.I. army. Her identifier is ANJ32768.

title: Koe ga Dasenai Shoujo wa "Kanojo ga Yasashi sugiru" to Omotteiru
title_original: 声がだせない少女は「彼女が優しすぎる」と思っている
description: The story of a mute girl and the girl who befriends her. Note: Eighth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category

characters.name: Oto Mashiro
characters.description: She cannot speak due to her aphonia.

characters.name: Kikuno Kokosaki
characters.description: She can read minds.

title: Catulus Syndrome
title_original: 猫娘症候群(かとるすしんどろーむ)
description: Shirakaba Yuki is a girl with the Catulus syndrome, which afflicts her with cat ears and a tail, plus some behavior like a cat. In the middle of her high school entrance ceremony, Ayano Riko - who is also a first year - comes in with a mountain of cats on her back. Apparently she's a cat magnet. They become friends.

characters.name: Riko Ayano
characters.description: Birthday: August 31

characters.name: Yuki Shirakaba
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ March 20

title: Warikitta Kankei desu kara.
title_original: 割り切った関係ですから。
description: Kaburagi Aya, a highschool student who is at the bottom of the school caste, and Kurosaki Sei, a teacher who was oppressed by a trauma from the past, get to know each other through a dating app. With ulterior motives from both side, the relationship between them gets distorted gradually... (Source: Ichijinsha, translated) Note: Includes an epilogue chapter and a four-chapter extra story

characters.name: Sei Kurosaki
characters.description: She is a teacher teaching at a Tokyo high school.

characters.name: Haruki Tokiwa
characters.description: She is Aya Kaburagi's childhood friend.

title: Nikurashii Hodo Aishiteru
title_original: 憎らしいほど愛してる
title_en: I Love You So Much, I Hate You
description: Saori Fujimura and her boss, Ayako Asano, are an unbeatable duo at work, but after hours their relationship is more than just professional. As tensions mount between Ayako and her husband and Saori’s feelings grow stronger, they’ll have to decide—is it love they seek, or merely pleasure? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Ayako Asano
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") Product Planning Division Manager and [Saori Fujimura](https://anilist.co/character/363231/Saori-Fujimura)'s boss. She is currently married and respected by everyone in the office.

characters.name: Saori Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Fujimura is the youngest staff member and the ace of the sales department. Has always been interested in older women. She currently works in the Product Planning Division, with [Asano](https://anilist.co/character/363230/Ayako-Asano) as her boss.

title: Succubus & Hitman
title_original: サキュバス＆ヒットマン
description: High schooler Gamou Shouya is a dead man—sort of. The real Gamou Shouya is long gone, but his body lives on, inhabited by the soul of a boy who made a pact with the succubus Armelina. In exchange for his services as her personal hitman, Armelina is helping him hunt down the people who brutally murdered him and his family. The path ahead is dark and deadly, but Shouya’s got nothing left to lose…not even his soul. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Boku no Namae wa "Shounen A"
description: A story about a goodhearted boy named Takashi, who murdered his teacher at the age of 13 to protect his childhood friend Yui. The story revolves around tragedies happening to both of them because of that incident.

title: Oddman 11
description: There are 11 kids in Setsu's school who have special quirks and characteristics, called Oddman. Setsu wants to date the only male Oddman, Itami, so she proceeds to challenge all the other Oddman since they're his ex-girlfriends. In the process, she makes several Oddman fall for her instead.

title: Namboda Motan Sai
description: Yi-Hyeok and In-Seo have been friends for their entire lives. It’s something they take for granted. Just like the sky is blue and water is wet, the two of them are lifelong buddies. Or, well, that’s what they think right up until the moment In-Seo kisses Yi-Hyeok as a joke that turns into something more, sparking a whole new scorchingly hot relationship between them. It might be pretty funny, really steamy, and a little strange...but they’re still friends. Right? …Right?! (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes 66 extra chapters.

characters.name: In-Seo Baek
characters.description: __Height__: 185 cm In-Seo is Yi-Hyeok's only childhood friend who secretly have feelings for him, he was popular during high school and had tons of girlfriends.

title: Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san
title_original: 舞妓さんちのまかないさん
description: Within the winding streets of Kyoto's geisha district, there lives a 16 year old girl named Kiyo. After failing to become a Maiko, an apprentice traditional Japanese performer, Kiyo works as the caterer for her troupe. This is the story of her daily life.

characters.name: Kiyo Nozuki
characters.description: A 16 year old girl that left her hometown of Aomori and came to Kyoto to follow her dream of becoming an apprentice geisha, but is now working as a cook.

characters.name: Sumire Herai
characters.description: __Maiko name:__ Momohana Kiyo's childhood friend and apprentice maiko.

characters.name: Onii-san
characters.description: He has been working as a professional Otokoshi. An Otokoshi assists geiko and maiko in putting on their kimono. They make rounds to the maiko houses and lift garments as heavy as twenty kilograms.

title: I Siguge Gaeingyoseup
description: Yu-Chan, who's shy when it comes to girls, has to tutor a curious little girl. Little does he know that he'll be teaching her some other things too. (Source: Toomics, edited)

characters.name: Yu-Chan Kim
characters.description: A PT trainer turned private tutor because of the pandemic.

characters.name: Chae-Eun Seol
characters.description: [Chae-Won](https://anilist.co/character/249254)'s younger sister who's preparing to retake the exam.

characters.name: Chae-Won Seol
characters.description: [Chae-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/249253)'s older sister who's interested in [Yu-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/249252).

characters.name: Min-Jeong Ha
characters.description: She's a manager of a gym that [Yu-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/249252) typically goes to.

characters.name: Jin-Sol
characters.description: She's [Chae-Won](https://anilist.co/character/249254)'s high school classmate.

characters.name: Jin-Sem
characters.description: [Jin-Sol](https://anilist.co/character/285046)'s twin sister.

title: Killing Me!
description: Vampire hunter Saki Fujimiya is the epitome of poise and finesse—that is, when she’s not around Miyoko Kujou! Why does Miyoko get such a rise out of her? Well, to begin with, Miyoko’s a campire—Saki’s natural enemy—but that’s not the only reason Miyoko gets under Saki’s skin. Despite Saki’s best efforts to kill Miyoko, something keeps stopping her from biting the bullet and ending it all for good. It’s hard to tell who’s really the prey in this love comedy packed with bite! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Killing Me! was announced to be discontinued on 2018-07-28, with only one collected volume that included Chapters 1-9 and an "Extra Story".

title: Kaguhara-san no Fetish Note
title_original: 香原さんのふぇちのーと
description: Kaguhara Ririka is a high school girl in her first year at Fu Eichi High School. She has an ordinary appearance, no personality to speak of, and no friends. However, she has a unique hobby that she keeps secret. She loves exploring all kinds of embarrassing "fetishes" of cute girls, and she keeps a diary of her observations of those girls trying to keep their fetishes to themselves! As Ririka seeks out the sweat, smell, and flesh of cute girls and record them writhing in shame, who will be the object of her observation tonight? (Source: Gamma Plus, translated)

characters.name: Ririka Kaguhara
characters.description: Ririka Kaguhara is a plain, friendless and often overlooked first year girl at Fuetchi Senior High. However, she has one hobby in particular that she can never tell a soul about; that being her dedication to her fetish and recording her observations of how it manifests itself in all sorts of unique ways amongst her classmates.

characters.name: Kaori Akishita
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'3") __Features:__ That scent of hers that I can count on to waft my way from the seat next door is the joy that grants verve to my daily toil. The wonderful fragrance from one of the school's most gorgeous and kind hearted girls... Is it not life's greatest pleasure? It's an especially vivid experience if she's just finished working up a sweat, for example after a morning run or a P.E. class. One can only assume that scent comes straight from her armpits. I developed this theory after observing the sweat stains under her armpits which sometimes appear. Whilst it's not yet known if she trims her armpit hair or if it's natural growth, but what precious little hair that remains looks soft and beautiful. (By: [Ririka Kaguhara](https://anilist.co/character/292203))

characters.name: Rin Ashioi
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'4") __Features:__ Ashioi-san, the quintessential big sister. Is it because her house has a strained budget due to her many siblings? Or is she simply the type who loathes to throw things away? At any rate, the result is that she keeps her pairs of socks and shoes until they're completely worn out, and that has lead to the accumulation of a rich aroma around her feet. Of special mention is the unique nosefeel of her socks, which is something that can not be brought about by mere sweat alone. The way I'd describe the fragrance is that it's less akin to something like vinegar, but much more similar to popcorn or other savoury smells. Also worth noting is my running theory that the reason she periodically clip clops with her indoor shoes in class is that it's her attempt to release the building steam around her feet. (By: [Ririka Kaguhara](https://anilist.co/character/2

characters.name: Miko Shizen
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'8") __Features:__ A cute and innocent looking girl with surprisingly sweaty hands. That said, it doesn't seem to worry her too much. I wonder if one day she'll come be bothered by them? Anyways, it's thanks to them that the sleeves of her cute oversized cardigan are always just a little damp. When I got a taste of her hand sweat, it had a slightly briny flavour to it. That said, the smell was definitely mostly comprised of the pungent hand cream that she uses, so I may need to come up with some sort of ingenious scheme in order to enjoy her purely natural scent. (By: [Ririka Kaguhara](https://anilist.co/character/292203))

characters.name: Shitori Butsushiri
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'2") __Features:__ I'm a little scared of her, especially since she's got such a big voice. But on that same note, she's also got a big ass, so I think I should be more open minded about big things. Speaking of big things, it's not just that great ass, but her entire lower body that's as thick and sturdy as a tree. However, these are no mere fatty masses, they are the toned thighs and vibrant ass cheeks forged from day in day out club training. Just from a touch of that springy skin it's easy to tell how well packed everything is under the hood, which as everyone knows is the sign of a healthy youth. Also, even if she doesn't sweat as much as others do, the way her shorts have no choice but to ride tight against her panties make it so that any sweat around her hips and buttocks are much more noticable. And contrary to expectations, her sweat doesn't smell as strongly

title: Satanophany
description: A mysterious "Medusa Syndrome" turns schoolgirls into homicidal monsters who are behind numerous atrocities in Japan. However, nothing is what it seems when Chika Amagi is arrested for the brutal murder of five people...

characters.name: Katya Rastorgueva
characters.original: カチュア・ラストルグエヴァ

title: Yume no Hashibashi
description: Kyoko is at the autumn of her life. She can barely recognise her own family member. But one day, someone she remembers perfectly comes to visit. Her name is Mitsu, the woman Kiyoko had a love story with. Just after the war, when they were still teenagers, they nearly did the irredeemable out of passion. Despite a few meetings from time to time, life ups and downs separated them, but the story draws us back in the time when they couldn't imagine life without each other. (Source: Atelier Akatombo, translated)

title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival @COMIC
title_original: 乙女ゲームのヒロインで最強サバイバル@COMIC
title_en: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
description: After losing her parents at a young age to a monster attack on their village, Alicia is sent to an orphanage, where she spends three miserable years being mistreated—and doing her best to smile through it all. After finally reaching her limit and running away, Alicia is attacked by a strange woman who wants to take the young girl’s place as the protagonist of something called an otome game. During the struggle, Alicia accidentally absorbs part of the woman’s memories and knowledge, transforming her from a scared child to a calculated young woman with a mission: to write her own destiny. Now adrift in an unforgiving world, Alicia vows to grow stronger by any means necessary. She’ll need all the might she can muster if she has any hope of changing her fate and fighting for survival. (Source: J-Novel Club)

characters.name: Alicia Melrose
characters.original: アーリシア=メルローズ
characters.description: The main protagonist, her real name is "Alicia Melrose". She is the heroine of the Otome game "Love on Silver Wings". She has a pinkish blonde hair with peachy tints. She lost her parents when the town where she lived was attacked by an outbreak of demons when she was four years old, and was sent to an old church orphanage in a small town. There, she spent her days in hell, being abused and mistreated by the caretaker, an old woman, and the elders. When she was 7 years old, she ran away from the orphanage thinking she was going to be sold, and was attacked by a mysterious woman who was planning to use a magic stone to replace herself from body and mind. She strikes back and kills the woman. When she realizes that this world is the world of Otome games "Ciel" and that her parents' death and her current situation are just scenarios, she becomes angry at everything as "nonsense" and decides

title: Adachi to Shimamura
description: The second floor of the gym―this was where we always met. It was class time, but of course, there weren't any classes going on in a place like this. This was where Shimamura and I became friends. We hung out here―talking about TV shows and cooking, playing some ping pong... This is where we fostered our friendship. Keeping my head propped against the wall, I let out a small sigh. What was this feeling? Yesterday, I'd dreamt of me and Shimamura kissing. Not that I'm like that. I'm sure Shimamura isn’t either. It’s not even something worth repeating myself about, but really, it’s not like that. It's just that when she hears the word "friend," I want her to think of me first. That's all.

characters.name: Sakura Adachi
characters.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Akira Hino
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji). Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

characters.name: Yashiro Chikama
characters.description: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

characters.name: Taeko Nagafuji
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura). Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure. Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

title: Shino to Ren
description: The tomboy and the quiet girl don't seem to have much in common at first glance, except that they're head over heels in love. Ren is loud, brash, and possessive—a far cry from Shino's calmer, more reserved demeanor. But hey, sparks fly in the most unlikely cases, and this couple can barely keep their hands off each other. Between Ren's aggressive flirting and Shino's adorable personality, if one of them isn't blushing, whoever's reading along with them sure will be. (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Shino Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm A first-year student who's a fundamentally docile and introverted girl.

characters.name: Ren Shirayuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm An honest girl who's protective of [Shino](https://anilist.co/character/317252). She hates how cute her name is (last name "Snow White", first name "Love").

characters.name: Suuna Kuruma
characters.description: She is a shy and withdrawn girl with no friends and poor communication skills.

characters.name: Ruka Hamanasu
characters.description: Ruka is Suuna's roommate. She is a popular and flirtatious girl who flirts with a different girl every day.

title: Ohana Holoholo
description: Maya, who works as a translator, lives with her bisexual former girlfriend, Michiru, and Michiru's son, Yuuta. Residing in the same apartment building is an actor called Nico, who drops by for a visit almost everyday, and knows about Michiru's past. Somewhat like family, and somewhat not, their lives interweave full of warm days. Note: Includes five side stories and an extra.

characters.name: Michiru Amamiya
characters.description: A single mother living with [Maya](https://anilist.co/character/57267/Nagumo-Maya). She acts like a child and like to be coddled, she works as a telephone operator.

characters.name: Maya Nagumo
characters.description: A translator that lives with Michiru and Yuuta. She's like a strong, dependable, older sister. 5 years ago, she and Michiru were lovers.

characters.name: Nico Kusaka
characters.description: A young actor who lives downstairs from Maya and the others. He dated Yuuta's father, who is now deceased. He dotes on Yuuta

characters.name: Yuuta Amamiya
characters.description: Michiru's son. He's very quiet, but sensitive to the attitudes of adults.

characters.name: Hiyori
characters.description: Takaki's little sister. She doesn't like Yuuta.

characters.name: Megumi Mochizuki
characters.description: A teacher at the nursery school Yuuta attends. ~!He ask Michiru to go out with him.!~

characters.name: Eisuke Kuwabara
characters.description: Maya's former classmate. ~!He proposed to Maya twice but was eventually turned down both times.!~

characters.name: Takaki
characters.description: Yuuta's friend from nursery school. He's calm

characters.name: Keiichi Amamiya
characters.description: Dated Nico before marrying Michiru, ~!Died the day Nico was putting on a performance!~

title: Lycoris Recoil
description: Japan—a nation where vicious crime and terror have been all but eliminated. And who keeps the peace? Cute schoolgirls, of course! Those uniformed youths you see on street corners and in stylish cafés may just be agents of Lycoris, with pistols in their purses and missions on their minds… (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl. ~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco. A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris. She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 3rei!!
title_original: Fate/kaleid liner プリズマ☆イリヤ ドライ！！
description: Just as Miyu was about saved from being swallowed into despair, all of a sudden a mysterious small duo that has mastered the Class Cards suddenly appears in front of the Illya? These witches are taking things to the next level! (Source: Comic Walker)

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot. His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059). __In Fate/Zero:__ ~! Initially summon

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.original: クロエ・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card. ~!She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21

characters.name: Erika Ainsworth
characters.original: エリカ・エインズワース
characters.description: ~! Her true name is Pandora !~ Illya describes Erika as a "twisted child" whose innocence can fool people into thinking that Erika is harmless when she really has a cunning side of her that can potentially make her very dangerous; however, she is indeed a child that is afraid to be alone and tries to use any method, albeit rough, to avoid being lonely. ~! Pandora was created by the Twelve Olympians six thousand years before the events of PRISMA☆ILLYA. Differing from other worlds, Pandora's Box was never opened in Miyu's World, so Pandora was left unable to die because her "death" itself is also within the box. She was given knowledge by the gods that she had to wait until humanity perished so that she can finally open the box and release the world's true potential. Because of her immortality, Pandora suffered greatly as people unreasonably tried to kill the undying mud doll whenever they

characters.name: Artoria Pendragon
characters.original: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1) Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon. __In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his C

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Cú  Chulainn
characters.description: Born as Sètanta from a mortal woman, Deichtine, and the Sun God Lugh he's a Hero from the Ulster Cycle of Irish Mythology. He took the name Cú Chulainn after he killed the guard dog of the blacksmith Culann, said to be stronger than 10 men, when he was only a child. To make up to the old blacksmith he offered himself as a guard dog and since then was called Cú Chulainn, "Culann's savage dog". Trained in the Arts of the Spear and magic Runes by Scáthach, he wields the cursed Gàe Bolg, the spear that inflicts wounds that never heal. __In Fate/Stay Night:__ ~! Originally the servant of [Bazett Fraga McRemitz](https://anilist.co/character/24332/Fraga-McRemitz-Bazett), he becomes the Servant of [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506/Kotomine-Kirei) after Kirei fatally wounds Bazett and remains under his command for the duration of the War. !~ __In Fate/Grand Order -First Order:__ ~

characters.name: Sakura Matou
characters.description: __Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night) A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

characters.name: Shinji Matou
characters.description: [Sakura Matou](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older brother, and a long-time friend of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Shinji is very popular as vice-captain of the archery dojo despite being chauvinistic and a narcissist. Like [Rin Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin), he is of a distinguished lineage of sorcerers, though the Matou blood has thinned and no longer produces heirs naturally capable of sorcery. Shinji feels uncomfortable with his sister's daily visits to Shirou's home. He has an open crush on Rin, but she does not return his favors.

characters.name: Medusa
characters.description: ~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone. With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Ho

title: Mayu, Matou
description: Clad in school uniforms practically breathing with life are the girls of Hoshimiya Girls' Academy, their hair long and luxurious. When a certain "incident" rocks the academy, the hidden feelings these girls possess will be entwined in this pure girls' love story. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Tadokoro-san
description: Shy and introverted, Tadokoro Kageko passes her free time in class drawing instead of hanging out with her classmates. But even when her classmates approach her, it’s only to make fun of her drawings and appearance. In stark contrast, Nikaidou Sakurako is well-liked among her peers as she has both beauty and smarts. And while everyone makes fun of Tadokoro, Nikaidou on the other hand, is totally infatuated with her. Just one look at one of Tadokoro’s drawings and Nikaidou fell in love with the art and eventually, the artist herself. When Tadokoro offers to draw Nikaidou a portrait, Nikaidou becomes ecstatic as this may be her chance to get closer with the girl she has been obsessing over. (Source: Lilyka Manga) Note: The chapter count includes 8 extra chapters.

characters.name: Kageko Tadokoro
characters.description: Tadokoro is a high school student, who was bullied for her gloomy looks as a child and thus became introverted and developed an interest for manga with cool looking guys. When her classmates started bullying her for her hobby again, Sakurako, the person adored by everyone, stands up for her and they start befriending each other.

characters.name: Sakurako Nikaidou
characters.description: A smart and beautiful girl adored by others. She stands up for Tadakoro, when their classmates ridicule Tadakoro for drawing manga. She starts developing an interest for the reclusive girl.

title: Odoriba ni Skirt ga Naru
title_original: 踊り場にスカートが鳴る
description: Kiki Haruma always dreamed of doing ballroom dance as the feminine "partner" role, but as she aged she grew taller and taller, eventually causing her to give up ever looking good in a dress or anything girly. Now in the second-year of high school, she specializes in the masculine "leader" role—until one day, her partner suddenly leaves her. When Michiru Toribami, a petite and pretty first-year student, comes to join the ballroom dance club, Kiki asks her to be her new partner, but Michiru told her that she only dances the leading role—and she wants none other than Kiki to be her partner.

characters.name: Kiki Haruma
characters.description: __Height__: 172 cm Kiki is a Sakuragamori High student who always dreamed of doing ballroom dance as the feminine "follower" role, but as she aged she only grew taller and taller, eventually causing her to give up ever looking good in a dress or anything ladylike. Now, as a second year in high school, she specializes in the masculine "leader" role until she met Michiru.

characters.name: Michiru Toribami
characters.description: Michiru is a short and pretty first-year girl at Sakuragamori High School who joins the ballroom dance club. She's introverted yet fun-loving and deeply wants Kiki to be her partner.

characters.name: Shion Nemunoki
characters.description: Shion is a shy Sakuragamori student in the ballroom dance club. She was the former partner of Kiki Haruma.

characters.name: Tsukiko Ichinomiya
characters.description: She was Homare's partner while she was a student at Sakuragamori High School and is currently the instructor of the ballroom dance club there.

characters.name: Homare Haruma
characters.description: [Kiki's](https://anilist.co/character/230736/Haruma-Kiki) older sister. She was Tsukiko's partner while she was a student at Sakuragamori High School and is now a professional dancer.

title: Bocchi the Rock! Gaiden: Hiroi Kikuri no Fukazake Nikki
title_original: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！外伝　廣井きくりの深酒日記
title_en: Bocchi the Rock! Side Story: Kikuri Hiroi's Heavy-Drinking Diary
description: Kikuri Hiroi-genius bassist of Sick Hack, terror of concert venues, eternal deadbeat, and all-around poor role model-has always believed there’s no problem you can’t drink your way out of. The world might be dull and depressing, but whether it’s the failing economy, overdue rent, or just plain ol’ social anxiety, a quick trip around the spiral of happiness will help everything work itself out in the end, right? Surely her personal life isn’t a total disaster...right?! Find out in this freewheeling spin-off of Bocchi the Rock! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Kikuri Hiroi
characters.description: Bassist and vocalist of the band "SICK HACK". Always drunk to forget about life's downsides.

characters.name: Shima Iwashita
characters.description: Drummer of the band "SICK HACK".

characters.name: Eliza Shimizu
characters.description: Guitarist of the band "SICK HACK". She originally came from England, and moved to Japan 3 years ago so she could attend Comiket ("Comima" in the Japanese release of the manga) and be in an anison cover band. On top of her band activities, she also makes doujinshi.

characters.name: Hitori Gotou
characters.description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

characters.name: Nijika Ijichi
characters.description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

characters.name: Seika Ijichi
characters.description: Nijika's older sister and manager of the live house "STARRY".

characters.name: PA-san
characters.description: __Height:__ 162cm Mysterious looking female PA engineer with a mouth piercing. In her private life, she is active as a virtual Youtuber under the name "Otogi Alto" producing gameplay videos.

characters.name: Ginjirou Yoshida
characters.description: The manager of the live house "FOLT".

characters.name: Yoyoko Ootsuki
characters.description: Guitarist and vocalist of the band "SIDEROS".

characters.name: Aiko Satou
characters.description: A music journalist and fan of guitarhero.

characters.name: Akubi Hasegawa
characters.description: The drummer of SIDEROS.

characters.name: Ryou Yamada
characters.description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

title: xxxHOLiC: Rei
description: In xxxHOLiC Rei, Kimihiro Watanuki continues his relationship with the Space-Time Witch, Yuko. In her mysterious shop where wishes are granted—for a price—will he discover even more secrets? And what will he have to trade this time for the answers he seeks? The latest chapter in the critically acclaimed xxxHOLiC franchise from manga legends CLAMP, creators of Tsubasa and Chobits! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Kimihiro Watanuki
characters.description: Watanuki (a name meaning "April 1" in kanji) is known for having both a volatile and caring personality. Depending upon the person he talks to, his emotions tend to be overly exaggerated. He lives alone because his parents died when he was young, but harder than these conditions is the fact that his everyday life is plagued with strange spirits that only he can see, and they are drawn to him. Apparently this was inherited- it is noted that his blood smells good to spirits. One average day, while Watanuki is being chased by a legion of spirits, he comes across a strange house which the spirits are repelled by. He feels compelled to enter, and there meets [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/236/Ichihara-Yuuko), who claims that it is a store which grants wishes in exchange for a price. Watanuki asks for the spirits to stop chasing him, and Yuuko agrees to granting it but only if Watanuki w

characters.name: Yuuko Ichihara
characters.description: Being one extremely experienced in her industry, Yuuko is not foolish enough to give away her real name like [Watanuki](https://anilist.co/character/235). That aside, Yuuko has served as a major catalyst for Watanuki's transformation, acting somewhat as his mentor. She loves to drink and eat Watanuki's wonderful cooking and dragging Watanuki on crazy outings at the drop of a hat. Despite this immature and free-spirited attitude, Yuuko has been known to be sage-like and serious when the time calls for it. Yuuko seems to know the true hitsuzen that Watanuki will follow, and has often offered cryptic messages to warn him of impending danger or a folk tale that he should take a bit more seriously. She also seems to truly care about him, making sure he is safe at night, sending the Kudakitsune (pipe-fox) with him for extra protection, or calling Doumeki when he needs saving. Yuuko is very pow

characters.name: Shizuka Doumeki
characters.description: Shizuka Dômeki is Kimihiro Watanuki's classmate and considered a rival by Watanuki. He is part of the school's kyūdō club and often participates (and tops) school competitions. Also because of his cool and calm composure he is very popular with the girls.
