He has a cool, calm and often sarcastic demeanor. He barely speaks unless explaining folklore or asking Watanuki for impossible bento lunches (such as asking for food that is out of season or hard to find). He also has a deadpan sense of humor that is often dark and somewhat fatalistic. Much to the annoyance of Watanuki he seems to pop up everywhere, especially when Watanuki gets a chance to be with Himawari. He often replies in a one word phrase like "Hn" or "Oh". He is also very observant, and even though he does not show it he seems to be very protective of Watanuki, He lives in a shrine owned by his late grandfather, a priest in whi

characters.name: Himawari Kunogi
characters.description: Watanuki's main love interest. He has been infatuated with Himawari ever since the beginning of the series and even some cryptic remarks from Yūko like "are you sure she's good luck?" haven't deterred him. Himawari is caring and kind towards Watanuki, but she has her own reasons in avoiding him becoming closer to her. For some reason she was born with the power to cause serious misfortune (although unintended) to those around her, an issue that even brought death to her grandmother and sometimes brought trouble to her friends.

characters.name: Maru
characters.description: Maru is one of the two girls that led Watanuki into Yūko's shop. It isn't stated whether the girls were created by Yūko, Clow Reed, the both of them, or someone else entirely, but since they have no souls and cannot leave the shop, it can be assumed that they were created there. ~!Possible Powers-In chapter 126, Yūko explained why Maru and Moro are required to stay inside the shop. The shop itself is not seen by anyone unless they are fated to do business with Yūko. Maru and Moro's concentration is what is keeping the shop in existence. As a side-effect, they have long deep bouts of sleep. They help out around the shop, but mostly act as the cheering squad. They almost always speak in unison, or close to it. Watanuki seems to get along with them most of the time, at least when they are not dragging him into one of Yūko's plans. It is noted that Maru and Moro's full names are both words w

characters.name: Moro
characters.description: Moro is one of the two girls that led Watanuki into Yūko's shop. It isn't stated whether the girls were created by Yūko, Clow Reed, the both of them, or someone else entirely, but since they have no souls and cannot leave the shop, it can be assumed that they were created there. ~!Possible Powers-In chapter 126, Yūko explained why Maru and Moro are required to stay inside the shop. The shop itself is not seen by anyone unless they are fated to do business with Yūko. Maru and Moro's concentration is what is keeping the shop in existence. As a side-effect, they have long deep bouts of sleep. They help out around the shop, but mostly act as the cheering squad. They almost always speak in unison, or close to it. Watanuki seems to get along with them most of the time, at least when they are not dragging him into one of Yūko's plans. It is noted that Maru and Moro's full names are both words w

title: Hero-san to Moto Onna Kanbu-san
title_original: ヒーローさんと元女幹部さん
title_en: Superwomen in Love! Honey Trap and Rapid Rabbit
description: When the villainess Honey Trap defeats the superheroine Rapid Rabbit, she sees her nemesis’ face for the first time…and falls head over heels in love! Unable to kill Rapid Rabbit, Honey Trap is cast out of her evil organization, her plans for world domination dashed. Now, the two superwomen are teaming up to fight evil together. Can Honey Trap defeat her former colleagues and seduce the heroine at the same time? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana
title_original: 上伊那ぼたん、酔へる姿は百合の花
description: Kamiina Botan is a 20-year-old college student. At the welcome party for the dorm she was assigned to, the dorm leader Ibuki gives her a highball to drink and she becomes tipsy, leading to her involvement with Ibuki from now on... A tipsy teasing girl's comedy!

characters.name: Ibuki Tonami
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/eve.o0o0.keeey/) Born in Toyama prefecture. She is a third-year at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan). She is the dorm leader of the university dormitory where her and Botan live. She has a neat bob cut and usually wears lax, boyish, and oversized clothes. She is a pretty heavy drinker and has a lot of knowledge about alcohol. This shows especially in her dorm room, which is filled with half-empty liquor bottles. Due to things that happened in her past, she is scared of drinking with other people, so she usually drinks alone. However, this changes when she meets Botan.

characters.name: Botan Kamiina
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kamiina.botan/) Born in Nagano prefecture. The main character of the manga as well as a first-year college student. She is enrolled in the management engineering department of the Faculty of Science and Engineering. She entered college as a ronin, and thus is 20 years old, meaning she is allowed to drink. She has a hard time drinking carbonated drinks and bonds over this with [Ibuki](https://anilist.co/character/309268/Tonami-Ibuki).

characters.name: Chin-Lan Chang
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/chang.chin_lan/) An international exchange student from Taiwan who moves into the dormitory. She has short black hair, a calm atmosphere, and a self-paced personality. Japanese isn't her native language, and she occasionally uses Taiwanese Hokkien when speaking. ~!She very quickly catches onto Ibuki's feelings for Botan and tells Botan to only keep getting closer to Ibuki if she plans on answering her feelings. She also became friends with Gujou rather quickly, after finding out about her unrequited feelings for Ibuki.!~

characters.name: Kanade Gujou
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ka_na_de.206/) Born in Gifu prefecture. She is a student at the same university as Botan and the others and lives in the same dormitory. She has been interested in Ibuki for a long time and is jealous of Botan's relationship with her. She has seen Ibuki drinking alone once before and has asked her to drink together a number of times, however, Ibuki has always refused.

characters.name: Yaeka Kitamori
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/yaeka_journy/) Born in Yamanashi Prefecture. She is a second-year at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan). She seemingly has an intimate relationship with [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/309274/Yusa-Akane).

characters.name: Akane Yusa
characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/y0usir_jp/) A second-year student at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan), she also lives in the dormitory. She has a deep knowledge of music and her dorm room is filled with instruments and vinyl records from her dad. She plays guitar as part of the band "YOUs!R". She seemingly has an intimate relationship with [Yaeka](https://anilist.co/character/309271/Kitamori-Yaeka).

title: Wolya Hwawon
description: The enchanting flower maidens of Moonlight Garden are coveted by all, as they are known to provide sexual pleasures beyond the imagination. But Dohwa, a young flower maiden who has not yet “bloomed,” concocts potions in the hopes of escaping her destined fate at the brothel. One night, she is caught stealing ingredients for her potions by Lady Hyewon, the new mistress of the Garden. But it turns out Dohwa isn’t the only one with an agenda. Lady Hyewon harbors a few terrible secrets of her own. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 3 epilogue chapters.

title: Sinipsawon
description: Seunghyun spent his 20s following his crush through college and grad school, only to wind up totally single and with no idea where to go in his career. When he manages to land an internship at a competitive marketing company, he’s ready for a fresh start without worrying over unrequited love. Except he’s put under the handsome workaholic Kim Jongchan, whose hot and cold attitude leaves Seunghyun flustered. And worse yet, his crush from school works in the same company too! Will Seunghyun survive his first job and a potential first relationship? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title: Sadistic Beauty: Oejeon A
description: Gyerin decides to leave behind her ill-fated first love with Doona and start anew. She quickly meets a woman who looks like her ideal type from head to toe... Is Juyeon, full of armor-piercing amounts of charm, her fortune or woe? (Source: Bomtoon, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Tensei Pandemic
description: Imamura Hinata is a high school boy with a cute appearance. Since his trauma with the first love, he wanted to be more manly than anybody else. But one day he woke up to something different...The total opposite of his ideal male body!

title: Shutohel
description: Beginning of the 13th century. In the days of old existed a woman warrior named Shutohel, the Evil One, feared even by the Mongols, said to be the strongest army in history. At first, she was just a normal Tangut's soldier frightened by the mongol threat, but after coming close to death so many times, she found in herself a superhuman strength. On the other side, a young mongol prince, Yurul, is fascinated by the Tangut's, his enemies' writings, and is worried for the future.... Note: Won the New Creator Prize of the 16th annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2012.

characters.name: Shutohel
characters.description: She used to be an average Tangut soldier, frightened by the Mongol threat. Then came war and she found herself the lone survivor. Maddened with feelings of revenge and agony at the idea that she is the last proof of her dead comrades' existence she becomes a unleashed beast among humans, an fury let loose on the path of vengeance. That is, until she meets Yurul...

characters.name: Sudou
characters.description: A young modern japanese high school student. He spent most of his life having vivid dreams about his past life until he meets Suzuki who helps Sudou come to the realization that he in fact is also the reincarnation of Shutohel. After remembering his meeting with Yurul and Shutohel's death sentence, he decides to interfere and possess Shutohel's dead body so that she can be reunited with Yurul again. Although Shutohel eventually takes her own body over again, he spends a long time in her body and also meets many important characters like Veronica.

characters.name: Yurul
characters.description: The story’s Deuteragonist, Yurul was raised as the younger son of the leader of the Tsog tribe, which is under Mongol control, but is secretly a son of the Khan. As such, he was groomed from an early age to be a scholar, with the hopes that one day he could be used as a bargaining chip to improve the Tsog’s power. Fascinated with the words and cultures of the enemies his tribe stamps on as they advance, and hating the violence and brutality of the plains, Yurul decides to run away from his home, determined to save as much culture as he can from the Tangut, even a bit. Helped by Boldo, he discovers an immense treasure hidden by his adoptive mother - nine slabs of jade engraved with Tangut letters, known as the “Voice of Jade”. Setting out to deliver them to safety, he meets Shutohel, and finds his destiny intertwined with hers. (Source: TV Tropes)

characters.name: Harabal
characters.description: Yurul’s older brother, the son of the Tsog tribe’s leader. An incredibly powerful and ruthless warrior who fights for the Mongols, he is known as "Melgen (God’s Arrow General)", for his great skill with the bow. A commander of great renown within the Mongols, he is the one that butchers the forces of the fortress occupied by Little Sparrow, and unknowingly starts her rampage. (Source: TV Tropes)

title: Amanchu!
description: Hikari Kohinata is an overwhelmingly cheerful and outgoing 15-year-old girl who has spent all her life in a small and beautiful seaside town on the Izu peninsula. On the first day of high school, she meets Futaba Oki, a slightly introverted girl who has just moved from Tokyo. Before she knows it, Futaba gets dragged along into Hikari's passion for scuba diving. And from there, Futaba gradually starts to come out of her shell, and learns how to take challenges and dive into the ocean of life. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Hikari Kohinata
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm Student in Yumegaoka High School Year 1 Class 2 She lives with her grandma at the beach. She loves diving and Tonjiru (Miso pork soup). She wears a diver's safety whistle on her neck. Likes to give people nicknames. She was the one that decided on 'Dotty' and 'Cha'.

characters.name: Futaba Ooki
characters.description: Her nickname was given by Hikari. Student in Yumegaoka High School Year 1 Class 2. Withdrawn and shy, easily nervous in front of people. She got a moped license and commutes to school via a scooter. She loves to take photographs with her mobile phone and safe-keeping them as precious memories. Joined the diving club through Pikari's invitation.

characters.name: Ai Ninomiya
characters.description: Ai Ninomiya Yumegaoka High School Year 2 Student President of the Diving Club. The elder of the twins, she treats Makoto pretty badly, a rather "aggressive" personality. Dives often around Izu and first met Pikari there.

characters.name: Makoto Ninomiya
characters.description: Makoto Ninomiya Yumegaoka High School Year 2 Student Diving Club Senior Member. Dives often around Izu and also first met Pikari there. The younger of the twins, a more "submissive" personality, treated badly by his twin sister, Ai.

characters.name: Mato Katori
characters.description: Yumegaoka High School Year 1 Class 2 Home Teacher Diving Club Supervisor, Adviser, Consultant Shares an interest in scuba diving with Hikari. Had a competition with Hikari when she first went to school and realised that they were diving buddies. Her car is a Nissan Cube (a mini MPV) called "Pokoteng 3rd-kun". Very possible the same character in manga "Roman Club", shares exactly the same name with Katori Senkou's older sister. (Amano Kozue tends to cross over blood relatives of main characters.)

characters.name: Kino Kohinata
characters.description: Hikari's Grandmother. She lives with Pikari at the beach while running a beach house. A smoker who seems to be an expert in cooking Tonjiru or Butajiru.

characters.name: Aria
characters.description: A cat named by Hikari while in the diving clubroom. Named due to it's tea-coloured ears and tails, and the "cha" sound it makes. It's a domestic cat whose real name is Aria.

characters.name: Akane
characters.description: One of Dotty's old friends.

characters.name: Chizuru
characters.description: One of Dotty's old friends.

characters.name: Principal
characters.description: The principal of Yumegaoka High school, and the owner of Advisor Tea and Ohime. (Source: AMANCHU! Wiki)

characters.name: Chizuru Himeno
characters.description: One of Dotty's old friends.

title: Ikemen Joshi to Josou Danshi
title_original: イケメン女子と女装男子
description: My first time out in public cross-dressing as a woman is turning out horribly. A handsome man swept me off my feet and before I knew it we were in a love hotel!? (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Kadokawa for serialization.

title: Moshi, Koi ga Mieta Nara
title_original: もし、恋が見えたなら
description: Mei Haruno was born with the troublesome ability of being able to see pink arrows indicating who people were in love with. In order to escape, she chooses to enroll in an all-girls’ boarding school in the hopes of never getting involved in romance again…only to discover not one, but two arrows directed right at her! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

title: Watashi Igai Jinrui Zenin Yuri
title_en: The Whole of Humanity Has Gone Yuri Except for Me
description: Marika Uruuno is just a normal girl in a normal world. She’ll fall in love normally, get married normally, and have a normal family- or that was the plan anyway. But when she suddenly wakes up in a version of reality filled only with women, she finds herself questioning what exactly “normal” means and why it’s so important to her. And as Mariko discovers something even more precious, she’s faced with a choice-will she find a way back to her previous life…or will she stay in this strange new world? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Lily Kazami
characters.description: Lily is a calm prodigy who comes from a world where only girls exist. When she finds Marika, a girl who came from a world where both men and women exist, she became Marika's 'camouflage girlfriend'

title: Houkago
description: An after school romance of two girls.

title: Sadistic Beauty
description: The lives of two men are thrown into chaos when the sexy Chun Duna returns to town. On one end is student Woo Haesol whose timid nature reveals a man just begging to be dominated. On the other is Professor Byun Minho, a male chauvinist who bitterly views Duna as his mortal enemy. Tempers flare as pain turns into pleasure under the watchful eye of a sadistic beauty. (Source: Tappytoon) Note: The series was cancelled by Lezhin at 51 chapters. It has since resumed serialization on Bomtoon.

characters.name: Du-Na Cheon
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm

title: Sounan desu ka?
description: Because of a plane crash … starting today, we’re spending the springtime of our lives on a desert island!! There’s nothing here, so we have to make everything!! And eat everything!! (Ugh!) Check out our high-school-girl survival story of courage and knowledge. We’re actually doing pretty well! Volume 1 includes: how to eat cicadas, how to build traps, a simple allergy test, how to eat hermit crabs, etc. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Homare Onishima
characters.description: She is solemn high school girl in Class 2-F at first glance, she is the survival specialist of the group being taught by her father since her childhood.

characters.name: Asuka Suzumori
characters.description: Asuka Suzumori is the cheery and athletic girl of the group who is a member of the basketball club while also helping out the track-and-field club, making her the second athletic next to Homare Onishima.

characters.name: Mutsu Amatani
characters.description: Mutsu Amatani is the shy academic girl of the group. Highly intelligent, she ranked first in her school year. Her hobbies are reading novels and cooking, Mutsu dreams to become a yaoi writer in the future

characters.name: Shion Kujou
characters.description: Shion Kujo is the rich and spoiled girl of the group. Being raised in a rich environment, she frequently whines which results in her sometimes embarrassing herself. Initially distrustful at [Homare Onishima](https://anilist.co/character/136411/) at first, she gradually warms up to the group while adjusting to her current stranded life.

title: Mr. Mallow Blue
description: A story about high school students and reclusive NEETs at a boarding school. A mysterious beauty x reclusive NEET x aloof ikemen. Those who find it difficult to live in a cruel society meet by chance and a strange story begins.

title: Maou no Musume, Sugoku Choroi.
title_original: 魔王の娘、すごくチョロい。
description: The romantic comedy centers on Hell, the daughter of the Demon King who resurrects the hero she resents for sealing her father. Hell plans to torment the hero as her servant, but he turns out to be a man with an incredibly sparkling and cool presence. Hell's feelings toward him waver. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Saki
description: Saki's never been a big fan of mahjong. A lifetime of being forced to play with family at holidays (and losing her money as a consequence...) has left a foul taste for the game in her mouth. When she's convinced, though, to play a game with her classmates, she discovers that not only has fending off her family left her with an uncanny ability for the game but, more surprisingly, that it can even be fun! Is this revelation enough to cleanse Saki's distaste for the game? Can her classmates convince her to join their club, or is there just too much baggage to make it worth her while? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: __Position:__ Vanguard Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutenant A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name. A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most, ~!the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.!~ Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: __Position:__ Sergeant A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

characters.name: Kyoutarou Suga
characters.description: A first year student and one of the new recruits for the Kiyosumi Mahjong club, but is not as talented as the rest of the members due to the fact that he is new to the game. As such, he is sent to perform menial tasks more than actually practice. He is attracted to Nodoka due to her physique but so far these feelings are unrequited by Nodoka. He is constantly abused by Yuuki but pays no attention to her pranking ways. He is close with Saki since he has known her since Middle School, but tends to use her to get small things, such as a Ladies' Lunch. Nonetheless, he cares for all of his fellow club members and most likely doesn't mind helping them out, despite being harassed by most of the members.

characters.name: Mihoko Fukuji
characters.description: A third year student serving as the Captain of the Kazekoshi Mahjong Club as well as being the team's ace player. She has a very kind nature, being nice to everyone she meets regardless of who they may be; her kindness extends even to the point where she offers Yuuki, an opposing player from the contending school team, Kiyosumi, her bento so that she would calm down. She even becomes very teary when her teammates help her out, as she feels that it was her fault that her teammates had to work in her place because it was her responsibility. She has been revealed to be very ineffective when working with technology. ~!She keeps her right eye closed to hide her heterochromia from others; while her left eye is reddish-gold, her right eye is actually sapphire blue. She never opens her right eye unless confronted with a dire situation during a Mahjong game. With both eyes open, she is shown to a

characters.name: Koromo Amae
characters.description: Premier member of the reigning champion Mahjong team, Ryuumonbuchi, and one of the most idolized yet feared players in the game. She is said to be possessed by a demon when playing; she even outranked a professional Mahjong player at a previous tournament. She is also the key player that brings an end to Kazekoshi's winning streak. She has a bad habit of wanting to crush her opponent's pride. ~!Her mahjong playing style pressures her opponents and her abilities can prevent them from reaching tenpai. This, together with the mahjong move she favors most, Haitei Raoyue or "last tile win" is a combination that slowly drives her opponents into despair. Haitei Raoyue's literal meaning is "to scoop up the moon from the seabed." Her abilities include being able sense when her opponents are in tenpai and the approximate value of their hands. She usually goes for big hands.!~ She is Touka's cousin

characters.name: Jun Inoue
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Plays the game by reading the flow and manipulating it. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 井丿上惇 instead

characters.name: Tomoki Sawamura
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 澤村智貴 instead

characters.name: Hajime Kunihiro
characters.description: Hajime is a 2nd year student at Ryuumonbuchi High School and is Touka's personal maid. A level-headed cool girl, she, according to Touka, is a strong mahjong player, capable of accomplishing almost anything that she sets her mind to: indeed, Hajime is a proven skilled player, capable of beating any regular player save the "monster" players, such as Saki, Koromo, and Takei. In the past, Hajime used lived with her Father, both of whom who struggled to make a living working as magicians: it is because of this occupation that Hajime is skilled in performing magic tricks, in particular, the "sleight-of-hand" trick, which she used when she played for her school team when she was younger: Hajime utilized her magician skills to make an illegal move, seemingly winning the game for her team. However, later investigations revealed the violation, causing Hajime's team to lose and Hajime herself to q

characters.name: Touka Ryuumonbuchi
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Comes from a very rich family and loves being in the spotlight which leads her to hate Nodoka because of her popularity as the middle school champion. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 龍円渕透火 instead

title: Onii-sama e...
description: A classic manga about girls at a private all-girls school. The storyline centers around the experiences of Nanako, a "normal" girl who is invited to join the prestigious school organization, the Sorority, and is resented by all the other students because she doesn't appear to be qualified. Other key characters are Nanako's two friends: Tomoko, her friend since childhood who is alienated by Nanako's decision to try to join the Sorority, and Mariko, a strange, obsessive girl who is invited to join the Sorority along with Nanako; her "older brother," Henmi, who she corresponds with by mail; and the "Three Magnificent Ones," all of whom are admired and quasi-worshipped by the rest of the student body: the head of the Sorority, Miya-sama, the haunted, pill-popping rebel, Saint Juste, and the star athlete with a mysterious disease who doesn't like the Sorority, Kaoru-no-kimi. Notes: - Includes the one-shot "Canterbury no Natsu (カンタベリーの夏, Summer in Canterbury)". - Includes the one-shot "Yureru Soushun (ゆれる早春, Early Spring Trembling)."

characters.name: Nanako Misonoo
characters.description: Nanako is a sweet and generous 16-year-old girl, who just wants to "be loved by the others, even if only a bit", and doesn't mean to harm anyone. She is suddenly plunged into a world that may change her deeply, as she becomes a member of the Sorority, a prestigious school organisation that only the richest, most beautiful and sophisticated girls can access, the dream of all the youngest students. Nanako's admittance, decided by Lady Miya, will set in motion around the young character a real storm of envy, "retaliations", and threats, causing Nanako's disbelieved desperation before so much violence addressed towards her. After losing for some time Tomoko's support, object of sometimes excessive attentions from the devoted and troubled Mariko Shinobu, Nanako finds comfort in the letters she writes to her "dear brother", Takehiko, in the friendship of Kaoru, who protects her more than once,

characters.name: Rei Asaka
characters.description: Rei is a charming girl attending the second year at Seiran. Nanako meets her for the first time in the bus taking her and Tomoko to their first day in the new high school. Nanako is immediately impressed by her beauty, her confident attitude, and most of all by her "warm and deep" voice. Just like Kaoru, she's an androgynous beauty: she always wears dark man clothes, is a rebel (she smokes uncaring of school rules and likes throwing knives in the old clock tower); she's a very sensitive and tormented soul (she reads and recites Verlaine's poems), she's worshipped by all the youngest students (she plays basketball, plays in the school theatre, she can play wonderfully the piano, the flute, the violin - and guitar in the manga- ). However, everywhere Rei goes, she always takes with her a wide range of pills, that help her forget or ease the pain in her soul, caused mainly by her mysterious

characters.name: Fukiko Ichinomiya
characters.description: A very beautiful girl, unquestioned leader of the Sorority and President of the Student Council. Elegant and refined, Fukiko influences and controls everyone around her, determining their happiness or despair. She has a capricious character, both able of extreme tenderness and chilling wickedness. She seems to have a liking for Nanako (and we'll gradually understand why) and she'll help her become a member of the Sorority, causing a real storm around the young character. Her attitude towards Nanako, however, will always be stressed by several ups and downs, mainly because of Nanako's relationship with Takehiko (and partly with Rei). The main target of her gratuitous wicked actions, however, is always Rei, with whom she has a mysterious and complicated relationship... In her "anime" version we get to discover something more of Fukiko's past and secrets, and in general she's better describ

characters.name: Mariko Shinobu
characters.description: Mariko is Nanako's classmate - she sits close to her - and is immediately attracted by her; she is a very beautiful girl who, not differently from the others, wants to become a member of the Sorority, and is very proud of her beauty. She wants Nanako to become her best and closest friend, and is very jealous of Nanako's friendship with Tomoko. For this reason, she'll try to undermine this relationship, telling some lies to Tomoko. She passionately defends Nanako in several occasions, but sometimes her behaviour is excessive; her sometime strange attitude towards the others is mainly caused by her serious family problems (the relationship between her parents is in a crisis and because of her father, Mariko completely distrusts men...). For some time, Mariko will risk losing forever Nanako's friendship. Mariko has very deep feelings for Kaoru, and in time she'll also become a friend of Tom

characters.name: Kaoru Orihara
characters.description: Kaoru is an androgynous beauty. She's one year older than Nanako, but she's in the same class as her because a mysterious disease prevented her from attending school for a year. Kaoru is a real leader, in fact, besides being the "class-leader", she's also the captain of the school basketball team. She has a noble and generous heart, and can't bear any form of injustice or abuse of power. The name everybody calls her, "Kaoru-no-kimi" (Prince Kaoru), comes from Kaoru Udaisho, a noble character from the ancient Japanese tale Genji Monogatari, a character famous for his beauty and the divine fragrance coming from his body. Kaoru is well-known for her intense vitality and her incredible love for life; she's probably Saint Just's closest friend, she deeply cares for her and often gets mad at Rei's neglect for her health. Kaoru's heart still belongs to a person who is very close to Nanako, a ve

characters.name: Tomoko Arikura
characters.description: Tomoko has been Nanako's best friend and support since childhood. Because of Nanako's admission in the Sorority their relationship - and the trust Tomoko has in Nanako - will be affected negatively. Differently from the manga, however, in the anime this rift, caused by some lies told by Mariko, will be resolved, and Tomoko will always be by Nanako's side, inciting and helping her as usual in her moments of despair or difficulty. With the passing of time, Tomoko will also become friends with Mariko, and will defend her in front of the others more than once. Tomoko's presence in the anime helps in giving a tone of "normality", and helps the viewer not to lose the contact with real life: while all the girls at Seiran base their lives on the Sorority's activities, making of them a matter of life and death , Tomoko always shines in her simplicity, letting the viewer breathe in relief...

characters.name: Takehiko Henmi
characters.description: The "dear brother" of the title, he's a reassuring figure to whom Nanako tells her life experiences by letter . Takehiko is linked to Nanako by more than this elective relationship, and is more in contact than Nanako may imagine with some girls surrounding her and affecting her life. He's a student at university, and his dream is to make an academic career abroad, especially in Germany. He's a quiet and serious guy, and deeply cares for Nanako.

characters.name: Takashi Ichinomiya
characters.description: In the beginning, the name of this character often appearing in Takehiko's company is never mentioned. He's Henmi's good-humoured and genial friend and university colleague. The first time we see him alone is in the building where Saint Just lives, and in time we'll discover how he's related to Rei... He likes Mariko Shinobu, and will try very patiently to win her heart, mainly being there for her in a very difficult moment of her life. (from http://members.tripod.com/~aoisora)

characters.name: Aya Misaki
characters.description: Aya is one of Mariko and Nanako's class mates. The daughter of a famous lawyer, she wishes with all her strength to become a member of the Sorority, like her mother had been when she was young. The main target of her wickedness and malicious remarks is Nanako, as Aya thinks she's completely unworthy of being a Sorority member. Some time later, Mariko, who's always been in competition with her, will become her main target. She has two friends supporting and following her almost everywhere, Furuta and Sonobe. She's better described in the anime version, where we get to know some elements of her past and some hidden aspects (like her sweetness and solitude) of her personality and behaviour. (from http://members.tripod.com/~aoisora)

title: Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen
title_original: はぐれアイドル 地獄変
title_en: Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight!
description: Eighteen-year-old karate expert Misora Haebaru moves to Tokyo to pursue her dream of becoming a famous singer. Unfortunately, her sleazy handlers trick her into the adult entertainment industry instead. Her only way out is to survive a martial arts tournament where she must fight her way through one hundred lustful male opponents. If she loses, she will pay the ultimate erotic price! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Mao Mao
characters.description: __Height__: 172cm An aggressive fighter from Myanmar who practices lethwei, a brutal form of Burmese boxing. ~!It is later revealed that her real name is Yasmin. She is a member of the Rohingya people, an oppressed Muslim ethnic group residing in Myanmar and Bangladesh. After military troops killed her family, she was sold as a sex slave. She was shot while trying to escape but was rescued from death by her would-be teacher and given the name 'Mao Mao'.!~

title: Bocchi Kaibutsu to Moumoku Shoujo
title_original: ぼっち怪物と盲目少女
description: When a monster girl stumbles upon a blind girl who doesn't run away from her, the two begin to bond. The blind girl listens to the monster as if she were human, and the monster slowly begins to feel warmth in her heart.

characters.name: Linaria
characters.description: She is a guard for the Blind household, and she is very overprotective when Lily is involved.

characters.name: Lip Tutale
characters.original: リップ ・ チューテイル
characters.description: She is the stable manager and coach driver for the Blind family.

characters.name: Edel Monstera
characters.original: エーデル・モンステラ
characters.description: Marie's mother. She is the manager of a restaurant whose head chef is her husband.

characters.name: Amaryllis Monstera
characters.original: アマリリス・モンステラ
characters.description: She was born without a voice, which is believed to be the result of a curse.

characters.name: Nazuna Tokiwa
characters.description: She is a skilled doctor and magician who travels from place to place but is currently staying nearby.

characters.name: Flannel Blind
characters.original: フランネル・ブラインド
characters.description: Lily's father and president of the Blind Butcher Company.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Head maid for the Blind family. ~!She is immortal.!~

title: Futsuu to Bakemono
description: Itou, a socially awkward teenager, finds herself jealous of her classmate Takahashi, who seems to get along with everyone. However, one day, she witnesses Takahashi...eat someone whole!? That's amazing! A monster who knows how to blend right in with humans? Itou definitely needs to be her friend now! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Chiguhagu na Karera no Koi no Yukue
title_original: ちぐはぐな彼らの恋のゆくえ
description: What will happen when stylish, smart and secretly otaku Misaki encounters her work colleague Momokawa at a game tournament?

characters.name: Tarou Momokawa
characters.description: __Hobby:__ Playing online games He is an office worker and a professional gamer.

characters.name: Misaki Amami
characters.description: __Hobby:__ Playing online games She is a part-time office worker.

characters.name: Kaguya Takeuchi
characters.description: She is Misaki's friend and also a gamer.

title: Pietà
description: A story about two classmates who become friends, Sahoko and Rio. Rio is depressed and self-abusive and isn't loved by her "family" (which consists of her father, stepmother, and stepbrother), but Sahoko seems to be the bright spot in her life. Sahoko also seems to have a mysterious past and doesn't seem to have a good relationship with her parents; she lives with her aunt. It's also hinted at that Sahoko and Rio have met once before, when they were much younger... (Source: Lililicious) Note: includes 1 extra chapter

title: Lily
description: This is a school love story where Yi Lin bumps into the tomboy Ruo Xi, sparking an interest between each other that slowly blooms. "Is that true? I, fall in love with a girl?" "Why every time I saw her my heart is beating faster?" "How many times does she notice my burning face?" Yi Lin and Ruo Xi both need an answer to go on. (Source: Webcomics)

characters.name: Yilin Fan
characters.description: An ordinary girl in her second year of high school. She's a good student, kind and outgoing, trusting of other people.

characters.name: Ruoxi Lan
characters.description: She colors her hair red for a special reason. Member of the Martial Arts Club. Playful with her friends, she is reliable and strong.

characters.name: Ziyun Xu
characters.description: President of the Drama Club and a good friend of Fan Yiling. Talkative and outgoing, she is always the life of the party.

characters.name: Fan Gao
characters.description: President of the Martial Arts Club and a childhood friend of Lan Ruoxi.

characters.name: Xiaojie Dai
characters.description: Former delinquent who reformed after she met Lan Ruoxi. Being from a rich family, she is generous to her friends.

characters.name: Xiao Che
characters.description: Yilin's friend after timeskip. They work together in radio and the girl joins the college friend group. She appears right from the S2 chapter 1.

title: Kunoichi Tsubaki no Mune no Uchi
title_original: くノ一ツバキの胸の内
description: The plot centers on the titular Tsubaki Kunoichi, the best student in her school, and a curiosity that she cannot reveal. Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

characters.name: Tsubaki Kunoichi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Tsubaki is the leader of the Dog Squad and the Akane Clan's top student, She is good at ninjutsu in general and has a very serious personality, so the teachers expect a lot of her. However, she loses her composure when it comes to "men" she does not know yet.

characters.name: Asagao
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Asagao is a member of Dog Squad. She and her classmate, Sazanka , are an uneven duo with extremes in both appearance and personality. She is such a gourmand that she would rather eat four or five times a day than three times a day, and she hates "no rice" more than any other punishment. Although she is a kunoichi, she is not good at ninjutsu.

characters.name: Sazanka
characters.description: __Height:__ 133 cm Sazanka is a member of Dog Squad. She is easily misunderstood by others because of her foul mouth and mischievous nature, and is treated as a problem child by her teachers. On the other hand, she adores Tsubaki , the leader of the Dog Squad, and refers to her as "Nee-sama".

characters.name: Tachiaoi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Tachiaoi is a member of Team Rat.

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Shion is a member of Team Ox.

characters.name: Rindou
characters.description: __Height:__ 147cm (4'9") Rindou is a transfer student from the Aoi Clan, who later joins the Dog Squad as their fourth member. She is shy and usually hides her face with a fox mask.

characters.name: Suzuran
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Suzuran is a member of Team Ox.

characters.name: Higuruma
characters.description: Higuruma is a member of Team Rat.

characters.name: Itadori
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm Itadori is a member of Team Tiger.

characters.name: Fuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm Fuki is a member of Team Tiger.

characters.name: Ajisai
characters.description: __Height:__ 137 cm Ajisai is a member of Team Ox.

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: __Height:__ 137 cm Ume is a member of Team Tiger.

title: Shura Yukihime
description: A story of pure vengeance, Lady Snowblood tells the tale of a daughter born of a singular purpose, to avenge the death of her family at the hands of a gang of thugs, a purpose woven into her soul from the time of her gestation. (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Yuki Kashima
characters.description: Oyuki is a seductive and beautiful woman, with formidable skills in using a blade hidden in her umbrella. She has been entrusted with the task of vengeance by her mother to kill the 4 people who murdered her brother and father. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gaikotsu Miyahara
characters.description: A writer who pens the Oyuki's story in an effort to draw the final two tormentors out in the open. Although antagonistic at first, he comes to treat Oyuki as his daughter even risking his life to assist in her quest. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Matsuemon
characters.description: The leader of a band of beggars who assists Oyuki in discovering the location of her kill list in return for Oyuki stealing a hojicho for him. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Sakura, Saku.
description: A mysterious boy comes to Saku Fujigaya's rescue when she falls in on a train, but he leaves before she can thank him. After this experience, Saku never ignores strangers in need of help to emulate the boy who helped her. Saku would like to thank the boy who helped her, but all she has is a note signed "Ryosuke Sakura." She discovers that a boy in her high school, Haruki Sakura, has an older brother named Ryosuke. She asks Haruki to deliver her thank-you letter to Ryosuke, but why does he refuse? (Source: Shojo Beat) Note: Includes the one-shot "Otome no Itari" in volume 5, plus prologue and epilogue chapters.

characters.name: Saku Fujigaya
characters.description: High school freshman. Searching for a boy named "Sakura" who helped her on the train in middle school. That incident inspired her to start helping other people. Now she won't abandon anyone in need of help.

characters.name: Haruki Sakura
characters.description: High school freshman. A gentle but slightly obtuse boy. Has a brother Ryosuke who is two years older.

title: Bocchi Kaibutsu to Moumoku Shoujo
title_original: ぼっち怪物と盲目少女
description: A lonely monster, living in seclusion in the forest, wishes she could live amidst humans despite her frightening appearance. Everything changes when she starts getting a visitor–a blind human girl who’s fascinated with her mysterious forest friend. As the monster and the girl grow attached in their secluded world, their love proves that beauty is in the eye of the beholder. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Linaria
characters.description: She is a guard for the Blind household, and she is very overprotective when Lily is involved.

characters.name: Flannel Blind
characters.original: フランネル・ブラインド
characters.description: Lily's father and president of the Blind Butcher Company.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Head maid for the Blind family. ~!She is immortal.!~

title: Wo de Shiwu Kan Qilai Hen Keai
title_original: 我的食物看起来很可爱
description: A vampire that has been asleep for almost two hundred years, Maria, has been awakened by a wolf girl passing by, Xing Lan. When the casket was opened, a curse fell upon Xing Lan. Instead of being scared, the naïve Xing Lan instead believes she has found an amazing companion, and the two embark on a journey to the city. The story begins like this. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Wicked Spot
description: After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. She soon becomes an internet sensation, attracting a huge following of doting fans—and shocks them all by announcing she is a witch. The big reveal turns one follower called Hanako, a lonely young woman with seemingly inhuman strength and a curious resistance to magic, into a dedicated hater, and inadvertently sends them both on a whirlwind adventure beyond their wildest dreams! (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Blooming Sequence
description: Seowoo, president of the film club, is standing outside in the rain, a welcome break from the noisy and chaotic bar behind her, when a girl with orange hair stumbles out the doors and practically into her arms. Then she begins singing “Dancing in the Rain” while... dancing in the rain. It’s a minute encounter, really, but Seowoo has seen the greatest romances bloom from the smallest moments in the movies. So when Hayoung shows up to join the film club, Seowoo – who’s not even sure what she herself is feeling – finds her heart skipping a beat. (Source: Lezhin)

characters.name: Ha-Yeong An
characters.description: She is a freshman college student who joins the Cine.So film club.

characters.name: Seo-U Hyeon
characters.description: She is a college student double majoring in Accounting and Journalism and it's the president of the Cine.So film club.

title: Kimi ni Okuru Eien
description: Note: Originally released as a booklet bundled with the limited edition release of Kimi to Tsuzuru Utakata Volume 6.

characters.name: Shizuku Hoshikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shy girl who avoids speaking with others, she's constantly haunted by her past of having bullied a friend. In secret, she wrote a novel expressing her innermost feelings she has never shared with anyone. Although she had planned to erase herself along with her novel when she finished writing, it didn't work out that way because her classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/204142) borrowed her novel after noticing it by chance. Having read it, Kaori asks when her next novel will be. Everything changes from then on, as they agree to go out until summer ends.

characters.name: Kaori Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 149cm Cheery and energetic, she accidentally stumbled upon her classmate Shizuku's novel when she approached her. After borrowing the novel in order to read it, she has started take an admiration towards Shizuku and asks when her next novel will be. Distraught to know she wasn't planning to write another one, Kaori asks to go out together so she can be inspired to write a new story. Unbeknown to Shizuku, she knew her from elementary school. There's also something she's hiding from her...

characters.name: Shiori Asaka
characters.description: Kaori's little sister.

characters.name: Seri Ichihara
characters.description: She is friends with [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/308867/Ichinose-Ruri).

characters.name: Ruri Ichinose
characters.description: Ruri Ichinose was Shizuku Hoshikawa's classmate in fifth grade of elementary school. She is currently attending a different high school.

title: Futari wa Daitai Konna Kanji
title_original: ふたりはだいたいこんなかんじ
title_en: The Two of Them Are Pretty Much Like This
description: Thirty-year-old Eri and twenty-year-old Wako are “roommates.” Eri is a professional writer, and Wako’s a voice actor who’s building up her reel. Having worked together and now living together, these two women in love have a nice little life for themselves! Follow this comfortable couple in a heartwarming manga tale about the everyday humor, stressors, and joys of a life shared together. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Strawberry Fields wo Mou Ichido
title_original: ストロベリー・フィールズをもう一度
description: “I am your future amore-your lover!” With these words, Pure Sakurasaka crashes into Akira Kouno’s life. As if it wasn’t wild enough that she says she’s come from six years in the future, Pure insists that in her time, she and Akira are engaged to be married! It’s an impossible claim, especially since Akira has sworn off 3D romance, content to immerse herself in 2D dating games. Besides which, why would someone as cute as Pure be interested in a loner like her…? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Swap ⇔ Swap
description: Two girls, Ichinose Haruko and Nikaido Natsuko, bump into each other by accident, resulting in a kiss and them swapping bodies. The only way to swap back is to kiss again...

characters.name: Natsuko Nikaido
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'3") Contrary to her flashy looks, she is surprisingly pure. She cannot deal with men. She believes kisses are special, and they should not be swapping and kissing so casually. In contrast to Haruko, she does poorly in her studies, but is good at cooking. She is also allergic to cats, and is envious that her friends have siblings, as she is an only child.

characters.name: Haruko Ichinose
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5 ft) Haruko is a nice, honest person who likes big breasts. Unlike Natsuko, she is not as bothered when kissing each other. Haruko is the smartest person in her class, but is not good at cooking or exercising. She enjoys playing video games, likes Enka and gravure idols. She is envious of her friends, who have bigger busts than her, and is conscious of her small bust.

characters.name: Satsuki Yusa
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5.4 ft) Reliable girl who often takes care of her two younger brothers. Has good common sense, so she does proper comebacks.

characters.name: Yume Toujou
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5.1 ft) She likes to eat. A lot. A real lot. For some reason has a strange but enviable body that can eat many times more than a normal person and not gain weight.

characters.name: Akiho Mishima
characters.description: ~!Fuyumi is her swap partner.!~

characters.name: Fuyumi Shikata
characters.description: ~!Akiho is her swap partner.!~

characters.name: Ayu Aikawa
characters.description: She likes Haruko, so she sees Natsuko as a rival. She yells a lot.

title: Mahou Shoujo Tokushusen Asuka
title_original: 魔法少女特殊戦あすか
description: When the Earth is threatened by the sudden appearance of undead creatures, a group of young women blessed with powers from a mysterious source rose to defeat them. Now, after three years of apparent peace, the same malevolent creatures have resurfaced. Five magical girls are once again conscripted to war as the Magical Girl Special-Ops force, to defend mankind from an unholy nemesis! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Kurumi Mugen
characters.description: Known as "War Nurse" due to her power based on healing techniques, Kurumi was part of the Magical Five, the group of five magical girls that saved humanity from the beasts of the Netherworld three years ago. She now works as a Magical Warfare Research Officer in the 2nd Research Division of the JGSDF.

characters.name: Asuka Ootorii
characters.description: Known as "Rapture," Asuka is the former leader of the Magical Five, the group of five magical girls that saved humanity from the beasts of the Netherworld three years ago. Due to the scars that the life on the battlefield left on her, she vows to never become a magical girl again and to live a peaceful life away from war.

characters.name: Tamara Volkova
characters.description: Tamara Volkova is a Magical Girl with the designation of Phoenix who works for the United Nations (formerly the Russian Military) and is one of the surviving Magical Girls from the Distonian War, the 'Magical Five'.

characters.name: Sacchuu
characters.description: Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka's Fairy companion Looks like a black cat that can fly Has an ability to analyse objects and enemies Is able to use guns (and is good at it)

title: Kimi wa Nazotoki no Ma Cherie
title_original: きみは謎解きのマシェリ
title_en: My Dear Detective: Mitsuko’s Case Files
description: Hoshino Mitsuko is a determined and hard-working woman living in the 1930s, where career women are a rarity and looked down upon. Despite rampant sexism and pressure to “stay home,” she’s determined to prove herself as a successful detective no matter what. One day, she’s approached by the handsome waiter Yoshida Saku, who presents Mitsuko with her very first solo case. Together, the two work closely to solve the mystery, and Mitsuko finds Saku quite capable—but very curious—and takes him on as her new assistant. Can this duo tackle cases and the turbulent atmosphere of the Showa era? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Mitsuko Hoshino
characters.description: Japan's first female detective and a resolute career woman. Together with her assistant and partner-in-solving-crime Saku Yoshida, she solves mysteries in 1920s Ginza, Tokyo, and gets paid to do it.

characters.name: Saku Yoshida
characters.description: A young university student, a part-timer at the coffee house Sicilia… and the heir of the Yoshida Department Store business in Ginza. To learn about the world at large outside the sheltered circumstances of his upbringing, he joins Mitsuko Hoshino as a detective assistant and helps solve crimes in 1920s Tokyo.

title: Shinsekai yori
description: About one thousand years into the future, civilization has been retrograded and humans are living dispersed within small communities. People in this era have a psychic power called "Juryoku" which materializes things they imagine. In the absence of advanced scientific technology, people are using this power as a major source of energy. One day, a girl called Saki, along with her friends, finds a small archive robot outside the town. It records the ancient history of humans. It tells them that Juryoku was found in the 21st century and the discovery caused a world war between psychics and non-psychics. The psychics won this war and thus their reign of terror began. When the adults in town figure out that the children discovered this forbidden knowledge, they seal their Juryoku and exile them. Saki and the others end up in a forest where they meet a huge hairless bipedal mouse known as a "Bakenezumi" and get involved in a violent war the creatures are currently engaged in.

characters.name: Saki Watanabe
characters.description: Saki is the main character and narrator of the story. Saki is a new student at the magic school, “Saint Academy”. Once she joins Saint Academy, she hangs out with [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/57571/Asahina-Satoru), [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/57573/Akizuki-Maria), and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/57575/Aonuma-Shun), her friends from Wakien Elementary School, as well as [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/57589/Itou-Mamoru), her new classmate. While she's not shy, she is sensitive and delicate.

characters.name: Satoru Asahina
characters.description: A loud, brash 12-year-old who is part of a childhood friend group consisting of himself, Saki, Shun, Maria and Mamoru that attends Sage Academy in Kamisu 66. Satoru is a quick-witted and observant person who cares a lot about his friends despite poking fun at them. He is shown to be particularly close with Saki, as he teases and argues with her more often than the others. Like the rest of the students at the academy, he has a psychic ability called Cantus. During summer camp, the group of five go off on a wild adventure that leads to Satoru and Saki being separated from the others and them meeting a Queerat named Squealer, who appears trustworthy at first but seems to have dangerous intentions.

characters.name: Maria Akizuki
characters.description: Maria is Saki's best friend and a beautiful girl with pale, white skin and blazing red hair. She's very strong willed, and commands the weak, quiet Mamoru, but in times of need she devotes herself to protecting him. On the other hand, she does show a girlish fear of scary stories too. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Shun Aonuma
characters.description: Another one of Saki's childhood friends. Shun is very clever, with a strong intellectual curiosity and mature manners. His marks in magic are excellent at Saint Academy, and many have high hopes for his future. According to Satoru, Shun is the most talented at using the Force in their group.

characters.name: Mamoru Itou
characters.description: After joining Saint Academy and being put in the same class as Saki, he follows them around. He's a very shy boy, and rarely voices his own thoughts and opinions. ~!As he grows older, he starts to have feelings towards Maria. He and Maria were killed after their child's birth.!~ (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Squealer
characters.original: 野狐丸; スクィーラ
characters.description: Squealer is a queerat, an intelligent species that work as servants to humans. Like others of his species, he's small and has the appearance of a giant rat, but is very intelligent and astute. He is the representative of the Robber Fly, a colony of queerats. ~!His ideals are freedom, equality between humans and queerats, and the end of the monarchy system inside of the queerats colonies where the queen is the absolute ruler. He helps [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/57569) and her friends to escape from the wild queerats that were pursuing them. Later, he rescues [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/57573) and [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/57589) from the tainted cats and keeps them in his colony. But his main objective was to get a human child from them to start a revolution. Once he got the child and bred it until it got the cantus, around 10 years old, he uses it to attack

characters.name: Akki
characters.description: Mysterious child who appeared in Kamisu-66 in July of year 237. ~!She is Maria and Mamoru's daughter, but was raised by the queerats.!~ ~!She does not experience death feedback after killing humans. The reason why was because she believed that she was a queerat; thus, her death feedback would only initiate upon killing a queerat.!~ ~!In the end she was killed via death feedback by killing Kiroumaru, who was disguised as a human.!~

title: Coffee Moon
description: Pieta leads an uneventful life in a world of black rain. As the rain pours down, as always, she takes her usual route to school, but the typical conversation with her friend Danae doesn’t happen. “Why can I remember...yesterday’s today?” (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Pieta
characters.description: Every day, Pieta walks to school down the same road, through the same rain, then has the same conversation with her friend Danae. Eventually, she finds happiness in the repetition.

title: Saikin Kono Sekai wa Watashi dake no Mono ni Narimashita......
title_original: 最近この世界は私だけのモノになりました……
description: One morning, upon waking up, people disappeared from the world. Only a single girl was left behind. A beautiful girl's sexual fantasy of seeking men and warmth!!

title: Magan he Danai
description: The funny, daily life of a young adult couple.

title: Hanjuku Joshi
description: When we touch, I grow wings...... A Love and Sex story of two young women packed with growth to maturity. Yae, a girl who has a complex about how feminine she is, transfers to a girl's high school where she meets boyish and energetic Chitose. Chitose's astonishing lack of inhibition is intensely attractive....a woman's world rapidly unfolds in a bittersweet story. Plus, a Student x Teacher adult story!! (Source: Jmanga)

characters.name: Yae Sakura
characters.description: Yae is an extremely feminine girl who wishes she were more like the cheerful, athletic and boyish Chitose. Her wish to be less of a "girly girl" comes from a past event which has left her with scars that Chitose begins to heal. Initially, she finds herself lonely and alienated in an all-girls' high school but Chitose quickly sweeps her along, and Yae finds herself falling in love. She inwardly battles with her emotions in getting close to Chitose on both an emotional and physical level due to painful memories from middle school. Yae is good at cooking and sewing but is terrible at sports. She eventually becomes good friends and confidantes with the older student Mari who enjoys teasing Yae continually.

characters.name: Chitose Hayami
characters.description: Chitose is an exuberant and outgoing tomboy who befriends Yae very early on in the series. She fences and lives for sports and other physical activity, and is considered to be a "star" student in the school, quite unlike Yae who is relatively quiet and is not particularly athletic. Chitose first takes an interest in Yae because she looks like a girl Chitose once had a crush on when she was younger. Eventually, she falls for Yae and struggles to get closer to the other girl despite her roughness and blunt personality.

characters.name: Mari Hanashima
characters.description: 3rd years student at "Momoyama Girls Middle and Highschool" and President of the English Club.

characters.name: Ran Edogawa
characters.description: Teacher at the "Momoyama Girls Middle and Highschool" and Advisor of the English Club.

title: Majo to Kyurasu
description: In 16th century Europe, a witch helps her young apprentice escape a witch hunt and then disappears without a trace. Years later, in modern-day Japan, the apprentice finally tracks her down—only to find that the once-powerful witch is now a gloomy, apathetic woman who spends her days smoking by the window. What follows is a laid-back, offbeat comedy about the clash between a responsible apprentice and her completely unmotivated mentor. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Nokori Ichinichi de Hametsu Flag Zenbu Heshiorimasu: Zamaa RTA Kiroku 24Hr.
title_original: 残り一日で破滅フラグ全部へし折ります: ざまぁRTA記録24Hr.
description: Alexandra is the daughter of a duke in the Kingdom of Tarraconensis. One day, she suddenly realizes that she is the villainess in an otome game, just one day before the story's climactic event! She knows that she'll be denounced and her engagement annulled the next day, but she won't be condemned so easily! She will show her accusers what she's really made of! With only 24 hours left, Alexandra must fight to overcome a desperate situation. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.name: Alexandra
characters.description: The daughter of a duke in the Kingdom of Taraconensis. She is engaged to the crown prince, but things aren't going very well. The day before a party held at their school, she regained her memories of her previous life.

title: Love/Death
description: Shouko wants to kill her friend Akkii. Akkii wants to kill her friend Shouko. How come? Because they love each other so much! This is a story following the romance between two yandere high school girls. Note: - Includes an epilogue - Contains another separate six-chapter story called "Nicochuu (にこちゅう)"

characters.name: Akira Minami
characters.description: Akkii is one of the protagonists of the yuri manga Love Death. A fickle and violent woman, who's madly in love with her classmate Shōko.

characters.name: Shouko Sayou
characters.description: Shōko Sayō is one of the protagonists of the yuri manga "Love Death". A fickle and dangerous woman, who's madly in love with her classmate Akkii.

title: Ningen Konchuuki
description: "Human Metamorphosis," a satirical Manga depicting human society compared to the insect world, focuses on the life of a devious woman. Tomura Toshiko, who is said to be a genius, is a rising star writer. Her novel wins the Akutagawa Prize for the best novel of the year. While she attends the award ceremony, another woman named Usuba Kageri commits suicide in another place. It turns out that Kageri and Toshiko used to live together, and the awarded novel was copied from Kageri's transcript. Toshiko is like a parasite: approaching talented people one after another, squeezing everything out of them and stealing their works for her own fame. Behind her success story, she has her secrets.

characters.name: Toshiko Tomura
characters.description: Toshiko Tomura (born Kageri Usuba) is a former star of the theatrical company Theatre Claw and the winner of the New York Design Academy Award. Known as the "Woman of Talent", she wins the Akutagawa Prize for her story "The Book of Human Insects". Tomura's greatest talent is, in fact, her ability to imitate the talents of others. She clings to talented people, one after another, taking everything out of them and stealing their works for her own fame.

title: Touhou Suzunaan: Forbidden Scrollery.
description: Touhou Suzunaan ~ Forbidden Scrollery is a Touhou official comic published by Kadokawa in Comp Ace beginning on October 26, 2012. It introduces the human book renter and collector Kosuzu Motoori as the main character, with the story centered around her mysterious ability to decipher any book no matter the language or script, and her assortment of various rare and dangerous demon books.

characters.name: Reimu Hakurei
characters.description: She is the miko of the Hakurei Shrine, a remote building far in the east where the boundaries of Gensōkyō and the human world overlap. It is believed that she is the 13th of her line. Reimu is very easygoing — some would say lazy — and hates to train. As such, even though she's naturally talented, her offensive and magical abilities are only average. However, she has a strong sense of duty, and if it's for the sake of Gensokyo she can overcome almost any obstacle through sheer perseverance. Her main abilities are flying in the sky, good intuition, and getting along with everyone; even those who were once her enemies. In the games, she is characterized by her homing amulets and yin-yang orbs.

characters.name: Marisa Kirisame
characters.description: Marisa is a human witch who lives in a cluttered house in the Forest of Magic. She is friends with Reimu and visits her often, but otherwise is solitary and spends most of her time researching magic. She is also an avid collector stuffing her house with various items, and would go "borrowing" things from others without returning them. She is selfish, sometimes violent, and has a disagreeable manner. Underneath, though, she is honest and a hard worker. This makes it strange that she is friends with Reimu, whose powers are purely from talent while she had to work very hard to get her own to the same level. Her ability is high-level destructive magic.

characters.name: Hieda no Akyuu
characters.description: She is the current "Child of Miare" (御阿礼の子), who is born in the Hieda family once in every few hundred years with the ability to "not forget anything she sees" and record Gensokyo's history. She seems to like red tea. Despite her young age, her memory goes back 1200 years. It is because every "Child of Miare" of the Hieda family is a reincarnation of the previous "Child of Miare", who inherits the memories of the previous incarnates. She is the ninth reincarnation in the line. It seems that no one but herself and Yukari know this, though she does mention part of it to Reimu during Memorizable Gensokyo. Each time she reincarnates her life span gets shorter and shorter, and each Child of Miare works on a written record of Gensokyo's history called the Gensokyo Chronicle. Perfect Memento in Strict Sense is the edition of this record that Akyu is writing. (Source: TouhouWiki)

characters.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
characters.description: Mamizou Futatsuiwa is a youkai tanuki who originally lived outside Gensokyo. She moved to Gensokyo to help a friend. She originally lived with humans in a city named Sado. Mamizou often lended them money and got along with them well. However, she doesn't get along with foxes and there are no foxes in Sado. She currently lives in Myouren Temple, along with Nue Houjuu. She holds the power to disguise herself and objects by shape-shifting. _Source: Touhou Wikia_ She makes an appearance in the 9th chapter of Touhou Ibarakasen ~ Wild and Horned Hermit

characters.name: Kosuzu Motoori
characters.description: Kosuzu Motoori is a carefree human girl living at Human village and working at the Suzunaan book renter. She has just recently gained the ability to dechipher all books by just touching them. She uses this ability for reading youkai books, not caring much about their dangerous nature. Kosuzu is shown to be acquaintances with Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame and Hieda no Akyuu. Kosuzu Motoori is the main character of Touhou Suzunaan - Forbidden Scrollery. __Youkai books:__ Youkai books, or in other words youma or demon books, are books written by youkai. They can be old classics simply written by youkai, books written for humans by youkai, or grimoires used by magicians. Most often though, they are books recording a youkai's existence. For a youkai which has its existence denied, the only hope to escape the fate of disappearing entirely from the cycle of reincarnation is to record its own e

characters.name: Sakuya Izayoi
characters.description: Sakuya is the only human living in the Scarlet Devil Mansion, yet she is also the head maid. The official fanbook suggests she had been a vampire hunter before she began working in the mansion, but she was defeated by Remilia Scarlet who pitied her and gave Sakuya her current name. Though she looks about sixteen like the other girls, Sakuya has the ability to slow, stop and possibly reverse time. She seems to have been serving Remilia for a long time and may be far older then she looks. Socially, she interacts mainly with the others in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Her talents are cooking, knife throwing and time manipulation. The latter two abilities characterize her appearances in-game, and led to frequent parodies in reference to Dio Brando of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, who also controls time and throws knives. This reference goes so far as Sakuya using some of his poses in a game. She is

characters.name: Remilia Scarlet
characters.original: レミリア・スカーレット
characters.description: __Species:__ Vampire __Abilities:__ Manipulation of fate __Occupation:__ Mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion __Location:__ Scarlet Devil Mansion Remilia is the owner and head of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, the mistress of [Sakuya](https://anilist.co/character/5570/Izayoi-Sakuya) and Meiling, friend of Patchouli, and the older sister/guardian of Flandre. Though her appearance (and often behavior) is childlike and seems nonthreatening, she has fearsome magical powers and a reputation to match, being known throughout Gensokyo as the dangerous "Scarlet Devil." Like all vampires she is photosensitive and weakens when exposed to sunlight, so she typically remains inside her mansion (which has few windows to prevent light getting in) during the day and emerges during the night. While she is naturally known to drink human blood, her light appetite means her victims almost never die from their w

characters.name: Reisen Udongein Inaba
characters.original: 鈴仙・優曇華院・イナバ
characters.description: A moon rabbit, she came to Gensokyo about 30 years ago to escape a war between the Earth and the Moon. Since then, she has been an apprentice to Eirin, a pet to Kaguya, and a caretaker to Tewi. Reisen has the ability to sense and manipulate waves of all kinds, localised in her "Lunatic Red Eyes". Her signature use of this ability is manipulating brain waves through eye contact, allowing her to induce madness or hallucinations depending on the strength of her opponent's will. By increasing the frequency of brainwaves she can make a person short-tempered and irrational, or by reducing them can leave her target apathetic and depressed. Reisen can also manipulate light and sound waves to deceive the senses indirectly, from concealing the paths of her danmaku, to creating after-images of herself, to casting wide-area illusions that cause people to get lost. Finally, she is capable of releasin

characters.name: Yuyuko Saigyouji
characters.description: Yuyuko is the ghost 'princess' of Hakugyokurou, the netherworld of the "formerly-living", but was once a living human. Long ago, after her death from suicide, her body was used to place a seal on the Saigyou Ayakashi, a dangerous youkai cherry tree, to stop it from killing innocent humans. During the events of Perfect Cherry Blossom, she enlisted Youmu to find a way to make the tree bloom to resurrect the corpse buried beneath it, apparently unaware that it was her own body. Forced to abandon her plan as it would only result in her own destruction and the unleashing of the Saigyou Ayakashi's terror once again, she resigned herself to continuing the existence she had been fated to. She has the power to invite mortal souls to death, and those souls who perish this way wind up in Hakugyokurou rather than heaven or hell. Though it might seem dangerous for such a whimsical, flaky personality

characters.name: Youmu Konpaku
characters.description: Youmu is one of the stranger entities in Gensokyo, part-human and part-ghost at the same time. Her two halves are not intermixed like one would expect from a cross-breed, but actually exist in physically seperate bodies. Youmu has a straight-forward and focused personality, which complements her swordsmanship abilities well. However, her personality conflicts with that of her master, Yuyuko Saigyouji, who is very whimsical and playful in nature. Still, she serves Yuyuko as best as she can, tending to the gardens in Hakugyokurou and following her orders. Youmu commonly wields two blades at once, having studied some under her father, Youki. The longer blade, called 楼観剣 (Roukanken) - Tower-Watching Sword, is said to be able to kill ten ghosts in one swipe; the shorter blade, 白楼剣 (Hakurouken) - White Tower Sword, is able to cleave through a person's own confusion. However, not much is known

characters.name: Yukari Yakumo
characters.description: The characters for Yakumo literally mean "eight clouds" (but can also mean "countless clouds"), and Yukari "violet". Yukari is an elder youkai who dwells on the border of Gensokyo, and may predate the existence of the realm itself. A good friend of Yuyuko's and an acquaintance of Reimu's. She is the self-appointed stewardess of the seal between Gensokyo and the outside world, but doesn't do a particularly good job of it... Most of the time, she is asleep, leaving all the work to her shikigami Ran and Ran's shikigami Chen. When she isn't, she tends to amuse herself by pulling in unprepared humans from the outside world and stranding them in Gensokyo. A very irresponsible youkai. Her ability is the manipulation of boundaries, and such boundaries distinguish her spellcards. Often, though, she just summons her shikigami and various others to create her danmaku for her.

characters.name: Aya Shameimaru
