characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Taketo Aida
characters.description: Taketo Aida is the grandson of Miss Aida, the owner of the candy store where Ilulu ends up getting a job. Although he starts off being suspicious of Ilulu they end up becoming friends after he's shown her kind side. He's shown to be supportive and kind as he's willing to go out of his way to lend a helping hand.

title: Kashimashi: Girl Meets Girl
title_original: かしまし ～ガール・ミーツ・ガール～
description: Being a girl is harder than it looks... For Hazumu, this couldn't be truer, because just the other day, she...was a he. Shunned by the girl of his dreams, Hazumu loses himself in the mountains and is promptly squashed by an oncoming space ship. The alien inside, feeling guilty, rebuilds Hazumu's body...but as the wrong gender! Now Hazumu must learn how to be the girl his parents always wanted while dealing with the trials and tribulations of being caught in a love triangle between two girls--his childhood friend, Tomari, and Yasuna, the girl who rejected him but is now strangely attracted to him/her! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment).

characters.name: Hazumu Osaragi
characters.description: The story begins with Hazumu, the main character, as a boy, who always seemed to have a crush on his friend and classmate Yasuna Kamiizumi ever since he first met her. He was not very masculine in either his appearance or his actions, and so as a child he would get teased for being so feminine. In addition, several flashbacks have been featured in both the manga and anime featuring Hazumu dressed like a girl at a young age. Whether he wanted to do this of his own accord or his mother just dressed him up is never specified but regardless he didn't seem to be bothered by it; indeed he was shown to enjoy it. Once in high school, he confesses his love to Yasuna one day, but is rejected. Afterwards, he climbs the nearby Mt. Kashima to clear his feelings. He is fatally injured by an alien spacecraft crash-landing on the mountain. In an attempt to rectify the accident, the alien pilot revives H

characters.name: Yasuna Kamiizumi
characters.description: Yasuna tends to be a quiet and often lonely girl compared to the rest of her friends. Since her parents are rarely around due to being overworked, she seems to depend on her close friends for love and support, especially when it comes to Hazumu, who unfortunately doesn't tend to show her the type of affection Yasuna desires from her. Yasuna and Hazumu first met as classmates, though they rarely ever talked with each other, which means that Hazumu was simply admiring Yasuna from afar. One day when on Mt. Kashima sometime before the main story began, Yasuna found that they shared an interest in gardening. It was also at this point where she pointed out how feminine Hazumu appeared, which is also the main reason she could see most of his figure minus his face, which as a male was always shown with his hair covering it. As fate would have it, Yasuna rejected Hazumu's first confession of love

characters.name: Tomari Kurusu
characters.description: Tomari is Hazumu's childhood friend who has been with Hazumu for a long time, and most importantly protected him often from bullies. In direct contrast to Hazumu, her most obvious quality is that she is a tomboy which is shown through her actions and lack of interest in traditionally feminine things such as clothing or shopping. Indeed, Tomari's friends of both genders consider her very masculine which often causes Tomari to get angry at such comments. Additionally, she is a member of the Track and Field Club and enjoys physical activities. Before Hazumu's change, she shows some latent interest in Hazumu and is at first just as shocked as everyone else when he is transformed into a girl. Tomari has always put a lot of effort into supporting Hazumu and defending him whenever he is in despair. Though Hazumu has always been grateful for Tomari's support, at times Tomari later seems to be je

characters.name: Ayuki Mari
characters.description: Ayuki is Tomari's best female friend, who, much like Yasuna, is quiet and reserved, though seems to be more social than Yasuna. Indeed, she serves to act as the voice of reason between the interactions of the other characters. Additionally, Ayuki seems to have an interest in observing the people around her and she enjoys learning about the sciences, though most specifically, biological sciences. It is suggested indirectly that Ayuki is also interested in Hazumu, and later in the anime, she also seems to be interested in Tomari. However, she says that she prefers not to get involved with the developing love triangle and simply observes from the sidelines.

characters.name: Asuta Soro
characters.description: Asuta is Hazumu's best male buddy before and after the UFO crash, though his opinion of Hazumu changes somewhat due to his taking interest in Hazumu's new female form and feminine personality. Asuta is a good deal more manly than Hazumu ever was, and was trying to find Hazumu to give him some adult magazines (which Hazumu hates) on the night of the Mt. Kashima incident as an attempt to try to console him for getting turned down by Yasuna. Asuta has found himself more and more attracted to Hazumu after the transformation, leaving Hazumu completely oblivious of this fact. Eventually, Asuta resolves to simply being Hazumu's best male friend and sees that her main interest is indeed with Yasuna.

characters.name: Namiko Tsuki
characters.description: She is the homeroom teacher of Hazumu's class who has an excessively cute style shown through her loud expressions of love towards Hitoshi Sora or her passion for protecting her students in her class. Also, she is extremely clumsy which gives rise to her being the butt of many jokes.

characters.name: Hitoshi Sora
characters.description: Hitoshi Sora is a cultural anthropologist and space alien. His research brought him to visit Earth, and he is currently in disguise as the biology teacher at Hazumu's high school. His unfamiliarity with human ways provides the series with an outside perspective on love - the focus of Sora's research. Additionally, his views on other subjects, such as friendly competition or war, provide a somewhat existentialist point of view. The alien's research, explained in the manga, is of great importance to the survival of his species as he fears that if his currently rather unemotional people do not rediscover passions like love, they may all eventually die out.

characters.name: Jan Puu
characters.description: Jan Puu is an artificial intelligence employed by Hitoshi Sora as the automatic pilot of his spaceship. Though Jan Puu is very enthusiastic about new people, she seems to have few social skills and often acts like a human child. Her human body is modelled after Hazumu's female body, whom she addresses as onee-nii-sama (お姉兄さま literally meaning "older sister-brother").

characters.name: Touru Osaragi
characters.description: He is Hazumu's father, who loves taking pictures of Hazumu. This often consists of him trying to get Hazumu in provocative poses and expressions which leads his wife to wrestle him down to the ground. Additionally, he repeatedly attempts to take a bath with his daughter but is always stopped.

characters.name: Kahoru Osaragi
characters.description: She is Hazumu's mother, who loves to buy new feminine clothes for Hazumu to wear. Usually she buys these clothes without consulting Hazumu herself and regardless Hazumu ends up wearing them, though Hazumu doesn't put up any resistance to her new and ever increasing wardrobe.

title: Kare to Kanojo no Sentaku
title_original: カレとカノジョの選択
description: Hokkaido and Tokyo: Seven years after being separated, the young man has been waiting for his best friend to meet again since middle school. What arrived at him was an email from a best friend who apologized for being late, and a mysterious beauty. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Dame Inu Kanojo
description: Sakurako Kuramochi has totally remade herself into a more popular girl since her debut in high school. However, deep down inside, she still bears the scars of being dumped by a girl she used to like. One day after school, while walking downtown, Sakurako bumps into another girl, who turns out to be that girl who rejected her in the past! For some reason, she proclaims that she's fallen in love with Sakurako at first sight, and asks if they can meet again. Sakurako gets angry at the girl for not recognizing her, and comes up with a plan to get revenge...? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Osananajimi BIG LOVE
description: I once had a childhood friend who was a cute angel. However, when we met again, many years later, she had become a flamboyant gal. A yuri story between two childhood friends. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published, it was collected for a commercial volume release on 2024-09-26.

title: Oshi to no Yuri wa Arienai!
title_original: 推しとの百合はありえない！
description: It's a yuri manga!! It's original!! A wholesome all-ages manga that definitely won't do anything illegal. (Source: Pixiv, translated) Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

characters.name: Kaoru Kenzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm A cheerful dumb gyaru who gushes over the class representative, Tsukamoto Anne, whom she perceives to be incredibly beautiful. Due to her poor grades and rule-breaking tendencies, as well as the possibility of being suspended or expelled from school, she was chosen to join Tsukamoto as a class representative so that Tsukamoto could assist her in changing her behavior. Tsukamoto, on the other hand, begins to assume she is a drug addict due to her lack of intelligence.

characters.name: Anne Tsukamoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm A class representative who is a perfectionist with an aggressive personality. Her perfectionist attitude prompts her to accept a teacher's offer to have her improve the conduct of Kenzaki Kaoru, a dumb gyaru who adores Tsukamoto and is also a type of person Tsukamoto despises, by appointing them both as class representatives. However, Kenzaki's weird and dumb behavior when she meets with her gives her the false impression that she uses drugs, and Tsukamoto discreetly tries to help her overcome her drug addiction.

title: Kyuuketsuki to Yobaretai
description: Aoi wants to go to the same school as her childhood friend Yuuna so she transfers to Vlad Academy, but everyone except Aoi is actually a vampire!? Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Watashi no Shumitte Hen desu ka?
title_original: 私のシュミってヘンですか?
description: Maiko Fujimiya is a second-year high school student whose hobby is admiring girls' butts.She likes to stand at the bottom of the stairway closest to the female-only train and stare upwards. However, she doesn't adore all butts equally; her type is a big, sexy, plump ass. Fortunately, she has noticed a girl with the perfect butt riding on the same train as her. Moreover, she also gets off at the same station as Maiko. Still, Maiko is content with admirng that ass from afar and fantasising about it, but her life is about the change when the girl suddenly approaches her. Included one-shot: Himitsu no Zettai Ryouiki (秘蜜の絶対領域)

title: Fatale Game
description: "If it means that I can read your work again, I'll even chase you to the ends of the earth." Seri Tainaka, writing under the pen name Nanakusa, is a mid-career manga artist living in the shadow of her only one-hit-wonder. Her series "To Hell and Back" was adored by fans, but despite now being a ten-year veteran, her successes ended there. So when Seri is told that she is being assigned a new editor, it only fuels her insecurities. When Seri meets the quirky Sumire Futami, she's both creeped out and captivated by the strange and overly forthright woman, who claims she'd go to hell and back to make her a success again. But just when Seri starts to think she and Futami might be an unstoppable duo, she meets the other manga artists Futami is assigned to, and a dangerous game of jealousy, envy, and femme fatales begins. It turns out that Futami has no qualms about going back and forth between which of her artists capture her attention the most, and they'll stop at nothing to win the number one spot in their fickle editor's heart! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: mono
description: From Afro, the creator of Laid-Back Camp, comes a new comedy adventure manga! The Photography Club is in danger of shutting down?! And the Cinema Club too?! Fret not, for they shall merge and become…Cinephoto Club! Now club members Satsuki, An, and Sakurako are asked to be the main characters for manga artist Haruno's latest work that's centered around action cameras. The girls head out to capture the lovely sights of Japan, experimenting with gadgets beyond photography and film equipment, and of course, chomping on the local delicacies along the way! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Haruno Akiyama
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) **Camera:** Smartphone A 4-koma manga artist, using the pen name "Akino", and was a few steps shy of becoming a full-blown NEET. Lives with her grandmother who runs a cheap sweets shop.

characters.name: Sakurako Shikishima
characters.description: **Height:** 145 cm (4′9″) **Camera:** Smartphone The president of the Cinema Studies Club. When all the senior students graduated, she was left behind (alongside fellow member "Ms. Tajima"), and like the Photo Club, Sakurako's club is on the verge of being completely dismantled.

characters.name: Kako Komada
characters.description: **Height:** 175 cm (5′9″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera Kako is a motorcyclist who is into "motovlogging", often recording her scenic rides for people to watch on the Internet on WeTube — her "ISERIDER" account contains multi-part touring videos that might average 20,000 views.

characters.name: Satsuki Amamiya
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm (5′1″) **Camera:** 360° camera A girl who adored her senpai so much that she joined her Photography Club. Unfortunately, after her senpai's graduation, Satsuki was left in ruins, until she finally made the initiative to buy not just a camera -- but one that captures the world in 360-degrees!

characters.name: An Kiriyama
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4′11″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera An loves "Sacchan" (Satsuki) so much that she also joined the Photography Club. Her personal camera is a small, but tough-bodied action cam.

characters.name: Torayo Kurokuma
characters.description: Famous horror manga artist. She lives in a famous shrine and loves cats

characters.name: Fuuka Inomata
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) She is an alumnus and actress of the old Cinema Club.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Kagamihara
characters.description: A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

characters.name: Sakura Kagamihara
characters.description: Sakura Kagamihara is the older sister of [Nadeshiko Kagamihara](https://anilist.co/character/124576). She often drives Nadeshiko to and from campsite destinations.

characters.name: Shuuichirou Kagamihara
characters.description: The father of [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Nadeshiko-Kagamihara) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/125023/Sakura-Kagamihara) Kagamihara.

title: Tai Sekaiyou Mahou Shoujo Tsubame
title_original: 対世界用魔法少女つばめ
title_en: Magical Girl Tsubame: I Will (Not) Save The World!
description: The world is in danger! Who will rise to protect it? Introducing Tsubame, an ordinary high school student who dreams of becoming a magical girl. But if she has to choose between the world and her friends... A new adventure from Mapollo 3, the creator of PPPPPP! Buckle up for some passion, magical girls, and a dash of madness! (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Dachi no Imouto
description: A friend asked him to keep an eye on his friend's sister to keep her away from bad guys, but it backfires. Love at first sight and a secret relationship are filled with sweet immorality. A love story with a difficult road ahead. (Source: Hakusensha, translated) Note: Includes 33 extra chapters.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Gou
title_original: ひぐらしのなく頃に 業
description: Life couldn’t be better for Keiichi Maebara. Sure, not much happens in the sleepy mountain village of Hinamizawa…but in the three short weeks since moving here, he’s already found some amazing new buddies—who are all cute girls! However, when he discovers hints of Hinamizawa’s violent history, his dear companions insist on keeping him in the dark. Keiichi can’t escape his growing unease—will it be enough to shake his faith in his best friends? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar

characters.name: Shion Sonozaki
characters.description: Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. ~!Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger sister.!~ She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, s

characters.name: Satoshi Houjou
characters.description: Satoshi is the older brother of [Satoko Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Although he is currently missing, his past influence is the key to the actions of several characters in Higurashi. Similar to Satoko, he cannot distinguish the difference between cauliflower and broccoli. Because of this, it can be inferred that both Satoshi and Satoko are color-blind. ~!It is revealed in Matsuribayashi-hen (Festival Accompanying Chapter), that Satoshi is in fact alive. [Shion Sonozaki](https://anilist.co/character/1313/Sonozaki-Shion) learned from [Kyosuke Irie](https://anilist.co/character/7445/Irie-Kyousuke), that he has been kept in the underground levels of the Irie Clinic. Satoshi is sedated and restrained, undergoing treatment for Level Five Hinamizawa Syndrome, which surfaced after he had killed his aunt on the night of the Watanagashi.!~

characters.name: Kuraudo Ooishi
characters.description: Kuraudo Oishi is a veteran police investigator at Okinomiya who has vowed to solve the mystery of the Hinamizawa murders before his retirement, due to personal reasons. Due to his uncouth tactics and the lengths that he goes to in order to solve the mystery, he is looked upon as a nuisance by the villagers. ~!He approaches one of the main characters to become his informant in several arcs, and is sometimes unwittingly responsible for triggering their paranoia.!~

characters.name: Miyo Takano
characters.description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

characters.name: Rumiko Chie
characters.description: Rumiko is the female teacher of Keiichi's class, who is a parody character of Tsukihime's Ciel-Senpai (permission for her usage was given by Type-Moon). The seiyū for her character in the anime series is the same as the seiyū of Ciel from the Tsukihime anime. Going along with the parody, her favorite food is curry rice, just like Ciel, and will go to great and somewhat scary, lengths to uphold the honor of curry, which is shown in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei OVA, where she becomes enraged by Keichi's "offense" to curry. On a stronger note, she is seen wielding wooden T's, shapped, and held, in exactly the same fashion as the Black Keys from Tsukihime.

characters.name: Mamoru Akasaka
characters.description: He is a young police investigator at the Metropolitan Police Department in Tokyo. He befriended [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) while investigating a case in Hinamizawa four years ago, all due to a prophecy about his wife which came true, though he just brushed it off as coincidence.

characters.name: Kyousuke Irie
characters.description: Kyosuke is the head doctor of the village clinic. Despite his young age and the fact that he has a severe maid fetish, he is highly respected in the community. He cheerfully makes house calls and seems to truly care about everyone's health. He has (half-jokingly) admitted that he wishes to marry [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko) when she is older, but is not above chasing after [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) when she is wearing one of the uniforms from the restaurant Angel Mort. In addition, he is the manager of the village's baseball little league team, the Hinamizawa Fighters. ~!In the past, he has performed lobotomies without consent, which led to him being banished from the medical academic society in Tokyo. He is recruited by Takano to direct research the Hinamizawa Syndrome, which he feels will redeem himself. It is later revealed that

title: Kekkyoku Sonna Kimi Ga Suki
title_original: 結局そんなきみが好き
description: A spin-off story from Comic Yuri Hime series Can't Defy The Lonely Girl by the original author. The story is about the couple of Wakana Morinaga and Yuina Minami, who appeared as side-characters in the main series, and their life in college. (Source: Number Nine, translated)

characters.name: Wakana Morinaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm Wakana is a high-spritied gal from Osaka. She is athletic but does not want to join an athletic club because it is too tiresome. She is pretty good at playing the piano.

characters.name: Yuina Minami
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm Yuina likes fashion and trendy things. She reads hair styling and fashion magazines and doesn't participate in any school clubs.

characters.name: Sora Honda
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm She's a student who was persuaded to return to school on the condition that "[Ayaka](https://anilist.co/character/183577/Sakurai-Ayaka) listens to one of her requests every day." She has a quiet, clever, and introverted personality.

characters.name: Ayaka Sakurai
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm She is a model student with top-of-the-class grades, but she suffers from anxiety during tests, causing her to attend a lower-level high school than she hoped for. She is the class representative and has an outgoing, quiet, and guarded personality. She adores baby chick dolls and has an entire collection in her room.

title: Hardcore Vanilla
description: “Tie me up and punish me. I want to be your dog…” Chanhee has a major crush on Eunjo, the campus goddess. Tired of waiting around, he decides to join her in her secret fetishes – stepping foot into the wild, wild world of BDSM. What Chanhee doesn’t realize, however, is that Eunjo is a vanilla just like him, and that the two have just embarked on a journey neither of them had asked for. Kinks and crushes, and a whole lot of drama in between! (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: Kuzu Rounin-sei, Jinsei ga Tsurai node Yoru no Onee-san wo Yonde Mita
title_original: クズ浪人生、人生が辛いので夜のお姉さんを呼んでみた
description: Makino failed her college entrance exam. Her only comfort is in her 2D game characters... until she found an ad for a call-girl who looked exactly like her favorite in-game waifu! The yuri love comedy between a gullible young woman and a street-wise call-girl begins now! (Source: Ganma, translated)

characters.name: Makino Hanabusa
characters.description: Makino failed her college entrance exams and decided to cheer herself up by hiring a call girl who looked like her favourite video game character.

characters.name: Mashiro Satou
characters.description: She teaches at Makino's parents' cram school while also working as a call girl.

characters.name: Sena Tsumabuki
characters.description: Reina's girlfriend. She grew up in an orphanage.

characters.name: Reina Hanabusa
characters.description: Makino's older sister, Sena is her girlfriend.

title: Ohimesama no Himitsu
description: Fujiwara is the school’s most admired student and captain of the volleyball team, but her reputation is at risk when she accidentally breaks the principal’s most prized possession, a priceless vase. Fellow student Miu witnesses the accident, and Fujiwara begs her not to tell. In exchange, she’ll do whatever Miu wants. It turns out that what Miu wants is to date Fujimaru! Although this wasn’t an arrangement that either girl expected, the two soon discover that breaking the vase may have been destiny’s way of bringing them together. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yuki no Niiduma wa Boku to Tokeaitai
title_original: 雪の新妻は僕と溶け合いたい
description: When Yusuke Sakanoi fainted from heat stroke at his part-time job, he was rescued by a cool, mysterious beauty. Entranced, he tracked her down at a soapland bathhouse. Her name is Rinka, and she is a novice snow-woman who just came to the city to learn the trade from the other snow-women at the bathhouse, feeding off the energy of the men who come in. It turns out that while he was delirious, Yusuke wished for Rinka to marry him, and that's enough for them to become husband and wife! Can he handle being a couple with a very cute and very sexy snow-woman? A newlywed love comedy that's a bit cold and a bit ecchi!

title: Asagi Iro no Saudade
title_original: あさぎ色のサウダージ
description: Fujisawa Ren, struggled to find place both in hometown and in Tokyo, where Ren started living as if trying to escape. Unable to discover hope for life, Ren was on the verge of giving up everything. That's when Matsuri, a childhood friend Ren never wanted to meet but longed to see desperately, appeared. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Sugar Girl Drip
title_original: シュガーガール・ドリップ
description: Marie, a sparkling college girl and online influencer with an overflowing need for approval, gets a part-time job at a diner cafe because she likes the uniform. There, she meets Aki, a minefield girl who's trouble, and it's going to change their lives forever...? The overdose of desire begins, in a neon-lit city that never sleeps! (Source: Comic Days, translated)

title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san
description: About best friends Yachiyo Inugami and Suzu Nekoyama. Inugami likes cats and has a dog-like personality. Nekoyama likes dogs and has a cat-like personality.

characters.name: Aki Hiiragi
characters.description: Yachiyo's friend and Suzu's classmate who often serves as the straight-man trying to bring Yachiyo and Suzu's relationship back down to reality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yukiji Ushiwaka
characters.description: Mikine's senior in the biology club who, much like her cow-like name suggests, has ample breasts.

title: Siseonui Kkeut
description: Welcome to Greywoods, a beautiful mansion isolated deep in the countryside. Its main inhabitants? The Viscount Rose, his daughter Lady Eileen, the housekeeper, the butler, and... a new maid, Marie. As Lady Eileen and her newest (and only) companion begin to open up to each other, do their hearts follow close behind? Now, don’t mind any lingering ghosts still haunting the grounds, they’re not real! Nor are there any enduring secrets, deep-rooted betrayals, or an air of mystery... just trust me. (Source: Tapas)

title: Tsuki ga Kirei desu ne
description: "This is a story of a country far, far away. What distinguished the citizens of this country apart from others was the animal ears on their heads and also, their acceptance of same-sex marriage." Kasuga Chiru is the only daughter of a powerful and wealthy family. At seven years old she was engaged to Shinonome Senri, a girl from a family of much lower status. But besides that day, the two never met again. Now sixteen, Chiru prepares to marry her betrothed, yet she wonders if the kind Senri has changed over the years they've been apart, and whether they can become a happy family even though their union is arranged. Upon visiting Senri's town, Chiru is overwhelmed by all the love and fondness the townspeople have for their apothecary, Senri. Chiru begins to feel a stirring in her heart, that same wonderful feeling the night Senri rescued her, the night they met. A tender love story of arranged marriages and fox girls begins! Note: Includes four extras.

title: Semelparous
description: Ever since they were young girls, best friends Yorino and Haruka have been training to become Bastioners–soldiers who battle in a walled area that protects humanity from the kaiju trying to break through. But when Haruka is killed during a routine exercise, Yorino must fight even harder to make sure she never loses someone close to her again. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Haikei, Arishi Hi ni Saku Hanatachi e
title_original: 拝啓、在りし日に咲く花たちへ
description: Kasumi, a serious girl who has just started at an all-girls school, discovers a letter tucked into an old book she found in the library. The letter's writer yearns to have a special relationship with another girl, like how it was described in the book… A romance about the the old-school "S" kind of girls-love. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Comic Girls
description: The story concerns the daily life of young up-and-coming mangaka living together in a dormitory.

characters.name: Ruki Irokawa
characters.description: A serialized "Teen's Love" manga artist. She originally wanted to draw cute animal manga for children, but her ability to draw big-breasted women led to her drawing erotic manga.

characters.name: Tsubasa Katsuki
characters.description: A serialized shounen manga artist with a boyish appearance. She will often put herself in the role of one of her characters in order to work on her manga. Because of her handsome appearance, other girls often fall in love with her, the most notable example of which is Koyume.

characters.name: Koyume Koizuka
characters.description: A shoujo manga artist who struggles with drawing boys. She develops a crush on Tsubasa. She has no experience in romance, so she is always nervous about the quality of her romantic manga and the nature of her "strange" feelings for Tsubasa as another girl.

characters.name: Kaoruko Moeta
characters.description: A shy 4-koma manga artist who moves into the Bunhousha Dormitory to improve her manga. As she looks much younger than she is, her appearance often becomes a reason for jokes and affection of others.

characters.name: Suzu Fuura
characters.description: A horror manga artist who enjoys the screams of others. Despite her odd behavior, she is rather pretty.

characters.name: Ririka Hanazono
characters.description: The housemother at Bunhousha Dormitory, ~! who is a former yuri manga artist. !~

characters.name: Miharu Nijino
characters.description: The strict homeroom teacher of Kaoruko's class.

characters.name: Mayu Amisawa
characters.description: Kaoruko's editor.

title: Idol na Kanojo to Wotaku na Boku to
title_original: アイドルな彼女とヲタクな僕と
description: "She is a famous idol. On the other hand, I am just a nerd. We have to keep our relationship a secret."

title: Kaijuu Iro no Shima
description: Middle school student Kon Chigawa has never left the small island she was born on, nor does she expect to. Shunned by her classmates, Kon's always alone, and she hasn't ever been in love, either. That is, until she encounters the city girl Furuka on a cliff-and ends up resuscitating her after they fall into the ocean! Upon waking, the two mysteriously find themselves in front of a cave said to house monsters, a place Kon often spends time by. And with that, strange occurrences begin to happen on the island... (Source: Yen Press)

title: philosophia
description: Ai-chan, a pretty student in her first year in a university, meets Tomo after she asks for a cigarette light from Ai. An apathetic, budding friendship ensues as they try and survive everyday university life together with the help of their daily does of caffeine and nicotine.

characters.name: Ai
characters.description: Ai is a stubborn, somewhat hot-tempered beauty. She is indifferent to people’s compliments on her beauty and is tired of people’s superficiality. She is annoyed of her partying and sex-crazed peers. She is diligent to her studies so she can graduate and not depend on other people. She didn’t believe in love at first, but gradually learns to after she met Tomo, her senior in the university. They have met in a smoking area on entrance ceremony day after Tomo approaches her to borrow her lighter. They got along well. Since then they meet regularly to smoke together and drink coffee in a cafe. Her favorite food is bread.

title: Con Cafe Jou wa Koi wo Kiru
title_original: コンカフェ嬢は恋を着る
description: Tsumugu Aisaka, is a huge fan of clothes and aspires to become a fashion designer. One day, she meets a con cafe girl in Kabukicho and ends up working as a new cast member. What happens when she can only "talk about clothes" with people she meets for the first time? (source: Comic Fuz, translated)

characters.name: Miki
characters.description: Owner of the Runaway Cafe

title: Oomuro-ke
description: A spin-off of the Yuru Yuri series featuring Sakurako and her sisters. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sakurako's older sister. She's always quiet and has a cool demeanor. ~!Nadeshiko is dating a girl, whose identity is currently unknown; it is one of the main mysteries of the Ohmuro-ke manga. It is hinted that the girlfriend might be one of her three classmates –with whom she is on good terms with– after a phone call that revealed that the two girls visit the same school.!~

characters.name: Hanako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 127 cm Sakurako's younger sister who is an elementary school student.

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

characters.name: Kokoro Ogawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 125 cm

characters.name: Mirai Souma
characters.description: __Height:__ 127 cm

characters.name: Megumi Sonokawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm

characters.name: Misaki Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 126 cm

title: Uso Kareshi Demo Ii Kara Tonikaku Shitai Mashiro-chan
title_original: 嘘彼氏でもいいからとにかくシたいましろちゃん
description: Mashiro Naomoto wants to have a taste of romance and maybe go a little further than that, now that she's in high school. However, she lacks self-confidence and she figured that it's impossible for anyone to like her. But to her surprise, a handsome boy named Oosagi-kun suddenly confesses to her. Mashiro suspects that his confession must be the result of some punishment game, but her own desires overcome her doubts, and she does the unexpected by making her own moves on him?! This is a rom-com where a high school girl's libido runs wild!! (Source: Comic-Meteor, translated)

title: Hana wa Saku, Shura no Gotoku
description: Hana, who lives on the small island of Junaru with a population of 600, loves to read to the children of the island. Mizuki senses the power of Hana's "reading", and invites her to join the Broadcasting Club, where Mizuki is the club president. "Tell me what you really want, and I will make it come true." "I want to join the broadcasting club." Hana decides to join the club, and as she experiences many "firsts" with the members of the broadcasting club, it only deepen her love for reading aloud... (Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

characters.name: Ryouko Totonoi
characters.description: Vice-president of the broadcasting club.

characters.name: Miiko Nekoi
characters.description: A first-year student at Sumomogaoka High School and Kana's classmate. She has a friendly personality. She is a member of the track and field club.

title: Onna dakara, to Party wo Tsuihou sareta node Densetsu no Majo to Saikyou Tag wo Kumimashita
title_original: 女だから、とパーティを追放されたので伝説の魔女と最強タッグを組みました
description: Tanya, a mage who was exiled from her adventurer party for the unreasonable reason of "because she is a woman", accidentally breaks the seal of the great witch Laplace, and decides to form a new party together. After having her job changed from being a mage to being a magic swordsman, Tanya powers up and joins the guild ranking battles with Laplace to get back at the party that had banished her. It may be sudden, but the strongest tag team proves to be a great success! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

characters.name: Tanya Artemiciov
characters.original: ターニャ・アルテミシオフ
characters.description: Tanya is a skilled mage who got kicked from her party for being a woman.

characters.name: Laplace
characters.description: Laplace is a Sorceress who was sealed away in the Western Wasteland under a mountain by Maxwell the Grand Mage 300 years ago. She was freed by Tanya when one of Tanya's spells broke the mountain under which Laplace was sealed away.

characters.name: Nadine Amaryllis
characters.original: ナディーネ・アマリリス
characters.description: Nadine is a level 3 Healer who worked for the Adventurers' Guild as a receptionist until Tanya invited her to join a party she created with Laplace.

characters.name: Katherine Foxxi
characters.original: キャサリン・フォキシー
characters.description: She joined the party Tanya used to be a part of before Ryan Daars kicked her out. She only joined the party to meet people in the hopes of finding a suitable man to marry.

characters.name: Ryan Daars
characters.description: Tanya's childhood friend and the leader of the party she used to be a member of. He told Tanya that he kicked her out of the party because she wasn't affectionate enough, and that female adventurers retire early in order to find a marriage partner.

characters.name: Arianora Aweigkorrt
characters.original: アリエノーラ・アウェイグコート
characters.description: The First Empress of the Nouhim Empire and the only direct descendant of the Emperor.

characters.name: Maxwell
characters.description: The legendary mage who sealed Laplace 300 years ago. He attained immortality and is still the Chief of the Royal Sorcerers for the Nouhim Empire 300 years later. ~!He is Laplace's biological father. He subjected his daughter to a variety of biological experiments in order to achieve his own immortality.!~

title: Moonlight flowers: Gekka Bijin
description: A classic yuri manga about a woman who leaves her husband for an old friend from school. There are two stories in this manga--one (Moonlight Flowers) is the main story, and the other (Midnight Flowers) is about the love interest's past. (Source: Lililicious)

characters.name: Sahoko Yamaguchi
characters.description: A young woman who is getting married at the beginning of the story. Although she's not in love with her husband, Sahoko is unable to say no the her parents and always does what she's told. After meeting her friend from high school again, Kaoru, she starts to realize what she truly wants from her life.

characters.name: Kaoru Kuno
characters.description: A flower designer and friend of Sahoko who spent many years loving her secretly even after being rejected. She's caring, sweet, and does always her best to comfort her. The second story in this tankobon is about her past and how she came to terms with her lesbianism after meeting two other women in love.

title: Kanojo no Idea
description: Ever since middle school, Hinata has been a huge fan Sumika Nayuki, an actress of her same age. Now in high school, Hinata ran into Sumika on the street, and was shocked to find her idol's real-life behavior to be very different from the public persona that Hinata worshiped. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Chapter count includes 16 regular chapters and 3 extras.

title: Show Me Your Bust
description: Ever since Jiho saw her best friend Woohee's perfectly shaped breasts in a bar bathroom, she couldn't stop thinking about them. To her surprise, an exasperated Woohee lets her see and even touch them after this confession... but the more Jiho fondles them, the more they seem to unlock her Pandora's box of raging hormones. One minute, she's squeezing Woohee's breasts in her dorm, and the next, she's hooking up with her longtime crush Yeonwoo, whose true feelings are a complete mystery. It's clear that Jiho finds them both hot, but which of them holds the key to her heart? (Source: Tappytoon)

title: Onee-san wa Joshi Shougakusei ni Kyoumi ga Arimasu.
title_original: お姉さんは女子小学生に興味があります。
description: Minori Yamada is a high school teacher and a complete perverted lolicon. Sometimes her roommate brings home a little girl named Coco Suzuhara to babysit, and Minori gets to indulge in all her cuteness.

characters.name: Coco Suzuhara
characters.description: __Height:__ 116 cm A innocent girl who loves Minori-chan a ton, she is a 6 year old in elementary school who loves to hang out with Minori Yamada.

characters.name: Minori Yamada
characters.description: A high school teacher who happens to be a lolicon, and the girl she babysits with her roommate. She has a laid-back and clever personality.

characters.name: Yuu Ikeya
characters.description: She is a roommate of Minori Yamada and a friend of Coco Suzuhara.

characters.name: Hime Maruyama
characters.description: She is a friend of Coco and a love rival of Minori Yamada.

characters.name: Ayari Hayakawa
characters.description: She is a friend of Coco and Hime and a rival of Minori Yamada. She has two biological mothers. She has a secretive and reserved personality.

characters.name: Yurika Suzuhara
characters.description: She is the mother of Coco and a neighbor of Minori Yamada and Yuu Ikeya.

title: Nanashi no Asterism
title_original: ななしのアステリズム
description: Tsukasa, Nadeshiko, and Mikage have been inseparable since they began junior high, but Tsukasa has a secret she’s been keeping from her best friends--she actually has a big crush on Nadeshiko! Not wanting to risk their friendship, she planned to keep it a secret forever, but when Tsukasa learns that Nadeshiko has a crush on Mikage, her desire to support her friends now conflicts with her own feelings. First love blossoms in unexpected ways for these three young women and their circle of friends. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Nadeshiko Washio
characters.description: Tsukasa and Mikage's best friend. She is caught by Tsukasa trying to kiss Mikage while she is asleep, revealing that she has a crush on Mikage. Tsukasa promises support her with this crush.

characters.name: Tsukasa Shiratori
characters.description: The series protagonist, Tsukasa is a cheerful girl who does not want anything to change in her current friendship group. This has become a problem for her as she has developed a crush on Nadeshiko. She also has a twin brother.

characters.name: Mikage Kotooka
characters.description: Tsukasa and Nadeshiko's best friend. She enjoys making sweets and often bakes treats for Tsukasa and Nadeshiko. She often quickly begins dating and then breaks up with boys to the point of her relationships not being seen as serious by her friends.

title: Mino-san no Sore, Sawattemo Ii?
title_original: 美乃さんのそれ、さわってもいい？
description: Mino, the mysterious girl who sits beside Sota in class, has a little “something” on her head that Sota can’t help but notice. But as his gaze follows her, even more curious things about her just keep popping up…?! Spend time with the well-developed and mysterious Mino in this super exciting, slice-of-life comedy!! *This is a special digital edition containing an exclusive bonus page at the end of the volume. (Source: Emaqi)

title: Siscon Onee-chan to Ki ni Shinai Imouto
title_original: シスコンお姉ちゃんと気にしない妹
description: There's no such thing as an older sister who hates their younger sister. Every older sister on the face of the Earth loves their younger sister dearly. I, Sakura Shima, have an adorable sister one year younger than me. The sister yuri comedy everybody is talking about! (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated) Note: This is the serialization of the webcomic originally self-published on Nicovideo.

title: LIBERTA
description: An office worker named Komari is saved from a monster by a mysterious vampire named Liberta. A vampire yuri action manga from the creator of Tadokoro-san . Note: Chapter count includes four extra chapters.

title: Manyeo, 30 Se
description: 30-year-old virgin Mihye is burning up with lust, but the only company she has on her 30th birthday is wine, cake, and a life-sized pillow of her favorite idol singer. Well, a girl’s gotta drink up and dream big. She blows out the candles with just one wish for her coming year…to finally pop that cherry. When she opens her eyes, lo and behold, a handsome hunk has materialized out of thin air. And he’s got an irresistible offer for her: become a witch, and take him has her familiar. One thing's for sure... This witch will be riding more than broomsticks. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes 31 extra chapters.

title: Mars no Kiss
description: Yukari is a "bad girl." She rebels against her controlling mother by dyeing her hair, polishing her nails and having an older boyfriend, with whom she has an intimate relationship. In fact, as she notes, that's kind of all they have right now. He never takes her anywhere; they just go to a karaoke box, sing a bit, and have sex. Miki is a "good girl." She's tall, and has classic Japanese beauty. She's quiet and bookish and smart. And a bit aloof. The two are forced to share a double desk at the beginning of the term which annoys Yukari to no end. Like most bad girls, her initial reaction is disdain and derision for the good girl's behavior. But, one day, after school, she sees Miki in the Art Room, gently kissing a statue of Mars and her heart starts to race. When someone comes up from behind, both Miki and Yukari know that they've been seen, and everything changes between them. (Source: Okazu Blogspot)

title: Gene Bride
description: Isahaya Ichi is fed up with men, a woman navigating a world where she’s underestimated at work because of her gender and sexually harassed. But when her former classmate, Masaki, unexpectedly shows up, everything changes. He claims to be the other half of her “destined pair” from a junior high school event called “Gene Bride,” where genetic information matched students into couples for a day. While Ichi barely remembers the event, Masaki’s sudden reappearance sparks a journey of rediscovery and buried secrets. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Dallaeya
description: Bo-Eun has recently acquired a furry little roommate named Dallae (Korean for azalea), who she met in an azalea field. Dallae has her own schedule, though, and comes and goes as she pleases. Meanwhile, Bo-Eun can’t seem to stop dreaming about a missed friendship in high school – her name is Sae-Yeon. Oddly enough, it was around the time that Dallae started showing up that Bo-Eun started having recurring dreams of Sae-Yeon... This story has two (or is it three?) main characters, and they’re all hiding a secret from each other. (Source: Lezhin) Note: Won the 3rd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest.

title: Gal to Otaku wa Wakari Aenai.
title_original: ギャルとオタクはわかりあえない。
description: Saotome is the top Gyaru in class: loud, sociable, and stylish. Otonashi, on the other hand, is a stereotypical nerd. However, they both have secret tastes that clash sharply with their chosen public images... So what'll happen once each girl discovers the other's secret?

title: Kareshi Tokidoki Kanojo
description: Akizuki Hotaka, a high school student who has just turned 17, meets and falls in love with the school’s madonna, Shishizaki Chisato. Hotaka was prepared to have his heart broken, but Chisato agreed to become lovers. However, Chisato has a secret that Hotaka can’t imagine. Love changes “everything” for a boy. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

title: Renai Manga
description: New manga editor Haruka has just been assigned to her favorite manga artist ever, Kuroi Ritsu. Kuroi-sensei's manga, "With You" motivated her to turn her life around. When she finally meets shut-in, mopey, entirely unfashionable Kuroi-sensei, Haruka is in for a bit of a shock. Includes 2 bonus chapters.

characters.name: Ritsu Kuroi
characters.description: Mopey shut-in mangaka. Her manga "With You" inspired her future editor Haruka to turn her life around.

title: Shoujo Sect
description: A story about a group of girls and their relationships at an all-girls school. Included bonus chapters: 0, 7.1, 13.1, 13.2

characters.name: Shinobu Handa
characters.description: (Manga Based) Shinobu is one of the main characters of the story. She has no trouble with money or making her way in the world. She is a bourgeois only child. She loves women regardless of age. In regards to coming in late, sleeping in class, generally being a delinquent and failing grades, she is ahead of the curve. However, it seems that she used to be a perfect student straight out of some movie. Although Shinobu is involved in a harem with most of her classmates, she is in love with Momoko Naitou the most. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Momoko Naitou
characters.description: The main character of the series. Momoko is a member of the schools disciplinary committee which is a duty that she takes very seriously and often puts her at odds with Shinobu. She is very gluttonous (though never seems to gain any weight), irritable, and has very little tolerance for other peoples antics (though she is shown to have a mischievous side of her own). She is kind to her classmates however which makes her very popular. Momoko always wears a rather strong-smelling perfume which usually gives away her presence before she even makes it known. Several years before the series she first met Shinobu in a park when they both were very young. Shinobu gave her a cookie and Momoko in return gave her a kiss. This encounter left Shinobu with deep feelings of love for Momoko, though Momoko does not remember at all. Momoko finds it hard to warm up to Shinobu due to latters promiscuity, bu

characters.name: Kyouko Hayato
characters.description: A teacher at the all-girls school. She is very tall and beautiful yet acts somewhat childish which makes her popular among her students. Her favorite student is Momoko, with whom she is infatuated. She often hangs around with Momoko after school and allows her to stay at her place. She has a hard time with money due to her expensive tastes but remains constantly upbeat. After seducing Momoko in her apartment she is struck terribly ill and is forced to resign from school.

characters.name: Veneo Takashiro
characters.description: Good at debates and factorization, she is childhood friends with Ayame. She always carries her favorite stuffed animal, which is half her her body length, made from good fleece raw material and less repellent urethane foam. It can be used to store things like purses. On summer days when the weather is warm, she likes to sleep with it during afternoon naps. She lives in Momoko's dorm. (Source: Shoujo Sect vol.1 Ch )

characters.name: Kirin Suwabe
characters.description: Shinobu's best friend and lover who is constantly seen in her company. She fancies herself as Shinobu's servant which she says gives her a sense of self-worth. Kirin is very much in love with Shinobu despite her feelings for Momoko, and even said that she would gladly share Shinobu as long as she could stay with her. She later ends up falling for another girl named Matsuri, who is deeply in love with her and who Kirin had sex with once in the manga and second episode of the anime. (From Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chizuru Komai
characters.description: A classmate of Momoko, she is a very bold and stubborn girl who has trouble expressing herself. She does not compromise well with others and tends to be rather single-minded which makes her difficult to deal with. She is deeply in love with her older sister Shigure and tries desperately to make her see it. She goes to Momoko for advice and succeeds in achieving her older sister's affections, which leaves Momoko distraught in learning that she assisted an "unnatural love." She is a member of the school's drama research club to which she is very dedicated. (From Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shigure Komai
characters.description: A third-year student and Chizuru's older sister. She is beautiful, intelligent, and serene with a good grip on things. She could easily be a class leader but chooses to go straight home after school instead. She is deeply in love with Chizuru but is much more subtle about her feelings and even tries to suppress them, though she eventually gives in after going to Shinobu for advice and realizing that both her and her sister's feelings are too strong to ignore. (From Wikipedia)

characters.name: Maya Enjyoji
characters.description: One of the many girls in the school who is infatuated with Shinobu. Maya is a pretty smart girl, but she is also very submissive and weak-willed so she'll go along with anything anyone tells her to do. One day when Maya was on clean-up duty she found Shinobu sleeping in an empty room. Her infatuation got the better of her and she kissed Shinobu unaware that she was in the process of waking up. Shinobu later confronted her about it and Maya broke down and began apologizing, saying that she'll do anything to make it up to her. Shinobu brought Maya to an empty club room where she proceeded to seduce her. After some encouragement from Kirin, Maya pledged herself as Shinobu's servant. Maya's devotion to Shinobu continues to grow and she ends up staying with her to the very end where they form a three-way relationship between themselves and Momoko. Shinobu helps Maya to bre

characters.name: Sayuri Ookami
characters.description: A shady third-year student who longs to make Shinobu hers and hers alone. Ookami is the top of her class and is well-respected by her teachers as well as most of her underclassmen for her model behavior but also proves to be a calculated schemer in her pursuit of Shinobu. She attempts to seduce Shinobu in an empty room but is repeatedly, yet, half-heartedly refused because Shinobu doesn't want to hurt her. Her true plan was to get Momoko to lose her temper and get herself expelled so that she would be separated from Shinobu. Her plan is realized when Momoko attacks her with a fire extinguisher. The matter is settled quietly out of court and Momoko is allowed to stay but she chooses to leave anyway. Despite the fact that her plan ultimately succeeded it proves to be in vain as Momoko and Shinobu consummate their feelings several months later.(From Wikipedia)

title: Senpai ga Oyobi desu!
description: Yoriko Souma found the popular student council president Kinako Urushima lying on the street, passed out from hunger. Souma felt so sympathetic that she gave Urushima a dog whistle to summon her if Urushima ever needed help again, which turned out to be all the time!

characters.name: Yoriko Souma
characters.description: A first-year high school girl who gives student council president Kinako Urushima a dog whistle to be used in emergencies. Owing to her excellent hearing, Yoriko is the only one capable of hearing the whistle, even at great distances. She regularly takes care of Kinako and worries about her wellbeing. She is affectionately nicknamed 'Mayo' by Kinako (a portmanteau of her surname and given name). She has a pet hamster and is a member of a sports club.

title: Kijin Gahou
description: Collection of one-shots. 1. Collecting (あつめもの) #1 About a girl who collects everything her crush touches. 2. Collecting (あつめもの) #2 It's about a man who keeps a photographic album of women giving him blowjobs. Of course, no collection is complete without a little variety. 3. Collecting (あつめもの) #3 Schoolboys play a sexual card game. 4. Collecting (あつめもの) #4 A lunchbox factory girl collects vomit. 5. Collecting (あつめもの) #5 A man gathers his missing girlfriend's body parts. 6. Collecting (あつめもの)#6 A suicidal girl enters a little group of sick woman that made abortion a grotesque art. With usual Kago sick humor and nonsense. 7. Harakiri (はらきり) A world where cutting your stomach is the newest fashionable trend among schoolgirls. 8. The Unscratchable Itch (隔靴掻痒) Putting worms under skin can be an addictive pleasure. 9. Holy Night (大聖夜) Santa is terrorizing the Japanese by flooding everyone with unwanted gifts. The only way to stop Santa from sending more is to convince him that you’re happy with what you got, or so they believe. The story is split between a girl trying to find a way to get Santa to stop sending her vibrators, and the various government schemes to try and capture or e

title: Danjjagui Gyeonggye
description: Best friends, household pet, or just charity case? Hayoon has no idea what she is to Minju after all these years. She's grateful Minju's family took her in despite her being nothing but a lowly recessive omega, but her relationship with Minju sure is confusing. Minju does seem to like her, whispering sweet nothings in her ear and helping her out when she's in her heat, but who can tell? Ever the stereotypical rich alpha, Hayoon knows for a fact that Minju gets bored easily, that she loses all interest once she gets what she wants. Unable to tear herself away from Minju's grip, Hayoon unwillingly comes to harbor affection, albeit spiteful affection, for her friend... (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Savage Fang Ojou-sama: Shijou Saikyou no Youhei wa Shijou Saikyou no Bougyaku Reijou to Natte Nidome no Sekai wo Musou Suru
title_original: サベージファングお嬢様 史上最強の傭兵は史上最凶の暴虐令嬢となって二度目の世界を無双する
description: Envil, known by the title “Savage Fang”, was a renowned mercenary who should have died fighting in the civil war. Instead, he awoke back in time—inside the body of the very tyrant who started the war in the first place! Mylene Eltania was the world's most beautiful, most ruthless empress. With beautiful hair signaling her divine gift, and beauty beyond compare, she was a force to be reckoned with. Now, this mercenary has a second chance to fight back before it’s too late. Mylene’s beauty on the surface, but a savage beast rages below! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Chapter count includes one additional epilogue chapter.

characters.name: Mylene Lelier
characters.original: ミレーヌ=ペトゥレ・ド・レーリエ

characters.name: Albert
characters.description: Prince of the Kingdom of Irutania.

title: Majo no Kekkon
description: Opening the Door of Truth is the ultimate goal for many witches, with one popular method being a Witches’ Marriage, a contractual bond. Melissa is one such witch—but is her heart truly immune to the adorable Tanya as she claims? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Chikarawaza no Sister
description: "Repent your sins… and God will surely forgive you…” Whether it's a man who wastes too much money on gacha, a woman who feels bad about working at a black company, a princess who can't wake up in the morning because of a witch's curse, a hero whose holy sword is stuck in a rock, or a devil who dares to tempt her, a beautiful nun will rescue these lost lambs with "merciful love" and "punch to the face"! (Source: Comic Meteor, translated) Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, the series was collected for commercial publication by Comic Meteor on 2025-02-12.

characters.name: Sister
characters.description: A devout nun with a tendency to solve conflicts with her strength.

characters.name: Mikhail
characters.description: A young apprentice priest. He looks up to Sister as a role model and greatly respects her.

title: Aishita Bundake Aishite Hoshii!
title_original: 愛したぶんだけ愛してほしいっ！
description: Mutsurugi Nana, who leads a self-indulgent, unemployed life, is still waiting for her ideal prince to come one day while satisfying her need for approval by uploading doctored selfies on the Internet. Then, Tsukasa, a candidate for the "ideal prince" appears, praising Nana as "cute" and escorting her home gently. Nana is so impressed by Tsukasa's words and acts that she couldn't help herself from falling for Tsukasa. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

characters.name: Nana Mutsurugi
characters.description: The protagonist of the story. Nana is a college dropout NEET who lives with her parents. She is a menhera and obsessed with her social media account, which has over 20,000 followers. She falls in love with Tsukasa at first sight. She earns a decent amount of money by selling adult content of herself on the internet. ~!After learning that Tsukasa has a girlfriend, she decides to shower Tsukasa with money and gifts in order to make her fall for her instead. She is very easily manipulated by Tsukasa and even blocks her online friends when Tsukasa tells her to do so.!~

characters.name: Tsukasa
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") The main deuteragonist of the story and also Nana's love interest. Currently goes to college and is aiming to become a civil servant. She spends most of her time in her room playing video games. The author, Manio, describes her character as "無自覚クズ" or "unconscious scum", someone who is generally a bad person but isn't aware of it themselves. ~!After hooking up with Nana she reveals to her that she actually has a girlfriend named Yumi, who she has a rather complicated relationship with. Yumi is a very possessive girl, who doesn't like it when Tsukasa hangs out with people other than her. Due to this, she has tried breaking up with Tsukasa multiple times, only to come back to her immediately after. Tsukasa says she doesn't want to break up with her either, as Yumi is the first person she's ever truly loved.!~ ~!She later talks Nana into blocking some of her online

characters.name: Momomiya
characters.description: One of Nana's online friends, very into makeup. Nana describes her as an Onee-san type girl. Momomiya is the one who first introduces Tsukasa, one of her IRL friends, to Nana by bringing her along to one of their get-togethers.

characters.name: Yumi
characters.description: ~!Tsukasas girlfriend. Not much is known about her other than her severe mental issues and possessiveness which Tsukasa often complains about.!~

characters.name: Karami
characters.description: One of Nana's online friends. Nana describes her as a small, black-haired beauty, and is shocked at how skinny she is when she first meets her in real life. ~!She later blocks Nana and starts rumors about her when she finds out that her partner had used one of Nana's lewd pictures as their phone's wallpaper.!~

title: Cirque Arachne
description: Teti joins the Cirque Arachne, a troupe of acrobats, and finds herself captivated by one member in particular...

characters.name: Teti
characters.description: The newest member of the acrobat troupe. She looks up to Charlotte whom she finds flawless.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: The star of the acrobat troupe. Charlotte is very nice and gentle, but is very serious when it comes to her work, which is shown by her focused expressions. She is an elegant, graceful, and beautiful woman. Her specialties are juggling and aerial. She's also not very good with fire.

characters.name: Lenny
characters.description: The leader of the acrobat troupe. She is the one who recruited Teti.

title: Maria†Holic
description: Kanako is excited to be transferring into a new all-girl mission school. She’s looking for her ideal yuri partner. When she meets Mariya Shidou she thinks she’s found the one. But wait! Mariya is a cross-dressing sadistic boy and now Kanako is forced to keep his secret! But that’s not all. To complicate things she’s drawing the attention of the most popular girl in school and, at the same time, catching the wrath of all the other girls. Will Kanako ever find the cute girl of her dreams? Or will she die of sexual-frustration nosebleeds? Love is a complicated affair for Kanako and the girls of Maria Holic. (Source: One Peace Books)

characters.name: Mariya Shidou
characters.description: __Height:__ 160.3 cm At first glance, a seemingly kind, and selfless student, Mariya's true personality couldn't be further from that. A cunning, and incredibly sadistic boy who enjoys nothing more than torturing Kanako, or his twin sister Shizu, although he claims the treatment of the latter is because of his love for her. Mariya attends the prestigious Ame no Kisaki Catholic girl's school, due to a rather silly bet thought up by the previous head of the school, who in actual fact is Mariya's grandmother who he deeply cares for, and holds in high esteem. Mariya keeps a rosary she once owned as a memento. The bet in question is that Mariya, and his twin sister each attend schools for the opposite gender, and if they can stick that out for three years, the winner shall become head of both schools. There is a catch, and that must be that nobody can find out their true gender. When Shizu co

characters.name: Kanako Miyamae
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm She is a second year high school transfer student to the prestigious Catholic girls' school Ame no Kisaki, which both her parents attended. Kanako's father was a teacher there, and her mother a student; when they fell in love, they got married quite soon after they left school. Kanako was born not too long after that. She made a decision to come to Ame no Kisaki based on her parents finding happiness together, and she in turn wanted to find her fated one. However, not all is clear on the path of love. The day before she enrolls, Kanako happens to meet a kind, helpful, and indeed beautiful student, Mariya Shidou. Although, she is not what "she" seems. Kanako absolutely detests men, and will proceed to break out in hives if one happens to touch her. (She is a Lesbian, but prefers the term "yuri", even though she still hides this fact from her peers.) It's interesting to

characters.name: Yonakuni-san
characters.description: Dog of Dorm Leader.

characters.name: Matsurika Shinouji
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm Matsurika is Mariya's maid. She is generally silent but is usually quite rude when she chooses to speak. She delivers the vast majority of her lines with almost no facial expressions. The majority of her insults are directed at Kanako and Mariya. She refers to Kanako by such names as "Ms. Pig," "Eiffel Tower" and "Tokyo Tower" due to Kanako's tall stature. When speaking to Mariya, Matsurika often delivers sharp remarks in regards to his cross-dressing tendencies or sexual perversions. Matsurika also attends classes with Mariya. She also stays hidden from the rest of the students, and follows Mariya's orders when told.

characters.name: Nanami Kiri
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm Kiri is an aloof and bespectacled student at Ame no Kisaki. Although she appears quite cold and dispassionate on the surface, she is actually a very caring and helpful personality. At the bequest of the teacher, she helps Kanako to overcome her initial troubles at the school, to the extent that she is willing to put her own reputation at stake by pretending to be Kanako's lover; so as to avoid trouble from Ryūken's fans. She eventually becomes very close friends with Sachi.

characters.name: Yuzuru Inamori
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm Yuzuru is a demure and friendly girl who has long been friends with Sachi. She is fairly shy and has some self-esteem issues. Kanako sees Inamori as a more elegant girl and is intrigued by her surprisingly large breasts. She is the best archer in the school's archery club, of which Mariya is also a member.

characters.name: Sachi Momoi
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm A bright and cheerful girl, Sachi quickly becomes friends with the newcomer, [Kanako](https://anilist.co/character/13869/Miyamae-Kanako). She has orange hair, commonly tied in pigtails. She is good friends with [Yuzuru](https://anilist.co/character/13872/Inamori-Yuzuru). She seems to have access to hammer space, as she pulls numerous things out from her pockets, even things that would not fit.

characters.name: Shizu Shidou
characters.description: __Height:__ 160.6 cm Shizu is Mariya's twin sister. She attends an all boys school which was also run by the ex-chairman. She has a similar hatred/fear of males, and had similar experiences as Kanako, who she affectionately calls 'Kana-chan'. Unlike Mariya, she appears to actually be the kind, innocent girl that Mariya attempts to portray. She is also quick to get her feelings hurt, as well.
