The agreement for the competition was the loser would be chosen if someone found out from either school; Kanako, thinking Shizu was Mariya, mentioned Mariya's touching her, which revealed to Shizu that Kanako knew Mariya's gender, thus defining Mariya as the loser. Shizu had only went into the school to switch with Mariya for their schools' physical examinations. However, because Kanako found out Mariya's secret before she began attending the school, it was null, and because Kanako knew Shizu's true

characters.name: Ryuuken Ishima
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm Ryūken is the star of Ame no Kisaki, due to her tall stature, good looks, kindness, and generally tomboyish nature. She is a member of the Drama Club, and has played several male roles. She has a great number of fans and her own fan club. Mariya himself is actually quite jealous of her popularity. She was supposed to be Kanako's roommate at the dormitories only to be run out the first night by Mariya so that Mariya could keep a close eye on Kanako. Ryūken's fans cause mischief for Kanako because they are jealous of her friendship with Ryūken.

characters.name: Ryouchou-sensei
characters.description: An unusual young girl with cat ears who looks after Dorm No. 2 which Kanako is assigned to. She is addressed as "Miss Dorm Leader" by all the students. When Kanako met her, and tried to make small talk and ask casual questions Dorm Leader looped back to the first question to say that she might also be addressed as 'Boss' or 'God'. Kanako took this as a hint to ask no more questions. The students do not dare disobey her for fear of vague, yet frightening threats. She has a pet dog, Yonakuni, who helps her take care of the place. Her rule of the dorm extends to manhandling Father Kanae after repeatedly demanding bribes so that he can see Kanako. She has an idiosyncratic speech pattern which makes her speak in a rather languid fashion and inserts the phrase 'desu yo' wherever grammatically possible. She is always accompanied by Yonakuni-san, the apron wearing dorm watchdog.

characters.name: Fumi Kumagai
characters.description: Homeroom teacher for Kanako, Nanami, Sachi and Yuzuru. She is a graduate of Ame no Kisaki, remembers Professor Miyamae, Kanako's mother and had met Kanako herself, when she was very young. She tells Kanako that everyone calls her "Miss Teddybear".

characters.name: Ayari Shiki
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shiki runs the school's student council. She is Mariya's and Shizu's cousin, and has a standing rivalry with Mariya. She calls him 'Flat Chest', as he calls her 'Fat Ass'. Apparently, the cause of the animosity between Mariya and Ayari happened because of a childhood incident where she had her dress ripped open supposedly by Mariya (and her underwear exposed). Because of that incident, she got called "Panda-Chang" after the mascot character printed on her underwear and all sorts of nicknames related to pandas. She blames Mariya for this incident and therefore holds a grudge on him for that. Ayari and Mariya look much alike and are about the same height.

title: Yabai Idol no Manager ni Natchatta Hanashi
title_original: やばいアイドルのマネージャーになっちゃった話
description: On stage, Maron is a sparkling idol, but in her private life, she is a weird, chain-smoking, emo girl. As her manager, I have to support Maron and keep the true face of the "perfect idol" hidden from the public. An idol with a history and her caring manager Their story begins in the smoking room. (Source: Ichijin Plus, translated) Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization by Comic Howl starting 2024-04-16.

title: Pension Life Vampire
title_original: ペンションライフ・ヴァンパイア
description: Vampires and werewolves... One day, Eri, a "revision officer" who hunts down things that are said to resent mankind, wanders into a pension run by a mysterious girl. The encounter between a girl whose existence was denied and a legendary vampire. She won't change the world, but she can become kind. A heartwarming house administration comedy begins now! (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Poor Poor LIPS
description: Nako is a poverty-stricken 21 year-old in desperate need of a job. She applies for a job at a jewelry store. When shop owner Ren identifies herself as a lesbian, the competition for the position evaporates, leaving only Nako. Ren asks her if her sexual orientation will be a problem, Nako sensibly replies that she's not interested, so she doesn't see any problem. The comic is a a series of 4-koma strips, and range from beating Nako's state of poverty to death (as in the strip where she's about to eat bread crusts for lunch and is mistaken for feeding the birds) and to Ren's privilege and her orientation. But never in a mean way. Nako's not entirely naive, but she's not entirely clueful either, which makes for a nice mix of goofy silly and plain funny. (Source: Okazu)

characters.name: Nako Okashi
characters.description: Okashi is a poor and optimistic young woman. She is an orphan who lives by herself in a small apartment. after losing her job at a bakery, she decides to work at a jewelry store where she learns immediately that her boss is a lesbian.

characters.name: Ren Otsuka
characters.description: Otsuka is the owner of the jewelry store where Nako works. Whenever she hires new employees she immediately tells them that she is a lesbian, resulting in all the applicants leaving, except for Nako.

characters.name: Keiki Furui
characters.description: Nako's high school classmate. He works hard at his family's cake shop.

characters.name: Akio Otsuka
characters.description: Ren's father. He was a struggling actor before meeting his wife Nei. He now owns a company that produces chocolate.

title: Kimi no Love wo Misetekure!
title_original: 君のラブを見せてくれ！
description: The story centers on a famous manga author and popular high school girl named Komichi Shijou. She writes a hit love comedy manga, but she actually does not know how it is like to fall in love. Because of this, she falls into a slump and is unable to write her manga. One day, she accidentally witnesses a guy's failed love confession in school, which inspires her to write again. She asks the guy to confess again, but this time with her help. Komichi's investigation about true love begins. Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title: On a Leash
description: Tensions run high on the battlefield as soldiers fight through death. Bombs rain from the sky and bullets pepper the ground. In battle, beasts screech through the sky and tear through the earth. After the smoke clears, the soldiers return to their human forms weary from battle and numbed by death. But amid the explosions and chaos, a spark of passion ignites. Time will tell whether it can survive the horrors of war, or if it will succumb to it. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

title: Gaebalhaejuseyo
description: A salacious bondage sesh with the boss counts as overtime, right? Seungwon's first job lands herself in the lap of video game mastermind, Mimi Kim. Mimi "reluctantly" spins a web of lust, while coy Seungwon discovers her inner dominatrix. It's a titillating dance of kinks and toys, all for the sake of saving the company and the future of game development. Throw in a little blackmail and you've got the fantasy that HR reports are made of. (Source: Tapas)

title: Hoshikawa Ginza Yonchoume
description: This story lets us look into the relationship of Matsuda Otome (a home schooled girl) and Nakagawa Minato (a high school teacher). Otome has been through a difficult past and is now under the care of Minato-sensei. Otome becomes suspicious of Minato's day-to-day routines and investigates. What will Minato tell Otome when she confronts her? Each volume contains one kakioroshi chapter. Volume 3 contains the side story "My First Hoshikawa" (マイファースト星川). Chapter 20 is split into part A and B. --counted as two.

characters.name: Otome Matsuda
characters.description: A homeschooled student.

characters.name: Minato Nakagawa
characters.description: An high school teacher who has taken one of her students, Matsuda Otome, into her home to take care of.

characters.name: Kanae Inotani
characters.description: A college student who also teaches in a cram school. She has a very pragmatic personality.

characters.name: Hina Yahagi
characters.description: Servitor in the bookstore, has a crush on Otome since the first sight.

characters.name: Mitsuki Oohori
characters.description: Minato's friend since college time.

title: Kimi wo Wasureru Koi ga Shitai
title_original: 君を忘れる恋がしたい
title_en: My First Love with You Again
description: When Shino saw Sena playing guitar in middle school, it was love at first sight—and then her first relationship, her first real boyfriend…and countless other firsts! Even after Sena’s transfer to another school forced them apart, Shino has carried a torch for him all the way to college, where she’s found him again by some miracle! But that pure and genuine face she once knew is no longer there, instead replaced by a distant expression… (Source: Yen Press)

title: Kanojo Shoukan Shimashita!?
description: Yuta Agatsuma is a high school student who has no romantic experience. He doesn't know what true love is like, but he finds his classmate Nodoka Kanzaki interesting. Is this love!? Meanwhile, his younger sister Yoru, who dreams of summoning demons, is performing summoning rituals again. This time, the summoning circle suddenly starts to glow, and a girl descends from above. She is Lars, a demon from the underworld, and she offers Yuta a contract!? A thrilling 7-way love comedy begins, where cheating = the end of the world! (Source: Storia, translated)

title: Harukana Receive
description: When high schooler Haruka moves to Okinawa, she finds herself enamored with the beach right outside her front door and resolves to form a volleyball team with her cousin, Kanata. However, because she’s so short, Kanata gave up on volleyball ages ago. Can Haruka get her to take up the sport again in time for the junior tournament? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

characters.name: Kanata Higa
characters.description: Kanata Higa is one of the main characters in Harukana Receive. Upon her debut, Kanata was initially somewhat withdrawn. This came from being relatively short compared to the other characters, which gave her a disadvantage at beach volleyball. Though Kanata's distancing makes her rather shy, quiet, and reserved, she can behave eccentrically in unusual situations. ~!After meeting [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/126573/Oozora-Haruka), she begins to open up while develops a new "outotsu" playing-style which lets her adapts her short stature with Haruka's height. As she and Haruka bond, she maintains her friendship with [Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/137105/Tooi-Narumi) to which they believe it's stronger to win together than alone.!~

characters.name: Haruka Oozora
characters.description: Haruka Oozora is one of the protagonists in Harukana Receive. She first came to Okinawa because of her parents' employment and moves in with her grandmother. She is a very energetic and light-headed girl and childish to some extent, but positively straightforward where she is empathetic towards those around her.

characters.name: Akari Ooshiro
characters.description: Akari Ōshiro is a new member and later manager of the Umuru High Beach Volleyball Club in Harukana Receive. Akari is a tsundere-type, thus is constantly embarrassed and nervous when called by her nickname 'Shii-Chan' or when [Claire](https://anilist.co/character/126577/Thomas-Claire) remembers her participation in the drink's advertising in the past as the Shequasar Girl.

characters.name: Ayasa Tachibana
characters.description: Ayasa Tachibana is Narumi Toi's best friend and partner. She was originally an indoor volleyball player on a scholarship, but transitioned to beach volleyball from being inspired after challenging Narumi.

characters.name: Emily Thomas
characters.description: Emily Thomas is Claire's twin sister and her beach volleyball partner. She is also part of Umuru High's student council and president of the school's Beach Volleyball Club. Although they often argue with each other and Emily regularly sarcastically comments on her childish antics, they still remain a good pair and Emily refuses to play with anyone other than Claire.

characters.name: Claire Thomas
characters.description: Claire Thomas is Emily's twin sister where they are both American exchange students at Urama High School, and both are the top junior beach volleyball players in the world. Emily makes up one half of Team Eclair. She quickly becomes close with Haruka because of the similarity of their personalities and they can often be seen together if Kanata is not around.

characters.name: Narumi Tooi
characters.description: Narumi Toi is Kanata Higa's former beach volleyball partner. Together with [Ayasa](https://anilist.co/character/126575/Tachibana-Ayasa), Narumi is a consecutive champion of local beach volleyball competitions and even adapting her "idols" status of this sport.

title: Datsudoutei no Aite wa... Masaka no Aitsu!?
title_original: 脱童貞の相手は…まさかのアイツ!?
title_en: My First Time Is with.... My Little Sister!?
description: Fondling Kaori's full, developed breasts, I'm about to stick my dick into her pussy... But, why the hell am I about to have sex with my little sister!? (Source: Coolmic) Note: Originally serialized as a web manga under the title Hatsu Ecchi no Aite wa... Imouto!? (初エッチの相手は…妹！？). Each chapter is split into 3 ‘episodes’ in the English serialization.

title: Blue Friend
description: Second-year middle school student Ayumu Kurihara changes classes and is seated next to the beautiful but strange Misuzu Tsukishima who dislikes boys. Mizusu can't get close to other people, but after being moved by Ayumu's sweet, honest personality she begins to open up to her little by little. Ayumu too is captivated by the awkwardly delicate Mizusu and the two of them become close.

characters.name: Ayumu Kurihara
characters.description: Ayumu is great at sports and is a spirited second year middle school student. She is admired by girls because of her straight-forward personality. She is confused about her feelings for Misuzu, though outwardly she appears to be handling them.

characters.name: Misuzu Tsukishima
characters.description: A Beautiful girl with a shadow hidden somewhere. She is popular with the boys, though because of that girls are jealous and loathe her. She absolutely hates men due to a certain incident in the past. She has feelings for Ayumu that go beyond friendship.

characters.name: Satsuki Azuma
characters.description: Satsuki went to the same elementary school as Misuzu, and is a girl that knows about Misuzu's past. She continues to harass and tease Ayumu and Misuzu, but what are her true intentions...?

title: Toki-sensei wa Kigaetai
description: Meet Shisoya Toki, a quiet female teacher with a thing for “clothes”. Often seen as cold and unfriendly, her students call her the “unfortunate beautiful teacher”. But one day, while organizing supplies in the old school building, she finds a brand new pair of bloomers. Suddenly, her kinky curiosity about “clothes” goes wild. Sometimes sexy, sometimes cute. Get ready for a wild ride full of seductive cosplay.

characters.name: Toki Shisoya
characters.description: A 25-year-old high school math teacher.

title: Senpai, Oishii desu ka?
description: Miho Miyata is a college girl who loves to eat but doesn't have anyone to share her interest. She is tired of her friends trying to fix her up with other guys, so she asks her brother to pretend to be her boyfriend, only for him to cancel at the last second! When Miho calls, he tells her that he had found someone to take his place. The person who shows up is Mori-senpai, famous for being the most beautiful girl in the entire school! This is a girls-love story about a traumatised girl and a beautiful senior who bond with each other through food! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Miho Miyata
characters.description: A college girl with a big appetite

characters.name: Kotoko Mori
characters.description: ~!Ever since her parents separated she hasn't been able to taste any of the food she eats.!~

title: Oppai Yuri Anthology
title_original: おっぱい百合アンソロジー
description: A yuri anthology focused on boobs! More than a dozen of wonderful authors bringing you some ecchi and funny boob-centric yuri stories!

title: Shy na Ano Ko ni Natsukaretai
title_original: シャイなあの子に懐かれたい
description: We're strangers, but I would like to get to know her better... An opposites-attract slice-of-life yuri romantic comedy! (Source: Dengeki Daioh G, translated)

characters.name: Ayame Akaogi
characters.description: __Height__: 167cm

characters.name: Konomi Shiraishi
characters.description: __Height__: 155cm

title: Kami Eshi JK to OL Fujoshi
description: With BL manga as her greatest and only love, Aizawa is destined to be forever alone. All her time not spent in the office is spent fawning over fanart of her favorite pairing, completely wasting her beauty. One day, the goddess of her world, the artist Misumi, announces that she will descend on a comic convention, so off Aizawa goes! When she finds Misumi's booth, what awaits her is...a super cute high school girl?! (Source: INKR)

title: Watashi, Elite Tenshi desu ga Nankou Furaku na JK ni Komattemasu!
title_original: 私、エリート天使ですが難攻不落なJKに困ってます！
description: Ariel is an angel, a being that exists to reward good deeds by granting small wishes that appear over people's heads. But one day, she encounters a girl whose wish neither she, nor any previous angel, could read. Aiming to grant Kirara's unknown wish, she descends upon the human world to meet her personally, but Kirara's mind isn't as innocent as her mountain of good deeds may suggest. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Xiao Gu Niang
description: "I think I could fall in love with you." "You're cute like a little pony." A love story between the cute but flighty elder girl "Little Fox" and the younger but more mature "Young Pony." See how they flourish both in love and in life! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

characters.name: Xiaoen Mu
characters.description: A woman who's a long time resident of a certain small town, in which she acts as the farm manager/director.

characters.name: Xingyuan Shi
characters.description: A woman who moved to a small town and has a part-time job at a local bakery. Has a poor relationship with her family, especially her dad.

title: "Furetai" wa Koi no Hajimari
description: With her cool demeanor and refined looks, the well-read Kaede Minato is revered by her schoolmates. Momoko Hattori’s cute appearance made her a bit of an idol in the school right after enrollment. The two had virtually no interaction when Momoko’s chance encounter with Kaede promptly accelerates their relationship. A romantic tale on the brink of love. (Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Seonnyeooejeon
description: When a naïve woodcutter steals the robe of a fairy descended from heaven, he condemns her to centuries trapped in the human realm. In the present day, the fairy is known as Mo-Ran Cheon, a renowned actress who is unexpectedly accused of murder. Bitter and resentful from her exile, Mo-Ran sees her plot for vengeance take shape when she discovers that Je-Ha Sa, a police detective tasked with investigating the murder, is the reincarnated woodcutter of centuries past. (Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title: Yukashi Yuusha no Fukushuutan: Mizu wo Oyu ni suru Koto Shika Dekinai Yuusha dakedo, Subete wo Ubatta Omaera wo Korosu niwa Koitsu de Juubunda
title_original: 湯沸かし勇者の復讐譚〜水をお湯にすることしか出来ない勇者だけど、全てを奪ったお前らを殺すにはこいつで十分だ〜
description: A Hero is someone chosen by God to receive a supernatural 'gift'. A unique existence, only one Hero can exist at a time, with a new one being chosen upon the former's death. This generation's Hero is a ordinary villager girl named Kyrie whose gift is merely being able to boil water. When her family and friends are slaughtered, Kyrie is backed into a corner and learns the true value of that boiling hot power, and how well it could be used to fan the flames of revenge that burned inside of her.

title: Joukamachi no Dandelion
title_original: 城下町のダンデライオン
description: In the manga's story, the everyday lives of the nine super-powered siblings of the royal family are monitored by more than 200 surveillance cameras and broadcast nationwide. The people of the nation who are watching the broadcast will have the ability to elect the next monarch. The story focuses on Akane, the third-oldest sister who can manipulate gravity. She is shy and desperately does not want to be caught on camera.

characters.name: Akane Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ Gravity Core The main viewpoint character, Akane is the third daughter and fourth child of the Sakurada family. She hates being the center of attention and being followed by cameras all day. Her ability is Gravity Core, which allows her to manipulate the gravity of herself and anyone she touches, as well as allowing her to increase her speed and strength.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ Heaven's Gate Kanade is the third of the nine Sakurada children and the second oldest daughter. She is twins with her brother [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/89193/Sakurada-Shuu). She is also the vice president of the student council. Her ability makes her able to materialize any object. However, the cost of the object is immediately removed from her savings.

characters.name: Shuu Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ Transporter Shuu is the second of the nine Sakurada children and the oldest son. He is twins with his sister [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/89099/Sakurada-Kanade). His ability makes him able to teleport him and anyone he touches to a certain location. Without realizing it, he has a crush on his childhood friend, [Hana Satou](https://anilist.co/character/241563/Satou-Hana). He ends up dating her, and she helps him with his campaigning program for the elections.

characters.name: Hikari Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ God Hand Hikari is the seventh of the nine Sakurada children and the second youngest daughter. She later becomes an idol under the name Light Sakuraba and using her ability to make herself look older. She does that in an attempt to become more popular after getting inspired by another young idol, Sachiko. She doesn't seem to be very interested in becoming king, and instead focuses on her idol career. Her ability makes her able to change the growth state of any living being for 24 hours.

characters.name: Teru Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ Limit Over Teru is the eighth of the nine Sakurada children and the youngest son. He is the most enthusiastic of the siblings. He tends to speak in an old fashioned way and likes to think of himself as a hero. He also likes to impress his younger sister, [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/89215/Sakurada-Shiori). His ability makes him able to drastically increase his body strength to a superhuman level.

characters.name: Shiori Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ Soulmate Shiori is the last of the nine Sakurada children and the youngest daughter. Despite being very young, she's actually thoughtful and observant. She particularly cares for [Teru](https://anilist.co/character/89214/Sakurada-Teru) and [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/89218/Sakurada-Aoi). She sometimes helps Teru during his speeches. Her ability makes her able to communicate telepathically with animals and objects.

characters.name: Misaki Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ All for One Misaki is the fifth of the nine Sakurada children and the third youngest daughter. She is twins with her brother [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/89217/Sakurada-Haruka). It is heavily hinted she has a crush on Haruka. Her ability makes her able to duplicate herself up to 7 clones of herself. Each clone represents one of the 7 deadly sins. Since each copy excels in each of their aspects, Misaki gets annoyed that that makes her look bland in comparison as she doesn't excel in anything.

characters.name: Haruka Sakurada
characters.description: __Ability:__ Lots of Next Haruka is the sixth of the nine Sakurada children and the middle son. He is twins with his sister [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/89216/Sakurada-Misaki). He tends to be the straight man in the antics of his siblings and remains calm. He is not interested in becoming king, and instead supports Misaki by helping her in her campaign. It is slightly hinted he may have feelings for Misaki. His ability makes him able to calculate the probabilities of any situation.

characters.name: Aoi Sakurada
characters.description: __Abilities:__ Invisible Work, Absolute Order Aoi is the first of the nine Sakurada children and the oldest daughter. ~!She decides to withdraw from the elections as her true power which was kept secret from everyone was Absolute Order which makes people to follow her orders even though it's against their will.!~

characters.name: Souichirou Sakurada
characters.description: Souichirou is the father of the nine Sakurada children and the king. His ability is reading the aura of emotions from people.

characters.name: Satsuki Sakurada
characters.description: Satsuki is the mother of the nine Sakurada children and the queen.

characters.name: Hana Satou
characters.description: Hana is Shuu's classmate from elementary school who moved out from the town. After coming back to the town for high school, she falls in love with him. ~!After confessing her feelings to him publicly, Shuu accepts her feelings, but decides to put a status quo on their relationship since he wants to focus on the election, though they end up properly dating. She helps him a lot by managing his campaign speeches and schedule.!~

title: Deai-kei Site de Imouto to Deau Hanashi
title_original: 出会い系サイトで妹と出会う話
description: Two sisters sign up for a dating website under pseudonyms. They mesh well together and meet up for a date where they discover that the person they were flirting with online was their sister and that sister was a lesbian. They decide to go on their date anyway... Note: The main story concludes at chapter 10. Includes chapters 10.01-10.10 11-12: Dame na senpai × dekiru kouhai 13: Acchan to Kasumi

characters.name: Sayo Daidou
characters.description: The younger Daidou sister, a bossy, serious, and short-tempered girl studying to become a dental hygienist. She fell in love with her elder sister, Ayumu, when they were teenagers, but they grew apart after Ayumu devoted herself to her studies. Jealous and lonely, Sayo began to shun her sister, who left for her classes, leaving her sister and first love behind. Years later, they reunite thanks to a dating website.

characters.name: Ayumu Daidou
characters.description: The elder Daidou sister, an easygoing, perverted, and seemingly irresponsible girl who works in research and development for a big company. She fell in love with her younger sister, Sayo, when they were teenagers, but they grew apart after Ayumu devoted herself to her studies. Believing that her sister, who had grown distant, hated her, Ayumu decided not to confess after getting into university, as originally planned, and instead left for her classes, leaving her sister and first love behind. Years later, they reunite thanks to a dating website. While at university, Ayumu dated Tsubomi Kagaya for almost a year, but she was dumped because of her distant behavior and enduring infatuation for her younger sister.

characters.name: Tsubomi Kagaya
characters.description: The fourth of the Kagaya children. She doesn't work at the family inn, unlike her siblings, instead going to college in the city, dating Ayumu Daidou during this time.

title: Ienai Himitsu no Aishikata
title_original: いえない秘密の愛し方
description: Highschool teacher Saeki Nao is secretly a hardcore otaku who loves yuri manga. One day, at a doujinshi convention they participate in, Nao is eager to convey her feelings to "Nyapoleon", an artist she worships. However, it turned out to be a girl from her school, Kurumizawa Haruka, and moreover, she had to help her. After the event, they decided to go out for a meal, at Haruka's suggestion.... When she wakes up in the morning, there is Haruka in the bed...?! Note: The first two chapters correspond to the two-part one-shot serialised from June 26, 2020 to July 3, 2020.

title: Yuri na Watashi to Akuma na Kanojo (?)
title_original: 百合な私と悪魔な彼女(?)
description: As a child, Yashiro Nonoyama developed an intense fear of men due to boys constantly bullying her. Now in high school, she dreams of being reunited with her first love: a girl who protected her one day from her bullies. Yashiro is in disbelief when a transfer student named Mikoto Saionji arrives who looks a lot like her first love, but she later discovers that Mikoto is actually a guy, and that he was her first love. Yashiro learns that Mikoto is rapidly turning into a girl, and the only way to counteract this change is for them to passionately make out with each other every day. (Source: Kiss Manga)

title: BoiGyaru
description: A boyish girl and a gyaru are dating.

characters.name: Touma Unabara
characters.description: Manatsu's girlfriend.

characters.name: Manatsu Yamada
characters.description: Touma's girlfriend

title: Gokujou Drops
description: High-school freshman Komari needs to find a dorm to stay in and ends up living at the prestigious Paraso no Yakata, but only because she agreed to be Himemiya Yukio’s servant!

characters.name: Komari Maezono
characters.description: Maezono Komari is another first year student at an all-girls school. She wants to live in the dorms but there’s no space available except for a room in the Paraiso dorm which is filled with the cream of the crop from the school. There she meets Himemiya Yukio who says Komari can stay if she’ll be her servant.

characters.name: Yukio Himemiya
characters.description: Idol of the school. She is roommate of Komari. On the first day when she met Komari, she told her to undress if she wants to stay at the dorm. Usually low blood pressure at day.

title: Bikachou Shinshi Kaikoroku
description: Perverts are people who know the shape of their desires. They have carefully traced those contours like a blind man using both hands to measure the shape of a vase. Colette works in a brothel in early 20th century Paris, an occupation she can't escape. She and the other girls support each other, satisfying the desires of their clients, day in, day out. The one source of hope in her difficult life was her trysts with Leon. But Colette could never be sure if Leon really loved her... The strength of women in their pleasurable confines; the naked desires of the 'amorous gentlemen.' Welcome to a beautiful, bewitching bordello of love and desire.. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title: Anata Mitai ni
description: Office worker Kanna Kurisa struggles to achieve results at work. One night meets a woman who seems to embody her own longings...

title: Friend Girlfriend
title_original: フレンドガールフレンド
description: Yuki and Asaka are best friends who’ve known each other since childhood. One day, after a boy confesses his feelings to her, Asaka announces, “I’ll give it a try just for the experience.” Yuki isn’t happy about her best friend being snatched up by some random guy…? (Source: Hana to Yume, translated)

title: Sankakkei no Kowashikata
description: Koto, Aya, and Erika were secretly in love with each other. Koto revealed her feelings for Aya, but a short while later, Aya disappeared as if she had been spirited away. Seven years later, Aya reappears to Koto and Erika, just as she was then... (Source: U-Next, translated)

title: TSF Monogatari
description: As Takumi Musashino lay in his hospital bed, with his body being consumed by cancer and doctors giving up on him, he knew that his life was coming to an end. At the last minute, a mysterious woman appears with an experimental treatment promising a miracle cure, but warns there might be some side effects. Though the treatment cures him of his cancer, his body continues to change until Takumi has become a full-fledged woman! Takumi hoped the cure would allow them to live a normal life again, but not only has their body changed, their relationship with friends and classmates are now different. With every guy giving them weird looks and wanting to touch their new body, can Takumi navigate their new life as an average woman? (Source: FAKKU) 1, 3-5, 7-8. TSF Monogatari (TSF物語); Comic Mujin 2010-10, 12, kakioroshi, 2011-01, 04, kakioroshi 2. Ero wa Bungaku! (エロは文学！); Comic Mujin 2010-05 6. Hitori Nabe x Futari Nabe (一人ナベｘ二人ナベ); Comic Mujin 2008-12

characters.name: Takumi Musashino
characters.description: Takumi suffers from a terminal illness, agrees to try an experimental gene therapy and is changed into a girl.

title: Ninja to Koroshiya no Futarigurashi
title_original: 忍者と殺し屋のふたりぐらし
title_en: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
description: After a series of unfortunate events, young ninja Satoko has found herself sharing a house with the deadly assassin, Konoha. On the run from her village due to a misunderstanding, she’s relying on Konoha’s murderous skills to keep her safe from the ninjas seeking to kill her. But Konoha isn’t the easiest to get along with and is only tolerating Satoko due to her excellent skills at cleaning up messes—both from Konoha’s work and in her home. Somehow, these two will find harmony in their new life together while keeping ninja attackers at bay! So long as they can survive each other, that is. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Satoko Kusagakure
characters.description: A recent runaway from a ninja village who is ignorant about the outside world. She is useless at Ninja battle techniques, but has the special ninjutsu ability to turn objects into leaves. Her experience doing chores for the village makes her skilled at cleaning.

characters.name: Konoha Koga
characters.description: Despite looking like a normal high school girl, she is an assassin. She invites [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) to help with her assassin work due to the usefulness of her ninjutsu. Outside of work she is somewhat of a slob and her real name is unknown.

characters.name: Marin Izutsumi
characters.description: A rival assassin to [Konoha](https://anilist.co/character/341513/Konoha-Koga) who uses various inventions instead of combat ability. As an apology for kidnapping [Satoko,](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) she sends [Roboko](https://anilist.co/character/350518/Roboko) to Konoha.

characters.name: Kuro
characters.description: Leader of the fugitive ninjas who convinced [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) to leave the village, she regrets dragging Satoko into her personal business and tries to help her when she can. She has ninjutsu which erases memories and currently is unemployed as she lives with her [girlfriend](https://anilist.co/character/350517/Yuriko).

characters.name: Yuriko
characters.description: Ordinary person who lives together with [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/350516/Kuro). She is a beautiful woman and a good person, but also readily accepts ninjas and assassins so may also be a weird person.

characters.name: Roboko
characters.description: A robot made by [Marin](https://anilist.co/character/350515/Marin-Izutsumi) which resembles [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure). She has many useful features which make [Konoha](https://anilist.co/character/341513/Konoha-Koga) very happy.

title: Ginsei no Proust
description: Kazuki, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, and a straight-A student at a prestigious school for girls, meets Moka, a wild girl from a rowdy school. What becomes of Kazuki when witnessing a steamy moment between Moka and her boyfriend leaves her all shaken up...?! Find out in this seaside tale of two polar opposites and their fated encounter. (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Everyday Lily
description: A realist lesbian accidentally comes out to a closeted lesbian, whose only lesbian experience was through 2-D artworks. Find out how their college lives start involving a daily dose of lily. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

characters.name: Nayoung Yang
characters.description: Lesbian (Or, as she refers to herself, a lily girl), idealist.

title: Mina Soko Nite
description: It is said that at the bottom of the lake in this town lies a "mermaid" that eats people. Today, the mermaid still wanders the town in search of companions, stirring up the restless hearts of the people. A modern fable about foolish girls who cannot live in clean water.

title: Bokura no Ai wa Kimochi Warui
title_original: 僕らのアイは気持ち悪い
description: Everyone is hiding a "secret." Azuki Komugi is obsessed with ruminating on her memories of her high school girlfriend "Meguru," and creating a body model of hers out of clay. One day, Azuki drops her homemade "Meguru" at the 100-yen shop where she works part-time, and sneaks into her workplace on her off-shift to get "her" back. However, what she sees there is a fellow co-worker, high school girl Yoyuki Remu, who is about to express her lust for "Meguru" in a way that is different from Azuki's... (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Gouhou Yuri Fuufu Hon
description: In a country far far away, the inhabitants are very similar to humans but the two distinct differences are their animal ears and their acceptance of same-sex marriage. 25-year-old Haru never had time to think of romance once her father died suddenly. Now that she is the last of her mother's unwed daughters, her uncle proposes an arranged marriage between her and a beautiful older woman. Haru accepts and the two are rushed through the ceremony. Now, they find themselves married to a stranger and adjusting to a new life as a married couple. Becoming closer, learning about one another, and falling in love is what this manga centers on. Notes: - Originally released as a doujinshi. A compilation was published by Ichijinsha on May 18, 2016. - Contains four side stories.

title: Watashi, Isekai de Dorei ni Sarechaimashita (Naki) Shikamo Goshujin-sama wa Seikaku no Warui Elf no Joou-sama (demo Chou Bijin ← Koko Daiji) Munou Sugite Nonoshiraremakuru kedo Douryou no Orc ga Iyashikei da shi Sato no Elf wa Kawaii shi
title_original: 私、異世界で奴隷にされちゃいました（泣）しかもご主人様は性格の悪いエルフの女王様！（でも超美人←ここ大事）無能すぎて罵られまくるけど同僚のオークが癒やし系だし里のエルフは可愛いし結構楽しんでる私です。
description: One day, Teru, a high school girl aspiring to become a manga artist, is hit by a truck and reincarnated into another world! She is made the slave of Sirius, a beautiful elf queen she meets in the other world, and begins a life of hardship... except... her orc coworker is the healing type, and the village's elves are cute? Eh? This seems like a pretty fun life...? (Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Kaijin Reijou
description: Asuma Sudou has always been a proud pervert, but he's sworn to give that up to chase the girl of his dreams. Having received a special invitation to enter the same all-girls school as her, he's planning to live his romantic youth to the fullest. But those plans are cut short when it turns out the school is a front for a secret organization dedicated to battling kaijin-monsters created when people succumb to their murderous impulses! The girls of the school fight using the relics of defeated kaijin, but when the bloodthirsty instincts sealed within threaten to overwhelm them, Asuma is the only one who can bring them back to their senses! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Driver's High
description: Leo Lombardi’s a hotshot L1 racecar driver for Team Zeus. He’s young, good-looking and has the driving talent to make anyone jealous. And sharing in that success is Leo’s boyfriend, J.J., who just so happens to be a mechanic on Team Zeus. All signs point to a clear lane for Leo to take home the championship for a second year in a row. But when J.J. suddenly breaks up with Leo, things start going south. With Leo’s fortuna (good luck charm) gone, his professional (and personal) life starts to suffer. How will he get rid of this monkey wrench in his plans and reclaim the driver’s high he once had…? (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.

title: Spotted Flower
description: It's about the married life between a newlywed working otaku and his pregnant wife.

title: Ppangnyeo
description: Cheongyeon female prison is full of lustful, evil people. Woo-Jin works as a guard here, and he meets her, a girls as fragile as a flower... (Source: DAYcomics)

characters.name: Bo-Ih Yoon
characters.description: __Crime:__ Negligent Homicide __Sentence:__ 2 Years __Occupation:__ Musician She has Antisocial Personality Disorder.

title: Fuzoroi no Renri
description: Our ages and lives are so different. But I… still want to be with you. Why do you love someone, when their ages, personalities, thoughts, and appearances have nothing in common. The story of two women who discover how they fulfill each other. (Source: Comic Newtype, translated) Note: The original Twitter comic was incorporated in the volume release of the serialized work. The first 93 chapters in the volume release are the Twitter comic, whereafter the serialized chapters were interspersed with the subsequent Twitter comic chapters.

characters.name: Iori Tanaka
characters.description: An office worker at a "black company" who drinks to cope with work-related stress, she has affairs with married guys on a regular basis and "has never been the most important person in anyone's life." When Minami Sendou, a waitress at her favourite izakaya, brings an inebriated Iori home, Iori unconsciously clings to her, and they end up spending the night together. She is a cheerful and carefree person, and with a few drinks, she can put herself in a good mood and show her affection for Minami, but she also has a scary side when she gets angry and tries to wrestle Minami into submission.

characters.name: Minami Sendou
characters.description: She works in an izakaya. She has blonde hair, ear piercings, and large tattoos covering her shoulders and back. She is especially popular with her female part-time workers. She was raised in an institution since she was a child due to a difficult family situation; it was here that she met Nakano Shizuku. She worries that her happiness with Iori may only be temporary, possibly as a result of the challenging environment she has had gone through. She also occasionally behaves as if she has given up on life, which frustrates Iori.

characters.name: Shizuku Nakano
characters.description: Minami's friend. They were raised in the same institution. She was rather aggressive when she first met Minami, punching her before greeting her, and grabbing a female classmate by the head and chest when she got into a fight with Saori, but as as a result of Shizuku's and Saori's conversations, she gradually became less hostile.

characters.name: Saori Tanaka
characters.description: [Iori's](https://anilist.co/character/291133) younger sister. She has feelings for Iori that are a bit out of the usual for a younger sibling, and she gets frustrated with Minami for taking away her big sister. She is in the same class as Shizuku, and her relationship with Shizuku begins when her homeroom teacher asks her to visit Shizuku's house, because Shizuku refuses to attend school.

characters.name: Kujou
characters.description: She is a physical education teacher at the high school that Saori, Shizuku, and Sugimoto attend. She is romantically attracted in women and wants a girlfriend, so she tries to go inside a lesbian bar, but she never find the courage to do so, so she always goes to the maid café next door. There, she meets Sugimoto, a part-time maid, and receives advice on love. Her students dislike her strict teaching, and she is frequently regarded as having "nothing but a pretty face."

characters.name: Ayame Shinohara
characters.description: She's a manga editor and a former professional gamer who met Heke through FPS games. She enjoys playing games with Heke under the alias Lala. She is also Heke's editor, although she has yet revealed to Heke that Lala = Shinohara, and assumes that Heke is clueless. Despite her cold façade, Heke has a clumsy side that reveals her emotions, such as blushing or happiness, and is unable to take action on her own.

characters.name: Sugimoto
characters.description: She is a third-year high school student. While working part-time at a maid café, she met Kujo and made a promise to help her find a girlfriend. Other female students envy her beauty and popularity, and they gossip about her behind her back.

characters.name: Heke
characters.description: A manga artist. While she is a bad person who spends her time playing FPS games just before a deadline, she knows how to cook well and save money. She pretends to be unaware that Lala is her editor Shinohara, but she has known for quite some time, and she confesses in front of Shinohara in a roundabout way that she likes the person she gets along with in the game in a romantic sense, and watches Shinohara's reaction.

title: MURMUR
description: Jinah has a secret habit: she can’t fall asleep without the explicit ASMR videos of a mysterious YouTuber named NA. It’s the only thing that calms her insomnia, even if the creator’s voice and trademark lip mole are hauntingly familiar. But when her company hosts a workshop featuring the internet's hottest star, Jinah’s digital fantasy becomes a physical nightmare. NA is actually Heo Jina, the high school "friend" who stole Jinah's first love and left her life in ruins. Now, it turns out the woman who ruined her is the only one who can make her feel alive... (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.name: Jin-A Kim
characters.description: __Height:__ 172cm She suffers from insomnia, barely falling asleep each night, having to listen to ASMR videos by a YouTuber named NA.

characters.name: Ji-Na Heo
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm She used to be Jin-A’s high school classmate and is who caused Jin-A's insomnia in the first place. She is now a really successful ASMR YouTuber who goes by the stage name of NA.

title: Fushigi no Kuni no Miyuki-chan
title_original: 不思議の国の美幸ちゃん
description: There are many worlds in the universe outside of our own, connected by doors that are hidden to the eye. But if you chance upon those doors, you can be transported to a place where supple beauties reign supreme and all of your fantasies come alive. Should you pass through the doorways, be most careful, for the creatures you will meet can be as dangerous as they are beautiful. Many would die for a glimpse at those worlds - Miyuki would do anything to have them go away. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Miyuki
characters.description: An average yet pretty school girl. She appears to be pretty bright, if a bit scatterbrained. She's also very innocent, claiming to have never even had a boyfriend before. So when she lands in several strange worlds filled with pretty women trying to "get to know her better," she becomes very panicky and wished for nothing more than to return home. Miyuki's travels lead her to seven different worlds.

characters.name: Ruri
characters.description: Ruri is Kouryuu's cat-demon underling and Hari's identical twin. She can transform into an ordinary house cat to hide from the world (during the day she must stay in her cat form, similar to the way Kohaku and Kouryuu turn small). She will do anything he asks of them to get gifts (often sex) and/or souls. She enjoys kisses from her master. You can tell the twins apart only by their jewelry: Ruri wears circles on her earring and necklace (earring and tail when in cat form), and Hari wears bars on hers.

characters.name: Hari
characters.description: Hari is Kouryuu's cat-demon underling and Ruri's identical twin. She can transform into an ordinary house cat to hide from the world (during the day she must stay in her cat form, similar to the way Kohaku and Kouryuu turn small). She will do anything he asks of them to get gifts (often sex) and/or souls. She enjoys kisses from her master. You can tell the twins apart only by their jewelry: Ruri wears circles on her earring and necklace (earring and tail when in cat form), and Hari wears bars on hers.

characters.name: Arashi Kishu
characters.description: A foundling girl raised by Shintō priests at Ise Jingū and the the Dragon of Heaven most immediately in touch with Princess Hinoto. Called the "Hidden Priestess of Ise", her specialty is sword fighting, a massive sword emerging from her left hand. Despite her cold, stoic front, Sorata falls in love with her, and ultimately she comes to reciprocate. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In the Republic of Hanshin, she's a retired miko married to Sorata. In Tokyo, she's a miko who can foresee disaster and is one of the seven fighters of the Tower faction. !~

characters.name: Yuzuriha Nekoi
characters.description: One of the dragons of Heaven, a fourteen-year-old schoolgirl descended from the keepers of Mitsumine Jinja, masters of inugami (dog-spirits), Yuzuriha is exceedingly energetic, often diffusing latent tension between Kamui and the rest of the Ten no Ryū. Yuzuriha is attended by her own personal inugami, Inuki, who can transform into anything she desires and who only others with occult powers can see. She was teased throughout much of her childhood as her classmates believed Inuki was her imaginary friend. Because of this, Yuzuriha made a vow that she would never fall in love with (or even date) a man who could not see Inuki. However, the first person outside of her family that she meets who can see Inuki is Shiyū Kusanagi—a Dragon of Earth. Yuzuriha falls in love with Kusanagi, regardless of their conflicting fates. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In Edonis country, she's

characters.name: Karen Kasumi
characters.description: A dragon of heaven, Karen is a Soapland call girl and devout Catholic, she was abused by her fundamentalist mother when her power to manipulate fire manifested in her childhood. She comes to admire Aoki. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In Shara-no, she's the leading actress in an entertainment troupe. In Tokyo, she's one of the seven fighters of the Tower faction. !~

characters.name: Satsuki Yatouji
characters.description: One of the Dragons of earth, a complex and ingenious young woman with utter contempt for humans, and a love for the digital world. Even though being usually cold and emotionless, she develops feelings for Yuuto. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle:__ ~!In Tokyo, she's one of the seven fighters of the City Hall action. Unlike in X, she studies medicine and is more no-nonsense than apathetic or heartless. She initially receives Syaoran's group with suspicion, but later treats their wounds. !~

characters.name: Hinoto
characters.description: A yumemi (dreamseer) in the employ of the Japanese government residing in the basement of the Japanese Diet Building. She is blind, deaf, mute, crippled, and must communicate telepathically, but her dreams have never failed to come true. She foresees the battle between the Dragons of Heaven and Earth and the advent of Kamui, but cannot determine which path he will choose. Either way, she foresees that the Dragons of Heaven will lose, but conceals this from them. For a time, she is possessed by her dark half, which causes a disastrous battle to occur within Hinoto's own consciousness (played out on the dreamscape), as well as many complications for the Ten no Ryū.

characters.name: Kotori Monou
characters.description: Fūma's younger sister, a delicate child with a congenital heart condition, and a developing yumemi (dreamseer). She was Kamui's very close childhood friend, and despite his initial coldness when he returns to her life, remains steadfastly kind to him. In the TV series, her dream is to become an indigo dyesmith (in the style of Japan's Edo period), well aware of the commitment necessary, and she spends time in her school's library reading up on the subject. ~!Kotori was an important key to making Kamui choose one of the two sides. She was destined to die by the second Kamui, the only thing that was left to fate was whether Kamui was going to kill her or Fuma. However, since Kamui decides that the only thing he wants is to protect her (and thus indirectly saying he will join the Seals to protect humanity so that Kotori won't die), the person that finally kills her

characters.name: Kanoe
characters.description: Princess Hinoto's younger sister, who supports the Dragons of Earth mainly to spite her. She can enter and leave dreams like Hinoto and Kakyou, but cannot see the future unaided. She works as a secretary in the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building for the Governor. She is in a sexual relationship with Yuuto, but sometimes she also flirts with Satsuki and (briefly) Fuuma.

title: I Love You Yori Aishiteru
title_original: 愛羅武勇より愛してる
description: Kazumi Shinjou who is a delinquent and Risa Takaoka who is a model student become unexpected friends. (Source: Yuri Project) Included one-shot: Onaka wo Sukasete Kaettekuru ne

title: Girls und Panzer: Ribbon no Musha
title_original: ガールズ&パンツァー リボンの武者
description: Tankathlon is a new form of tank sport gaining slowly gaining popularity among Senshado enthusiasts. While also involving tank battles, Tankathlon is distinguished by its lack of official oversight allowing any school with tanks to participate in a battle anywhere at any time, and a 10-ton weight restriction on tanks used, limiting battles to light tanks and tankettes.

characters.name: Shizuka Tsuruki
characters.description: Shizuka is the commander and gunner of the 2-man "Centipede Team" crewing a Type 97 Te-Ke light tank. Shizuka is an eccentric girl who believes to have been born into the wrong time. She expresses great interest in warfare, and is inspired by her cultural heritage in the matter, which seems appropriate given her family descends from the Takeda Clan. Shizuka uses the clan's symbols with pride as she engages in tankathlon very eagerly. She appears stoic for the most part but her desire for an exciting battle shows through. She has great degree of skill in archery, practicing it even on horseback, and though new to tankathlon, she has displayed a talent for tank battles.

characters.name: Jajka
characters.description: A former gunner of Chwat tank destroyer, she is the overall commander of Bonple at the time of the 63rd Senshado Tournament, she is referred as Grandmaster in Tankathlon world.

characters.name: Miho Nishizumi
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Kumamoto City, Kunamoto Prefecture She was born into the distinguished family of the Nishizumi Style of Sensha-do, but she changed schools to Ooarai Girls Academy intending to run away from Sensha-do. However, perplexingly enough, she was extorted into joining Sensha-do by the student council. She's a second-year and considers her friend's feelings more than anyone else. She has traumatic memory of tanks because of an incident that happened during her past with a tank. She's Ankou Team's Commander and is Ooarai's De Facto captain. Miho has a polite personality and can lack self-confidence when in social situations. However when in a Sensha-do battle, Miho is known for her quick and decisive thinking. Miho also has a deep sense of loyalty to her friends, being ready to sacrifice her own reputation for the sake of others. Finally, Miho is a fan of t

characters.name: Saori Takebe
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture Hana's friend and the other girl who befriended Miho during the first day of school. She is a social butterfly and is incredibly talkative. She yearns for a love that will love everything in the world, despite never being in a relationship before. She thought she would be popular among boys if she took Sensha-do. She is a member of the Ankou Team and serves as the Radio Operator and machine gunner. She also acts as a big sister for the Rabbit team comprised of the freshman. She sometimes calls [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi) "Miporin". Saori is also a talented cook. ~! As of Das Finale, she is now the PR Manager for the Oorari Student Council !~ (Source: Official Character Sheet)

characters.name: Hana Isuzu
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5'4") **Home Town:** Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture A member of Anko Team and the Team's gunner. A beautiful girl who has a gentle and composed demeanor, and is the other girl alongside Saori who befriended Miho during the first day. She was born into a home that had mastered the art of flower arrangement, but having felt dissatisfaction with this way of life, as a genuine Ojou-sama she chose Shensha-do instead. ~! She is disowned by her mother because of her decision to pursue Sensha-do instead of flower arrangement, but eventually, her mother reconciles with her after seeing the positive effects Sensha-do has had on Hana's life.!~ ~! As of Das Finale, Hana is the President of the Ooarai Student Council !~

characters.name: Yukari Akiyama
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture A member of Anko Team, and the loader of the Team. She gets overly excited when she sees or hears anything about tanks - to put it, she is a tank otaku. Yukari has had a deep love for all things tanking and WW2 since a young age. She collects tank models and frequently utilizes WW2-era equipment whenever possible. She uses her knowledge of tanks to help the team. She has a deep respect and admiration of overall tank commander [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi), going as far to refer to her as "Nishizumi-dono". Yukari is also known for her infiltration missions, where before a match she will sneak her way into the competing team's school in order to get intel for Miho and the rest of Oorari. ~!As of Das Finale, Yukari is now the Vice President of the Oorari Student Council.!~

characters.name: Mako Reizei
characters.description: **Height:** 145 cm (4'9") **Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture A member of Anko Team and is the team's driver. She is a quiet and gloomy girl who falls easily asleep, and hates mornings. She is also weak to certain conditions. She is late to school everyday but is top of the class and can learn things almost instantly just by reading. She is a genius with a high level grade performance. But, due to her habitual tardiness in the morning she has insufficient credits, and so in exchange for credits, she is pursuing Sensha-do. She is childhood friends with [Saori Takebe](https://anilist.co/character/62941/Saori-Takebe). Mako lives with her aging and strict grandmother [Hisako Reizei](https://anilist.co/character/74701/Reizei-Hisako). ~!Mako lost her parents in an accident when she was in elementary school. According to Saori, Mako fought with her mother shortly before the accident and w

characters.name: Kay
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") **Home Town:** Sasebo, Nagasaki Prefecture The energetic leader of the Saunders Sensha-dou team, portrayed as a stereotypical American, who is loud, boisterous, charismatic, and laid back. She believes that Sensha-dou is not war and believes in fair play.

characters.name: Alisa
characters.description: A manipulative and aggressive radio operator who taps enemy communications to obtain an unfair advantage in combat. Commanded the flag tank in Saunders' match against Oarai in first round of the national Sensha-dou championship. She was scolded by [Kay](https://anilist.co/character/72655/Kay) when the latter found out about her radio tapping.

title: Ryokataomoi na Futago Shimai
description: Saori and Shiori are twin sisters. They both love each other, but think their loves are unrequited! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Lilith 2
description: Jaehee comes across as a shy, hard-working high school teacher. But behind closed doors, she gets her kicks by kneeling at the end of a whip, with her childhood friend Huilin holding the handle. However, when Sulhwa joins the school as a student teacher, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now Jaehee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain. Back with the same writer and a new artist, “Lilith 2” follows on where “Lilith” left off. So strap in and enjoy the rest of the ride…. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Sarangeun Hwansang!: The Queen
title_en: Love is an Illusion! - The Queen
description: Free-spirited Alpha Do-Gyeom has finally decided to put her promiscuous past behind her and settle down. As a 39-year-old woman, however, her options for marriage partners have dwindled. Luckily she has her beleaguered Omega secretary, Seung-Ah, to do most of the work of finding a suitable match for her. It shouldn’t be a problem, even if Seung-Ah and Do-Gyeom have harbored secret feelings for each other for years. In fact, arranging Do-Gyeom’s marriage may just be the catalyst for the two of them to finally admit their attraction…unless another Alpha gets in the way! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

characters.name: Do-Gyeom Park
characters.description: Second Gender: Alpha (dominant)

characters.name: Seung-Ah Lee
characters.description: Second Gender: Omega (dominant)

characters.name: Mu-Jin
characters.description: __Second Gender:__ Alpha Although he's a tough-looking alpha, he makes adorable ceramics at the Cutie Workshop (기요미공방).

characters.name: Do-Jin Park
characters.description: Park Do-Jin is a singer/songwriter, born in a wealthy family only Alphas. He hates Omegas and has only relationship with Betas and Alphas.

characters.name: Hye-Sung Kim
characters.description: Kim Hye-Sung is an Omega who believes he is an Alpha. He had a difficult childhood and even dropped out of school.

characters.name: Hee-Soo Yoon
characters.description: Hee-Soo is a beta that is denominated lackey of the family Park. He follows Do-Jin everywhere, calling him a young master. He does not seem to like Hye-Sung and totally disapproves of his master having any relationship with him.

characters.name: Byul Park
characters.description: ~!Park Byul is the son of Park Do-Jin and Kim Hye-Sung. He was conceived accidentally.!~

title: Ueno-kun wa Kaihatsuzumi
description: An unfortunate story in the spring of youth about a boy who can’t get off without being bullied by three girls.

characters.name: Sora Ueno
characters.description: Ueno Sora is the protagonist of Ueno-kun wa Kaihatsuzumi , a socially awkward college student whose life becomes complicated after reconnecting with girls who used to bully him in the past. Although he appears quiet and passive, Ueno is surprisingly honest and emotionally vulnerable, often getting dragged into embarrassing and chaotic situations because of his unusual desires and inability to properly handle intimacy.

title: Maya no Souretsu
description: A horror story, in which the main character and her family go to their summer house for vacation and people start dying one by one. The twist is that the main character, Reina, is falling in love with her mysterious neighbor, Maya. But who is Maya really, and how does she know so much about Reina's family? Note: The series was published as a single volume in 2005 along with two other stories, "Otouto" ("Little Brother") and "Kurisuchiina no aoi sora" ("Christina's blue sky").

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: A tall, dark and mysterious woman whom Reina encounters and falls in love with.

characters.name: Reina Harukawa
characters.description: The daughter of the wealthy Harukawa family. Reina feels misunderstood and neglected by her parents. She falls in love with Maya quickly after meeting her and the two develop a strong bond.

title: Qinai De L
description: Dr. Wei struggles after finding out that the girl she hooked up with was only sixteen years old, but somehow it's not as easy to avoid the girl as she had thought.

characters.name: Wei Wei
characters.description: Wei Wei is a 34-year-old ophthalmologist.

characters.name: Ding Yi
characters.description: Ding Yi is a 16-year-old high school student.

characters.name: Sichen Lu
characters.description: She is Wei Wei's work colleague.

characters.name: Xiao Ou Lin
characters.description: He is Wei Wei's friend and colleague

title: Suitou-to!
description: Momose is an ordinary college student who harbors two secrets. The first is that, despite posting lots of sweet and sugary foods onto her social media, she actually hates them and wants to eat more fatty, rich meals. And the second is... Note: Chapter count includes 23 regular chapters and 1 extra.

title: Cigarette Anthology
title_original: シガレットアンソロジー
description: Anthology of one-shots by various mangaka dealing with the theme of cigarettes. 1. TIME MACHINE RECORD [Oh! Great] 2. One Room Sick No Pantsu (ワンルームシックノーパンツ) [Kanshou Vector (Taguchi Shouichi & Harukawa Misaki)] 3. Cupola no Haru-chan (キューポラのハルちゃん, Haru of Cupola) [Kira Takashi] 4. EASY WAY TO STOP SNIPING [Sugimura Shinichi] 5. Kiniro no Ame Hoshi no Kemuri (金色の飴 星の煙, Golden Candy, Starry Smoke) [Fumi Fumiko]

title: Joshikou dakara Safe
description: It's tempting to tease the girl that you like, right? Nanase is interested in her classmate Momo. Whenever you see her, you can't help but to just play with her! A yuri comedy about a girls school where the law is out of bounds and the girls are always on the edge of their seats! ☆

title: Kimi no Tame no Curtain Call
title_original: 君のためのカーテンコール
description: Shy, mousy Sakura Akutsu is content to keep her adventures confined to the pages of her notebook—until the brash, outgoing new transfer student Tsubame Hiiragi gets her hands on it, that is. The two secretly share the stories Sakura spins, but soon that secret proves too big to keep, and Tsubame whisks Sakura into a glittering world she could never have imagined! As Sakura learns to be confident in who she is and ignore what others think, Tsubame learns to go below the surface and dig deep for emotional truths that may have eluded her... Together they'll learn about art, love, truth, and most of all, the theater...! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Tsuki wa Hitsuji wo Kazoenai
title_original: 月はヒツジを数えない
description: A high school girl is trapped in an unfortunate life, living in despair... Until one day, when she's suddenly summoned to another world! The fresh start offers the girl hope for a new life. The reason for her summoning is… to be the sleeping companion for a handsome cross-dressing princess! (Source: Comic Newtype, translated)

characters.name: Noah Serpeiente
characters.original: ノア・エテルネル・セルピエンテ

title: Benghuai 3
description: A Manhua of the popular smartphone game Honkai 3rd launched by miHoYo 「Collapse」 ... An unknown force once known bury the civilization of mankinds in the distant past ... now descended into this peaceful world once again. "Honkai, the mysterious power responsible for destroying human civilization countless times, has descended upon this beautiful world once again…” With the lands now flooded with deadwalkers and Honkai beasts, a group of girls bearing the burdens of despair continue their fight onward. Will there be any hope of clinging to survival?" Three years ago, the third Honkai descended upon Chuangai City in the far east... Under the glow of sunset, Valkyrie Kiana leapt out from the Hyperion, plummeting through the clouds like a falling meteor towards a warship. Her relentless Valkyrie determination represented a glimmer of hope. With this breathtaking scene, the story of the Captain and the Hyperion begins and the stage is set for the battle with the Honkai. Fight for all that is beautiful in this world!

characters.name: Mei Raiden
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'8") Raiden Mei is one of the main protagonists along with Kiana Kaslana, Bronya Zaychik, Theresa Apocalypse and Murata Himeko. She is the daughter of the Massive Electric Industries' CEO. When she was young, her father was arrested for fraud and most of her family assets were seized due to her father’s criminal activities, and was later captured to be part of a Honkai-related experiment. This event has caused her to be cold and distant towards others, though her friendship with Kiana has caused her to become more gentle and caring. ~!She also has a Ruler sealed within her, which was unleashed during the Choukuu City event, and later awakened as the 3rd Herrscher. After Kiana stopped her, she joined Schicksal shortly after learning on how to control her power.!~

characters.name: Kiana Kaslana
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") A Schicksal Valkyrie and a student at St. Freya's Academy. She is the 69th successor of the Kaslana family and daughter to Siegfried Kaslana and Cecilia Schariac. Her mother died when she was young and her father later abandoned her. She attended various schools before ending up in the same school as Mei and Bronya. She becomes a Valkyrie to find out what happened to her parents. Kiana also has rather open feelings for Mei, something that, among other things, sparks her rivalry with Bronya.

characters.name: Bronya Zaychik
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'10") Bronya is a high-performance cyborg without emotions, who was raised to be a deadly assassin and led to her being the infamous cold-blooded sniper, the Silver Wolf until she got knocked out by Cocolia and met [Seele Vollerei](https://anilist.co/character/142952/Vollerei-Seele) at an orphanage, in which unbeknownst to them, was actually the supply of experimentation subjects of a project called the X-10 Experiment. After losing Seele when she dissolved in a quantum state, Bronya entered St. Freya's Academy as a mole of Anti-Entropy with hopes of saving her former lover.

characters.name: Hua Fu
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Honkai Impact 3rd:__ She's a class monitor in Kiana's class, as well as a martial arts master. A calm and reasonable girl. Member of the Amber Project. Plunged into cryogenic sleep about fifty thousand years ago. Her goal after awakening in a new era is to guide people to the development of civilization and to help repel new attacks of the Honkai energy.

characters.name: Otto Apocalypse
characters.description: The Overseer of Schicksal, Otto is a very mysterious and evil man. He is also the adoptive father of [Theresa Apocalypse](https://anilist.co/character/142945/Theresa-Apocalypse), a failed clone that Otto created using the late [Kallen Kaslana](https://anilist.co/character/142943/Kallen-Kaslana)'s DNA.

characters.name: Kallen Kaslana
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") The most famous Valkyrie warrior who has ever lived, and the ancestor of Kiana Kaslana, Kallen is an elegant Schicksal knight whose spirit lives on to fight the Honkai. She remains the object of the Overseer Otto's eye. ~!She was the most powerful among her fellow valkyries in her era and was Otto Apocalypse's first love interest but she did not return his feelings.!~ ~!Kallen wielded the Oath of Judah until her untimely death in the hands of a Honkai beast.!~

characters.name: Jizi Wuliangta
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") __Honkai Impact 3rd:__ Murata Himeko is an A-rank Valkyrie, a teacher at St. Freya Academy, and the Captain of Hyperion. She's the leader of Squad V, supervising the team composed of [Kiana Kaslana]( https://anilist.co/character/142947/Kiana-Kaslana), [Raiden Mei]( https://anilist.co/character/142946/Mei-Raiden), and [Bronya Zaychik]( https://anilist.co/character/142948/Bronya-Zaychik). She is a strong and reliable leader at work, though she struggles with severe alcoholism and even drinks while teaching. She is brave and sometimes reckless in battle, never backing down when others' lives are at stake. Despite having no prior combat experience, she worked hard to become a member of the Assault Squad through grueling training. __Honkai: Star Rail:__ Murata Himeko is a part of the Astral Express crew in Honkai: Star Rail. She is an adventurous scientist who encoun

characters.name: Theresa Apocalypse
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") She is principal of St. Freya's Academy where Kiana, Mei and Bronya currently attends in and granddaughter of the ruler of Schicksal, Otto Apocalypse. She was born from Kallen Kaslana's genes and is a certified valkyrja with an unknown rank. ~!She was close friends with Kiana's parents- especially the late Cecilia Shania- and was asked to be the child's godmother.!~

characters.name: Rita Rossweisse
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm The vice captain of "Immortal Blades" and the trusted adjutant of Durandal. Rita is one of the three S-rank valkyries in Schicksal. Diligent in her duties to be the ultimate maid, Rita will learn anything that might better fulfill her master's wishes from clearing enemies on the battlefield to playing video games.. Not much is known about Rita as she keeps her secrets hidden very well. Perhaps only Durandal and fellow valkyries of "Immortal Blades" would know anything about her.

characters.name: Sakura Yae
characters.description: __Height:__ 194 cm (including ears) Yae Sakura used to be the shrine maiden of Yae Village. Despite her devotion, hard work, and wishes for the village's well-being, her ill sister was ultimately sacrificed and used in a barbaric ritual to hopefully quell the houkai. Ironically, the ritual did not work and despite the sister’s last wish, but gradually began to feel hatred towards the village. ~!The two eventually started a relationship and loved each other, until Sakura got possessed by the will of the Houkai from the purple box and [Kallen](https://anilist.co/character/142943/Kaslana-Kallen) was forced to seal her loved one away.!~

characters.name: Seele Vollerei
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (before X-10) An orphaned girl who became Bronya's closest friend at Cocolia's orphanage. ~!Her alter ego, Hei Seele Vollerei (黑希儿·芙乐艾), has control of her True Stigmata's power. Hei Seele's personality is drastically different from Seele's and is initially ruthless and unkind, but this later on changes as she learns to care for Seele, and eventually even her friends. She has a violent reaction with people she sees as a threat to herself or Seele, and is particularly overprotective of her, showing worry any time she battles. She also has the habit of staring at Seele's face while she is sleeping. A lot of the time she is quite dishonest about her feelings, putting up a tough act rather than admitting she cares deep down. She is easily provoked and jealous, and quick to suggest more forceful means of action in most situations. She also dislikes being considered a monste

characters.name: Hei Seele Vollerei
characters.description: Hei Seele is a being awakened inside Seele Vollerei, originally referred to by the latter as "the other me". She originates from the stigma on Seele's chest, giving her greater control over the stigma's power. Hei Seele vowed to protect Seele, the meaning of her existence, from all harm that should come her way. Hei Seele acts violent, cruel, and even sadistic towards her enemies, but is straightforward in conveying her genuine feelings of goodwill to those she cares about. Still, she prefers fighting and violent solutions to solve problems, especially to protect Seele and her friends. A being born from the desire for protection, her identity revolves around being Seele's protector. However, this means that as Seele continues to grow more independent and mature, Hei Seele is starting feel anxious about being forgotten and left behind. ~!Eventually, Hei Seele and Seele are split apart, ga

title: Dear NOMAN
description: Ever since she was little, Mashiro has been able to see ghosts—of people, of animals, and of some strange creatures that don’t seem to be either. For years, she’s pretended not to see the eerie sights around her, but then a chance encounter plunges Mashiro into the world of the inhuman Nomans. An accidental kiss leaves Mashiro partnered with Bazu, a human-hating crow lady, as she joins the Boundary Preservation Society to help the dead that walk the earth move on… (Source: Yen Press)

title: Shoujo Kishidan x Knight Tale
title_original: 少女騎士団×ナイトテイル
description: Notes: Includes one extra chapter. The manga was never finished. The author tried to continue it under CyComics but this never came to be and after three years he said he would self publish it, though nothing has come out yet.

characters.name: Kasugai Kanade
characters.description: Main character of Shoujo Shoujo Kishidan X Knight Tale, also a knight.

title: Anjuneun Namja
description: One woman is on a mission to experience another night of ecstasy with a man whose name she never caught, but whose touch she can’t forget. Seven years ago, Eun-Seong was plucked from disaster by an enigmatic savior. What she remembers most isn’t the heroic rescue, but what happened next. After winding up in bed with her hero, she didn’t catch his name, but she did get the most amazing night of pleasure in her life! Since then, she’s searched for the perfect climax with countless others, yet it always remains tantalizingly out of reach. Undeterred, Eun-Seong continues her hot pursuit of the elusive “Big O” and the mysterious man who holds the key to her ultimate satisfaction. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

characters.name: Ok-Je Yu
characters.description: __Occupation__: Staff at a small publishing house

characters.name: A-Reum Nam
characters.description: __Occupation__: College Student

characters.name: Min-Hui Hong
characters.description: __Occupation__: Theater Actor

title: Watashi wa Kimi wo Nakasetai
description: "Tears" connect people who have never met before. This is the story of an honour student and a delinquent who are connected through these tears.

title: Aewanui Mihak
description: Cho-eul and Ju-ah have been BFFs since childhood. In high school, they shared a kiss, but it was only because Cho-eul said she was bored. They’ve continued to be inseparable, but only as friends. Deep inside, Ju-ah wants things to be different and even Cho-eul senses - and toys with - this unspoken tension. So how close is too close? What would happen if besties crossed the fine line between friends... and desire? (Source: Tapas)

title: Raise Kamika
description: A Boy-Meets-Girl story between Ookuni Raise, a high school boy who was left to fend for himself by both his parents, and the transfer student girl, Mikami Kamika. Due to an unfortunate incident, Raise ended up rubbing Kamika’s breast, which in turn led to her suspicion of his being a molester. Starting from their worst encounter, the tale unfolds as they were flown into a mystical world.

title: Raishuu, Ame ga Futtara
description: A story where two women meet on a rainy day.

title: Watashi no Sekai wo Kousei suru Chiri no You na Nani ka.
title_original: 私の世界を構成する塵のような何か。
description: A university student trying to understand love.

characters.name: Maasa Inariba
