I wanted to win over Komaki so badly that I tried to compete with her, even at the risk of losing "something important" - the result was my loss. And so Komaki said, "Wakaba, kiss me," and she stole away my first kiss. In order to regain my dignity, I challenge Komaki to another match, but she says that if she wins, she will take away another one of my most precious things.... Going on a date, sleeping in the same bed, even saying "I love you." I should have hated Komaki for taking all these first-times away from me, but what is this feeling that is filling my heart instead? (Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated) Note: Gold Prize winner in the 28th Sneaker Awards.

title: Yami Zokusei no Mahoutsukai daga, Naze ka Yuusha ni Natteshimatta: Sore wa Tomokaku Yome ni Ii Kurashi o Saseru Tame ni Ganbatte Nariagarou to Omou
title_original: 闇属性の魔法使いだが、なぜか勇者になってしまった ～それはともかく嫁にいい暮らしをさせるために頑張って成り上がろうと思う～
title_en: Busy Wizard: This Warlock Just Wants to Provide for his Wives!
description: After years of honing his magic deep in the mountains, eighteen-year-old Christophe dreams of making a name for himself in the imperial capital. But en route to the city where his fortune awaits, he meets a battered and beaten, yet surprisingly well-bred girl. (Source: Panty Press)

title: Gekitotsu no Hexennacht
title_original: OBSTACLEシリーズ 激突のヘクセンナハト
description: The earth is ruled by the Black Witch. The Black Witch was sealed in the moon and can only be judged once a decade on the night of Hexennacht. The ones who can fight the Black Witch are the chosen magical girls who have won their battles. Horinouchi Mitsuru, the Eastern Japan representative who aims to be the strongest, happens across a girl with strange power who says her name is Kagami Kagami. The girls "clash"! To save the world with their own power!!

title: Jussai no Saikyou Madoushi
description: A ten-year old girl named Ferris was a slave working in the magic stone mine. However, she was discovered to possess an astonishing amount of magical power, and she was enrolled in a magic academy. She is watched over by various people as her talent improved with tremendous speed. Every political faction made moves to try to control her power. Ferris was the only person who did not know she was a powerful magician. Ferris was satisfied as long as she had plenty to eat every day.

title: Miniskirt Uchuu Kaizoku
description: The story centers around a spirited high school girl named Marika. She keeps herself busy with the space yacht club and her part-time job at a high-class retro café. One day, two men suddenly appear and claim to be subordinates of her dead father. They demand that she assume command of the space pirate ship Benten Maru. A privateer ship's compact was made during a war of independence a century ago, and according to that compact, the ship must be inherited by the captain's next direct descendant. Marika finds herself embarking on a new life as a space pirate. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Yuusha Goroshi no Hanayome
description: In the light of day, Sister Alicia Snowell is a faithful and devoted bride of the gods, dedicated to serving the Holy Church and its followers. In the shadows, she’s one of the Church’s top inquisitors, tasked with hunting down and eliminating heretics by any means necessary. Alicia’s latest mission: assassinate the Hero Elcyon, slayer of the mighty Demon Lord, whose growing fame threatens to eclipse the Church’s political power. In order to kill the divinely protected, supposedly unkillable Hero, Alicia first needs to win Elcyon’s heart. There’s just one problem—Elcyon turns out to be a girl named Cion! Alicia’s at a loss for what to do, but while she tries to figure out how to seduce a girl, more trouble brews on the horizon. With remnants of the demon army still at large, Alicia and Cion face one deadly supernatural battle after another! Where will the two girls’ intertwining paths lead them? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Suki na Ko no Imouto
description: The one who fulfills my desires is the younger sister of the person I love―. A love triangle between the perfect older sister and her care-free younger sister. I, Yuka Amamiya, confessed my feelings to my first love, Nagisa Hanabusa... but I was rejected. Unable to let go of my lingering feelings, Nagisa's younger sister and my friend, Mino-chan, made a surprising offer. "I'll help you forget all about my sister." She offered to let me do everything I had wanted to do with Nagisa — but do it to her instead. I saw the shadow of the person I loved in her younger sister, and I started going on dates with Mino-chan, dressed as Nagisa, and... "Yuka-senpai, you're about to kiss a dear friend who's like a little sister, right?" I indulged in my desires, almost drowning in them. As I spent more time with Mino-chan, who was supposed to be a substitute for Nagisa, I found myself gradually falling for her― (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Oboreru Bed de, Tenshi no Negao wo Mitai dake. #Futari de Okashita Himitsu no Kousoku Ihan
title_original: 溺れるベッドで、天使の寝顔を見たいだけ。 #ふたりで犯した秘密の校則違反
title_en: Watching the Angel Sleep, Drowning in Bed Together
description: Ayana Yukihira is a second-year in high school, and after her parents’ divorce, she’s looking for a new start in an apartment of her own. But when she receives the keys, she finds another girl already there—fresh out of the bath! Due to an administrative error, the apartment was also rented out to Yuu Fukami, one of Ayana’s classmates at her new school. But instead of forcing Ayana to find another place to live, Yuu invites Ayana to share the lease as a roommate. As it turns out, the girls also share a mutual attraction that grows with every touch, every passing day…until they’re virtually drowning in it. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Carneades
description: This is a world inhabited by angels, demons, vampires, beastmen, and humans. Each of the five races has its own secrets and desires. No one yet knows the truth hidden within. But the opening bell is about to ring. (Source: MF Bunko, translated)

title: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
title_en: The Girls Adrift Among the Stars
description: AN INTERGALACTIC VOYAGE FOR A PLANET TO CALL HOME A horse-drawn carriage races across the cosmos. Or rather, a spaceship made to look like one. At the helm are a pair of refugees who fled Earth after pollution rendered it uninhabitable: Ridley, a scientist and the designer of this peculiar spacecraft, and Watari, an accomplished martial artist with debilitating shyness. This eccentric duo has but one goal—to find a stable planet where they can settle down on! However, every world the two visit is a little off… A planet with a god that can revive the dead, a planet where lucky people reign supreme, a planet lined with endless libraries… Can the girls navigate the unique challenges posed by each bizarre world and live to reach the next leg of their journey? And is there really a replacement for Earth waiting to be found among the stars? (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes a volume-bonus chapter.

title: Kirai Doushi no Watashitachi wa Ichiya no Ayamachi de
title_original: 嫌い同士のわたしたちは一夜の過ちで

title: Howling Blaze: Souen no Kenshi to Fushi no Majo
title_original: ハウリング・ブレイズ 葬焔の剣士と不死の魔女

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) Tanpenshuu
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ!(※ムリじゃなかった!?) 短編集
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll Be Your Lover! Unless… Even More Stories to Love!
description: From Sena Ajisai's student council dreams to Satsuki's fangirling, see what else the crew is up to in this brand-new spinoff! While Amaori Renako panics over maintaining her image as a cool, popular girl who absolutely did not only recently stop shutting herself up in her room, the world keeps on turning. Sena Ajisai runs for the student council, Hitoe Hanatori joins the girls at the pool, and Satsuki writes a fan letter to her favorite author. It’s No Freaking Way, but this time, Renako’s sharing the spotlight! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shino to Ren: Future
description: Lovebirds Ren and Shino have left their school days behind and set out into the world of working adults. Independence is exciting, but living on their own and starting their careers come with a whirlwind of challenges. Ren is struggling to make time in her busy modeling schedule for her girlfriend. Shino is happy about Ren’s success, but she can’t help but notice all the admiring gazes Ren attracts. Then when they’re finally alone, Shino shies from physical intimacy! And to top it all off, Shino gets along with her coworkers and students so well that it’s stoking Ren’s jealousy. Do these high school sweethearts have what it takes to clear these hurdles and build a future together? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Deatte Hitotsuki de Zecchou Jorei!
title_original: 出会ってひと突きで絶頂除霊！
description: Climax Exorcism. It is the obscene ability that forces anyone, dead or alive, to climax when penetrated. And as a side effect, it also causes evil spirits and monsters to become purified and exorcised when they cum. Haruhisa Furuya, the boy who possesses this unholy ability, is one of the lowest-ranking students at the Exorcist Academy. After all, if he uses his ability, it would destroy his social standing (among other things)... But then Haruhisa meets someone, a girl named Misaki Souya, a girl with an evil eye capable of exposing people's secrets. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)

title: Senketsu Oujo, Mina Korosu
description: Mary is a princess who lacks the ability to use magic. Her arranged political marriage was set in stone, and she hoped to finally serve a purpose as a member of the royal family. However, during the engagement party, her engagement was abruptly broken off, and she was falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to execution. Betrayed by her own parents and brother, Mary manages to escape with her only ally, her older sister. Their attempt to flee is thwarted, and both Mary and her sister are killed by the most powerful mage known as the arcanist. But on the brink of death, Mary’s powers awaken. She possesses the arcana of the Death God, allowing her to devour corpses and augment her strength. With this newfound ability, Mary becomes determined to exact revenge on all those responsible for her sister’s death.

title: Himitsu: Kuro no Chikai
description: Rin, a young angel (presumed female, but angels don’t have clear genders) falls in love with a young human girl, Miku. However, their love is considered taboo, and so, Rin makes a deal with the devil to be reborn as the human boy, Len, in order to be with Miku. However, their happiness together is short-lived, and even that soon ends in tragedy.

title: Hataraku Watashi to Kanojo no Dousei
description: Mari is known as a "cold woman" who doesn't like to get involved with otherpeople. One day, Mari, who worked at a flower shop, was asked to take care of Sumirei, a high school girl who has lost her mother and has nowhere else to go due to her circumstances. Mari felt compelled to take her in. But Sumirei, who was still depressed with a broken heart, wasn't ready to talk, and they began to live together awkwardly. But over time, Mari got glimpses of Sumirei's family environment and school life. And as they spent time together, Sumirei gradually opened up to her. The more she learned about Sumirei's innocent lifestyle, the more Mari realized the weaknesses of her own emotional state. (Source: Fujimi L Bunko, translated)

title: Kenshi wo Mezashite Nyuugaku Shita noni Mahou Tekisei 9999 Nan desu kedo!?
title_original: 剣士を目指して入学したのに魔法適性9999なんですけど！？
description: Laura who had received special education to be a swordsman from her A-Rank adventurer father since a young age, enters the Royal Capital's Adventurer's school at the age of 9. Laura filled with expectation in her heart in hopes to make many swordsman friends. At the day of the entrance ceremony, Laura's sword aptitude value was measured at 107. Between normal students whose aptitude value is around 50-60, Laura was definitely a sword genius, but the magic aptitude that was measured after that was 9999. Laura was stunned, and while she didn't know what was even happening she was transferred to the Magic Department. Contrary to Laura's will, she exerts her super-genius, and instantly becomes stronger than anyone in the school.

title: Ashita no Sekai de Hoshi wa Kirameku
title_original: 明日の世界で星は煌めく
description: In a “ruined world” begins the adventures of two girls. A girl, who because of some special circumstances, was branded a “witch”, Yuki Minato. Even now that she’s in high school, her dark days are still not over. But on the second day of school, the world ended. The streets are now filled with lifeless beings, moving corpses, as humanity’s end approaches. A month later, Yuki managed to survive with a familiar and “magic” left by her missing father. One day, to replenish supplies, she went into the streets filled with moving corpses. On her way back, she heard a gunshot. Even though right now there’s no one in town that’s worth saving, in the past there was a kind girl she was close to. Remembering that girl, Minato decides to help the owner of the gun shot. When she arrives, in front of her was that girl, Honoka Sakaki. For Honoka’s goal, the two decided to work together, but… (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yuri Kuma Arashi
description: Kureha Tsubaki is a shy second-year student at Arashigaoka Academy whose life takes a turn for the weird after she meets transfer student Ginko Yurishiro, who begins showing up in her dreams as a bear princess. Kureha becomes friends with Ginko only to discover that she is wrapped up in her own world and believes everything is made up of bears. When Kureha begins having feelings for Ginko, she decides to help her get to the bottom of her delusions. But are they really just delusions or something more…? (Source: Otakumode)

title: Kare nanka Yori, Watashi no Hou ga Ii Desho?
title_original: 彼なんかより、私のほうがいいでしょ？
description: That girl has a man she likes. I have to make it mine before I confess! "I think I have a favorite person ..." To that word, Kano Mizusawa's soul set out on a journey for a moment. Horimiya Oto is her childhood friend. She is attractive for her loose semi-long hair, has excellent grades except for exercise, is homely and attentive, and she has said that she has a man she likes. Even though we are girls, before I knew it, she was more than a close friend. Even so ... But even if the mind is impossible, if it is the body ...!" (!?) Thus, Kano's unreasonable and slightly radical [Sound capture strategy] begins! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kono Nukumori wo Kimi to Yobunda
title_original: このぬくもりを君と呼ぶんだ

title: Afternoon Tea wa Ikaga desu ka?: Watashi to Senpai no Fujun de Ichizu na Futarigurashi
title_original: アフタヌーンティーはいかがですか？ 私と先輩の、不純で一途なふたり暮らし

title: FLOWERS: Le volume sur printemps
title_original: FLOWERS ―Le volume sur printemps- フラワーズ〈春篇〉
description: Suoh: "Is it wrong if I fall in love with a girl?" Surrounded by immense walls in the middle of a forest, lies the prestigious all-girls school, Saint Angraecum Academy. It's a school that prides itself on growing bright and cultured young women. The school's Amitié program is designed to help foster new friendships that will last a lifetime. This is why Suoh Shirahane, a painfully shy girl with a mysterious past, has enrolled. As her first year of high school begins, she is filled with hopes of a new life. Follow her as she navigates her new friendships and attempts to unravel the many mysteries at the academy, including occult rituals and the mysterious disappearance of fellow students, all while trying to pass her classes. As spring warms into summer, so does Suoh's friendships until they too blossom into a love that is something more. More importantly, who will she choose?

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
title_original: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる
description: Shurine is a girl who has mastered the sword, having been raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, she is falsely accused of assassinating the person she is guarding and forced to goes on the run. Driven from her home, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger after being caught up in a battle over royal succession. As Lutecia is being attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes her an offer, "I'm a bit short on money. If you need a bodyguard, I'm available right now." Their encounter will determine the fate of the kingdom! A girls-love swordplay battle fantasy begins! Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) SS-shuu
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ！（※ムリじゃなかった!?） SS集
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll Be Your Lover! Unless… More Stories to Love!
description: After a traumatic middle school life where she spent most of her time in her room playing video games, Amaori Renako set out to become the ideal version of herself in high school. Now, she’s a member of a group of popular girls called the Quintet, dating the most beautiful girl in school, and living the high school dream! Now her daily life is so exciting that you could even fill a book with all the stuff she and her friends got up to in between the drama and romance! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gokumon Nadeshiko Koko ni Ari
description: The Gokumon clan - a bloodline from hell. Living in their mysterious stronghold in the ancient capital of Kyoto, they command fear not only from those who wield magic, but also monsters and demons. Nadeshiko Gokumon is the monster-devouring heiress of this wicked family. She is the most beautiful, and the most abominable, girl who comes straight from the flames of hell. However...... "Nadeshiko, I see you are as lovely as your name." The encounter with the most strange, disturbing, and beautiful woman, Amana Ichijiku, who laughs in her face without fear, changes Nadeshiko. Something lurks in the flower ceiling. A human sacrifice packed in a box. A curse that threaten the school. A deceitful beast. A shapeless monster. As the two confront one supernatural challenge after another, they eventually come face to face with the very thing they have been turning away from. "If it weren't for you, I would still be an ogre." A woman with a human soul in an ogre's body and a girl with a monstrous soul in a human body. The connection between the two is a story that will be sealed with blood. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated) Note: Winner of the Grand Prize in the 17th Shogakukan Light Novel A

title: Sugu Kenka Suru Tokai Gyaru to Kyou-bijin wo Nakanaori Sasetai Dake na no ni! (※Watashi wo Toriau no wa Yamenasai!)
title_original: すぐケンカする都会ギャルと京美人を仲直りさせたいだけなのに! (※わたしを取り合うのはやめなさい!)
description: I'm sandwiched between a charismatic city gal and a pure and lovely Kyoto beauty... don't squish me! I, Kurimoto Tsubame, moved to Tokyo from the countryside and now, for some reason, I'm being pressed tightly between two beautiful girls. How did it end up like this...? I just want to make up the bitter rivalry between Seira-chan and Orine-san...! (Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title: Girls Kingdom
description: All Misaki wanted was a free education. Instead, she accidentally lands an exclusive contract with the most prestigious girl in school... to serve as her personal maid! Misaki soon discovers that Amanotsuka Academy for Girls is no ordinary school—her classes are all about how to be a maid, too! Students who impress the school’s elite young ladies with their domestic service skills might be lucky enough to become a “Seraph,” guaranteeing them a job with an upper-class household after they graduate. But Misaki doesn’t want to be a maid; she just wants to study hard, go to college, and work for a good company. So why did Himeko make her into her Seraph out of nowhere? What kind of rich girl hires a maid who wants nothing to do with the job?! If she wants to get through high school, Misaki has a lot to get used to! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: TS Tensei Bishoujo Netora Reiko wa Netoraretai
title_original: TS転生美少女 音虎玲子は寝取られたい

title: Mikake wa Chou-seiso na Haraguro Joshi ni mo Asobareru Hanashi
title_original: 見かけは超清楚な腹黒女子にもてあそばれる話

title: Tensei Nanajo de Hajimeru Isekai Life
title_original: 転生七女ではじめる異世界ライフ
description: A high school girl, Kanami Miria, reincarnated as the seventh daughter of an aristocrat. Since she had lived a miserable life, she dreamed of living peacefully in her second life. However, she reincarnated in a super-poor aristocratic family in the countryside. In order to achieve her goal to leave the house and live a peaceful life, she practiced magic and secretly went to the Royal Girls Academy. But, thanks to her omnipotent magical power, her evaluation became ridiculous. The easygoing Miria decided to ignore all invitations and aim for a relaxing life with her omnipotent magical power.

title: Deretai Kanojo no Ura Omote
description: Shinonome Hyouka and Mashima Iori used to be childhood friends, but Hyouka's attitude changed drastically some time during junior high. The sweetheart Hyouka started treating Iori coldly whenever they met. However, when another childhood friend, Ameya Hikari, starts to make moves on Iori, Hyouka's attitude towards Iori also begins to waver... (Source: GC Novels, translated)

title: Osananajimi wa, Nyaa to Naite Skirt no Naka
title_original: 幼馴染は、にゃあと鳴いてスカートのなか
description: When I saw “Maki Saihara” listed in the roster of my new class, the weight of that name made me feel as if I can't move at all. Maki is a dear childhood friend, but we haven't spoken in over a year. (How did I talk to Maki......?) The distance between me and my childhood friend seems very far, even though she is sitting right next to me in the same classroom. Until one day, when Maki suddenly comes over to my house. "Ichika, I want to show you something." Something suddenly pops out of her head. Cat ears! In no time at all, the distance that had separated us disappears. Now Maki, whose personality has become like that of a cat as well, comes and lies down next to me, rubs herself against me, and spoils me with just the two of us in this carefree time. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nekonoyama Neneko wa Nekoninaru
title_original: 猫ノ山寧々子はネコになる
description: Nekonoyama Neneko is a demi-human high school girl who can turn into a cat. Trying to hide her true identity from the world, she is shy around other people except for her family. The only outsider she trusts is her older sister’s friend, Mashiro. Neneko can't help but be drawn to the cool and mysterious Mashiro. One day, Neneko discovers that Mashiro is a vampire, and she proposes living together as her blood donor (partner). This is a romance between girls clumsy at love. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Death Loop Reijou wa Ikinokoru Tame ni Ryoute wo Chi ni Someru You desu
title_original: デスループ令嬢は生き残る為に両手を血に染めるようです
description: "Until the demon lurking among the participants is slain, this game shall not end." Lady Hermina, the daughter of the Count Einhorn, finds herself entangled in a deadly game called the "Summoning Ritual of a Wicked God" within an ancient northern castle, alongside her childhood friend and maid, Charlotte. Among the eight participants at the castle, two are designated as "demons," tasked with murdering one person each night. Those who are not demons must execute a suspicious individual through daily voting, participants are unable to leave the castle until all demons are annihilated. In this game where death looms, Hermina must use all of her wits to survive, while trying to protect Charlotte, but...!? (Source: Lanove, translated)

title: 17-sai to, 18-ijou: Kouhai Gyaru wa Watashi to xx wo Shiritairashii
title_original: 17歳と、18以上 ～後輩ギャルは私と××を知りたいらしい～

title: Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban
description: "Witches lurk among these girls." It was supposed to be Ema's first day of high school. But instead of waking up in her bed, she found herself in a dark prison cell. She found herself suddenly trapped in an island prison, isolated in some unknown, distant sea. In her confusion, an owl informed Ema of her new situation: "You have been identified as a potential witch — a threat to the world. Thus, you will live here as a prisoner for the rest of your life." The life Ema had taken for granted had suddenly collapsed. As she began her new life as a prisoner, Ema got to know the other girls in her situation. Her fellow witch candidates. However, one day, the owl gathered the prisoners for a shocking announcement: "We will be holding a witch trial." One by one, the girls would have to single out a witch among the thirteen of them... In other words, they would have to vote out the next candidate to be executed. It was the beginning of a cruel game indeed... (Source: Steam)

title: Yuutousei ga Adult Goods wo Kai ni Kita
title_original: 優等生がアダルトグッズを買いに来た
description: Aya Mizuki, a high school girl working part-time at a used bookstore that also sells adult goods, runs into Yuuki Kayano, a top student from her class, at work one day. Yuuki, who is highly respected at school, was actually carefully looking for items for items for “stress relief.” “Please just keep this a secret from the school and my parents…” Their relationship based on a shared little secret began with this unexpected encounter. Yuuki gradually finds herself drawn to Aya, who is cool yet kindhearted and listens to her worries without judging her. Even when she’s “doing it” alone, she can’t help but think of Aya. Just then, a rumor starts spreading that Aya and Yuuki are dating…? (Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Shoujo no Nozomanu Eiyuu-tan
description: "Which is the real you!?" Likes: Cooking, eating, and being pampered. Specialty: Murder. Krische Alberinea Christand, a general of the Alberan Kingdom, is the greatest genius in both military and magical history. She is the prodigy who single-handedly brought an end to the era of swords and heroes through numerous magical revolutions. Though widely feared as a cold-blooded and unparalleled slaughterer, the reality of her character is quite different. She is actually a slightly gluttonous, affectionately spoiled girl who cheerfully asks, "Ehehe, what's for dinner today?" This somewhat airheaded and eccentric girl has but one simple wish: to spend peaceful days with the people she holds dear. Nothing more. However, as if to mock those desires, a cruel fate forces a sword into the hands of a 12-year-old village girl, dragging her onto a battlefield ruled by death and violence. An unprecedented, common-sense-defying ultimate heroine makes her appearance! She offers an angel's smile to those she loves, and a single, fatal flash of the blade to those who oppose her. Follow the kingdom's strongest god of war as she traces the guideposts to happiness in this "girls' memento mori."

title: Kao dake Ii Classmate ga, Yatara to Guigui Kuru Yuri no Hanashi.
title_original: 顔だけ良いクラスメイトが、やたらとグイグイ来る百合の話。

title: Enman Katei no Hitozuma ga Musume no Tomodachi ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
title_original: 円満家庭の人妻が娘の友達にドはまりする話
description: Yuki Amamiya is a highly regarded designer with a stable life. She has a good relationship with her husband and daughter, and they have a dog together. It’s a harmonious, picture-perfect family. She never harbored a single doubt about her family and believed this life would smoothly go on forever. …Until that day, when she met Kai. She was her daughter’s classmate — childlike in appearance, yet with words, actions, and a gaze that challenged even adults. She's inspired by retro anime catgirls and has a personality that is meant to be easily approachable. Doesn't really understand sex or sex appeal, but finds it to be an interesting part of the human experience. She thinks about it more than the average robot because of all of the pornography in Aiyana's house. Would like to travel with Aiyana and help her more out in the world. characters.description: Tarot: The Hermit Music Genre: Vocaloid, EDM, Maidcore Likes: Doujinshi, erotica, being taken care of Dislikes: Public arguments, structured jobs, psychology students Aiyana dislikes socializing because her lack of understanding of societal structures always causes her to experience humiliation, distress, or participate in relationships that leave her with negative feelings. She sorts out her thoughts methodically, trying to write most of them down. She encourages others to do the same. She communicated with her mother through notes often. Dislikes when someone assumes how she's feeling. Experiences alexithymia. Really likes Adelaide post college because she is such an empathetic and blunt person. Same with Eva. [From in-game profile]

characters.description: Tarot: The Hierophant Music Genre: Angry female hip hop, orchestral movie tracks Likes: Cake, cute house decor, small animals Dislikes: Pop up visits, surprise parties, insecure people Adelaide experiences a lot of insecurity but is very good at hiding it. She's especially insecure about how intensely she feels her emotions. This leads to her avoiding getting close to others. Gets overwhelmed fairly easily but this is because she has an emotionally exhausting job and social mask. Tends to be irritable around friends because she is so tired. Gets worked up fairly easily and will engage in fights if pushed, though it is much harder to provoke her now that she is older. She fought with people who spoke poorly of Aiyana in high school. [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Calliope

She feels bad taking credit for this as she was inspired by work of past programmers. She's a very sweet person, but she also says a lot of bizarre things that make people uncomfortable. Calliope can be rather flippant and doesn't have a strong moral compass. In college, she ran around with a lot of other lolita trans girls. She dragged Adelaide into her friend group. title: The Difference Between Us
description: The Difference Between Us is a My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic fan game about Fluttershy on her first date with Pinkie Pie. Fluttershy never knew that Pinkie felt that way about her, and she struggles to figure out what she wants and how she feels about Pinkie as she finds her way through the date. There are three main routes through the date, and each route has three endings, all with several different variations depending on your prior choices. There's a little drama along the way, but there are no bad endings, just different ways of exploring a new relationship and the new feelings that come with it. All of the mane six as well as the cutie mark crusaders make appearances to offer advice, hang out, or even put on a show. And all along the way, Fluttershy and Pinkie Pie will tell stories, share secrets, heal old wounds, and, hopefully, grow a little closer. [From [url=https://robindaydream.itch.io/the-difference-between-us]itch.io[/url]]

title: Shimaisou -II-
description: "True love doesn't perish." Houmoku Chikaku's suicide – the year has passed and by January the third semester has begun. Kagome Seishin Girls Academy is shook by a particular event: The election of the new student council administration team is imminent. First year student of the Bird Class, Mashiro Hii, is lending a friend, Suoh Tamaki, her supportive hand during the election process. One day, Hii meets a girl called Tsubaki Tsukumo, the supposed sister of the former student council's vice president Tsubaki Shijuuku who has now disappeared. In order to seek out the truth, Hii confronts the residing student council president, Rindou Tsui, with the question whether she's the murderer of Houmuku Tooku, the twin sister of the late suicide victim Houmoku Chikaku. Tsui is ready to let her in on the truth if a certain condition is fulfilled – they agree on a bet. A bet about which candidate will succeed in becoming the next student council president. Hii reluctantly accepts. "Should I win this bet, I want you to fall in love with me." [Translated with anecdotal information added from the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ240372.html]DLSite[/url]]

title: By Your Side
description: A story of the mundane, set within a fantastical version of '60s Britain. In a world full of industry, magic, and adventure, the unnamed protagonist decides to settle down. She has, together with her girlfriend, saved up enough money to afford an apartment. The two move in together and the game begins. You, as the protagonist, play through a daily routine of interacting with the Heroine. As the days pass you will unlock new options, new outfits, new scenes, and plenty of backstory.

characters.name: The Protagonist
characters.description: A photographer who once showed no interest in humans. Her life changed when a stranger entered the frame. Pushed along by the Fairy, she stumbled into a romance with the Heroine. Though she may be quiet—and she may seem cynical at times—she truly loves life and all the beauty it brings.

characters.name: The Heroine
characters.description: An upbeat herbalist with a bouncy personality. She pulled the protagonist into many fun activities, and the two eventually fell in love. She hopes to one day save enough money to buy a house, and maybe even marry her beloved. Although she lives as the embodiment of love, at times she seems to harbour a deep hatred for the world.

characters.name: Euon
characters.description: Saved by the Protagonist’s good will, Euon the Fairy promised to one day repay the favour. This repayment came when the Protagonist met the Heroine. A very long time ago Fairies flooded the forests, using the roots and leaves of trees to communicate with one another. However over the years they—like many of the Earth's creatures—dramatically declined in numbers. They are considered an endangered species and are a very rare sight.

title: Eldritch University
description: Kasumi Kawamura just wants to get through university while rekindling her relationship with her girlfriend. But not long after she arrives at school, a strange epidemic starts to infect the city, causing the afflicted to have terrible nightmares and lose the motivation to live their lives. Coinciding with the appearance of this "Nightmare Syndrome", an old wound that Kasumi thought healed starts to burn and cause frightening visions to those around her. Caught in the center of this situation, Kasumi and her friends try desperately to find a solution. Yet all the while, Kasumi wonders if she might be to blame... [From [url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/eldritch-university]itch.io[/url]]

characters.name: Kasumi Kawamura
characters.description: Eldritch Academy: Yue’s classmate. Kasumi prefers spending time with her friends to studying, and she has a reputation for being an airhead. She spends a lot of time with Yue, to the latter's annoyance. [From itch.io] Eldritch University: The protagonist and main viewpoint character. Kasumi spent much of high school being regarded as an airhead, which has led her to try to act more mature... with limited results. She tends to be friendly and outgoing, making friends easily. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Misaki Asahara
characters.description: Eldritch Academy: A second-year at Solana Academy. Misaki has known Kasumi for years, and they have recently begun dating. She is outgoing and friendly, always looking for new friends. [From itch.io] Eldritch University: Kasumi's girlfriend. They were forced to break up years ago when her mother discovered the relationship, and the events that followed have changed Misaki's outlook on life. While she was once extroverted, she now keeps to herself; with only Kasumi and a few close friends to keep her company. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Shizuka Hirose
characters.description: A young woman who had once trained to be a police detective. Many are turned away by her imposing demeanor and strict sense of what is right. However, she is utterly determined to protect others from the supernatural, having seen the danger of such threats. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Yuri Tachibana
characters.description: A young woman who is fascinated by the supernatural. As a friend of Shizuka, she seems to be the polar opposite: she is often cheerful and approachable. However, she is prone to becoming obsessed and rambling on about what she is interested in. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Hinata Watanabe
characters.description: A girl in some of Kasumi's classes that has a mischievous sense of humor. She looks younger than her age, to the surprise of many. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Hiroshi Suzuki
characters.description: A boy in some of Kasumi's classes. He's a bit of a goofball and doesn't take much seriously, though he is easily flustered. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Minoru Kiyomizu
characters.description: One of Misaki's professors. While he seems to do well at his job, he is seen as rather laid-back compared to some teachers. [From itch.io]

title: Rising Angels: Judgment
description: Coming back into port, the crew of the Nimross face an upcoming trial for their actions. Their defense is lead by Defense Sergeant Náme Puccile, Natalie's younger sister and a former SITO who left on bad terms with her team. The crew is slowly settling back into their normal lives in port, coping with the burdens that they now carry with them from their life-or-death missions. An uncertain future awaits the crew as they try to seek out that normality... But pieces of a mystery that has haunted the crew are already coming alive and it is up to both the crew of the Nimross and their new defense team to fight back before everything they've fought for is wiped away! [From [url=https://idhas.itch.io/rising-angels-judgment]itch.io[/url]]

characters.name: Natalie Puccile
characters.description: The protagonist. A brilliant mind who always excelled at schooling, Natalie won numerous awards growing up for academic excellence. When she graduated, Natalie immediately joined the space force to work as a Special Investigations and Tactics officer. During training, she rapidly overtook her peers. However, few people wanted to associate with her due to her brazen nature and elitism. After a whistleblowing incident, Natalie was assigned to manage an outpost in the middle of nowhere with only a couple of robots. Nevertheless, Natalie worked hard and was finally award a chance to prove herself to command.

characters.name: Zuri
characters.description: The security officer of the KSS Nimross. In high school, Zuri was a track star, admired galaxy-wide for her speed. When she graduated, she accepted a commission to the academy to become a security officer. Spunky and determined, Zuri’s fearless and optimistic nature serves as a rallying point to those around her. While she questions herself, there is nothing more important to her than striving to be a true warrior and protect her friends.

characters.name: Sol Hackett
characters.description: A fighter pilot who has spent the last couple years fighting in the war. After losing the love of his life to a non-human, Sol’s bitter hatred for non-humans has only amplified. While fighting in the war, Sol’s constant loss of loved ones and friends has led him to become pessimistic and depressed. Tough on his fellow pilots, Sol knows it is only a matter of time before they leave him as well.

title: Warm
description: Megumi Shimizu's life is routine and monotonous. Get up, go to school early, fulfill her duties as class leader, try to deal with Inoue, and go home and do it all again tomorrow. She has no friends, her life doesn't seem like it'll go anywhere...and she's fine with that. She's used to it, just like she's used to the cold, numbing winters in her hometown of Ikigai. Then one day, a new transfer arrives. A new transfer who is instantly liked by her classmates and teacher, who is everything Megumi is not. Bubbly, sweet, happy, social. And for some reason, this new girl, Hinata Mikami, thinks Megumi is nice and wants to be friends. And Megumi is stunned to find she likes Hinata too... [From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/warm]Itch.io[/url]]

title: She Already Has Someone She Likes?!
description: “Every man has his secret sorrows which the world knows not; and oftentimes we call a man cold when he is only sad.” Kawamura Shizuka is the type of girl who lies awake at 2 in the morning thinking about that time in 3rd grade she accidentally called her teacher 'mom'. In stark contrast, Ishihara Mai is almost too sure of herself, exuding boundless confidence even when it's clear she's in the wrong. Despite the night-and-day difference in their worldviews, these two have somehow managed to become the best of friends, something that Shizuka is (begrudgingly) okay with... Until she finds out that the girl who she's always thought of out-of-her-league has a crush...on who, exactly? (seriously, would it kill her to be a little less vague?!) Like, obviously, she was never planning on confessing in the first place!!! But now...it's almost like Mai's forcing her hand! [From [url=https://studiochuunibyou.itch.io/she-already-has-someone-she-likes]itch.io[/url]]

title: GOOD LUCK BABY!
description: Having a stroke of bad luck [i]sucks[/i]. Having a few [i]weeks[/i] of bad luck is even worse. That's something Hifumi Tanaka unfortunately learns first-hand. Stubbing her toe one too many times, losing her wallet on the train to the city, getting to school two hours late... this unrelenting streak of misfortune makes her cry out in frustration to the universe. “Can't something [i]good[/i] happen for once?!” Hifumi's luck begins to turn around upon meeting the famous delinquent Kasumi Itou. Even though she's known at school for being trouble, the reality is that Kasumi is a funny, level-headed girl with a heart of gold. Just as their mutual crushes on each other begin to bloom, they are met with one heck of a surprise... [b]A baby with a halo sitting happily on Kasumi's doorstep![/b] Meeting this baby changes not [i]just[/i] the lives and luck of our girls, but the entire world - and [i]maybe[/i] even the galaxy - as we know it. Can they evade the looming shadow of a mysterious villain known only as "Empress Metis" long enough to get this baby back home? [From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

full_description: With no memories and no sense of self, you are brought to a witch’s house deep in the forest. To regain your life, you must break into the house, complete a task... and survive whatever you may find in there. [From Itch.io]

title: Cherrywitched!
description: In Cherrywitched! You play as a witch detective for the Council of Witches who’s been struggling with a recent series of missing person cases. One day, you decide to take a break from work to visit your favorite cafe: Cherry Pie’s Cafe! This game takes place in the same universe as my first visual novel Berrywitched! So if you haven't played that game, please consider checking it out. [From [url=https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/cherrywitched]Itch.io[/url]]

characters.name: Inquiry
characters.description: A detective witch, currently investigating a series of missing person cases. Frustrated by her lack of progress, she visits a cafe owned by her old friend, Cherry Pie. [spoiler]Eventually becomes the adoptive mother of Strawberry after her older sister Cherry Pie is arrested.

characters.name: Cherry Pie
characters.description: A cherry witch who runs a cafe. Has been friends with Inquiry for a long time, though as time passes, it becomes apparent that she's more connected to Inquiry's current case than she lets on. [spoiler]As it turns out, she's been kidnapping witches in order to harvest their nuclei (the organ from which a witch's magic stems), baking them into pies that would then be served to members of the Everlasting to prolong their lifespans. Eating one too many nuclei herself has caused her behavior to become erratic, leading her to drug and kidnap her crush Inquiry to force her to love her back.

characters.name: Strawberry
characters.description: Cherry Pie's younger sister. Inquiry first encounters her after she ends up locked in the oven. [spoiler]She eventually gets adopted by Inquiry after her older sister gets arrested.

title: Teen Zombie in Your Cabin
description: Three years have passed since the zombie uprising. You managed to escape the chaos and survive in an isolated cabin in the woods, all alone, for better and for worse. Until, one day, you come across a young zombie who doesn't seem entirely lost. You decide to temporarily make room for her, attend to her needs, try to educate and humanize her, and, perhaps, seek a future together. Decide how to take care of the situation. Teach her to talk properly, to play, to brush her teeth or to know her body, while you discover that you have a lot to learn too. Keep your cabin warm and well stocked, and above all, don't even run out of fresh meat.​ [From [url=https://pent-panda.itch.io/teen-zombie-in-your-cabin]Itch.io[/url]]

title_original: 百合の館物語 ～姫君の花弁とメイドの蕾～
description: An old mansion stands quietly deep in the woods. While taking a trip Fumio becomes lost, and solicits help from this mansion. Appearing before Fumio is the beautiful head of the household, Reina, and her servant Batra. Fumio is welcomed in curteously, but that night she happens to witness Reina and Batra together in bed. Seeing two women make love for the first time sparks a fiery desire in Fumio. Fumio becomes captivated with Reina's enchanting beauty and completely entrusts her body to her. And then from that day things started at the mansion was more days. As if guided by a mysterious fate, Fumio goes on to being swallowed up by the two women's secret whirpool. [From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE049670.html]English DLSite[/url]]

title_original: 百合の花幻想奇譚～永久の愛を君に誓う～
description: One summer day, in gentle rain... Yuuna Hibiki saw two girls kiss lips tenderly. One young girl with green hair, Mai Himeno. Yuuna's rival. The other, Chisa Hayase. Yuuna's true love. To see her heart's desire kissing another... That scene shocked Yuuna. But she was powerless to change it. Because she is not a being of this world. Yuuna is an ethereal spirit left behind to exist in Earth, seeing Chisa longingly and wanting to be thought of by her. But, that remains a distant prayer. It is in this state that Iori Senzaki discovers Yuuna. She is an academic and an eccentric, and can see such things. Together they will find a way to achieve Yuuna's dream... [From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063227.html]DLsite English[/url]]

description: I thought it was love at first sight. When you smiled, my heart pounded and my cheeks turned hot. I won't ever, ever forget that... Today, I got to see you. Today, I got to talk to you. Today, today, today, today... With these little things piling up, I'm getting to know you. The princess diva of Convallaria sang of love again today. I love you, and these feelings won't change, but little by little, bit by bit, something is changing. I thought it was love at first sight. Beautifully and tenderly, longing for my senpai. That's what I thought. As the days have gone by, this feeling has gradually grown, and I've finally begun to notice it... title: Baked:Magic
description: The story of a bakery, two witches, a knight, and some muffins. BAKED:MAGIC is a light-hearted story about Lana, a witch that owns a bakery. She recently took on an apprentice that is eager to learn how to bake delicious muffins using magic. They are frequented by their 'number 1 customer' who is a royal knight. Learn how Lana deals with love, life, rejection, and acceptance. Play through the four days of her life ending with a single big event. [From [url=https://red-baby.itch.io/bakedmagic] itch.io[/url]]

characters.name: Lana Oleyn
characters.description: A renowned witch that owns a bakery in Parinea. She earned the respect and admiration of the locals by protecting her homeland against slime monsters during the war. Lana enjoys drinking all kinds of herbal teas and eating savoury muffins. She has a calm demeanour and a dry sense of humour. [From official website]

characters.name: Elliot Ardia
characters.description: A young woman who recently discovered her witchling abilities. She was one of Lana's first customers when the bakery opened up and is Lana's self-proclaimed biggest fan. She enjoys eating sweets, talking about town gossip and cracking the odd joke here and there. She can be forgetful at times and is a bit of a clutz. [From official website]

characters.name: Jayne Do
characters.description: A royal knight that frequents Lana's bakery to buy the same thing every morning. She is of elven descent and considers Lana to be a good friend from their time together in the war. She enjoys calming aromas that help her relax. She is a bit of a worrywart and takes her job very seriously. [From official website]

title: Crown & Cauldron
description: Zerlinda was a child when she escaped the witch trials that robbed her of her mother. She has lived as a recluse ever since, enjoying her garden and the company of her familiar. When an intruder manages to breach the barriers around her woods, Zerlinda realizes just how deep her scars run and how fragile her inner peace is. Also, the intruder is a princess. A strong-willed princess who refuses to be married off and wants to live just like Zerlinda does: freely.

characters.name: Zerlinda
characters.description: Zerlinda embraces being a witch of the wilds, and enjoys delicacies like moss infusions and pickled flower bulbs. She has a soft spot for owlets—her familiar regularly uses this fact to his advantage.

characters.name: Eugenie Priscilla Raisa
characters.description: Eugenie Priscilla Raisa is the eleventh in line for the throne, but she thinks of her royal blood as an inconvenience. Her days in the palace were spent listening to wandering bards and minstrels while avoiding the etiquette intructor.

characters.name: Spoon
characters.description: Spoon has been Zerlinda's familiar for decades. He uses a glamour to make himself look like a tiny round owlet; his cute appearance lets him get away with almost anything.

title: Life Can Be Amazing
description: Renowned and award-winning chef, Paula Scott is having a bad week. Her world-famous London bistro has just received scathing reviews for her new menu and on top of that, her girlfriend of three years has just left her. Adamant to cheer her up and get her cooking again, her best friend and business partner Katrina reaches out to Crazy Carrie, their fun-loving but very irresponsible friend from university, to see what they can do for Paula. Naturally, a night of mad drinking ensues leading them to inadvisably fly to the Caribbean with just the shirts on their backs. Deciding to stay on in search of inspiration and healing from the wounds of broken hearts, the three ladies choose to spend a long weekend in the idyllic islands. Will Paula rediscover her love for cuisine? Will she learn to relax and go with the flow of life? Will she find love along the way? Only you can find out by playing “Life Can Be Amazing”. [From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697780/Life_Can_Be_Amazing/]Steam[/url]]

title: Marissa Is Now Idle
description: You are Annalise Baker, known in the MMO WarCore as Peony Everglim. You've played this game for years, made friends that came and went. In one hour, WarCore will go offline for good. It's time to say goodbye. Marissa Is Now Idle is a visual novel made for the Dying MMO Jam, that takes place on a computer in 2003. After logging in, you find your internet friend Marissa sitting next to you and have one last conversation. description: The year is 2013, and Homura Asano is trying to get by as a second year at the prestigious Ainami Academy. Up until the beginning of the second semester, she hasn't had much in the way of friends, hasn't participated in any clubs, and has never had a girlfriend. Most of all, she has a strong premonition that she will not live to see her third year. Is it possible to change the course of her life and avert this fate?

characters.name: Asano Homura
characters.description: A 16 year old second year student who spends most of her time alone, playing video games or studying the occult. The few that do know of her either think of her as the weird girl who sleeps in class, or the younger sister of the more notable Azami Asano, albeit lacking in the same social graces.

characters.name: Sivagnanam Anisha
characters.description: A 16 year old second year student who takes academic life very seriously, to the disdain of her peers. Her high standards prevent her from allowing others to get by on mediocrity, and drive her to speak her mind whenever she feels so inclined. She seems frustrated with Homura's lack of ambition and lethargic approach to life at such a high-class school.

characters.name: Asano Azami
characters.description: A 17 year old third year student, popular with the student body for her charm, elegance, and intellect. When not leading the mock trial club, she spends her time helping fellow students and looking after her younger sister. Although her responsibilities have distanced her from her sister in their personal life, she seems to wish to be a part of her life while she still has the chance.

characters.name: Morikawa Mitsuru
characters.description: A young woman who teaches Physics at Ainami, and acts as Homura's homeroom teacher for her second year. Though she's only just started teaching this year, she's already made friends with her coworkers, and is generally well-received by students. She wants the best for her students, and has chosen to pay special attention to Homura's development as a student by tutoring her in piano on weekends.

characters.name: Snake
characters.description: A 17 year old third year whose presence at the school baffles most, considering its prestige and exclusivity. She often skips class, flagrantly breaks school rules, rarely listens to authority, and has garnered a reputation that makes most fear to cross her path. She seems not to care about anyone at the school whatsoever.

characters.name: Goshima Yui
characters.description: A 16 year old second year student with a passion for martial arts and fighting games. As Homura's childhood friend, she is the only person Homura hangs out with at school, though they haven't spent much time together outside of that in some time since they began at Ainami. She seems to wish to rekindle the closer bond they once had in middle school.

characters.name: Sanada Hitomi
characters.description: A second year student at Ainami in class 2B, and the student council treasurer. A kind, albeit shy girl, who seems to be at Anisha's beck and call.

characters.name: Aioi Yoko
characters.description: Art teacher at Ainami Academy. Spends more time talking about her love life than art.

characters.name: Akakura Aiko
characters.description: Second year student at Ainami Academy, Class 2B. Head of Ainami photography club. Fan of German Expressionism.

characters.name: Akazome Jotaro
characters.description: Yui's brother, Roopa's husband, father to Jyotsna and Maya, and nephew to Josuke and Akihiro.

characters.name: Akazome Jyotsna
characters.description: Daughter to Jotaro and Roopa, niece to Anisha and Yui.

characters.name: Akazome Roopa
characters.description: Anisha's sister, Jotaro's wife, and mother to Jyotsna and Maya.

characters.name: Asano Ayana
characters.description: Homura and Azami's mother, married to Yuichi.

characters.name: Asano Yuichi
characters.description: Homura and Azami's father, married to Ayana.

characters.name: Fukuda Ichirou
characters.description: History teacher at Ainami Academy.

characters.name: Fukuda Makoto
characters.description: First year student at at Ainami Academy, class 1D. Peppiest member of the volleyball team. Ichirou's cousin.

characters.name: Goshima Akihiro
characters.description: Music teacher at Ainami Academy. Yui's adoptive father. Married to Josuke.

characters.name: Goshima Josuke
characters.description: Headmaster at Ainami Academy. Yui's adoptive father and biological uncle to both her and Jotaro. Married to Akihiro.

characters.name: Hiek Mu
characters.description: Popular math teacher at Ainami Academy.

characters.name: Kaneda Mechasuka
characters.description: A popular third year student, class 3A. Known to throw good parties and takes great care in keeping in touch with all her friends.

characters.name: Lilith Kennedy
characters.description: English teacher at Ainami Academy. Came from America.

characters.name: Kenzaki Tsunade
characters.description: Second year student at Ainami Academy, class 2B. Part of photography club. Comes from a farming family.

characters.name: Kollontai Mayumi
characters.original: コロンタイ まゆみ
characters.description: Friend of Yamaguchi Kira. Biracial, Japanese and Russian. Likes to throw rocks at targets.

characters.name: Luna Mann
characters.description: First year student at Ainami Academy, class 1D. International student from America. Hopes to be astronaut one day.

characters.name: Mantis
characters.description: Bloodhound gang member. Loves to knit and crochet.

characters.name: Mitsurugi Tatsuya
characters.description: Detective with the Myoujoshima Police. Jotaro's childhood friend.

characters.name: Mizukoshi Shiori
characters.description: Second year student at Ainami Academy. Part of photography club. Hopes to go into fashion.

characters.name: Mizukoshi Souji
characters.description: Convenience store clerk. Third year at Kuromyoujo High School.

characters.name: Raven
characters.description: Second in command in the Bloodhound gang. Third year student at Kuromyoujo High School. Snake's oldest friend, and the most friendly of the group.

characters.name: Shimano Akinari
characters.description: CEO of Abaddon, the company which operates from the former location of Hinatsuboshi Academy.

characters.name: Shinazawa Chieko
characters.description: Second year student at Ainami Academy. Part of photography club. Hopes to be metallurgist one day.

characters.name: Tenjou Yuhi
characters.description: School nurse at Ainami Academy. Tends to students with a chronic health condition where necessary.

characters.name: Eva Veidt
characters.description: Second year student at Ainami Academy, class 2B. Part of photography club. Always wears a face mask. Half-German.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.description: Bloodhound gang member. Not very talkative.

characters.name: Yamaguchi Kira
characters.description: Niece to Yamaguchi Takeshi. Dreams of becoming a Bloodhound gang member. Aspiring kendoka.

characters.name: Yamaguchi Takeshi
characters.description: Leader of the KurenC gang. Enjoys drinking and mahjong.

In this countryside, Ainyang accidentally met a beautiful girl named Deng Kangsui. The two girls, who grew up in different environments, began to develop feelings after a chance meeting. Fleeting Summer's End is a short visual novel set in the remote countryside of Teoswa in the middle and late August. title: Eclipse: Special Forces
description: All men have been wiped from the Earth. It marks the dawn of a new world. Under the blessing of La, the one true god, women have peacefully ruled the world for over a millennium. Guarded by Eclipse, a special forces unit composed solely of women gifted with Supernatural Powers, peace seemed eternal—until now. With the sudden emergence of a mysterious cult called ‘Apep’, the world’s hidden truths begin to resurface. As Haesu, a dedicated member within Eclipse, you're drawn into a web of conspiracy, betrayal, and forgotten histories. Amidst growing chaos, will you guide Haesu to uncover the hidden truth?Every choice you make shapes not only Haesu’s destiny but the future of the world itself Can you face the truth—amid love, desire, and spilled blood? Your journey awaits. [From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280020/Eclipse__Special_Forces/]Steam[/url]]

characters.name: Haesu
characters.description: [i]“Mhm, alright. Let’s turn this place upside down.” Member of [i]Eclipse / Nullification of supernatural powers While Haesu believes she lacks a strong sense of justice, those around her see her differently. Her unwavering urge to help others has earned her the reputation of being a natural "meddler." While investigating the 'indiscriminate terror incident,' she gets closer to a shocking truth and finds herself at a crossroads…? [From Steam]

characters.name: Dallae
characters.description: [i]“I’d rather die than be on the losing end.” Member of [i]Eclipse / Illusion manipulation Haesu’s partner, who uncovered the hidden truth behind the indiscriminate terror incident, holds Haesu in special regard due to their unique bond that has lasted since childhood. However, toward others, she remains indifferent and often acts with cruelty. [From Steam]

characters.name: The Prophet
characters.description: The commander-in-chief of Eclipse [i]"My only choice is to sin to survive and lay bare my sins before our great Mother." As the only person capable of hearing the voice of [b]La, the creator of all things, she is revered and venerated as the [b]Spokesperson of the Sun God by all. [From Steam]

characters.name: Max
characters.description: "If you say another word, I'll shoot. A shot to your head, senior, would make for a spectacular firework." Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department Role: Operations Team 1 member Ability: Enhanced sense of smell Max is always on edge, like a skittish cat poised to pounce. While she holds a sharp tongue and an even sharper schedule, those who know her well understand: beneath her constant nagging lies a deeply kind and dependable soul. She lives by a strict code—orderliness, punctuality, and meticulous planning—and expects nothing less from those around her. This often puts her at odds with Haesu, who endures her grumbling with remarkable patience. Despite their bickering, Max relies on Haesu more than she’s willing to admit. She also shares a close bond with Adora, her fellow graduate from the Eclipse Academy. Together, they operate like a perfectly synchronized pair. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Adora
characters.description: "...... So noisy." Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department Role: Operations Team 1 member Ability: Water manipulation Adora prefers silence over conversation and naps over action. Sensitive to noise and movement, she needs at least 12 hours of sleep a day—and will take any opportunity to sneak in more. She’s been caught sleeping while standing more than once, prompting Haesu to shout in horror, “It’s like she’s possessed by a demon!” She may grumble about Max’s constant scolding, but deep down, Adora considers her to be her closest friend. Their odd-couple dynamic—one wired like a ticking clock, the other always half-asleep—somehow just works. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Rianne
characters.description: "I distinctly ordered that securing the suspect must be the top priority." Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department Role: Operations Team 1 captain Ability: Wind manipulation Rianne is many things to Haesu—savior, mentor, and the closest thing to family she has left. A former pupil of Haesu’s late mother, Rianne took in both Haesu and Dallae during a time of political peril, raising them not as burdens, but as beloved younger siblings. Her exceptional skill and sharp instincts led to a rapid rise through the ranks. By her early 20s, she had earned the rare title of the Prophet’s exclusive escort—a position of unmatched honor and trust. Only two people in the world dare call the Prophet by name: Ricky, and Rianne. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Ricky
characters.description: "Sign here!!" Affiliation: Eclipse - Thoth Department Role: Chief Ability: Earth manipulation Ricky is the world’s foremost artifact engineer and jeweler—a genius whose innovations have reshaped both science and society. Alongside President Sabrina of Maat, she co-developed groundbreaking artifacts capable of producing supernatural phenomena without a natural gift. Her curiosity toward supernatural powers borders on obsession. To Ricky, people are only worth remembering if they possess something truly exceptional. Aside from the Prophet, Rianne, and Sabrina, she recalls no one by name—only “valuable specimens” earn her attention. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Chase
characters.description: "Shall I bring you the usual?" Affiliation: Eclipse - Café Rest Role: Manager Ability: The smile of an angel (or so they said) Chase manages Rest, the café nestled on the first floor of the Eclipse Facility—a rare oasis of calm amidst the chaos. It's a beloved hangout for Operations Team 1. With her gentle smile and soft-spoken charm, Chase has earned the quiet adoration of Eclipse’s roughest members. But there's one visitor she seems to treat just a little differently: Haesu. New menu items appear just for her, one after another—small, unspoken gestures that say more than words ever could. [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]"There's no point in knowing, you're going to die anyway." Nationality: Hathor Born into the lowest class of Hathor, the Nation of Fire, she knew only filth, starvation, and violence. In that pitiless world, one truth burned itself into her soul: Only the strong survive. If

characters.name: Harold
characters.description: "May God's blessings be with you." Nationality: Hathor During an undercover investigation at a noble-only party in the Nation of Water, Tefnut, Haesu and Dallae come across a striking figure—an enigmatic host. While all others conceal their faces with identical masks—preserving the anonymity demanded by the occasion—one woman defies the code. She wears an animal mask from Hathor, the Nation of Fire. A goat, no less—a symbol long entwined with danger and darkness. Her presence is elegant, refined... and entirely wrong. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Seo-an
characters.description: "An imbalance of power often sows the seeds of misfortune." Nationality: Bastet Role: Ruler Ability: Mind control Seo-an is a natural-born politician who rose to power at an unusually young age, swiftly becoming the ruler of Bastet. Through quiet cunning and tireless planning, she secured the dominance of her literati families over the nation’s governance—and has kept it ever since. Her personal motto, “Slow and steady wins the race,” isn’t just a saying. It’s her strategy. She approaches every goal with deliberate precision, never rushing, always calculating. Each move is careful. Each silence, intentional. And perhaps, beneath that flawless control… a flicker of envy toward Haesu lingers. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Khalifa
characters.description: "The scorching sun will illuminate our future...!" Nationality: Tefnut Role: Sultan Ability: Sand manipulation Khalifa embodies the essence of Tefnut in its boldest form: radiant, proud, and unapologetically indulgent. To her, the world’s treasures—gold, jewels, even people—are hers by nature. Humility doesn’t exist in her vocabulary. She is the kind of woman who flaunts what others would hide, and gives away what others would hoard. Her insatiable urge to collect knows no bounds, living beings included. Some call her arrogant. Others, reckless. And yet, despite her extravagance, she is adored by the masses—thanks in no small part to her staggering philanthropy (and, let’s be honest, her beauty). During a diplomatic visit to the Land of Solar, Khalifa caught sight of Haesu… and smiled. Some say it was curiosity. Others say it was the look of a collector who’s just found her next prize. [

characters.name: Maeghan
characters.description: "I heard you made another foolish mistake, 'Prophet.'" Nationality: Hathor Role: King Ability: Blue Flame manipulation To Maeghan, supernatural power is not merely strength—it is sacred. A gift from the divine, proof of rightful supremacy. She believes those who wield such power are destined to rule, and none more so than herself. Wielding the legendary Blue Flames, she claims the title of the true sovereign—chosen to unite all nations under a single banner. Among the Four Rulers, Maeghan has ruled the longest. Her flames have never dimmed. Neither has her ambition. Her rule is not built on mercy. It is forged in fire. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Sabrina
characters.description: "Distinguish whether what you seek is truly peace, or simply the satisfaction of your selfish desires." Nationality: Maat Role: President Ability: Photographic memory Sabrina, President of Maat, is one of the most respected leaders in the world—celebrated for her groundbreaking scientific achievements and unwavering dedication to progress. Under her guidance, Maat has become a beacon of innovation and reason. Driven by a fierce commitment to knowledge and fairness, she champions inclusive governance, working to ensure that those without supernatural powers are never left behind. Together with Ricky, she co-developed artifacts capable of harnessing supernatural powers through machinery—redefining the limits of what technology and science can achieve. She's also one of the few people capable of holding a (relatively) normal conversation with Ricky. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Aben
characters.description: "Surely you haven't joined hands with that damned Khalifa?!" Nationality: Tefnut Role: Sovereign of House Chella Relation: Adora's mother [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Mittel
characters.description: "Your Grace, whom will you appoint?" Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department Role: Chief [From Twitter]

title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan
description: In “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan,” you play as Maria Ramirez, an American working in Japan as an English teacher. It’s a rewarding, fun job, and you’re beloved by students and coworkers alike–until suddenly, one day you lose your job. You work for a dispatch English teaching company, and they lost their contract with your school, just one month before the end of the school year. Out of nowhere, you must change the course of your life. You have a loving girlfriend to support you and other friends facing this alongside you, but ultimately you must make an extremely tough choice about your future. This game is based on the real-life experiences of English teachers throughout Japan, on issues that tens of thousands of people endure every single year, and is designed to provide an up-close viewpoint of what the dispatch contract system does to the individuals impacted. [From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554600/Life_of_a_Dispatch_English_Teacher_in_Japan/]Steam[/url]]

title: Guardian Recall ~Shugo Juu Shoukan~
title_original: ガーディアンリコール ～守護獣召還～
description: 1999: Japan is hit by a sudden earthquake and is left in ruins. 2017: After a period of reconstruction life in Japan nearly returns to normal. However Egubado, the organization behind the earthquake, occupies Tokyo and once again plots to destroy Japan. Take control of one of two groups of girls who have the ability to control guardian beasts and journey to Tokyo to put an end to Egubado's schemes.

characters.name: Amagi Miyuki
characters.description: Protagonist of the heaven route and master of the heaven type guardian Ten-Chan. A cheerful, but airheaded girl. She awakens to her guardian abilities during an attack on her school by Egubado and from that moment onward fights to protect what is dear to her.

characters.name: Daichi Yuuko
characters.description: Protagonist of the earth route and master of the earth type guardian Pochi. A biker with a strong sense of justice traveling throughout Japan. She awakens to her guardian after the hotel she was staying at was attacked and resolves to fight against Egubado ever since.

characters.name: Homura Mayu
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Miyuki's best friend and the master of the fire type guardian Kouen. Often finds herself exasperated at Miyuki's antics but supports her nonetheless.

characters.name: Kaibara Misato
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the water type guardian Mel. Seeks revenge against Egubado for their involvement in the murder of her father and disappearance of her childhood friend. Becomes especially close with Keiko. [spoiler]and becomes family her her during the epilogue.

characters.name: Hichiwa Keiko
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the wind type guardian Nagi. Has the ability to unconsciously read minds and had a troubled childhood because of it. Forms a very close bond with Misato throughout the course of the game. [spoiler]And becomes family her her during the epilogue.

characters.name: Hijiri Yukari
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the holy type guardian Nolt. Former member of the JSDF and the team brains. Logical to a fault and is capable of making difficult decisions if it's for the good of the group. She often butts heads with Yuuko due to their contrasting personalities, but cares for her deeply despite that.

characters.name: Ikazuchi Akira
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the lighting type guardian Zabitan. Tokusatsu otaku and rock singer of justice. A tokusatsu maniac to the point where she can't help but act like a hero of justice and never fails to have a dramatic speech ready. Fights against Egubado to be just like the heroes she admires.

characters.name: Takegami
characters.description: Optional boss character and a unlockable character in the PSX version. Master of the heaven type guardian Gohoudouji. A warrior that seeks to challenge the strong.

characters.name: Suou Chikana
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the earth type guardian Gaou. She was fighting against Egubado before the game's start an recruits Miyuki open learning of her abilities. Plays the role of the team's big sis.

characters.name: Hinokage Ran
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the lighting type guardian Zekuu. Raised in the same orphanage as Kaoru and is her best friend, but is separated from her at the game's start when she captured by Egubado.

characters.name: Ichinomiya Suzune
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the holy type guardian Dogar. The more cheerful and outgoing of the Ichinomiya twins. Her powers don't work unless she is with her sister.

characters.name: Naoe Hasumi
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the dark type guardian Kanetsugu. Was Yukari's mentor on how to use a guardian. She allows herself to get captured at the start of the game in order to allow Yui to escape during one of Egubado's attacks.

characters.name: Iwamizawa Yui
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the holy type guardian Saiki. A descendant of a long line of protectors. Joins Yuuko's team in order to save Naoe.

characters.name: Shizunai Sayaka
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the water type guardian Archer. Akira's number one fan, a airheaded lady that goes at her own pace much to the chagrin of those around her.

characters.name: Kodomari Kaoru
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the wind type guardian Fudou. Was raised in the same orphanage as her best friend Ran. After Ran is kidnapped she joins Yuuko's group to find her.

characters.name: Hiraizumi Ruri
characters.description: Joins in the earth route. Master of the lighting type guardian Kirara. Boy crazy, but her luck with men is horrible due to Egubado's attacks interfering with all of her dates. [spoiler]Has the reputation of being the only character with a straight sex scene in a otherwise yuri game.

characters.name: Ichinomiya Kotone
characters.description: Joins in the heaven route. Master of the fire type guardian Gara. The more shy and reserved of the Ichinomiya sisters. Her powers don't work unless she is with her sister.

characters.name: Jin Hitomi
characters.description: A member of Egubado. Master of the dark type guardian Kokuryuu. Has a long history with her superior Megumi. Has a negative outlook on life. [spoiler]But after a meeting with Miyuki she begins to have hope for the future and eventually betrays Egubado. Joins after Miyuki's and Yuuko's group meet each other.

characters.name: Hanzawa Yumi
characters.description: Tomomi's subordinate and a villain in the heaven route. Master of the water type guardian Wool. [spoiler]Misato's childhood friend. Was unintentionally responsible for the deaths of her parents and Misato's father. Was taken in by Egubado shortly after.

characters.name: Kagami Ryouko
characters.description: Villain in the earth route. Master of the heaven type guardian Donald. Trouble making member of Egubado that constantly gets in Yuuko's way with schemes that always blow up in her face.

characters.name: Nanjou Tomomi
characters.description: A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the fire type guardian Suzaku. She has a fondness towards cute girls, but is a sadistic women who only sees them as playthings for her to monopolize.

characters.name: Hokuto Megumi
characters.description: A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the earth type guardian Genbu. A cold blooded and calculating woman. Is especially fond of her subordinate and long time friend Jin. [spoiler]After Jin's betrayal she loses her calm personality as she becomes obsessed with getting revenge.

characters.name: Saionji Reiko
characters.description: A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the lighting type guardian Byakko. A vain woman who thinks nothing of others and is only concerned with her own appearance.

characters.name: Azuma Satomi
characters.description: A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the water type guardian Seiryuu. Has hidden feelings for Megumi and a deep resentment towards Jin for her relationship with her.

characters.name: Ryuukihi
characters.description: Egubado's leader. A woman shrouded in mystery.
